title: Designing, Deployment and Field Testing of C2Stack for Networked Intelligent Software-Defined UAVs
summary:
Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are emerging as critical enablers of next-generation wireless networking and autonomous systems. Despite their potential, deploying and testing networked UAV systems in real-world environments remains challenging, largely due to the absence of well-developed, end-to-end, ready-to-use protocol stacks. To fill this gap, we present C2Stack, a configurable protocol stack and experimental framework designed for real-time control, evaluation, and optimization of UAV networks. C2Stack incorporates a modular control plane, referred to as the~C2Stack Network Operating System (CNOS), alongside a programmable data plane that exposes APIs for cross-layer algorithm development, digital twin integration, and autonomous swarm control.
  In this article, we share our experience with the deployment and testing of C2Stack. We implemented C2Stack on a custom UAV swarm platform that integrates multiprocessor system-on-chip (MPSoC) radios with Intel NUC computing modules, enabling interoperability with various RF front ends. Field trials were conducted in both netted environments and large-scale outdoor test ranges, focusing on two representative use cases: (i) network utility maximization through online reinforcement learning, and (ii) collaborative interference source localization. The experiments demonstrate the feasibility of real-time, data-driven optimization in dynamic aerial environments, while also revealing practical challenges in field deployments of networked UAV systems, including power constraints, sensing limitations, and deployment logistics. We have made C2Stack source code available to the community under the MIT License, with the goal of establishing it as a foundational framework for experimental research on intelligent networked aerial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了C2Stack，一个可配置的协议栈和实验框架，专为无人机网络（UAV networks）的实时控制、评估和优化而设计。该框架包含模块化控制平面（CNOS）和可编程数据平面，支持跨层算法开发、数字孪生集成和自主集群控制。作者在自制无人机平台上实现了C2Stack，并在围网环境和大型室外测试场进行了现场试验，验证了两个代表性用例（在线强化学习驱动的网络效用最大化、协作式干扰源定位）的可行性，同时揭示了实际部署中遇到的功耗、感知和物流等挑战。源代码已在MIT许可证下开源。
AI.motivation: 无人机正在成为下一代无线网络和自主系统的关键使能技术，但在真实环境中部署和测试网络化无人机系统仍然困难，主要原因是缺乏成熟的、端到端的、可直接使用的协议栈。作者旨在填补这一空白，为无人机网络实验研究提供一个基础框架。
AI.method: C2Stack采用模块化架构：控制平面为C2Stack网络操作系统（CNOS），数据平面可编程并对外开放API，支持跨层算法开发、数字孪生集成和自主集群控制。系统实现基于定制无人机集群平台，结合多处理器片上系统（MPSoC）无线电和Intel NUC计算模块，可与多种RF前端互操作。通过两个用例（在线强化学习网络效用最大化、协作干扰源定位）在两个环境中进行现场验证。
AI.result: 实验证明了在动态空中环境中进行实时、数据驱动优化的可行性，同时也揭示了现场部署网络化无人机系统的实际挑战，包括功率限制、传感局限性和部署后勤问题。
AI.conclusion: C2Stack作为智能网络化空中系统实验研究的基础框架，已在MIT许可证下向社区开源，旨在推动该领域的进一步研究和应用。

title: Hybrid Offline-Online Multi-Agent Decision Transformers for Wireless Resource Management
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications in Aug 2026. The offline training part was presented at the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
summary: This paper develops a hybrid offline-online multi-agent reinforcement learning framework based on decision transformers. The policy is first pretrained offline via supervised sequence modeling of trajectories generated by existing policies, providing a safe and sample-efficient initialization. It is then fine-tuned online using a hybrid objective that incorporates critic-guided gradients, enabling performance improvements beyond the offline policy. To facilitate stable offline-to-online transfer and effective multi-agent coordination, the framework incorporates return-weighted sampling, a critic conditioned on neighbors' actions, and neighborhood-correlated exploration. The approach is fully distributed: both training and execution rely only on local observations and limited information exchange among neighboring agents. Evaluations with dynamic traffic arrivals in two settings: (i) joint scheduling and power allocation and (ii) coordinated beamforming, show that the proposed method achieves quality-of-service (QoS) performance comparable to centralized methods. Moreover, when pretrained on lower-quality datasets, online fine-tuning is also observed to surpass the initial offline policy. These results demonstrate a promising learning-based alternative for wireless resource management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于决策变换器的混合离线-在线多智能体强化学习框架，用于无线资源管理。策略首先通过离线监督序列建模预训练，然后通过结合评论家引导梯度的混合目标进行在线微调，在两种无线场景中实现了与集中式方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 无线资源管理中的多智能体强化学习方法通常面临样本效率低、安全性不足以及离线到在线迁移不稳定等问题，需要一种既能安全初始化又能持续提升性能的框架。
AI.method: 采用决策变换器进行离线预训练，使用包含评论家引导梯度的混合目标在线微调，并集成返回加权采样、邻居动作条件评论家和邻域相关探索等机制，实现完全分布式的训练和执行。
AI.result: 在联合调度与功率分配以及协调波束赋形两个动态流量场景中，该方法达到与集中式方法相当的QoS性能；在低质量数据集上预训练后，在线微调也能超越初始离线策略。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了学习型方法作为无线资源管理有前景替代方案的潜力，兼顾了样本效率、安全初始化和持续性能提升。

title: Adaptive RIS-aided Communications through ML-based Generation of Phase Masks
summary: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RISs) are an attractive technology for Millimeter Wave (mmWave) communications due to their ability to passively reflect incident signals. However, current implementations of RIS rely on performing computationally-intensive algorithms offline to generate phase masks, which are stored as a codebook on the embedded microcontroller on the RIS. The codebook size is restricted by the embedded microcontroller's storage capacity, which limits the ability of the RIS to adapt to evolving channel conditions and deployment scenarios. In this demo, we showcase an Machine Learning (ML)-based solution for dynamically generating new phase masks during runtime. Our approach leverages a ML model deployed on the microcontroller for approximating the output of a phase mask generation algorithm, responding to new inputs while remaining smaller than a codebook.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种基于机器学习（ML）的动态相控掩模生成方案，部署在RIS的嵌入式微控制器上，用于在运行时实时生成新的相控掩模，替代传统依赖预存码本的方法，克服码本存储容量限制，使RIS能更好地适应动态变化的信道条件和部署场景。
AI.motivation: 当前的RIS实现依赖离线计算生成相控掩模，并以码本形式存储在嵌入式微控制器上。由于微控制器存储容量有限，码本大小受限，导致RIS难以适应快速变化的信道条件和多样化的部署场景。因此需要一种能够在运行时动态生成相控掩模的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种基于ML的解决方案，将ML模型部署在微控制器上，用于近似逼近相控掩模生成算法的输出。该模型能够在运行时接收新输入并生成新的相控掩模，同时其体积小于传统码本。
AI.result: 展示了ML模型能够成功部署在嵌入式微控制器上并动态生成相控掩模，模型体积小于码本，并且能够在运行时响应新输入，克服了存储容量限制。
AI.conclusion: 基于ML的动态相控掩模生成方案为RIS提供了一种更灵活、更自适应的实现方式，有望替代传统码本方法，提升RIS在实际部署中应对动态环境的适应能力。

title: Performance Analysis of Time-Delay Systems under External Perturbations Using Output-to-Output Gain
summary: Communication delays are inherent in networked control systems and may significantly affect closed-loop performance. This paper investigates the impact of external perturbations in observer-based linear systems with delayed measurements and control signals using the output-to-output gain (OOG) framework. By employing dissipativity theory and Lyapunov--Krasovskii functionals, delay-dependent linear matrix inequality conditions are derived that provide explicit upper bounds on the OOG for systems with independent delays in measurement and actuation channels. In addition, two special classes of constant-delay systems are considered: Padé-approximated systems and finite-dimension reducible systems. Numerical examples illustrate the applicability of the proposed approaches

AI.tldr: 本文利用输出到输出增益（OOG）框架研究具有测量和控制信号延迟的观测器线性系统中外部扰动的影响，通过耗散理论和Lyapunov-Krasovskii泛函推导出时滞相关的LMI条件，为测量和驱动通道独立延迟的系统提供OOG显式上界。
AI.motivation: 通信延迟在网络化控制系统中固有存在，会显著影响闭环性能。现有研究对带有延迟测量和控制信号的观测器系统的外部扰动影响分析尚不充分，需要系统的框架来量化这种影响。
AI.method: 采用输出到输出增益（OOG）框架进行分析；结合耗散理论和Lyapunov-Krasovskii泛函；推导时滞依赖的线性矩阵不等式（LMI）条件；针对测量和驱动通道的独立延迟给出OOG显式上界；同时考虑两类特殊常数延迟系统：Padé近似系统和有限维可约系统。
AI.result: 推导出可为测量与驱动通道独立延迟系统提供OOG显式上界的时滞依赖LMI条件，并通过数值算例验证了所提出方法的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于OOG框架和LMI的方法能够有效量化网络化控制系统中通信延迟对闭环性能（尤其是外部扰动影响）的影响，为延迟系统的性能分析提供了理论工具。

title: Modeling of Network Constraints in Large-scale Capacity Expansion Optimization of Power Grids
summary: Capacity expansion modeling plays a critical role in optimizing the deployment of new generation, storage, and transmission, typically at national and regional levels. To support long-term planning, these models consider a large set of energy technologies and policies, along with decades of weather and demand data. Realistic capacity expansion models thus become high-dimensional optimization problems, with hundreds of millions of variables and constraints, which are challenging to solve. A common strategy to address this complexity is to omit non-linear, non-convex AC optimal power flow (ACOPF) constraints and instead use linearized power balance equations or transport formulations. While these simplifications improve tractability, they limit our understanding of how power flow and the physical properties of power networks impact investment decisions across generation, storage, and transmission infrastructure. This paper addresses this gap by extending the GenX capacity expansion model to incorporate fixed point theorem-based network constraints. These embed ACOPF-based considerations while maintaining the tractability of the planning model, nearly preserving the dimensionality of the transport formulation and incurring only modest runtime increases. This approach is much cheaper than embedding ACOPF directly, making it appropriate for large-scale capacity planning problems. We compare our approach to the original transport-based GenX model as well as a non-linear, non-convex version that incorporates the full ACOPF constraints, for a case study of the ISO New England grid.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了GenX容量扩展模型，通过引入基于不动点定理的网络约束来嵌入ACOPF（交流最优潮流）的考虑，在保持规划模型可解性的同时，相比仅用传输模型更准确地反映电网物理特性对投资决策的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统的容量扩展模型为追求可解性而省略非线性非凸的ACOPF约束，使用线性化功率平衡或传输公式，但这限制了人们对电网潮流和网络物理特性如何影响发电、储能和输电投资决策的理解。
AI.method: 在GenX容量扩展模型中引入基于不动点定理的网络约束，这些约束嵌入ACOPF的考量，同时保持规划模型的可处理性，几乎不增加维度，仅带来适度的运行时间增加。该方法比直接嵌入ACOPF更廉价，适用于大规模容量规划问题。
AI.result: 通过与原始基于传输的GenX模型及包含完整ACOPF约束的非线性非凸版本的对比，在ISO新英格兰电网案例研究中验证了该方法的有效性。该方法在合理运行时间内嵌入了ACOPF约束的考量。
AI.conclusion: 基于不动点定理的网络约束提供了一种折中方案，既能在大规模容量扩展规划中考虑ACOPF相关的物理约束，又不会导致计算成本过高，弥补了传输模型与完整ACOPF模型之间的鸿沟。

title: Improving Swaption Calibration in Factor HJM Stochastic Volatility Models: A First-Order Correction to Frozen Swap-Rate Loadings
summary: The factor HJM stochastic volatility model introduced by Sepp and Rakhmonov (2025) obtains tractable swaption pricing by freezing the nonlinear swap-rate loading along a deterministic expected-state path. This removes the dependence of conditional swap-rate variance on the current yield-curve state. We introduce a first-order Taylor correction to the loading that adds no calibration parameters. Conditional on retaining the frozen annuity-measure drift, we show that the first variation of the swap-rate transform is affine in the centered rate states and reduces to one-dimensional equations in volatility. For quadratic-drift lognormal stochastic volatility, these equations yield a finite-dimensional ODE representation and a direct log-volatility formulation. Calibrations to independently generated nonlinear-model prices show substantially lower stochastic volatility parameter bias and held-out pricing error, with only modest changes in local calibration identifiability.

AI.tldr: 本文对Sepp和Rakhmonov (2025)提出的因子HJM随机波动率模型引入一阶泰勒修正，修正swap-rate负荷的确定性预期状态路径近似，在不增加校准参数的前提下显著降低随机波动率参数偏差和样本外定价误差。
AI.motivation: Sepp和Rakhmonov (2025)的因子HJM随机波动率模型通过冻结非线性swap-rate负荷在确定性预期状态路径上实现可解的swaption定价，但这一近似消除了条件swap-rate方差对当前收益率曲线状态的依赖，导致参数偏差和定价误差。
AI.method: 对swap-rate负荷引入一阶泰勒修正，该修正不增加任何校准参数；在保留冻结年金测度漂移的条件下，证明swap-rate变换的一阶变分关于中心化利率状态是仿射的，并可约化为关于波动率的一维方程；对于二次漂移对数正态随机波动率，这些方程可表示为有限维ODE和直接对数波动率形式。
AI.result: 对独立生成的非线性模型价格进行校准，结果表明该方法大幅降低了随机波动率参数偏差和样本外定价误差，而局部校准可识别性仅发生适度变化。
AI.conclusion: 一阶泰勒修正显著提升了因子HJM随机波动率模型在冻结路径近似下的定价精度，且无需额外参数，在实际校准中保持了良好的可识别性。

title: When Can We Work in Embedding Space? What Text Embeddings Preserve
summary: When do text embeddings work as inputs to empirical analysis? Their use rests on an assumption: that we can trade text for its low-dimensional embedding, and lose little in doing so. I make that assumption precise under a generative model in which documents are mixtures of latent topics. I study two uses---clustering units in embedding space and controlling for high-dimensional text. A cluster of embeddings is a set of documents with similar topic mixtures; controlling for the embedding is equivalent to controlling for the topic mixture, so validity reduces to whether that mixture captures the confounding. In an application to 363 U.S. metropolitan areas, embedding-based clusters of LLM-generated economic descriptions recover interpretable economic archetypes and separate local employment dynamics more sharply than clustering on model residuals, or on a curated set of industry and demographic covariates.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了文本嵌入在实证分析中作为输入的适用条件。在潜在主题混合的生成模型框架下，作者阐明了嵌入聚类和文本控制两种用途的有效性假设，并通过美国363个大都市区的LLM生成经济描述数据验证了嵌入聚类的优越性。
AI.motivation: 文本嵌入在实证分析中被广泛使用，但其有效性前提（以低维嵌入替代原始文本不丢失信息）从未被精确刻画。作者希望明确这一假设，并为嵌入的两种典型用途（聚类和控制变量）提供理论基础。
AI.method: 在生成模型下将文档建模为潜在主题的混合，证明嵌入聚类等价于识别具有相似主题混合的文档，而控制嵌入等价于控制主题混合。随后在363个美国大都市区的LLM生成经济描述数据上进行实证应用，比较嵌入聚类与模型残差聚类及传统协变量聚类的效果。
AI.result: 嵌入聚类能够恢复可解释的经济原型（archetypes），并且在区分地方就业动态方面比基于模型残差或人口/行业协变量的聚类更为显著和清晰。
AI.conclusion: 文本嵌入在实证分析中的有效性取决于主题混合是否捕捉了混淆因素；在具体应用中，基于LLM生成文本的嵌入聚类展现了优于传统方法的性能，支持了该方法在实证研究中的价值。

title: Quantitative Target Convergence and Uniform-in-Time Propagation of Chaos for Langevin-Regularized SVGD
summary:
We establish quantitative convergence to the target and uniform-in-time propagation of chaos for Langevin-regularized Stein variational gradient descent. The Stein interaction need not be small relative to the confining Langevin drift and does not generally yield a contractive particle coupling. At the mean-field level, the Stein and Langevin components dissipate the same relative entropy in the kernel-induced Stein and $2$-Wasserstein geometries, producing the squared kernel Stein discrepancy and relative Fisher information. Under a log-Sobolev inequality for the target, this yields exponential last-iterate convergence. We also derive a finite-particle entropy identity relative to the product target, giving exponential-in-time convergence of the empirical measure up to polynomial sampling errors.
  For propagation of chaos, we develop two complementary finite-time approaches. A synchronous coupling, combined with exponential moment estimates for the nonlinear mean-field diffusion, yields explicit single-exponential bounds in Wasserstein distance and kernel Stein discrepancy (KSD). Moving-product entropy gives joint-law relative entropy control relative to the evolving mean-field product law and, through entropy superadditivity and concentration, fixed-marginal relative entropy and total variation bounds and empirical KSD estimates. Under an additional $T_2$ inequality for the initial law, it also yields Wasserstein bounds. Combining these finite-time estimates with target convergence at a logarithmic cutoff time gives polynomial uniform-in-time propagation of chaos rates in expectation for empirical KSD and $W_2^2$, and for fixed-marginal total variation and $W_2^2$. All bounds control the last iterate in physical time. We also compare the two finite-time mechanisms and identify regimes in which each gives the sharper polynomial exponent.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了Langevin正则化Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）的定量收敛性和时间一致传播混沌（uniform-in-time propagation of chaos）理论。作者证明了在均场层面上，Stein与Langevin分量分别通过核诱导的Stein几何和2-Wasserstein几何耗散相同形式的相对熵，从而在目标满足log-Sobolev不等式时获得指数级最后迭代收敛。对于传播混沌，论文发展了同步耦合和移动乘积熵两种互补的有限时间方法，并结合目标收敛在对数截止时间上的估计，得到了关于经验KSD和Wasserstein距离的多项式时间一致传播混沌率。
AI.motivation: Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）是贝叶斯推断中的核心采样算法，但对其理论保证的理解仍不完整。已有工作通常要求Stein相互作用相对于Langevin约束漂移很小，或依赖于收缩性的粒子耦合，这限制了理论的适用范围。本文旨在去除这些限制条件，建立更一般条件下的定量收敛性和传播混沌结论。
AI.method: 论文的方法包含两大方面：（1）均场层面：利用核诱导Stein几何与2-Wasserstein几何中的相对熵耗散结构，分别产生平方核Stein散度（KSD）和相对Fisher信息，在log-Sobolev不等式下获得指数收敛。（2）有限粒子层面（传播混沌）：a) 同步耦合方法，结合非线性均场扩散的指数矩估计，获得Wasserstein距离和KSD的显式单指数界；b) 移动乘积熵方法，控制联合分布相对于演化均场乘积分布的相对熵，利用熵超可加性和集中不等式获得固定边缘相对熵、总变差和经验KSD界。最后将有限时间估计与目标收敛在对数截止时间上的结合，得到多项式时间一致传播混沌率。
AI.result: 论文获得了以下主要结果：（1）均场水平上，在目标满足log-Sobolev不等式下，最后迭代指数收敛；（2）有限粒子水平上，推导了相对于乘积目标的熵恒等式，给出经验测度的时间指数收敛（含多项式采样误差）；（3）两种传播混沌方法各自给出了显式的有限时间界；（4）结合目标收敛，获得了经验KSD和W_2^2的期望多项式时间一致传播混沌率；（5）对两种有限时间机制进行了比较，识别了各自给出更优多项式指数的参数区域。
AI.conclusion: 本文在不需要Stein相互作用相对于Langevin漂移较小的假设下，建立了Langevin正则化SVGD的完整理论框架，涵盖了均场收敛、有限粒子传播混沌以及时间一致性的定量估计。这项工作显著推进了对SVGD类算法理论性质的理解，为实际应用提供了更坚实的理论支撑。

title: NLP-Driven Knowledge Extraction and Thematic Classification of Translated Ancient Indian Medical Texts
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Presented at the National Conference on "Reimagining LIS Education: Integrating Indian Knowledge Systems with NEP 2020" (March 2025), organized by Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) and the Indian Association of Teachers of Library and Information Science (IATLIS). Recipient of the Best Paper Award
summary: Ancient Indian medical texts like Sushruta Samhita have extensive information on diseases, treatments, and surgical techniques. Yet, their ancient format and use of intricate vocabulary pose difficulties in accessibility and systematic ordering. The research here utilizes Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods like Named Entity Recognition (NER), BERTopic modeling, and Knowledge Graph development in Neo4j to extract, categorize, and visualize important concepts based on translated versions. Thematic classification with BERTopic allows for the identification of the underlying medical topics, whereas NER supports the structured entity recognition of diseases, treatments, researchers, and medicinal plants. Graphbased network analysis with Neo4j also allows for the semantic representation of relationship among extracted entities, supporting knowledge retrieval and digital preservation. The findings illustrate how graph databases, topic modeling, and entity recognition facilitate the computational organization of Ayurveda's historical medical wisdom, closing the gap between the conventional texts and contemporary data-driven inquiry. The suggested method promotes historical text analysis, medical informatics, and digital humanities to make ancient Indian medical wisdom more accessible and understandable.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用NLP技术（NER、BERTopic主题建模和Neo4j知识图谱）对古印度医学文献《Sushruta Samhita》进行数字化组织，实现疾病、治疗、药用植物等概念的提取、分类和可视化，从而弥合古代医学文本与现代数据驱动研究之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 古印度医学文本（如《Sushruta Samhita》）蕴含丰富的疾病、治疗和外科技术信息，但其古老的格式和复杂的词汇结构导致可访问性差、难以系统整理，亟需计算手段来提升其可读性和可用性。
AI.method: 综合运用三种NLP方法：1）BERTopic主题建模对医学内容进行主题分类；2）命名实体识别（NER）结构化提取疾病、治疗、研究者、药用植物等实体；3）Neo4j知识图谱进行基于图的网络分析，构建实体间的语义关系表示。
AI.result: 研究证明图数据库、主题建模和实体识别相结合能够有效实现Ayurveda历史医学知识的计算化组织，支持知识检索和数字保存，成功构建了古代医学文本与现代数据分析之间的桥梁。
AI.conclusion: 该方法推动了历史文本分析、医学信息学和数字人文的交叉发展，使古印度医学智慧更加易于获取和理解，为传统医学文献的数字化转型提供了可借鉴的框架。

title: DS-Lighting: Making Agent Harnesses Explicit for Data-Science Automation
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise for automating data-science workflows, yet their end-to-end performance depends critically on the agent harness that represents tasks, manages execution state, constrains output artifacts, and provides evaluation feedback. Existing data-science agents often leave this harness implicit, making results difficult to reproduce, compare, and attribute across heterogeneous tasks. We introduce DS-Lighting, a unified harness toolkit that makes harness design explicit for data-science automation. DS-Lighting decomposes the harness into four reusable layers: data, workflow, execution, and evaluation, and represents diverse agents as executable operator programs that support both predefined pipelines and adaptive search. We further integrate multiple open-source data-science benchmarks into an MLE-Bench-style task format, enabling controlled comparison under a shared task interface, sandboxed runtime, and metric protocol. Experiments across agents, harnesses, models, and ablations show that explicit harness design improves reproducibility, comparability, and reliability, while reducing avoidable system-level failures in end-to-end data-science workflows. Our code is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/dslighting

AI.tldr: 本文提出DS-Lighting，一个用于数据科学自动化任务的统一显式harness工具包。它将harness设计分解为数据、工作流、执行和评估四个可复用层，将多种智能体表示为可执行的算子程序，并整合多个开源基准到MLE-Bench风格的任务格式中，从而提升可复现性、可比较性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有数据科学智能体的end-to-end性能高度依赖于harness设计（任务表示、执行状态管理、输出约束、评估反馈），但大多数智能体的harness是隐式的，导致结果难以复现、比较和归因。
AI.method: 将harness分解为四个可复用层（数据、工作流、执行、评估）；将多样智能体表示为可执行算子程序，支持预定义流水线和自适应搜索；整合多个开源数据科学基准为统一的MLE-Bench风格任务格式，提供共享任务接口、沙箱运行环境和统一指标协议。
AI.result: 跨智能体、harness、模型和消融实验表明，显式harness设计能提升可复现性、可比较性和可靠性，并减少端到端数据科学工作流中可避免的系统级故障。
AI.conclusion: 显式化harness设计对数据科学自动化至关重要，DS-Lighting提供了统一且可复用的工具包，为后续研究与基准比较奠定了基础。

title: ERR+: Sequential Entropy Resolution for Efficient and Decisive LLM Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on complex tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought (CoT) traces via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). While current RLVR methods have achieved strong results with correctness-based reward signals, they provide limited guidance on the quality of the reasoning process itself, leaving the internal reasoning structure largely unoptimized. Through empirical analysis across multiple model families, we identify a consistent pattern: correct reasoning trac es exhibit more frequent and larger token-level entropy drops within the thinking phase than incorrect ones. We propose ERR+, a two-phase RLVR framework grounded in this observation. The first phase trains with the Entropy Relief Reward (ERR), a bonus proportional to cumulative token-level entropy drops in the thinking phase, log-normalized by response length. Unlike prior methods that suppress entropy, ERR rewards the resolution of uncertainty while leaving exploratory high-entropy states unconstrained. The second phase introduces the Robust Relative Efficiency Reward, which scores each response's length against co-generated peers via a $\tanh$-transformed within-group $z$-score. We provide a formal analysis showing that joint optimization of the two objectives induces gradient conflict in early training, motivating the sequential design . Experiments on five datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in both accuracy and response conciseness across model backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/XrkArul/err_response

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERR+，一个两阶段强化学习推理框架。第一阶段使用熵释放奖励（ERR）奖励思考阶段中token级别熵的累积下降（按响应长度对数归一化），第二阶段使用鲁棒相对效率奖励，通过tanh变换的组内z-score对响应简洁性进行评分。实验在五个数据集上展示了一致的准确率和响应简洁性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLVR方法虽使用正确性奖励信号取得了强结果，但对推理过程本身的质量提供了有限指导，内部推理结构基本未优化。作者通过实证分析发现正确推理轨迹在思考阶段表现出更频繁且更大的token级熵下降，这成为设计更优训练信号的基础。
AI.method: 两阶段RLVR框架：(1) 第一阶段使用熵释放奖励（ERR），奖励思考阶段累计token级熵下降，按响应长度对数归一化，保留高熵探索状态；(2) 第二阶段引入鲁棒相对效率奖励，用tanh变换的组内z-score对每个响应的长度进行评分（相对于同批次生成的响应）。作者通过正式分析证明了联合优化两个目标会在早期训练中引发梯度冲突，因此采用顺序设计。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上的实验表明，ERR+在多个模型骨干上均实现了一致的准确率和响应简洁性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将推理过程中的熵变化（不确定性消解）作为训练信号，ERR+能更好地优化推理过程的质量而不仅是结果正确性，同时通过两阶段设计避免了联合优化中的梯度冲突问题。

title: The Brand War: A Gamified AI-Feedback System for Time-Limited EFL Writing
summary: Writing is cognitively demanding and anxiety-provoking for English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners, especially under time pressure. This paper presents The Brand War, a web-based gamified writing application combining competitive game mechanics with iterative GPT-4.1-powered formative feedback for undergraduate EFL learners completing a timed narrative writing task. Students role-play as marketing interns competing for a job offer, using review passes to receive AI feedback, attack opponents, or shield their own passes while drafting a 500-word brand story. We conducted an exploratory single-session classroom study with 29 university EFL students in Taiwan to examine engagement patterns, whether iterative AI feedback improved writing performance across revisions, and how AI and human scores related to overall outcomes. Students wrote within 60 minutes, using up to five AI feedback passes before a final human-graded submission. Most (65.5%) used the AI feedback system, and within-student AI scores improved modestly across revisions (M = +3.7, SD = 7.4), with larger gains among students completing more cycles and significantly higher final- versus first-review scores among multi-cycle completers (p = .032). AI-assessed and human final scores showed strong convergent validity (r = 0.722, p < .001), and AI-feedback users scored descriptively, though not significantly, higher than non-users. Students maintained a high mean focus ratio (82.4%), and competitive mechanics were used sparingly, suggesting most prioritized writing over social interference even when available. Findings suggest embedding iterative AI scoring within a competitive game context is feasible and may scaffold writing improvement, with implications for EFL writing pedagogy and AI-mediated gamified learning design.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一款名为"The Brand War"的基于网页的游戏化写作应用，它将竞争机制与GPT-4.1驱动的形成性反馈相结合，用于台湾29名大学EFL学习者的限时叙事写作任务。研究发现62.4%的学生使用AI反馈系统，各修订轮次的AI评分略有改善，AI评分与人工评分高度相关(r=0.722)，且学生保持了高专注度(82.4%)。
AI.motivation: EFL学习者在限时写作中面临认知负荷高和写作焦虑的问题。现有研究缺乏将游戏化竞争机制与AI形成性反馈相结合来支持EFL限时写作的实证探索。
AI.method: 开发"The Brand War"网页游戏化写作应用，融合竞争游戏机制与GPT-4.1迭代反馈。开展探索性单次课堂实验研究，29名台湾大学EFL学生在60分钟内完成500字品牌故事写作，可最多使用五次AI反馈机会（用于获得反馈、攻击对手或保护自己），最终由人工评分。
AI.result: 65.5%的学生使用了AI反馈系统；学生内AI评分跨修订轮次适度提升(M=+3.7, SD=7.4)；完成多轮次的学生最终评分显著高于首次评分(p=0.032)；AI评分与人工评分强相关(r=0.722, p<0.001)；AI反馈使用者得分描述性更高但未达显著；学生平均专注度高达82.4%，竞争机制使用较少。
AI.conclusion: 将迭代AI评分嵌入竞争性游戏环境是可行的，可能有助于支撑写作改进。该研究对EFL写作教学法和AI介导的游戏化学习设计具有启示意义。

title: End-to-End Neural Shrinkage of Indefinite Pairwise Correlation Matrices for Small-Cap-Inclusive Portfolios
summary: Small-cap-inclusive equity universes contain recently listed and intermittently traded securities, so enforcing a common look-back discards a substantial fraction of the available information. Pairwise-complete estimation preserves the longest overlap for each asset pair, but the resulting correlation matrix can be indefinite because its entries are computed on different samples. This prevents direct use in Markowitz optimization and falls outside the assumptions of standard random-matrix shrinkage. We adapt a rotation-invariant neural covariance estimator to this setting. The model computes mask-aware marginal moments and a pairwise correlation matrix proxy, processes its signed spectrum, and uses a bidirectional gated recurrent unit conditioned on factor-aligned effective sample lengths derived from the overlap matrix and eigenvector loadings. It maps all eigenvalues, including negative ones, to a positive inverse spectrum. The reconstructed covariance is positive definite and is trained end-to-end to minimize five-day realized global-minimum-variance risk. We evaluate 26 expanding-window models from 2000 to 2025 on up to 1,500 U.S. equities in a closing-auction simulator with point-in-time selection, commissions, financing, corporate actions, and market impact. Across the 26-year out-of-sample period, the neural estimator reduces annualized five-day volatility by approximately 20\% and increases the Sharpe ratio by approximately 40\% relative to the next-best covariance estimator. These improvements are consistent across realized risk, risk-adjusted performance, and drawdown control, remain after the modeled execution frictions, and are supported by a 99.9\% Model Confidence Set that retains only the neural estimator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种旋转不变的神经协方差估计器，用于处理小市值股票中因交易稀少导致的成对完整估计（pairwise-complete estimation）产生的非正定相关矩阵问题。模型通过掩码感知的边际矩、成对相关矩阵代理、符号谱处理和基于因子对齐有效样本长度的双向GRU，将所有特征值（包括负值）映射为正的逆谱，从而重构正定协方差矩阵。在2000-2025年间26个扩展窗口模型中，该神经估计器相比次优估计器将5日年化波动率降低约20%，夏普比率提升约40%，并在99.9%的Model Confidence Set中保持唯一入选。
AI.motivation: 小盘股纳入的股票池包含新上市和间歇性交易的证券，统一回溯期会丢弃大量可用信息。成对完整估计虽然保留每对资产的最长重叠期，但计算得到的相关矩阵可能因不同样本而变成非正定矩阵，无法直接用于Markowitz优化，也超出了标准随机矩阵收缩方法的假设范围。
AI.method: 提出一种旋转不变的神经协方差估计器：1) 计算掩码感知的边际矩和成对相关矩阵代理；2) 处理其有符号谱；3) 使用双向GRU，以因子对齐的有效样本长度（源自重叠矩阵和特征向量载荷）为条件；4) 将所有特征值（包括负值）映射为正的逆谱，重构正定协方差；5) 端到端训练以最小化5日实现的全局最小方差风险。
AI.result: 在2000-2025年间26年样本外测试中（最多1500只美国股票，含拍卖模拟器、点对点选择、佣金、融资、公司行为和市场冲击），神经估计器相比次优协方差估计器将5日年化波动率降低约20%，夏普比率提升约40%。改进在实现风险、风险调整表现和回撤控制上一致，且在考虑了执行摩擦后仍然成立，并得到99.9%的Model Confidence Set支持（仅保留神经估计器）。
AI.conclusion: 该神经协方差估计器有效解决了非正定相关矩阵在协方差估计中的问题，通过将负特征值也映射到正逆谱实现正定保证，在真实市场约束下显著优于传统方法，展示了深度学习方法在不完整数据协方差估计中的强大潜力。

title: The Convergence Rate of Stochastic Tracking with Application to Optimal Execution
summary: We study the quadratic tracking problem of a general stochastic target process with absolutely continuous controls, with and without terminal constraint. We derive explicit, non-asymptotic upper bounds in terms of a Besov-type modulus of the target. These bounds yield sharp explicit rates that specialize to the square-root order for semimartingale targets. We then apply these results to a generalized Obizhaeva--Wang execution model with random terminal inventory. We first develop a Hilbert-space approach to characterize its optimal strategy, which includes jumps. To avoid such trading spikes, one regularizes the problem by a quadratic trading-rate penalty with coefficient $\varepsilon$. We then show that the regularized optimal execution cost---and therefore the excess price impact cost of the regularized optimal strategy---converges at the sharp rate $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$. Since the regularized optimal strategy is not available in closed form, we further construct a nearly optimal strategy which is readily implementable and shares the same approximation rate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一类一般随机目标过程的二次跟踪问题（含终端约束与无终端约束两种情况），推导出基于Besov型模量的显式非渐近上界，并获得了对半鞅目标具有平方根阶的尖锐收敛速率。随后将这些结果应用于带随机终端库存的广义Obizhaeva-Wang执行模型，通过Hilbert空间方法刻画最优策略（含跳跃），并通过二次交易率惩罚项进行正则化，证明正则化最优执行成本以O(√ε)的尖锐速率收敛，同时构造了可实现且具有相同逼近速率的近最优策略。
AI.motivation: 实际交易执行中，跟踪随机目标过程是最优执行问题的核心，但现有结果往往缺乏显式、非渐近的误差上界。同时广义Obizhaeva-Wang模型的最优策略可能包含跳跃（交易尖峰），这在实践中不可行，需要正则化处理并量化正则化带来的成本损失。
AI.method: 1) 利用Besov型模量刻画目标过程的路径光滑性，推导二次跟踪问题的显式非渐近上界；2) 对广义Obizhaeva-Wang模型建立Hilbert空间框架求解最优策略；3) 引入二次交易率惩罚项(系数ε)正则化问题，分析正则化前后成本差的收敛速率；4) 构造不依赖闭式解的、可直接实现的近最优策略。
AI.result: 得到了以Besov型模量表示的显式上界，对半鞅目标给出平方根阶的尖锐速率；正则化最优执行成本（以及超额价格冲击成本）以O(√ε)的尖锐速率收敛；所构造的近最优策略同样达到该逼近速率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为一般随机目标的二次跟踪问题提供了统一的显式误差分析框架，并成功应用于带随机终端库存的Obizhaeva-Wang执行模型，既解决了最优策略含跳跃的不可行性问题，又通过正则化与近最优策略的构造实现了理论最优性与实践可实现性的兼顾。

title: Two Kinds of Nothing: What Insignificant Results in Finance Actually Show
summary: Claims of the form "we find no evidence that X affects Y" appear throughout the applied finance literature, yet whether such a claim contains evidence of absence or absence of evidence depends entirely on its confidence interval. The term "statistically insignificant" is routinely read to mean zero economic effect. However, a more honest description is that zero could not be rejected along with a range of other coefficient effect sizes. The crucial question is whether effect sizes in that range are consequential. This note distinguishes two kinds of insignificant results that are indistinguishable in a standard regression table: bounded null claims where the intervals reject effect sizes of consequence and thus represent a genuine finding, and vacuous null claims where even consequential effects remain unrejected and therefore establish nothing. I propose a minimal reporting standard for regression results in applied finance, where the smallest consequential effect size is stated (in the units of the decision, per a named increment of the regressor) alongside the descriptive statistics and compared with the relevant edges of the confidence intervals of null claims. Using only the reported coefficient and standard error, authors can distinguish bounded (informative) null claims that reject consequential effect sizes from vacuous null claims that establish no information, perhaps due to deficiencies in data or the identification strategy. The symmetric phrase "no effect" conceals, in particular, the frequent split verdict: bounded in one direction, vacuous in the other. In ongoing work, I apply this framework to published null claims in leading finance journals, beginning with my own.

AI.tldr: 本文指出"无显著效应"的表述具有误导性，区分了两种看似相同但实质不同的无效结果：有界零假设（置信区间排除有实际意义的效应大小，属于真实发现）和空洞零假设（即使有实际意义的效应也未被排除，不提供任何信息）。作者提出一个最低报告标准：在回归结果中明确说明最小有意义效应大小，并将其与置信区间边界进行比较。
AI.motivation: 应用金融文献中大量出现"未发现X影响Y的证据"这类声明，但"统计不显著"常被误读为零经济效应。实际上，置信区间可能包含有实际意义的效应大小，也可能不包含。区分这两种情况对结论的有效性至关重要，但目前的标准回归表中无法区分它们。
AI.method: 作者提出一种基于置信区间分析的框架，将无效结果分为两类：有界零假设（区间排除了有意义的效应大小，代表真正的发现）和空洞零假设（有意义的效应仍未被排除，不建立任何结论）。提出最低报告标准：用决策单位明确最小有意义效应大小（按指定回归变量增量），与描述性统计并列，并与无效声明的置信区间边缘比较。只需报告系数和标准误即可进行区分。
AI.result: 该框架揭示了对称性表述"无效应"的误导性，特别是可能隐藏了常见的"分裂判决"——一个方向上是有界的，另一个方向上是空洞的。作者正在将该框架应用于领先金融期刊上已发表的无效声明，从自己的论文开始。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁应用金融领域采用更诚实的报告标准：不仅要报告系数和标准误，还要明确最小有意义效应大小，使读者能够判断"无效应"声明究竟是真实的发现（有界）还是空洞的（无信息）。这有助于避免将数据不足或识别策略缺陷误读为真实的零效应证据。

title: Recovering Posterior Beliefs in Credit Risk: A Latent-State EM Extension of the Information-Geometric Framework
summary: This paper develops a latent-state framework for recovering borrower-level posterior beliefs in credit-risk analysis. Creditworthiness and financial fragility are represented as latent dimensions, while observed borrower scores follow a finite Gaussian mixture model and default depends on the latent profile. Borrower-specific probabilities of default are obtained by averaging profile-specific default probabilities over the posterior distribution of latent states. A joint Expectation--Maximization procedure is used to estimate the mixture structure and the profile-specific default probabilities from observed score--default pairs. After estimation, predictive posterior beliefs are computed using the observed scores alone, thereby preserving the information available before default realization. A controlled simulation experiment evaluates the recovery of structural parameters, posterior beliefs, and borrower-level probabilities of default. Posterior distributions are interpreted as points on the probability simplex, and their recovery is assessed using both conventional error measures and information-geometric divergences. The results provide a controlled benchmark for studying the interaction between latent economic structure, posterior uncertainty, and credit-risk prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个潜在状态框架，用于在信用风险分析中恢复借款人层面的后验信念。信用度和财务脆弱性被视为潜在维度，借款人分数遵循有限高斯混合模型，违约取决于潜在画像。通过联合EM算法估计混合结构和画像特定违约概率，然后利用观测分数计算预测后验信念，并在模拟实验中评估其恢复效果。
AI.motivation: 在信用风险分析中，借款人真实的信用状况（信用度和财务脆弱性）是不可直接观测的潜在变量，而实际可观测的只有借款人评分和违约结果。传统方法可能忽略了潜在状态结构对违约预测的影响，因此需要一个能够显式建模潜在状态并恢复借款人级后验信念的框架，以更好地理解潜在经济结构与信用风险预测之间的交互。
AI.method: 采用潜在状态框架：将信用度和财务脆弱性建模为潜在维度，观测借款人分数服从有限高斯混合模型，违约概率取决于潜在画像。使用联合期望最大化（EM）算法同时估计混合结构和画像特定违约概率（基于观测分数-违约对）。估计后，仅利用观测分数计算预测后验信念，保留违约实现前的信息。后验分布被解释为概率单纯形上的点，恢复效果用常规误差度量和信息几何散度评估。
AI.result: 通过受控模拟实验验证了结构参数、后验信念和借款人级违约概率的恢复效果。实验提供了研究潜在经济结构、后验不确定性与信用风险预测之间相互作用的受控基准。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将潜在状态结构与信用风险预测相结合，能够在违约实现之前仅利用观测分数恢复借款人的后验信念，并通过信息几何视角对后验恢复质量进行更精细的评估，为后续研究提供了基准。

title: Optimal Block Time for AMM Liquidity Providers under Jump-Diffusion Prices
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at MARBLE 2026 (Lecture Notes in Operations Research, Springer); adds Appendix A with the full proofs of every numbered result and Appendix B with supporting illustrations. 25 pages, 2 figures
summary: Loss-versus-Rebalancing (LVR) is the dominant adverse-selection cost borne by liquidity providers on automated market makers. Under geometric Brownian motion, arbitrage profit scales with the probability of a profitable block, which vanishes as the block time $Δt \to 0$; this is the standing argument for ever-shorter blocks. Modeling the reference price instead as a jump-diffusion, I show that the constant-product LVR rate splits into a diffusion channel carrying the known multiplier $F(γ/(σ\sqrt{Δt}))$ and a jump channel $λV \cdot G(γ;m,δ^2)$ carrying no $Δt$, the two interacting only through an explicitly bounded remainder. The block schedule therefore governs only one channel. For symmetric jump laws the jump channel is moreover an exact lower bound, $\ell(Δt) \ge λV G > 0$, so the rate does not vanish as $Δt \to 0$, and descends slowly, as $\sqrt{Δt}$. At Ethereum's calibrated 12-second slot the rate is 471 bp/yr against a floor of 125, so only three quarters of LP loss is schedule-addressable. At Solana's 400 ms slot the jump channel already dominates. Netting the rate against per-block consensus cost, the LP-side optimal block time is invariant in pool size and in every jump parameter $(λ,m,δ)$: jumps shift the level of LP loss but not the planner's marginal tradeoff. Volatility, the fee tier, and consensus cost set the optimum, near 8 s. However, LVR is only one input to block-time welfare, so this bounds the LP-side contribution rather than settling the design question.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动做市商（AMM）中流动性提供者（LP）所承受的逆向选择成本LVR（Loss-versus-Rebalancing）。作者将参考价格建模为跳-扩散过程，证明LVR率可分解为扩散通道和跳跃通道两部分，其中跳跃通道不随区块时间Δt趋近于零而消失，而是存在严格正的下界。在以太坊12秒出块下，仅约四分之三的LP损失可通过调整出块时间改善；最佳出块时间约8秒，且对跳跃参数具有不变性。
AI.motivation: 现有理论在几何布朗运动假设下认为LVR随区块时间Δt→0而消失，这成为追求更短出块时间的论证基础。但现实中的参考价格并非连续扩散过程，而是包含跳跃（如新闻、清算、大额冲击等事件）。作者旨在检验跳跃的存在是否会颠覆"更短出块时间更好"的既有结论，并定量刻画跳跃对LVR的影响。
AI.method: 将参考价格建模为跳-扩散过程，将常量乘积AMM的LVR率分解为两个通道：扩散通道（携带已知乘子F(γ/(σ√Δt))）和跳跃通道（λV·G(γ;m,δ²)，不依赖Δt），两者仅通过一个有界余项相互作用。通过对称跳跃律证明跳跃通道是精确下界，推导出LVR率的渐近行为，并与每区块共识成本进行净额计算以求解LP侧最优出块时间。
AI.result: 对称跳跃律下LVR率满足ℓ(Δt)≥λV·G>0，不随Δt→0消失，且以√Δt的速率缓慢下降。以太坊12秒出块下LVR率为471基点/年，下限为125基点，仅四分之三的LP损失可通过出块时间调控。Solana 400毫秒出块下跳跃通道已占主导。LP侧最优出块时间对池规模和所有跳跃参数(λ,m,δ)不变，仅由波动率、费用层级和共识成本决定，约为8秒。
AI.conclusion: 跳跃的存在从根本上改变了"出块越快越好"的结论——LVR并不能通过缩短出块时间无限逼近零，而是存在不可消除的跳跃通道损失。但LVR只是出块时间福利的一个输入维度，该结果仅界定了LP侧的最优出块时间贡献，不能单独决定出块时间设计的最终方案。跳扩散模型为AMM的LVR分析提供了更贴近现实的价格动态假设，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Geodesic strong convexity does not imply forward invariance under gradient flow on SO(3): a certified counterexample
summary:
Let $mathcal{C}=\overline{\mathcal{B}}_ρ(R_c)$ be a geodesic ball of
  radius $ρ<π/2$ in SO(3) with the bi-invariant metric,
  and let $f$ be geodesically strongly convex on $\mathcal{C}$ with an
  interior minimizer.
  It is tempting to expect the gradient flow
  $\dot R=R(-\nabla f)^\wedge$ to keep $\mathcal{C}$ forward
  invariant: the flow is attracted to an interior point, and
  strong convexity appears to leave no room for outward motion.
  We show this expectation is false by an explicit, fully
  certified construction with $ρ=0.3$: a cost, quadratic in
  the principal logarithmic chart with off-diagonal coupling
  $0.7$, whose geodesic Hessian satisfies
  $\Hess f\succeqμI_3$ on all of $\mathcal{C}$ with a
  machine-certified modulus $μ\geq0.172$, rigorous ball arithmetic over exact rational inputs, yet whose descent
  velocity at a boundary point has the exact rational outward
  radial component $21/500$.
  A continuity corollary of the exact rate certifies that the
  flow exits the ball; numerical integration puts the peak
  excursion near $0.3143$ before convergence to the minimizer.
  The mechanism is elementary: strong convexity constrains the
  projection of the gradient onto the minimizer direction, not
  onto the inward radial direction.
  Code reproducing every certified constant and figure
  accompanies the note.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个显式构造反例，证明SO(3)上测地强凸函数在测地球内的梯度流并不一定保持球的前向不变性。作者给出了一个在半径为0.3的测地球上强凸（模数μ≥0.172，经严格球算术验证）但边界点处径向向外速度为精确有理数21/500的代价函数，并利用连续性推论证明流确实会逸出球外。
AI.motivation: 直觉上，对于定义在测地球上的测地强凸函数（内部有极小值点），梯度流理应被吸引到内部点，强凸性似乎排除了向外运动的可能性。然而这种直觉尚未被严格验证，本文旨在检验这一"诱人"的期望是否成立。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个在主对数坐标系中二次型且具有0.7非对角耦合的代价函数，半径ρ=0.3。通过机器辅助的严格球算术（基于精确有理输入）证明其测地Hessian在整个球上满足Hess f ⪰ μI₃（μ≥0.172），同时精确计算边界点处下降速度的径向向外分量为有理数21/500；再利用精确率估计的连续性推论证明流必然逸出球，并通过数值积分定位最大越界幅度。
AI.result: 构造出满足所有强凸性假设的函数，但其梯度流在边界点径向速度向外（21/500），证明测地球并非前向不变；连续性推论确认流必逸出，数值积分显示峰值越界约在0.3143附近后才收敛回极小值点。
AI.conclusion: 核心机制在于：强凸性约束的是梯度在极小值方向上的投影，而非指向球心的径向方向。因此，尽管函数强凸且极小值在球内，梯度流仍可能暂时离开球域。这一反例推翻了"强凸+内部极小值⟹测地球不变"的朴素直觉，对黎曼流形上优化算法的收敛域分析具有重要警示意义。

title: Differentiating Minimal-Norm Solutions to Parametric Optimization Problems
summary: Differentiating through parametric optimization problems is central to bilevel programming and meta-learning, often accomplished using approximate implicit differentiation. The implicit function theorem requires inverting a partial Jacobian of the optimality condition, which fails when there are many solutions. Nonetheless, in such cases it is possible to relax invertibility to a strictly weaker uniform range condition, under which it is shown that the minimal-norm solution mapping admits generalized derivatives by using a limiting Tikhonov regularization argument and conservative set-valued field theory. With additional control on the eigenvalues of the generalized Hessians, a pseudoinverse formula is justified. This is established for a class of smooth convex objectives and extended to nonsmooth composite problems. These assumptions are verified for Least-Squares, Huber regression and LASSO. The resulting extension of nonsmooth implicit differentiation to ill-posed settings is examined experimentally on data poisoning and data hypercleaning problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在参数优化问题具有多个解（病态）的情况下，仍能通过近似隐式微分进行求导的理论框架。作者利用均匀值域条件和极限Tikhonov正则化论证，证明了最小范数解映射在更弱的条件下仍可求导，并推广到非光滑复合问题，在最小二乘、Huber回归和LASSO上验证了假设，并在数据投毒和数据超清理任务上进行了实验验证。
AI.motivation: 隐式函数定理要求对最优性条件的偏Jacobian求逆，但当优化问题存在多个解时该矩阵不可逆，导致隐式微分失效。作者旨在放宽可逆性条件，使病态（ill-posed）设置下仍能进行微分。
AI.method: 将可逆性条件放松为均匀值域条件（uniform range condition），通过极限Tikhonov正则化论证和保守集值场论（conservative set-valued field theory）推导最小范数解映射的广义导数。在广义Hessian特征值可控时，证明伪逆公式成立。方法适用于光滑凸目标函数并扩展至非光滑复合问题。
AI.result: 在最小二乘、Huber回归和LASSO等经典问题上验证了假设成立。实验证明该方法在数据投毒和数据超清理任务中有效，将非光滑隐式微分成功扩展到病态场景。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作填补了病态参数优化中隐式微分的理论空白，为双层规划和元学习在非唯一解情况下的应用提供了严格的数学基础和实用工具。

title: Importance Sampling Enhanced with the COS Method for the Portfolio Risk Allocation
summary: We introduce ISCOS, a cross-entropy importance-sampling calibration method for rare credit-portfolio losses. We derive Gaussian and Gaussian--inverse-Gamma proposals and analyse the propagation of finite-COS approximation errors to the fitted parameters. Numerical experiments for Gaussian and Student t-copula credit portfolios show the efficiency of this method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ISCOS方法，一种用于稀有信用组合损失估计的交叉熵重要性采样校准方法。该方法推导了高斯和高斯-逆伽马提议分布，并分析了有限COS近似误差向拟合参数的传播，数值实验验证了其在高斯和Student t-copula信用组合中的效率。
AI.motivation: 稀有信用组合损失的准确估计在金融风险管理中至关重要，但传统蒙特卡洛方法在稀有事件场景下效率低下，需要更有效的方差缩减技术。
AI.method: 结合交叉熵重要性采样与COS方法（基于Fourier-cosine展开的定价方法），推导高斯和高斯-逆伽马两种提议分布，并系统分析有限COS近似误差对校准参数的传播影响。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，ISCOS方法在Gaussian和Student t-copula信用组合中均表现出高效性，能够有效估计稀有损失概率。
AI.conclusion: ISCOS提供了一种鲁棒且高效的稀有信用损失估计框架，通过交叉熵与COS方法的结合，在保证精度的同时显著提升了计算效率。

title: Moments of Random Coefficients in Short Panels
summary: We study identification and estimation of moments of random coefficients in short linear panels, allowing the number of heterogeneous coefficients to exceed the number of equations observed for each unit. Under moment homogeneity, different regressor histories impose restrictions on the same moment vector. We give necessary and sufficient conditions for these restrictions to identify moments of a given order, stated in terms of the row spaces generated by the regressor support. The results show that moments may be identified even when the coefficients cannot be recovered for any individual, and, for two full-row-rank histories, give the exact loss of independent restrictions caused by overlap of their row spaces. When the support condition fails, we establish nonidentification in the maintained model and characterize the sharp identified set implied by these conditional moments. At second order, the identified set is determined by positive-semidefinite covariance restrictions and is also sharp relative to the full joint distribution of outcomes and regressors. Under the support condition, weighted minimum-distance estimators are root-$N$ asymptotically normal; under conditional nondegeneracy, oracle generalized-inverse weighting attains the Chamberlain (1987) efficiency bound for the maintained conditional-moment model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究短面板线性模型中对随机系数矩的识别与估计问题，允许异质性系数数量超过每个单位观测到的方程数。在矩同质性假设下，不同回归变量历史对同一矩向量施加约束。作者给出了这些约束识别给定阶矩的充要条件，并以回归变量支撑生成的行空间表述。即使在个体系数无法恢复时，矩仍可被识别；当支撑条件不满足时，刻画了条件矩隐含的锐化识别集（第二阶由半正定协方差约束决定）。在支撑条件下，加权最小距离估计量具有根号N渐近正态性，且在条件非退化下，广义逆加权达到Chamberlain(1987)效率界。
AI.motivation: 短面板中随机系数模型的识别与估计是计量经济学的经典难题。当异质性系数维度超过每个单位可观测方程数时，传统的个体层面识别方法失效，导致难以估计系数矩的总体特征。作者旨在解决这一困境，在矩同质性（moment homogeneity）假设下利用不同回归历史提供的跨单位限制来识别系数矩，并为之提供理论保证。
AI.method: 作者从理论上建立随机系数矩的识别条件：以回归器支撑生成的行空间来刻画矩可识别的充要条件；分析两个满行秩历史之间行空间重叠导致的独立约束损失；在支撑条件不满足时，刻画条件矩隐含的锐化识别集，并证明二阶时该集合由半正定协方差约束决定且相对完整联合分布也是锐化的；估计方面采用加权最小距离估计量，并给出广义逆加权达到Chamberlain效率界的方法。
AI.result: 证明矩的识别不要求个体系数可恢复；给出了不同回归历史识别同一矩向量的充要条件及其精确的约束损失；刻画了支撑条件失败时的锐化识别集；建立了加权最小距离估计量的根号N渐近正态性，并证明在条件非退化下广义逆加权估计可达到Chamberlain(1987)效率界。
AI.conclusion: 本文为短面板中维度过高的随机系数矩的识别和估计提供了完整的理论框架，表明即使个体系数不可识别，其总体矩仍可通过不同回归历史的交叉限制得到识别和有效估计，显著扩展了短面板随机系数模型的应用范围。

title: The information geometry of product-reference discrete diffusion: Interaction growth complexity and optimal scheduling
summary: We study a class of product-reference diffusion algorithms for sampling from a discrete distribution. We show that their sampling performance can be characterized using a path-based measure of data geometry that we call the interaction growth complexity (IGC). We show that a bivariate IGC kernel gives an exact representation of both the KL discretization error and a simple one-step upper bound. The simpler univariate IGC density can be used to study the effect of stepsize choices on the iteration complexity required to obtain $ε$-accurate samples in KL divergence. Samplers that traverse the path with equi-spaced steps in log-squared-reliability-odds have performance that depends on the aggregate IGC mass, whereas refined choices of stepsizes have a lower complexity depending on a square-root functional. In the fine-grid limit, both of these characterizations become sharp. We also allow general product reference distributions and show that the reference law can substantially reshape the IGC profile and the resulting sampling complexity; in particular, references far from both the uniform and the data marginals can yield dimension-dependent improvements. Finally, the aggregate IGC mass admits bounds in terms of total correlation and dual total correlation, thereby connecting the pathwise geometry to classical measures of multivariate dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一类用于离散分布采样的产品参考扩散算法，提出了一种基于路径的数据几何度量——交互增长复杂度（IGC），并证明其能精确刻画KL离散化误差和一步上界，用于分析步长选择对采样复杂度的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有的离散采样算法缺乏统一的框架来理解采样性能与数据几何之间的关系，特别是步长选择如何影响迭代复杂度以及参考分布的选择如何影响采样效率，这些问题尚未得到清晰的理论刻画。
AI.method: 提出交互增长复杂度（IGC）作为路径化数据几何度量；利用双变量IGC核精确表示KL离散化误差和一步上界；利用单变量IGC密度研究步长选择对迭代复杂度的影响；允许一般产品参考分布并分析其对IGC轮廓和采样复杂度的影响；通过总相关和双总相关给出IGC质量的界。
AI.result: 在log平方可靠性几率等距步长下，采样性能取决于聚合IGC质量；而精细化步长选择可使复杂度降低，依赖平方根泛函；在细网格极限下两个刻画均为精确的。参考分布远离均匀分布和数据边际分布时可获得维度相关的改进。IGC质量可由总相关和双总相关界定。
AI.conclusion: 交互增长复杂度为理解产品参考扩散采样算法提供了一个统一的理论框架，将路径几何与经典多变量依赖度量联系起来，并为步长策略和参考分布的选择提供了理论基础。

title: Parametric Multimodal User Memory: Storing What Captions Cannot Carry
summary:
A personalized agent needs a user memory: a persistent model of who its user is. Today it is almost always text -- transcripts and captions retrieved by similarity. This serves the captionable half of a person ("my cat is named Bibi"), but discards the perceptual half no caption can hold: how a voice sounds, how a face reads across age and lighting, how tired someone sounds. We measure this loss across five modalities: a strong caption-based re-identifier recovers as little as 0.11 of a dedicated encoder's recall, collapsing toward chance on non-nameable signals.
  We instead ground perceptual memory in the model, decomposing recall into two subproblems: a vision-language model grounds the referent in context (what and where), and a dedicated encoder extracts an identity key (who), stored as one inline token read by attention at generation with no external round-trip. Neither suffices alone -- the VLM identifies cross-age faces at only 0.54 recall where a face encoder reaches 0.81, and an ungrounded encoder recognizes a two-person-scene referent at 0.05 -- yet together they reach correct-region oracle (0.96), generalizing to multi-speaker audio and video. The recognition core is training-free: it reproduces the encoder's recall on any frozen model at O(1) registration cost. On PerceptMem (12 domains, 1,080 tasks) perceptual identity is capacity-limited while exact facts are binding-limited: identity belongs in a parametric bank, facts in a text store. The two memories compose cleanly: an agent with both can remember not only what its user said, but also what they are like.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将感知记忆（如声音、面容等无法用文字描述的信息）直接内嵌到模型中的个性化代理记忆系统，将回忆分解为"目标定位"（VLM完成）和"身份提取"（专用编码器完成）两个子问题，二者结合可达到0.96的识别准确率，并在12个领域、1080个任务上验证了感知身份记忆与事实文本记忆的互补性。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化代理的记忆几乎完全基于文本（转录和字幕检索），这只能捕捉可被文字描述的信息，而丢失了无法用文字编码的感知信息（如声音特质、跨年龄的面容变化、疲劳状态等）。作者量化了这一损失：基于字幕的再识别器仅能恢复专用编码器0.11的召回率。因此需要一种能够保留感知记忆的代理记忆方式。
AI.method: 将感知记忆直接落地到模型中，将回忆分解为两个子问题：(1) 视觉语言模型（VLM）负责在上下文中定位指代对象（what和where）；(2) 专用编码器提取身份键（who），作为单个内联token存储在模型中，在生成时通过注意力机制读取，无需外部往返。识别核心是训练无关的，能以O(1)注册成本在任意冻结模型上复现编码器的召回效果。
AI.result: 单独使用VLM在跨年龄人脸识别上仅达0.54的召回率（专用人脸编码器为0.81），未定位的编码器在两人场景中指代识别仅达0.05；但两者结合可达正确区域oracle水平（0.96），并能泛化到多说话人音频和视频。在PerceptMem基准（12个领域，1080个任务）上，感知身份受容量限制而精确事实受绑定限制：身份应存入参数化存储库，事实存入文本存储。
AI.conclusion: 感知身份记忆和事实文本记忆应分开存储且天然可组合：参数化银行存身份（who）、文本存储存事实（what）。两种记忆共同使用，代理不仅能记住用户说了什么，还能记住用户是什么样的。这为个性化代理提供了一种超越纯文本记忆的完整记忆方案。

title: Expert-validated STEM QA
comment: We have open-sourced a portion of our dataset for the AI research community at https://huggingface.co/datasets/TuringEnterprises/Open-RL
summary: Recent advancements in AI are helping scientists achieve breakthroughs in fields such as mathematics, medicine, and materials sciences. New evaluation datasets for AI models contribute to such advancement in AI. In the STEM domain, frontier models have consumed most of the available online data, creating the need for human-created datasets that codify the knowledge of leading experts in the domain. There are several STEM datasets available for the research community in this field. However, there are some gaps in these datasets, leaving room for improvement. Examples of gaps include (1) saturation in model performance on these datasets, leaving no head-room for meaningful evaluations, (2) skewed taxonomy distributions, (3) multiple choice question format that is misaligned with how scientists use AI in the real world, and (4) inaccurate answers and rationales partially led by a contest-based data collection and a time-bound review process. In this study, we present 'Expert-validated STEM QA', a high-quality, expert-validated STEM dataset (N=398) in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Mathematics, created by 241 domain experts. We (1) carefully designed a taxonomy with balanced distribution, (2) vetted question contributors with quality-driven incentive, (3) conducted multiple rounds of reviews with revisions validated by domain experts based on consensus, and (4) created the dataset in verifiable question and answer format. Our study demonstrated low performance ($<25\%$) of frontier AI models on the dataset as a benchmark. Post-training on a separate, private version of the dataset (N=2,000) increased performance of the open source model by $15\%$ relative to the baseline model (p=0.045) on the STEM subset of HLE-verified dataset, indicating potential utility of the dataset for model training. We have open-sourced a portion of our dataset for the AI research community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了'Expert-validated STEM QA'，一个由241名领域专家创建的高质量、专家验证的STEM数据集（398题），涵盖物理、化学、生物学和数学。该数据集解决了现有STEM数据集的多个缺陷（性能饱和、分类不均衡、选择题格式不适配、答案不准确），并通过精心设计的分类体系、质量驱动的贡献者筛选、多轮专家共识审查和可验证的问答格式来保证质量。前沿AI模型在该数据集上表现低于25%，证明了其作为基准的难度；使用私有版本（2000题）进行后训练，使开源模型在HLE-verified数据集的STEM子集上相对提升15%。
AI.motivation: 现有STEM评估数据集存在四个主要缺陷：模型性能饱和缺乏区分度、分类分布不均衡、选择题格式与实际科学家使用AI的方式不符、基于竞赛的数据收集和限时审查导致答案和推理不准确。这些空白需要高质量、专家验证的数据集来推动AI在STEM领域的发展。
AI.method: 该研究通过以下方法构建数据集：（1）精心设计分类体系确保分布均衡；（2）采用质量驱动的激励机制筛选问题贡献者；（3）进行多轮审查，由领域专家基于共识共识验证修订；（4）采用可验证的问答格式而非选择题。数据集由241名领域专家创建，共398个问题，涵盖物理、化学、生物学和数学。（2,000题私有版本用于模型训练实验。）
AI.result: 前沿AI模型在该数据集上准确率低于25%，表明数据集作为基准具有充分挑战性。使用私有版本（N=2000）进行后训练后，开源模型在HLE-verified数据集的STEM子集上相对基线提升15%（p=0.045），验证了数据集对模型训练的潜在价值。部分数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功创建了首个兼顾高难度、分类均衡、格式实用性和答案准确性的专家验证STEM数据集，既可作为具有足够区分度的评估基准，也可用于模型后训练以提升性能，为STEM领域AI评估和训练提供了有价值的资源。

title: Unsupervised Latent Space Alignment with Hyperspherical Geodesic Matching
summary: Independently trained neural networks tend to encode the same data with similar latent geometries. These latent geometries are not directly compatible, yet they can be nearly the same up to some class of transformations. While there exists many methods for alignment between different latent spaces, it is typically done using a set of shared sample correspondences, known as anchors. This leaves a fundamental question: are the geometric signatures of different latent spaces representing similar data sufficient to recover an alignment between them? To that end, we introduce HGA (Hyperspherical Gaussian Alignment), a method that directly optimizes a transformation between two latent spaces by maximizing a geometric measure of "fit" between them. Since it is driven by the geometry of the latent spaces rather than paired data, HGA can operate in both an unsupervised and weakly supervised regime. On tasks such as model stitching or multilingual word embedding correspondence recovery, HGA manages to match supervised results with minimal or no supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HGA（超球面高斯对齐）方法，通过直接优化两个潜在空间之间的几何"拟合度"来实现对齐，无需配对数据或锚点，仅依赖潜在空间的几何特征即可恢复变换。
AI.motivation: 独立训练的神经网络往往以相似的潜在几何编码相同数据，但这些空间虽相似却不相容。现有对齐方法通常依赖共享样本对应（锚点）或配对数据，这引出一个根本问题：仅凭不同潜在空间的几何签名是否足以恢复它们之间的对齐？
AI.method: HGA通过最大化两个潜在空间之间的几何拟合度量来直接优化变换。它由潜在空间的几何驱动而非配对数据驱动，因此可以在无监督和弱监督两种场景下工作。
AI.result: 在模型拼接（model stitching）和多语言词嵌入对应恢复等任务上，HGA在极少或无监督的情况下达到了与监督方法相当的结果。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间的几何签名足以驱动对齐，HGA证明了仅依靠几何信息即可在无监督或弱监督条件下实现与监督方法相当的对齐性能。

title: On-Screen Inertia: Persistent Racial and Gender Disparities in Hollywood Film (1900-2024)
comment: 52 pages including Supplementary Information; 4 main figures, 15 supplementary figures, 17 supplementary tables
summary: Hollywood has diversified its casts. Whether this has translated into structural change in how those actors are positioned within narratives remains largely unexamined. Drawing on 76,815 U.S. English-language films (1900-2024) and over 3.1 million cast and crew entries, we move beyond headcounts to examine long-term inclusion trends through network centrality, occupational stereotypes, crew-to-cast diversity pathways, and financial outcomes. We find evidence of what we term on-screen inertia. While the raw inclusion of women and racial minorities has increased modestly, White actors have become more overrepresented relative to the U.S. Census in recent decades, not less. Within the visibility layer, women face a consistent longevity penalty with significantly shorter careers than men, and visual depictions framing men as dominant and women as sensual have remained stable since the 1950s. Structurally, White actors retain disproportionate network centrality; women achieve parity in centrality and lead billing yet cluster in secondary co-lead roles; and occupational stereotypes anchoring racial and gender groups to specific labor categories persist largely unchanged across the pre- and post-2000 periods. Crew diversity associates with cast inclusion only along matching demographic lines (i.e., racial with racial, gender with gender) and does not extend to narrative centrality, revealing a structural ceiling on hiring-based interventions. Critically, we find no consistent market penalty for diversity across decades of box office returns and audience ratings, eliminating the primary rationalization for these practices. Together, these findings demonstrate that Hollywood's representational inequalities are not a rational market response, but are an institutionally sustained choice.

AI.tldr: 本文基于76,815部美国英语电影（1900-2024年）及310余万条演职人员数据，超越简单的人数统计，通过网络中心性、职业刻板印象、剧组到演员的多样性路径及财务结果等维度，考察好莱坞长期包容性趋势。研究发现"银幕惯性"现象：尽管女性和少数族裔的绝对人数有所增加，但白人演员相对美国人口普查数据的过度代表反而加剧；女性面临职业寿命惩罚；白人演员在网络中心性上保持优势；剧组多样性仅沿匹配的人口学线条（种族对种族、性别对性别）与演员多样性相关，且不延伸至叙事中心性；同时未发现多样性带来市场惩罚的证据。结论认为好莱坞的再现不平等并非理性市场反应，而是制度性维持的选择。
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注好莱坞演员人数/多样性的"计数"变化，但鲜有考察这些变化是否转化为叙事结构层面的实质性改变。作者希望超越表面的人数统计，深入探讨演员在叙事中的结构性定位（如网络中心性、角色类型、职业刻板印象等）是否发生真实变化，并检验"多样性损害票房"这一常见的行业合理化说辞是否成立。
AI.method: 使用大规模数据集（76,815部电影、310余万条演职人员记录），采用多维分析方法：(1)网络中心性分析衡量演员叙事位置；(2)职业刻板印象分析考察种族/性别与劳动力类别的锚定关系；(3)剧组到演员多样性的关联性路径分析（区分种族与性别维度）；(4)财务结果分析检验票房与观众评价的市场惩罚。时间跨度为1900-2024年，并比较2000年前后两个时期。
AI.result: 三项关键发现：其一，"银幕惯性"——白人在近几十年相对人口普查的过度代表不降反升；其二，结构性不平等持续——女性面临职业寿命惩罚，白人保持网络中心性优势，女性虽达中心性与主演并列的平权却聚集于次要联合主演角色，种族和性别群体的职业刻板印象在2000年前后基本未变；其三，剧组多样性仅对匹配维度的演员包容性有正向关联，且不扩展到叙事中心性，同时数十年间未发现多样性对票房和评分的稳定市场惩罚。
AI.conclusion: 好莱坞的再现不平等不能用市场理性来解释——多样性并不损害经济回报，因此行业排斥多样性的做法缺乏经济依据，属于制度性维持的选择而非市场驱动的结果。作者的"银幕惯性"概念揭示了表面包容性增长下的深层结构性停滞，并指出基于招聘的干预措施存在结构性天花板。

title: Metaorder modelling and identification from public data
summary: Market-order flow in financial markets exhibits long-range correlations. This is a widely known stylised fact of financial markets. A popular hypothesis for this stylised fact comes from the Lillo-Mike-Farmer (LMF) order-splitting theory. However, quantitative tests of this theory have historically relied on proprietary datasets with trader identifiers, limiting reproducibility and cross-market validation. We investigate whether it can be recovered from anonymous public data using synthetic metaorder reconstruction. Using transaction and quote data for the largest 239 stocks by market capitalisation on the JSE as of 13 March 2026 with the data range being 1 January 2023 until 31 December 2025, we conduct a grid search over reconstruction parameters and evaluate each configuration against established metaorder stylised facts and the LMF relation. Configurations selected to minimise errors across the metaorder impact stylised facts reproduce the targeted aggregate properties but yield a poor LMF relation. Configurations selected to minimise the LMF discrepancy recover the relation by construction while retaining several broad impact features, although some stock-level execution and decay fits are weaker. These asymmetric results show that recovering aggregate impact stylised facts alone is insufficient to identify LMF-consistent order splitting, while the LMF-targeted result establishes compatibility within the reconstruction class rather than an independent test. The findings support consistency with, rather than direct validation of, the LMF theory using anonymous market data.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨是否能用匿名公开数据（南非JSE交易所239只股票，2023-2025年数据）通过合成元订单重建来恢复Lillo-Mike-Farmer（LMF）订单拆分理论。结果发现，以元订单冲击风格化事实为优化目标的重建参数能再现聚合特征但LMF关系很差；而以LMF差异最小化为目标的重建虽然能构建出LMF关系但保留的宽泛特征较弱。结论是：仅恢复聚合冲击风格化事实不足以识别LMF一致的订单拆分，匿名数据只能支持与LMF理论的一致性而非直接验证。
AI.motivation: LMF订单拆分理论是解释金融市场价格订单流长程相关性的主流假说，但以往对该理论的定量检验依赖带有交易者标识符的专有数据集，限制了可复制性和跨市场验证。作者希望探索是否可以用匿名的公开市场数据来恢复和检验这一理论。
AI.method: 使用JSE交易所按市值排名最大的239只股票的成交和报价数据（2023年1月至2025年12月），通过合成元订单重建方法，对重建参数进行网格搜索，并将每种配置对照既定的元订单风格化事实和LMF关系进行评估。
AI.result: 以最小化元订单冲击风格化事实误差为目标的配置能再现目标聚合属性但LMF关系较差；以最小化LMF差异为目标的配置则能通过构建恢复LMF关系，同时保留若干宽泛的冲击特征，但部分个股层面的执行和衰减拟合较弱。两种配置的结果呈现不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 仅恢复聚合冲击风格化事实不足以识别LMF一致的订单拆分；LMF目标化结果仅建立在该重建类别内的兼容性而非独立检验。匿名市场数据只能支持与LMF理论的一致性，而非直接验证该理论。

title: Authority-Inference Separation in Agentic Finance: First-Line Control, Blockchain Enforcement, and Replayable Assurance
summary: AI agents can select tools, counterparties, and transaction parameters, yet inference should not itself confer authority to execute a financial action. This study develops and evaluates Authority-Inference Separation (AIS), an intent-centered architecture for bounded agentic finance. AIS treats a financial action intent as the control object: a machine-generated proposal can receive temporary executable authority only after an independent deterministic control plane validates registered agent identity, accountable ownership, mandate and risk-appetite lineage, policy version, state, approvals, and exact economic semantics. Blockchain can then enforce the operational representation of granted authority and record portable settlement evidence, while institutional legitimacy, service delivery, accounting classification, and human accountability remain off-chain obligations. Evaluation combines four-domain instantiation, official BIS and MAS cases, a 48-fixture executable prototype, and a public-ledger observability test. Across 36 synthetic authorization attacks, a direct-agent baseline accepted 36 attack effects, a prompt-policy baseline accepted 20, and AIS accepted none; all three accepted 8/8 admissible fixtures. AIS also rejected 4/4 token replays and 8/8 recipient or rail substitutions, withheld completion in 4/4 service-delivery failures, and populated all 13 defined evidence fields. A test of 1,700 recent Base transactions associated with public x402 facilitator addresses shows that public ledgers can evidence settlement and selected authorization parameters but cannot establish institutional mandate, legal accountability, service delivery, or accounting treatment. AIS and blockchain are therefore complementary: AIS decides whether a specific intent may act, while blockchain can make granted authority bounded, executable, and independently observable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"权威-推理分离"(AIS)架构，将金融行动意图作为控制对象，通过独立的确定性控制平面验证身份、所有权、授权与风险偏好等，再赋予机器生成提案以临时可执行权威，区块链则负责执行与记录。实验表明AIS可抵御36种合成授权攻击，且AIS与区块链互补。
AI.motivation: AI智能体能够选择工具、交易对手和交易参数，但推理本身不应赋予其执行金融行动的权威。现有基线（直接智能体、提示策略）在授权攻击面前存在严重漏洞，亟需构建意图为中心的受限智能体金融架构。
AI.method: AIS架构将金融行动意图作为控制对象，采用双层设计：(1) 独立确定性控制平面——验证注册智能体身份、可问责所有权、任务与风险偏好谱系、策略版本、状态、审批及精确经济语义；(2) 区块链层——执行授权权威的操作性表示并记录可携带的结算证据。机构合法性、服务交付、会计分类与人类问责保持链下。评估涵盖四域实例化、BIS/MAS官方案例、48夹具可执行原型及公共账本可观测性测试。
AI.result: 在36个合成授权攻击中，直接智能体基线接受36个攻击效应，提示策略基线接受20个，而AIS全部拒绝；三者均接受8/8应允许夹具。AIS还拒绝4/4令牌重放与8/8收款方或轨道替换，在4/4服务交付失败中扣留完成，并填充全部13个证据字段。对1700笔Base交易测试表明公共账本可证明结算与部分授权参数，但无法建立机构授权、法律问责、服务交付或会计处理。
AI.conclusion: AIS与区块链互补：AIS决定特定意图是否可行动，区块链使授予的权威有界、可执行且可独立观测。推理与权威必须分离，机器生成提案仅在确定性验证通过后才能获得临时可执行性。

title: A note on markets with semi-static trading strategies
summary:
We investigate arbitrage in a discrete-time financial market model where, in addition to finitely many dynamically traded assets, there are also static options to choose from. We introduce the concept of small cones of random variables and present a sufficient condition for the attainable positions in the market to be closed in probability.
  A fundamental theorem of asset pricing is shown in the present context. Utility maximization will also be considered. We will provide economically meaningful examples of infinite dimensional small cones to demonstrate the pertinence of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散时间金融市场模型中的套利问题，该模型除了有限多个动态交易资产外，还包含静态期权。作者引入"小锥"（small cones）的随机变量概念，为市场中可达头寸在概率意义下的闭性提供了充分条件，并证明了资产定价基本定理，同时考虑了效用最大化问题，提供了无限维小锥的经济学实例。
AI.motivation: 在包含静态期权的金融市场中，可达头寸可能在概率意义下不封闭，这会影响资产定价基本定理的成立。作者需要提出一个新的数学框架（小锥概念）来给出可达头寸闭性的充分条件，从而推广资产定价基本定理并研究效用最大化问题。
AI.method: 本文采用以下方法：（1）引入小锥（small cones）的随机变量概念，作为刻画市场结构的新工具；（2）利用小锥条件推导可达头寸在概率意义下封闭的充分条件；（3）在此基础上证明资产定价基本定理（无套利与等价鞅测度存在性之间的联系）；（4）将框架应用于效用最大化问题；（5）构造无限维小锥的具体经济学实例来验证方法的有效性。
AI.result: 成功给出了可达头寸在概率意义下封闭的充分条件（基于小锥概念），证明了该市场背景下资产定价基本定理成立，并对效用最大化问题进行了分析。提供了具有经济学意义的无限维小锥实例。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入小锥概念，为包含静态期权的离散时间金融市场提供了新的数学框架，解决了可达头寸封闭性问题，建立了资产定价基本定理，并展示了该框架在效用最大化中的适用性。无限维小锥实例证明了该方法在经济建模中的实际价值。

title: Deep Hedging Under Realistic Market Frictions: A Regime-Conditional Empirical Study of Dynamic Option Hedging on Bitcoin Options
summary:
Classical option-hedging methods like Black-Scholes delta assume constant, free rebalancing, which real markets don't allow. Deep hedging trains a neural network to handle these frictions directly, and prior work reports strong results. But those comparisons usually pit deep hedging against a frictionless classical baseline on simulated price data. That's not a fair fight, and it leaves open whether the advantage is real.
  We test this using five years of actual BTC options data from Deribit (2020-2024), comparing Black-Scholes delta, Leland's cost-adjusted hedge, and the Whalley-Wilmott no-trade band against three deep hedging setups: an LSTM and a feedforward network, each trained with a CVaR loss and, in some runs, a penalty for trading too often. All six strategies face the same 5 basis point transaction cost.
  On 11,546 test episodes from September 2023 to December 2024, Whalley-Wilmott cuts transaction costs significantly versus hourly rebalancing, saving $1.79 per episode against plain BS delta (95% CI [-2.21, -1.39], p < 0.0001) by trading about eight times less often. Its P&L and tail-risk numbers are better too, though not quite significant at this sample size. None of the three deep hedging models beat any classical benchmark on any metric, and all kept trading almost every hour regardless of penalty weight, a twenty-fold range barely moved the needle. A calmer validation period shows Whalley-Wilmott's P&L edge shrinks or disappears there while its cost edge holds, so the result depends on market regime. We think the likely causes are a small training set and the lack of any built-in mechanism for sitting still in the architectures tested. Not a flashy result, but an honest one: a real-data check on a claim mostly supported by simulations so far.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2020-2024年Deribit真实BTC期权数据，对深度对冲（LSTM和前馈网络）与三种经典对冲方法（Black-Scholes delta、Leland、Whalley-Wilmott）进行公平对比。结果显示，经典方法（尤其是Whalley-Wilmott）在真实数据上表现出色，而三种深度对冲模型均未能在任何指标上超越经典基准，且无论惩罚权重如何都几乎每小时交易。作者认为原因可能是训练集过小以及所测架构缺乏"静默"机制。
AI.motivation: 以往深度对冲研究通常将深度学习方法与无摩擦的经典基线在模拟数据上对比，这不公平且无法验证其优势在真实市场中是否成立。本文旨在用真实BTC期权数据对深度对冲进行公正检验。
AI.method: 使用Deribit五年真实BTC期权数据（2020-2024），对比六种策略：三种经典（BS delta、Leland、Whalley-Wilmott非交易带）和三种深度对冲（LSTM与前馈网络，各含CVaR损失，部分加入交易频率惩罚），所有策略面临相同5个基点的交易成本。共11,546个测试时段（2023年9月至2024年12月）。
AI.result: Whalley-Wilmott通过减少约8倍交易频率，平均每时段节省$1.79交易成本（p<0.0001），P&L和尾部风险也更好但未达显著水平。三种深度对冲模型均未在任何指标上击败经典基准，且无论惩罚权重如何（20倍范围变化）几乎都保持每小时交易。平稳验证期Whalley-Wilmott的P&L优势缩小或消失，但成本优势保持。
AI.conclusion: 深度对冲在真实数据上的优势并不成立，可能原因包括训练集过小以及所用架构缺乏停止交易的机制。该结果提醒研究界：基于模拟数据的深度对冲优势需经真实数据验证，结果取决于市场制度环境。

title: From Rigid to Adiabatic: Canonical Regularization of AC Networks via Action-Angle Variables
summary: Traditional power system analysis relies on timescale separation and the rigid-network assumption, freezing electromagnetic transients into algebraic power-flow equations via Steinmetz's phasor theory. As grid-forming converter penetration increases, magnetic energy dynamics on transmission lines interact with converter control loops on comparable timescales, challenging this rigid-network assumption. Returning to Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction driven by rotating magnetic fields, this paper models the transmission lines' rotating magnetic fields in action-angle canonical coordinates, regularizes the rigid algebraic constraints of power-flow equations into canonical equations on adiabatic symplectic manifolds, and establishes a port-Hamiltonian standard form for AC power grids. Based on the minimal-counterexample principle and using the equal-area criterion's classical two-machine system, this paper reveals a latitudinal instability channel via Bloch-sphere coordinates: Q-V control releases voltage-amplitude freedom, shifting the stability boundary from the equatorial UEP (unstable equilibrium point) to a saddle point, thereby unifying the analytical frameworks of P-delta angle stability and Q-V voltage stability in power system analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战传统电力系统分析中基于时间尺度分离和刚性网络假设的理论基础。随着电网形成变流器渗透率增加，输电线磁能动力学与变流器控制环路的时标变得可比。论文通过将输电线的旋转磁场建模于作用-角度正则坐标，把功率流方程的刚性代数约束正则化为绝热辛流形上的正则方程，建立交流电网的端口-哈密顿标准形式。并利用最小反例原理和经典两机系统（等面积准则），通过Bloch球坐标揭示了纬度不稳定通道：Q-V控制释放电压幅值自由度，使稳定性边界从赤道不稳定平衡点转移到鞍点，从而统一了电力系统分析中P-Δ功角稳定性与Q-V电压稳定性的分析框架。
AI.motivation: 传统电力系统分析依赖时间尺度分离假设和刚性网络假设，通过Steinmetz相量理论将电磁暂态冻结为代数功率流方程。然而，随着电网形成变流器渗透率提高，输电线磁能动力学与变流器控制环路在可比时间尺度上相互作用，导致刚性网络假设不再成立，亟需新的理论框架。
AI.method: 1) 回归法拉第电磁感应定律，将输电线旋转磁场建模在作用-角度正则坐标下；2) 将刚性代数约束正则化为绝热辛流形上的正则方程；3) 建立交流电网的端口-哈密顿标准形式；4) 基于最小反例原理，利用等面积准则的经典两机系统，通过Bloch球坐标分析稳定性。
AI.result: 揭示了纬度不稳定通道：Q-V控制释放电压幅值自由度，将稳定性边界从赤道UEP（不稳定平衡点）移至鞍点，从而统一了P-δ功角稳定性和Q-V电压稳定性的分析框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高变流器渗透率下的交流电网提供了新的数学基础（辛几何与端口-哈密顿框架），并建立了功角稳定性与电压稳定性的统一分析框架，对现代电力系统稳定性理论具有重要推进意义。

title: Calculus of the Facial Distance
summary: We develop a few calculus rules to compute or lower bound the facial distance of a polytope. We illustrate our calculus rules on various popular polytopes. In particular, we provide a provide a lower bound on the facial distance of the Birkhoff polytope.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了若干微积分规则来计算或下界估计多面体的面距离，并在多种常见多面体上进行了验证，特别给出了Birkhoff多面体面距离的下界。
AI.motivation: 面距离是多面体中的一个重要几何量，但直接计算往往困难，缺乏系统的计算工具，因此需要开发有效的微积分规则来估计或精确计算各类多面体的面距离。
AI.method: 提出了若干微积分规则，用于计算或给出多面体面距离的下界。这些规则被应用到多种常见多面体上，并特别针对Birkhoff多面体进行了下界的推导。
AI.result: 成功说明了这些微积分规则在多种流行多面体上的适用性，并为Birkhoff多面体的面距离提供了一个下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的微积分规则为多面体面距离的计算与估计提供了系统工具，且该方法在Birkhoff多面体这类复杂结构上也能获得有效的结果。

title: Neural Calibration of a Complete Market Model
summary: We propose a neural calibration method to construct a recombining binomial tree directly from a set of given option prices. Rather than estimating a continuous option pricing function or a local volatility surface as an intermediate object, a neural network is used to deform a benchmark lattice. This leads to a discrete pricing model which is guaranteed to be arbitrage-free, complete, easy to interpret, and can be used directly for pricing and to find replicating trading strategies. Calibration is formulated as a penalized optimization problem that combines a repricing error with an admissibility penalty, and an optional spatial regularization term based on implied local volatilities. Numerical experiments on synthetic and SPX market data show that the proposed approach yields accurate repricing and is very competitive when compared to recently proposed other neural calibration methods. It preserves the computational advantages of lattice-based valuation and hedging. In particular, the calibrated tree can be reused to price contracts that allow early exercise, and could even be calibrated directly with American option prices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经校准方法，直接从给定的期权价格构建可重组的二叉树，无需估计连续期权定价函数或局部波动率曲面，而是用神经网络对基准格点进行变形。
AI.motivation: 传统神经校准方法通常需要估计连续的期权定价函数或局部波动率曲面作为中间对象，这可能导致计算复杂且难以保证无套利性质。本文旨在构建一个既准确又可直接用于定价和套期保值的离散定价模型。
AI.method: 用神经网络对基准二叉树格点进行变形，将其构造为可重组的二叉树。校准问题被形式化为一个带惩罚的优化问题，包含重定价误差项、可采纳性惩罚项以及可选的基于隐含局部波动率的空间正则化项。
AI.result: 在合成数据和SPX市场数据上的数值实验表明，该方法能够实现准确的重定价，并与近期提出的其他神经校准方法相比具有很强的竞争力。该方法保留了基于格点定价和套期保值的计算优势。
AI.conclusion: 校准后的树可以重复用于定价允许提前行权的合约，甚至可以直接用美式期权价格进行校准，展示了方法的通用性和实际应用价值。

title: Jigsaw-CRL: Recovering Global Latent Causal Order from Fragmented Multi-Client Interventions
summary: Causal representation learning (CRL) aims to recover latent causal variables and their structural relations from high-dimensional observations. Existing CRL methods typically assume that all environments are defined over the same latent variables, or at least share a common latent representation space. We study a fragmented multi-client setting, where multiple clients interact with the same global latent causal system but each client only accesses and intervenes on a subset of the latent variables. In this regime, marginalizing unused latent variables induces bidirected edges, so a single client no longer admits a node-wise latent causal graph, and the global latent causal order must be recovered by assembling client-specific structural fragments. We propose \textbf{Jigsaw-CRL}, a framework for recovering global latent causal order from such fragmented interventions. Under soft interventions, differences between precision matrices across environments exhibit a low-rank structure governed by latent ancestor relations. This enables recovery, for each client, of a block partition, the corresponding block-level ancestral order, and latent subspaces, and then assembly of these fragments into the global node-level latent causal order. We establish identifiability guarantees, develop practical algorithms, and validate the framework on synthetic data. Our codes are available on https://anonymous.4open.science/r/code-for-Jigsaw-CRL-7B26

AI.tldr: 本文提出Jigsaw-CRL框架，解决碎片化多客户端场景下的因果表示学习问题。在该场景中，多个客户端各自只访问和干预全局潜在因果系统的一个子集，通过组装各客户端学习到的结构碎片来恢复全局潜在的因果顺序。在软干预下，利用环境间精度矩阵差异的低秩结构来实现块级因果顺序和潜在子空间的恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有CRL方法通常假设所有环境共享相同的潜在变量或共同的潜在表示空间，但实际应用中存在碎片化多客户端场景：每个客户端只能访问和干预全局潜变量系统的一个子集。在这种场景下，边缘化未使用的潜变量会引入双向边，单个客户端不再具有节点级潜在因果图，需要跨客户端组装结构碎片来恢复全局因果顺序。这是一个尚未被充分研究的问题。
AI.method: 提出Jigsaw-CRL框架，包含三个步骤：(1) 利用软干预下环境间精度矩阵差异的低秩结构，该结构由潜在祖先关系决定；(2) 对每个客户端恢复块划分、对应的块级祖先顺序和潜在子空间；(3) 将这些客户端特定的结构碎片组装成全局的节点级潜在因果顺序。
AI.result: 建立了可辨识性保证，开发了实用算法，并在合成数据上验证了框架的有效性。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: Jigsaw-CRL是首个解决碎片化多客户端场景下全局因果顺序恢复问题的框架，通过组装客户端级结构碎片实现全局潜在因果结构的可辨识与恢复，拓展了因果表示学习的适用范围。

title: Gurukul AI: An Interactive AI-Driven Educational Platform for Indian Education System
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT and LLaMA have transformed AI-driven education, but these systems are predominantly trained on Western-centric data, making them ill-suited for regional curricula like India's. The Indian education system is linguistically diverse, exam-oriented, and structured around standardized syllabi, not addressed by existing datasets or tools. In this work, we curate a syllabus-aligned QA dataset based on NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) textbooks for classes 9-12, capturing the content, context, and teaching style of Indian curricula. The final dataset, comprising 18,720 question-answer pairs across five subjects, is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/Gurukul. We fine-tune the LLaMA 3.1 8B model using this dataset and deploy it in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework tailored to educational needs. We introduce GurukulAI, an open-access platform that enables Indian students to chat with the model, get doubts cleared, practice exam-style questions, receive contextual answers, and interact in both English and Hindi. By localizing AI for Indian classrooms, our work bridges the gap between global LLM capabilities and regional educational demands. The code is available at https://github.com/lingo-iitgn/GurukulAI.

AI.tldr: 本文针对印度教育体系，基于NCERT教科书（9-12年级）构建了18,720个QA对的课程对齐数据集Gurukul，并微调LLaMA 3.1 8B模型，结合RAG框架部署为GurukulAI开放平台，支持英文和印地语交互，帮助印度学生答疑、练习考试题目并获取上下文答案。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型主要基于西方中心化数据训练，不适用于像印度这样语言多样、以考试为导向、围绕标准化教学大纲构建的区域教育体系。缺乏针对印度课程内容的现成数据集和工具，需填补全球LLM能力与区域教育需求之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 从NCERT教科书（9-12年级）中策展课程对齐的QA数据集，涵盖5个学科共18,720对问答；基于该数据集对LLaMA 3.1 8B模型进行微调，并部署在面向教育场景的检索增强生成（RAG）框架中；构建GurukulAI开放平台，支持英语和印地语交互。
AI.result: 构建了公开的Gurukul数据集（18,720 QA对，5个学科）和GurukulAI平台，实现了与印度课程对齐的对话式AI教育助手，支持答疑、考试练习和上下文问答等功能。
AI.conclusion: 通过本地化AI以适配印度课堂，该工作有效弥合了全球大语言模型能力与区域教育需求之间的差距，验证了课程对齐数据集与RAG框架在教育场景中的可行性。

title: A collective capability boundary in frontier large language models on guideline-conformant and case-specific oncology decision-making
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high scores on medical knowledge examinations, yet real-world oncology is not a knowledge test--it is a sequence of guideline-pathway choices, escalation judgments, and commitments under uncertainty. Existing benchmarks largely measure factual recall, leaving open whether frontier LLMs share decision-path blind spots that combining models cannot fix. We built the Oncology Decision Boundary Benchmark (ODBB)--2,005 oncology decision points across NCCN guidelines and colorectal cancer cases--and evaluated nine frontier LLMs (four closed-source, five open-weight families) released between June 2025 and April 2026. A fully deterministic scorer (zero LLM inference) classified outputs into 14 failure types, independently validated by two oncologists (Cohen's weighted $κ$ = 0.939 and 0.790) on a 225-item stratified sample. Treating the nine as a pooled super-model, 42.1% (Wilson 95% CI 40.0--44.3%) of all items--35.7% of the 1,586 NCCN items and 66.4% of the 419 colorectal-cancer cases--were answered correctly by none, with failures concentrated in choosing between guideline pathways before reasoning within any: a consistent blind spot in clinical meta-judgment that likely requires architectural intervention rather than more training data. Two models tuned for decisiveness (GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview) made unsafe commitments three to five times more often than the seven cautious models without scoring higher. In 3--9% of items, models stated the correct next clinical step yet did not commit to it--failures of decision, not knowledge. Model quality is no longer the primary bottleneck for clinical LLM deployment; the binding constraint is the assumption that any single model can be the sole basis for a clinical decision. Progress requires architectures that detect when a model reaches its competence boundary and route the decision to a clinician.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了肿瘤决策边界基准（ODBB），包含2,005个基于NCCN指南和结直肠癌病例的肿瘤决策点，评估了2025年6月至2026年4月发布的九个前沿LLM。结果显示42.1%的决策点没有任何模型能正确回答，模型在"路径选择"（临床元判断）上存在系统性盲区，且追求果断性的模型不安全承诺率高出谨慎模型3-5倍。作者认为模型质量不再是临床LLM部署的主要瓶颈，真正的约束是"单一模型作为临床决策唯一依据"这一假设本身。
AI.motivation: 现有医学LLM基准主要衡量事实回忆能力，而真实肿瘤学实践是序列化的指南路径选择、升级判断和不确定性下的承诺决策。作者质疑前沿LLM是否共享仅靠模型组合无法修复的决策路径盲点，因此需要专门评估LLM在临床决策边界上的表现，而不仅仅是知识掌握程度。
AI.method: 构建ODBB基准（2,005个决策点，涵盖NCCN指南与结直肠癌案例），评估九个前沿LLM（四个闭源、五个开源家族）。采用完全确定性的评分器（零LLM推理）将输出分类为14种失败类型，并由两位肿瘤学家独立验证（加权Cohen's κ=0.939和0.790）。将九个模型视为一个组合超级模型，分析所有模型都无法回答的项目。
AI.result: 作为组合超级模型，42.1%（95% CI 40.0-44.3%）的项目没有任何模型答对——NCCN项目35.7%失败，结直肠癌案例66.4%失败。失败集中在"先选路径再推理"的环节，即临床元判断的一致盲点。两个追求果断性的模型（GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview）不安全承诺率比七个谨慎模型高3-5倍且得分未提高。3-9%的项目中模型能陈述正确答案却不做决策承诺。作者认为这需要架构干预而非更多训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 模型质量已不再是临床LLM部署的主要瓶颈；根本约束是"单一模型可作为临床决策唯一依据"的假设。进步需要架构能够检测模型到达能力边界，并将决策路由给临床医生。模型在路径选择上的系统性盲区暗示需要架构层面的干预而非简单增加训练数据。

title: Curvature Cryptanalysis of Smooth Transformer Feed-Forward Networks
summary: We show that smooth two-layer feed-forward networks (FFNs) expose an additional structural model extraction channel under a chosen-input raw-output oracle at the FFN branch; consider transformer FFN branches with GELU or SiLU activations under chosen-input raw-output access, without access to parameters, gradients, or internal activations; exploit a second-order leakage channel in which projected input Hessians form different mixtures of the same hidden symmetric rank-one factors induced by the FFN input weights. We formalize resulting Hessian collection as a partially symmetric decomposition to establish conditions for local identifiability and stability to exploit vector-output stencil reuse to reduce the structural query cost by a factor of 16. On independently trained CIFAR-10 vision transformers, only 16 projected Hessians, corresponding to 8193 black-box queries, recover the hidden FFN directions with average absolute cosine alignment above 0.94, with 95.1 % of GELU and 91.9 % of SiLU directions exceeding 0.90 alignment. Recovery remains high across independently trained models, repeated extraction runs, and all transformer blocks. The recovered structure supports functional extraction too. Keeping the recovered directions fixed and fitting only the remaining FFN parameters yields high-fidelity substitutes with more than 93 % top-1 agreement, while test accuracy remains within 0.90% and 0.62% of the GELU and SiLU targets. Output rounding and Gaussian noise substantially reduce recovery under a fixed attack configuration, but adapting the finite-difference step restores average alignment to 0.9603 and 0.9398. This is an end-to-end path from black-box second-order observations to hidden FFN-structure recovery and functional replacement. Under the stated oracle model, smooth FFN curvature exposes internal parameter geometry that behavioral fidelity alone cannot reveal.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示光滑两层前馈网络（FFN）在选定输入、原始输出的预言机访问下，存在一种额外的结构模型提取通道。通过利用投影输入Hessian形成的二阶泄漏通道，恢复隐藏的FFN方向（输入权重诱导的对称秩一因子），并在CIFAR-10视觉Transformer上验证了高效恢复和高保真功能替代。
AI.motivation: 现有模型提取工作多关注行为层面的功能复制，但光滑FFN的曲率信息可能暴露仅凭行为保真度无法揭示的内部参数几何结构。作者希望探索黑盒二阶观测是否足以恢复隐藏的FFN内部结构，并评估其用于功能替代的可行性。
AI.method: 将收集到的投影Hessian形式化为部分对称分解问题，建立局部可辨识性和稳定性的条件；利用向量输出模板复用将结构查询成本降低16倍；通过有限的投影Hessian（16个，对应8193次黑盒查询）恢复隐藏FFN方向；针对输出舍入和高斯噪声，采用自适应有限差分步长来恢复对齐精度。
