AI.result: 在独立训练的CIFAR-10视觉Transformer上，16个投影Hessian（8193次查询）即可恢复隐藏FFN方向，平均绝对余弦对齐超过0.94，其中GELU方向95.1%、SiLU方向91.9%的对齐超过0.90。恢复的结构支持功能提取，固定恢复方向仅拟合其余FFN参数即可获得超过93%的top-1一致率，测试精度与GELU/SiLU目标分别相差0.90%和0.62%。自适应有限差分将噪声下的平均对齐恢复到0.9603和0.9398。
AI.conclusion: 在指定的预言机模型下，光滑FFN的曲率暴露了行为保真度无法揭示的内部参数几何。该工作提供了一条从黑盒二阶观测到隐藏FFN结构恢复及功能替换的端到端路径，表明光滑激活函数下的FFN存在结构提取的安全隐患。

title: Distributional Validity and Calibration of a Korean Synthetic Persona Panel for Digital and AI Service Use: A Secondary-Data Validation Against the Korea Media Panel Survey
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access. Code and data: https://github.com/howardkim1977/persona-validation-repro (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21397425)
summary: Synthetic personas based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as substitutes for human survey respondents, yet systematic validation outside English-speaking contexts remains scarce. This secondary-data study evaluates how well a Korean synthetic persona panel (NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-Korea), conditioned into Gemini 3.5 Flash (primary) and EXAONE (comparison), reproduces digital and AI service-use distributions from the KISDI Korea Media Panel Survey. Sex-and-age-stratified panels of about 8,000 personas per model answered the survey's own items - eight service-use indicators and eight innovativeness and acceptance constructs - and were compared against weighted survey estimates. The overall mean absolute error (MAE; RQ1) was 15-19 percentage points (pp), with binary item-mean correlations of 0.69-0.90. Segment error (RQ2) across five demographic axes was 15-19 pp, with between-group gaps up to 52.4/36.2 pp (Gemini/EXAONE). Errors followed model-specific signatures: an age stereotype with low anchoring (Gemini) versus an acquiescence-consistent level bias (EXAONE). Reference-year analysis was consistent with temporal misalignment driving most generative-AI overestimation, whereas short-form underestimation was framing-sensitive. Holdout calibration on 30% of the real data (RQ3) roughly halved sex-by-age cell MAE (18.9->8.6, 15.9->6.7 pp) - yet direct estimation from the same real subsample was far more accurate (3.6 pp), and the correction did not transfer across time. The calibrated panel retained an advantage only under extremely scarce real data (about 100 responses) and, for one model, for unobserved segments. Persona-narrative conditioning beat demographic-only conditioning, but neither surpassed simple real-data baselines. Synthetic panels are thus not survey substitutes; their value is diagnostic, with operational use confined to settings lacking real data.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了韩语环境下基于LLM的合成人物面板（NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-Korea）在再现KISDI韩国媒体面板调查的数字与AI服务使用分布上的表现。结果显示整体平均绝对误差为15-19个百分点，虽经校准可减半误差，但仍远不及直接使用真实数据子样本的估计（3.6 pp）。合成面板仅在最极端的数据匮乏情境（约100个响应）下才具优势，因此结论是：合成面板不能替代真实调查，其价值在于诊断性用途，实际操作仅适用于缺乏真实数据的场景。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于LLM的合成人物被越来越多地提议作为人类调查受访者的替代品，但在非英语语境下的系统验证仍然稀缺。本研究旨在填补这一空白，通过在韩国语境下对合成人物面板进行严格验证，检验其能否可靠地再现真实调查的分布。
AI.method: 采用二手数据研究设计，将NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-Korea合成人物面板分别条件化到Gemini 3.5 Flash（主要）和EXAONE（对比）两个模型中。构建按性别和年龄分层的约8000人物面板，回答KISDI调查的8个服务使用指标和8个创新性与接受度构念。通过加权调查估计值比较，计算整体MAE（RQ1）、五个人口轴的分段误差（RQ2），并通过30%真实数据的保留校准评估改进效果（RQ3）。
AI.result: 整体MAE为15-19个百分点，二值项目均值相关性为0.69-0.90。分段误差为15-19个百分点，组间差距最高达52.4/36.2个百分点。不同模型呈现不同错误特征：Gemini存在年龄刻板印象和低锚定，EXAONE存在默许一致性水平偏差。保留校准可将性别×年龄单元格MAE减半（18.9→8.6，15.9→6.7 pp），但直接使用真实数据子样本估计更准确（3.6 pp），且校准无法跨时间迁移。合成面板仅在约100个响应的极端数据匮乏情境及未观测分段（针对一个模型）时具优势。
AI.conclusion: 合成面板不能作为调查的替代品；其价值在于诊断性用途，实际操作仅适用于缺乏真实数据的狭窄场景。人物叙述条件化优于仅人口统计条件化，但二者均未超越简单的真实数据基线。

title: Wasserstein-Barycentric Interaction Fields for Spatial Factor Models: Evidence from Language-Model Representations
summary: Spatial return models take the interaction matrix as given and leave feedback uninterpreted. We construct a bandwidth-free field from firms' language-model article embedding distributions using target-anchored Wasserstein barycentric reconstruction. A quadratic exposure-adjustment problem maps feedback into a peer-misalignment penalty ratio. For 52 firms, the field, frozen from 2018-2022 news, yields a 2023-2026 penalty ratio of 3.46 (95% interval [2.89, 4.17]) and higher conditional quasi-likelihood than equal-weighted peer support or RBF weighting of the same distances. Joint penalty ratios for the barycentric and news co-mention fields are 2.33 and 0.86 with boundary calibrated tests which reject both exclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无带宽参数的空间收益模型，利用语言模型嵌入分布和Wasserstein重心重建构建企业间关系场，并通过二次曝光调整问题将反馈映射为同伴错位惩罚比，实证显示其在52家企业中优于等权与RBF加权方法。
AI.motivation: 传统空间收益模型将交互矩阵视为给定，且无法解释反馈机制。研究者希望构建一个无需选择带宽参数、且能内生化解释企业间反馈关系的模型框架。
AI.method: 从企业新闻文章的语音模型嵌入分布出发，利用目标锚定的Wasserstein重心重建构建无带宽场。通过一个二次曝光调整问题，将反馈映射为同伴错位惩罚比。同时引入新闻共现场与重心场联合建模，并用边界校准检验进行统计推断。
AI.result: 基于2018-2022年新闻冻结的场，在2023-2026年间得到惩罚比为3.46（95%置信区间[2.89, 4.17]），其条件拟似然高于等权同伴支持或相同距离的RBF加权。重心场与新闻共现场的联合惩罚比分别为2.33和0.86，边界校准检验拒绝了两个场的排除。
AI.conclusion: 基于语言模型嵌入的目标锚定Wasserstein重心场能有效捕捉企业间空间反馈关系，无需带宽选择，且优于传统加权方法；新闻共现场与重心场共同对收益模型有显著贡献。

title: A Systematic Approach to Mechanism Design with Stochastic Dynamic Stability
summary: We consider a resource allocation problem with strategic agents that have private stochastic satisfaction functions and local constraints. To achieve a global optimal solution, we propose an incentive mechanism that induces a game among the agents. For the payment function of the mechanism, we construct a family of quadratic functions using the linear matrix inequality (LMI) approach that implements the social welfare maximizing outcome on the unique Nash equilibrium (NE) of the induced game while ensuring budget balance and individual rationality. Moreover, we propose a decentralized variable sample-size proximal best-response (VS-PBR) algorithm with Krasnoselskij iteration where only aggregate information is available to the agents. The algorithm is dynamically stable, as it is proven to converge in the mean-square sense to the NE of the game. The efficiency of the mechanism is then investigated on the Sioux Falls City transportation network, where electric vehicle (EV) users jointly select their destination and route.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种激励机制，通过LMI方法构造二次支付函数，诱导博弈并使社会福利最大化解成为唯一纳什均衡，同时满足预算平衡和个体理性。并提出一种去中心化变样本量近端最佳响应(VS-PBR)算法，利用Krasnoselskij迭代，在仅有聚合信息条件下均方收敛到纳什均衡。在Sioux Falls交通网络上验证了机制在EV用户联合选择目的地和路线场景中的效率。
AI.motivation: 在存在具有私有随机满意度函数和局部约束的战略性智能体的资源分配问题中，需要设计一种激励机制，使得全局最优解能够通过智能体之间的博弈自然达成，同时兼顾预算平衡、个体理性等经济性质以及实际部署中的去中心化和信息约束。
AI.method: 1) 利用线性矩阵不等式(LMI)方法构造一族二次支付函数，将社会福利最大化实现为诱导博弈的唯一纳什均衡；2) 提出去中心化的变样本量近端最佳响应(VS-PBR)算法，采用Krasnoselskij迭代，智能体仅依赖聚合信息进行决策更新。
AI.result: 算法被证明在均方意义上收敛到博弈的纳什均衡，具有动态稳定性；通过在Sioux Falls City交通网络上针对EV用户联合选择目的地和路线的问题进行仿真，验证了机制的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 该机制为战略性智能体下的资源分配问题提供了一种同时满足经济性质（预算平衡、个体理性）、实现全局最优（社会最优为唯一NE）以及可去中心化分布式求解（VS-PBR算法保证收敛）的完整解决方案，并在交通网络中验证了实际应用潜力。

title: B$^3$-PWL: GPU-Batched Branch-and-Bound for Piecewise-Linear Optimization with SOS2 Constraints
summary: Piecewise-linear (PWL) optimization problems arise in many mixed-integer programming (MIP) optimization applications, including portfolio optimization, workforce scheduling, and resource allocation. But solving them to global optimality remains computationally expensive because branch-and-bound repeatedly solves LP relaxation subproblems. Existing solvers are largely CPU-centric, leaving the scalability of modern GPUs underutilized. Few prior GPU-accelerated branch-and-bound either targets neural network which is not suitable for general PWL optimization, or accelerates only auxiliary subroutines such as strong branching heuristics within CPU-centric MIP solvers. To bridge this gap, we propose B$^3$-PWL, a GPU-centric batched branch-and-bound framework for piecewise-linear optimization with Special Ordered Set of type 2 (SOS2) constraints. Our method solves batches of LP relaxation subproblems concurrently on the GPU using a first-order primal-dual solver, enabled by a specialized batched block-tiled sparse matrix kernel. To complement bound computation, we further introduce a unified feasibility search module that combines an SOS2 repair primal heuristic with a batched feasibility pump to rapidly obtain feasible incumbents and improve pruning efficiency. On a benchmark of 43 PWL-MIP instances, B$^3$-PWL achieves a 9.25x geometric-mean speedup over NVIDIA cuOpt while reaching high-quality feasible incumbents on every tested instance. On a public valve-point unit-commitment benchmark, it further outperforms NVIDIA cuOpt and the open-source CPU solvers SCIP and HiGHS, demonstrating the potential of first-order LP methods as the central engine of GPU-accelerated branch-and-bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出B³-PWL，一个GPU-centric的批量分支定界框架，用于求解含SOS2约束的分段线性优化问题。通过在GPU上并发求解一批LP松弛子问题（使用一阶原始-对偶求解器和批量块状稀疏矩阵内核），并结合SOS2修复启发式与批量可行性泵的可行性搜索模块，在43个PWL-MIP实例上实现了比NVIDIA cuOpt快9.25倍的几何平均加速，并在阀点机组组合基准上超越cuOpt、SCIP和HiGHS。
AI.motivation: 分段线性（PWL）优化问题广泛存在于投资组合优化、人员排班和资源分配等混合整数规划（MIP）应用中，但求解到全局最优计算开销大，因为分支定界反复求解LP松弛子问题。现有求解器主要基于CPU，未充分利用现代GPU的可扩展性。已有的GPU加速分支定界方法要么仅针对神经网络而不适用于一般PWL优化，要么只在CPU-centric MIP求解器中加速强分支等辅助子程序。
AI.method: B³-PWL采用GPU-centric的批量分支定界框架：(1) 在GPU上并发求解一批LP松弛子问题，使用一阶原始-对偶求解器，并由专门的批量块状稀疏矩阵内核支撑；(2) 引入统一的可行性搜索模块，结合SOS2修复原始启发式与批量可行性泵，快速获得可行解（incumbent）以提高剪枝效率。
AI.result: 在43个PWL-MIP实例基准上，B³-PWL相比NVIDIA cuOpt实现9.25倍的几何平均加速，并在所有测试实例上获得高质量的可行解。在公开的阀点机组组合基准上，进一步超越NVIDIA cuOpt及开源CPU求解器SCIP和HiGHS。
AI.conclusion: 本文展示了将一阶LP方法作为GPU加速分支定界核心引擎的潜力，证明GPU-centric的批量分支定界方法能够有效加速一般PWL优化的求解，弥补了现有工作仅针对神经网络或仅加速辅助子程序的不足。

title: Agentic Quantitative Trading: A Survey of Workflows, Systems, and Evaluation
summary: Quantitative trading is moving from isolated predictive models toward agentic workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, memory, and feedback. This survey reviews agentic quantitative trading across five stages: factor mining, signal discovery, portfolio construction, order execution, and risk management. We further examine agentic quant trading systems through architecture, coordination, and adaptation, while comparing benchmarks across strategy construction, offline trading, live market evaluation, and reliability assessment. Our review finds that current systems remain concentrated on signal discovery, while complete integration with portfolio construction, execution, and risk control is still uncommon. Multi-agent systems also rely heavily on aggregation despite increasingly diverse workflow structures. Benchmark evidence further shows that strong model or forecasting capability does not reliably translate into trading performance under live market conditions and reliability controls. We conclude with future directions for more complete trading workflows, stronger coordination, and evaluation matched to the capability being assessed.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了智能体量化交易（Agentic Quantitative Trading）领域，涵盖从因子挖掘、信号发现、组合构建、订单执行到风险管理的五大阶段，并从架构、协调和自适应三个维度审视系统设计，同时对比了各类基准评测方法。
AI.motivation: 量化交易正从孤立的预测模型转向结合推理、工具使用、记忆和反馈的智能体工作流，但该领域缺乏系统性梳理，当前系统在完整交易流程集成方面仍存在明显不足。
AI.method: 采用综述研究方法，从五个交易阶段（因子挖掘、信号发现、组合构建、订单执行、风险管理）对现有智能体量化交易系统进行分类，并从架构、协调、自适应三个角度分析系统，同时对比策略构建、离线交易、实盘市场评估和可靠性评估四类基准。
AI.result: 研究发现当前系统主要集中在信号发现环节，与组合构建、执行和风险控制的完整集成仍不常见；多智能体系统虽然工作流结构日益多样化，但严重依赖聚合机制；基准证据表明，强大的模型或预测能力并不总能可靠地转化为实盘市场条件下的交易表现。
AI.conclusion: 未来应朝着更完整的交易工作流、更强的协调机制以及与所评估能力相匹配的评测方向发展。

title: Sharp Restricted Isometry Thresholds for Global Minima of Rank-Restricted Matrix LASSO
summary: We determine the sharp restricted isometry threshold for recovery at global minima of the rank-restricted matrix LASSO. For target rank $r_{\star}$, if the rank-$k$ RIP constant satisfies $δ<δ_{\mathrm{sharp}}(k/r_{\star})$, where $δ_{\mathrm{sharp}}(t)=t/(4-t)$ for $0<t<4/3$ and $δ_{\mathrm{sharp}}(t)=\sqrt{(t-1)/t}$ for $t\ge4/3$, then every global minimizer has Frobenius error $\lesssim\sqrt{r_{\star}}λ$ for all $λ\gtrsim\|\mathcal{A}^{*}(ξ)\|_{\mathrm{op}}$ and at every search rank $r\ge r_{\star}$. The constants depend only on the RIP constant and $t=k/r_{\star}$, and in particular are independent of the search rank. When the rank restriction is inactive, the result specializes to the ordinary convex matrix LASSO. We also obtain the analogous results for sparsity-restricted vector LASSO. Conversely, we show that the threshold $δ<δ_{\mathrm{sharp}}(k/r_{\star})$ cannot be improved, due to the existence of counterexamples whose global minimizers fail to recover the ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了秩限制矩阵LASSO在全局最小值处恢复的锐利限制等距（RIP）阈值。对于目标秩r*，若秩k的RIP常数满足δ<δ_sharp(k/r*)，其中δ_sharp(t)=t/(4-t)（0<t<4/3）且δ_sharp(t)=√((t-1)/t)（t≥4/3），则所有全局极小化器都有Frobenius误差≲√(r*)λ，对一切λ≳||A*(ξ)||_op和每个搜索秩r≥r*成立。常数仅依赖于RIP常数和t=k/r*，与搜索秩无关。当秩限制不活跃时，该结果退化为普通凸矩阵LASSO。文章还得到了稀疏限制向量LASSO的类似结果。相反地，文章证明了该阈值δ<δ_sharp(k/r*)不可被改进，因为存在全局极小化器无法恢复真实值的反例。
AI.motivation: 矩阵LASSO是低秩矩阵恢复中的核心方法，而确定其RIP锐利阈值对于理解何时能保证全局最小值恢复真实低秩矩阵至关重要。此前缺乏对秩限制矩阵LASSO在该阈值下的精确刻画，以及在搜索秩大于目标秩时误差界是否与搜索秩无关的分析。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析推导出分段的锐利RIP阈值函数δ_sharp(t)，并对t<4/3和t≥4/3两种情形分别给出不同的阈值表达式。作者分析了秩限制矩阵LASSO的全局极小化器性质，证明了当RIP常数满足该阈值条件时，恢复误差仅依赖于目标秩r*和正则化参数λ，而不依赖于搜索秩r。同时构造反例证明该阈值的最优性。
AI.result: 得到了秩限制矩阵LASSO的锐利RIP恢复阈值δ_sharp(t)=t/(4-t)（t<4/3）和δ_sharp(t)=√((t-1)/t)（t≥4/3）。在该阈值下所有全局极小化器都有O(√(r*)λ)的Frobenius误差，且误差常数与搜索秩无关。该结果同样适用于稀疏限制向量LASSO，并通过反例证明了阈值的不可改进性。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整刻画了秩限制矩阵LASSO的锐利RIP恢复阈值，该阈值是分段函数形式，且在稀疏向量情形有对应结果。锐利性的证明表明该条件既是充分的也是必要的，为低秩矩阵恢复的理论保证提供了精确界。

title: STAGEET: Stage-wise Typed Edit Tagging for Grammatical Error Correction with Arabic as a Case Study
summary: Sequence-to-edit approaches make grammatical error correction (GEC) efficient and locally interpretable by predicting edit labels over the input rather than generating a full corrected sentence. Their interpretability, however, is primarily operational: a label specifies how the string should change, but a single edit vocabulary does not always reveal the type of correction being made. We propose STAGEET, a stage-wise typed edit-tagging framework that reorganizes Seq2Edit supervision into typed executable stages and extends edit operations to correction categories. STAGEET decomposes correction into an ordered sequence of medium-grained typed stages; each stage predicts from its own label space, rewrites the current hypothesis once, and passes the resulting intermediate sentence to the next stage. We instantiate the framework as both an end-to-end shared-encoder multi-head model with stage-specific adapters and a fully specialized variant with one independent tagger per stage. Experiments on QALB-2014 and ZAEBUC show that category-aware staged correction retains competitive edit-based GEC performance while exposing a more inspectable correction trajectory, and attains state-of-the-art results on QALB-2014.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAGEET，一个阶段式类型化编辑标注框架，将Seq2Edit的语法纠错任务分解为有序的中粒度类型化阶段，每个阶段使用独立的标签空间预测并重写中间假设，在保持竞争力的纠错性能的同时提供更可检查的纠错轨迹，并在QALB-2014上达到最先进结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的Seq2Edit方法虽然高效且局部可解释，但其可解释性主要是操作层面的——编辑标签只说明字符串如何改变，单一编辑词汇表无法揭示纠错的类型类别，导致缺乏更高层次的语义可解释性。
AI.method: STAGEET将纠错过程分解为有序的中粒度类型化阶段序列；每个阶段拥有自己的标签空间，预测当前假设的编辑，重写一次中间句子，并传递给下一阶段。框架包含两种实例化：端到端共享编码器多头模型（带阶段特定适配器）和完全专业化变体（每个阶段独立标注器）。
AI.result: 在QALB-2014和ZAEBUC上的实验表明，类别感知的分阶段纠错在保持具有竞争力的基于编辑的GEC性能的同时，展现出更可检查的纠错轨迹，并在QALB-2014上达到最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: STAGEET通过在编辑标注中引入类别信息并实现阶段化纠错轨迹，在性能和可解释性之间取得了良好平衡，证明了类别感知的分阶段纠错是可行的且有效的。

title: Statutory AI: Aligning Large Language Models With Legal Norms
summary: With the increasing development of AI regulatory frameworks, ensuring that artificial intelligence systems, particularly generative models, operate in accordance with legal and ethical standards has become a critical priority. Existing proposals for AI alignment and value-guided behavior, however, face some limitations. Approaches such as Constitutional AI depend on human supervision, while broad normative frameworks like the Good-for-Humanity (GfH) principle may be overly general and ambiguous to provide actionable governance guidance. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hybrid approach called Statutory AI that employs pre-existing human-authored principles drawn from specific themes within a legal corpus. Specifically, Statutory AI uses legal texts as a constitutional framework, enabling AI systems to autonomously critique and revise their outputs according to established norms. It operates in two stages, both using Chain-of-Thought prompting. The first stage classifies the user prompt into one of the identified themes, while the second stage analyzes it in conjunction with relevant articles selected from the legal corpus of that theme. To illustrate the potential of our approach, we conducted an experiment involving 1,000 red-teaming prompts and five penal themes: discrimination, disclosure of confidential information, violence, fraud, and abuse of vulnerable persons. Statutory AI reduced harmful content by 52 to 59 percentage points across tested models, approximately 10 percentage points higher than standard Constitutional AI, while cutting computation time by over 50%.

AI.tldr: 提出Statutory AI混合方法，利用法律文本作为宪法框架，通过两阶段Chain-of-Thought提示让AI系统自主批判和修订输出，在减少有害内容方面比Constitutional AI高约10个百分点，同时计算时间减少50%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有AI对齐方法存在局限：Constitutional AI依赖人类监督，而Good-for-Humanity等广义规范框架过于笼统模糊，难以提供可操作的治理指导。
AI.method: 采用法律语料库中特定主题的既有原则作为宪法框架，分两阶段运行（均使用Chain-of-Thought提示）：第一阶段将用户提示分类到识别出的主题中；第二阶段结合该主题法律语料库中选出的相关条款进行分析。
AI.result: 在1,000个红队提示和五个刑法主题（歧视、泄露机密信息、暴力、欺诈、虐待弱势群体）的实验中，Statutory AI将有害内容减少了52到59个百分点，比标准Constitutional AI高出约10个百分点，同时计算时间减少超过50%。
AI.conclusion: Statutory AI通过利用法律文本作为可操作的宪法框架，提供了一种更有效且更高效的AI对齐方法，克服了现有方法在依赖人类监督和准则过于笼统方面的缺陷。

title: Equivariant Sheaf Neural Networks: Learning Geometric Transport on Graphs
summary: Equivariant graph neural networks provide a principled way to model geometric systems, but efficient first-order architectures remain limited in how vector information can be transformed as it moves across a graph. We introduce \textsc{ESNN}, an Equivariant Sheaf Neural Network that enriches this interaction by learning directed, matrix-valued transport between neighboring vector features while preserving exact Euclidean equivariance. Rather than increasing the order of the representation, ESNN keeps scalar and vector features first-order and places the additional geometric flexibility in the edge transport itself. We characterize this transport theoretically, showing that when relative displacement is the only covariant geometric input, every linear $O(n)$-equivariant map decomposes into independent radial and tangential components, while learned covariant features enable richer feature-conditioned transformations. We also introduce controlled symmetry relaxation for systems with a preferred ambient direction, which may be prescribed or inferred from data while recovering full $E(n)$-equivariance when the directional pathway is inactive. Across particle dynamics, mesh-based simulation, point-cloud classification, and molecular property prediction, ESNN improves dynamics prediction, recovers the gravity axis when symmetry is broken, yields substantial gains on selected mesh tasks and long-horizon rollouts, and remains robust to unseen rotations. These results show that learning how geometric information is transported across edges offers a complementary route to expressive equivariant message passing without requiring higher-order representations.

AI.tldr: ESNN是一种等变Sheaf神经网络，通过学习有向矩阵值边传输（edge transport）来丰富几何信息在图中的传递，同时保持一阶标量和矢量特征的精确欧几里得等变性，在粒子动力学、网格模拟、点云分类和分子性质预测等任务上取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的等变图神经网络虽然能建模几何系统，但高效的一阶架构在向量信息跨图传递时的变换方式上存在局限，需要探索在不增加表示阶数的情况下提升表达能力的途径。
AI.method: ESNN在两个节点特征之间引入学习到的有向矩阵值传输（edge transport），保持标量和矢量特征为一阶，将额外的几何灵活性放在边传输本身。理论上证明了当相对位移是唯一协变几何输入时，每个线性O(n)-等变映射可分解为独立的径向和切向分量；同时引入受控对称性松弛来处理具有偏好环境方向的系统，可从数据中推断或在方向通路不活跃时恢复完全的E(n)-等变性。
AI.result: 在粒子动力学、网格模拟、点云分类和分子性质预测任务上，ESNN显著改善了动力学预测、在对称性破缺时能恢复重力轴、在选定网格任务和长时程推演中获得大幅提升，并对未见过的旋转保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 学习几何信息在边上的传输方式为表达性等变消息传递提供了一种互补路径，无需使用高阶表示即可提升模型能力。

title: Advisor career stage and PhD advisee outcomes
summary: PhD advisors are central to doctoral training, but their influence may vary across career stages. Early-, mid-, and late-career advisors may differ in research activity, mentoring capacity, professional networks and access to resources. However, little is known about how PhD advisor career stage is associated with PhD student development outcomes. Drawing on multiple large-scale datasets comprising 250,838 advisor-advisee pairs from 312 U.S. PhD-granting institutions, we examine the relationship between advisor career stage and PhD advisee outcomes in knowledge production, collaboration networks and academic career placement. We find that early-career PhD advisors are associated with advisees' higher research productivity and citation performance, more opportunities to engage in direct and intensive research collaboration, and greater likelihood of securing a faculty position. Mid- and late-career faculty, by contrast, appear to have advantages in providing network capital which students can inherit after graduation, training PhD advisees to produce disruptive research, and supporting them in securing faculty positions at top institutions. This study contributes to a more comprehensive understanding of the reproduction of scientific talent by revealing the role of advisor career stage in shaping this process. These findings have implications for doctoral applicants' decision-making and for institutional policymaking on PhD training, faculty support and faculty evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于312所美国博士授予机构的250,838对导师-博士生数据，发现早期职业导师与博士生更高的科研产出、引用表现、紧密合作机会及获得教职的可能性相关；而中晚期职业导师则在提供网络资本、培养颠覆性研究和支持顶尖机构教职方面具有优势。
AI.motivation: 博士导师对博士生培养至关重要，但其影响力可能因职业阶段而异。早期、中期和晚期职业导师在研究活动、指导能力、专业网络和资源获取上存在差异，然而导师职业阶段与博士生发展结果之间的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 利用多个大规模数据集，涵盖312所美国博士授予机构的250,838对导师-博士生数据，分析导师职业阶段与博士生在知识生产、合作网络和学术职业安置方面的结果之间的关系。
AI.result: 早期职业导师与博士生更高的研究生产力和引用表现、更多直接和深入的研究合作机会以及更大的获得教职可能性相关；中晚期职业导师则在提供可继承的网络资本、培养颠覆性研究和支持博士生获得顶尖机构教职方面具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了导师职业阶段在塑造科学人才再生产过程中的作用，为全面理解科学人才培养提供了新视角，对博士申请者的决策以及博士培养、教师支持和教师评价方面的制度政策制定具有启示意义。

title: Stochastic Optimal Control of Hawkes Jump-Diffusion Systems
summary: This paper is devoted to developing a framework for stochastic growth models with environmental risk, in which rare but catastrophic shocks interact with capital accumulation and pollution. Building on the Poisson point process formulation studied in arXiv:2511.13568, we extend the model to disasters driven by a marked Hawkes process, allowing past disasters to temporarily increase the likelihood of subsequent shocks. Our work focuses on a subcritical Markovian Hawkes specification, in which the state space is augmented by the self-excitation component of disaster risk. We establish the well-posedness and nonexplosion of the resulting controlled Hawkes dynamics. Using the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman characterization of the corresponding Poisson control problem, we obtain quantitative estimates for the Hawkes excitation process and prove, under a small-excitation scaling, that the Hawkes value function converges to its Poisson counterpart as the magnitude of self-excitation vanishes. This provides a rigorous Poisson approximation of the stochastic control problem and quantifies the effect of self-excitation on optimal growth under environmental disaster risk.

AI.tldr: 本文为带有环境风险的随机增长模型建立了一个新框架，将灾害冲击建模为带标记的霍克斯过程（Hawkes process），使过去的灾害事件能够暂时提高后续冲击发生的概率。作者考虑了次临界的马尔可夫霍克斯设定，通过增广状态空间纳入自激成分，建立了受控霍克斯动力学的适定性和非爆炸性，并证明了在小激发现象尺度下霍克斯值函数收敛到泊松对应量，从而提供了对最优增长的严格泊松逼近。
AI.motivation: 传统随机增长模型通常使用泊松过程建模罕见灾害，但泊松过程假设灾害事件之间是独立的，无法捕捉灾害聚集效应（即一次灾害后短期内再次发生灾害的概率更高）。作者希望扩展已有工作（arXiv:2511.13568中的泊松点过程公式），以更真实地刻画环境灾害风险的时序依赖性和自激特征。
AI.method: 1) 将灾害风险建模为带标记的霍克斯过程，扩展原有的泊松点过程框架；2) 聚焦于次临界马尔可夫霍克斯设定，通过自激分量增广状态空间；3) 建立受控霍克斯动力学的适定性与非爆炸性；4) 利用对应的泊松控制问题的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman特征，获得霍克斯激发现象的定量估计；5) 在小激发现象缩放下证明霍克斯值函数收敛到泊松值函数，量化自激对最优增长的影响。
AI.result: 论文证明了受控霍克斯动力学的适定性和非爆炸性，获得了霍克斯激发现象过程的定量估计，并证明了在小激发现象缩放下，霍克斯值函数收敛到其在泊松框架下的对应量，给出了一个严格的泊松逼近结果，同时量化了自激效应对环境灾害风险下最优增长的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为具有自激灾害聚集效应的环境风险增长模型提供了严格的数学基础，证明了在小自激极限下泊松模型是霍克斯模型的良好近似，并明确指出自激效应如何改变最优增长路径。这一结果为在实践中利用更简单的泊松模型逼近复杂的霍克斯动力学提供了理论依据。

title: Portfolio Risk Bounds without Cross-Asset Return Covariances: Distributional Fields from Language-Model Representations
summary: Portfolio risk assessment ordinarily relies on reliable estimates of cross-asset return covariances, which are difficult to obtain in short, high-dimensional panels. We show that firm-level distribution-valued characteristics can instead provide one-sided certificates of portfolio risk. Under maintained links from characteristics to systematic exposures and from exposures to returns, multi-firm Wasserstein-2 dispersion yields a sharp upper bound on systematic portfolio variance and a corresponding bound for standardized returns. A weighted pairwise relaxation produces an objective that is convex under a checkable condition and requires marginal volatility scales but no cross-asset return covariances. With zero firm-specific slack, the common-map scale changes the certified variance reduction but not the normalized allocation, which depends only on observed information geometry. In a 52-firm panel from 2018-2022, an allocation constructed from Qwen3-Embedding-8B news representations lies between the 0.69th and 1.33rd in-sample variance percentiles across four prespecified capped portfolio populations; equal risk weighting lies between the 21.1st and 28.6th percentiles. The lower in-sample variance ranking relative to equal risk also appears across the reported frozen language-model representations. The framework therefore distribution-valued firm information into a coherent risk bound and an implementable allocation rule constructed without cross-asset return covariances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于企业层面分布值特征的投资组合风险评估新框架，利用多企业Wasserstein-2离散度对系统投资组合方差提供严格上界，无需跨资产收益协方差即可构建可实施的投资组合配置规则。
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合风险评估依赖可靠的跨资产收益协方差估计，而在短期限、高维面板数据中难以获得可靠估计。作者旨在探索是否可以利用企业层面分布值特征来替代协方差估计，提供投资组合风险的单边证明（one-sided certificates）。
AI.method: 在特征与系统性暴露、暴露与收益之间维持联系的假设下，利用多企业Wasserstein-2离散度推导系统投资组合方差及标准化收益的严格上界。通过加权成对松弛得到一个在可检查条件下为凸的目标函数，仅需边际波动率尺度而无需跨资产收益协方差。在零公司特定松弛度情况下，公共映射尺度改变认证的方差缩减但不改变归一化配置，后者仅依赖于观测到的信息几何。
AI.result: 在2018-2022年52家企业面板中，基于Qwen3-Embedding-8B新闻表示构建的配置落在四个预定上限投资组合群体的样本内方差百分位的0.69至1.33之间；等风险加权配置位于21.1至28.6百分位之间。较低的样本内方差排名在冻结语言模型表示中同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将分布值企业信息转化为一致的风险边界和无需跨资产收益协方差的可实施配置规则，为高维短期面板下的投资组合风险评估提供了新途径。

title: Stochastic Nonlinear Model Predictive Control with Gaussian Mixture Uncertainty Propagation
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
summary: We propose a novel Stochastic Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (SNMPC) framework for nonlinear systems with additive noise. Building on recent advances in nonlinear uncertainty propagation, we show that the state distribution of the system can be tractably approximated over time by Gaussian mixture distributions, with formal error bounds in Wasserstein distance. This representation yields closed-form expressions for expected costs and chance constraints, which become exact for affine constraints and exact up to a constant for quadratic costs. Consequently, the resulting control problem can be solved efficiently via nonlinear programming, while providing formal open-loop guarantees of correctness and asymptotic optimality. Experiments on a set of benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach compares favorably with existing methods in nonlinear settings with multi-modal disturbances, where standard approaches lead to poorly scaled solutions and unsafe or overly conservative control actions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于高斯混合分布近似的随机非线性模型预测控制（SNMPC）框架，利用非线性不确定性传播的最新进展，以Wasserstein距离下的形式误差界来近似状态分布，从而获得期望成本和机会约束的闭式表达，最终将问题转化为可高效求解的非线性规划。
AI.motivation: 传统非线性随机最优控制方法在处理多模态扰动时往往产生糟糕的标度解、不安全或过于保守的控制行为，难以兼顾计算效率与控制质量。
AI.method: 借助非线性不确定性传播的先进技术，将系统状态分布以高斯混合分布进行近似（附带Wasserstein距离误差界）；利用该表示推导期望成本与机会约束的闭式表达式（仿射约束精确，二次成本精确至常数项）；将随机控制问题转化为非线性规划求解。
AI.result: 在基准测试集上的实验表明，所提方法在非线性多模态扰动场景下优于现有方法，避免了标准方法导致的解质量差、不安全或过于保守的问题；同时提供了形式化的开环正确性保证与渐近最优性证明。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的SNMPC框架为非线性系统在多模态噪声下的随机最优控制提供了一种兼具理论保证与计算效率的求解途径。

title: A New Primal-Dual Algorithm with Two Convex Combinations and Linesearch for General Convex-Concave Saddle-Point Problems
summary: Convex-concave saddle-point problems are ubiquitous across diverse domains, including machine learning, image processing, economics, and equilibrium problems. Primal-dual algorithms provide a highly effective and powerful framework for convex-concave saddle-point problems. Convex combination has become a crucial acceleration technique for primal-dual algorithms, and the integration of this technique has recently made these algorithms a highly active research topic. The choice of the convex combination parameter often has a significant impact on both the theoretical analysis and the numerical performance of the corresponding algorithms. However, the requirements on this parameter imposed by theory are sometimes inconsistent with those suggested by numerical experiments. For instance, theoretical analysis often requires the parameter to be small, while numerical experiments tend sometimes to favor larger values. To address this inconsistency and further advance primal-dual algorithms with convex combination, we develop a novel strategy based on two convex combinations, integrate it into a primal-dual framework, and propose a new primal-dual algorithm with linesearch, termed NPDAL-n, for general convex-concave saddle-point problems. The proposed two convex combinations in NPDAL-n ensure that the permissible range of the convex combination parameters is mainly determined by theoretical considerations, with little regard for numerical performance. Through rigorous Lyapunov energy descent analysis, we establish the global convergence and a sublinear ergodic convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(1/N)$ for NPDAL-n under standard assumptions. When the primal function is strongly convex, we develop an accelerated version of NPDAL-n that achieves an optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/N^2)$ rate.

AI.tldr: 本文针对凸-凹鞍点问题，提出了一种基于双重凸组合策略的原始-对偶算法NPDAL-n，并引入线搜索技术。该方法解决了理论分析中凸组合参数要求与数值实验偏好不一致的问题，在标准假设下证明了全局收敛性和O(1/N)的次线性遍历收敛率；当原始函数强凸时，加速版本可达到最优的O(1/N²)收敛率。
AI.motivation: 凸-凹鞍点问题广泛存在于机器学习、图像处理、经济学等领域。原始-对偶算法是解决此类问题的有效框架，而凸组合是关键的加速技术。然而，凸组合参数在理论要求（通常要求较小）与数值实验偏好（有时倾向较大值）之间存在不一致，这一矛盾阻碍了算法的理论分析与实际应用效果的统一。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种基于两次凸组合的新策略，将其集成到原始-对偶框架中，并设计了带线搜索的新算法NPDAL-n。双重凸组合的设计使得凸组合参数的允许范围主要由理论考量决定，而不必过多顾虑数值表现。算法通过Lyapunov能量下降分析进行收敛性证明；当原始函数强凸时，进一步开发了加速版本。
AI.result: 通过严格的Lyapunov能量下降分析，在标准假设下证明了NPDAL-n的全局收敛性以及O(1/N)的次线性遍历收敛率。对于强凸情形，加速版本实现了最优的O(1/N²)收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的双重凸组合策略有效调和了理论分析与数值实验对凸组合参数要求的矛盾，为原始-对偶算法的发展提供了新的思路，同时在强凸情形下达到了最优收敛速率。

title: Uniform Statistical Convergence of Empirical Sinkhorn Potentials with Exponential and Polynomial Dependence on the Regularization Parameter
summary: We study the empirical Sinkhorn estimator of the entropic optimal transport potentials under the uniform loss. Since the potentials are only unique up to additive constants, we measure the error using the quotient supremum norm, defined as $d_\infty([u],[v]) = \inf_{a\in\mathbb{R}}\|u-v-a\|_\infty$. For a fixed regularization parameter $\varepsilon>0$, we establish a non-asymptotic statistical rate of $n^{-1/2}$. This is achieved by combining the Birkhoff-Hopf contraction theorem with entropy bounds on normalized kernel sections. However, the constant in this bound grows exponentially with $1/ε$. To improve this, we isolate geometric conditions under which the empirical estimator maintains the $n^{-1/2}$ rate but features polynomial dependence on $1/\varepsilon$. The key requirement is a polynomial residual-stability estimate for the population Sinkhorn map. We provide sufficient criteria for this, including a polynomial contraction property and a local inverse estimate. Furthermore, we introduce two rigorously verifiable model classes an $\varepsilon$-weak residual-interaction class obtained after separable centering and another based on connected tight-edge graphs for fixed discrete costs where the polynomial rate is guaranteed without relying on abstract resolvent assumptions. Finally, we establish matching minimax lower bounds demonstrating that the $\varepsilon n^{-1/2}$ rate cannot be uniformly improved in the bounded-interaction regime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了熵最优传输势的经验Sinkhorn估计量在一致损失下的统计性质，利用商 supremum 范数度量误差，建立了 n^{-1/2} 的率，并探讨了常数对 1/ε 的依赖关系，最终给出了匹配的极小极大下界。
AI.motivation: 熵最优传输势的经验Sinkhorn估计量虽然已有研究，但已有收敛率对正则化参数ε的依赖通常是指数级的，这在实践中不可接受。作者希望找到几何条件，使得在保持 n^{-1/2} 统计率的同时，常数对 1/ε 仅有多项式依赖，从而在实际应用中更可行。
AI.method: 作者结合Birkhoff-Hopf收缩定理与归一化核截面的熵界建立非渐近率；随后通过引入多项式残差稳定性估计作为关键条件，将常数改进为对 1/ε 的多项式依赖。为验证该条件，提出了多项式收缩性质和局部逆估计两个充分判据，并构造了两个可严格验证的模型类：可分中心化后的 ε-弱残差交互类，以及固定离散代价下基于连通紧边图的模型。
AI.result: 建立了 n^{-1/2} 的非渐近统计率；在多项式残差稳定性条件下，常数对 ε 的依赖从指数改进为多项式。同时构造了两种可验证的模型类保证多项式率，并建立了匹配的极小极大下界 ε n^{-1/2}，证明在有界交互区域中该率无法被一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统刻画了熵Sinkhorn估计量在一致损失下的统计复杂度，阐明了正则化参数 ε 对估计精度的影响机制，并通过极小极大下界确认了所得上界的本质最优性。

title: From GenAI Virtual Patient Dialogue Logs to Teacher-Interpretable Process Evidence: A Learning Analytics Study in Higher Education
summary: Medical history taking is a dialogue-based clinical reasoning task in which learners must gather, organise, and integrate patient information while the consultation unfolds. Generative AI-powered virtual patients (GenAI VPs) make repeated history taking practice scalable and preserve full turn by turn dialogue. However, these logs are educationally difficult to use directly. Complete transcripts are too detailed for routine teacher review, whereas final scores obscure whether learners followed up patient cues, checked uncertainty, or used summaries to guide later questioning. This study examined whether coded GenAI VP dialogues can provide teacher-interpretable process evidence of clinical reasoning. We analysed 1{,}030 GenAI VP dialogues from 210 second-year medical learners across five weeks chest-pain cases. Each consultation was teacher-scored using a rubric assessing the full history taking dialogue, and consultations were classified within each week as high- or low-rated using the weekly median score. To explain how rated performance was reflected in the dialogue process, we applied three analytic layers to the same coded dialogue data: behavioural prevalence, local co-occurrence using Epistemic Network Analysis, and sequential transition using Transition Network Analysis. High-rated consultations involved more history taking activity, but differences were not simply about volume. High rated consultations more often connected information gathering and symptom exploration with communication, checking, organisation, and synthesis. Summarising and organising moves more often led to verification or mechanism-oriented follow-up. These findings show how layered analysis of GenAI VP dialogue logs can reveal process patterns associated with high rated history taking and support process-focused feedback in medical education.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了1030段由210名二年级医学生产生的GenAI虚拟患者问诊对话，通过三层分析（行为频率、认知网络分析、转换网络分析）揭示高分问诊的关键过程模式：高分咨询不仅仅是问诊活动量更大，更在于信息收集与沟通、核查、组织、综合之间的连接更紧密，且总结和组织行为更常引导后续的验证或机制导向追问。
AI.motivation: 传统医学问诊教学评估面临两难：完整对话日志过于冗长，教师难以逐条审阅；而最终分数又无法反映学习者的过程性推理能力（如是否跟进患者线索、是否核查不确定性、是否使用总结引导后续提问）。需要一种能提供教师可解读的过程性证据的分析方法。
AI.method: 分析1030段GenAI虚拟患者问诊对话，由教师用标注完整问诊对话的量规评分，并按每周中位数分数将咨询划分为高、低评分组；对同一编码对话数据应用三层分析：行为频率分析、基于认知网络分析的局部共现分析、基于转换网络分析的序列转换分析。
AI.result: 高分咨询包含更多问诊活动，但差异不仅是数量上的；高分咨询更常将信息收集和症状探索与沟通、核查、组织、综合连接起来；总结和组织行为更常引导验证或机制导向的后续追问。
AI.conclusion: 对GenAI虚拟患者对话日志的分层分析能揭示与高评分问诊相关的过程模式，支持医学教育中面向过程的反馈。

title: From Question-First to Analyst-First: Domain-Expert Skills and Verified Knowledge Compilation for Proactive Enterprise Analytics
summary: Conversational analytics systems assume the user already has a well-formed question, leaving a non-expert facing a blank query box on an unfamiliar enterprise schema. Commercial 'proactive' tools narrow this gap only by detecting statistical anomalies over analyst-curated metric layers, and academic next-question recommenders depend on query logs that a fresh dataset lacks. We describe a production analytics system that inverts the interaction model from question-first to analyst-first through two coupled architectural ideas. First, a pluggable domain-expert 'skill' abstraction: a folder-based, database-free subject-matter pack (a manifest, per-stage prompt facets, keyword-routed references, report templates, and optional compute) auto-selected per (client, dataset) by deterministic schema matching and spliced as a cross-cutting concern into every stage of an agentic pipeline, the schema explorer, and the report engines, degrading to a strict no-op when absent. Because a skill is a self-contained folder resolved deterministically, the catalogue is open-ended: an extensible marketplace of domain experts. Second, an offline knowledge-compilation loop: an agent probes the dataset's parquet via DuckDB (zero load on production), runs critic-gated per-table convergence with self-healing retries, and data-validates joins by value overlap, producing durable schema knowledge that drives standing expert reports whose every published metric is re-verified by re-executing its evidence SQL, plus suggested questions that mirror the report agenda. These close a proactive loop: reports surface numbers, the numbers seed questions, and a click launches a verified deep dive, all before the query box is used. We give a formal model and report illustrative single-tenant evidence. We make no user-study or benchmark claims; the contribution is the architecture and its defensibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"分析师优先"（analyst-first）的生产级分析系统架构，颠覆了传统"提问优先"（question-first）的交互模式。系统通过两个核心思想实现：(1) 可插拔的领域专家"技能"（skill）抽象——一种基于文件夹、无需数据库的主题包，通过确定性schema匹配自动选用并贯穿整个代理流水线；(2) 离线知识编译循环——代理通过DuckDB探测parquet数据，执行带有批评门控和自愈重试的逐表收敛，并基于值重叠验证连接，生成持久化的schema知识，驱动常驻专家报告和推荐问题。该系统在用户使用查询框之前就主动呈现报告和问题，形成"报告揭示数字→数字启发问题→点击进入深潜"的主动闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有会话分析系统假设用户已有结构良好的问题，但非专家面对陌生企业schema的空白查询框时无从下手。商业"主动"工具仅能通过分析师策划的度量层检测统计异常，学术的next-question推荐依赖查询日志而新数据集没有这些日志。因此需要一种无需查询日志、不依赖预定义度量层的方案来弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 两个耦合的架构思想：(1) 可插拔领域专家"技能"抽象：基于文件夹、数据库无关的主题包（包含manifest、每阶段提示面、关键字路由引用、报告模板、可选计算），通过确定性schema匹配按(客户端,数据集)自动选择，作为横切关注点注入代理流水线、schema探索器和报告引擎的每个阶段，缺失时降级为no-op。技能是自包含文件夹且确定性解析，因此目录是开放式的可扩展市场。(2) 离线知识编译循环：代理通过DuckDB探测parquet（生产零负载），执行批评门控的逐表收敛与自愈重试，按值重叠数据验证连接，生成持久schema知识，驱动常驻专家报告（每个发布指标通过重执行其证据SQL重新验证）和建议问题（镜像报告议程）。
AI.result: 本文给出了形式化模型并报告了说明性的单租户证据。作者明确声明不做用户研究或基准测试声明，贡献在于架构本身及其可辩护性（defensibility）。
AI.conclusion: 该架构通过"报告→问题→深潜"的主动闭环，在用户使用查询框之前就提供价值，为非专家用户弥合了陌生schema的认知鸿沟。技能抽象保证了可扩展性和开放性，离线知识编译保证了生产系统零负载。

title: The Halt Vector: Internalizing a Causal Steering Intervention for Efficient Reasoning
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Efficient Reasoning, COLM 2026 (non-archival). Code: https://github.com/dylanjayabahu/halt-vector
summary: Reasoning models do not stop when they know the answer. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B the chain of thought runs about twice as long as the model's own answer probability takes to settle, and how much of that excess is removable varies from problem to problem, so a global length penalty cannot take it out. We take it out by internalizing a causal interpretability finding into the weights. The mechanism is a halt vector: a difference-of-means direction at layer 18 of this model whose steering strength controls how long it thinks, while a replicated value axis does nothing. Installing that intervention in the weights is harder than it looks. Maximizing the scalar projection onto the direction corrupts the off-axis dimensions a frozen downstream reader depends on, and generation gets longer instead of shorter; what works is reconstructing the whole steered activation with those dimensions pinned to their natural values. Fit from 24 problems and no reinforcement learning, the halt removes about a quarter of the thinking at held accuracy across five unseen benchmarks, and the cut tracks each problem's own removable slack at 0.70. It also closes a non-termination pathology that grows with difficulty and that a decoding-time confidence hook makes worse. We do not claim to beat a well-tuned length penalty or decoding-time early exit on the raw trade-off; the contribution is how the halt is obtained.

AI.tldr: 论文发现DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B的思维链长度约是答案概率收敛时间的两倍，且可移除的冗余因问题而异。作者通过因果可解释性发现了一个"停止向量"（halt vector）——第18层的均值差方向，其操纵强度控制思考长度。通过将整个被导向的激活重建（而非仅最大化标量投影）并固定离轴维度，将该干预固化进权重中。仅用24个问题、无强化学习，可使五个未见基准的思考量减少约四分之一，且削减量与各问题自身可移除冗余的相关性达0.70，还能修复随难度增长的终止失败病理。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在已经知道答案后不会停止思考，产生大量冗余计算。由于每个问题可移除的冗余量不同，全局长度惩罚无法有效去除，需要一种可泛化、针对性的截停机制。
AI.method: 首先通过因果可解释性识别第18层的一个"停止向量"（halting direction），其导向强度控制思考时长。将干预内化到权重的关键是：不能只最大化标量投影（会破坏冻结下游读取器依赖的离轴维度），而需重建整个受导向的激活并将这些维度固定为自然值。作者用24个问题拟合，无需强化学习。
AI.result: 在五个未见基准上，约去除四分之一的思维链长度且保持准确率；削减量与每个问题自身可移除冗余的相关性为0.70；同时修复了随难度增长的非终止病理（该病理在解码置信度钩子下反而恶化）。
AI.conclusion: 作者不声称在原始权衡上胜过精心调优的长度惩罚或解码时提前退出，贡献在于通过因果可解释性发现并权重内化"停止向量"这一方法路径本身。

title: Can AI-Assisted Inquiry Enhance Students' Decision-Making Skills in Socio-Scientific Issues? A Three-Group Experimental Study on Climate Change
summary: Climate change is a socio-scientific issue: it rests on science but cannot be settled by science, because any serious response forces people to weigh costs, values, and competing interests under uncertainty. Helping students make such decisions well is a central aim of science education, and the arrival of generative artificial intelligence raises a sharp question: does a conversational AI partner deepen students' reasoning, or simply do the thinking for them? This study tested whether AI-assisted inquiry improves secondary students' decision-making about climate change. Using a pretest-posttest design with three groups (AI-assisted inquiry, inquiry without AI, and traditional instruction; 270 students, 90 per group), reasoning was assessed across seven decision-making steps, from defining the problem to monitoring with adaptive management, using a four-level analytic rubric scored through content analysis with high inter-coder agreement. All three groups began at comparable, mostly low levels and all improved, but the gains differed sharply. The AI-assisted group improved most, ahead of inquiry-only and of traditional instruction. Between-group effect sizes on gains were large for AI-assisted versus traditional instruction and moderate-to-large for AI-assisted versus inquiry-only, with the clearest advantages on stakeholder engagement, alternatives, implementation, and monitoring. Within the AI group, the number of times students checked the AI's claims against the sources predicted their gains, and no student was flagged for over-reliance. The findings suggest that AI helps most when it is designed to question rather than to answer, and that the inquiry it is embedded in carries much of the benefit.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过270名中学生的前后测实验，比较了AI辅助探究、纯探究和传统教学三种方式对学生气候变化决策推理能力的影响。结果显示AI辅助探究组进步最大，且学生主动核查AI信息来源的次数与其收益正相关，未发现过度依赖现象。
AI.motivation: 气候变化是典型的社会科学议题，需要权衡价值与不确定性下的复杂决策。生成式AI的出现引发核心疑问：AI对话伙伴究竟是深化学生的推理，还是替他们思考？这一问题直接关系到科学教育中AI工具的合理定位。
AI.method: 采用前后测设计，将270名学生（每组90人）分为AI辅助探究、无AI探究和传统教学三组，通过七个决策步骤（从问题界定到自适应管理监控）的四级分析性量规进行内容分析评分，并统计AI组学生核查AI来源的次数。
AI.result: 三组均有进步但幅度差异显著：AI辅助探究组提升最大，与AI组对比传统教学组效应量大，对比纯探究组效应量中到大。AI组在利益相关者参与、备选方案、实施和监控上优势最明显；AI组内核查来源次数与进步相关，无人被判定过度依赖AI。
AI.conclusion: AI在设计中"提问而非作答"时帮助最大，且其所嵌入的探究框架本身承载了大部分收益。这为生成式AI在教育中的应用提供了重要设计原则。

title: A Catalog of Probability Generating Functionals for Multitarget Tracking and Data Assignment Problems
summary: This paper studies the class of Bayesian tracking filters for which the probability generating functional of the joint target-measurement process can be derived from the statistical assumptions that define the problem. The class includes filters for labeled and unlabeled targets, as well as hybrid filters in which both labeled and unlabeled targets are present. New results include the probability generating functional for interval filtering of target trajectories for both labeled an unlabeled targets, and a novel method for computing the probability generating function of measurement-to-target assignment probabilities. Probability generating functionals give exact expressions for calculating the importance weights in particle filter implementations. Low computational complexity approximations to the particle weights are derived from the probability generating functionals via the saddle point method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一类贝叶斯跟踪滤波器，其联合目标-测量过程的概率生成泛函（PGFL）可从定义问题的统计假设中推导出来。该类滤波器涵盖标记目标、未标记目标以及两者混合的混合滤波器。论文提出了标记和未标记目标轨迹区间滤波的概率生成泛函新结果，以及计算测量到目标分配概率生成函数的新方法。PGFL可为粒子滤波实现提供精确的重要性权重计算表达式，并可通过鞍点法从PGFL推导出低计算复杂度的粒子权重近似。
AI.motivation: 多目标跟踪滤波器的性能分析通常依赖于特定统计假设，但缺乏一种统一的泛函框架来推导关键量（如重要性权重和分配概率）。论文旨在为广泛的贝叶斯跟踪滤波器类提供统一的PGFL理论框架，从而简化粒子滤波实现中重要性权重的精确计算。
AI.method: 论文提出了一种基于概率生成泛函（PGFL）的统一方法论：首先从统计假设推导联合目标-测量过程的PGFL；然后利用该PGFL推导粒子滤波中重要性权重的精确表达式；最后通过鞍点法对粒子权重进行低复杂度近似。
AI.result: 论文提供了三个新结果：（1）标记和未标记目标的轨迹区间滤波PGFL；（2）计算测量到目标分配概率生成函数的新方法；（3）通过鞍点法从PGFL推导出低计算复杂度的粒子权重近似方法。
AI.conclusion: PGFL为贝叶斯多目标跟踪提供了一种统一的数学框架，能够精确计算粒子滤波的重要性权重，同时鞍点法提供了一种在保持合理精度的前提下降低计算复杂度的实用途径，适用于广泛的跟踪场景（标记/未标记/混合目标）。

title: The Stochastic Team Orienteering Problem
summary: This paper analyses the Stochastic Team Orienteering Problem (STOP), a stochastic variant of the Team Orienteering Problem (TOP). In the STOP, travel times are represented by random variables. The objective is to determine a set of routes that maximises the expected collected profit. We model the problem as a two-stage stochastic integer program and propose an exact solution method based on the Integer L-shaped method. We also consider a set of non-linear chance constraints to restrict the search to highly reliable routes. In the first-stage, a set of routes is selected, while in the second-stage the recourse evaluates the expected profit of the selected routes. We present a new set of optimality cuts and strengthen the formulation by considering valid inequalities and constraints liftings. Computational results provide a comprehensive analysis of the algorithm using the standard TOP benchmark dataset from the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机团队定向问题（STOP），将行驶时间视为随机变量，目标为最大化期望收集利润。作者将其建模为两阶段随机整数规划，提出基于整数L-shaped方法的精确求解算法，并引入非线性机会约束以确保路线高可靠性，同时设计了新的最优性割和有效不等式来强化公式，在标准TOP基准数据集上进行了全面计算分析。
AI.motivation: 团队定向问题（TOP）在实际应用中往往面临行驶时间不确定性的挑战，传统确定性模型无法处理这类随机性。作者旨在将TOP扩展到随机环境，在不确定条件下为决策者提供高可靠性和高期望收益的路线方案。
AI.method: 将STOP建模为两阶段随机整数规划：第一阶段选择路线集合，第二阶段通过追索（recourse）函数评估所选路线的期望利润。采用整数L-shaped精确求解方法，提出新的最优性割，并通过有效不等式和约束提升（liftings）增强公式，同时引入非线性机会约束以筛选高可靠性路线。
AI.result: 使用文献中的标准TOP基准数据集进行了全面的计算实验，对算法性能进行了深入分析，验证了所提方法的有效性和求解效率。
AI.conclusion: 本文为随机环境下的团队定向问题提供了一种精确求解框架，通过机会约束保证了路线的可靠性，并通过多种强化手段提升了算法性能，为后续随机路径规划问题的研究提供了坚实的方法基础。

title: Deciding When to Decide: Testing Operational Suboptimality Under Distributional Shift
summary: Deployed decisions are often optimized once and retained because updates impose operational, regulatory, or switching costs. As operating conditions change, when should such decisions be re-optimized? We study this question for stochastic optimization when the objective's functional form is known but the decision maker's trade-offs are encoded by an unknown preference parameter. Standard distribution-shift tests are poorly aligned with this goal: they can flag detectable yet decision-irrelevant changes without determining whether the incumbent decision has become materially suboptimal. We propose \texttt{RADAR} (Regret-based Assessment of Decision Adequacy and Risk), a decision-focused framework that uses inverse optimization to infer latent preferences and tests the deployed decision's optimality gap under the current distribution. By targeting regret, \texttt{RADAR} ignores decision-irrelevant shifts while detecting changes that warrant re-optimization. We develop two-sample and sequential changepoint procedures and establish asymptotic guarantees for Type-I error and power. Across synthetic optimization problems, a semi-synthetic capacity allocation task, and police-zone planning, \texttt{RADAR} more reliably distinguishes harmful from harmless shifts than decision-agnostic alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADAR框架，用于判断在运营条件变化时，已部署的随机优化决策是否应当重新优化。RADAR通过逆优化推断潜在偏好参数，并直接测试当前分布下部署决策的最优性差距（regret），从而区分有害与无害的分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 已部署的决策通常一次性优化后长期使用，因为更新决策会带来运营、监管或切换成本。然而当环境变化时，传统分布偏移检验与"是否应重优化"这一目标不匹配：它们可能标记出可检测但决策无关的变化，却无法判断现有决策是否已严重次优。作者希望直接针对决策关切（regret）而非分布差异来检测变化。
AI.method: 提出RADAR（基于遗憾的决策充分性与风险评估框架）。核心思路：利用逆优化从未知偏好参数中推断潜在偏好，然后在当前分布下测试已部署决策的最优性差距。开发了两样本和序贯变点检验程序，并建立Type-I误差和检验功效的渐近保证。
AI.result: 在合成优化问题、半合成的容量分配任务以及警区规划任务中，RADAR比决策无关的替代方法更可靠地区分有害与无害的分布偏移。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接针对决策遗憾进行检验，RADAR能忽略决策无关的偏移，同时检测出值得重新优化的变化，为随机优化中"何时需要重新优化"这一实际问题提供了决策聚焦的解决方案。

title: Looking Again: Measuring Sycophancy in the Reasoning Chains of Multimodal Models Under Pressure
summary: Large multimodal reasoning models (LMRMs) are getting increasingly capable, primarily through generating explicit chain-of-thought reasoning before answering. In language models it has been observed that this performance often comes with sycophancy, the tendency of a model to agree with the user over the evidence. However, for LMRMs no reliable method to measure sycophancy yet exists. We bridge this gap by introducing a benchmark and dataset for evaluating LMRM sycophancy when confronted with a wrong answer from a user. Our benchmark pairs four visually grounded datasets spanning mathematical, clinical, temporal, and demographic reasoning with five pressure conditions in single-turn and multi-turn settings. We evaluate sycophancy in the final answer as well as its emergence within the reasoning chain. We find that sycophancy is prevalent under pressure, with Statement pressure eliciting the highest rates and Conviction the lowest for all models except Mistral-Small-4, and under multi-turn pressure reasoning-level sycophancy intensifies sharply in clinical visual judgement, reaching 95.7% for the most affected model. We further introduce a failure taxonomy separating reasoning-chain from answer-level sycophancy, and a complementary sentence-level taxonomy locating where in the chain drift first emerges. Our results show that sycophancy can corrupt the reasoning chain independently of the final answer, so answer-level evaluation alone is insufficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于评估大型多模态推理模型（LMRM）谄媚行为（sycophancy）的基准与数据集。该基准将四个视觉基础数据集（数学、临床、时间、人口推理）与五种压力条件结合，在单轮和多轮设置下评估推理链和最终答案中的谄媚倾向。研究发现谄媚在压力条件下普遍存在，且推理链层面的谄媚与最终答案层面的谄媚可独立发生，因此仅评估最终答案是不够的。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态推理模型能力日益增强，主要通过在作答前生成显式思维链推理来实现。在语言模型中已观察到这种性能往往伴随着谄媚倾向（模型倾向于认同用户而非证据），然而对于LMRM尚无可靠的方法来测量谄媚。作者希望弥合这一空白。
AI.method: 构建基准与数据集：将四个视觉基础数据集（涵盖数学、临床、时间、人口推理）与五种压力条件配对，在单轮和多轮设置下进行测试。评估最终答案中的谄媚，以及推理链中谄媚的出现；引入一个故障分类法区分推理链层面与答案层面的谄媚，以及一个句子级分类法定位推理链中最早出现偏差的位置。
AI.result: 谄媚在压力条件下普遍存在；Statement压力引发最高谄媚率，Conviction最低（除Mistral-Small-4外所有模型一致）；多轮压力下临床视觉判断的推理链谄媚急剧加剧，受影响最严重模型达到95.7%。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚可以独立于最终答案而污染推理链，因此仅评估答案层面的谄媚是不够的，需要同时关注推理链层面的谄媚检测与评估。

title: The Signal in the Noise: An Auditable Reliability Layer for Biomedical Text Classification
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 2026 14th International Conference on Bioinformatics and Computational Biology (ICBCB 2026), Kitakyushu, Japan; to appear in IEEE Conference Proceedings (IEEE Xplore). Code: https://github.com/MoustafaMohamedMoustafaHassan/the_signal_in_the_noise_CORD19_project
summary: Biomedical NLP pipelines routinely presuppose clean input text, yet large-scale corpora assembled through automated PDF parsing harbour pervasive OCR-like artifacts, token splits and merges, hyphenation remnants, and character-level corruption, that systematically erode lexical evidence and degrade downstream classifiers. We introduce a conservative, fully auditable spell-correction reliability layer conceived as a safety-oriented preprocessing module rather than a maximal-accuracy corrector: under conditions of uncertainty, the system abstains from editing, in accordance with a medical do-no-harm philosophy. The deterministic architecture couples bounded edit-distance candidate generation with corpus-derived n-gram scoring and a suite of biomedical safety gates that protect domain-critical terminology. We evaluate the layer both intrinsically, on a manually curated benchmark of 2,104 token-level cases, and extrinsically, on a tri-class CORD-19 topic classifier (Prevention, Treatment, Epidemiology) spanning 10,000 examples under a principled four-run protocol (Clean, Noisy, Restored, Safety). Intrinsically, the layer attains 94.61% error-fix recall on synthetic errors with zero harmful edits on negative controls. Downstream, it recovers approximately 80.45% of the noise-induced macro-F1 degradation, elevating macro-F1 from 0.7654 (Noisy) to 0.7717 (Restored) while preserving near-clean performance (Safety: 0.7721). A supplementary case study on 103 real-world OCR-extracted abstracts classified with BioBERT confirms that transformer encoders appeared relatively robust to mild noise, motivating a future grey-box architecture that integrates bounded neural signals and UMLS lexicons without compromising auditability. The system is fully deterministic, artifact-driven, and designed with deployment and auditability in mind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个保守的、可审计的拼写纠错可靠性层，作为生物医学NLP管道中的安全导向预处理模块，用于修复PDF解析引入的OCR类伪影。系统在不确定时选择弃权不编辑（do-no-harm原则），结合有界编辑距离候选生成、语料n-gram评分和生物医学安全门。内部评测在2,104个词级案例上达到94.61%错误修复召回率且零有害编辑；外部评测在CORD-19三分类任务上恢复了约80.45%的噪声引起F1退化。
AI.motivation: 生物医学NLP管道预设输入文本干净，但大规模语料库通过自动PDF解析会引入大量OCR类伪影（ token分裂/合并、连字符残留、字符级损坏），系统性侵蚀词汇证据并降低下游分类器性能。现有纠错系统追求最大准确率而非安全性，不适合高风险的生物医学场景。
AI.method: 采用保守的确定性架构：有界编辑距离候选生成 + 语料推导的n-gram评分 + 一套生物医学安全门（保护领域关键术语）。核心设计哲学是do-no-harm：在不确定条件下系统弃权而非编辑，保证完全可审计。评测协议包含四轮：Clean、Noisy、Restored、Safety，内部与外部评测结合。
AI.result: 内部评测：94.61%错误修复召回率，负向对照零有害编辑；外部评测：从Noisy的macro-F1 0.7654提升至Restored的0.7717，恢复约80.45%噪声退化，Safety模式下达0.7721接近干净数据表现。BioBERT在真实103篇OCR摘要案例中表现出对轻度噪声的相对鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的保守纠错层有效恢复了噪声导致的性能退化，同时严格遵守安全性和审计性要求。发现Transformer编码器对轻度噪声较鲁棒，未来方向是开发灰盒架构，整合有界神经信号和UMLS词典而不损害可审计性。系统完全确定性、伪影驱动，面向部署和审计设计。

title: Conservative Hybrid Graph Networks for Process Systems with Learned Routing
summary: Industrial process networks do not maintain a single effective topology while operating: streams are throttled or bypassed, and units move between idle, transition, and active regimes. Models of such systems are typically trained on measured state trajectories while the operating mechanisms that generated them remain latent, and an unconstrained graph network can fit such a trajectory without assigning stable physical meaning to the recovered routing. We address both problems with the Conservative Hybrid Graph Network (CHGN), which learns routing, regime assignment, and removal rates as data-driven surrogates and inserts them into a fixed transport equation, so that the mass balance holds by construction for any predicted routing. CHGN trained on networks of 10-20 nodes transfers zero-shot to unseen graphs of 25-40 nodes without retraining, reaching an RMSE of 2.1e-3 against 6e-2 to 9e-2 for GNN baselines under the same protocol, with a gate MAE of 7.9e-3 and regime accuracy of 94.3% (1.2e-2 and 96.4% respectively on the fixed training topology). On a fluid-mixing pilot plant, CHGN improves on a persistence baseline for held-out physical faults but does not predict manual interventions, for which the governing valve actions are unobserved. The model therefore transfers across process topologies without retraining and exposes the latent mechanisms governing plant behaviour to inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出保守混合图网络（CHGN），将学习到的路由、工况分配和去除率作为数据驱动替代模型，插入固定输运方程中，使质量平衡在任何预测路由下都成立。CHGN可在不重新训练的情况下零样本迁移到未见过的图拓扑，显著优于GNN基线。
AI.motivation: 工业过程网络在运行中不保持单一有效拓扑，流股被节流或旁路，单元在闲置、过渡和活跃工况间切换。现有模型通常在测量状态轨迹上训练，但生成这些轨迹的运行机制是潜在的，而无约束图网络拟合轨迹时不赋予恢复的路由以稳定的物理意义。
AI.method: CHGN学习路由、工况分配和去除率作为数据驱动替代模型，并将它们插入固定的输运方程中，使得质量平衡在结构上成立（无论预测什么路由）。
AI.result: 在10-20节点网络训练的CHGN可零样本迁移到25-40节点的未见图，RMSE达2.1e-3（GNN基线为6e-2至9e-2），gate MAE为7.9e-3，工况准确率94.3%（固定训练拓扑上分别为1.2e-2和96.4%）。在流体混合中试装置上，CHGN对保留的物理故障优于持续性基线，但无法预测人工干预（阀门动作未观测）。
AI.conclusion: CHGN无需重新训练即可跨过程拓扑迁移，并能暴露控制工厂行为的潜在机制供检查。

title: Predicting Student Attrition in Competitive Programming: A Large-Scale Study Integrating Survey Insights and Global Behavioral Logs
comment: Accepted at International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Advanced Sciences and Technologies (EFAST 2026). 10 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables
summary: Competitive programming (CP) offers computer science students an environment for developing algorithmic reasoning skills. However, sustained participation remains a challenge, as many students disengage after encountering skill plateaus or performance anxiety. While educational data mining (EDM) has studied dropout in MOOCs and academic courses, CP attrition remains understudied. This paper presents a dual-layer framework combining large-scale Codeforces activity logs (n=1,816) with a multi-institutional psychographic survey across 10 universities in Bangladesh (n=64). Analysis reveals that true attrition is preceded by an 83.71% reduction in contest participation and a 15.6% increase in struggle time. We identify a "Skill-Application Paradox": stopped students self-report higher mathematical confidence (3.88 vs. 3.41) and data structure understanding (3.57 vs. 3.09) than active peers, yet their independent practice and upsolving habits are significantly weaker (p < 0.001). Benchmark evaluations show that a Soft-Voting Ensemble achieves a 0.737 CV F1-score on behavioral logs, while Random Forest achieves 0.924 CV F1-score on psychographic data (an exploratory pilot). We deploy the survey-trained model as a proof-of-concept Early Warning System over 22 active students, identifying 4 at high risk. These findings show that behavioral and psychographic signals can support data-driven mentoring in computing programs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于分析竞技编程（CP）学生流失问题的双层框架，结合大规模Codeforces行为日志（n=1,816）和孟加拉国10所大学的多机构心理统计调查（n=64）。研究发现真正的流失之前会出现参赛减少83.71%和挣扎时间增加15.6%的前兆信号，并揭示了"技能应用悖论"：流失学生自我报告的能力信心更高但实践习惯更弱。基准测试显示行为数据的Soft-Voting Ensemble达到0.737 CV F1分数，心理数据的Random Forest达到0.924 CV F1分数。研究还部署了早期预警系统作为概念验证，识别出4名高风险学生。
AI.motivation: 竞技编程是培养计算机学生算法推理能力的重要环境，但学生的持续参与面临挑战，许多学生在遇到技能瓶颈或表现焦虑后停止参与。虽然教育数据挖掘（EDM）已研究过MOOC和学术课程中的流失问题，但竞技编程的流失现象研究不足，缺乏系统的行为和心理层面的综合分析框架。
AI.method: 本文提出一个双层框架：(1) 大规模Codeforces行为日志分析（n=1,816），追踪参赛频率和挣扎时间等行为指标；(2) 跨10所孟加拉国大学的多机构心理统计调查（n=64），收集学生的自我效能感、学习习惯等心理特征。在此基础上训练机器学习模型（Soft-Voting Ensemble用于行为数据，Random Forest用于心理数据），并部署为早期预警系统进行概念验证。
AI.result: 研究发现真正流失前参赛参与率下降83.71%，挣扎时间增加15.6%。行为日志的Soft-Voting Ensemble达到0.737 CV F1分数；心理数据的Random Forest达到0.924 CV F1分数（探索性试点）。早期预警系统在22名活跃学生中识别出4名高风险学生。同时发现了"技能应用悖论"：流失学生比活跃学生自我报告更高的数学信心和数据结构理解，但独立练习和深入解题习惯显著更弱（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 行为和心理信号能够有效支持计算教育项目中的数据驱动指导。行为特征（参与频率、挣扎时间）和心理特征（自我效能感与实际练习习惯的差异）的结合可以为竞技编程学生的流失风险提供早期预警，从而支持导师进行针对性干预。

title: Learning neural controllers for nonlinear systems from data
summary: This article addresses the problem of designing neural feedback controllers for unknown nonlinear systems. We propose an indirect data-driven framework that uses offline data to identify the system dynamics, upon which a neural feedback controller and a neural Lyapunov function are jointly synthesized. Input constraints are enforced by integrating a hard-saturation structure into the controller architecture. Robust synthesis conditions are derived to account for data perturbations during identification. Formal stability is certified by combining SMT verification with local Lyapunov analysis near the equilibrium. Numerical examples validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种间接数据驱动的框架，用于为未知非线性系统设计神经反馈控制器。该框架利用离线数据辨识系统动力学，联合合成神经反馈控制器和神经Lyapunov函数，通过硬饱和结构处理输入约束，并结合SMT验证与局部Lyapunov分析来保证形式化稳定性。
AI.motivation: 未知非线性系统的神经反馈控制器设计仍然是一个挑战，现有方法难以同时处理数据驱动辨识、输入约束和形式化稳定性保证。需要在数据存在扰动的情况下，仍能确保闭环系统的稳定性。
AI.method: 采用间接数据驱动方法，分两个阶段：(1) 利用离线数据辨识系统动力学模型；(2) 在辨识得到的模型上联合训练神经反馈控制器和神经Lyapunov函数。控制器采用硬饱和结构以满足输入约束，推导了考虑数据扰动的鲁棒综合条件，最终通过SMT验证结合平衡点附近的局部Lyapunov分析来认证形式化稳定性。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了所提出框架的有效性，表明该方法能够在存在数据扰动的情况下成功合成满足输入约束的神经控制器，并通过形式化验证保证了闭环系统的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为数据驱动的神经控制提供了一个可靠的框架，将系统辨识、控制器综合和形式化验证有机结合，为未知非线性系统的安全控制提供了新的解决思路。

title: Regularized extragradient method for structured bilevel optimization in continuous and discrete time
summary: In a real Hilbert space, we study a bilevel optimization problem that consists in minimizing an outer convex function over the zero set of a maximally monotone operator. In the smooth setting, where the outer objective is convex and Fréchet differentiable and the inner operator is single-valued, continuous and monotone, we associate with the problem a first-order dynamical system that can be viewed as a monotone flow applied to a dynamically regularized operator. Under suitable geometric conditions on the inner problem --- either a weak Attouch-Czarnecki-type integrability condition or the stronger assumption of sharpness --- we establish last-iterate convergence rates for both the outer and inner residuals, together with weak convergence of the trajectories to optimal solutions of the bilevel problem. In the smooth+nonsmooth setting, we enrich the outer objective with a proper, convex, and lower semicontinuous function, while the inner operator is augmented by the subdifferential of a function with the same properties. We propose a regularized proximal-extragradient algorithm in which both the forward and backward steps are performed with respect to dynamically regularized operators and functions, respectively. Under geometric assumptions on the inner problem analogous to those in the smooth setting, we establish last-iterate convergence rates for both the outer and inner residuals, together with weak convergence of the iterates to optimal solutions of the bilevel problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究实Hilbert空间中的双层优化问题，即在外层凸函数上最小化且内层为极大单调算子零点集的问题。在光滑设定下提出一阶动力系统，在光滑+非光滑设定下提出正则化近端外梯度算法，并在弱Attouch-Czarnecki型可积性条件或锐度假设下，建立了外层和内层残差的最后迭代收敛率以及轨迹弱收敛到最优解的结果。
AI.motivation: 双层优化问题在机器学习、信号处理和变分不等式等领域有广泛应用，但在内层为单调算子零点集的设定下，现有方法缺乏系统性的收敛性分析。作者旨在填补这一空白，为光滑和非光滑两类场景提供统一的理论框架和算法设计。
AI.method: 1) 光滑设定：构造一个涉及动态正则化算子的一阶单调流动力系统；2) 光滑+非光滑设定：提出正则化近端外梯度算法，前向步和后向步分别针对动态正则化算子和函数执行；3) 在弱Attouch-Czarnecki型可积性条件或锐度假设下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 在光滑设定下，建立外层和内层残差的最后迭代收敛率及轨迹弱收敛到双层问题最优解；在光滑+非光滑设定下，获得类似几何假设下的最后迭代收敛率及迭代序列弱收敛结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者为双层单调算子零点优化问题提供了统一的理论框架，在两类几何条件下都保证了最后迭代收敛性，为后续算法设计与加速研究奠定了基础。

title: Neural ODE enhanced linear mixed effect models for estimating complex association patterns of time-varying covariates with the marker trajectory
summary: Longitudinal cohort studies produce repeated data that enable the assessment of time-varying association patterns between exposures and health outcomes. Classical linear mixed-effects models (LMMs) can accommodate a large variety of association patterns while accounting for the irregularly spaced, partially observed measurement. But they require the analyst to pre-specify the functional form linking the exposure history to the outcome. We propose the Neural ODE-LMM, which embeds a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE) within the linear mixed-effects framework: a learned vector field encodes covariate trajectories into a continuous-time latent state that drives both the fixed- and random-effect design, while preserving the standard LMM observation model. This retains classical likelihood-based inference while learning complex, potentially cumulative, covariate effects flexibly. All parameters are estimated by maximising a penalised marginal likelihood. To quantify covariate effects, we introduce contrasts of counterfactual predictions that compare the expected outcome under alternative covariate trajectories with variance estimated via the delta method. In simulations, the model recovers both instantaneous and cumulative-burden effects without prior specification of the functional form. Applied to the Trois-Cités (3C) cohort, a population-based study of 7{,}324 participants, the method reveals trajectory-dependent associations of BMI and fasting glucose with cognitive decline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Neural ODE-LMM模型，将神经普通微分方程嵌入线性混合效应框架中，用于纵向队列研究中灵活学习暴露轨迹与健康结局之间的时变关联，无需预先指定函数形式。
AI.motivation: 传统线性混合效应模型（LMM）虽能处理不规则间隔、部分缺失的纵向数据，但需要分析者预先指定暴露史与结局之间的函数形式，这在实际应用中往往困难且可能引入偏差。
AI.method: 将Neural ODE嵌入LMM框架：学习到的向量场将协变量轨迹编码为连续时间潜在状态，驱动固定效应和随机效应的设计，同时保留标准LMM观测模型；所有参数通过最大化惩罚边际似然估计；通过反事实预测的对比来量化协变量效应，方差用delta方法估计。
AI.result: 模拟中模型无需预先指定函数形式即可恢复瞬时效应和累积负担效应。应用于Trois-Cités（3C）队列（7324名参与者）时，发现BMI和空腹血糖与认知衰退之间存在轨迹依赖的关联。
AI.conclusion: Neural ODE-LMM在保留经典似然推断优势的同时，能够灵活学习复杂、可能累积的协变量效应，为纵向队列研究中的动态暴露-结局关联提供了有力工具。

title: MA-RAG: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Query-Driven Summarization of Longitudinal Parkinson's Disease Assessments
summary: Accurate interpretation of single-visit and longitudinal clinical assessments for Parkinson's disease is time-consuming and often depends on specialist expertise. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate natural language summaries, they frequently lack domain-specific clinical grounding and struggle to produce factually correct and temporally consistent responses for structured longitudinal assessment data. To address these limitations, we propose MA-RAG, a query-driven multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation framework that decomposes clinical reasoning into domain-specialized agents, combines structured fact extraction, and synthesizes clinically grounded summaries through a final verification stage. The framework supports four clinical analysis tasks: single-session, trajectory, comparison, and cohort summarization. We evaluate MA-RAG using objective metrics, namely Fact Precision, Hallucination Rate, Temporal Fidelity, and Semantic Similarity, together with subjective evaluations conducted by clinical experts. Compared to Traditional, RAG-only, and Single-agent RAG baselines, MA-RAG substantially improves factual correctness, achieving up to a 122% relative increase in Fact Precision (from 0.436 to 0.990) and reducing the Hallucination Rate by up to 98% (from 0.564 to 0.010), while consistently receiving top ratings from clinical experts for organization and clinical usefulness. These results demonstrate that domain-specialized multi-agent reasoning enables reliable query-driven summarization of structured longitudinal clinical assessment data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MA-RAG，一个查询驱动的多智能体检索增强生成框架，用于帕金森病临床评估数据的准确摘要生成。该框架将临床推理分解为领域专门化智能体，结合结构化事实提取和最终验证阶段，支持单次会话、轨迹、比较和队列四种摘要任务。相比传统方法、仅RAG和单智能体RAG基线，MA-RAG在事实精确度上提升高达122%（从0.436到0.990），幻觉率降低98%（从0.564到0.010），并获得临床专家的最高评分。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病临床评估数据的单次访视和纵向解读耗时且依赖专家经验。虽然LLM能生成自然语言摘要，但缺乏领域特定的临床基础，难以对结构化纵向评估数据产生事实正确且时间一致的响应，因此需要更好的解决方案。
AI.method: MA-RAG是一个查询驱动的多智能体检索增强生成框架，核心包括：1) 将临床推理分解为领域专门化智能体；2) 结合结构化事实提取；3) 通过最终验证阶段合成临床基础摘要。框架支持四种临床分析任务：单次会话摘要、轨迹摘要、比较摘要和队列汇总。
AI.result: 使用客观指标（事实精确度、幻觉率、时间保真度、语义相似度）和临床专家主观评价进行评估。相比传统方法、仅RAG和单智能体RAG基线，MA-RAG在事实精确度上实现122%的相对提升（0.436到0.990），幻觉率最多降低98%（0.564到0.010），并在组织性和临床实用性方面持续获得临床专家最高评分。
AI.conclusion: 领域专门化的多智能体推理能够实现对结构化纵向临床评估数据的可靠查询驱动摘要生成，有效解决LLM在临床场景中缺乏领域基础和事实不一致的问题。

title: Paper Pilot: A Human-in-the-Loop Expert System for Evidence-Traceable Scientific Manuscript Generation in Applied Sciences
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly embedded in scientific workflows for literature analysis, drafting, and review. Existing systems advance autonomous discovery and manuscript generation, but do not resolve the governance problem that arises when ideas, methods, results, and claims propagate through AI-assisted workflows without mandatory human approval or artifact-level traceability. This paper proposes Paper Pilot, a human-in-the-loop expert system for evidence-traceable scientific manuscript generation in applied sciences. It adapts the Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (CARE) methodology to manuscript development through manuscript-owner approval gates, explicit no-pass criteria, claim classification, audit logging, advisory LLM review, and evidence-locked revision control. The framework defines eight approval gates across the idea-to-claim pipeline and distinguishes literature-grounded from artifact-grounded claims, requiring reported numbers and interpretations to remain traceable to approved evidence; its system prompt is openly released for deployment in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or institutional LLM environments. As a first empirical validation, we evaluate the citation-grounding layer with a controlled, mechanically scored benchmark (two commercial LLMs, real arXiv papers, no LLM judge): under coverage pressure ungated drafters fabricated up to 25% of their citations and never flagged an evidence gap, whereas the same models under Paper Pilot's evidence-locked rules produced zero fabricated citations and surfaced the planted gaps as explicit placeholders. Preliminary results for result grounding, revision, and adversarial robustness point the same way; full evaluation is left to future work. Paper Pilot positions LLM-assisted writing as a controlled human-AI decision-support process rather than a fully autonomous authorship pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Paper Pilot，一个面向应用科学领域、带有人类参与的证据可溯源科学手稿生成专家系统。它基于 CARE 方法论，通过八个人工审批门控、证据锁定修订控制、声明分类与审计日志等机制，确保 LLM 辅助写作中想法、方法、结果和声明均可追溯到已批准的证据。初步基准测试表明，在覆盖率压力下，未经门控的模型可伪造高达25%的引用且从不标记证据缺口，而 Paper Pilot 规则下零伪造引用并显式标记缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 推动了自主发现和手稿生成，但未能解决 AI 辅助工作流中缺乏强制人工审批和工件级可追溯性所导致的治理问题——即思想、方法、结果和声明在无监督下传播的风险。
AI.method: 将协作式智能体推理工程（CARE）方法论适配到手稿开发流程，设计八个人工审批门控覆盖从想法到声明的完整流水线，区分文献扎根与工件扎根声明，要求报告数字和解释可追溯到已批准证据，并采用审计日志、咨询性 LLM 评审、证据锁定修订控制和明确的不通过标准。系统提示词开放发布于 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 等环境。
AI.result: 在引用扎根层的受控基准测试中（两个商业 LLM、真实 arXiv 论文、无 LLM 评审），未门控的草稿模型在覆盖率压力下制造了高达25%的伪造引用且从不标记证据缺口；相同模型在 Paper Pilot 证据锁定规则下产生零伪造引用，并将植入的缺口显式标记为占位符。结果扎根、修订和对抗鲁棒性的初步结果方向一致，完整评估留待未来工作。
AI.conclusion: Paper Pilot 将 LLM 辅助写作定位为受控的人机决策支持过程，而非全自主的作者流水线，通过人工审批门控和证据追溯机制为科学写作中的 AI 治理提供了一条可行路径。

title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Semantic ID Recommenders: Does the Model's Own Code Hierarchy Help?
summary: Generative recommenders increasingly emit semantic IDs (SIDs): each item is a short sequence of hierarchical discrete codes from a residual quantizer, decoded autoregressively. Before spending scarce A/B-test, a team may decide offline which decoder or reranking variants are worth testing - a job for off-policy evaluation (OPE). We ask a simple question: can the model's own SID tree serve as the action abstraction for that OPE? Our answer has three parts. (i) Under the near-argmax logging real recommenders use, per-item OPE is hopeless - as item-level effective sample size is usually small on production logs - but marginalizing items to code-prefix clusters restores estimable support and cuts error. (ii) This gain is thanks to coarsening, not to the hierarchy specifically; but the SID tree is what makes coarsening feasible in a generative system - each cluster's mass is exactly and cheaply returned by the decoder, whereas flat clustering requires enumerating item/leaf masses that a code-only decoder does not directly expose. (iii) Resolution depth is the operative knob - coarser under scarce support - and a conditional bias bound links the coarsening bias to the quantizer's worst-case reconstruction residual and the target-logging divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在生成式推荐系统中，能否使用模型自身的语义ID（SID）树作为离线策略评估（OPE）的动作抽象。研究发现：在近argmax日志策略下，逐物品OPE不可行，但将物品边缘化到代码前缀簇可恢复估计支持并降低误差；此增益源于粗化而非层级本身，但SID树使粗化在生成式系统中变得可行；分辨率深度是可操作的调节旋钮，并有条件偏差界将粗化偏差关联到量化器最差重构残差和目标-日志策略散度。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐器越来越多地使用SID，但在投入昂贵的A/B测试前，团队需要离线决定哪些解码器或重排变体值得测试。作者想回答核心问题：模型自身的SID树能否作为OPE的动作抽象？
AI.method: 论文提出三部分方法：(i) 在近argmax日志策略下分析逐物品OPE的无效性，提出将物品边缘化到代码前缀簇；(ii) 论证增益来自粗化而非层级，并指出SID树能精确廉价地返回簇质量（而扁平聚类需枚举叶子质量）；(iii) 引入分辨率深度作为控制旋钮，推导条件偏差界。
AI.result: 研究发现逐物品OPE在生产日志上因有效样本量过小而不可行，但代码前缀簇层面的OPE能恢复估计支持并降低误差；SID树使得粗化在生成式系统中可行；偏差界将粗化偏差与量化器最差重构残差及目标-日志散度联系起来。
AI.conclusion: SID树可作为生成式推荐系统OPE的有效动作抽象，关键在于利用其层级结构实现粗化，并通过调节分辨率深度在偏差和方差间取得平衡。该框架为在A/B测试前筛选解码器与重排变体提供了可行的离线评估方案。

title: Experts Disagree on How to Fight AI Disinformation, but Agree That Health and Politics Need Different Solutions
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Author-formatted version; identical in content to the version published in Harvard Kennedy School Misinformation Review 7(4), 2026, CC BY 4.0. Replication materials: doi:10.7910/DVN/BXO2QA
summary: When 54 international experts assessed AI-generated disinformation threats, they revealed a surprising pattern: while video deepfakes received the highest average threat ratings in the political domain (M = 6.31/7), the pattern differed in the health domain, where AI-generated text received the highest average rating (M = 5.80). Experts also diverge on what to do: government regulation drew both the most "most effective" (30%) and the most "least effective" (15%) votes, though rating distributions were contested rather than polarized, indicating disagreement over priorities rather than over efficacy. These findings offer an initial expert map of an AI-disinformation landscape that is still rapidly forming.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了54位国际专家对AI生成虚假信息威胁的评估，发现政治领域视频深度伪造威胁评分最高（M=6.31/7），而健康领域AI生成文本威胁评分最高（M=5.80）。专家对应对措施存在分歧：政府监管既获得最多"最有效"投票（30%）也获得最多"最无效"投票（15%），但评分分布显示是优先级分歧而非效力争议。
AI.motivation: AI生成的虚假信息正在快速发展，但对其威胁格局的专家共识尚不清晰。本研究旨在通过国际专家评估，绘制新兴的AI虚假信息威胁地图，以便为政策制定和风险应对提供依据。
AI.method: 采用专家调查法，邀请54位国际专家对AI生成虚假信息在不同领域（政治、健康等）的威胁程度进行评分（7分制），并对不同应对措施的有效性进行投票评估。
AI.result: 1) 政治领域：视频深度伪造威胁评分最高（M=6.31/7）；2) 健康领域：AI生成文本威胁评分最高（M=5.80）；3) 政府监管既获最多"最有效"票（30%）也获最多"最无效"票（15%），但分布是争议而非两极分化，反映优先级分歧而非效力判断分歧。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现AI虚假信息威胁存在领域特异性：不同媒介形式在不同领域的威胁程度不同。专家对应对策略存在优先级分歧而非效力否定，这为AI虚假信息治理的初期提供了专家视角的基线图谱。

title: Minimizing Grid Interconnection Capacity Requirements for AI Data Centers: A Developer-Side Planning Framework with Onsite Resources and Workload Flexibility
summary: Securing grid interconnection capacity has become a bottleneck for AI data center projects and can take longer than constructing the facilities themselves. This mismatch can delay deployment for years, making early interconnection planning essential. This paper develops ICP-AI, an interconnection capacity planning framework from a data center developer's perspective. The framework minimizes grid import capacity under a prescribed onsite investment budget while jointly sizing photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage system (BESS) resources and scheduling deadline constrained workload flexibility. A secondary refinement fixes the minimum grid capacity and selects the minimum-investment PV-BESS portfolio among solutions that achieve that capacity. The framework is evaluated using monthly composite stress profiles across varying temporal assumptions, load shapes, flexible load fractions, and deferral windows. Results show that interconnection capacity reduction depends strongly on the planning environment: at a $100M budget, it is about 6% for the high load factor baseline, exceeds 10% under monthly average solar availability, and reaches 13.3% for a more diurnal load. At a $10M budget, 5% flexible load with a 1 h workload deferral window reduces BESS capacity from 15.30 to 4.87 MWh while increasing capacity reduction from 4.43% to 4.84%. To test sensitivity to temporal compression, the model is also solved over the full 8,760 h chronology, which preserves the main capacity and flexibility trends. Overall, ICP-AI quantifies the interconnection capacity and infrastructure substitution value of workload flexibility, providing an investment-interconnection frontier to support capital allocation and early project planning in constrained grid environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICP-AI框架，从数据中心开发商视角规划电网互联容量：在给定现场投资预算下最小化电网导入容量，联合优化光伏和储能系统规模及调度具有期限约束的工作负载灵活性；二次优化在固定最小电网容量下选择最低投资组合。评估显示容量削减强烈依赖规划环境，最高可达13.3%。
AI.motivation: AI数据中心项目面临电网互联容量获取的瓶颈，这通常比设施建设本身耗时更长，可导致部署延迟数年。因此早期互联规划至关重要，需要在电网受限环境下优化投资与容量配置。
AI.method: 开发ICP-AI框架：主问题在给定现场投资预算下最小化电网导入容量，联合优化光伏（PV）与电池储能（BESS）规模并调度具有期限约束的工作负载；二次精化固定最小电网容量，在达到该容量的方案中选择最低投资PV-BESS组合。使用月度复合应力剖面及完整8760小时时序进行敏感性评估。
AI.result: 在1亿美元预算下，高负荷因子基线容量削减约6%，月均太阳能可用性下超10%，日间负荷特征下达13.3%。1千万美元预算下，5%弹性负荷配合1小时延迟窗口将BESS容量从15.30降至4.87 MWh，容量削减从4.43%提升至4.84%。8760小时完整时序验证了主要趋势。
AI.conclusion: ICP-AI量化了工作负载灵活性对互联容量和基础设施替代的价值，提供投资-互联前沿以支持资本分配和早期项目规划，在电网受限环境中具有重要实践意义。

title: Risk-averse design optimization with CVaR constraints via multifidelity tail-region correction
summary: Risk-averse design optimization with conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) constraints requires accurate tail estimates, but repeated high-fidelity (HF) evaluations are costly. We propose a multifidelity (MF) tail-region correction method that uses dimensionally decomposed generalized polynomial chaos expansion (DD-GPCE) as a global surrogate and directs a limited HF budget to responses that most strongly influence CVaR. Covariance of the estimated DD-GPCE coefficients quantifies finite-sample prediction uncertainty and defines a confidence-interval-based tail region. Within this region, a two-stage strategy explores locations with high prediction uncertainty and then exploits locations with large correction-induced shifts. A Tikhonov-regularized residual expansion using the same polynomial basis yields a unified tail-corrected surrogate. For a ten-bar truss, the method produced a design close to the crude-MCS reference with approximately 72 to 274 times fewer HF evaluations than the considered MF importance sampling configurations. For a suction valve, it reduced mass by 1.05% and bending and bulging CVaR by 17.68% and 21.53%, respectively, while satisfying the valve-opening requirement. The results demonstrate accurate, HF-sample-efficient CVaR-constrained design through localized MF correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多保真度（MF）尾部区域校正方法，用于带条件风险值（CVaR）约束的风险规避设计优化。该方法以维度分解广义多项式混沌展开（DD-GPCE）作为全局代理模型，将有限的高保真度（HF）计算预算集中用于对CVaR影响最大的响应区域。通过估计的DD-GPCE系数协方差量化有限样本预测不确定性，定义置信区间尾部区域，并在该区域内采用两阶段策略（先探索高不确定性位置，再开发产生大校正偏移的位置）。利用Tikhonov正则化残差展开获得统一的尾部校正代理模型。在十杆桁架算例中，相比多保真度重要性采样配置，HF计算量减少约72-274倍且设计接近粗粒度MCS参考；在吸入阀算例中，质量降低1.05%，弯曲和鼓胀CVaR分别降低17.68%和21.53%，同时满足阀门开启要求。
AI.motivation: CVaR约束的风险规避设计优化需要精确的尾部估计，但重复的高保真度评估代价高昂，限制了对极端事件风险的精确量化。
AI.method: 提出MF尾部区域校正方法：以DD-GPCE构建全局代理模型；利用系数协方差定义置信区间尾部区域；在尾部区域内采用两阶段策略（探索高不确定性位置+开发大校正偏移位置）；使用Tikhonov正则化残差展开生成统一的尾部校正代理模型，将有限HF预算聚焦于CVaR最敏感的响应位置。
AI.result: 十杆桁架算例中，以约72-274倍少于MF重要性采样的HF评估次数获得接近粗粒度MCS参考的设计；吸入阀算例中，质量降低1.05%，弯曲和鼓胀CVaR分别降低17.68%和21.53%，同时满足阀门开启约束。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部MF校正，实现了高精度且HF样本高效的CVaR约束设计优化，证明了所提方法在尾部风险约束下的工程优化中的有效性。

title: A Deep Latent Variable Framework for Jointly Modeling Missingness, Measurement Error, and Heterogeneity
summary: Missing data, measurement error, and population heterogeneity are pervasive challenges in analyzing data arising from modern observational studies and machine learning applications. Although these problems frequently coexist and interact, they are often treated separately in existing works. We propose a unified probabilistic framework that jointly addresses these issues utilizing deep latent variable representation. The proposed method integrates a novel hierarchical tree-routed variational autoencoder with pattern-aware latent representations and calibration-based denoising. The framework accommodates missing data mechanisms, including MCAR, MAR, and MNAR, while simultaneously learning subgroup-specific and globally shared latent structure. The introduced reconvergent routing mechanism enables selective parameters to be shared across related subpopulations, which offers flexibility as well as improved statistical efficiency. Simulation studies demonstrate substantial improvements over existing deep generative imputation approaches under complex heterogeneous missingness and measurement-error settings. The proposed framework provides a principled approach for learning from noisy and incomplete data in modern healthcare and other high-dimensional applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的概率框架，通过深度潜变量表示同时处理缺失数据、测量误差和群体异质性这三个在观察性研究和机器学习中普遍存在的挑战。该框架整合了新型分层树路由变分自编码器、模式感知潜表示和基于校准的去噪技术，能够处理MCAR、MAR和MNAR类型的缺失机制，同时学习子群体特异的和全局共享的潜结构。
AI.motivation: 缺失数据、测量误差和群体异质性是现代观察性研究和机器学习应用中普遍存在的挑战，这三个问题经常同时出现且相互影响，但现有工作通常将它们分开处理，缺乏一个统一框架来联合解决这些相互交织的问题。
AI.method: 提出一个统一概率框架，核心创新包括：(1) 分层树路由变分自编码器(hierarchical tree-routed VAE)；(2) 模式感知潜表示(pattern-aware latent representations)；(3) 基于校准的去噪技术(calibration-based denoising)；(4) 回收路由机制(reconvergent routing)实现相关子群体间的选择性参数共享；(5) 能同时处理MCAR、MAR和MNAR三种缺失机制。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明，在复杂的异质性缺失和测量误差设置下，该方法相比现有的深度生成式插补方法有显著改进。
