AI.conclusion: 该框架为从嘈杂和不完整数据中学习提供了有原则的方法，适用于现代医疗保健和其他高维应用场景。

title: Asymmetric Within-Document Predictive Learning for Scientific Document Representation
summary: We study predictive pretraining for scientific document representation using the discourse structure of papers. We propose SciJEPA, a citation-free framework that learns through asymmetric within-document prediction: title and abstract representations are used to predict method representations, and method representations are used to predict conclusion representations. Experiments on RELISH, high-influence citation, SciDocs, and cite prediction show that plain predictive training is viable but weaker than a controlled contrastive baseline using the same section pairs. Adding Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) substantially improves performance and narrows this gap. The effect of regularization is task-dependent: moderate SIGReg helps fine-grained ranking, while stronger regularization can weaken local alignment. We further show that different encoding branches support different retrieval regimes. These results position within-document predictive learning as a promising citation-free complement for scientific document representation, provided that embedding geometry is carefully controlled.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciJEPA，一种基于论文篇章结构（title/abstract→method→conclusion）的非对称预测预训练框架，用于科学文档表示。实验表明纯预测训练弱于受控对比基线，但加入Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization（SIGReg）后性能显著提升并缩小差距。正则化效果与任务相关，且不同编码分支支持不同检索场景。
AI.motivation: 现有科学文档表示学习多依赖引用关系或对比学习，但引用信息未必充分或可用。作者希望探索一种无需引用、利用论文内部篇章结构做预测式预训练的方式，并揭示其与对比学习的差距来源。
AI.method: 提出SciJEPA框架：(1) 利用论文内的discourse structure，进行非对称的within-document预测，即用title+abstract预测method表示，再用method预测conclusion表示；(2) 引入Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization（SIGReg）控制embedding几何结构；(3) 与相同section pairs的对比学习基线进行受控比较。
AI.result: 在RELISH、high-influence citation、SciDocs和cite prediction等任务上，纯预测训练可行但弱于对比基线；加入SIGReg后显著提升并缩小差距。正则化影响因任务而异：中等SIGReg利于细粒度排序，过强正则化削弱局部对齐。不同编码分支擅长不同检索模式。
AI.conclusion: 基于篇章内部的预测式学习是有前景的、无需引用的科学文档表示补充方案，前提是需仔细控制embedding的几何特性。该方法为科学文档表示提供了对比学习之外的替代路径。

title: The Race between Agentic AI Capabilities and Data Quality Control in Online Surveys
summary: Online surveys are a foundational data collection instrument in a variety of fields, with attention checks serving as critical guardians of response quality. However, the rapid emergence of agentic AI (goal directed systems powered by a large language model (LLM) brain and/or a multimodal processing unit with tool-augmented capabilities) raises new questions about the robustness of these safeguards. We investigate how well agentic AI architectures can complete web-based surveys and pass standard attention checks. We evaluate a single-agent architecture capable of multimodal input processing and tool-based web interaction on a controlled survey sandbox. We analyze the problem from two perspectives. From an attack perspective, we demonstrate how structural vulnerabilities such as exposed DOM metadata and predictable option encoding allow agents to resolve attention checks through structured parsing only. From a defense perspective, we implement a mitigation strategy of DOM metadata obfuscation to remove semantic cues in text-based questions. We evaluate multiple open-source language and multimodal models to study capability and orchestration effectiveness. Based on our evaluations, we offer perspectives on how to simultaneously meet the needs of empiricists and agentic AI researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体AI能否完成在线调查问卷并绕过注意力检查。研究发现，具备多模态输入和工具交互能力的单智能体架构可通过暴露的DOM元数据和可预测的选项编码等结构漏洞，仅凭结构化解析即可通过注意力检查。防御方面，作者提出DOM元数据混淆策略以去除文本问题中的语义线索，并评估了多个开源语言和多模态模型的能力与编排效果。
AI.motivation: 在线调查是各领域的基础数据收集工具，注意力检查是保障数据质量的关键机制。然而大语言模型驱动的智能体AI的快速兴起，使得这些安全保障措施面临新的鲁棒性挑战，需要系统性地研究智能体AI能否绕过这些检查。
AI.method: 在受控的调查沙盒中评估一种支持多模态输入处理和基于工具的网络交互的单智能体架构。从攻击视角演示结构漏洞（暴露的DOM元数据、可预测的选项编码）如何让智能体通过结构化解析解决注意力检查；从防御视角实施DOM元数据混淆策略，并评估多个开源语言和多模态模型的性能。
AI.result: 智能体AI能够利用调查问卷的结构性漏洞（如DOM元数据暴露和可预测的选项编码）通过标准注意力检查，仅需结构化解析即可完成。DOM元数据混淆可作为一种有效的防御缓解策略来去除语义线索。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了同时满足实证研究者和智能体AI研究者需求的视角，强调了在线调查注意力检查在面对agentic AI时需要重新设计，并提出了攻击与防御两个方向的洞见。

title: Learning-Theoretic Foundation for General Coded Computing: The Straggler Setting
summary:
Coded computing has emerged as a powerful paradigm for mitigating the impact of straggling workers in distributed computing systems. However, existing coded-computing schemes are predominantly designed for the exact recovery of highly structured computations, such as polynomial evaluation and matrix multiplication, and typically rely on strict recovery thresholds. These assumptions significantly limit their applicability to modern machine-learning workloads, particularly deep neural networks (DNNs), whose computations generally lack rigid algebraic structure and, in many applications, require only accurate approximations rather than exact recovery.
  To address this gap, we revisit coded computing from a learning-theoretic perspective and introduce General Coded Computing (GCC). Rather than adopting existing algebraic tools, GCC formulates coded computing through a natural end-to-end mean-squared error loss that directly measures the discrepancy between the desired computations and their recovered estimates. By deriving suitable upper bounds and restricting the encoder and decoder to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with mild smoothness constraints, we show that both the encoder and decoder admit specific representations as linear combinations of RKHS kernel functions. This representation allows the corresponding coefficients to be computed efficiently. Moreover, this framework enables us to establish theoretical performance guarantees for GCC under two complementary straggler regimes. In the worst-case setting with $N$ worker nodes, and at most $S$ stragglers, we show that the end-to-end loss decays at least at rate $O(S^3N^{-3})$ for standard configurations. We then study a probabilistic setting in which each worker independently straggles with probability $p$. We prove that the expected loss can still converge at rate $O(\log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出General Coded Computing (GCC)，从学习理论视角重新审视编码计算，通过端到端均方误差损失和RKHS框架，使编码计算适用于缺乏代数结构的深度神经网络任务，并给出了最坏情况下的O(S³N⁻³)和概率情况下的O(log³₁/ₚ(N)N⁻³)性能保证。
AI.motivation: 现有编码计算方案主要针对具有严格代数结构的计算（如多项式求值和矩阵乘法），依赖精确恢复阈值，难以适用于深度神经网络等缺乏刚性代数结构且只需近似精度的现代机器学习工作负载。
AI.method: GCC将编码计算建模为端到端均方误差损失，将编码器和解码器限制在带平滑约束的再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中，证明编码器和解码器可表示为RKHS核函数的线性组合，从而高效求解系数，并分别分析最坏情况和概率情况两种滞后者（straggler）场景下的理论性能。
AI.result: 在最坏情况下，N个工作节点最多S个滞后者时，端到端损失以O(S³N⁻³)速率衰减；在概率设置下，每个工作节点独立以概率p滞后者时，期望损失以O(log³₁/ₚ(N)N⁻³)速率收敛。
AI.conclusion: GCC通过学习理论框架成功将编码计算扩展到需要近似恢复的现代机器学习任务，提供了理论性能保证，突破了传统编码计算对代数结构和精确恢复的依赖限制。

title: Reference-Distribution Dependence in LLM-Based Synthetic Persona Data: Diagnosis and Post Hoc Adjustment of Demographic Distributions
comment: 22 pages, 1 figures, 7 tables. Data, materials, and code: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/BUFIGC
summary: We diagnose how closely the demographic distributions in LLM-based synthetic persona data match external reference distributions. For the three variables examined, we show that most of the observed error is attributable to the choice of reference rather than to the generator. Using total variation distance (TVD), we compare the sex x age group x province joint distribution of 1,000,000 records from Nemotron-Personas-Korea (NPK) with Korean official statistics. Against resident-registration figures for April 2026, the time of use, the bias bound, defined as the largest possible difference in the share of any subgroup formed from the three variables, is 1.81 percentage points. This is comparable to the margin of error of a survey of roughly 2,900 respondents. This value is not a fixed property of the data. Matching the reference period and series to the generating reference identified here, the 2024 register-based census restricted to Korean nationals, lowers it to 0.56 percentage points. Over the 15 months between the best-matching month (January 2025) and the time of use, the resident-registration population structure itself moves more than twice the distance of NPK's minimum error. Raking and cell post-stratification, the two weighting schemes used in Korean survey practice, remove most of the reference-period dependence at a variance inflation of about 0.2% in both cases. After raking against the generating reference, the residual joint discrepancy lies at, and marginally above, the upper bound of what a perfect generator would produce when realizing 1,000,000 records (97.6th percentile of the Monte Carlo distribution). We recommend treating synthetic persona data as auxiliary material for small-scale survey design rather than as a substitute for survey data, and re-running both diagnosis and adjustment against official statistics current at the time of use.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了基于LLM的合成个性数据（Nemotron-Personas-Korea）中人口统计分布与外部分布的一致性。研究发现大部分观测到的偏差源于参考分布的选择而非生成器本身。使用总变差距离（TVD）比较100万条记录与韩国官方统计数据的联合分布，偏差界为1.81个百分点（相当于2,900名受访者的调查误差），但通过匹配正确的参考时期和序列可将偏差降至0.56个百分点。加权方案（脱钩和单元后分层）可消除大部分参考时期依赖性，仅产生约0.2%的方差膨胀。作者建议将合成个性数据作为小规模调查设计的辅助材料，而非调查数据的替代品。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM生成合成个性数据的应用日益广泛，需要系统评估这些数据在人口统计特征上与真实参考分布的一致性。现有研究缺乏对偏差来源（生成器本身 vs 参考分布选择）的严格分解，也缺乏与调查误差基准的量化比较，这使得用户难以判断合成数据的可靠性及适用场景。
AI.method: 使用总变差距离（TVD）作为度量，比较NPK数据集（100万条记录的性别×年龄组×省份联合分布）与韩国官方统计数据。将TVD转换为"偏差界"（任意子群份额的最大可能差异），并与调查样本量对应的边际误差进行比较。通过匹配参考时期和序列来隔离参考选择的影响；通过蒙特卡洛模拟建立完美生成器的误差上限基准。评估两种韩国调查实践中使用的加权方案（脱扣和单元后分层）对偏差和方差的影响。
AI.result: （1）对2026年4月居民登记数据，偏差界为1.81个百分点，相当于约2,900名受访者的调查误差；（2）匹配正确的参考（2024年基于登记的普查，限韩国国民）后，降至0.56个百分点；（3）15个月内居民登记人口结构自身变化距离是NPK最小误差的两倍以上；（4）两种加权方案消除了大部分参考时期依赖性，方差膨胀仅约0.2%；（5）对生成参考进行脱扣后，残余联合偏差处于完美生成器100万条记录模拟分布的97.6百分位。
AI.conclusion: 合成个性数据的偏差主要由参考分布的选择而非生成器能力驱动。通过正确的参考匹配和加权调整可以达到接近完美生成器的水平。但由于参考时期依赖性和残余偏差的存在，应谨慎使用：建议将合成个性数据定位为小规模调查设计的辅助材料，并在使用时针对现行官方统计重新进行诊断和调整。

title: Review-Period Sensitivity in Multiclass Queue Scheduling
summary: Optimal control of stochastic queueing networks is typically studied under continuous-time control. In many service settings, however, managers can adjust decisions only at discrete and potentially infrequent review epochs. We study a multiclass queue scheduling problem in which server assignments can be changed only at the beginning of discrete review periods, and examine how performance depends on the review-period length. We analyze a family of associated fluid control problems parameterized by the review-period length and characterize the first- and second-order sensitivity of the value function. For the two-class case, we derive explicit expressions for these derivatives and characterize their signs. We find that for short review periods, the value function need not be monotone. Once the review period is sufficiently large, the value function becomes monotone nondecreasing and may exhibit a convex or linear region before eventually becoming concave. We further numerically examine the robustness of these observations for the original stochastic scheduling problem and show that stochasticity smooths the nonmonotonicity at smaller scales, while the qualitative sensitivity patterns remain visible and become more pronounced as the scale of the system increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多类队列调度问题中，服务器分配只能在离散且不频繁的审查周期开始时进行调整的情况。通过分析以审查周期长度为参数的流体控制问题族，刻画了值函数的一阶和二阶敏感性。研究发现短期审查周期下值函数不必单调，当审查周期足够长时值函数变为单调非减，并可能呈现凸或线性区域后转为凹。数值实验表明随机性会平滑小尺度下的非单调性，而定性敏感性模式在大尺度下更加明显。
AI.motivation: 传统随机排队网络的最优控制研究通常假设连续时间控制，但在许多实际服务场景中，管理者只能在离散且可能不频繁的审查时间点调整决策。这种离散审查约束下的性能如何随审查周期长度变化尚不清楚，需要从理论和数值两方面进行深入分析。
AI.method: 作者构建了一族以审查周期长度为参数的流体控制问题，据此刻画值函数的一阶和二阶敏感性。对两类别情形推导出这些导数的显式表达式并刻画其符号。此外，通过数值实验检验原始随机调度问题中这些观察的稳健性。
AI.result: 在短期审查周期下，值函数不必单调；当审查周期足够大时，值函数变为单调非减，并且可能出现凸或线性区域，最终转为凹。随机性会平滑较小尺度下的非单调性，定性敏感性模式仍然可见，并且随着系统规模增大而变得更加明显。
AI.conclusion: 离散审查周期对排队调度的性能影响呈现出非单调的复杂模式，随机性对大系统的敏感性模式有平滑和放大作用，这为实际服务系统中的审查周期设计提供了理论指导。

title: Exploiting Micro-Structure in the Generalized Riccati Recursion for Optimal Control
summary: Optimal Control Problems (OCPs) have been applied to a variety of applications. Such problems are often transcribed into a Nonlinear Program (NLP) for which solution methods typically solve a Linear Quadratic (LQ) subproblem. To efficiently solve this LQ subproblem, the Riccati recursion exploits the block-diagonal structure that arises from discretizing an OCP using a Multiple Shooting method. However, reformulating general dynamics constraints to fit the required problem structure to use the Riccati recursion introduces additional micro-structure within these block matrices that remains unexploited. This work demonstrates how structure-exploiting solvers such as Fatrop can benefit from exploiting not only the block-diagonal structure but also the micro-structure within those blocks. We propose a structure-exploiting LU decomposition algorithm and integrate it within the Riccati recursion. Numerical results on randomized linear systems and two OCP examples demonstrate a reduction in computation time of the search direction of up to 20%, with the largest speedup observed for relative zero block sizes around 0.25 and large stage-wise equality constraint jacobians.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用块内微结构的LU分解算法，并将其集成到Riccati递归中，用于更高效地求解最优控制问题离散化后的LQ子问题。数值实验表明，在随机线性系统和两个OCP实例上，搜索方向的计算时间最多可减少20%。
AI.motivation: OCP通过Multiple Shooting离散化后转化为NLP，求解时通常需要解决LQ子问题。Riccati递归利用块对角结构高效求解，但一般动力学约束引入的额外微结构尚未被利用。作者旨在进一步挖掘这些块内微结构以提升求解效率。
AI.method: 提出一种结构利用型LU分解算法，并将其集成到Riccati递归中。该算法不仅利用块对角结构，还利用每个块内部的微结构（如零块模式），从而在求解LQ子问题的搜索方向时减少计算量。
AI.result: 在随机线性系统和两个OCP实例上的数值结果表明，搜索方向的计算时间最多可降低20%。最大加速出现在相对零块大小约为0.25且级级等式约束雅可比矩阵较大时。
AI.conclusion: 结构利用型LU分解与Riccati递归的集成可以有效地挖掘块内微结构，为Fatrop等结构利用型求解器带来显著的性能提升，尤其在特定问题结构条件下加速效果最为明显。

title: Learning Representations through Token Prediction: Geometry, Approximation, and Downstream Guarantees
summary: Token prediction is a central pre-training objective for modern language models. Despite its empirical success, why token prediction learns broadly useful representations remains incompletely understood. We develop a statistical framework connecting token prediction with representation geometry, encoder approximation, and downstream performance. Under a softmax prediction head, we show that accurate token prediction organizes token embeddings according to similarities between the distributions of contexts in which different token types appear, as measured by Hellinger distance, with explicit errors governed by prediction accuracy and token frequency. Meanwhile, the contextual representation provides a low-dimensional coordinate for the conditional distribution of the target token relative to these embeddings. We further introduce a self-consistency principle showing that repeated applications of a shared representation block can progressively refine the contextual representation without introducing additional block parameters. Among representations with the same prediction accuracy, this recurrent construction favors those that can be stably reconstructed from their contexts. Finally, we establish downstream guarantees for token generation, token community recovery, and classification by a linear probe, showing how prediction accuracy and recovered geometry translate into performance beyond the pre-training objective. Together, these results explain how the simple objective of predicting tokens can recover semantic geometry and produce broadly useful representations. A controlled simulation illustrates the theoretical mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统计框架，将token预测的语言模型预训练目标与表示几何、编码器逼近及下游性能联系起来，解释为何简单的token预测能产生广泛有用的表示。
AI.motivation: Token预测是现代语言模型的核心预训练目标，虽然经验上非常成功，但为何token预测能学习到广泛有用的表示在理论上仍未被完全理解。作者希望从理论上解释这一现象。
AI.method: 作者构建了统计框架：1) 在softmax预测头下，证明精确的token预测根据不同token类型出现上下文的分布相似性（Hellinger距离）组织token嵌入，误差由预测准确性和token频率控制；2) 证明上下文表示为目标token条件分布的低维坐标；3) 引入自一致性原则，说明共享表示块的重复应用可逐步细化上下文表示而无需增加参数量；4) 建立token生成、token社区恢复和线性探针分类的下游保证。
AI.result: 通过理论分析证明token预测目标能够恢复语义几何，产生广泛有用的表示。自一致性原则表明循环构造倾向于选择能从上下文稳定重建的表示。模拟实验验证了理论机制的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果共同解释了简单的token预测目标如何恢复语义几何并产生广泛有用的表示，为理解语言模型预训练的有效性提供了理论依据。

title: Do large language models scrutinise what they review? A multimodal audit of scoring calibration, error detection, and author-identity effects
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate peer reviews, prompting examination of their capacity for critical evaluation. This study evaluates two multimodal LLMs, Qwen2.5-VL-72B and Pixtral-Large-124B, as reviewers across 165 submissions to the 2026 International Conference on Learning Representations, a venue that postdates both models' training cutoffs. Manuscripts were presented to both models with author identities blinded, replaced with high-prestige affiliations, or replaced with low-prestige affiliations, and in either text-only or text-with-figure format. Additionally, 145 verifiably detectable errors were inserted into 55 manuscripts to assess error identification under natural and verification-oriented prompts. Across all manuscript groups, including rejected submissions, LLM scores ranged from 7.0 to 8.1, whereas human mean scores ranged from 3.4 to 6.8. The models detected 12.1\% of the verified errors under natural prompting, and a one-sentence verification instruction increased detection to 22.2\%; however, 78\% of the errors remained undetected. Providing figures reduced error detection while increasing review scores. No visual error was reliably verified against its corresponding figure, and half of the text-only reviews described figures that were not provided. Author identity did not influence either review scores or error detection. LLM editorial decisions exactly matched those produced by simple score averaging.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了两个多模态大语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-72B和Pixtral-Large-124B）在ICLR 2026审稿任务中的表现。发现LLM评分系统性偏高（7.0-8.1 vs 人类3.4-6.8），错误检测率极低（自然提示下仅12.1%，验证指令下22.2%），图表输入反而降低错误检测并提高评分，且作者身份不影响评分。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用于生成同行评审，评估其批判性评价能力变得至关重要。本研究旨在检验LLM是否能胜任论文审稿任务，特别是在模型训练截止日期之后提交的新论文上。
AI.method: 对165篇ICLR 2026投稿，使用两个多模态LLM进行评审，操控三个变量：作者身份（匿名/高威望机构/低威望机构）、论文格式（纯文本/文本配图），并插入145个可验证错误到55篇手稿中，比较自然提示和验证导向提示下的错误检测能力。
AI.result: LLM评分范围7.0-8.1，远高于人类评分的3.4-6.8；自然提示下仅检测到12.1%的错误，验证指令提升至22.2%，但仍有78%错误未被发现；图表降低了错误检测但提高了评分；50%的纯文本评审描述了未提供的图表；作者身份对评分和错误检测均无影响；LLM编辑决策与简单评分平均完全一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM目前不适合作为独立论文审稿人：其评分缺乏区分度且系统性偏高，错误检测能力严重不足，视觉信息处理存在严重缺陷（如幻想不存在的图表），并可能被提示词简单操纵（验证指令仅小幅提升检测率）。纯粹依赖分数平均的LLM编辑决策也过于简化。

title: CDPR: Counterfactual Advantage-based Credit Assignment for Cost-Aware Sequential Medical Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is a step-by-step, cost-aware process: a physician orders examinations one at a time, observes the results, and updates the diagnosis before reaching a final conclusion. Most medical language models instead treat diagnosis as a one-pass classification task and ignore the trade-off between a test's value and its cost. We model diagnosis as a cost-aware sequential decision process and train the policy with reinforcement learning. The main difficulty is credit assignment: the only reliable signal comes once at the end of a long trajectory, so it scores a wasteful workup the same as an efficient one. We propose CDPR (Counterfactual Diagnostic Process Reward), which needs no expert labels and no learned critic. CDPR first finds the states where the policy hesitates, using the uncertainty of its action distribution, and then scores the chosen action by its advantage over the alternatives the policy itself would consider, estimated with short rollouts under a utility that balances correctness against test count, cost, and infeasible requests. A rollout cache reuses within-batch trajectories to keep the cost low. We integrate CDPR into GRPO and test it on one in-domain (MIMIC-IV) and two out-of-domain (ClinicalBench and a private hospital dataset) benchmarks. CDPR improves diagnostic accuracy while clearly reducing the number and cost of examinations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDPR（反事实诊断过程奖励）框架，将临床诊断建模为成本感知的序贯决策过程，并通过强化学习训练诊断策略。CDPR无需专家标注或学习型评论家，通过识别策略犹豫状态并基于反事实优势来评分动作，在提升诊断准确率的同时显著减少检查数量和成本。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗语言模型将诊断视为一次性分类任务，忽略了临床诊断的序贯性、成本与价值的权衡。此外，训练诊断策略时存在信用分配难题：唯一可靠信号在长轨迹结束时才出现，导致浪费的检查与高效检查获得相同评分。
AI.method: 将诊断建模为成本感知的序贯决策过程，并用强化学习训练策略。CDPR首先利用策略动作分布的不确定性寻找犹豫状态，然后通过短rollout估计所选动作相较策略自身会考虑的其他备选方案的竞争优势，使用平衡正确性、检查次数、成本和不可行请求的效用函数进行评分。此外引入rollout缓存复用批内轨迹以降低计算成本，并将CDPR集成到GRPO框架中。
AI.result: 在域内数据集MIMIC-IV和两个域外数据集（ClinicalBench及私有医院数据集）上，CDPR在提升诊断准确率的同时，明显减少了检查的数量和成本。
AI.conclusion: CDPR证明了通过反事实奖励设计可以有效解决成本感知诊断中的信用分配问题，在不需要额外监督信号的前提下实现更高效、更准确的临床诊断决策。

title: SemKV: Semantic Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization Guided by the Quality Cliff for Long-Context LLM Inference
summary: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck of long-context large language model (LLM) inference, growing linearly with context length. We show that uniform KV quantization on a fractional-bit grid does not degrade gracefully: under a prespecified multi-seed statistical protocol, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with an affine quantizer is statistically indistinguishable from FP16 KV down to 2.322 code bits/value and collapses at 2.0 bits - a quality cliff in (2.0, 2.322] that reappears in generation-time quantization and multi-turn dialogue and transfers to Mistral-7B. The cliff reframes importance-aware mixed precision: above it, eight model-internal importance indicators are statistically interchangeable, so the benefit of mixing is grid interpolation, reaching average precisions uniform quantization cannot realize. SemKV preserves every token, ranks tokens by a model-internal score, and assigns two adjacent above-cliff precisions, achieving a measured 6.0x storage reduction with no statistically detectable quality difference from full KV (n=900, three seeds), and outperforming FP16 token pruning granted a 1.5x larger memory budget. Replacing the affine base with a distortion-optimized quantizer (TurboQuant-MSE) lowers the cliff in every protocol tested, raising the no-detectable-loss operating point to 7.9x. The recipe: measure the cliff for the target deployment setting, then interpolate above it.

AI.tldr: 本文发现KV缓存量化的关键发现：均匀KV量化在分数位网格上存在"质量悬崖"（在2.0到2.322位之间），基于此提出SemKV方法，通过模型内部重要性评分对token分配两种相邻的悬崖以上精度，实现6.0倍存储压缩且无统计可检测的质量差异；结合失真优化量化器可将无损操作点提升至7.9倍。
AI.motivation: 长上下文大语言模型推理中，KV缓存是主要内存瓶颈，随上下文长度线性增长。现有的均匀KV量化技术假设分数位网格上质量会优雅退化，但缺乏系统的统计验证；同时混合精度方法依赖于重要性指标的选择但缺乏理论基础。
AI.method: 首先通过多种子统计协议（n=900，三种子）测量均匀KV量化的质量悬崖；然后提出SemKV框架：保留所有token，使用模型内部评分对token排序，分配两种相邻的悬崖以上精度来实现混合精度量化；最后用失真优化的TurboQuant-MSE量化器替代仿射基量化器以降低悬崖位置。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，均匀仿射量化在2.322位仍统计不可区分于FP16，但在2.0位塌缩。SemKV实现6.0倍存储压缩且无质量差异，优于获得1.5倍更大内存预算的FP16 token剪枝方法。更换TurboQuant-MSE后无损操作点提升至7.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 关键在于为部署环境测量质量悬崖，然后在悬崖之上进行精度插值——这是实现无损KV压缩的可靠配方。质量悬崖的存在也重新定义了重要性感知混合精度量化的价值：在悬崖之上重要性指标可互换，混合精度收益本质上是网格插值。

title: Filling holes in science draws collective attention, but most higher-order holes remain unexplored
comment: 25 pages of main text, 140 with all the supplemental. 4 main figures, many more in the supplement
summary: Much scientific discovery involves filling holes between ideas and arguments that unleash techno-scientific advance. Representing knowledge as high-dimensional concept embeddings, we use persistent homology to detect holes of increasing order, from gaps between disconnected ideas to higher-order cavities, and identify the research works that fill them. We find two empirical asymmetries. Researchers who fill anticipated holes are poised to draw collective attention by staging outsized novelty and foresight, indicating that bridging holes anticipates where science will converge, most strongly in empirical fields and least in formal and design fields. Yet as knowledge grows, higher-order holes explode while the fraction science fills collapses, leaving most higher-order combinations unexplored. These results call for a richer science of holes, and mark a frontier where contemporary AI might help fill the high-dimensional gaps human science opens.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高维概念嵌入与持续同调（persistent homology）来检测科学知识图谱中的"洞"（从断裂思想间的空隙到高阶腔体），并识别填补这些洞的研究工作。研究发现两种经验不对称性：填补预期之洞的研究者能获得更多集体关注，体现前瞻性与新颖性（在实证领域最强，形式与设计领域最弱）；但随着知识增长，高阶之洞数量爆发而科学填补比例骤降，大部分高阶组合仍未被探索。文章呼吁建立更丰富的"洞的科学"，并指出当代AI可能有助于填补人类科学开启的高维空白。
AI.motivation: 科学研究常通过填补思想与论证之间的空隙来推动科技进步，但现有方法难以系统识别这些"洞"及其在不同阶数（从简单断连到高阶腔体）上的结构特征与演化规律。
AI.method: 将知识表示为高维概念嵌入，应用持续同调检测不同阶数的洞（从分离思想间的空隙到高阶腔体），并识别填补这些洞的具体研究工作，进而统计其关注度与领域分布。
AI.result: 发现两种经验不对称性：填补预期之洞的研究者能吸引更大集体关注（体现新颖性与远见），此效应在实证领域最强、形式与设计领域最弱；同时，随着知识增长，高阶洞的数量爆炸性增长而填补比例不断下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了科学中"洞"的结构与动态特性，指出大部分高阶组合仍未被探索，呼吁建立更系统的洞科学，并展望当代AI可协助填补人类科学所开辟的高维空白。

title: Relative-Degree Wall Restricts Passivity-Based Stability Analysis in Inverter-Dominant Grids
summary: This letter reveals a fundamental limitation of passivity-based distributed stability analysis in power systems. Under the standard formulation, passivity certification inherently imposes a relative-degree compatibility constraint that excludes many high-fidelity inverter dynamic models (e.g., those that include electromagnetic transients). Potential extensions of passivity frameworks are discussed to break this limitation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了基于无源性（passivity）的电力系统分布式稳定性分析中的一个根本性局限：无源性认证在标准框架下天然施加了相对阶（relative-degree）兼容性约束，导致许多高保真逆变器动态模型（如包含电磁暂态的模型）被排除在外，并讨论了打破该限制的潜在扩展方向。
AI.motivation: 现有基于无源性的分布式稳定性分析方法在电力系统中有广泛应用，但标准框架存在隐藏的约束条件，即相对阶兼容性限制，使得许多实际的高保真逆变器模型无法纳入该分析框架，限制了方法的适用性和可靠性。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析揭示了无源性认证与系统相对阶之间的内在联系，指出标准无源性框架隐含地要求系统的相对阶必须满足特定约束（通常相对阶为0或1），而包含电磁暂态的高保真逆变器模型往往具有更高的相对阶，从而不满足无源性条件。文章进一步探讨了可能的扩展途径（如广义无源性、动态无源性等）来突破这一限制。
AI.result: 论文论证了在标准无源性框架下，相对阶兼容性约束是一个固有的、无法绕过的数学限制，并给出了一类无法通过标准无源性认证的高保真逆变器模型示例（含电磁暂态模型），同时提出了若干潜在扩展方向。
AI.conclusion: 标准无源性框架在电力系统分布式稳定性分析中存在根本性的相对阶限制，需要发展扩展的无源性理论框架（如高阶无源性或动态无源性方法）来覆盖更广泛的高保真逆变器动态模型，以提升分布式稳定性分析的实际工程适用性。

title: Nechvile-Transformed Spacecraft Dynamics and Propellant Computation in the 3-Body Problem
summary: The uncontrolled equations of motion in the Nechvile frame for the restricted three-body problem have been well-known since at least the 1960s. It would seem that adding an external force to these equations is quite trivial: simply add an external force per mass term to the acceleration equations. Here we show that the last statement is not true. In fact, we show that the additive generic external force must be multiplied by the inverse of $(1 + e \cosθ)^3$ where $e$ is the relative eccentricity of the primaries and $θ$ is the true anomaly of the rotating frame located at the barycenter. Furthermore, when this result is combined with the mass flow rate equation, it generates several surprising results due to the mismatch between the resulting quadratic term and the cubic term in the equations of motion. This leads to a corresponding modification of the rocket equation itself. A Birkhoff-theoretic solution to an illustrative cislunar space mission problem shows propellent savings of 80% with the use of the correct cost functional. The popular quadratic cost utilizes more than $2X$ the minimum propellant consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在Nechvile框架下受约束三体问题中，向运动方程添加外部力并非简单直接。外部力必须乘以因子(1 + e cosθ)^−3，且这一修正与质量流率方程结合会产生多个惊人结果，包括对火箭方程的修改。以地月空间任务为例，使用正确的代价函数可节省80%推进剂，而常用的二次型代价函数消耗超过最小值的2倍。
AI.motivation: 长期以来，研究者认为在Nechvile框架的三体问题运动方程中添加外部力只需简单地在加速度方程中加入单位质量外力项。作者揭示这一直观认识是错误的，外部力需要乘以一个与偏心率和真近点角相关的因子，这对推进剂消耗优化问题具有重大影响。
AI.method: 作者从Nechvile框架（以质心为原点、随主星旋转的坐标系）下的无控运动方程出发，推导了在引入一般性外部力时所需乘上的修正因子(1 + e cosθ)^−3。随后将该修正与质量流率方程结合，推导出火箭方程的修正形式，并将其应用于Birkhoff理论框架下的地月空间任务最优控制问题。
AI.result: 1) 一般性外部力必须乘以(1 + e cosθ)^−3；2) 修正后的方程中二次项与三次项不匹配，导致火箭方程本身需要相应修改；3) 在地月空间任务示例中，使用正确的代价函数可节省80%推进剂；4) 常用的二次型代价函数消耗的推进剂是最小值的2倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该研究颠覆了长期以来关于三体问题中外部力添加的简单认识，指出了代价函数选择对推进剂最优化的关键影响。不仅修正了理论基础，还提供了具有显著工程意义的推进剂节省方案。

title: Fairness in multi-class multi-group classification problems via contextial coherent risk measures
summary: We propose a new design of fair classifiers for multi-class classification problems in the presence of vector-valued sensitive attributes. In that scenario each sensitive attribute has multiple values and forms several groups relevant to the fairness consideration. Naturally those groups are overlapping and one should also analyze the interaction of factors. Additionally, the decision makers aided by the classification should not violate individual rights at the expense of satisfying fairness metrics at the group level. We propose an approach using the theory and methods of coherent measures of risk aiming at resolving the fairness challenges. Further, we propose a specialized numerical method for solving the resulting optimization problem. The method scales well with the increase of the number of observations. Additionally, we note that the obtained classifier is robust with respect to corrupted data or to situation when data is scarce. We demonstrate the advantages of the proposed framework in comparison to the support-vector machine framework and other methods handling fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向多分类问题、支持向量值敏感属性的公平分类器新设计框架。该框架利用一致风险度量理论解决重叠群体间的公平性问题，并提出一种随样本量扩展的高效数值优化方法，同时保证分类器对数据损坏和稀缺具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的公平分类器大多处理单一敏感属性或二元分类场景，难以应对多值敏感属性带来的重叠群体以及因素交互效应。同时，已有方法在满足群体层面公平指标时可能牺牲个体权利，需要在群体公平与个体公平之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 采用一致风险度量的理论与方法构建公平分类优化问题，将群体公平约束和个体权利保护统一纳入风险度量框架中；同时提出一种专门针对该优化问题的数值求解方法，该方法能够很好地随样本量扩展。
AI.result: 实验表明，与支持向量机框架及其他公平性处理方法相比，所提出的框架在公平性表现上具有优势；分类器对数据损坏和样本稀缺场景具有鲁棒性；数值方法在大规模数据下具有良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 一致风险度量理论为解决多值敏感属性下的公平分类问题提供了有效的数学框架，能够在保障群体公平的同时维护个体权利，且具备良好的计算效率和鲁棒性。

title: Intelligent Identification and Repair of Design Defects in BIM via Domain-Specific Large Language Models
summary: Existing methods lack a generalized approach to efficiently identify and resolve the diversity of design defects in BIM. Therefore, this study proposes an integrated framework to identify and repair various defects in BIM via domain-specific LLMs. Firstly, a BIM-to-Text method with component-balanced chunking is introduced to bridge BIM data with LLMs. Then, prompt learning with rule injection, few-shot prompting and RAG is proposed to identify defects and generate repair suggestions. Meanwhile, a hallucination control strategy combining key identifier validation and token-length thresholds is introduced to ensure reliability. Experiments show capability expansion yields 85% identification accuracy versus 70% for traditional rule checking, achieving a 94% rate of reasonable repair suggestions. Moreover, the proposed hallucination control further increased accuracy from 64% to 85%, eliminating 92.5% of hallucinations in a single intervention round. This study establishes an end-to-end prototype from raw BIM data input, through defect identification, to repair suggestion generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成框架，利用领域特定的大语言模型（LLM）来识别和修复BIM（建筑信息模型）中的各种设计缺陷。通过BIM到文本转换、提示学习（规则注入、少样本和RAG）以及幻觉控制策略，解决了传统方法难以泛化识别多种缺陷的问题。实验结果显示缺陷识别准确率达85%（传统规则检查仅70%），修复建议合理率达94%，幻觉消除率达92.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有BIM设计缺陷检测方法缺乏通用且高效的手段来识别和解决多样化的设计缺陷，无法满足建筑行业对自动化质量检查的需求。
AI.method: 1) 提出BIM到文本转换方法，采用组件平衡分块策略将BIM数据与LLM桥接；2) 提出结合规则注入、少样本提示和RAG的提示学习方法来识别缺陷并生成修复建议；3) 引入幻觉控制策略，结合关键标识符验证和token长度阈值来确保可靠性。
AI.result: 能力扩展使缺陷识别准确率从传统规则检查的70%提升至85%，修复建议合理率达94%；幻觉控制策略将准确率从64%提升至85%，单轮干预中消除了92.5%的幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了从原始BIM数据输入、缺陷识别到修复建议生成的端到端原型系统，验证了领域特定LLM在BIM缺陷检测与修复中的有效性和可靠性。

title: SHAPE of Chain-of-Thought in Math Reasoning
comment: accepted to The 3rd AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet the mathematically meaningful skills underlying their reasoning remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{SHAPE}, a framework that analyzes Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories through two lenses developed in mathematics education: (1) semantic spaces: the model's evolving mathematical interpretations of a problem (e.g., algebraic, geometric), and (2) heuristics: the specific mathematical actions taken within those spaces (e.g., simplifying the problem, working backward). We first use \texttt{SHAPE} to analyze the reasoning patterns of various models. Our findings reveal that the mathematical heuristics employed by a model better explain final answer correctness than traditional CoT features. Furthermore, models are likely to reach correct solutions by concentrating their reasoning effort within a few semantic spaces rather than exploring many disparate ones -- a pattern consistent with human behavior. Next, we utilize the \texttt{SHAPE} lens to evaluate whether post-training truly enhances mathematical proficiency. We find that reinforcement learning induces mode-seeking in heuristic usage. Lastly, we post-train LLMs by promoting diverse heuristics and demonstrate its effectiveness in improving accuracy. Overall, \texttt{SHAPE} provides a theoretically-grounded diagnostic framework for decoding LLM reasoning and offers a new path toward post-training LLMs for math reasoning. The code for our model is available at https://github.com/holi-lab/SHAPE-of-CoT

AI.tldr: 论文提出SHAPE框架，通过数学教育中的两个视角（语义空间和启发式）分析大语言模型在Chain-of-Thought推理中的数学思维模式，发现数学启发式比传统CoT特征更能预测答案正确性，并利用该框架评估和改进后训练方法。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM在数学推理基准上表现优异，但其背后的数学有意义技能尚未被充分探索，缺乏理论驱动的框架来系统分析模型的推理过程。
AI.method: 引入SHAPE框架，从两个数学教育视角分析CoT轨迹：(1)语义空间——模型对问题的不断演化的数学解释（如代数、几何）；(2)启发式——在这些空间中采取的具体数学行动（如简化问题、逆向工作）。该框架用于分析推理模式、评估后训练效果，并指导通过对多样化启发式的促进来改进后训练。
AI.result: 发现：(1)数学启发式比传统CoT特征更能解释最终答案的正确性；(2)模型在少数语义空间集中推理努力比探索多个不相关空间更可能得到正确答案，符合人类行为模式；(3)强化学习在启发式使用中引入了模式寻求行为；(4)通过促进多样化启发式进行后训练能有效提高准确性。
AI.conclusion: SHAPE提供了具有理论基础的诊断框架，用于解码LLM推理，并为数学推理的后训练提供了新路径。

title: RankShift: In-Database Detection and Explanation of Categorical Shifts
summary: A login service can receive its usual number of failed sign-ins while one source grows from 2% to 30% of them. The same pattern appears in system logs when a rare event template becomes common while the message rate stays stable. These events change which categories are active without changing how many events occur. RankShift detects such changes inside the analytical database that stores the data. It compares each window's category shares with a benign reference using a Pearson score whose terms identify the categories responsible for the change. The same query returns the score, calibrated alert, and largest increasing contributions. We evaluate RankShift on HDFS, BGL, and Thunderbird. It matches the count-vector autoencoder within 0.001 AUROC on HDFS (0.999 versus 1.000) and leads on Thunderbird (0.983 versus 0.949). In a controlled fixed-volume experiment, RankShift detects rare-category shifts that are invisible to event-count monitoring, reaching 0.787 AUROC compared with 0.771 for the autoencoder. Across all three corpora, observed false-alarm rates track the requested operating levels. RankShift requires no model training or inference service, and the autoencoders deployed state is 137x larger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RankShift，一种在分析型数据库内部检测类别份额变化（而非事件数量变化）的异常检测方法。它通过Pearson评分比较每个窗口的类别份额与良性参考，无需模型训练，部署状态比自编码器小137倍，在HDFS、BGL和Thunderbird数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于事件计数的监控方法会忽略一种重要异常：当某些类别（如罕见的日志模板或失败登录来源）的份额发生显著变化，而事件总数保持稳定时，这些变化无法被计数监控检测到。现有机器学习方法（如自编码器）需要额外的训练和推理服务，部署成本高。
AI.method: RankShift在分析型数据库内部工作，将每个时间窗口的类别份额与良性参考进行比较，使用Pearson评分量化差异，评分中的各项能识别导致变化的类别。同一个SQL查询即可返回评分、校准警报和最大增长贡献类别。
AI.result: 在HDFS上RankShift达到0.999 AUROC（对比自编码器的1.000），在Thunderbird上领先（0.983对比0.949）。在受控固定体积实验中，RankShift能检测到事件计数监控不可见的罕见类别转移，达到0.787 AUROC（自编码器为0.771）。三个语料库的误报率与请求的操作水平一致，且部署状态比自编码器小137倍。
AI.conclusion: RankShift证明，类别份额变化是一种有意义且可检测的异常信号，且可以直接在分析型数据库内以纯SQL方式实现，无需训练、无需推理服务，在检测性能和部署效率上均具竞争力。

title: Stress-testing university AI governance: A prospective method for locating policy breakpoints
summary: Universities are producing AI principles and use policies faster than they are building decision pathways for unfamiliar forms of AI agency. This study develops Institutional AI Governance Stress Testing (IAGST), a prospective documentary method for locating where publicly documented governance ceases to yield an accountable response. IAGST adapts established policy stress-testing and wind-tunneling logic. Its originality lies in combining controlled capability escalation, a frozen documentary corpus, a six-dimensional governance response chain, non-compensatory decision rules, and case-level breakpoint diagnosis. The method was demonstrated using 133 substantive public documents from five Western Australian universities and 15 quality-screened scenarios, resulting in 75 university-scenario encounters. Six cases were resolved, 14 were resolved through structured discretion, and 55 were indeterminate. Governed pathways fell from 16 of 25 augmentation cases to four delegation cases and none at autonomous substitution. The dominant weakness was not the complete absence of responsible roles: all 50 authority-gap cases named a role at only a generic level but lacked sufficient decision criteria or process. The findings show how universities can move beyond policy inventories and principal statements by testing whether authority, procedures, safeguards, and reviews remain connected as AI capabilities evolve. IAGST is a reproducible diagnostic for policy learning, not a ranking or measure of implementation.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出机构AI治理压力测试（IAGST）方法，用于定位大学AI治理文档中无法产生问责响应的薄弱环节。通过对西澳五所大学的133份文件与15个场景进行测试，发现治理通路随AI能力升级而急剧下降，主要弱点在于权威角色缺少决策准则与程序细节。
AI.motivation: 大学制定AI原则和政策的速度远快于为不熟悉的AI代理形式构建决策路径的速度，现有政策清单无法应对AI能力演进带来的治理缺口，需要一种前瞻性方法来检验已公开的治理文档能否产生可问责的响应。
AI.method: IAGST方法将政策压力测试与风洞测试逻辑相结合，具体包括：受控能力升级、冻结文档语料库、六维治理响应链、非补偿性决策规则以及案例级断点诊断。研究使用西澳五所大学133份实质性公开文件与15个经过质量筛选的场景进行演示，形成75次大学-场景交互测试。
AI.result: 在75次测试中，6个案例得到完整解决，14个通过结构化裁量解决，55个结果不确定。治理路径从增强场景的16个下降到委托场景的4个，在自主替代场景中为0个。主要弱点并非缺乏责任角色，而是50个权威缺口案例中角色仅停留在泛化层面，缺少足够的决策标准或流程。
AI.conclusion: 大学需要超越政策清单和原则性声明，通过测试权威、程序、保障和审查在AI能力演进过程中是否保持关联性。IAGST是一种可复现的政策学习诊断工具，而非排名或实施衡量工具。

title: Stimulated Oscillations in Renewable Energy Integrated Power Systems - Part II: Methodology of Oscillation Mitigation
summary: As presented in Part I of this series, closely located poles can produce high-amplitude oscillations even under small perturba-tions, which are referred to as stimulated oscillations. As the second installment of this series, this paper develops a method-ology for stimulated oscillation mitigation. Firstly, the logical relationship between system stability and oscillation risk is in-vestigated, clarifying that stability is neither a necessary nor a sufficient condition for oscillation risk. Secondly, the dominant factors affecting the pole and zero position on the complex plane, as well as their effectiveness and limitations are analyzed. For feedback control systems in particular, the influence of feedback paths on the pole-zero distribution of closed-loop systems is ana-lyzed. On this basis, a methodology for stimulated oscillation mitigation is proposed. Combined with the reduced-order trans-fer function of systems with closely separated poles, the order relation and configuration of poles and zeros for the feedback path transfer function, together with the criteria for gain selec-tion, are elaborated. Finally, a parameter tuning scheme for the poles, zeros and gain of the feedback path transfer function is presented. The proposed methodology for stimulated oscillation mitigation based on feedback control is not restricted to specific devices and can serve as a methodological reference for the design of diverse oscillation suppression schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文作为系列论文的第二部分，提出了基于反馈控制的受激振荡抑制方法。文章首先厘清了系统稳定性与振荡风险之间的逻辑关系（稳定性既非振荡风险的必要条件也非充分条件），随后分析了影响极点和零点位置的主导因素及其有效性局限，特别针对反馈控制系统分析了反馈路径对闭环系统零极点分布的影响。在此基础上，结合具有近距离极点系统的降阶传递函数，阐述了反馈路径传递函数的零极点阶次关系、配置方法及增益选择准则，并提出了零极点与增益的参数整定方案。
AI.motivation: 系列论文第一部分揭示了近距离极点在小扰动下可产生高幅值振荡（即受激振荡）的现象，本论文旨在针对这一现象开发系统的抑制方法论，填补受激振荡缓解策略方面的研究空白。
AI.method: 论文采用理论分析方法：首先从逻辑层面厘清稳定性与振荡风险的关系；其次从复平面角度分析影响零极点位置的因素及其局限；然后针对反馈控制系统，分析反馈路径对闭环系统零极点分布的影响；结合降阶传递函数，提出反馈路径传递函数的零极点配置方法、增益选择准则与参数整定方案。
AI.result: 提出了一套完整的受激振荡抑制方法论，包括反馈路径传递函数的零极点阶次关系与配置准则、增益选择判据，以及具体的参数整定方案。该方法不局限于特定设备，具有通用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于反馈控制的受激振荡抑制方法论可作为一种通用的方法学参考，适用于各类振荡抑制方案的设计，不受具体设备类型的限制。

title: Value of Information in Dynamic Decision Making
summary: We study the value of information in predicting the evolving state of a finite Markov chain. At each stage, a decision maker chooses a state and observes only whether the current state of the chain matches her choice; the resulting information is used to make a prediction on the state at the final stage of the problem. We show that, when the chain starts from an invariant distribution, the optimal terminal value is non-decreasing with the number of observations and converges at a uniform exponential rate. We introduce the predictive learning index, which measures whether all attainable informational value is extracted after finitely many observations, and show that both finite and infinite indices may occur. In contrast, for nonstationary initial distributions, the value may strictly decrease with the horizon.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在有限马尔可夫链中，决策者通过逐步观察来预测最终状态的信息价值问题。研究发现：当链从平稳分布开始时，最优终期价值随观察次数单调不减且以均匀指数速率收敛；论文引入"预测学习指数"衡量有限次观察后是否提取了全部信息价值，并证明有限和无限指数均可出现；而对于非平稳初始分布，价值可能随时间范围严格递减。
AI.motivation: 理解在动态环境中信息的价值如何随观察次数增长而变化，特别是在马尔可夫链预测的背景下，探索信息获取的边际收益是否递减以及是否存在收敛性保证。
AI.method: 建立了一个序贯决策框架：每阶段决策者选择一状态，仅观察当前链状态是否与所选状态匹配，利用所得信息预测最终阶段状态。从信息论与最优停止/动态规划角度分析最优终期价值函数的单调性与收敛性质，并引入预测学习指数来刻画信息价值的有限可提取性。
AI.result: 1) 在平稳初始分布下，最优终期价值随观察次数单调不减，且以均匀指数速率收敛；2) 预测学习指数可为有限也可为无限，说明某些情形下有限次观察即可提取全部信息价值，某些情形则不然；3) 在非平稳初始分布下，价值可能随时间范围严格递减，与平稳情形形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 信息的价值在马尔可夫链预测问题中具有复杂的结构性质：平稳性保证了价值的单调递增和指数收敛，但初始分布的选取对价值函数的单调性有根本性影响。预测学习指数的引入为量化信息提取充分性提供了新工具。

title: Estimating Population-Risk Curves Along Nonconvex Gradient Flows from the Training Sample
summary: We estimate the conditional population-risk curve of a realized smooth nonconvex gradient flow from the training sample. Flow approximate leave-one-out (Flow-ALO) propagates a deletion response and evaluates omitted observations at approximate deleted paths. The risk-curve error decomposes into response approximation, exact-LOO fluctuation, and deletion-to-full risk transfer. On each fixed finite horizon, bounded centered training-loss gradients, a one-sided Hessian lower bound, locally Lipschitz Hessians, and a strict tube-closure condition yield an explicit $(n-1)^{-2}$ bound for the deletion-response error. Bounded evaluation-loss gradients transfer the deletion-response bound to the score without requiring the Hessian to be invertible. Direct first-order jackknife cancellation and exact-LOO concentration control deletion-to-full risk transfer and fluctuation, respectively, completing recovery of the conditional population-risk curve. For bounded smooth two-layer mean-field networks training both layers, the score-error bound is uniform in width.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flow-ALO方法，用于在非凸梯度流训练过程中估计条件总体风险曲线。该方法通过传播删除响应（deletion response）并评估省略观测在近似删除路径上的表现，将风险曲线误差分解为三项，并在一定假设下给出了显式的$(n-1)^{-2}$误差界，且对两层平均场网络的宽度具有一致性。
AI.motivation: 评估模型泛化能力（即条件总体风险曲线）是统计学习中的核心问题，但传统方法（如交叉验证、jackknife）在大规模非凸优化场景中计算代价高昂。本文希望针对实际中广泛采用的平滑非凸梯度流训练过程，提供一种高效且具有理论保证的风险曲线估计方法。
AI.method: Flow-ALO（Flow approximate leave-one-out）方法：在梯度流训练过程中传播删除一个观测后的响应（deletion response），并在近似删除路径上评估被省略的观测。误差分解为三项：响应近似误差、精确LOO波动项、以及删除到全量训练的风险转移项。作者在有限时间区间上，借助有界中心化训练损失梯度、单侧Hessian下界、局部Lipschitz Hessian以及严格的管闭（tube-closure）条件，推导出删除响应误差的显式$(n-1)^{-2}$界；再通过有界评估损失梯度将该界转移到评分上，且无需Hessian可逆假设；最后利用一阶jackknife消去和精确LOO集中性分别控制风险转移与波动项。
AI.result: 在给定假设下，Flow-ALO的删除响应误差达到$(n-1)^{-2}$的显式收敛阶；评分误差不需要Hessian可逆即可从响应误差传递；对于训练双层的平滑两层平均场网络，评分误差界对网络宽度一致成立。
AI.conclusion: Flow-ALO提供了一种计算可行且理论上可证明的逐点条件总体风险曲线估计方法，适用于平滑非凸梯度流，并在平均场神经网络场景中展示了宽度一致的误差控制。

title: Enabling Proactive Spoken Turns via a Generalized Style-Aware Full-Duplex Framework
summary: Compared with half-duplex dialogue systems where the system waits for user turn completion before it responds, natural full-duplex dialogue systems require agents to act proactively in real time, including timely interruptions and backchannels. This creates a key challenge: improving turn timing without sacrificing response quality. To address limitations in realistic proactive turn-taking, we build a generalized style-aware full-duplex framework with three key components. Firstly, we propose LPS-TC, a Lightweight Proactive Speech Turn Controller for plug-and-play integration. It features a fine-grained action space covering both reactive and proactive turn behaviors, enabling half-duplex models with full-duplex capabilities and enhancing existing full-duplex models with superior timing control. Secondly, we construct WildTurn, a large-scale, real-world English dataset containing approximately 2,981 hours of filtered multi-turn stereo conversations from face-to-face and telephone conversations, annotated with five turn-taking and five backchanneling styles. Trained on WildTurn, LPS-TC exhibits rich spoken dynamics that are not captured by existing static full-duplex benchmarks. Thirdly, we introduce a two-tier evaluation scheme that assesses both chunk-level timing precision and turn-level interaction quality under realistic streaming constraints. Our experiments, integrating LPS-TC with half-duplex models like Qwen2.5-Omni and full-duplex models like Freeze-Omni, showcase its superior performance in timing appropriateness and response quality. Our framework also demonstrates fine-grained style controllability and strong generalizability, enabling more natural and human-like spoken interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用的风格感知全双工对话框架，包含轻量级主动语音轮次控制器LPS-TC、大规模真实世界数据集WildTurn（约2981小时）和双层评估方案，能够在不牺牲响应质量的前提下改善轮次时序控制，并支持细粒度的风格可控性和强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的半双工对话系统需要等待用户说完才响应，而自然的全双工对话系统需要代理实时主动行动（如及时打断和反馈）。核心挑战在于改善轮次时序的同时不牺牲响应质量，而现有方法在处理现实主动轮次切换方面存在局限。
AI.method: 框架包含三个关键组件：(1) LPS-TC（轻量级主动语音轮次控制器），采用细粒度动作空间，覆盖反应式和主动式轮次行为，可即插即用地集成到现有模型；(2) WildTurn数据集，包含约2981小时的真实世界过滤多轮立体声对话，标注了五种轮次切换和五种反馈风格；(3) 双层评估方案，同时评估块级时序精度和轮次级交互质量，并考虑现实流式约束。
AI.result: 将LPS-TC集成到半双工模型（如Qwen2.5-Omni）和全双工模型（如Freeze-Omni）的实验中，展示了在时序适当性和响应质量方面的优越表现，并证明了细粒度风格可控性和强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够赋予半双工模型全双工能力，增强现有全双工模型的时序控制，实现更自然、更接近人类的语音交互。

title: Leveraging Generative AI to Design Accessible Interactive Visualizations for Undergraduate Mathematics: A Six-Phase Workflow
summary: Interactive visualizations support conceptual understanding in undergraduate mathematics, but building them has required programming expertise most instructors lack. Using a design-based research approach, we develop, deploy, and evaluate a six-phase workflow (Foundation, Customization, Mathematical Depth, Application, Accessibility, Pedagogical Control) that uses generative AI to build WCAG~2.2 Level~AA compliant visualizations without programming. The six phases structure every prompt, scaffold the AI's code generation, and define where human verification is applied. We ask whether the structure reliably yields correct and accessible tools, whether it runs both backward (reverse-engineering prompts from a finished tool) and forward (generating a tool from a plain-language idea), and what verification each phase requires. Across four deployed tools spanning calculus, multivariable calculus, and differential equations, we evaluate mathematical correctness against closed forms, accessibility through automated and manual screen-reader testing, and the errors that recurred. The structure produces structurally complete first-pass tools, but human verification remains mandatory at every phase: each output must be checked for mathematical correctness, accessibility, and pedagogical fit before the next phase begins. The workflow is platform-independent and serves both instructors and students.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一个六阶段工作流（Foundation, Customization, Mathematical Depth, Application, Accessibility, Pedagogical Control），利用生成式AI在不需编程知识的情况下构建符合WCAG 2.2 AA标准的交互式数学可视化工具。通过四个已部署的教学工具（覆盖微积分、多元微积分和微分方程），评估了数学正确性、可访问性和错误模式，发现结构能生成完整的初版工具，但每个阶段仍需人工验证。
AI.motivation: 交互式可视化能促进本科数学的概念理解，但构建这些工具通常需要编程专业知识，而大多数教师不具备这种能力。因此需要一种无需编程即可生成可视化工具的方法。
AI.method: 采用设计研究（design-based research）方法，开发并评估一个六阶段工作流：Foundation（基础）、Customization（定制）、Mathematical Depth（数学深度）、Application（应用）、Accessibility（可访问性）、Pedagogical Control（教学控制）。该流程结构化了每个提示词，为AI代码生成提供支架，并定义了人工验证的介入点。同时测试了工作流的前向（从自然语言概念生成工具）和后向（从成品工具逆向工程提示词）运行能力。
AI.result: 该工作流能生成结构完整的初版教学可视化工具，且具有平台无关性，同时服务教师和学生。验证覆盖了数学正确性（对照闭式解）、可访问性（自动化和手动屏幕阅读器测试）以及反复出现的错误模式。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI驱动的六阶段工作流可有效降低构建交互式数学可视化的门槛，但人工验证在每个阶段都是不可或缺的：每一步输出都必须在进入下一阶段前检查数学正确性、可访问性和教学适配性。

title: Revisiting the Provable-Auditable Privacy Gap of DP-SGD
comment: The code for this paper can be found here: https://github.com/pineappleEnthusiast/empirical-privacy-defense
summary:
Differential privacy (DP) has traditionally been used to provide theoretical upper bounds on an algorithm's stability to changing its training data. In modern private machine learning applications, achieving strong tradeoffs between utility and theoretical privacy is challenging, and thus one may optimistically hope that existing theoretical privacy analyses are loose. Recent work on privacy auditing has adopted a dual viewpoint, instead lower bounding the true privacy of an algorithm by constructing empirical distinguishing events. The auditing literature has thus far yielded a pessimistic outlook on the looseness of theoretical privacy bounds for DP-SGD, the de facto private training method in modern ML, as nearly-matching empirical lower bounds have been achieved under various threat models [NHSBTJCT23, AC24, CBP25].
  In this work, we propose the empirical privacy lower bound of an algorithm as a concrete metric to optimize for, complementary to the theoretical upper bound. We give a lightweight defense framework that generically augments optimization methods in the ML pipeline to have significantly-improved empirical privacy on standard benchmarks. Moreover, we show that our framework comes at no theoretical privacy cost when augmenting DP-SGD, unlike previously-proposed defenses against membership inference attacks. We evaluate our defense against a broad range of audit constructions, models, and datasets to demonstrate its flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将经验隐私下界作为可优化的具体指标，并设计了一个轻量级防御框架，可通用地增强机器学习流程中优化方法的经验隐私性，同时不影响DP-SGD的理论隐私上界。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私传统上提供算法稳定性的理论上界，但在现代私有机器学习中，理论与实践之间的差距如何是模糊的。最近的隐私审计工作采用下界视角，发现DP-SGD的理论隐私界几乎紧致，这令人悲观。因此需要一种方法来优化经验隐私下界，同时不损害理论保证。
AI.method: 提出将经验隐私下界作为优化目标，设计一个轻量级防御框架，通用地增强优化方法。该框架在标准基准上显著提升经验隐私，且与之前针对成员推理攻击的防御不同，在增强DP-SGD时不引入理论隐私成本。
AI.result: 在多种审计构造、模型和数据集上评估了该防御框架，展示了其灵活性和显著提升的经验隐私性能，且对DP-SGD不牺牲理论隐私保证。
AI.conclusion: 经验隐私下界可以作为与理论上界互补的具体优化指标，本文提出的轻量级防御框架能有效提升经验隐私而不损害理论保证，为隐私保护机器学习提供了新的优化方向。

title: Free Speech and Artificial Intelligence
comment: Preprint. Forthcoming in Mark Satta, Étienne Brown, and JP Messina (eds.), Philosophy and Free Speech: An Introduction. London: Routledge, 2027
summary: Philosophers and legal scholars are engaged in debates about the implications of artificial intelligence for freedom of expression. This paper analyzes the free speech issues raised by two distinct AI technologies: social media recommendation algorithms and conversational AI (i.e., chatbots powered by large language models). The first part shows that, through their recommendation algorithms, social media platforms control the dynamics of speech visibility in the digital public sphere, making algorithmic recommendation relevant to the philosophy of free speech. The second part turns to conversational AI. It discusses both the reasons for granting or withholding speech rights to artificial agents and users' right to receive information, which may render specific forms of chatbot regulation illegitimate. Throughout, the chapter also considers whether social media platforms or AI developers hold corporate speech rights. Its general aim is to raise rather than settle questions that arise from the rapid development of AI technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了两种AI技术（社交媒体推荐算法和对话式AI/聊天机器人）引发的言论自由问题，探讨算法如何控制言论可见性、人工智能代理是否应享有言论权、用户获取信息的权利，以及平台和企业是否拥有公司言论权，最终目标在于提出问题而非解决问题。
AI.motivation: 哲学家和法律学者正就AI对言论自由的影响展开激烈辩论，但相关讨论尚不充分，需要系统分析这两种关键AI技术所引发的言论自由议题。
AI.method: 论文采用概念分析和哲学论证的方法，分为两部分：第一部分分析社交媒体推荐算法如何通过控制言论可见性影响数字公共领域的言论动态；第二部分讨论对话式AI的言论权利归属、用户获取信息的权利，以及公司言论权的适用问题。
AI.result: 论文表明推荐算法使平台控制了言论可见性的动态，使其与言论自由哲学高度相关；同时讨论了授予或剥夺人工智能代理言论权的理由，以及用户信息获取权可能使某些聊天机器人监管形式不具合法性。
AI.conclusion: 论文的总体目标是提出而非解决由AI技术快速发展引发的言论自由问题，为后续深入研究和政策讨论奠定基础。

title: Adaptive Finite-Time Position-Force Control of Teleoperation Systems With Time-Varying Delays Using a Liquid State Machine Uncertainty Estimator
summary: Teleoperation systems are increasingly used in medical, rehabilitation, and remote manipulation applications, where accurate position/force tracking and stable interaction are essential. In such applications, the remote environment may exhibit viscoelasticity, frictional memory, contact transitions, and other dynamic interaction effects, causing the system response to depend not only on the current state but also on its previous evolution. This history dependence, together with communication delays and uncertain nonlinear dynamics, makes accurate uncertainty compensation particularly challenging. Conventional feedforward neural approximators do not inherently retain temporal information, while fully recurrent architectures may introduce additional computational and online training complexity. To address this limitation, this article introduces the first application of a liquid state machine (LSM) to bilateral teleoperation control. A finite-time adaptive controller is developed using a hybrid position/force auxiliary error system with velocity and force filters, while the LSM is employed to estimate uncertain dynamics by exploiting its intrinsic temporal processing and fading-memory capabilities with a simple adaptation mechanism. Closed-loop stability and finite-time convergence are established through a Lyapunov--Krasovskii framework. Simulations in spring--damper and generalized Maxwell viscoelastic environments demonstrate improved position and force tracking and lower mean execution time compared with an RBFNN-based controller.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将液体状态机（LSM）应用于双边遥操作控制，利用其内在的时间处理与衰减记忆能力来补偿历史依赖的不确定动力学，结合有限时间自适应控制器，在粘弹性环境下实现了优于RBFNN的位置/力跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 遥操作系统在医疗、康复和远程操作中面临粘弹性、摩擦记忆和接触转换等历史依赖的动态交互效应，系统响应不仅依赖当前状态还依赖历史演化。传统前馈神经网络无法保留时间信息，而完全递归架构又增加计算和在线训练复杂度，亟需一种兼具时序处理能力且结构简单的补偿方案。
AI.method: 提出一个基于LSM的有限时间自适应控制器。采用混合位置/力辅助误差系统，结合速度滤波和力滤波器；利用LSM的固有时间处理和衰减记忆特性估计不确定动力学，并通过简单适应机制实现更新。稳定性通过Lyapunov-Krasovskii框架建立。
AI.result: 在弹簧-阻尼器和广义Maxwell粘弹性环境仿真中，与RBFNN控制器相比，位置和力跟踪精度更高，且平均执行时间更低。
AI.conclusion: LSM为遥操作控制中历史依赖的不确定性补偿提供了一种低成本、高效的新途径，兼具递归结构的时间记忆能力与前馈结构的简单性。

title: Regularized Coupling Maps on Matrix Polytopes: From Assignment to Graph Matching and Optimal Transport
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. An invited manuscript for the Proceedings of the International Consortium of Chinese (ICCM)
summary: Three classical problems-linear assignment, graph matching, and optimal transport-share a common structure: they seek an optimal matrix-valued coupling on a matrix polytope. We study regularized coupling maps that encompass two families of regularization: entropy/KL regularization, which exponentiates the input score matrix and projects it onto the relevant matrix polytope via the KL-projection; and the Frobenius/Euclidean regularization, which performs the Euclidean projection of the scaled input matrix onto the same polytope. We trace how these two geometries yield complementary algorithmic tools for graph matching (CSGO, ASM, FRAM) and optimal transport (IP-EOT, PSN). The regularized coupling map serves as a direction generator in graph matching and as a solution representation in optimal transport, with the regularizer determining the geometry and the outer task determining the precision standard.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了线性分配、图匹配和最优传输三类经典问题中共享的矩阵多面体上的正则化耦合映射，涵盖熵/KL正则化和Frobenius/欧几里得正则化两类方法，并分析了它们在图匹配和最优传输算法中的互补作用。
AI.motivation: 线性分配、图匹配和最优传输这三类经典问题虽然应用场景不同，但都具有共同的结构——在矩阵多面体上寻找最优矩阵值耦合。作者希望通过统一的视角来理解不同正则化方法（熵正则化与Frobenius正则化）如何影响求解算法，从而揭示这些看似独立的研究方向之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 作者识别出两类正则化耦合映射：1）熵/KL正则化——通过KL投影将输入分数矩阵指数化并投影到相关矩阵多面体上；2）Frobenius/欧几里得正则化——将缩放后的输入矩阵通过欧几里得投影到同一多面体。论文追踪了这两种几何在具体算法中的应用：图匹配中的CSGO、ASM、FRAM，以及最优传输中的IP-EOT、PSN。
AI.result: 正则化耦合映射在图匹配中充当方向生成器，在最优传输中充当解表示。正则化方式决定了几何结构，而外部任务决定了精度标准，两种几何相互补充，提供了互补的算法工具集。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一的框架连接不同的正则化几何和算法，本文揭示了正则化耦合映射在不同任务中的双重角色（方向生成器与解表示），并指出正则化选择与任务精度需求之间的关系，为跨领域算法设计提供了统一的视角。

title: Informative Label Missingness in Multiclass Classification Information Geometry and Excess Risk
summary: Informative label missingness can change the usual efficiency ordering between completely and partially labelled classifiers because the pattern of missing labels may itself carry information about the classification model. We develop a general likelihood-based theory for this phenomenon in parametric multiclass classification. An efficient-information decomposition separates information lost through unavailable class memberships from information contributed by the missing-label mechanism. We then derive a quadratic expansion of plug-in excess risk over the active pairwise faces of the multiclass Bayes boundary, showing that classification efficiency depends on how information gains and losses align with directions that perturb the decision boundary. This yields a classification-weighted generalized-eigenvalue criterion under which informative partial classification may have smaller asymptotic classification risk without globally dominating complete classification in Fisher information. Near missing completely at random, with the marginal missing-label proportion fixed, redistribution of missing labels changes lost class-label information at first order, whereas efficient information from the missingness pattern appears only at second order. Three-class quadratic discriminant calculations, finite-sample experiments, and a semi-synthetic multiclass application illustrate the resulting regime-dependent behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了信息性标签缺失（即缺失模式本身携带分类模型信息）如何改变完全标注与部分标注分类器之间的效率排序。作者建立了参数化多分类的似然理论框架，通过有效信息分解分离丢失信息与缺失机制贡献的信息，并推导出plug-in超额风险的二次展开，提出分类加权广义特征值准则，表明信息性部分分类可在不全局支配完全分类的Fisher信息下获得更小的渐近分类风险。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为完全标注分类器通常比部分标注分类器更高效，但当标签缺失模式本身携带信息时（信息性缺失），这一效率排序可能被颠覆。作者希望建立一般性理论框架来理解和量化这一现象。
AI.method: 1) 建立参数化多分类的似然理论，提出"有效信息分解"将信息分为两类：因类别标签不可用而丢失的信息与缺失标签机制贡献的信息。2) 推导plug-in超额风险的二次展开，该展开作用于多分类Bayes边界的活跃成对面（pairwise faces）。3) 基于此提出分类加权广义特征值准则，用于判断信息性部分分类是否优于完全分类。4) 分析近完全随机缺失（MCAR）情形下的一阶与二阶效应。5) 通过三分类二次判别分析、有限样本实验和半合成多分类应用加以验证。
AI.result: 信息性部分分类可能在渐近分类风险上优于完全分类，但并非在Fisher信息意义上全局支配。在近MCAR条件下且边际缺失比例固定时，缺失标签的重新分布在一阶上改变丢失的类别标签信息，而缺失模式的有效信息仅在二阶出现。三分类二次判别计算、有限样本实验和半合成应用展示了随参数区域变化的依赖行为。
AI.conclusion: 分类效率取决于信息增益与信息丢失如何与扰动决策边界的方向相对齐。这为理解信息性缺失下部分分类器的相对优势提供了统一的理论框架，并给出了实用准则（分类加权广义特征值）来判断何种情形下部分标注优于完全标注。

title: PAUSE: Editable Strategy Artifacts for Long-Form Cultural Story Adaptation
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Culture x AI: Evaluating AI as a Cultural Technology, ICML 2026. Project page: https://abdur75648.github.io/pause/
summary: Generative AI systems increasingly mediate cultural adaptation, but their cultural decisions are often hidden inside prompts, transient model plans, or final prose. We study PAUSE (Pause-And-Update Strategy Editing), an intervention that exposes an editable adaptation strategy as a human control surface for cultural decisions in long-form story adaptation. The strategy is a structured artifact that can be inspected, edited, and then projected through downstream character, entity, and chapter-localization stages. In two Chinese-source serialized novels, we test whether human edits to this strategy propagate into chapter-level prose. Across 9 edited-vs-control chapter comparisons, judges select the edited-strategy output in all 9; a marker audit shows target markers in 8/9 edited outputs and 0/9 controls, with forbidden markers absent from edited outputs and present in all controls. We frame these results as a smoke-scale edit-adherence study, not a claim that the outputs are culturally authoritative or literary-quality improvements. PAUSE offers one practical way to make AI-mediated cultural adaptation more inspectable and contestable before decisions propagate through long-form generation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PAUSE（Pause-And-Update Strategy Editing）干预方法，将生成式AI在文化改编中的决策暴露为可编辑的适配策略，作为人类控制界面。在两部中文源网络小说的实验中，人类对策略的编辑成功传播到章节级文本，9/9章节被评判者选择为更优，靶标标记出现在8/9编辑输出中且0/9对照中，禁忌标记则完全相反。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI越来越多地介入文化改编过程，但其文化决策通常隐藏在提示词、模型内部计划或最终文本中，缺乏可检查性和可争辩性。用户无法在决策传播到长文本之前对其进行干预或修正。
AI.method: PAUSE将改编策略作为结构化的可编辑工件暴露出来，人类可以检查、编辑该策略，然后将其投射到下游的角色、实体和章节定位阶段。该策略作为控制界面，在生成之前引导文化决策的传播。
AI.result: 在9组编辑vs对照章节比较中，评判者在全部9组中选择编辑策略的输出；标记审计显示靶标标记出现在8/9编辑输出中、0/9对照中，而禁忌标记在编辑输出中完全缺失、在全部对照中出现。
AI.conclusion: PAUSE提供了一种实用的方式，使AI媒介的文化改编在决策传播到长篇生成之前更具可检查性和可争辩性。作者将结果定位为小规模编辑遵循性研究，而非声称输出具有文化权威性或文学质量提升。

title: Integrating Triaxial IMU Sensors and Ensemble Learning for Effective Parkinson Disease Severity Classification
summary: Parkinson disease PD is a progressive neurodegenerative disease that can have a significant impact on motor performance resulting in the appearance of symptoms such as tremors rigidity postural instabilities and bradykinesia. Timely clinical treatment disease management and quality life of the patients are closely linked to early and appropriate identification of PD. Over the past few years the growth of wearable sensor technology and artificial intelligence AI have made it possible to create noninvasive and data driven disease detection methods. This paper proposes a comparative system using artificial intelligence to detect Parkinsons disease by analyzing the motion and tremor data captured by an inertial measurement unit IMU. The data comprises the signals of the acceleration and gyroscope sensors measuring movement in three directions X Y and Z. The signs and symptoms provide helpful information about subtle motor deficits associated with PD. Several classification models like Support Vector Machine SVM Logistic Regression LR KNearest Neighbors KNN Decision Tree DT Extreme Gradient Boosting XGBoost and Light Gradient Boosting Machine LightGBM were used to compare their effectiveness. The Logistic Regression model had a performance around 75 percent in all evaluation metrics and KNearest Neighbours KNN around 90 percent. The support vector machine SVM performed almost 94 percent whereas the performance of classifiers such as Decision Tree and XGBoost was close to 96 percent and overall classification efficacy respectively. LightGBM model performs consistently at the best rank among all of the evaluated methods having Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1score of around 97 percent. The results show that the proposed machine learning approach offers an accurate and effective predictive capability in the classification of PD severity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于AI的比较系统，利用IMU（惯性测量单元）采集的运动和震颤数据（三轴加速度和陀螺仪信号）来检测帕金森病。比较了多种机器学习分类模型（SVM、LR、KNN、DT、XGBoost、LightGBM），其中LightGBM表现最佳，准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数均达约97%。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，严重影响患者运动功能。早期准确识别PD对及时治疗、疾病管理和患者生活质量至关重要。近年来可穿戴传感器和AI技术的发展为实现无创、数据驱动的疾病检测方法提供了可能。
AI.method: 利用IMU（惯性测量单元）捕获的三维（X、Y、Z）加速度计和陀螺仪传感器信号，提取运动与震颤数据作为特征。构建并比较了多种机器学习分类器，包括SVM、Logistic Regression、KNN、Decision Tree、XGBoost和LightGBM，评估其在PD检测中的有效性。
AI.result: Logistic Regression在所有评估指标上表现约75%，KNN约90%，SVM约94%，Decision Tree和XGBoost接近96%。LightGBM在所有方法中表现最佳，准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数均约为97%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的机器学习方法在PD严重程度分类中表现出准确且有效的预测能力，其中LightGBM模型性能最优，验证了基于IMU数据和AI的帕金森病检测方法的可行性与优越性。

title: From the Loss Landscape to Diverse Feature Learning in Neural Networks
comment: PhD dissertation. This article draws from arXiv:2408.11804
summary:
Over the course of the last decade, neural networks have grown from an academic curiosity to moving the markets of nations. Despite this explosion in both research and deployment, relatively little is understood about how they achieve the solutions they do. This is both scientifically relevant, and pressing for society. When neural networks make decisions across self-driving, construction, law, hiring and health, there have been and will continue to be unintended consequences.
  However, attempting to generalize the failures of the largest and most important production systems makes for a very difficult task. Yet signs of these failures exist at all scales of neural networks, so we should be able to study a much more tractable setting. All neural networks must undergo an optimization process, called training, to be useful. To a great degree, understanding neural networks is understanding their optimization: through what process and exposure to which data did they arrive at their results. Yet our knowledge on this topic as a field is quite imprecise. In particular, a curious phenomenon called mode connectivity, the ability to connect neural networks in the loss surface, defies explanation entirely.
  This dissertation elucidates, explains and exploits this special structure in the loss landscape...

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇博士论文摘要，旨在阐明、解释并利用神经网络损失景观中的模式连通性（mode connectivity）现象。论文指出，理解神经网络的关键在于理解其优化过程，而模式连通性——即在损失面上连接神经网络的能力——是一个尚未被解释的奇特现象。
AI.motivation: 神经网络已从学术好奇心发展为影响国家市场的关键技术，但我们对它们如何达到解决方案的理解仍然有限。这既具有科学意义，也具有社会紧迫性，因为神经网络在自动驾驶、建筑、法律、招聘和医疗等领域的决策已产生并将继续产生意外后果。虽然研究大型生产系统的失败很困难，但这些失败迹象存在于所有规模的神经网络中，因此可以在更易处理的环境中研究。理解神经网络很大程度上就是理解其优化过程，而模式连通性这一现象至今无法被解释。
AI.method: 论文采用可扩展（tractable）的研究视角，聚焦于神经网络训练这一优化过程，从较小规模的网络入手研究模式连通性现象，而非直接研究难以处理的大型生产系统。
AI.result: 论文尚未在摘要中展示具体结果，但声称将"阐明、解释并利用"（elucidates, explains and exploits）损失景观中的这一特殊结构。
AI.conclusion: 论文旨在通过对模式连通性的深入研究，增进对神经网络优化过程的理解，为解释神经网络如何达成解决方案提供理论依据。

title: Why Organizational Rules Fail AI: O-I-B-A-R and the Externalization of Decision Boundaries
summary: AI systems increasingly enter organizations through policies, procedures, playbooks, prompts, and other explicit representations of work. Yet formal descriptions often differ from situated practice, and captured know-what can omit the contextual know-how experts use when judgments are uncertain. We argue that a recurring class of organizational AI failures arises partly from a knowledge representation problem at the sociotechnical interface: the AI receives the procedure, while the organization operates on the procedure plus negative boundaries, runtime judgments, responsibility assignments, and learning history. We introduce O-I-B-A-R (OPEN, IS, BUT, ACTION, RESULT), a scaffold for externalizing these missing decision boundaries. IS records when a judgment holds. BUT records a concrete failure containing information beyond the logical negation of IS. Comparable success and failure cases are decomposed toward a minimally sufficient changing variable, which becomes a value-bearing decision dimension. A suspension represents the state in which the dimension is known but its current value is unresolved, specifying what must be measured, asked, retrieved, or escalated to a human. RESULT confirms a boundary, shifts a threshold, or exposes a new dimension. Incidents can generate new dimensions, unresolved values can define human-AI handoffs, and feedback can expand the decision space. We also identify a sociotechnical tension: durable and attributable failure histories can suppress the candor on which useful boundary knowledge depends. Externalization must therefore be designed as an organizational intervention with real costs and incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出O-I-B-A-R框架，用于显式化组织决策中缺失的隐性边界知识（负面边界、运行时判断、责任分配、学习历史），以解决组织AI系统因"收到程序但组织按程序加隐性知识运行"而产生的失败问题。
AI.motivation: AI系统通过策略、程序、剧本、提示词等显式表征进入组织，但正式描述常与实际情境实践不符，且捕获的"知道什么"遗漏了专家在不确定判断时使用的"知道如何"的情境知识。组织AI失败的一个反复出现的根因，是AI只接收程序，而组织实际运作基于程序加上负面边界、运行时判断、责任分配和学习历史——这是一个社会技术接口层面的知识表征问题。
AI.method: 提出O-I-B-A-R脚手架（OPEN, IS, BUT, ACTION, RESULT）用于外化这些缺失的决策边界。IS记录判断成立的条件；BUT记录包含信息超出IS逻辑否定的具体失败案例；通过将成功与失败案例分解，找出最小充分改变变量，成为有价值的决策维度；"悬挂"状态表示维度已知但其当前值未决，需指定需测量、询问、检索或升级给人类的内容；RESULT确认边界、移动阈值或暴露新维度。事件可生成新维度，未决值可定义人机交接，反馈可扩展决策空间。
AI.result: 该框架能通过事件生成新决策维度、未决值定义人-AI交接、反馈扩展决策空间。同时识别出社会技术张力：持久且可归因的失败历史可能抑制坦诚，而坦诚正是有用边界知识所依赖的。因此外化必须被设计为一种带有真实成本和激励的组织干预。
AI.conclusion: O-I-B-A-R将隐性边界知识外化的过程同时定位为一个知识表征问题和一个组织干预问题，需要配套设计成本与激励机制来维护坦诚性，从而真正解决组织AI在不确定判断场景中的系统性失败。

title: Conformal Prediction Regions for Continuous-Time Trajectories under Random Sampling
summary: Uncertainty quantification for continuous-time trajectories is a prerequisite in many safety-critical engineering domains. However, a major challenge in data-driven uncertainty quantification is that calibration trajectories are sampled only at discrete, often sparse, and random intervals. Standard conformal prediction methods typically fail to provide guarantees in between sampling times. In this work, we introduce a new technique to obtain valid conformal prediction regions for continuous-time trajectories that are sampled at discrete and possibly random times. To accomplish this goal, we make three contributions: (1) we provide an algorithm that leverages regularity properties of the underlying trajectories to obtain valid prediction regions in between samples, (2) we provide methods that estimate valid bounds on the aforementioned regularity properties from an additional high-frequency calibration dataset, and (3) we introduce and compare several algorithms to deal with random sampling times. Finally, we present experiments where we validate that our methods achieve valid coverage across the entire continuous trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的技术，用于对仅在离散且随机时间点采样的连续时间轨迹进行有效的共形预测区间构建，通过在采样点之间利用轨迹的规律性属性来保证整个连续轨迹的覆盖有效性。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键的工程领域中，连续时间轨迹的不确定性量化至关重要。然而，数据驱动的校准轨迹通常只能在离散、稀疏且随机的间隔内采样，标准的共形预测方法无法在采样时间点之间提供有效性保证，这是一个亟待解决的挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了三项贡献：(1) 设计了一种算法，利用底层轨迹的规律性属性在采样点之间获得有效的预测区域；(2) 提供了从额外的高频校准数据集中估计这些规律性属性的有效上界的方法；(3) 引入并比较了多种处理随机采样时间的算法。
AI.result: 实验验证了所提出的方法能够在整个连续轨迹上实现有效的覆盖，即在采样点之间也能保持共形预测的有效性保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了离散采样条件下连续时间轨迹共形预测的挑战，为安全关键应用中连续轨迹的不确定性量化提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Negative-Curvature-Informed L-BFGS via Minimal Secant Corrections for Finite Minimax Problems
summary: We study a limited-memory quasi-Newton method for unconstrained finite minimax problems. The nonsmooth maximum is handled by a truncated hyperbolic smoothing model, while the curvature pairs used by L-BFGS are modified only when a genuine negative-curvature observation is detected. Three correction rules are developed. The first replaces $y_k$ by $-y_k$; the second is obtained from the Euclidean nearest-point problem; and the third is obtained from the nearest-point problem in the $B_k^{-1}$ metric. All three rules enforce the same positive secant curvature $s_k^T\ytilde_k=|s_k^Ty_k|$ on a strict negative-curvature pair. The standard BFGS update and the standard L-BFGS two-loop recursion are then used without any change. In particular, the method does not require an eigendecomposition, a Krylov negative-curvature search, or an isotropic shift $B_k+μ_kI$. We prove that every accepted pair preserves positive definiteness, establish the sufficient-descent property and finite termination of the Armijo backtracking under explicit metric and smoothing assumptions, and derive a global Clarke-stationarity result for the continuation framework. We also show that all three corrections become inactive in a sufficiently strongly convex neighborhood, so the local method reduces to ordinary L-BFGS. The paper separates the common algorithmic framework from the choice of the negative-curvature correction, which allows the three variants to be compared under identical smoothing, line-search, and memory rules.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限无约束极小极大问题的有限内存拟牛顿方法。通过截断双曲平滑模型处理非光滑的max函数，仅在检测到真正的负曲率观测时才修正L-BFGS的曲率对。提出三种修正规则：替换y_k为-y_k、欧几里得最近点问题和B_k^{-1}度量下的最近点问题，均强制正割曲率|s_k^Ty_k|。方法无需特征分解、Krylov负曲率搜索或各向同性移位，证明了正定保持、充分下降性、Armijo回溯有限终止以及全局Clarke平稳性。
AI.motivation: 有限极小极大问题在工程和机器学习中广泛存在，但非光滑特性使得传统L-BFGS无法直接应用。现有处理负曲率的方法（如特征分解、Krylov搜索、各向同性移位）计算成本高或过于复杂，需要一种简单有效的负曲率修正策略。
AI.method: 采用截断双曲平滑模型处理非光滑最大值函数；L-BFGS的曲率对仅在检测到真正负曲率观测时修正。提出三种修正规则：(1)将y_k替换为-y_k；(2)基于欧几里得最近点问题；(3)基于B_k^{-1}度量下的最近点问题。三种规则均使s_k^T y_tilde_k=|s_k^Ty_k|，且标准BFGS更新和L-BFGS两循环递归保持不变。
AI.result: 证明每个接受的曲率对保持正定性；在显式度量和平滑假设下建立充分下降性质和Armijo回溯的有限终止；推导出延续框架下的全局Clarke平稳性结果；证明在足够强凸邻域内三种修正均失活，局部方法退化为普通L-BFGS。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将通用算法框架与负曲率修正的选择分离，使得三种变体在相同平滑、线搜索和内存规则下可公平比较。方法简单高效，无需昂贵的特征分解或Krylov操作，保持了L-BFGS的实用性和收敛性保证。

title: Learning the Geometry of Admissible Hypotheses through Inductive Bias in Training Distributions
summary: Scientific discovery often requires reasoning over competing hypotheses that are consistent with experimental observations. For mixed-variable and combinatorial hypothesis spaces, however, constructing probabilistic representations remains challenging because both the active model components and their associated parameters are unknown. In this work, we present a framework for learning continuous latent representations of admissible partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding a scientific inductive bias directly into the training distribution. Progressively richer structural principles (e.g., sparsity, logical dependencies, common PDE families, and physical admissibility) are used to generate a structured distribution of hypotheses from which a gated variational autoencoder learns a continuous latent manifold. Experimental results show that the resulting 11-dimensional representation accurately reconstructs a broad collection of representative PDEs, while exhibiting smooth geometric transitions both within and across equation families. Through an ablation study we further demonstrate that introducing scientific principles reduces both structural misclassifications of equation forms and parameter estimation errors when reconstructing a representative benchmark set of admissible partial differential equations. These results show that embedding a scientific inductive bias in the training distribution enables the learning of compact and geometrically meaningful hypothesis manifolds, providing a principled foundation for future inference over competing governing equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种框架，通过将科学归纳偏置（如稀疏性、逻辑依赖、常见PDE族和物理可容许性）嵌入训练分布，利用门控变分自编码器学习偏微分方程的连续潜表征流形，从而实现对竞争性假设的几何化表示与推断。
AI.motivation: 科学发现常需在竞争性假设中进行推理，但在混合变量和组合假设空间中，由于活动模型组件和参数均未知，构建概率表示具有挑战性。
AI.method: 通过逐层引入逐步增强的结构性原则生成结构化假设分布，并训练门控变分自编码器（Gated VAE）学习连续潜流形，该流形维度为11维。
AI.result: 11维潜表征能准确重建广泛的代表性PDE，并在方程族内部及之间展现平滑的几何过渡；消融研究表明引入科学原则可减少方程形式的结构误分类和参数估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 在训练分布中嵌入科学归纳偏置能够学习紧凑且具有几何意义的假设流形，为未来在竞争性控制方程上进行推断提供了原则性基础。

title: Do MLLMs Really Understand Low-Resource Khmer Documents? A Pilot Study on Khmer Document VQA
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced document understanding, visual question answering, and text extraction. However, their reliability in low-resource, non-Latin settings remains uncertain. Khmer form documents present particular challenges because they contain complex script forms, mixed Khmer-English fields, and monetary values in both Cambodian Riel and US Dollars. Available resources for Khmer Document VQA are also limited. This paper presents a pilot diagnostic evaluation of open MLLMs on Khmer document images. We construct an evaluation subset from the previously introduced KH-FUNSD collection, covering invoices, receipts, quotations, and other business forms. The subset includes questions in English and Khmer, with answers retained in their original English, Khmer, mixed-script, or numeric forms. Rather than introducing a full public benchmark, this study examines the capabilities and failure modes of existing models. We evaluate representative open Qwen-VL models using direct image-based prompting and compare parser-assisted and external OCR-assisted configurations with Qwen3-VL-8B. Direct Qwen3-VL-8B outperforms smaller models, achieving 51.9% overall accuracy, although performance remains limited for Khmer-script and mixed-script answers. External OCR produces the strongest results, reaching 61.9% with Tesseract and 61.6% with PaddleOCR. Nevertheless, Khmer-script answers remain substantially more difficult than English and numeric fields. The results indicate that current MLLMs can process visually clear English and structured numeric content, but reliable native Khmer document understanding remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文对开放多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在高棉语文档理解任务上的能力进行了试点诊断评估。研究基于KH-FUNSD数据集构建了包含发票、收据、报价单等商业表单的评估子集，测试了Qwen-VL系列模型在直接图像提示、解析器辅助和外部OCR辅助三种配置下的表现。结果显示Qwen3-VL-8B直接提示达到51.9%准确率，外部OCR辅助最高可达61.9%，但高棉文字符和混合脚本答案的准确率仍然显著偏低，说明当前MLLMs对母语级高棉语文档理解仍是开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在文档理解方面虽有进展，但其在低资源、非拉丁语场景下的可靠性尚未得到充分验证。高棉语表单文档包含复杂的文字形式、英柬混合字段以及双货币（瑞尔和美元）数值，构成了独特挑战，且高棉语文档VQA资源极其有限。因此需要对现有开放MLLMs在高棉语场景下的能力与失败模式进行系统性诊断评估。
AI.method: 研究从KH-FUNSD数据集中构建评估子集，涵盖发票、收据、报价单等多种商业表单。评估设置包含英语和高棉语两种语言的问题，答案保留原始英语、高棉语、混合脚本或数字形式。实验中比较了三种配置：1）直接基于图像提示的Qwen-VL系列模型；2）解析器辅助配置；3）外部OCR（Tesseract和PaddleOCR）辅助配置，其中OCR辅助采用Qwen3-VL-8B作为基础模型。
AI.result: 直接使用Qwen3-VL-8B达到51.9%的整体准确率，优于更小的模型。外部OCR辅助配置取得最佳效果：Tesseract达到61.9%，PaddleOCR达到61.6%。然而，高棉文字符答案的难度显著高于英语和数字字段，即便在最优配置下，高棉语和混合脚本答案的准确率仍明显受限。
AI.conclusion: 当前开放MLLMs能够较好处理视觉清晰的英语内容和结构化数字信息，但对于可靠的原生高棉语文档理解仍存在明显不足。高棉语母语级文档理解仍是开放挑战，未来需要更多针对低资源语言场景的研究和资源建设。

title: C3-UniMM: Causal Cycle-Consistent Unified Multimodal Modeling via Super Alignment and Shared Decoding Space
summary: Unified Multimodal Models aim to achieve any-to-any understanding and generation across arbitrary modalities. However, existing methods primarily rely on modeling implicit statistical correlations and lack cross-modal structural consistency constraints. This deficiency leads to profound issues, including semantic drift, poor compositional generalization, and instability under interventions. In this paper, we propose C3-UniMM, a unified multimodal modeling framework based on Causal Cycle Consistency and Super Alignment. Specifically, we introduce a Structured Latent Causal Graph (SLCG) as a shared cross-modal semantic space and design unified multimodal encoding blocks, enabling understanding and generation to be synergistically optimized within the identical causal semantic structure. Furthermore, we propose a Unified Decoding Space to enforce structural preservation and semantic invertibility during the cross-modal generation process. Theoretical analyses demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances both the invertibility and mechanism invariance of cross-modal mappings. Extensive experimental results across multiple understanding, generation, and compositional generalization tasks indicate that C3-UniMM substantially outperforms existing unified multimodal baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C3-UniMM，一个基于因果循环一致性和超级对齐的统一多模态模型框架，通过结构化潜因果图(SLCG)作为共享跨模态语义空间，并结合统一解码空间来保证结构保持和语义可逆性，解决现有方法缺乏跨模态结构一致性约束导致的语义漂移和组合泛化差等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型主要依赖隐式统计相关性建模，缺乏跨模态结构一致性约束，导致语义漂移、组合泛化能力差以及干预下的不稳定性等深层次问题。
AI.method: 1) 引入结构化潜因果图(SLCG)作为共享跨模态语义空间；2) 设计统一多模态编码块，使理解和生成在同一因果语义结构中协同优化；3) 提出统一解码空间(UDS)以强制跨模态生成过程中的结构保持和语义可逆性。
AI.result: 理论分析证明该方法显著增强了跨模态映射的可逆性和机制不变性；在多个理解、生成和组合泛化任务上的大量实验表明，C3-UniMM显著优于现有统一多模态基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果循环一致性和超级对齐，C3-UniMM为统一多模态建模提供了结构化的因果约束方案，有效解决了语义漂移和泛化问题。

title: Continuity-Free Near-Minimax Leading-Order Regret for CVaR-UCBVI
summary: For finite-horizon tabular CVaR reinforcement learning, prior work proves a $\widetilde{O}(τ^{-1}\sqrt{SAK})$ leading regret bound for arbitrary normalized return laws and the sharper $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/τ})$ rate under a density lower bound. We show that the same Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI algorithm attains the sharper rate without continuity assumptions. The key is a selected-budget self-bound: the conditional variance of the episode shortfall is at most $τ$ plus the value-estimation width. Substitution into the original Bernstein decomposition yields, with high probability, $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/τ}+(SAHK^{1/4}+S^2AH)/τ)$ regret for arbitrary normalized return laws, including atomic, mixed, and continuous laws. The $τ^{-1/2}$ leading term matches the expected-regret minimax lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Thus Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI is minimax-optimal over the full return-law class in the leading-order regime; the lower-order terms retain their $τ^{-1}$ dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文证明 Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI 算法在无需连续性假设的情况下，对任意归一化回报分布（包括原子、混合和连续分布）都能达到 τ^{-1/2} 的主导遗憾率，与期望遗憾的极小极大下界在领先阶上匹配，从而在该算法类别上实现极小极大最优性。
AI.motivation: 以往关于有限时域表格型 CVaR 强化学习的研究中，任意归一化回报分布只能获得较差的 O(τ^{-1}√(SAK)) 遗憾界，而更好的 √(SAK/τ) 速率需要密度下界假设。本文旨在去除这一连续性假设，证明同一算法在任意分布下仍能达到更优速率。
AI.method: 关键创新在于提出"选定预算自界"（selected-budget self-bound）：情景缺额（shortfall）的条件方差至多为 τ 加上值估计宽度。将该界代入原始的 Bernstein 分解中，即可在高概率下获得最终遗憾界。
