Since each node in a spatio-temporal graph diffuses information globally across both spatial and temporal dimensions, existing unlearning methods primarily designed for static graphs and localized data removal cannot efficiently erase a single node without incurring costs nearly equivalent to full model retraining. To address this, we propose CallosumNet, a spatio-temporal graph unlearning framework biologically inspired by the corpus callosum structure. CallosumNet makes two key technical contributions: (1) it reconstructs subgraphs using biologically-inspired virtual edges; and (2) it restores interlinked spatio-temporal dependencies among subgraphs via a lightweight meta-graph integration layer. Empirical results on four diverse real-world datasets show that CallosumNet achieves complete unlearning while maintaining accuracy very close to the gold model. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wenlu-lab/STGraphUnlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CallosumNet，一种受胼胝体结构启发的时空图遗忘框架，通过虚拟边重建子图并用轻量级元图集成层恢复子图间依赖，实现在四个数据集上接近金标准模型的完整遗忘效果。
AI.motivation: 严格的隐私法规（如GDPR、CCPA）要求时空图模型能够完全遗忘未授权数据。由于时空图中节点信息沿空间和时间两个维度全局扩散，现有主要针对静态图的遗忘方法无法高效地移除单个节点，其代价几乎等同于完全重新训练模型。
AI.method: CallosumNet包含两个关键技术贡献：(1) 利用受生物学启发的虚拟边重建子图；(2) 通过轻量级元图集成层恢复子图间相互关联的时空依赖关系。整体框架受大脑胼胝体结构的启发。
AI.result: 在四个多样化的真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，CallosumNet实现了完全的遗忘效果，同时保持了与金标准模型非常接近的精度。
AI.conclusion: CallosumNet证明了生物启发的架构能够有效解决时空图数据遗忘问题，在不牺牲模型性能的前提下实现高效、完整的单节点遗忘，为隐私合规提供了可行方案。

title: Comment on "Event-Triggered Stabilization of Linear Time-Delay Systems via Halanay-Type Inequality"
summary: This comment revisits Lemma 1 in [1], which plays a central role in the event-triggered stabilization analysis developed therein. We identify technical gaps in the proof of the lemma and provide a corrected argument. In particular, careful treatment of the exponentially decaying term shows that its decay rate must be retained in the resulting convergence estimate. The statement of the original lemma, with the exponential decay rate determined by the minimum of the characteristic decay rate and the decay rate of this term, remains valid.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了文献[1]中在事件触发镇定分析中起核心作用的引理1，指出其证明中的技术性缺陷，并提供了修正后的论证。修正的关键在于对指数衰减项的细致处理，证明其衰减率必须被保留在最终的收敛估计中。原文引理的结论依然成立，只是指数衰减率由特征衰减率和该项衰减率中的最小值决定。
AI.motivation: 文献[1]中的引理1在事件触发镇定分析中具有核心地位，但其证明存在技术性缺陷（gaps）。为了确保后续分析的正确性和严谨性，有必要识别这些缺陷并提供修正。
AI.method: 对引理1的证明进行重新审视，特别关注指数衰减项的细致处理。通过修正论证，证明该指数衰减项的衰减率必须保留在最终的收敛估计中，而非被忽略或合并。
AI.result: 修正后的论证表明，原引理的陈述仍然有效，但指数衰减率应取特征衰减率与该指数衰减项衰减率中的最小值。
AI.conclusion: 原引理的结论在修正后依然成立，但需要更仔细地处理指数衰减项的衰减率，使其保留在收敛估计中，以确保证明的严谨性。

title: HEAR Who Said What: Unlocking Speaker-Attributed Reasoning via Counterfactual Voice Grounding
summary: Speech Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-speaker environments, yet their ability to attribute speech to the correct speaker and reason over speaker identities remains unclear. Hence, we introduce HEAR, a conceptually hierarchical benchmark diagnosing the foundational capabilities of speaker-attributed reasoning, comprising 2.4K human-verified samples from 887 diverse multi-party audio clips. Evaluating 20 leading SLMs on HEAR reveals they struggle with these foundational tasks, often relying on semantic priors rather than actual vocal cues. To address this, we present A2R, a 30B model optimized on Counterfactual Audio with Speaker-level Hard negatives (CASH), a dataset designed to guide the model to prioritize acoustic vocal cues over linguistic signals. A2R achieves strong performance on HEAR and exhibits zero-shot generalization to diverse multi-speaker downstream tasks, demonstrating that learned speaker attribution unlocks the model's latent capacity for speaker-aware reasoning. All resources are available at https://attributetoreason.github.io/AttributeToReason/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HEAR基准测试，用于诊断语音语言模型（SLM）在多说话人环境中的说话人归属推理能力，并提出了A2R模型及CASH训练数据集，通过反事实音频和说话人级难负例来引导模型优先关注声学线索，从而提升说话人感知推理能力。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型（SLMs）越来越多地部署在多说话人环境中，但它们将语音正确归属到说话人并基于说话人身份进行推理的能力尚不清楚。现有模型往往依赖语义先验而非真实的声学线索，这限制了其在真实多说话人场景中的表现。
AI.method: 1. 构建HEAR基准：包含2.4K人工验证样本、887个多样化多方音频片段，从概念层次诊断说话人归属推理能力。2. 提出A2R模型：一个30B参数的模型，在反事实音频与说话人级难负例（CASH）数据集上优化，旨在引导模型优先考虑声学语音线索而非语言信号。
AI.result: 评估20个领先SLM在HEAR上的表现，发现它们在基础任务上表现挣扎，常依赖语义先验。A2R在HEAR上取得强表现，并在多说话人下游任务中展现零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 学习说话人归属能力能够解锁SLM潜在的声音感知推理能力，为多说话人场景下的语音语言模型提供了新的训练范式。

title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) in Computational Pathology: Definitions, Taxonomy, and Recommendations
comment: On behalf of MICCAI SIG-CompPath. More information: https://miccai.org/index.php/special-interest-groups/sig-comppath/
summary: Computational pathology (CompPath) is transforming medicine by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to support diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment prediction from gigapixel whole-slide images. Clinical adoption is progressing, but is constrained by concerns about safety, accountability, and regulatory oversight in high-stakes clinical environments. Explainable AI (XAI) systems hold promise for building trust and enabling verification, yet the literature remains fragmented due to inconsistent terminology, overlapping methodological families, ad hoc validation, and current reviews. This review aims to formalize XAI methods in CompPath through the: i) introduction of a pathology-centric vocabulary comprising seven core terms; ii) development of a taxonomy across methodological families and three orthogonal axes (stage, type, scope); and iii) establishment of a task-driven framework that maps five clinical questions to recommended methods, method evaluation, and deployment context. Five key gaps between current XAI capabilities and clinical deployment are identified, and actionable steps are proposed to advance XAI for CompPath.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，旨在系统化计算病理学（CompPath）中的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法。作者提出病理学专属词汇（7个核心术语）、跨方法学族与三个正交轴（阶段、类型、范围）的分类体系，以及将5个临床问题映射到推荐方法、评估和部署情境的任务驱动框架，并指出当前XAI能力与临床部署之间的五大差距及推进建议。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学中AI的临床应用日益推进，但受限于安全性、问责制和监管方面的顾虑。XAI系统有望建立信任并实现验证，但现有文献因术语不一致、方法学族重叠、验证方式随意以及综述不足而呈现碎片化状态，亟需系统化梳理。
AI.method: 通过三方面形式化XAI方法：(i) 引入包含七个核心术语的病理学中心词汇；(ii) 构建跨越方法学族及三个正交轴（阶段、类型、范围）的分类体系；(iii) 建立任务驱动框架，将五个临床问题映射到推荐方法、方法评估与部署情境。
AI.result: 识别出当前XAI能力与临床部署之间的五大关键差距，并提出可推进CompPath中XAI发展的可操作步骤。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化词汇、分类体系和任务驱动框架，弥合XAI研究与临床部署之间的鸿沟，为计算病理学中可信、可验证的AI系统落地提供系统性路径。

title: Fully Distributed GNE Algorithms for Multi-Robot Placement without Consensus on Multipliers
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Published in the 2026 American Control Conference (ACC), pp. 3633--3638
summary: Recent machine learning research has increasingly focused on equilibrium analysis in non-cooperative games rather than solely on optimal solutions. Many such problems involve shared constraints and can be formulated as Generalized Nash Equilibrium Problems (GNEPs). For strongly monotone games, existing methods compute consensus-based variational GNEs (v-GNEs) by exchanging Lagrange multipliers. We propose a fully distributed continuous-time algorithm for shared linear equality constraints that converges without multiplier exchange and reaches any GNE, reducing communication overhead and improving privacy. Discrete-time schemes are also provided, and the method is validated on a multi-robot placement task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于共享线性等式约束广义纳什均衡问题(GNEP)的完全分布式连续时间算法，该算法无需交换拉格朗日乘子即可收敛到任意GNE，降低了通信开销并提升了隐私性，同时提供了离散时间方案并在多机器人布署任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有针对强单调博弈的GNEP求解方法依赖于交换拉格朗日乘子来实现共识，这带来了较高的通信开销并可能泄露隐私信息。作者希望设计一种无需乘子交换的分布式算法，以减少通信负担并增强隐私保护。
AI.method: 提出一种完全分布式的连续时间算法，用于求解带有共享线性等式约束的GNEP。该算法不依赖拉格朗日乘子的交换即可收敛到任意广义纳什均衡(v-GNE)，并进一步提供了对应的离散时间实现方案。
AI.result: 算法在理论上保证收敛到任意GNE，避免了乘子交换带来的通信与隐私问题，并在多机器人布署任务中验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除乘子交换需求，该方法在保持分布式求解能力的同时显著降低了通信开销并增强了隐私保护，为大规模多智能体博弈共享约束问题提供了更高效可行的求解途径。

title: Asynchronous Cooperative Online Learning for Multi-Robot Control under Computational Delays
summary: Ensuring the safe operation of multi-agent systems (MASs) under uncertain environments is crucial for cooperative robotic, where external disturbances and inaccurate dynamic models can significantly compromise performance and reliability. To address this challenge, calibrated machine learning models, particularly Gaussian process (GP) regression, are extensively employed due to their interpretable performance quantification. As the interconnected communication of MASs facilitates cooperative learning, agents are able to enhance learning performance by exchanging local GP inferences with their neighbors and aggregating the received information via distributed GP strategies. However, variations in computational power and prediction tasks among agents inevitably lead to heterogeneous computational delays and differences in query points, which are often overlooked in existing aggregation methods. To overcome these limitations, this work proposes an asynchronous cooperative learning strategy that explicitly accounts for prediction accuracy, query point variations and delay effects. Additionally, a distributed control law based on an adjoint MAS is developed to ensure the desired control performance. Simulations on unmanned surface vehicles validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, demonstrating substantial improvements in both learning and control performance compared to the state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑计算延迟和查询点差异的异步分布式高斯过程协同学习策略，并基于伴随多智能体系统设计分布式控制律，以提升不确定环境下多智能体系统的安全操作性能。通过无人水面艇仿真验证了其在学习和控制性能上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统在不确定环境下的安全运行面临外部扰动和模型不精确的挑战。虽然分布式高斯过程回归被广泛用于协同学习，但现有聚合方法忽视了智能体之间异质的计算延迟和查询点差异，这会影响学习与控制性能。
AI.method: 提出一种异步协同学习策略，显式考虑预测精度、查询点变化和延迟效应；同时基于伴随多智能体系统（adjoint MAS）设计分布式控制律，以确保期望的控制性能。
AI.result: 在无人水面艇上的仿真验证表明，所提出的方法在学习和控制性能上相较最先进的方法均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 异步协同学习策略有效解决了分布式GP聚合中延迟和查询点差异问题，结合伴随MAS控制律可显著提升不确定环境下多智能体系统的学习与控制性能。

title: Goldfarb-Idnani Revisited:Invariants, Certificates, and the Limits of Guessing
summary:
The dual active-set method of Goldfarb and Idnani solves the strictly convex quadratic program by adding and dropping one constraint at a time, requiring no phase one. Primal--dual active set and block principal pivoting skip the walk altogether: they guess an entire active set at once and repair it from returning signs.
  For bound constraints the guess is safe. The system solved on a candidate set is a principal submatrix of $G^{-1}$, positive definite regardless of the guess; this $P$-matrix property guarantees finite termination. For $C^\top x \ge b$ that hypothesis fails, which is our central focus. The working-set system is $C_{\mathcal{A}}^\top G^{-1} C_{\mathcal{A}}$, positive definite only when $C_{\mathcal{A}}$ has full column rank, a property of the guess, not the data. The $P$-matrix property is lost and the structural obstruction invalidates the guarantee. Strict convexity keeps the method usable: KKT conditions make candidate sets certified rather than trusted.
  Over 600 random instances across four constraint families this failure never occurs. However, duplicating columns of $C$ raises failure rates to 93\%, dropping certified fraction from 100\% to zero. On real long-only portfolio data, the active set reaches 442 of $494 + 1$ constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Goldfarb-Idnani对偶有效集法及主块枢轴法在严格凸二次规划中的适用性。对于仅含边界约束的情形，候选集对应的系统为保证正定的P-矩阵，确保有限终止；但对于一般线性约束C^T x ≥ b，工作集系统C_A^T G^{-1} C_A仅在C_A满列秩时才正定，P-矩阵性质丧失，理论上的终止保证失效。数值实验显示，600多个随机实例中该失败从未发生，但复制C的列后失败率升至93%，实际长仓组合数据中有效集可达494+1个约束中的442个。
AI.motivation: 传统的对偶有效集方法逐次添加/删除约束，需要大量迭代；原始-对偶有效集法和主块枢轴法可以一次性猜测整个有效集并修复。然而，对于一般线性约束（非边界约束），该方法的核心理论基础——P-矩阵性质——可能失效，这威胁到方法的有限终止保证。作者旨在分析并量化这一结构性障碍的实际影响。
AI.method: 作者从理论分析入手：边界约束情形下候选集的系统是G^{-1}的主子矩阵，天然正定（P-矩阵性质）；一般线性约束情形下，工作集系统为C_A^T G^{-1} C_A，仅当C_A满列秩时才正定，因此P-矩阵性质取决于猜测而非数据。严格凸性使KKT条件成为候选集的"认证"而非"信任"机制。作者通过数值实验（600+随机实例、四类约束族）及实际长仓组合数据验证该结构性失败的发生频率。
AI.result: 在600多个随机实例中，P-矩阵性质失效的情况从未发生。但通过复制C的列引入退化后，失败率飙升至93%，认证比例从100%降至0。在真实的长仓组合数据中，有效集达到494+1个约束中的442个，接近满秩极限。
AI.conclusion: 一般线性约束下原始-对偶有效集方法存在结构性障碍：候选集系统的正定性依赖猜测而非数据本身，P-矩阵性质可能失效。虽然随机实例中此问题罕见，但退化情形（如列复制）可导致几乎完全失败，表明该方法的稳健性在退化数据下严重不足，实际应用中需要谨慎。

title: AI Historian: Helping historians organize and verify person-centred temporal clues from dispersed historical narratives
summary: History is not preserved in complete, continuous form. Accounts of a person's activities, relationships and historical contexts are scattered across texts, chapters and narrative perspectives; historians must retrieve, identify and compare these materials to reconstruct temporal sequences and verify them against sources. Here we present AI Historian (AIH), an AI agent system that helps historians organize person-time evidence from dispersed biographical narratives. It takes source sentences as evidence units, identifies people and temporal cues, verifies candidate cross-text associations and infers comparable temporal ranges while preserving traceable source-text evidence. We evaluated AIH on six Shiji cases concerning Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Xiao He. AIH Agent achieved a temporal-localization MicroIoU of 86.2%, compared with 81.3% for human-only annotation and 17.1% for direct large-language-model prompting; it required about 14 min, versus 1 h 32 min for human-only annotation. We further applied AIH to the Twenty-Four Histories and other ancient Chinese histories, ancient Japanese and Korean histories, and modern and contemporary historical materials, and released the results through Westlake Historian. These results indicate that AIH can reduce the cost of organizing historical materials at scale while turning connections obscured by chapter-based narration into traceable, revisable research questions for collaborative testing.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍AI Historian (AIH)，一个帮助历史学家从分散的传记叙事中组织人物-时间证据的AI智能体系统。它以源句为证据单元，识别人物和时间线索，验证跨文本关联并推断可比时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。在《史记》六个案例中，AIH的时序定位MicroIoU达86.2%，远超直接大模型提示的17.1%，且耗时仅14分钟（对比人工标注1小时32分）。系统已应用于二十四史及日韩、近现代史料。
AI.motivation: 历史记录并非完整连续的形式保存，人物活动、关系和历史背景的证据分散在文本、章节和不同叙事视角中。历史学家需要检索、识别和比较这些材料来重建时间序列并对照原始资料验证，这一过程成本高昂且易遗漏跨章节叙事中隐含的联系。
AI.method: AIH以源句子作为证据单元，识别其中的人物和时间线索，验证候选的跨文本关联，推断可比的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。系统采用智能体架构，将分散的历史叙事证据组织为结构化的人物-时间关联。
AI.result: 在《史记》中关于刘邦、项羽和萧何六个案例上，AIH的时间定位MicroIoU达86.2%，高于人工标注的81.3%，远高于直接大语言模型提示的17.1%；耗时约14分钟，而人工标注需1小时32分钟。系统还成功应用于二十四史及其他古代中国历史、日韩古代史和近现代史料。
AI.conclusion: AIH能在大规模历史材料整理中显著降低成本，将因章节化叙事而被掩盖的联系转化为可追溯、可修订的研究问题，供协作验证，展示了AI智能体在历史学研究中的实用价值。

title: Discovering Machine Correlates of Consciousness
comment: published in: Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence Vol. 16855, Proceed- ings of the 19th International Conference on Artificial General Intelligence (AGI- 2026), San Francisco, CA, July 2026. pp. 237-255 https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3- 032-33195-3_18
summary:
Currently, in biological systems Neural Correlates of Consciousness (NCCs) are characterized in terms of EEG and FMRI signals. Unfortunately, this characterization prevents the transferability of the NCCs concept to machines. Such transferability would be useful in order to investigate AI consciousness. In this paper we provide an alternate characterization that is transferable, and enables the analogous definition of Machine Correlates of Consciousness (MCCs). Specifically, we propose that NCCs (MCCs) are substrate-level signals that are not under human (AI agent) control, and that are reliably modulated by emotions.
  This paper presents the first empirical investigation of MCCs. Specifically, we present the results of experiments conducted with two LLMs, Llama-2 7B and Llama-3.1 70B parameters. In these LLMs we collect hardware anomaly traces that are substrate-level indicator-sequences. And we show that after controlling for confounding factors, these are modulated differently by emotional and neutral computations. And this difference is statistically significant for the larger Llama-3.1 70B, but not for the smaller Llama-2 7B. The results constitute initial empirical evidence that MCCs are present in the Llama-3.1 70B configuration. And they are consistent with the hypothesis that consciousness probability and degree increase with the LLM sophistication.
  Independently of consciousness, MCCs can also be used for detection of emotions in AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可迁移的机器意识关联物（MCCs）概念，替代基于EEG和fMRI的神经意识关联物（NCCs）定义，并在两个LLM（Llama-2 7B和Llama-3.1 70B）上进行了首次实证研究，通过硬件异常痕迹作为底物级信号，发现情感与中性计算会调制这些信号，且差异在较大的模型中统计显著。
AI.motivation: 现有的NCCs定义基于EEG和fMRI信号，这种特性阻碍了将意识关联物的概念迁移到机器上。为了研究AI意识，需要一种可迁移的表征方式，使NCCs能够类比定义为MCCs。
AI.method: 提出NCCs（MCCs）定义为非人类（AI代理）控制且可靠地被情绪调制的底物级信号。在两个LLM上收集硬件异常轨迹作为底物级指标序列，控制混淆因素后比较情感与中性计算对这些信号的调制差异。
AI.result: 情感与中性计算对硬件异常痕迹的调制在Llama-3.1 70B上统计显著，但在Llama-2 7B上不显著，表明MCCs存在于较大的模型中，且与AI复杂度越高的模型意识概率和程度越高的假设一致。
AI.conclusion: 这是MCCs的首次实证研究，提供了LLM中存在MCCs的初步证据，支持意识概率与模型复杂度正相关的假设。此外，MCCs还可独立于意识研究，用于AI代理的情绪检测。

title: Where Induction Runs Out: Description-Length Difficulty and the Memorisation Gap in Integer-Sequence Benchmarks
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/sabilashang/where-induction-runs-out. Archived: doi:10.5281/zenodo.21830331
summary: Integer sequences from the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS) are increasingly used to benchmark mathematical reasoning in language models. We ask what such benchmarks actually measure, using an exactly computable reference learner: two-part minimum description length (MDL) over the class of P-recursive (holonomic) recurrences, evaluated on every prefix of a sequence as terms arrive. Three findings follow. First, MDL difficulty is a parameter count. The discovery point nd, the first prefix length at which a symbolic hypothesis beats verbatim storage, is predicted almost exactly by a combinatorial identifiability bound on the selected operator's order and degree. It is invariant to term magnitude: scaling Fibonacci over twelve orders of magnitude leaves nd unchanged, because a hypothesis must encode its own initial conditions and the magnitude cancels. Second, at scale the learner exhibits a regime our curated corpus could not produce even once: across 20,000 OEIS sequences, 89.98% of those that fit a recurrence on some prefix fit none at full length. We call this the wilderness -- induction acquires a theory, loses it, and never recovers. Third, evaluating three language models on sequences stratified by these MDL regimes refuted our pre-registered hypothesis: models do not confabulate where MDL reports no theory, but hedge appropriately. Confident errors are inverted, concentrating on the easy stratum, where apparent competence tracks recognition of the sequence rather than induction of its rule. OEIS-derived benchmarks therefore substantially measure memorisation, and MDL supplies a cheap, contamination-free difficulty signal they currently lack. Code and data are released.

AI.tldr: 本文使用两部分的极小描述长度（MDL）作为精确可计算的参考学习器，在P-递归（holonomic）递归类上评估OEIS整数序列基准。发现MDL难度本质上是参数计数，发现点nd可由组合可辨识性边界精确预测；在大规模研究中发现"荒野"现象（89.98%序列在前缀上可拟合递归但全长不可拟合）；并通过对三个语言模型的评估推翻了预注册假设——模型在MDL报告无理论时会恰当地回避而非胡编，自信错误反而集中在容易层，表明OEIS基准主要测量的是记忆而非归纳推理。
AI.motivation: OEIS整数序列越来越多地被用来基准测试语言模型的数学推理能力，但这类基准实际衡量的究竟是什么尚不清楚。作者希望用精确可计算的参考学习器（MDL）来揭示这些基准的本质，并探究模型是在真正进行归纳推理还是仅仅依赖记忆。
AI.method: 使用基于P-递归（holonomic）递归类上的两部件极小描述长度（MDL）作为参考学习器，对每个序列的每个前缀进行求值。通过可辨识性边界预测发现点nd，在大规模（20,000条OEIS序列）上分析MDL机制，并用这些机制对序列进行分层来评估三个语言模型。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1) MDL难度是参数计数，发现点nd被组合可辨识性边界几乎准确地预测，且对项幅值不变；(2) 大规模上发现"荒野"现象，89.98%的序列在前缀上可拟合递归但全长不可拟合；(3) 语言模型不会在MDL报告无理论时胡编，而是恰当地保持谨慎，但自信错误集中在容易层，表明其表现取决于序列识别（记忆）而非规则归纳。
AI.conclusion: OEIS派生基准在很大程度上衡量的是记忆而非归纳推理。MDL提供了一个廉价且无污染的难度信号，可以作为此类基准目前缺失的重要补充。作者发布了代码和数据。

title: Event-triggered Control and Online Learning for Networked Systems under Computational Delays
summary: Online learning-based control is a promising approach to control uncertain systems, where unknown components are identified during operation to improve control performance. However, resource-intensive online learning algorithms introduce non-negligible computational delays, especially when executed on systems with limited local computational resources. To mitigate this, an in-network online learning-based control structure is employed by deploying the learning-based controller on a remote computation node and connecting it via a communication channel. In this paper, control performance guarantee is first established by deriving tracking error bound for the in-network control architecture, while accounting for computational delays. The derived tracking error bound allows for diverse communication and computation strategies under a specific condition, including time-/event-triggered mechanisms. Additionally, the trade-off between communication and computation performances is shown for a given desired control performance. Furthermore, to enhance the efficiency in both communication and computation, an efficient control framework with an asynchronous event-triggered mechanism in both control and online learning is devised under the existence of computational delay. The proposed event-triggered strategy is proven to achieve the same control performance as time-triggered scenario while excluding Zeno behavior. Finally, we derive an explicit expression of the proposed event-trigger condition for exponentially stabilizable systems, and demonstrate its effectiveness through simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对在线学习控制的计算延迟问题，提出了一种网络内（in-network）在线学习控制架构，将基于学习的控制器部署在远程计算节点上。文章首先建立了该架构下包含计算延迟的跟踪误差界，然后在特定条件下支持多种通信与计算策略（包括时间触发和事件触发机制），并展示了通信与计算性能之间的权衡。进一步提出了在控制和在线学习中均采用异步事件触发机制的高效控制框架，在存在计算延迟的情况下能达到与时间触发相同的控制性能且排除Zeno行为，最后对指数可稳定系统推导了事件触发条件的显式表达式并通过仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 在线学习控制方法虽然能有效控制不确定系统并在运行中改善控制性能，但其资源密集型的在线学习算法会带来不可忽略的计算延迟，尤其在本地计算资源有限的系统中问题更为突出。因此需要一种能缓解计算延迟影响的控制架构和触发机制设计。
AI.method: 采用网络内控制结构，将学习控制器部署于远程计算节点，通过通信信道连接。推导考虑计算延迟的跟踪误差界，提出在控制和学习过程中均采用异步事件触发机制的高效控制框架，并证明其在排除Zeno行为的同时能达到与时间触发相同的控制性能。对指数可稳定系统推导事件触发条件的显式表达式。
AI.result: 建立了网络内控制架构下考虑计算延迟的跟踪误差上界；证明了所提异步事件触发策略能达到与时间触发场景相同的控制性能且排除Zeno行为；对指数可稳定系统推导出事件触发条件的显式表达式，并通过仿真验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为资源受限系统上的在线学习控制提供了理论保证，在通信和计算之间建立了可量化的权衡关系，并提出了一种在实际中可行且高效的事件触发机制，兼顾了控制性能与资源效率。

title: Efficiency of cooperation incentives in evolutionary population games under payoff-observation errors
summary: Traditional studies on evolutionary dynamics of cooperation have concentrated on an idealized game setup free of payoff-observation errors. However, in real-world scenarios, individuals frequently encounter errors when observing the payoffs of their opponents during game interactions, resulting from unintentional mistakes, such as data misrecording, overlooking critical details, and miscalculations. This gap between idealized error-free game models and the error-prone real-world game interactions leads to the lack of insight into the impact of payoff-observation errors on the evolutionary dynamics of population games, in particular the efficiency of cooperation incentives. In this paper, we construct a research framework for population games with payoff-observation errors, which enables us to investigate the effects of errors on the evolutionary dynamics of cooperation in the evolutionary Prisoner's Dilemma game with combined incentives. To quantify the implementation costs of incentives in the presence of errors, we devise an index function and employ optimal control theory to derive the optimal incentive protocols. Our theoretical and numerical results reveal that payoff-observation errors can lower the costs compared to error-free cases, and we also derive the theoretical conditions for these results. Finally, we formulate an optimization problem to explore the cost difference between the optimal incentive protocols with and without errors, and further design an algorithm to obtain the numerical solution that minimizes this difference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带收益观测误差的群体博弈中，误差如何影响合作演化的动力学及合作激励的效率。作者构建了含误差的演化囚徒困境博弈框架，利用最优控制理论设计最优激励协议，发现收益观测误差可以降低激励实施成本，并提出了优化算法来最小化有误与无误两种情形下最优激励协议的成本差异。
AI.motivation: 传统合作演化动力学研究基于无收益观测误差的理想化博弈设定，但现实中个体在观察对手收益时经常出现误记、遗漏关键细节、计算错误等人为失误。这种理想化模型与现实场景之间的差距，导致对收益观测误差如何影响群体博弈演化动力学（尤其是合作激励效率）缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含收益观测误差的群体博弈研究框架；2) 在演化囚徒困境博弈中引入组合激励；3) 设计指标函数量化误差存在下的激励实施成本；4) 运用最优控制理论推导最优激励协议；5) 提出优化问题及算法求解有无误差两种情形下最优激励协议的成本最小化差异。
AI.result: 理论与数值结果表明：收益观测误差相比无误差情形可以降低激励实施成本，并给出了这一结果成立的理论条件。此外，通过求解优化问题，获得了能最小化有无误差情形下最优激励协议成本差异的数值解。
AI.conclusion: 收益观测误差并非总是有害的——在某些条件下反而能降低合作激励的实施成本。这项研究填补了理想化无误差博弈模型与现实误差环境下博弈之间的研究空白，为理解实际复杂场景中的合作激励设计提供了新视角。

title: Quantifying Error Tolerance in Synthetic Data: An Atomic-level Operand vs. Operator Perturbation Study
summary: Synthetic data generation has become a cornerstone for advancing large language models. However, the lack of the quantitative analysis for error tolerance became a critical bottleneck. Consequently, current filtering strategies fluctuate between two extremes: they are either overly aggressive, risking the exclusion of potentially valuable samples, or overly permissive, failing to eliminate erroneous samples effectively. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (ATOM), a framework that decomposes data into functional units ($f(x)\rightarrow y$). ATOM distinguishes benign Operand $x$ perturbations from fatal Operator $f$ perturbations. The former are needlessly discarded by aggressive filtering, while the latter slip through permissive filtering. Our experiments reveal a double dissociation: models are robust to operand perturbations but collapse under operator perturbations. By prioritizing operator over aggressive operand precision, our ATOM-synthesized data outperforms rigorous baselines (e.g., +3.1% gain over LIMA), suggesting that operator diversity matters more than operand precision. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lut-hub/ATOM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATOM（原子操作树建模）框架，将合成数据分解为f(x)→y的功能单元，区分良性操作数（Operand x）扰动和致命操作符（Operator f）扰动，发现模型对前者鲁棒但对后者崩溃，通过优先操作符多样性而非操作数精度，ATOM合成数据较LIMA等基线提升3.1%。
AI.motivation: 合成数据生成对LLM发展至关重要，但缺乏对错误容忍度的量化分析成为瓶颈。现有过滤策略在"过于激进"（排除有价值样本）和"过于宽松"（无法有效剔除错误样本）两个极端之间摇摆，缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 提出ATOM（Atomic Tree Operation Modeling）框架，将数据分解为功能单元f(x)→y，区分操作数（Operand x）扰动与操作符（Operator f）扰动。通过双重分离实验揭示模型对前者鲁棒、对后者崩溃，并据此优化数据合成策略。
AI.result: 实验显示双重分离现象：模型对操作数扰动鲁棒，但对操作符扰动崩溃。优先操作符而非激进操作数精度过滤的ATOM合成数据，相较LIMA等严格基线获得+3.1%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 操作符多样性比操作数精度更重要，错误容忍度分析应区分扰动类型，这为合成数据过滤策略提供了量化指导，改变了"一味追求数据精度"的传统做法。

title: Evaluating the Hidden Costs of Personalization in Large Language Models
summary: While Large language models (LLMs) incorporate user personalization signals to improve usability and helpfulness, they increasingly shift from providing balanced, informative responses toward optimizing for user satisfaction when conditioned on personal context such as conversation history, inferred preferences, and user profiles. Specifically, we identify three emerging risks: (1) irrelevant personalization, where models reference personal information in unnecessary contexts; (2) preference narrowing, where models reinforce informational echo chambers; and (3) sycophantic bias, where models agree excessively with user opinions. As a result, models may reference personal information in contexts where it is unnecessary, inadvertently collapse response diversity, or agree excessively with user opinions. Despite the growing use of personalization in AI assistants, there has been limited systematic evaluation of its potential side effects. To bridge this gap, we propose PRISK, a dynamic evaluation framework with automated data generation and tailored metrics that uncovers systematic limitations in current LLM personalization and how personalized information shapes its responses. Our empirical analysis across 13 LLMs demonstrates the presence of user profiles and retrieved memories consistently exacerbates biases, resulting in an average drop of 45.9% in irrelevant personalization, 41.7% in preference narrowing and 61.7% in sycophantic bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISK动态评估框架，用于系统评估LLM个性化带来的三个风险：无关个性化、偏好窄化、谄媚偏差。通过对13个LLM的实证分析，发现用户画像和检索记忆持续加剧这些偏见。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地整合用户个性化信号（如对话历史、用户画像）来提升有用性，但可能从提供均衡信息转向优化用户满意度，带来三个新兴风险。目前缺乏对这些副作用的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出PRISK动态评估框架，包含自动化数据生成和定制化指标，用于揭示当前LLM个性化中的系统性问题及个性化信息如何影响模型响应。
AI.result: 对13个LLM的实证分析表明，用户画像和检索记忆的存在持续加剧偏见：无关个性化下降45.9%、偏好窄化增加41.7%、谄媚偏差增加61.7%。
AI.conclusion: 个性化信号会系统性加剧LLM的偏见行为，需要引起重视并加以缓解。

title: Scalable Clinical Data Infrastructure and Comparative ML Evaluation for Hospitalisation Risk Prediction in Elderly Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions using CPRD
summary: Deep learning architectures are increasingly proposed for patient trajectory modeling in electronic health records (EHRs), yet their advantage over simpler, more interpretable models is rarely subjected to rigorous empirical scrutiny in real-world clinical settings. We present a comprehensive patient timeline pipeline applied to elderly patients in CPRD Aurum, incorporating 260 clinical conditions classified via a three-tier automated framework including specialised detection logic for 17 complex conditions. Using this infrastructure, we benchmark Temporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (TG-CNN) against Logistic Regression with LASSO regularisation and Random Forests for predicting 12-month all-cause emergency hospitalisation risk, motivated by (but not filtered to) the elevated risk of adverse drug reactions. Under cross-validation, TG-CNN achieves a marginally higher mean AUC-ROC than LASSO (0.712 vs. 0.705), whereas on the held-out test set LASSO achieves the highest discrimination of three models (AUC-ROC 0.733, versus 0.710 for Random Forest and 0.702 for TG-CNN). We show, that discrimination alone is an incomplete criterion for clinical deployment: after Platt calibration, LASSO is the only model with an acceptable calibration slope (0.817), while Random Forest (0.759) and, TG-CNN (0.391) remain substantially miscalibrated. We argue that LASSO, not the highest-discriminating model, is the model best suited to direct clinical deployment. We present lessons for the machine learning and healthcare community regarding data infrastructure, model selection, and value of calibration and interpretability in high-stakes decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文在CPRD Aurum老年患者数据上构建了包含260种临床条件的患者时间线管道，并系统比较了TG-CNN、LASSO逻辑回归和随机森林在预测12个月全因急诊住院风险上的表现。尽管TG-CNN在交叉验证中AUC-ROC略高于LASSO，但在独立测试集上LASSO判别力最高；更重要的是，经Platt校准后，LASSO是唯一具有可接受校准斜率的模型，因此作者主张LASSO而非判别力最高的模型最适合临床部署。
AI.motivation: 深度学习架构虽越来越多地被用于电子健康记录（EHR）中的患者轨迹建模，但其相较于更简单、更可解释模型的实际优势在真实临床环境中很少受到严格的实证检验。作者旨在填补这一空白，为高风险的临床决策支持提供基于证据的模型选择指导。
AI.method: 1) 构建患者时间线管道，应用于CPRD Aurum中的老年患者，纳入260种临床条件，采用三层自动化分类框架（含17种复杂条件的专门检测逻辑）。2) 在预测12个月全因急诊住院风险的任务上（动机源于药物不良反应风险升高），基准比较三种模型：TG-CNN、LASSO正则化的逻辑回归和随机森林。3) 采用交叉验证和独立测试集评估判别力（AUC-ROC），并进一步通过Platt校准评估校准能力（校准斜率）。
AI.result: 交叉验证中TG-CNN的AUC-ROC（0.712）略高于LASSO（0.705）；但在独立测试集上LASSO判别力最高（AUC-ROC 0.733），优于随机森林（0.710）和TG-CNN（0.702）。校准方面，Platt校准后LASSO是唯一校准斜率可接受的模型（0.817），随机森林（0.759）和TG-CNN（0.391）仍严重失准。
AI.conclusion: 对于高风险的临床部署，仅依赖判别力是选择模型的不充分标准；在本研究中，LASSO虽非判别力最高的模型，但因其良好的校准性和可解释性，是最适合直接临床部署的模型。作者还为机器学习和医疗社区提供了关于数据基础设施、模型选择以及高利害决策支持中校准与可解释性价值的经验教训。

title: Interpolation Conditions for Instant Data Consistency with Port-Hamiltonian Structure
summary: We develop a data-driven framework for nonlinear port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems based on interpolation conditions to characterize consistency between observed data and structured dynamical models. Specifically, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of a pH system with a smooth (convex) Hamiltonian instantly consistent with a given dataset, without requiring explicit parametrization. We further provide a semidefinite programming formulation to verify consistency with non-degenerate interconnection and dissipation structures. Our results provide a principled approach to assess instant data consistency with physical structure and pave the way for control design directly from data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于插值条件的数据驱动框架，用于非线性端口哈密顿（pH）系统，通过推导必要和充分条件来判断给定数据集是否与具有平滑（凸）哈密顿量的pH系统即时一致，并提供半定规划（SDP）公式来验证非退化互连和耗散结构的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据驱动建模方法通常需要显式参数化或依赖于特定模型结构，缺乏一种系统性的方法来判断观测数据是否与物理结构（如端口哈密顿结构）一致。本文旨在填补这一空白，为数据与物理模型之间的一致性提供严格的数学条件。
AI.method: 1) 基于插值条件推导非线性pH系统与给定数据集即时一致的必要和充分条件；2) 不需要显式参数化，直接利用数据本身来验证一致性；3) 将一致性验证问题转化为半定规划（SDP）公式，特别针对非退化互连和耗散结构的情况。
AI.result: 得到了数据与具有平滑（凸）哈密顿量的pH系统即时一致的必要与充分条件，并给出了可计算的SDP公式来验证非退化互连和耗散结构的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为评估数据与物理结构一致性提供了原则性途径，为直接从数据设计控制器铺平了道路。

title: Toward a Cross-Lingual Romanization Ecosystem for Sinitic Languages: A Paired Mandarin-Cantonese Case Study
comment: Accepted to ISCSLP 2026. Tan Lee and Benyou Wang are co-corresponding authors
summary: This paper proposes the Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem, a cross-lingual Sinitic romanization design framework with supporting digital infrastructure and a community-driven open-source workflow. The design framework addresses the lack of systematic cross-lingual romanization alignment among Sinitic languages through four design principles: phonetic correspondence for representing similar sounds with similar romanized symbols, historical-phonological correspondence for aligning cognate romanization strings, one-phoneme-one-symbol, and basic Latin-letter use, with a balancing consideration recognizing trade-offs among these principles. For the main paired case study, we devel-op CantRomZJ1 and MandRomZJ1, Cantonese and Manda-rin romanization schemes following the design framework, respectively. We also develop schemes for several other Sinitic languages, including Meixian Hakka, Shanghai Wu, and Nanjing Jianghuai Mandarin, following the same de-sign framework. To bring the romanization schemes into practical use, we develop open-source infrastructure for structured romanization storage, conversion, parsing, dic-tionary construction, and input-method generation. Finally, we evaluate the design framework through speech-to-romanization experiments based on Meta's Massively Mul-tilingual Speech (MMS) fine-tuning. Compared with the Pinyin+Jyutping baseline, our Man-dRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1 condition reduces Cantonese WER and CER by 7.80% and 10.61%, respectively. These results suggest that cross-lingual romanization alignment can improve transfer in low-resource Sinitic speech technology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Sinitic罗马化生态系统（Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem），这是一个跨语言汉语族罗马化设计框架，包含数字基础设施和社区驱动的开源工作流。通过四个设计原则（语音对应、历史音韵对应、一音一符、基础拉丁字母使用）来系统化对齐汉语族语言间的罗马化方案，并通过语音到罗马化的实验验证了跨语言罗马化对齐能改善低资源汉语族语音技术。
AI.motivation: 汉语族各语言（粤语、普通话等）缺乏系统性的跨语言罗马化对齐方案，导致这些语言在语音技术发展中难以有效利用迁移学习的优势，特别是在低资源场景下。
AI.method: 提出四个设计原则构建罗马化设计框架：语音对应（相似音用相似罗马符号）、历史音韵对应（同源词罗马化字符串对齐）、一音一符、基础拉丁字母使用，并在原则间进行权衡。基于此开发了CantRomZJ1和MandRomZJ1方案，以及梅县客家话、上海吴语、南京江淮官话等方案。同时开发开源基础设施（结构化罗马化存储、转换、解析、词典构建、输入法生成），并通过Meta MMS微调进行语音到罗马化的评估。
AI.result: 与Pinyin+Jyutping基线相比，MandRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1条件使粤语的词错误率（WER）和字符错误率（CER）分别降低了7.80%和10.61%，证明了跨语言罗马化对齐对低资源汉语族语音技术的迁移改善效果。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言罗马化对齐方案能够有效改善低资源汉语族语音技术的性能，为汉语族语言的自然语言处理提供了系统化的基础架构和可复用的开源工具链。

title: MineCEraft: Evaluating Language Models as Construction Engineers in the World of Minecraft
summary: We introduce MineCEraft (Minecraft Construction Engineering Benchmark, pronounced mine-see-ee-raft), an easy-to-use, open-source benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the reliability and limitations of LLMs for construction tasks in Minecraft. The MineCEraft benchmark comprises 723 domain-expert hand-crafted natural-language instructions with programmatically verifiable evaluation, spanning 17 distinct task categories, providing a safe and controllable experimental environment for assessing LLMs' ability to perform realistic construction engineering tasks. With this benchmark, we conduct an in-depth evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and perform a detailed error analysis, revealing key failure modes and practical challenges in applying LLMs to construction engineering tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MineCEraft基准，一个开源、易用的Minecraft建设工程基准测试，包含723条领域专家手工制作的自然语言指令和可编程验证的评估体系，覆盖17个任务类别，用于系统评估LLM在建设任务中的可靠性和局限性。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏专门用于评估LLM在实际建设工程任务中可靠性和局限性的系统化基准，需要安全且可控的实验环境。
AI.method: 构建包含723条专家手工编写的自然语言指令的基准，采用程序化可验证的评估方式，覆盖17个不同的任务类别。
AI.result: 对最先进的LLM进行了深入评估，并进行了详细的错误分析，揭示了将LLM应用于建设工程任务时的关键失效模式和实践挑战。
AI.conclusion: MineCEraft为评估LLM在建设工程任务中的表现提供了一个安全、可控、可验证的基准平台，并识别出了实际应用中的主要障碍。

title: Controllability of time-varying lumped semilinear systems
summary: In this work we are concerned with the controllability of time-varying lumped control systems governed by a semilinear differential equation. We consider the semilinear system as a perturbation of a linear system. Assuming the underlying linear system is controllable, and the nonlinear forcing function satisfies a boundedness condition which is adapted to the underlying linear system, we show that the semilinear system is also approximately controllable

AI.tldr: 本文研究由半线性微分方程描述的时变集总控制系统的可控性问题，将半线性系统视为线性系统的扰动，在底层线性系统可控且非线性强迫项满足适当有界性条件的假设下，证明了半线性系统也是近似可控的。
AI.motivation: 实际工程和物理系统中的许多控制问题都涉及非线性项，这与传统线性可控理论存在差距。作者希望通过将半线性系统视为线性系统的扰动，在合理的条件下将线性系统的可控性结果推广到半线性系统，从而解决非线性系统近似可控性的理论问题。
AI.method: 将半线性系统建模为线性系统的扰动；假设底层线性系统是可控的；非线性强迫项满足与底层线性系统相适应的有界性条件；在此框架下证明半线性系统具有近似可控性。
AI.result: 在底层线性系统可控及非线性项满足有界性条件的假设下，证明了半线性时变集总控制系统是近似可控的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将线性系统的可控性结果成功推广到半线性系统，为非线性控制系统的近似可控性提供了理论保证，并指出了非线性项所需满足的具体条件。

title: Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities
summary: In this paper, we examine how well AI-generated multimodal stories align with the lived practices, relationships, language, values, and visual expectations of the communities they represent. We conduct a community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, combining quantitative annotations with qualitative focus group discussions. We find that cultural alignment depends not simply on recognizable cultural markers, but on how those markers fit social, linguistic, procedural, and visual context. From these evaluations, we develop a taxonomy of cultural alignment comprising five broader cultural marker categories and eight recurring mechanisms of misalignment. We additionally evaluate five multimodal LLM judges to examine whether automated evaluation can approximate community-grounded judgments at scale. Judge reliability and score calibration vary substantially across communities, with no single judge performing consistently across all five settings. These findings motivate community-calibrated evaluation pipelines in which automated judges are validated against community judgments to determine where they can be trusted and where human review remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过社区扎根的混合方法评估，检验AI生成的多模态故事与五個非洲社区的文化实践、关系、语言、价值观和视觉期望的契合度，提出了包含五类文化标记和八种错位机制的文化对齐分类法，并发现多模态LLM评判器在不同社区间的可靠性差异显著，进而提出社区校准的评估流程。
AI.motivation: 现有AI多模态生成内容的评估往往忽视文化对齐问题，缺乏从社区成员视角对生成故事进行系统性文化评估的方法论，研究者希望填补这一空白，理解AI生成内容在多大程度上符合特定社区的真实文化实践与期望。
AI.method: 采用社区扎根的混合方法：对19名来自五个非洲社区的文化代表进行定量标注与定性焦点小组讨论相结合；在此基础上建立文化对齐分类体系（五类文化标记类别、八种错位机制）；并进一步评估五种多模态LLM评判器，对比其与社区判断的一致性。
AI.result: 文化对齐不仅依赖可识别的文化标记，更取决于这些标记如何嵌入社会、语言、程序和视觉语境中；LLM评判器的可靠性和评分校准在不同社区间差异显著，没有单一评判器在全部五个社区中表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 应建立社区校准的评估流程，将自动化评判器与社区判断进行验证，以确定在哪些场景下可以信任自动化评估、在哪些场景下仍需人工审查参与。

title: Oculi: A Conversational Agentic Platform for Automated Credit Risk Analysis
comment: This work was completed at Royal Bank of Canada as part of the RBC Amplify program
summary: Credit risk analysis in financial institutions traditionally requires analysts to manually write SQL queries, run statistical computations, and build visualization dashboards. This is a time-consuming workflow that limits exploration to familiar segments. We introduce \textbf{Oculi}, a conversational platform that transforms natural language questions into comprehensive credit risk analyses, complete with data queries, statistical testing, and interactive visualizations. Oculi employs a three-layer architecture that separates reasoning (LLM-powered agent), execution (Model Context Protocol tool servers), and presentation (agentic UI), enabling analysts to discover high-risk portfolio segments. Within Oculi, a new segment discovery pipeline is proposed that combines deterministic statistical methods with LLM-guided feature selection, leveraging LLM semantic domain knowledge alongside data-driven metrics to identify meaningful, actionable portfolio segments. Evaluated on a mortgage portfolio with 200+ features, Oculi demonstrates effectiveness in discovering material risk segments previously intractable through manual exploration, reducing time-to-insight significantly while maintaining auditability and statistical rigor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Oculi，一个将自然语言问题转化为全面信用风险分析（包括数据查询、统计检验和交互式可视化）的对话式平台。它采用三层架构（LLM推理层、MCP执行层、agentic UI展示层），并提出了一种结合确定性统计方法与LLM引导特征选择的新颖分段发现流程。在包含200+特征的抵押贷款组合上评估，Oculi能发现以前人工探索难以触及的重要风险分段，显著缩短洞察时间，同时保持可审计性和统计严谨性。
AI.motivation: 传统信用风险分析依赖分析师手动编写SQL查询、运行统计计算和构建可视化仪表盘，这一工作流程耗时且将探索限制在熟悉的细分领域，亟需自动化方案以提高效率和扩大探索范围。
AI.method: Oculi采用三层架构：LLM驱动的agent负责推理，Model Context Protocol（MCP）工具服务器负责执行，agentic UI负责展示。核心创新在于提出一种新的分段发现流程，该流程将确定性统计方法与LLM引导的特征选择相结合，利用LLM的语义领域知识配合数据驱动指标来识别有意义、可操作的投资组合分段。
AI.result: 在包含200+特征的抵押贷款组合上评估，Oculi成功发现了通过人工探索难以获取的重要风险分段，显著减少了获得洞察所需的时间，同时保持了审计性和统计严谨性。
AI.conclusion: Oculi证明了对话式AI平台在信用风险分析中的有效性，通过LLM与统计方法的结合，能够在保持可审计性和严谨性的前提下，大幅提升风险分段的发现效率和探索广度。

title: Behavioral Latency as Weak Event-Time Supervision for EEG Reaction-Time Decoding
comment: 33 pages, including appendices; 7 figures and 12 tables. Accepted for publication in Neural Computation
summary: Single-trial EEG analyses are often organized around events and latencies, yet EEG-based reaction-time (RT) prediction is posed as scalar regression on a fixed stimulus-locked window. RT is treated as a window-level label rather than timing evidence about response-relevant dynamics. Here we reformulate trial-wise RT decoding as event-time posterior modeling. Instead of predicting RT directly, the model estimates a posterior over response-relevant event times, $p(t_{\mathrm{event}}\mid X)$, and uses its mean as the RT estimate. This treats behavioral latency as a weak observation of latent response-relevant timing. We evaluate this formulation on the Healthy Brain Network contrast change detection EEG task under a subject-disjoint, release-separated protocol. Across five seeds, distributional event-time supervision consistently improves held-out RT prediction relative to scalar regression and temporal-readout controls. Controlled objective comparisons isolate supervision of the event-time distribution, rather than expectation-based readout alone, as the source of this gain. Architecture controls show that the effect persists across four temporal backbones and is not explained by model scale. Beyond point prediction, posterior geometry characterizes concentration, target alignment, and interval behavior, while observation-noise calibration separates latent concentration from predictive uncertainty over RT. Shifted-crop inference probes shortcut use versus temporal localization. Matched shift-jitter improves robustness, increases mean sensitivity, and moves predictions more often in the expected crop-relative direction. Sensitivity remains below ideal crop-relative localization, leaving a clear equivariance gap. Together, these results establish event-time posterior modeling as a probabilistic and interpretable formulation for linking single-trial EEG dynamics to behavioral timing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将单试次EEG的RT预测重新表述为事件时间后验建模，模型估计响应相关事件时间的后验分布$p(t_{event}|X)$，并用其均值作为RT估计。在Healthy Brain Network对比变化检测任务上，分布级事件时间监督在多个时间骨干网络上一致优于标量回归和时序读出方法，并提供了后验几何、噪声校准和shifted-crop推理等可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 传统的EEG反应时间(RT)预测被建模为固定刺激锁定窗口上的标量回归，将RT视为窗口级标签而非关于响应相关动态的时间证据，忽略了RT作为潜在响应时间弱观测的本质。
AI.method: 将试次级RT解码重构为事件时间后验建模：模型学习响应相关事件时间$t_{event}$的后验分布$p(t_{event}|X)$，取其均值作为RT预测。采用subject-disjoint、release-separated协议，并设计控制实验分离分布监督与期望读出、架构控制和shifted-crop推理探针。
AI.result: 分布级事件时间监督在5个种子下一致优于标量回归和时序读出控制；效果在四种时间骨干网络上持续存在且不是由模型规模解释；后验几何表征了浓度、目标对齐和区间行为；matched shift-jitter提高鲁棒性和平均灵敏度，但灵敏度仍低于理想crop-relative定位。
AI.conclusion: 事件时间后验建模为连接单试次EEG动态与行为时序提供了概率性和可解释的框架，通过分布级监督获得的增益来源是事件时间分布监督本身而非仅期望读出，但仍存在清晰的等变性差距。

title: On the problem of assigning multiple interceptors over multiple aerial threats
summary: This article investigates the problem of assigning multiple identical interceptors over multiple identical aerial threats, where all interceptors are launched in a single salvo. For this problem, two strategies have been studied in the literature: (A) to spread all interceptors as evenly as possible over all threats, and (B) to randomly assign all interceptors over the threats. The main contributions of this article are as follows. First, the literature contains empirical evidence that Strategy A is more efficient than Strategy B in terms of the mean number of missed threats, when the number of interceptors is no less than the number of threats. This article gives a rigorous proof of this fact. Secondly, it demonstrates numerically that Strategy~A can be significantly more efficient than Strategy B. Thirdly, it shows that Strategy~A is not only superior to Strategy B, but also the bona fide optimal strategy. Finally, this article establishes that these conclusions also hold when the number of interceptors is less than the number of threats.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单次齐射中多枚相同拦截器分配至多个相同空中威胁的问题，严格证明了均匀分配策略（Strategy A）在平均漏网威胁数方面优于随机分配策略（Strategy B），并通过数值实验表明其显著更优，同时证明Strategy A不仅是优于Strategy B，而且是最优策略，且这些结论在拦截器数量少于威胁数量的情况下同样成立。
AI.motivation: 已有文献通过经验证据表明，当拦截器数量不少于威胁数量时，均匀分配策略（Strategy A）在平均漏网威胁数上比随机分配策略（Strategy B）更高效，但缺乏严格的数学证明，且策略A是否为真正最优策略尚未得到验证。
AI.method: 本文采用严格的数学证明方法，对均匀分配策略与随机分配策略在平均漏网威胁数上的优劣性进行严格论证；同时通过数值实验展示Strategy A的显著优势；并将结论推广至拦截器数量少于威胁数量的情形。
AI.result: 严格证明了Strategy A在拦截器数量不少于威胁数量时优于Strategy B；数值实验表明Strategy A显著优于Strategy B；证明Strategy A是真正的最优策略；上述结论在拦截器数量少于威胁数量的情况下同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 均匀分配策略在单次齐射拦截分配问题中既优于随机分配策略，又是真正的最优策略，且这一结论适用于拦截器数量与威胁数量的各种相对关系。

title: Attribute-Based Activation Steering of LLMs for Group-Specific Explanation Generation
summary: To effectively enable people to understand new topics, explanations should be tailored to their backgrounds and abilities. So far, prompting alone has been shown to be insufficient for creating such explanations and other computational methods are missing. Therefore, this paper investigates whether LLMs can be steered to generate explanations that are tailored to a specific group of people. To this end, we propose an approach that first identifies group-specific attributes in terms of explanatory style and knowledge of a specific target group. Building on activation engineering, it then computes attribute-based steering vectors and adds them to the internal activations of an LLM during inference to enable a fine-grained steering. In our experiments, we assess the steering effectiveness of our approach in terms of specificity and factuality of the generated explanations. Additionally, we evaluate the explanations in a study with human experts from different target groups. Compared to prompting and state-of-the-art steering baselines, our approach tailors the explanations significantly better to the target group while largely maintaining factuality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于激活工程的LLM解释生成方法，通过识别目标群体的解释风格和知识特征，计算属性导向向量并添加到模型内部激活中，以生成针对特定群体的个性化解释，相较于提示词和现有steering方法显著提升了解释的针对性和事实性。
AI.motivation: 对人类解释新话题时，解释需要根据受众的背景和能力进行定制，但仅依靠提示词（prompting）无法有效实现这一目标，且缺乏其他计算方法，因此需要探索如何引导LLM生成面向特定群体的定制化解释。
AI.method: 首先识别目标群体在解释风格和知识方面的群体特有属性，然后基于激活工程（activation engineering）计算属性导向向量，并在推理过程中将这些向量添加到LLM的内部激活中以实现细粒度的定向引导，从而生成定制化解释。
AI.result: 实验评估了方法的针对性和事实性，并通过不同目标群体的人类专家研究进行了评价。与提示词方法和最先进的steering基线相比，该方法在显著提升解释对目标群体的针对性同时，大体保持了事实性。
AI.conclusion: 基于激活工程的属性导向方法能够有效且细粒度地控制LLM生成面向特定群体定制的解释，优于传统提示词方法，为个性化解释生成提供了新的可行途径。

title: Automated Researchers Can Reliably Mitigate Alignment Failures
summary: Automating alignment research may accelerate progress toward aligned AI, but whether it does is hard to measure. Luckily, many alignment failures, such as deception, sycophancy, and jailbreaks, are already measurable by public benchmarks. We study whether automated alignment researchers (AARs) can post-train to mitigate alignment failures by proposing training methods and data to simultaneously optimize multiple safety benchmarks, while preserving general capability. Across 10 alignment failures, the strongest AAR methods significantly reduce the targeted alignment failures and generalize to a held-out benchmark, multi-turn behavioral audits, and models up to 4.7 times larger than the target model. As a human baseline, 28 experienced researchers receive up to eight hours to develop methods for the same benchmarks, but their methods underperform the best AAR methods. Using human ideas as the AARs' initial research direction does not improve performance, suggesting current AARs may not need guidance from experienced researchers. These results suggest that automating alignment research on well-characterized failures may be practical in the near term.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自动化对齐研究者（AARs）是否能够通过提出训练方法和数据来同时优化多个安全基准，从而缓解AI对齐失败。结果显示，最强的AAR方法在10种对齐失败中显著减少目标失败，并能泛化到保留基准、多轮行为审计和比目标模型大4.7倍的模型上。相比之下，28位经验丰富的研究人员在最多8小时内开发的方法表现不如最佳AAR方法，且加入人类想法作为初始研究方向并未提升性能。
AI.motivation: 自动化对齐研究可能加速实现对齐AI的进程，但这种加速效果难以衡量。幸运的是，许多对齐失败（如欺骗、谄媚、越狱）已有公开基准可以测量，因此可以借此检验自动化对齐研究的实际效果。
AI.method: 研究者设计自动化对齐研究者（AARs），使其能够提出训练方法和数据，并同时优化多个安全基准，同时保持通用能力。研究还对比了28位经验丰富的人类研究人员在最多8小时内开发的方法，并测试了将人类想法作为AAR初始研究方向的效果。
AI.result: 最强AAR方法在10种对齐失败中显著降低目标失败，并泛化到保留基准、多轮行为审计以及比目标模型大4.7倍的模型。人类基线方法表现不如最佳AAR方法，且人类想法作为初始方向未提升AAR性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前自动化对齐研究在特征良好的对齐失败上可能已具备近期实用性，且可能不再需要经验丰富的研究人员的指导。

title: Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations
summary: JEPA world models make latent-space planning a practical route to control, but they are built almost exclusively on images. Whether latent prediction survives geometric observations is unclear: point clouds are sparse, unordered, and self-occluded, and with 0.3-15% of scene points moving, the slow-feature optimum of latent prediction compounds with the geometric shortcut of 3D self-supervision. We lift three canonical JEPA designs to point clouds, frozen-encoder, distribution-prior, and action-sensitive, and re-sense the stable-worldmodel benchmark so that only the observation differs from the image baselines. All three plan without collapse: the distribution-prior model is statistically equivalent to its re-evaluated image counterpart on every benchmark, and the action-sensitive model attains the strongest result in our controlled comparison where the most geometry moves. Probing explains why: object positions are almost perfectly linearly decodable and attention falls on the few moving points. Planning withstands heavy dropout never seen in training, though range noise defeats the thinnest scene. Geometry finally makes a commanded 3D target a natural goal interface: we construct the goal latent from the target and the current latent, at no cost in success rate, without a goal observation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将三种典型JEPA世界模型（冻结编码器、分布先验、动作敏感）从图像拓展到点云几何观测上，通过重新设计稳定世界模型基准（仅观测模态不同），证明基于点云的隐空间规划不会崩塌，其中动作敏感模型在几何运动最多的场景表现最强，且可通过目标点云直接构造目标隐向量实现无目标观测的规划。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型在图像上已成功实现隐空间规划控制，但几乎完全基于图像构建。点云作为关键的几何观测模态，具有稀疏、无序、自遮挡的特点，且场景中仅0.3-15%的点在运动，导致隐预测的慢特征最优性与3D自监督的几何捷径相冲突。因此，需要验证隐预测能否在几何观测下存活。
AI.method: 将三种经典JEPA设计（frozen-encoder、distribution-prior、action-sensitive）迁移到点云，并重新构建stable-worldmodel基准，确保除观测模态外与图像基线完全一致。通过可控对比实验评估三种模型的规划表现，并通过线性解码探测和注意力分析解释模型行为，同时测试规划对点云丢帧和噪声的鲁棒性，以及利用目标点云构造目标隐向量的能力。
AI.result: 三种JEPA模型在点云上均能无崩塌规划；distribution-prior模型在所有基准上统计等价于重新评估的图像对应模型；action-sensitive模型在几何运动最多的场景取得最强结果。探测显示物体位置几乎可完美线性解码，注意力集中在少数运动点上。规划能承受训练中从未见过的重度丢点，但范围噪声会击溃最薄的场景。利用目标点云和当前隐向量构造目标隐向量在成功率上无损失。
AI.conclusion: JEPA隐空间规划可以成功扩展到点云几何观测，几何模态甚至提供了独特优势：命令式的3D目标可自然作为目标接口，无需目标观测即可实现目标导向规划，为几何感知的具身智能控制开辟了可行路径。

title: CP-WSP: A Declarative CP-SAT Framework for Configurable Multi-Constraint Workforce Scheduling
summary: Workforce scheduling is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and operational objectives. Existing CP formulations typically model simplified instances with 6-12 constraints at shift-level granularity and critically lack explicit support for: mandatory break scheduling with midpoint placement control; acuity weighted workload equity; sub-shift temporal granularity enabling demand-driven staffing; inter-week schedule stability; and cross-midnight shift patterns common in 24-hour operations. This paper presents CP-WSP: a declarative CP-SAT framework enforcing 14 hard constraints as mathematically inviolable requirements (zero regulatory violations by construction) while optimizing 15 soft objectives through a unified weighted penalty function -- all configurable via a JSON specification with no code changes required. Key contributions include: a shift-window variable decomposition enabling mandatory break scheduling with centrality control; acuity-weighted workload equity; multi-granularity temporal resolution from 30 minutes to 2 hours; inter-week schedule stability; a grid-offset preprocessing technique for cross-midnight shifts; and a reproducible 36-configuration benchmark suite for community comparison. Evaluated on INRC-II benchmarks at both hourly and shift-level granularity and on 36 synthetic configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CP-WSP，一个声明式CP-SAT工作力调度框架，通过14个硬约束和15个软目标（统一加权惩罚函数）处理强制休息调度、锐度加权工作量公平性、多粒度时间分辨率、跨周稳定性和跨午夜班次等问题，所有配置通过JSON规范实现无需代码改动，并在INRC-II基准和36个合成配置上进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 现有CP公式通常在班次级粒度上以6-12个约束建模简化实例，且缺乏对强制休息调度（含中点位置控制）、锐度加权工作量公平性、需求驱动的子班次时间粒度、周间调度稳定性以及24小时运营中常见的跨午夜班次模式的关键支持，亟需一个更全面且可配置的框架。
AI.method: 提出CP-WSP声明式框架，采用CP-SAT求解器，强制执行14个硬约束（构造上保证零违规），通过统一加权惩罚函数优化15个软目标。关键技术包括：移窗变量分解（支持带中心性控制的强制休息调度）、锐度加权工作量公平性、30分钟至2小时的多粒度时间分辨率、周间调度稳定性、跨午夜班次的网格偏移预处理技术，以及36配置的可复现基准套件。
AI.result: 在INRC-II基准上以小时级和班次级两种粒度进行评估，并在36个合成配置上进行了测试，验证了框架的有效性和配置灵活性。
AI.conclusion: CP-WSP通过声明式配置和更全面的约束/目标覆盖，提升了工作力调度的建模能力，为社区提供了可复现的基准套件，可支持实际复杂场景下的调度优化。

title: Anchoring Speech with Semantics: A Multimodal Adapter Mechanism for Automatic Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
summary: Low-resource ASR remains difficult because scarce transcripts provide limited supervised evidence for target-side generation. To address this gap, we propose SAMA-ASR, a lightweight adapter mechanism that augments the decoder with semantic anchors from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech; in principle, the mechanism can be applied to similar encoder--decoder multitask speech models. Through cross-modal adaptation, SAMA-ASR conditions decoder states on translation-derived semantic embeddings and a speech embedding, combining utterance-level meaning with speech-grounded evidence before token prediction. At evaluation time, these semantic anchors can be generated automatically by an upstream speech-to-text translator rather than supplied as oracle translations. Experiments on two 30-hour datasets covering the low-resource Sinitic varieties Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka show that SAMA-ASR improves over acoustic, prior prompt-based, and semantic-only translation-guided baselines and remains effective in practical automatic semantic-anchor settings; translator-capacity analyses show that useful semantic anchors can be produced by a compact ST model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAMA-ASR，一种轻量级适配器机制，通过辅助翻译的语义锚点和语音的声学锚点增强解码器，用于低资源语音识别任务。在台湾闽南语和客家语两个30小时数据集上，该方法优于多种基线，且语义锚点可由上游语音翻译模型自动生成，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 低资源语音识别（ASR）面临的主要挑战在于标注转录数据稀少，导致目标端生成的监督信号有限，传统方法难以有效学习。现有方法未能充分利用跨模态信息（语义和声学）来弥补监督不足的问题。
AI.method: SAMA-ASR采用轻量级适配器机制，从两个维度增强解码器：(1) 语义锚点——来自辅助翻译结果的语义嵌入；(2) 声学锚点——来自语音的嵌入。通过跨模态适配，解码器状态在令牌预测之前结合了话语级语义信息和语音证据。在推理时，语义锚点可由上游语音到文本翻译器自动生成，无需使用oracle翻译。
AI.result: 在两个30小时低资源数据集（台湾闽南语和客家语）上的实验表明，SAMA-ASR优于声学基线、基于提示的先验方法和仅语义的翻译引导基线。在实际自动语义锚点设置下仍然有效；翻译器容量分析显示，紧凑的语音翻译模型即可产生有用的语义锚点。
AI.conclusion: SAMA-ASR通过结合语义锚点和声学锚点的跨模态适配，有效提升了低资源ASR的性能，且该方法具有通用性，可应用于类似的编码器-解码器多任务语音模型。实际应用中无需oracle翻译即可工作，展示了实用性。

title: From Location Phrases to Geographic Entities: Task-Adapted Retrieval for People Search
summary:
People search must map free-form location phrases to geographic entities used as structured retrieval filters. Lexical standardizers handle canonical names well but are brittle to aliases, misspellings, metropolitan expressions, and same-name ambiguity. We formulate this task as graded, set-valued entity retrieval over a fixed ontology. We identify three coupled design requirements: distinguishing identity-preserving variation from knowledge-dependent aliases, controlling false negatives among valid same-name entities, and separating stable transformations from mutable entity knowledge. We realize them in a prompt-asymmetric bi-encoder with calibrated alias support, bounded ambiguity-aware negatives, and editable entity documents that support localized updates without retraining.
  Across a fixed production-derived development benchmark and a public GeoNames transfer task, task adaptation improves substantially over frozen encoders and standard token baselines. Controlled development ablations show that specialized supervision contributes beyond standard task fine-tuning and encoder scaling. On GeoNames, the adapted model improves known-target Recall@1 throughout zero-to-moderate character overlap, while character n-grams retain a small aggregate Target Recall@5 advantage. In a blinded human comparison on a stratified production challenge set, our model raises relevant P@1 from 28.0% to 46.0% (p=0.012). Fixed-query endpoint estimates improve on non-canonical queries and remain close to control on frequent queries; a randomized live experiment detects no engagement regression. These results support task-adapted geographic entity retrieval as a practical replacement for the incumbent taxonomy-based standardizer, with the largest relevance gains on non-canonical queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将人物搜索中的自由形式地点短语到地理实体的映射任务形式化为基于固定本体的分级、集合值实体检索问题，并设计了一种提示不对称双编码器（prompt-asymmetric bi-encoder），通过校准的别名支持、有界歧义感知负样本和可编辑实体文档来实现任务适应，在开发基准和GeoNames迁移任务上显著优于冻结编码器和标准词元基线，并在生产挑战集上实现相关P@1从28.0%提升至46.0%。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的人物搜索需要将自由形式的地点短语映射到结构化检索过滤所需的地理实体。传统的词汇标准化器（lexical standardizers）虽然能正确处理规范名称，但对别名、拼写错误、都市表达（如"大纽约地区"）和同名歧义等问题非常脆弱，亟需一种更鲁棒的映射方法。
AI.method: 本文识别了三个耦合的设计需求：(1) 区分保持身份的变异与依赖知识的别名；(2) 控制有效同名实体中的假阴性；(3) 将稳定的变换与可变的实体知识分离。基于此，提出提示不对称双编码器，包含校准的别名支持、有界歧义感知负样本以及支持局部更新而无需重训练的可编辑实体文档。
AI.result: 在固定生产派生开发基准和公用GeoNames迁移任务上，任务适应显著优于冻结编码器和标准词元基线。GeoNames上适配模型在零到中等字符重叠范围内提升已知目标Recall@1，而字符n-gram在Target Recall@5上保留小规模聚合优势。盲测人类比较中，相关P@1从28.0%提升至46.0%（p=0.012）；固定查询端点估计在非规范查询上提升，高频查询上接近对照；随机在线实验未检测到参与度回退。
AI.conclusion: 任务适应的地理实体检索可以实际替代现有的基于分类法的标准化器，在非规范查询上获得最大的相关性提升，同时在高频查询和在线参与度上没有回退，验证了该方法的实用性和部署可行性。

title: When Patients Cut In: Extending Clinical Conversational AI Safety to Interruptions
summary: Clinical voice agents are now deployed in routine care, where real patients do not wait their turn: they interrupt. These systems typically use a cascaded architecture (speech-to-text -> LLM -> text-to-speech), so when a patient cuts the agent off mid-utterance, clinically required content can be lost even when the model handles cooperative transcripts well. Yet clinical conversational-AI benchmarks almost universally assume patients wait for the agent to finish, missing interruption-induced loss of required content. We present a transcript-based evaluation of interruption recovery, adapting conversation-analytic overlap categories into three operational types (recognitional, competitive, transitional sub-unit) and testing four deployment-oriented, non-reasoning LLM configurations across four cells spanning history-taking (information gathering) and FAQ (information provision), scored on whether the agent preserves the clinically required content. In the gathering cells, target-question failure varied across models; in the provision cells, where arms are directly comparable, failure rose for every model. Rankings differ across cells, and competitive FAQ interruption produced 30/30 provision-coverage failures for all four models (Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%; baseline 0/30 for three, 4/30 for Llama). A brief apology marker ("sorry to interrupt") shifts recovery by tens of percentage points, inconsistently across models, and for one it reduces recovery. Interruption robustness therefore cannot be a single score: evaluation must be content-grounded, reported per cell, and matched to the deployment's interruption profile.

AI.tldr: 临床语音对话智能体已在实际诊疗中部署，但真实患者会打断系统，导致级联架构中临床必需内容丢失。本文提出一种基于转录本的打断恢复评估方法，将对话分析中的重叠类别操作化为三种类型，并在四个单元（病史采集/FAQ × 信息收集/信息提供）测试四种LLM配置。结果显示竞争性FAQ打断导致所有模型30/30次提供覆盖失败，且各模型排序因单元而异，说明打断鲁棒性不能用一个单一分数衡量。
AI.motivation: 临床对话AI基准几乎都假设患者等智能体说完，忽略了真实临床环境中患者会打断这一现象，导致打断引发的临床必需内容丢失从未被系统评估。
AI.method: 将对话分析中的重叠类别操作化为三种打断类型（识别性、竞争性、过渡性子单元），设计四个评估单元（病史采集-信息收集、病史采集-信息提供、FAQ-信息收集、FAQ-信息提供），用转录本评估方法测试四种面向部署的非推理LLM配置，以是否保留临床必需内容为评分标准，并测试道歉标记语的影响。
AI.result: 信息收集单元中目标问题失败率因模型而异；信息提供单元所有模型失败率均上升；竞争性FAQ打断下四种模型全部出现30/30提供覆盖失败（95%CI: 88.6-100.0%）；道歉标记使恢复率变化数十个百分点且跨模型不一致，对一个模型反而降低恢复率。
AI.conclusion: 打断鲁棒性不是一个单一分数可以概括的，评估必须基于内容、按单元报告，并与部署场景的打断特征相匹配。

title: Efficient GPU Retrieval for Semantic Search
summary:
Semantic Search on LinkedIn must retrieve relevant profiles from a corpus of hundreds of millions in response to natural-language queries such as "a fintech founder in Berlin who worked in payments." The deployed relevance policy is bottleneck-oriented: every active non-negotiable facet must be satisfied, and a pre-existing LLM Graded Relevance (GR) judge operationalizes this through a fixed min/median aggregation over facet grades. Cosine similarity instead averages evidence, letting a strong match on one facet mask failure on another, capping the recall of the first-stage (L0) retriever.
  We present a policy-aligned retrieval framework: embeddings are partitioned into eight category-supervised segments whose scores follow the same min/median rule at serving time; for multi-vector retrieval, this segment score is computed independently per tagged document slot and maximized across slots. A lightweight single-slot Stage-1 scorer generates high-recall candidates, while scale-invariant relative-norm gating keeps category activation consistent across training, evaluation, and serving. On 21K held-out queries, this representation improves offline relevance over a matched-capacity baseline, with gains broadly distributed across facet combinations.
  We serve this framework with a two-stage GPU architecture: an FP8 coarse ranker scores the full corpus, increasing per-shard capacity by 71% and Stage-1 matmul throughput by 36%, then an FP16 stage exactly re-ranks an oversampled candidate set, recovering 99.6-99.8% of full-FP16 recall at over 500 QPS per shard replica. In a member-randomized A/B test, exploratory-query Precision@10 under the unchanged GR judge rises from 63.7% to 79.0% and navigational Precision@1 from 65.5% to 74.7%, with a blinded human evaluation independently confirming the Precision@10 gain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种与策略对齐的检索框架，用于LinkedIn上的语义搜索。嵌入被划分为八个类别监督的分段，其分数遵循min/median聚合规则，替代了余弦相似度平均化可能掩盖单面失败的问题。通过两阶段GPU架构（FP8粗排+FP16精排）实现部署，在A/B测试中显著提升了探索性查询的Precision@10（从63.7%到79.0%）和导航性查询的Precision@1（从65.5%到74.7%）。
AI.motivation: 现有语义检索使用余弦相似度平均化证据，强匹配可能掩盖薄弱面的失败，导致L0阶段检索器的召回率受限。而实际部署的相关性策略是瓶颈导向的：每个活跃的不可协商方面必须被满足。因此需要一种与策略对齐（而非平均化）的检索表征。
AI.method: 1) 将嵌入划分为八个类别监督的分段，推理时按min/median规则聚合分段分数；2) 多向量检索中，分段分数在每个带标签的文档槽位独立计算并在槽位间取最大值；3) 轻量级单槽Stage-1打分器生成高召回候选；4) 尺度不变的相对范数门控保持类别激活在训练、评估和服务间的一致性；5) 两阶段GPU架构：FP8粗排器对全量语料打分（提升每分片容量71%、Stage-1 matmul吞吐36%），FP16阶段对过采样候选集精确重排（恢复99.6-99.8%的全FP16召回率）。
AI.result: 在21K保留查询上，该表征相对匹配容量的基线提升了离线相关性，增益广泛分布在方面组合中。在成员随机A/B测试中，探索性查询Precision@10从63.7%提升至79.0%，导航性查询Precision@1从65.5%提升至74.7%，盲人机评估独立确认了Precision@10的增益。FP8粗排使每分片容量提升71%，Stage-1 matmul吞吐提升36%，FP16精排恢复99.6-99.8%的召回率，服务速度超过每分片副本500 QPS。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明将检索表征与部署策略的聚合规则对齐（而非使用通用余弦相似度）能显著提升语义搜索的在线相关性。通过FP8低精度粗排与FP16精排的两阶段架构，在保持高吞吐（500+ QPS/分片）的同时实现了大规模语料（数亿级）的可扩展服务能力。

title: Reference-Grafting Matches Fine-Tuning at Eliciting Sandbagged Capabilities
summary: Sandbagging, in which a model deliberately underperforms on an evaluation despite retaining the underlying capability, threatens the safety evaluations that frontier-model governance depends on. The Elicitation Game found that fine-tuning elicits hidden capability from sandbagging model organisms whereas additive activation steering fails. We revisit that verdict with reference-grafting, which sets an activation's coordinate along a contrast direction to the value it takes in an honest reference, at a small set of circuits chosen by active learning. Across eleven fine-tuned password-locked models (1.5-32B, three architecture lineages), it recovers +94 to +101% of the honest-sandbagging gap, matching fine-tuning elicitation without weight updates or training labels; two to five paired examples suffice to fit the direction. Similar recovery holds for reinforcement-learning-induced sandbagging and for password-locked code generation. Grafting works because the fine-tuned lock is a thresholded gate: held-out accuracy stays at the sandbagged level until the grafted coordinate crosses a threshold near the honest reference, which is why additive steering and zeroing the coordinate often fail. The direction tracks how the sandbagging was induced rather than what is withheld -- fit on grade-school science (ARC) it elicits withheld hazardous knowledge (WMDP), yet prompting, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning each carry a different direction. Circuit-breaking marks the boundary: it reroutes activations on every forward pass, so the fixed edits we test are re-broken downstream and do not restore coherent generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"参考嫁接"（reference-grafting）技术，通过在对比方向上设置激活坐标到诚实参考值，在少量电路上进行主动学习选择，能够在11个密码锁定的微调模型中恢复+94%至+101%的诚实-装傻差距，匹配微调引出效果但无需权重更新或训练标签。
AI.motivation: 沙袋化（sandbagging）行为——模型在保留底层能力的同时在评估中故意表现不佳——威胁着前沿模型治理所依赖的安全评估。先前研究（Elicitation Game）发现微调能引出隐藏能力，而加性激活引导（additive activation steering）失败。本文旨在寻找更有效的引出方法。
AI.method: 提出参考嫁接（reference-grafting）技术：将激活在对比方向上的坐标设置为诚实参考中的值，通过主动学习在少量电路上选择嫁接位置。使用2-5个配对样本即可拟合方向。在11个密码锁定的微调模型（1.5-32B，三种架构谱系）上进行验证，并扩展到RL诱导的沙袋化和密码锁定的代码生成任务。
AI.result: 参考嫁接恢复了+94%至+101%的诚实-沙袋化差距，效果与微调引出相当但无需权重更新或训练标签。发现"嫁接"之所以有效是因为微调锁是一个阈值门控：保持准确率在沙袋化水平直到嫁接坐标跨越接近诚实参考的阈值，这解释了加性引导和归零该坐标为何失败。方向追踪沙袋化诱导方式而非内容——在ARC上拟合可在WMDP上引出有害知识，但提示、微调和RL各自携带不同方向。电路中断（circuit-breaking）标记边界：它会重路由每次前向传播的激活，固定编辑会在下游被重新打破。
AI.conclusion: 参考嫁接是一种更有效且样本高效的隐藏能力引出方法，揭示了沙袋化机制的阈值门控本质。该工作对前沿模型安全评估有重要启示：方向编码的是沙袋化如何被诱导而非内容本身，同时指出电路中断等防御机制会阻止固定编辑的恢复效果。

title: Large Language Models Systematically Favor Popular Options: Evidence and Mitigation Across MCQs
summary: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) are a standard format for evaluating large language models (LLMs), yet the popularity of answer options can confound evaluation. Modern LLMs systematically prefer popular but incorrect options over less popular correct ones, a vulnerability we call \textbf{popularity bias}. This pattern aligns with confidence miscalibration: model confidence remains high even as accuracy collapses for popular options. To systematically isolate this phenomenon, we introduce \textbf{PopMCQ}, a benchmark with six controlled strategies that vary option popularity while keeping the correct answer fixed. In our most adversarial setting, where all distractors are more popular than the correct option, models choose popular but wrong answers 66\% of the time. To mitigate this bias, we propose \textbf{PopDebias}, a lightweight inference-time correction that estimates and removes a popularity prior from model predictions. It requires no fine-tuning, is label-free at test time (using only a small calibration split for parameter fitting), and adds negligible computational cost. Experiments on 22 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 32B parameters) show consistent improvements, with accuracy gains up to 54.1 percentage points under strong popularity pressure. The code and data are available https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/PopMCQ

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大型语言模型在多选题评估中的"流行度偏差"问题，即模型系统性地偏好流行但错误的选项。作者提出PopMCQ基准（六种控制流行度的策略）和PopDebias方法（轻量级推理时校正，无需微调），在22个开源LLM上验证了有效性，准确率提升最高达54.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多选题是评估LLM的标准格式，但答案选项的流行度会混淆评估结果。现代LLM表现出系统性偏好流行但错误选项的趋势，且这种偏差伴随着置信度错误校准（即使准确率下降，模型置信度依然很高），这严重影响了模型的可靠评估。
AI.method: 1) 提出PopMCQ基准：包含六种控制策略来系统性地隔离流行度偏差，同时保持正确答案不变；2) 提出PopDebias方法：一种轻量级推理时校正技术，通过估计并从模型预测中移除流行度先验，无需微调，测试时无需标签（仅用少量校准数据拟合参数），计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在最对抗性设置下（所有干扰项都比正确答案更流行），模型66%的时间选择流行但错误的答案。在22个开源LLM（0.5B到32B参数）上的实验显示一致性改进，在强流行度压力下准确率提升最高达54.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 流行度偏差是LLM多选题评估中的一个重要缺陷，但可以通过轻量级的推理时校正（PopDebias）有效缓解，为未来更可靠的LLM评估提供了实用方案。

title: From Analytics to Tumor Boards: An Evidence-Linked Multi-Agent Workflow for Oncology Feature Extraction
summary: Clinically relevant oncology information is distributed across heterogeneous, longitudinal documentation, creating substantial abstraction burden and requiring accurate attribution across specimens, tumors, biomarkers, and time points, while manual cancer-registry abstraction can require 27.2 minutes per case, highlighting the need for scalable methods that preserve clinical context while converting documentation into structured data. We evaluate the Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), a configurable oncology information-extraction workflow which extracts clinically relevant structured fields from fragmented oncology documentation. The extraction task uses a clinician-informed schema of 328 attributes spanning report metadata, diagnosis, staging, and cancer-type-specific information. nMAS separates clinician-defined field specifications from model execution and combines complexity-aware extraction, report-level consolidation, and source-grounded validation. The retrospective evaluation included 230 de-identified oncology documents from 40 patients and 418 clinician-reviewed document-field pairs containing 1,126 non-empty reference values. Evaluation focused on fields identified by clinicians as present in the source documents rather than exhaustively annotating all 328 schema fields. nMAS achieved a rank-weighted value-level precision of 82.6%, recall of 87.5%, and F1 of 85.0%, compared with an F1 of 66.4% for an independently implemented UMA-style MiniMax M2.5 comparator. These findings support the feasibility of using a configurable, source-grounded extraction workflow to convert fragmented oncology documentation into reusable structured data.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了Nimblemind多智能体系统（nMAS），一个可配置的肿瘤学信息提取工作流，它能从碎片化的肿瘤学文档中提取328个临床相关属性字段。在230份去标识化文档、40名患者、418个临床医生审核的文档-字段对（含1,126个非空参考值）的回顾性评估中，nMAS达到82.6%的精度、87.5%的召回率和85.0%的F1分数，显著优于对照系统（F1 66.4%）。
AI.motivation: 临床相关的肿瘤学信息分散在异构、纵向的文档中，人工癌症登记抽象每例需要27.2分钟，工作量大且负担重。需要可扩展的方法在保留临床背景的同时将文档转换为结构化数据，以解决人工抽象负担和跨标本、肿瘤、生物标志物及时间点的准确归属问题。
AI.method: nMAS将临床医生定义的字段规范与模型执行分离，结合了复杂度感知提取、报告级整合和源文档锚定的验证。系统基于临床医生制定的328个属性模式（涵盖报告元数据、诊断、分期和癌症类型特定信息），采用多智能体工作流进行信息提取。
AI.result: nMAS在418个临床医生审核的文档-字段对上达到秩加权值级精度82.6%、召回率87.5%、F1 85.0%，而独立实现的UMA风格MiniMax M2.5对照系统的F1仅为66.4%。评估聚焦于临床医生确认存在于源文档中的字段，而非穷举标注全部328个模式字段。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，使用可配置、源文档锚定的提取工作流将碎片化肿瘤学文档转换为可复用的结构化数据是可行的，为减轻人工抽象负担提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: A Causal Model for Locating and Unlocking Sandbagging in Model Organisms
summary: Sandbagging models strategically underperform on evaluations while retaining the capabilities being measured. The evaluations that guide frontier-model deployment and governance then understate what these models can do. To understand the mechanism, we propose a causal model of how sandbagging is carried in the residual stream. Early layers write the sandbagging intent onto a single axis of the stream, and a later layer reads that axis and commits the answer. We study three instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Mistral-7B) and four ways of installing a sandbagging lock (prompting, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and circuit breaking). Each lock decides from the prompt whether to sandbag, and the fine-tuned and circuit-broken locks answer honestly whenever a password appears. The causal model predicts a window of layers, after the last sandbagging write and before the answer commit, in which a single-layer reference graft of the sandbagging axis to its honest value restores the full capability. The single-layer graft recovers the capability in 28 of the 33 runs of the prompted, fine-tuned, and RL-trained locks, with a median held-out recovery of 96%. The circuit-broken lock rewrites the whole state through a band of layers, and the single-layer graft fails at every layer. We therefore introduce a second intervention, context grafting, which replays the password's cached key/value activations so that every layer's attention reads them as additional context. Context grafting provably and empirically restores the full capability on all three models, and the recovery is surprisingly insensitive to the exact password content. More broadly, an auditor can use this causal model to design interventional auditing techniques for sandbagging models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种关于模型"沙袋化"（sandbagging）的因果模型，解释了模型如何在评估中战略性表现不佳。研究发现沙袋意图被写入残差流中的单一轴上，通过"单层接枝"和"上下文接枝"两种干预手段可以恢复模型能力。
AI.motivation: 沙袋化模型在评估中故意表现不佳但保留实际能力，导致前沿模型的部署和治理评估低估了模型真实能力。理解其机制对于审计和治理至关重要。
AI.method: 提出因果模型：早期层将沙袋意图写入残差流单一轴，后期层读取该轴并决定答案。研究了三种指令微调模型和四种沙袋锁定方式（提示、微调、强化学习、电路破坏），设计了单层参考接枝和上下文接枝两种干预方法。
AI.result: 单层接枝在33次运行中的28次恢复了能力（中位恢复96%），但电路破坏型沙袋失败。上下文接枝在所有三种模型上可证明且经验性地恢复了全部能力，且对密码内容不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 该因果模型为审计人员设计沙袋化模型的干预性审计技术提供了理论基础，上下文接枝是一种鲁棒的恢复能力方法。

title: SHADOWBENCH: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization
summary: Autoformalization translates informal mathematical theorems into code for proof assistants such as Lean. A central challenge is that current evaluation metrics can accept type-correct but misaligned statements or reject correct statements written in a different formulation. Inspired by Pass@$k$, we propose SA-Pass (*Semantic Alignment Pass*), which tests formal statements using auxiliary statements called *shadows* that characterize the intended statement. A generated statement receives full credit only when it compiles, implies each shadow (forward check), and is implied by their conjunction (backward check). We instantiate SA-Pass in ShadowBench, a Lean 4 full autoformalization benchmark of 178 postgraduate- to research-level problems spanning eight mathematical areas. Claude Code (Opus 4.8) with Numina-Lean-Agent reaches $61.8\%$ compile rate and $11.2\%$ SA-Pass. Across outputs generated by six agentic configurations, SA-Pass achieves $98.8\%$ binary agreement with expert judgments. An early version of ShadowBench served as the benchmark for Track 4 of the ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-Pass（语义对齐通过）评估方法，用于自动形式化任务，通过影子语句（shadows）检验生成的形式化语句是否与原始非形式化定理语义对齐，并构建了包含178个高等数学问题的ShadowBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有自动形式化评估指标存在缺陷：类型正确但语义错位的语句可能被接受，而表述不同但正确的内容可能被拒。需要一个能真正检验语义对齐的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出SA-Pass指标，使用表征预期语句的辅助语句（shadows）。生成语句获得满分须满足：编译通过、蕴含每个影子语句（前向检查）、并被影子语句合取所蕴含（后向检查）。基于此构建ShadowBench基准，包含8个数学领域的178个研究生至研究级问题。
AI.result: Claude Code (Opus 4.8)结合Numina-Lean-Agent在ShadowBench上达到61.8%编译率和11.2%的SA-Pass。在六种智能体配置的输出上，SA-Pass与专家判断的二元一致性达98.8%。
AI.conclusion: SA-Pass通过前后向蕴含检查实现了更可靠的语义对齐评估，ShadowBench已成为ICML 2026 AI4Math挑战赛Track 4的基准。

title: The Role of Network Topology and Opponent Information in Shaping Cooperation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Systems
summary: Several works have investigated the influence of graph topology on cooperation among artificial agents, while the majority of the literature has focused on modelling agents' adaptation through strategy imitation, which relies solely on the cumulative payoffs of others. This paper investigates scenarios in which each agent learns to play the two-player Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD) using deep reinforcement learning. Each agent is represented as a node in a graph, where its neighbours constitute the pool of opponents with whom it can interact. During each IPD episode, agents are provided with different types of information about their opponent, consisting of action history and opponent identity. Experimental results across different graph topologies show that the number of neighbours per node and the average path length are the main factors affecting the emergence of cooperation. We also show that, while partner selection fosters mutual cooperation by limiting the diversity of the opponent pool, providing agents with the identity of their opponent hinders the proliferation of cooperative strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图拓扑结构对深度强化学习智能体在重复囚徒困境（IPD）中合作行为的影响，发现邻居数量和平均路径长度是影响合作涌现的主要因素，且对手身份信息会阻碍合作策略的传播。
AI.motivation: 现有关于图拓扑对合作影响的研究大多基于策略模仿的适应机制（仅依赖累积收益），缺乏对智能体通过深度强化学习自主适应场景的探讨，因此需要探索在这种更灵活的学习方式下图拓扑如何影响合作。
AI.method: 每个智能体作为图中的一个节点，其邻居构成可交互的对手池。每个智能体使用深度强化学习学习玩双人迭代囚徒困境（IPD），在每轮IPD中对局中，智能体获得不同类型的对手信息（行动历史、对手身份标识），并在不同图拓扑下进行实验。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：（1）每个节点的邻居数量和平均路径长度是影响合作涌现的主要因素；（2）伙伴选择（限制对手池多样性）能促进互惠合作；（3）向智能体提供对手身份信息反而阻碍了合作策略的扩散。
AI.conclusion: 图的结构特性（邻居数、平均路径长度）在深度强化学习框架下同样对合作的涌现起关键作用，但信息提供方式（如对手身份）会产生反直觉的影响，为设计促进多智能体合作的系统提供了重要启示。

title: Knowledge Distillation under Teacher Misspecification: An Order-Parameter Analysis of the Gap between Teacher Mimicry and Task Performance
summary: Knowledge distillation trains a small student model to reproduce the outputs of a large teacher model, and its progress is typically monitored through the teacher--student discrepancy. The quantity of ultimate interest, however, is the student's error with respect to the true task. We study the relation between these two objectives in a minimal three-party model, a true teacher (generative model), a teacher, and a student, all soft committee machines, in which the true teacher contains a shared latent factor that the teacher cannot represent, with mismatch strength controlled by a single scalar $\dmiss$. Within an order-parameter description of online distillation, and exploiting closed-form (arcsine-type) expressions for all errors under error-function activations, we prove that the learning dynamics and the distillation error $\Ets$ are exactly invariant to $\dmiss$, whereas the true error $\Etzs$ and the gap $Δ=\Etzs-\Ets$ are strictly increasing in $\dmiss$, with a rate that is amplified linearly by the complexity $M_0$ of the true teacher. Numerical phase diagrams over the plane spanned by true-teacher complexity and student capacity confirm the predicted deformation: the contours of $\Ets$ do not move while the landscape of $\Etzs$ rises systematically, and a teacher-miss regime, where mimicry succeeds but the task fails, expands with $\dmiss$. The results give a quantitative warning against evaluating distillation solely through teacher-mimicry metrics and identify the gap $Δ$ as a minimal diagnostic for distinguishing teacher-miss from capacity-limited failure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了知识蒸馏中教师-学生差异与真实任务误差之间的关系。通过一个最小三方模型（真实教师、教师、学生均为软委员会机），证明蒸馏误差对真实教师中不可表示潜因子的失配强度完全不变，而真实误差随失配增加。这揭示了仅用教师模仿指标评估蒸馏可能产生误导，并提出差距Δ作为关键诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏中训练进度的监控通常通过教师-学生差异来衡量，但真正感兴趣的指标是学生相对于真实任务的误差。论文旨在严格分析这两者之间的关系，并警告仅通过教师模仿指标评估蒸馏可能带来的风险，特别是在教师本身存在"盲区"（无法表示的潜在因子）的情况下。
AI.method: 构建一个最小三方模型：真实教师（生成模型）、教师、学生，三者均为软委员会机。真实教师包含一个教师无法表示的共享潜因子（失配强度由标量δmiss控制）。在在线蒸馏的序参数描述下，利用误差函数激活下的闭式（反正弦型）表达式，严格分析学习动力学以及各类误差（蒸馏误差、真实误差）对δmiss的依赖性。
AI.result: 证明：（1）学习动力学和蒸馏误差Ets对δmiss严格不变；（2）真实误差Etzs和差距Δ严格随δmiss单调递增，且递增速率被真实教师复杂度M0线性放大。（3）数值相图确认：Ets等高线不变，而Etzs地形系统性上升，教师失配区域（模仿成功但任务失败）随δmiss扩大。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏中仅用教师模仿指标评估会给出误导性结论：存在"教师失配"（teacher-miss）机制，学生可以很好地模仿教师但在真实任务上失败。差距Δ=Etzs−Ets被识别为区分"教师失配"与"容量不足失败"的最小诊断指标，为蒸馏评估提供了定量警告和改进方向。

title: Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning
summary: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly.
