Built from $273$ human-verified tri-modal examples from Social-IQ, OmniBench, and VALOR, SCEval evaluates $15$ proprietary and open-source omni-modal systems. The results show that structural corruption lowers clean accuracy, text--vision damage forms the most stable shared fault line, and multi-modal degradation is non-additive rather than a simple function of the number of corrupted modalities. Clean omni-modal accuracy therefore does not establish that a model will remain reliable when cross-modal evidence becomes structurally unreliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCEval（结构破坏评估）诊断协议，通过在保持问题和答案空间不变的情况下，对文本、视觉和音频模态施加受控的结构性破坏，来揭示全模态大语言模型在模态内部证据结构被扰动时的脆弱性。基于273个人工验证的三模态样本，评估15个系统后发现：结构破坏会降低清洁准确率，文本-视觉损伤构成最稳定的共享故障线，且多模态退化是非加性的。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态大语言模型评估仅在"清洁"环境（所有通道完整、同步、可解释）下进行，无法判断模型成功是否依赖于稳定的跨模态结构，还是仅靠完整输入中的线索。清洁评估不能揭示模型在模态内部证据结构被扰动时的行为稳定性。
AI.method: 定义"模态故障线"概念（当模态保持存在且人类可解释但内部证据结构被扰动时行为失稳的边界），提出SCEval诊断协议：固定问题、答案空间和模态通道，对文本、视觉、音频单独及联合施加受控结构破坏。数据集来自Social-IQ、OmniBench和VALOR的273个人工验证三模态样本，评估15个专有和开源全模态系统。
AI.result: 结构破坏降低清洁准确率；文本-视觉损伤构成最稳定的共享故障线；多模态退化呈现非加性特征，而非简单取决于被破坏模态数量。清洁全模态准确率无法保证模型在跨模态证据结构不可靠时仍保持可靠。
AI.conclusion: 清洁全模态准确率不能作为模型鲁棒性的充分证据，当跨模态证据在结构层面变得不可靠时，模型性能会显著下降。这表明需要更严格的诊断评估协议（如SCEval）来全面检验全模态模型的鲁棒性。

title: Selective Forgetting: A Graph-Based Memory Framework for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary:
Knowledge graphs have been proposed as a structured alternative to flat retrieval-augmented generation for long-term agent memory, on the assumption that representing conversations as entities and relations improves recall. We evaluate that assumption directly. Our framework extracts each conversational turn into typed nodes and attributed edges, answers questions from a two-hop subgraph, and periodically prunes nodes that score low on a weighted combination of recency, access frequency, degree centrality, and age. On LongMemEval, the graph does not outperform a flat vector baseline at a matched candidate-generation budget of five retrieval roots: token F1 is $0.417$ against $0.468$, and a paired bootstrap over 500 questions gives
$Δ= -0.050$ (95\% CI $[-0.085, -0.016]$). The gap is widest on questions that require recalling a specific prior assistant turn, where judged correctness falls from $0.911$ to $0.607$, suggesting that decomposing a turn into entities discards the surface form these questions depend on. The forgetting module is more successful. Applied once to a persistent 27{,}021-node graph, it removes 9.8\% of nodes and 9.5\% of stored bytes; token F1 is unchanged ($+0.001$, 95\% CI $[-0.015, +0.016]$) and judged correctness falls by $1.6$ points, with the 95\% interval bounding any loss at $3.8$ points ($[-0.038, +0.006]$). Because our extractor is a single small model evaluated on one benchmark, these results characterise this extraction-based pipeline rather than graph-structured memory in general. Code: https://github.com/skhanzad/Selective-Amnesia

AI.tldr: 该论文直接评估了知识图谱作为长期智能体记忆相对于扁平向量检索的优势假设。研究发现，在匹配的候选生成预算下，图谱方法在LongMemEval基准上的表现不如扁平向量基线（token F1: 0.417 vs 0.468），尤其是在需要回忆特定助手回应的场景中差距最大。然而，遗忘（剪枝）模块效果良好，仅以极小性能损失（token F1 +0.001，判断正确率下降1.6点）换取了9.8%节点和9.5%存储字节的节省。作者谨慎指出，结论仅限于其特定的抽取式管道。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱被提出作为长期智能体记忆的扁平RAG的结构化替代方案，其核心假设是将会话建模为实体和关系能提升回忆（recall）性能。然而这一假设从未被直接验证过，论文旨在直接评估该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 框架包含三个组件：1) 将每次对话轮次抽取为带类型的节点和带属性的边；2) 从两跳子图中回答问题；3) 周期性基于加权组合（新近度、访问频率、度中心性和年龄）剪枝低分节点。在LongMemEval基准上与扁平向量基线在5个检索根（retrieval roots）的匹配预算下对比。
AI.result: 图谱未超越扁平向量基线：token F1为0.417对0.468，配对bootstrap显示Δ=-0.050（95% CI [-0.085, -0.016]）。差距最大的是需要回忆特定助手轮次的问题（判断正确率从0.911降至0.607）。遗忘模块更成功：对27,021节点图剪枝后移除9.8%节点和9.5%存储，token F1保持不变（+0.001）且性能损失在误差范围内。
AI.conclusion: 将对话轮次分解为实体/关系会丢弃这些问答所依赖的表面形式信息，结构化图谱并未超越扁平向量检索。但遗忘/剪枝机制被证明是高效且性能几乎无损的记忆管理策略。研究结论仅限定于其单模型、单基准的抽取式管道，不推广到所有图谱结构化记忆方法。

title: Learning Human Health and Diseases from 24-hour Wrist Movement
summary: Much of human health and function unfolds beyond the clinic, through the movements of everyday life. Wrist-worn accelerometers capture these movements continuously, yet their rich signals are often reduced to a small set of predefined behavioural summary measures. Here, we present Sensori, a self-supervised foundation model that learns general-purpose health representations directly from 24 hours of raw tri-axial wrist movement. We developed and evaluated the model across four population-based cohorts from the United Kingdom, China and the United States, comprising 122,640 participants contributing 683,617 person-days of free-living recordings. Sensori condensed each day of movement into a representation that captured diverse movement behaviours, demographic characteristics, health axes and physical function. Evaluation in independent cohorts showed that these representations generalised across populations and measurement settings without retraining. When added to common clinical covariates, Sensori significantly improved prevalent disease classification for 52 of 102 eligible conditions (median delta AUROC, 0.060; range, 0.012-0.242) and incident disease risk prediction for 26 of 87 eligible conditions (median delta Uno's C-index, 0.064; range, 0.025-0.172), with the largest gains for neurological and psychiatric disorders. These findings establish 24-hour wrist movement as a rich and scalable source of health information, with the potential to support passive health monitoring and disease prediction at population scale.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Sensori，一个基于自监督学习的基础模型，直接从24小时原始三轴腕部运动数据中学习通用健康表征。该模型在来自英国、中国和美国的四个群体队列（122,640名参与者，683,617人-天的自由生活记录）中开发和评估，其表征能够跨人群和测量环境泛化，显著改善了疾病分类和风险预测性能。
AI.motivation: 大部分人类健康和行为发生在临床环境之外，通过日常生活的运动体现。腕戴式加速度计可以连续捕捉这些运动，但丰富信号往往被简化为少量预定义的行为汇总指标，未能充分挖掘其健康信息价值。需要一种能直接从原始数据中学习通用健康表征的模型。
AI.method: 提出Sensori，一个自监督基础模型，直接从24小时原始三轴腕部运动学习通用健康表征。每个运动日被压缩为一个表征向量，涵盖多样化的运动行为、人口学特征、健康轴和身体功能。模型在四个大规模群体队列中开发和验证，并在独立队列中评估其无需重新训练的跨人群泛化能力。
AI.result: Sensori表征在独立队列中无需重新训练即可跨人群和测量环境泛化。加入常见临床协变量后，52/102种现有疾病的分类显著改善（中位AUROC提升0.060，范围0.012-0.242），26/87种疾病的发病风险预测改善（中位Uno's C-index提升0.064，范围0.025-0.172），其中神经和精神疾病的增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 24小时腕部运动是丰富且可扩展的健康信息来源，Sensori证明了其支持被动健康监测和群体规模疾病预测的潜力，为大规模健康监测提供了新途径。

title: Denoising as Projection: Constrained Optimization with Gradient-Guided Diffusion
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used not only for sampling from learned data distributions, but also for generating samples that optimize task-specific objectives. A common approach is to guide the reverse diffusion process using gradients of an external objective. However, when the data distribution is supported on a structured feasible set, such as a manifold or a constraint set, gradient guidance can move samples away from the learned data geometry. In this paper, we study a simple projected-gradient-guided diffusion update based on the observation that the Stein denoising operator can act as an approximate projection onto the data geometry. The proposed update incorporates the objective gradient inside the denoising step, yielding an inference-time method that uses only a pretrained denoiser and gradient evaluations. We analyze this update as an inexact projected-gradient method for constrained optimization over learned feasible geometries. Our theory covers three settings: linear manifolds, compact convex feasible sets, and compact Riemannian submanifolds. In all these settings, we prove descent and finite-time convergence guarantees. Numerical experiments support the theoretical interpretation and illustrate how the proposed update balances objective descent with preservation of the learned geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于投影梯度引导的扩散模型推理方法，利用Stein去噪算子作为数据几何的近似投影，在去噪步骤中融入目标梯度，实现约束优化与数据几何保持的平衡。论文在三种设置（线性流形、紧凸可行集、紧黎曼子流形）下证明了下降性和有限时间收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型常用于优化任务特定目标，但梯度引导可能将样本移离学习到的数据几何结构（如流形或约束集），导致生成样本偏离数据分布。现有方法缺乏对引导更新在结构化可行集上的理论保证，需要一种既优化目标又保持数据几何的方法。
AI.method: 基于Stein去噪算子可作为数据几何近似投影的观察，提出一种简单的投影梯度引导扩散更新。在去噪步骤内融入目标梯度，仅使用预训练去噪器和梯度评估，实现推理时的约束优化。将该更新分析为学习可行几何上的非精确投影梯度方法，覆盖线性流形、紧凸可行集和紧黎曼子流形三种设置。
AI.result: 在三种理论设置下均证明了下降性和有限时间收敛保证。数值实验支持理论解释，展示了所提更新在目标下降与学习几何保持之间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文为扩散模型引导生成提供了理论支撑，证明了一种简单实用的投影梯度引导更新既能优化外部目标又能保持数据几何，为推理时受约束的扩散采样方法建立了严谨的收敛性理论基础。

title: Cloud and On-Premises Deployment of Uzbek Legal RAG via Targeted Retriever Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Industry Track). Project home: [https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/](https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/)
summary: Deploying large language models for legal question answering raises challenges that general-purpose leaderboards do not capture, particularly for low-resource languages and under hard operational constraints. We report on building and operating a retrieval-augmented (RAG) legal assistant for Uzbek that must run in two regimes: a managed cloud service that maximizes answer quality within a per-token cost ceiling, and an on-premises deployment for clients whose legal data may not leave their infrastructure, restricting us to open-weight models on limited local hardware under latency constraints. Because no evaluation existed for this setting, we build two domain benchmarks: a retrieval benchmark of 178 expert-annotated legal queries with gold provision spans, and an end-to-end benchmark of 504 expert-curated question--answer pairs scored by an LLM judge whose ratings we validate against human judgments and against an independent-family judge. Applying these benchmarks under each regime, we find the open-versus-proprietary gap is small and cheaply closed by fine-tuning. Therefore, we train UTE-1, which is a state-of-the-art text embedder among open models for Uzbek. We also demonstrate that closing the performance gap via fine-tuning is both impractical due to the intensive hardware demands of long-context legal Q\&A and unnecessary, given that legal acts change frequently. We support this by reporting a negative result from a QLoRA experiment. We distill practical guidance for similar deployments, drawn from a system serving real users in production. We release our benchmarks, evaluation code and the fine-tuned embedder (UTE-1) \href{https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/}{at this https URL} to support future work on low-resource legal NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了为乌兹别克语构建和运行检索增强（RAG）法律助手的实践经验，该系统需在托管云服务和本地部署两种模式下运行。作者构建了两个领域基准（检索基准和端到端基准），发现开源与专有模型差距很小且可通过微调低成本弥补，因此训练了UTE-1文本嵌入器。同时通过负面实验结果证明，通过长上下文微调来弥补性能差距既不实际也无必要，最终发布了基准、评估代码和微调嵌入器。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型排行榜无法反映法律问答在低资源语言和硬性运维约束下的真实挑战。乌兹别克语缺乏领域评估基准，且需同时满足云端成本上限和本地硬件限制等约束条件，因此亟需针对该场景构建基准并探索可行的部署策略。
AI.method: 构建了两个领域基准：178条专家标注的检索基准（含法律条款黄金片段）和504条专家编制的端到端问答基准（由LLM法官评分，并对照人工评判和独立家族法官验证）。在两种部署模式下对比开源与专有模型，并通过微调（包括QLoRA实验）探索性能差距的弥补方式，最终训练出UTE-1乌兹别克语文本嵌入器。
AI.result: 开源与专有模型之间的性能差距很小，且可通过微调以低成本弥补。UTE-1成为乌兹别克语开源模型中性能最优的文本嵌入器。QLoRA负面实验表明，长上下文法律问答的微调由于硬件需求过高而不切实际，且法律条款频繁变更使得微调必要性不足。
AI.conclusion: 对于低资源语言的法律RAG系统，关注嵌入器和检索质量比盲目追求大模型微调更为有效；开源模型在合理微调下足以接近专有模型表现。作者发布了基准、评估代码和UTE-1嵌入器，并总结了面向实际部署的实践经验以支持低资源法律NLP的未来工作。

title: Agentic AI uncovers conserved cross-tissue protein co-abundance programs inaccessible to single-dataset analysis
summary: Protein co-abundance clusters preserved across tissues can reveal shared disease mechanisms and candidate therapeutic targets, particularly when proteins implicated in organ-confined diseases converge in peripheral or accessible tissues. However, previous cross-tissue studies have focused on biologically pre-selected tissue pairs, leaving most possible combinations and non-obvious relationships unexplored. We present an LLM-agent framework for large-scale, evidence-grounded comparison of tissue-specific protein co-abundance networks. The framework constructs tissue networks, derives pairwise consensus clusters, and integrates evidence from expression atlases, protein interaction and complex databases, pathway annotations, disease catalogues, and literature. Applied to all 820 pairwise combinations of 41 human tissues and fluids, it identified 1,833 conserved co-abundance clusters across 406 tissue pairs. Colon, synovial fluid, blood, cerebrospinal fluid, and bone marrow were the most broadly connected tissues, while the most cluster-rich pairs were dominated by bone marrow. The analysis also highlighted non-obvious relationships: skin-bone marrow exceeded the anatomically adjacent bone-bone marrow pair, while colon-breast contained cancer-relevant clusters involving extracellular-matrix remodeling, lipid metabolism, and immune modulation. Cluster-level analyses generated further mechanistic hypotheses, including a brain-gut extracellular-vesicle/redox/serotonin-cofactor axis and a liver-bone marrow stress-response axis involving genes linked to white matter disease. These results provide a global, comparable landscape of conserved protein co-abundance and a hypothesis-generating resource for mechanistic and therapeutic exploration. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Gry1005/AgenticAI-conserved-cross-tissue-protein-co-abundance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于LLM智能体的大规模跨组织蛋白共丰度网络比较框架，对41个人类组织和体液的全部820对组合进行系统性分析，识别出1833个保守的共丰度聚类，覆盖406对组织组合，并发现了如皮肤-骨髓、结肠-乳腺等非显而易见的组织间关联，以及脑-肠、肝-骨髓等机制性假设。
AI.motivation: 以往跨组织研究仅关注生物学上预先选定的组织对，而忽略了大多数可能的组合和非显而易见的组织间关系。因此需要一个大规模、证据驱动的系统方法，来全面探索跨组织的蛋白共丰度关系。
AI.method: 构建LLM智能体框架，包括：1) 构建各组织特异性的蛋白共丰度网络；2) 推导所有组织对间的共识聚类；3) 整合来自表达图谱、蛋白互作和复合物数据库、通路注释、疾病目录及文献的多源证据进行验证和解释。
AI.result: 对41个组织/体液的全部820对组合进行分析，识别出406对组织间的1833个保守共丰度聚类。结肠、滑膜液、血液、脑脊液和骨髓是最广泛连接的组织；骨髓主导了富含聚类的组织对。发现皮肤-骨髓关联超越解剖学上相邻的骨-骨髓对；结肠-乳腺含癌症相关聚类（ECM重塑、脂质代谢、免疫调节）；并生成脑-肠和肝-骨髓等机制性假设。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个全局、可比较的保守蛋白共丰度景观，以及用于机制和治疗探索的假设生成资源，代码和数据已公开。

title: Target-Aware State-Adaptive $p$-Dirichlet Graph Neural Regression for Non-Invasive Body-Composition Estimation
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. The first four authors contribute equally to this work and are listed alphabetically. Corresponding authors: N. Drenska, Y. Wang and S. B. Heymsfield
summary: Accurate estimation of body-composition outcomes, including body fat percentage (BFP), bone mineral density (BMD), and appendicular lean mass (ALM), is important for evaluating metabolic, skeletal, and muscular health. Direct assessment using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), however, requires specialized equipment and involves ionizing radiation. We propose a target-aware, state-adaptive $p$-Dirichlet energy-flow graph neural regression ($p$SADE-GNR) framework for estimating these outcomes from non-invasive anthropometric measurements. A neural encoder maps participant representations to hidden states that are propagated over an outcome-specific participant-similarity graph by a state-adaptive forward-Euler discretization of the graph $p$-Dirichlet energy flow. Graph distances weight each original or latent coordinate by its normalized absolute training-fold correlation with the outcome. Using clinical data from the Pennington Biomedical Research Center and five-fold cross-validation, the correlation-weighted model using the original standardized measurements achieved the lowest root mean squared error in all nine primary outcome-cohort combinations and outperformed previously reported support vector regression or least-squares support vector regression reference values in eight of nine comparisons. Autoencoder, variational-autoencoder, and Gaussian-mixture variational-autoencoder representations generally did not improve primary-outcome prediction or reduce computational cost. In an exploratory age-prediction analysis including ALM, BMD, and BFP as predictors, the correlation-weighted GMVAE model achieved the lowest mean error in all three cohorts. These results support target-aware, state-adaptive $p$-Dirichlet graph neural regression for non-invasive body-composition estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种目标感知、状态自适应的p-Dirichlet能量流图神经回归框架（pSADE-GNR），用于从非侵入性人体测量数据中估计身体成分指标（体脂率、骨密度、四肢瘦体重），在九项主要结果中八项优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 身体成分指标（体脂率、骨密度、四肢瘦体重）的准确评估对代谢、骨骼和肌肉健康至关重要，但传统的DXA直接测量需要专业设备并涉及电离辐射，因此需要一种基于非侵入性人体测量数据的估算方法。
AI.method: 提出pSADE-GNR框架：1）神经编码器将参与者表示映射为隐藏状态；2）这些状态通过状态自适应的前向欧拉离散化在图p-Dirichlet能量流上传播，构建参与者相似度图；3）图距离按每个坐标与目标结果的归一化训练折相关性进行加权。
AI.result: 使用Pennington生物医学研究中心的临床数据和五折交叉验证，相关性加权模型在九个主要结果组合中均取得最低RMSE，并在八个比较中优于已有SVR或LSSVR参考值。自编码器类表示未能改善预测或降低计算成本。在探索性的年龄预测分析中，相关性加权GMVAE模型在三个队列中取得最低平均误差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持目标感知、状态自适应的p-Dirichlet图神经回归方法可用于非侵入性身体成分估计，为临床健康评估提供了替代DXA的可行方案。

title: Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents
comment: Code and data are released at https://github.com/THUNLP-MT/TTED
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in manually constructed environments, yet their performance frequently collapses when transitioned to complex real-world settings. Existing research largely attribute this degradation to the compositional generalization gaps in LLMs on combinations of multiple simple, well-structured environments. In this work, we propose that LLM web agents can learn simple environment observations at test time. Specifically, we introduce trial steps for agents to decompose a complex environment observation into sub-modules, and implement a label-free learning method, Test-Time Environment Decomposition (TTED), to adapt agent behaviors with experience during inference. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the framework's efficacy across both synthetic and realistic benchmarks, showing (1) experience gains acquired within simpler sub-environments can be effectively composed to improve performance in the full one, and (2) test-time training on sub-environments can significantly enhance the compositional generalization of agents in real-world web automation tasks. We also provide key insights in the design of the label-free learning algorithm. As more complex environments are accessed by LLM agents, we believe learning environment decomposition skills at test time will be critical for robust real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出测试时环境分解（TTED）方法，让LLM智能体在推理阶段通过试错步骤将复杂环境观察分解为子模块，并通过无标签学习适应环境，从而提升在真实复杂环境中的组合泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在人工构造环境中表现优秀，但在真实复杂环境中性能急剧下降。已有研究将此归因于LLM在多个简单、结构良好环境组合上的组合泛化差距。本文质疑这一观点，提出LLM Web智能体可以在测试时学习简单环境观察。
AI.method: 提出TTED（Test-Time Environment Decomposition）方法：引入试错步骤（trial steps）让智能体将复杂环境观察分解为子模块，并实现一种无标签学习方法，在推理过程中通过已有经验自适应调整智能体行为。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准上的实验表明：(1)在简单子环境中获得的经验可以有效组合以提升完整环境中的表现；(2)子环境上的测试时训练能显著增强智能体在真实Web自动化任务中的组合泛化能力。同时提供无标签学习算法设计的关键见解。
AI.conclusion: 随着LLM智能体访问越来越复杂的环境，在测试时学习环境分解技能对于真实世界中的稳健部署至关重要。

title: Verification abundance, adjudication scarcity: what happens to mathematical knowledge when proof checking becomes free
summary:
In May 2026 an OpenAI model produced a counterexample to the Erdős unit distance conjecture. Five mathematicians published a human-verified version the same day, and the result entered the literature within weeks. In August 2026 the same laboratory published ten mathematical and theoretical computer science results, each accompanied by a machine-checkable Lean 4 certificate with no unproved steps. Four weeks later, one remained the subject of an unresolved dispute over whether its formalization meant what it claimed.
  We argue that this difference is structural. We distinguish three layers of verification: derivational validity, which a kernel checks; representational fidelity, whether the formal statement means the intended question; and epistemic significance. Only the first is mechanizable. Making it effectively free therefore does not eliminate verification work but shifts the burden to layers dependent on scarce expert attention.
  Measurements of the August corpus illustrate the shift. The kernel-checked proofs total 20.6 MB, while the statements requiring human audit total 55.6 KB, a ratio of 379 to 1. Yet those statements contain 218 bespoke definitions rather than relying on community-vetted ones. The audit surface is therefore small in volume but irreducibly expert. We argue that machine checking produces verification abundance while leaving adjudication scarce. We propose a six-category taxonomy of representational mismatch, a disclosure schema for machine-generated mathematical claims, and implications for software, cryptography, and regulated decision systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2026年OpenAI模型证明Erdős单位距离猜想反例及后续大规模机器生成数学结果的虚构案例，论证了机器验证的三个层次中只有"派生有效性"（derivational validity）可以机械化，而"表征保真度"（representational fidelity）和"认知意义"（epistemic significance）依赖稀缺的专家注意力。机器检查产生验证的充裕，却使裁决变得稀缺。
AI.motivation: 随着机器生成数学证明变得越来越普遍且内核检查（如Lean 4证书）变得高效，人们可能误以为验证工作已被消除。作者旨在揭示验证负担的结构性转移：机械化使内核级检查成本趋零，但将负担转移到需要专家判断的更高层次验证上，并指出这种差异是结构性的而非暂时的。
AI.method: 作者通过两个虚构/假想的案例对比（2026年5月单一证明的顺畅接收 vs 2026年8月十项结果的争议），提出三层验证框架（派生有效性、表征保真度、认知意义）；对8月语料库进行量化测量（20.6MB内核检查证明 vs 55.6KB需人工审计的陈述，379:1比率，218个定制定义）；提出六类别表征不匹配分类法、机器生成数学主张的披露模式。
AI.result: 1) 只有第一层验证（派生有效性）可以机械化；2) 审计表面在体积上很小（55.6KB）但本质上需要专家介入（218个定制定义缺乏社区审查）；3) 证实"验证充裕、裁决稀缺"的核心论断；4) 提出了可操作的分类法和披露模式。
AI.conclusion: 机器验证并没有消除验证工作，而是将其从可机械化的内核检查转移到依赖稀缺专家注意力的表征保真度和认知意义层。作者主张需要新的披露规范和治理框架，以应对机器生成数学结果在软件、密码学和监管决策系统中的广泛应用。

title: Adversarial Online Classification with a Preview
summary:
Worst-case online classification is governed by sequential complexity, such as Littlestone dimension, and can be impossible even for statistically simple classes, such as thresholds of VC dimension one. We study a preview model in which an oblivious adversary fixes an entire labeled sequence of length $T$, a uniformly random subset of size $pT$ is revealed before prediction begins, and the remaining $(1-p)T$ examples are then presented in their original adversarial order.
  Against the best full-sequence hypothesis evaluated on the unrevealed examples, we characterize the dependence on the preview rate $p$: for binary classes of VC dimension $d$, the optimal excess loss is $Θ(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$, up to the trivial cap at $T$; for multiclass classes we obtain the corresponding $\widetilde O(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$ bound with no dependence on the number of labels. Thus a random preview can replace worst-case sequential complexity by classical statistical dimensions without randomizing the online order. To achieve the sharp binary bound, our ChainedPrediction algorithm uses an online analogue of chaining, implemented as a multiscale aggregation algorithm rather than only as an analytic argument.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线分类的"预览"模型：对抗性对手固定整条长度为T的标签序列，在预测开始前随机均匀暴露其中pT个样本，剩余(1-p)T个样本按原始对抗顺序呈现。作者刻画了最优额外损失对预览率p的依赖：对VC维为d的二元类，最优额外损失为Θ(d/p+√dT)；对多类问题得到相应的Õ(d_DS/p+√d_Nat T)界且不依赖标签数。随机预览可将最坏情形序列复杂度（如Littlestone维）替换为经典统计维度，而无需随机化在线顺序。
AI.motivation: 最坏情形在线分类受序列复杂度（如Littlestone维）支配，即使对统计上简单的类别（如VC维为1的阈值）也可能无法学习。作者希望探索一种预览模型，通过预先暴露部分随机样本，将问题的复杂度从难以处理的序列复杂度转移到可处理的经典统计维度，从而在对抗性在线设置中实现可学习性。
AI.method: 作者考虑一个对抗性对手固定长度为T的完整标签序列，随机均匀选择pT个样本在预测前揭示，剩余样本按原始对抗顺序呈现。为了达到二元情形的锐利界，提出了ChainedPrediction算法，该算法使用在线版本的chaining技术，实现为多尺度聚合算法而非仅作为分析论证工具。对于多元类情况，使用d_DS（Dudley/二分复杂度）和d_Nat（Natarajan维度）刻画相应上界。
AI.result: 对于VC维为d的二元类，最优额外损失（相对未揭示样本上的最佳全序列假设）为Θ(d/p+√dT)，上限为T。对于多类情况得到Õ(d_DS/p+√d_Nat T)的界，且不依赖标签数量。这表明随机预览可以将最坏情形序列复杂度替换为经典统计维度，而无需随机化在线顺序。
AI.conclusion: 随机预览机制是弥合在线学习与统计学习之间复杂度鸿沟的有效手段。预览比例p的引入使得原本由Littlestone维等序列复杂度主导的困难问题，转变为由VC维、Natarajan维等经典统计维度控制的良性问题。ChainedPrediction算法的多尺度聚合实现是关键的算法创新，使理论保证得以实际实现。

title: Detecting and Repairing Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to BNAIC/BeNeLearn 2026 as a Type A paper
summary: Language models increasingly answer questions by consulting retrieved documents rather than memory alone, a design now common in search assistants and enterprise knowledge tools. Grounding a model in retrieved text reduces unsupported statements but does not eliminate them, and a reader cannot tell a grounded sentence from an invented one. Most research on this problem stops at detection, yet flagging a faulty answer changes nothing for the person reading it, and little is known about which action should follow. Using RAGTruth, a benchmark whose unsupported passages are annotated by hand, we split each flagged answer into individual factual claims, check each against the retrieved source, and compare leaving the answer untouched with three repair strategies of increasing richness: deleting an unsupported claim, replacing it with source text, and rewriting it. Three language models from different families judge the 916 repaired answers. Every strategy reduces the proportion of answers judged to contain unsupported content, and all three judges agree on the ordering. Deletion achieves the largest reduction while retaining least of the original answer, at 64.3% of the text, whereas rewriting retains 80.1% and reduces least. Repair is not confined to faulty answers: 83.5% of answers annotated clean are edited too. The strategies occupy different points on a grounding preservation trade-off rather than forming a quality ranking, and choosing between them needs evidence about answer usefulness that automatic metrics cannot supply.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RAG系统中检索增强生成的答案修复策略。作者将RAGTruth基准中标记为不支持的答案拆分为事实性声称，比较了四种策略：不处理、删除不支持的声称、用源文本替换、以及重写。三种语言模型对916个修复后的答案进行评判，发现所有修复策略都能减少不支持内容，但删除保留原文最少（64.3%），重写保留最多（80.1%）但减少程度最小。修复不仅限于有问题的答案——83.5%被标注为干净的答案也被修改了。研究表明这些策略处于"接地保留权衡"的不同位置，而非简单的质量排序。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多止步于检测RAG系统中的不实内容，但仅仅标记错误答案对读者毫无帮助。目前缺乏关于"检测之后应该采取什么行动"的系统研究，尤其是不同修复策略的效果和权衡尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用RAGTruth基准（手工标注不支持段落），将每个标记的答案拆分为独立的事实声称，逐一对照检索来源验证，然后比较四种策略：保留原样、删除不支持的声称、用源文本替换、以及重写。使用三个不同系列的LM对916个修复后答案进行评判。
AI.result: 所有修复策略均降低了被判定包含不支持内容的比例，且三个评判模型排序一致。删除策略减少最多但仅保留64.3%原文；重写保留80.1%但减少最少。值得注意的是，83.5%标注为干净的答案也被编辑了。
AI.conclusion: 修复策略并非简单的质量优劣排序，而是代表了"接地性保留"权衡空间中的不同位置。选择何种策略需要关于答案实用性的证据，而这超出了自动评估指标的能力范围。

title: Multi-Step Forecasting of Grape Berry Temperature based on LSTM Model with Feed-Forward Attention
summary: Accurate forecasting of grape berry temperature (Tb) is essential for enabling timely heat stress management in vineyards. In this study, a feed-forward attention mechanism integrated with a Long Short-Term Memory network (FAM-LSTM) was developed and evaluated for multi-step, high-resolution Tb prediction. Models were trained using environmental data from 2023 and 2024 at Prosser, WA, USA, and validated on 2025 summer data. FAM-LSTM was benchmarked against LSTM, GRU, RNN, and Random Forest (RF) across horizons ranging from 15 minutes to 72 hours (288 time steps). Two input scenarios were evaluated: nearest open-field weather station observations and in-vineyard microclimate measurements. FAM-LSTM consistently outperformed all benchmark models across all horizons and input scenarios. Incorporating in-vineyard microclimate data significantly improved forecasting accuracy at longer horizons. Using open-field data, FAM-LSTM achieved MAE and RMSE ranges of 0.58 to 1.70 deg C and 0.65 to 2.07 deg C, respectively. In-vineyard observations further improved performance, with MAE and RMSE in the ranges of 0.51 to 1.55 deg C and 0.71 to 1.87 deg C. Error analysis showed prediction uncertainty was highest during peak daytime periods (11:00 to 18:00) and increased progressively with forecast horizon. Overall, the FAM-LSTM framework offers robust Tb forecasting to support precision heat stress management in vineyards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合前馈注意力机制的LSTM网络（FAM-LSTM），用于葡萄浆果温度（Tb）的多步高分辨率预测。模型在美国华盛顿州Prosser地区2023-2024年数据上训练，并在2025年夏季数据上验证。FAM-LSTM在所有预测时域（15分钟至72小时）和输入场景下均优于LSTM、GRU、RNN和随机森林等基准模型，误差分析显示峰值日间时段预测不确定性最高。
AI.motivation: 葡萄浆果温度（Tb）的准确预报对葡萄园热胁迫的及时管理至关重要，但现有方法在多步高分辨率预测方面精度不足，需要更先进的深度学习模型来提升预测性能。
AI.method: 开发了前馈注意力机制与长短期记忆网络（LSTM）相结合的FAM-LSTM模型。使用2023-2024年Prosser地区的环境数据进行训练，在2025年夏季数据上验证。评估了两种输入场景：最近开放农田气象站观测数据和葡萄园内微气候测量数据，并与LSTM、GRU、RNN和随机森林进行对比，覆盖15分钟到72小时（288步）的预测时域。
AI.result: FAM-LSTM在所有预测时域和输入场景下均优于所有基准模型。使用开放场地数据时MAE为0.58-1.70°C，RMSE为0.65-2.07°C；使用园内微气候数据时MAE改善至0.51-1.55°C，RMSE为0.71-1.87°C。融合园内微气候数据显著提升了长时域预测精度。预测不确定性在日间11:00-18:00峰值时段最高，且随预测时域增加而增大。
AI.conclusion: FAM-LSTM框架为葡萄园精准热胁迫管理提供了稳健的浆果温度预测工具，能够支持及时的热胁迫响应决策。

title: Convergence rates for the RMSprop optimizer with full control of the hyperparameters
summary:
Popular adaptive stochastic gradient descent (SGD) methods to train artificial intelligence (AI) systems include the RMSprop, the Adam, and the AdamW optimizers, where the adaptivity parts in Adam and AdamW basically just coincide with RMSprop. Such adaptive methods involve several hyperparameters including the regularization parameter $ε$ (which ensures that one does not divide by 0 and is often chosen to be very close to zero such as $10^{-8}$ in PyTorch by default) and the second moment decay parameter $β$ (which is often chosen to be very close to $1$ such as 0.99 (RMSprop) and 0.999 (Adam and AdamW) in PyTorch by default). Despite the high relevance of such methods, it remains an open research problem to provide error estimates for such methods with the error constants being not exploding but uniformly bounded with the respect to the hyperparameters, even in the situation of convex stochastic optimization problems.
  It is the key contribution of this work to essentially solve this problem for RMSprop. Specifically, we bound the expectation of the stopped evaluation of the objective function at the RMSprop process from above by the sum of an initialization term that decays exponentially in the training time, a stochastic approximation remainder of order $γ_n$, and a memory error of order $( 1 - β)^2$ with the error constants being uniformly controlled over all admissible choices of the step sizes, the second moment decay parameter $β$ and the regularization parameter $ε\in[0,1]$ (also covering $ε=0$). Our non-asymptotic error estimates hold not just for all sufficiently large n but hold for every gradient step $n=1,2,3,...$ with all error constants being explicitly specified. The key innovative new feature in the proof of our analysis are suitable inverse moment bounds for the second moment process in RMSprop.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RMSprop优化器，在凸随机优化场景下，首次证明了其非渐近误差估计中误差常数关于超参数（步长、二阶矩衰减参数β、正则化参数ε）一致有界，解决了长期未解的关键理论问题。
AI.motivation: 自适应SGD方法（RMSprop、Adam、AdamW）在AI训练中被广泛使用，但其误差估计中的常数会随超参数爆炸的问题一直是开放研究难题。即使对凸随机优化问题，也缺乏误差常数关于超参数一致有界的理论保证。
AI.method: 作者对RMSprop在凸随机优化中的停止评估目标函数期望建立上界，由三项组成：随时间指数衰减的初始化项、阶为γ_n的随机逼近余项、阶为(1-β)²的存储误差项。核心创新在于证明RMSprop二阶矩过程的逆矩界（inverse moment bounds），使得所有误差常数对步长、β∈[0,1]和ε∈[0,1]（含ε=0）一致可控。
AI.result: 获得了对每个梯度步n=1,2,3,...均成立的非渐近误差估计，所有误差常数均显式给出，且覆盖ε=0的极端情况，误差常数关于所有超参数一致有界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实质上解决了RMSprop在凸随机优化中的误差估计常数一致有界性问题，为RMSprop及其相关自适应方法（如Adam）的理论分析奠定了基础。

title: All You Need Is Non-Commutative Words
summary: We represent lexical tokens as unitary matrices and encode each sentence as their ordered product. The noncommutativity of matrix product captures word order without positional encodings (PEs). The same algebra yields several capabilities, including antisymmetric self-attention with no query, key, or value projections, and parallel composition of variable-length text chunks at a reduced attention cost. Furthermore, it provides a canonical-coset readout layer that encodes all true unitary degrees of freedom compactly, while supporting continual learning through nested group extensions that enlarge the operator space with each new task preserving prior representations exactly. Across standard text-classification benchmarks, the method matches or exceeds bag-of-words baselines. Achieving higher accuracy on IMDB and comparable performance on AG News. Notably, this is accomplished by replacing the conventional $\sim$30,000-dimensional vocabulary space with a dense, 64-parameter real-valued encoding, highlighting the expressive efficiency of our parameterization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用酉矩阵表示词元，并通过矩阵乘积的有序性编码句子，从而无需位置编码即可捕获词序信息。该代数框架同时支持无需Q/K/V投影的反对称自注意力、变长文本块的并行组合（降低注意力成本），以及通过典范陪集读出层和嵌套群扩展实现持续学习。在标准文本分类基准上，该方法匹配或超越词袋基线，在IMDB上取得更高准确率，在AG News上表现相当，且仅用64个实值参数替代约3万维的词表空间。
AI.motivation: 传统词袋模型忽略词序信息，而基于位置编码的Transformer等方法需要大量参数且难以高效编码顺序。作者旨在寻找一种既能自然捕获词序、又能减少参数冗余的词汇表示与句子编码方式。
AI.method: 将每个词元表示为酉矩阵，句子编码为其有序乘积。矩阵乘积的非交换性天然编码词序，无需位置编码。该框架实现反对称自注意力（无需query/key/value投影）、变长文本块并行组合，并通过典范陪集读出层紧致编码全部真酉自由度，支持基于嵌套群扩展的持续学习（每学习新任务扩展算子空间，同时精确保留先前表示）。
AI.result: 在标准文本分类基准上，该方法匹配或超越词袋基线：IMDB上取得更高准确率，AG News上性能相当。值得注意的是，仅用64维实值编码即替代了传统的约30,000维词表空间，展现了参数化表达的极高效率。
AI.conclusion: 基于酉矩阵代数的词表示方法能以极低参数开销有效捕获词序并完成文本分类任务，同时在架构上天然支持高效注意力、并行组合和持续学习，验证了矩阵代数作为文本表示基础的高表达效率与扩展潜力。

title: Frequency Selective Neural Networks as a Foundation Architecture for Time Series Learning
summary: Time-series data across physical and biological domains are fundamentally driven by complex, non-stationary oscillatory modes. While deep learning models, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks, and Transformers, have dominated sequential analysis, they remain fundamentally "spectral-blind". By mapping continuous physical waves into unconstrained spatial or discrete token spaces, these architectures suffer from severe spectral entanglement, acting as opaque black boxes that decouple predictive accuracy from physical reality. In this paper, we introduce the Frequency Selective Neural Network (FSNN), pioneering a foundation architecture guaranteeing physical interpretability without sacrificing expressive power of deep learning. FSNN addresses spectral entanglement by explicitly embedding the rigorous mathematics of advanced signal processing into its neural topology. Through a fully differentiable Wiener-like filter bank optimized via complex-domain backpropagation, FSNN autonomously discovers and isolates the precise physical modes of a given task. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FSNN establishes state-of-the-art predictive performance, achieving $77.0\%$ average accuracy on the standard 10 multivariate UEA datasets and leading across all major metrics on the highly imbalanced PTB-XL clinical ECG benchmark. Crucially, in contrast to yielding abstract feature maps, FSNN converges directly on physically meaningful frequency bands, such as isolating the cardiac QRS complex, providing a highly scalable, interpretable paradigm for robust pattern recognition in complex temporal domains. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ad6174hhhh/FSNN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出频率选择性神经网络（FSNN），通过将高级信号处理的数学原理显式嵌入神经拓扑结构中，解决现有深度学习模型（CNN、RNN、Transformer）在时间序列分析中的"频谱盲"问题。FSNN利用全可微的Wiener类滤波器组和复数域反向传播自动发现并隔离物理模态，在10个多元UEA数据集上达到77.0%的平均准确率，并在PTB-XL临床心电基准上表现优异，同时保证物理可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法（CNN、RNN、Transformer）将连续物理波映射到无约束的空间或离散token空间，导致严重的频谱纠缠，模型如同黑箱，预测准确性与物理现实脱节。这些架构本质上"频谱盲"，无法捕捉非平稳振荡模式背后的物理规律。
AI.method: 提出FSNN架构，将先进信号处理的严格数学显式嵌入神经拓扑中。核心组件是一个全可微的Wiener类滤波器组，通过复数域反向传播进行优化，使网络能够自主发现并隔离任务相关的精确物理模态。该设计作为基础架构，在保证深度学习表达能力的同时实现物理可解释性。
AI.result: FSNN在标准10个多元UEA数据集上达到77.0%的平均准确率，实现最先进的预测性能；在高度不平衡的PTB-XL临床心电基准上所有主要指标均领先。模型直接收敛于物理有意义的频带（如隔离心电QRS复合波），而非抽象的特征图。
AI.conclusion: FSNN提供了一种高度可扩展、可解释的时间序列模式识别范式，证明物理可解释性与深度学习表达能力可以兼得。该工作在物理一致性和预测性能之间建立了桥梁，为复杂时间域中的鲁棒模式识别开辟了新路径。

title: On the Plasticity Collapse in Continual Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning enables deep neural networks to selectively remove the influence of specific data in response to privacy and regulatory requirements. While prior work largely studies single-shot unlearning, real-world systems must accommodate continual unlearning, where multiple unlearning requests occur sequentially over time. In this work, we identify a fundamental limitation of this setting: plasticity collapse, a progressive breakdown in a model's ability to effectively forget. Through theoretical analysis of continual unlearning dynamics, we show that continual unlearning operations accumulate geometric constraints in parameter space, leading to saturated subspaces that restrict future updates. This structural effect induces two distinct failure modes: (1) Forward failure -- diminishing forgetting quality for subsequent tasks, and (2) Backward failure -- spontaneous re-memorization of previously forgotten information. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures, datasets, and methods in image classification confirm that plasticity collapse is not an artifact of specific implementations, but a pervasive phenomenon inherent to continual unlearning. Our findings reveal a critical barrier to the long-term reliability of machine unlearning systems and motivate the development of plasticity-preserving unlearning algorithms. Our code is available at https://github.com/TIML-Group/Continual-Machine-Unlearning-Plasticity-Collapse

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了连续机器学习遗忘（continual unlearning）中的一个根本性缺陷——塑性坍塌（plasticity collapse），即模型在进行多次顺序遗忘操作后，参数空间中的几何约束不断累积，导致饱和子空间限制后续更新，最终引发前向失败（遗忘质量下降）和后向失败（已遗忘信息自发回忆）两种失效模式。通过理论分析与大量实验证明该现象是连续遗忘的固有特征，而非特定实现的产物，并呼吁开发保持塑性的遗忘算法。
AI.motivation: 真实世界系统需要支持连续遗忘（多次顺序遗忘请求），但现有研究大多聚焦于单次遗忘。本文发现连续遗忘存在一个此前未被识别的根本性限制——塑性坍塌，它会造成遗忘能力的渐进性崩溃，对机器遗忘系统的长期可靠性构成严重威胁。
AI.method: 本文首先从理论上分析连续遗忘的动态过程，证明遗忘操作会在参数空间中累积几何约束，导致饱和子空间限制未来的更新。基于此理论，识别出两种失效模式：（1）前向失败——后续任务的遗忘质量持续下降；（2）后向失败——先前已遗忘的信息会自发地被重新记忆。并通过跨多种架构、数据集和遗忘方法的图像分类实验验证该现象的普遍性。
AI.result: 在多种架构、数据集和方法的图像分类实验中，塑性坍塌被证实是一种普遍存在的现象，而非特定实现的人为产物。两种失效模式（前向失败和后向失败）均得到实验验证，确认了连续遗忘中模型遗忘能力的系统性退化。
AI.conclusion: 塑性坍塌是连续机器遗忘中固有的关键障碍，揭示了当前机器遗忘系统在长期可靠性方面的重大瓶颈。该发现为未来设计具有塑性保持能力的遗忘算法提供了明确的理论动机和实验基础。

title: Padārtha: Ontology-Grounded Fine-Grained NER Benchmark for Classical Sanskrit
summary: Annotation schemas are not neutral. When applied to classical literature, tag sets developed for modern journalistic texts impose source-culture definitions on texts they were never designed to describe. We instead ground a schema in the tradition of the text itself introducing \textit{Padārtha}, the first ontology-grounded fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark for Sanskrit, built on the \textit{Mahābhārata} epic. Our tag set derives from \textit{Nyāya-Vaiśesika}, a classical Indian ontological system, yielding 18 fine-grained categories organized under 10 ontological nodes and mapped onto five standard coarse tags, ensuring interoperability with existing benchmarks. Expert annotators label over 12.6K entries from a scholarly index of named entities, linked to corresponding mentions in the \textit{Mahānāma} corpus, producing fine-grained annotations for 108,335 entity mentions across 73,632 verses, along with a 5,000-verse expert-verified test set sampled to stress rare mentions. We present the first systematic benchmarking of generative NER against traditional architectures for Sanskrit, finding that fine-tuned generative models perform comparably to task-specific systems. However, all systems show a sharp decline from coarse to fine granularity and struggle with out-of-entity mentions unseen during training. The limitation is not due to data scarcity alone, as fine-tuned models recall unseen entities far worse than seen ones and tend to default to the majority sense under lexical ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Padārtha，首个基于本体论构建的梵语细粒度命名实体识别（NER）基准，基于《摩诃婆罗多》史诗，标签集源自古典印度本体论系统Nyāya-Vaiśesika，包含18个细粒度类别、10个本体节点，并映射到5个标准粗粒度标签。论文标注了108,335个实体提及，并首次系统对比了生成式NER与传统架构在梵语上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的标注模式并非中立，应用于古典文献时，为现代新闻文本设计的标签集会强加源文化定义，无法准确描述古典文本。因此需要一种扎根于文本自身传统的标注模式。
AI.method: 将标签集建立在古典印度本体论系统Nyāya-Vaiśesika之上，形成18个细粒度类别，组织在10个本体节点下，并映射到5个标准粗粒度标签以保证互操作性。专家标注者从学术索引中标注12.6K条目，链接到Mahānāma语料库中的提及，产出108,335个实体提及（覆盖73,632颂）的细粒度标注，以及5,000颂专家验证的测试集。首次系统对比生成式NER与传统架构。
AI.result: 微调的生成式模型与传统任务特定系统表现相当。但所有系统从粗粒度到细粒度均表现显著下降，且在训练中未见过的实体提及上表现挣扎。问题不仅源于数据稀缺——微调模型对未见实体的召回远差于已见实体，且在词汇歧义下倾向于默认多数义项。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为梵语古典文献提供了文化本体引导的NER基准，揭示了生成式模型在细粒度分类和罕见实体泛化上的系统性局限，表明该局限并非单纯由数据量不足导致。

title: Disentangling Representation using Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Medical Sound Diagnosis
comment: 4 figures, 2 tables, code is available at: https://github.com/ZhaoKe1024/DisentangledRepr
summary: Deep learning has a powerful capability of feature extraction. However, the lack of fairness and interpretability in deep neural networks poses limitations to their adoption in the medical domain. This paper proposes a disentangled representation learning (DisenRL) framework, named the Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Disentangled Representation (AGEDR), which incorporates Attribute Mapping Embedding (AME) modules designed to map attributes into vectors and align them with a subset of the latent vectors in a Variational AutoEncoder (VAE). This part of the latent vector will be disentangled from the remaining latent vectors by minimizing mutual information. A classifier is then trained using the mean parameters of the latent vectors from the VAE. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AGEDR outperforms both conventional classification models and existing disentangled representation learning methods. The ablation experiments also indicate the disentangling capability and fairness of AGEDR. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZhaoKe1024/DisentangledRepr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为AGEDR的可解耦表示学习框架，通过属性映射嵌入（AME）模块将属性映射到向量并与VAE中的部分潜变量对齐，通过最小化互信息实现潜变量的解耦，从而提升深度学习模型在医学领域的公平性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络虽具备强大的特征提取能力，但在医学领域中缺乏公平性和可解释性，这限制了其实际应用。作者旨在通过可解耦表示学习来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出AGEDR框架，包含属性映射嵌入（AME）模块，将属性映射为向量并与VAE中潜变量子集对齐；通过最小化互信息使该部分潜变量与其余潜变量解耦；最后利用VAE潜变量的均值参数训练分类器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明AGEDR在性能上优于传统分类模型和现有可解耦表示学习方法；消融实验验证了该方法的解耦能力和公平性。
AI.conclusion: AGEDR通过属性引导的潜变量解耦有效提升了深度学习模型在医学应用中的公平性与可解释性，且代码已公开。

title: MedCache: Efficient and Temporally Valid Memory for Longitudinal Clinical Agents
summary: Longitudinal clinical agents must maintain an evolving patient state from evidence distributed across visits, time points, and specialties. However, how agent memory should be designed for this setting remains unclear. We introduce a benchmark of multi-visit, multi-specialty patient records that evaluates long-context evidence retrieval, cross-time evidence aggregation, and cross-specialty clinical reasoning. Using this benchmark, we systematically study four memory design choices: curation, organization, retrieval, and memory-augmented reasoning. We find that temporal validity is more important than simply retaining more history; specialty-factorized memory reduces context but can hide shared evidence; and multiple agents help when specialists must reason together, not merely when evidence comes from multiple memories. Guided by these findings, we propose \textit{MedCache}, a hybrid framework that constructs temporally valid patient memory, organizes evidence into overlapping specialty views, routes each query to relevant memories, and adaptively invokes one or multiple specialists. Experiments show that MedCache improves reasoning accuracy and memory efficiency over strong single-agent and multi-agent baselines, while generalizing across model backbones and external datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多就诊、多专科的患者医疗记录基准，系统研究了纵向临床代理的记忆设计选择（策展、组织、检索和记忆增强推理），并提出MedCache混合框架，通过时间有效记忆、重叠专科视图、查询路由和自适应多专家调用，在推理准确性和记忆效率上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床代理需要在多次就诊、不同时间点和专科之间维护不断演进的患者状态，但代理记忆应如何设计在此场景中尚不明确，缺乏系统的评估基准和设计指导。
AI.method: 构建多就诊多专科的患者记录基准，系统研究四种记忆设计选择（策展、组织、检索、记忆增强推理），并提出MedCache混合框架：构建时间有效的患者记忆，将证据组织为重叠专家视图，将查询路由到相关记忆，自适应地调用单个或多个专家。
AI.result: 发现时间有效性比简单保留更多历史更重要；专科因子化记忆减少上下文但可能隐藏共享证据；多代理仅在专科需要共同推理时有帮助。MedCache在推理准确性和记忆效率上优于单代理和多代理强基线，并能在不同模型骨干和外部数据集上泛化。
AI.conclusion: 纵向临床代理的记忆设计需要优先考虑时间有效性，并在共享证据与记忆压缩之间取得平衡；MedCache通过混合框架有效结合了单代理的效率和多代理的协作能力。

title: Trajectory-Initialized Neural Double Q-Routing for Large-Scale Overhead Hoist Transport Systems
summary: Large-scale industrial robot fleets share constrained physical infrastructure, making vehicle travel times dependent on safety separation, intersection access, downstream blocking, and station contention. We study this problem in overhead hoist transport (OHT) systems, a representative ceiling-mounted material-handling system used in semiconductor fabs. Static shortest-path routing cannot account for these time-varying traffic costs, whereas tabular Q-routing adapts online but learns each destination--node--action value independently, limiting information sharing across sparsely visited routing contexts and making startup behavior sensitive to inaccurate value estimates. We propose Neural Double Q-routing, which replaces destination-indexed tables with a shared state--action value network. The network is warm-started through return-to-go regression on mixed simulator-generated routing trajectories and then refined online using Double-Q updates, local congestion correction, and event-stratified structured replay. Across nine matched fleet-size--arrival-rate settings with 100, 150, and 200 OHTs, the proposed framework reduces mean completion time relative to tabular Double Q-routing by $0.8\%$--$8.8\%$. It achieves the lowest mean completion time among all compared methods in the six 150- and 200-OHT settings, whereas Dijkstra remains best in the three 100-OHT settings. Completed-task counts remain within $1\%$ of tabular Double Q-routing in eight of nine settings, and 95th-percentile completion time decreases in eight settings. In two matched startup scenarios, offline initialization increases the number of completed tasks by up to $23\%$ and reduces tail completion time by up to $15\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Neural Double Q-routing（神经双Q路由）方法，用于大规模工业机器人车队（以半导体工厂的空中吊挂运输系统OHT为代表）在共享物理基础设施下的路径规划问题。该方法用共享的状态-动作值网络取代传统的按目的地索引的Q表，通过离线模拟轨迹的归因回归进行预热，再结合在线Double-Q更新、局部拥塞修正和事件分层结构化回放进行优化。在9种车队规模-到达率设置下，相比表格型Double Q-routing平均完成时间降低0.8%-8.8%，并在6种150和200 OHT设置中取得最优表现，离线初始化在两种启动场景中最多可提升23%的任务完成数量。
AI.motivation: 传统静态最短路径路由无法适应OHT系统中随时间变化的交通成本（如安全间距、交叉口通行、下游阻塞和站点争用等）；而表格型Q-routing虽能在线自适应，但每个目的地-节点-动作值独立学习，无法在稀疏访问的路由上下文中共享信息，且启动阶段对不准确的值估计非常敏感。因此需要一种能够共享学习且热启动稳健的在线路由方法。
AI.method: 提出Neural Double Q-routing框架，核心包含三个部分：(1) 用共享的神经网络替代目的地索引的Q表来近似状态-动作值函数；(2) 通过混合仿真器生成的路由轨迹进行返程归因回归（return-to-go regression）实现网络热启动；(3) 在线阶段结合Double-Q更新规则、局部拥塞校正机制以及事件分层结构化回放进行持续学习与优化。
AI.result: 在9种匹配的车队规模-到达率设置（100/150/200辆OHT）下，相比表格型Double Q-routing，平均完成时间降低0.8%-8.8%；在6个150和200辆OHT设置中均取得最低平均完成时间，而Dijkstra在3个100辆OHT设置中仍为最优。8/9设置中完成任务数保持在表格型Double Q-routing的1%以内，8个设置中95分位完成时间有所下降。在两种匹配的启动场景中，离线初始化最多可增加23%的完成任务数并减少15%的尾部完成时间。
AI.conclusion: Neural Double Q-routing通过神经网络值函数共享与离线热启动，有效克服了表格型Q-routing在稀疏路由上下文中的信息共享不足和启动敏感性问题，在中大规模OHT车队场景下优于现有路由方法，但在较小规模（100辆OHT）场景中经典Dijkstra仍有优势，表明方法在交通拥堵较轻的场景下优势有限。

title: StageWell: A Process-Aligned Chinese Corpus for Positive-Psychology Support Dialogue
summary: Positive psychology dialogue aims to support emotional distress and positive resource building, requiring models to produce not only empathetic replies but also coherent progression through a multi-turn support process. Existing resources often reduce supervision to turn-level strategies or holistic preference labels, leaving process position, support function, and local repair targets implicit. We introduce StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive psychology dialogue, together with HQS, a structured protocol for data construction and evaluation. StageWell organizes support into a six-stage support process and uses a multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting workflow to construct 12,445 SFT instances, 1,849 DPO preference pairs, and a GroundTruth subset of 120 expert-revised dialogues and 977 QA pairs. Guided by HQS, DPO pairs are built as process-localized repairs: flawed model outputs are used as rejected responses, and targeted rewrites under the same context and stage constraint are used as chosen responses. Across four 9B-14B open-source LLMs, this supervision yields robust gains in process control, response quality, and safety. Averaged across models, BERTScore improves by 0.037, Q-Overall increases by 1.32 points, S-exact increases by 0.236, and the H-critical rate decreases by 0.167. These results highlight the value of modeling supportive dialogue as a structured multi-turn support process rather than as single-turn response generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StageWell，一个面向积极心理学对话的六阶段过程对齐中文语料库，以及HQS结构化数据构建与评估协议。通过多智能体整篇对话重写流程构建了12,445个SFT实例、1,849个DPO偏好对及120篇专家修订对话，将DPO偏好对设计为"过程局部修复"，在多个开源LLM上验证了其在过程控制、响应质量和安全性上的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有积极心理学对话资源将监督简化为单轮策略标签或整体偏好标签，忽略了支持过程中的阶段位置、支持功能和局部修复目标，导致模型缺乏对多轮支持过程的结构化理解与连贯推进能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出六阶段支持过程框架；2) 设计HQS结构化协议用于数据构建与评估；3) 采用多智能体整篇对话重写工作流构建语料；4) 将DPO偏好对构建为过程局部修复——以有缺陷的模型输出为拒绝响应，在同一上下文和阶段约束下的定向改写为选择响应。
AI.result: 在四个9B-14B开源LLM上，BERTScore平均提升0.037，Q-Overall提高1.32分，S-exact提升0.236，H-critical率下降0.167，在过程控制、响应质量和安全性方面均获得稳健增益。
AI.conclusion: 将支持性对话建模为结构化的多轮支持过程而非单轮响应生成，能显著提升模型在积极心理学对话中的表现，验证了过程化建模的价值。

title: Facts Without Rules: Boundary Metadata Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems often coordinate by compressing an upstream interaction into a handoff artifact that downstream agents treat as shared state. We show that this handoff step is a structural source of privacy leakage: summaries preferentially preserve operational facts while weakening the boundary metadata that governs how those facts may be used---a failure mode we call \emph{summary collapse}. On a controlled multi-agent coordination testbed we measure marker survival with a human-validated judge ($κ= 0.74$), where $σ_b = 1$ means every boundary marker survives verbatim and $σ_b = 0$ means all are lost. Boundary-marker and operational-fact survival are nearly uncorrelated at the handoff level on both GPT-5-mini and DeepSeek-R1-32B (Pearson $r$ near zero): uncompressed free-text handoffs preserve boundaries at $σ_b \approx 0.80$, whereas a $25$-word budget drops $σ_b$ to ${\approx}0.57$ while operational-fact survival stays near ceiling. Controlled downstream tests reveal that protection depends on \emph{boundary explicitness}: vague languages leak in $73\%$ of GPT and $50\%$ of DeepSeek cases, while explicit constraints reduce leakage to under $15\%$ across all three tested models. A no-handoff single-agent control further shows the failure is not reducible to multi-agent topology as direct full-marker access still leaks more often than the operationalized handoff. Prompt-only mitigation and exact-string redaction only partially address the problem, while a gold-derived audience allowlist nearly eliminates leakage across models, showing that correctly identifying audience boundaries is the key factor.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示多智能体LLM系统中的"交接摘要"(handoff)环节是结构性隐私泄露源：摘要偏好保留操作性事实，却削弱了约束这些事实使用的边界元数据（称为"摘要坍缩"）。通过受控测试证明边界标记与操作性事实的存活率几乎不相关，压缩预算会显著降低边界保留率；边界明确性决定保护效果，而基于受众的白名单是最有效的缓解手段。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，上游交互被压缩成交接工件，下游智能体将其视为共享状态。作者发现这一交接步骤本身存在结构性的隐私泄露问题，此前工作未对此系统性研究，因此需要识别、量化和缓解这一"摘要坍缩"现象。
AI.method: 在受控多智能体协调测试平台上，使用人类验证的判断器(κ=0.74)测量标记存活率σ_b；跨GPT-5-mini和DeepSeek-R1-32B两个模型比较无压缩自由文本交接与25词预算交接；设计受控下游测试区分模糊与明确的边界约束；设置无交接单智能体对照；测试提示词缓解、精确字符串修订和基于受众的白名单三种缓解策略。
AI.result: 边界标记与操作性事实存活率在手稿层面几乎不相关(Pearson r接近零)；自由文本交接保留边界σ_b≈0.80，25词预算降至σ_b≈0.57而操作事实保持天花板水平；模糊语言在73%的GPT和50%的DeepSeek案例中泄露，明确约束将泄露降至15%以下；无交接单智能体对照反而泄露更多；白名单方法几乎完全消除泄露。
AI.conclusion: 摘要坍缩是多智能体系统固有的隐私泄露源，无法归因于多智能体拓扑本身；识别受众边界是防止泄露的关键因素，基于受众的白名单方法是最有效的缓解手段，而提示词和字符串修订只能部分解决问题。

title: BEACON: Behavioral and Semantic Enrichment of AlphaEarth Embeddings through Tri-Modal Contrastive Learning
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, Accepted by ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026
summary: Geospatial foundation models such as the AlphaEarth Foundation produce compact and globally consistent representations of the Earth's surface that transfer effectively to a wide range of downstream tasks. However, because these models are trained primarily on Earth-observation imagery, their embeddings mainly capture physical and spectral characteristics while encoding human activity and urban function only weakly. To address this limitation, we propose BEACON, a tri-modal contrastive learning framework that aligns three complementary views of urban space: physical representations from AE embeddings, semantic representations from point-of-interest (POI) text, and human behavioral representations from hourly POI visitation, while keeping the deployed representation image-only. Using the Houston Metropolitan Area as a case study area, we evaluated the performance of the BEACON framework on nine downstream tasks, including seven regression and two classification tasks against six baselines (raw coordinates, Space2Vec, SatCLIP, TESSERA, Clay and AlphaEarth), using frozen linear and MLP probes over five seeds. Under a linear probe, BEACON improves relative R^2 over AlphaEarth by up to 43% for obesity prevalence, 34% for poor mental health, and 22% for median household income, while remaining competitive in the prediction of physical and environmental variables. These findings highlight the value of augmenting geospatial foundation models with semantic and behavioral signals, extending their applicability from physical Earth observation to human-centered urban analytics.

AI.tldr: 提出了BEACON框架，一种三模态对比学习框架，通过对齐物理表征（AlphaEarth嵌入）、语义表征（POI文本）和行为表征（POI访问量）来增强地理空间基础模型的城市功能编码能力，在休斯顿大都市区的九项下游任务中显著提升了人类中心指标的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的地理空间基础模型（如AlphaEarth）主要基于地球观测图像训练，其嵌入能够捕捉物理和光谱特征，但对人类活动和城市功能的编码较弱，限制了其在人类中心城市分析中的应用。
AI.method: BEACON是一个三模态对比学习框架，对齐三种互补视角：AlphaEarth嵌入提供的物理表征、POI文本提供的语义表征、以及每小时POI访问量提供的人类行为表征，同时保持部署时的表征仅为图像（无需额外模态输入）。
AI.result: 在休斯顿大都市区的九项下游任务（七项回归、两项分类）中，使用冻结线性探针和MLP探针在五个随机种子下评估，BEACON相对AlphaEarth在线性探针下将肥胖患病率的R²提升最高43%，心理健康不佳提升34%，家庭收入中位数提升22%，同时在物理和环境变量预测上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将语义和行为信号增强到地理空间基础模型中是有价值的，能够将其适用性从物理地球观测扩展到人类中心的城市分析。

title: Learning-Assisted Congestion-Aware Route Scheduling for Semiconductor Fab Material Control Systems
summary: Automated material handling systems in semiconductor fabs are operated by a material control system (MCS) that must schedule a relay route for every transport command online, before execution. This is a data-driven scheduling problem in which route cost is dominated in the upper tail by queueing at heterogeneous, partially observable relay equipment, so route selection requires estimating both delivery time and congestion risk at the decision moment. This paper proposes a transport-network-aware dynamic congestion representation (TN-DCR). Built on a static directed transport graph induced by historically observed relay segments, TN-DCR combines structural route priors, multi-window network-wide congestion context, route-level bottleneck exposure, and an inductive graph-aware route embedding, all constructed under a prediction-time-safety invariant that admits only information observed strictly before the prediction moment. The representation feeds separate queue- and transfer-time regressors and an ordinal multi-label classifier producing calibrated multi-threshold exceedance scores, with an empirical-Bayes stock-key residual correction reducing systematic queue-time underprediction. The predictions serve as costs in a risk-constrained route-scheduling rule that minimizes predicted delivery time subject to a bound on extreme-congestion probability, embedding the learned predictors within a lightweight operations-research decision model. In a controlled closed-loop evaluation, mean delivery time falls by 16.4\% and internal resource waiting time by 22.6\% while throughput remains essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文针对半导体晶圆厂自动化物料搬运系统中的在线中继路径调度问题，提出了一种传输网络感知的动态拥塞表示（TN-DCR），通过结合结构路径先验、多窗口全网拥塞上下文、路径级瓶颈暴露和归纳式图感知路径嵌入，构建预测期安全的数据表示，并配合排队/传输时间回归器、序数多标签分类器及经验贝叶斯库存键残差校正，嵌入风险约束的路径调度决策模型中，在闭环评估中使平均交付时间下降16.4%、内部资源等待时间下降22.6%，且吞吐量基本不变。
AI.motivation: 半导体工厂物料搬运系统中的路径调度是数据驱动的在线决策问题，其路由成本在分布上尾由异质且部分可观测的中继设备的排队行为主导，因此路径选择需要在决策时刻同时估计交付时间和拥塞风险，传统方法难以应对这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出TN-DCR动态拥塞表示方法：基于历史观测中继段构建静态有向传输图，融合结构路径先验、多窗口网络级拥塞上下文、路径级瓶颈暴露及归纳式图感知路径嵌入；在预测期安全不变量约束下仅使用预测时刻之前的信息，配合独立的排队与传输时间回归器、序数多标签分类器生成校准的多阈值超额分数，并用经验贝叶斯库存键残差校正缓解排队时间系统性低估；最终嵌入风险约束的路径调度规则，在极端拥塞概率上界约束下最小化预测交付时间。
AI.result: 在受控闭环评估中，该方法使平均交付时间下降16.4%、内部资源等待时间下降22.6%，同时吞吐量基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了将预测感知的动态拥塞表示与轻量级运筹决策模型结合，能够在不损失吞吐量的前提下显著改善自动化物料搬运系统的路径调度效率，为数据驱动调度与运筹优化融合提供了有效范式。

title: When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization
summary: Large language models deployed in specialized domains must improve in-domain performance without sacrificing general capabilities. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are typically always on: their learned perturbations are applied to every input, which can degrade out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We propose Engram Adapter, a framework that repurposes pretraining-time conditional memory as a post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs. It uses multi-channel matching over local n-gram patterns with explicit occupancy tracking as a lightweight selectivity prior, making residual injection more likely on in-domain inputs while a learned scalar gate suppresses incoherent OOD retrievals. We evaluate on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with AG-News and MedMCQA as adaptation tasks and OOD benchmarks spanning reasoning, translation, code generation, and legal reasoning. Engram Adapter improves in-domain accuracy while preserving 99.4%--100.1% of average OOD performance; on LegalBench it slightly exceeds the frozen base model on average, whereas comparable always-on baselines degrade sharply. Mechanistic analyses show that although OOD activations are non-zero, gate and projection attenuation reduce residuals to approximately 0.08% of hidden-state norm, yielding small KL drift and negligible accuracy change. These results suggest conditional activation is a promising route toward modular, retention-preserving domain specialization over frozen backbones.

AI.tldr: Engram Adapter 是一种将预训练时的条件记忆重新用作冻结LLM后期适配器的框架，通过多通道n-gram匹配和占用跟踪作为选择性先验，加上学习的标量门控抑制OOD检索，在提升领域内精度的同时保留99.4%-100.1%的OOD性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数高效微调方法通常是"始终开启"的，对每个输入都应用学习到的扰动，这会导致领域外(OOD)性能下降。在专用领域部署LLM时，需要在不牺牲通用能力的前提下提升领域内表现。
AI.method: 提出Engram Adapter框架：1) 将预训练时的条件记忆重新用作冻结LLM的后设适配器；2) 使用多通道匹配局部n-gram模式，并显式跟踪占用情况作为轻量级选择性先验；3) 使残差注入更可能发生在领域内输入上；4) 通过学习的标量门控抑制不连贯的OOD检索。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上使用AG-News和MedMCQA作为适配任务，OOD基准涵盖推理、翻译、代码生成和法律推理。Engram Adapter提升领域内准确性，同时保留99.4%-100.1%的平均OOD性能；在LegalBench上平均略超过冻结基础模型，而始终开启的基线方法急剧退化。机理分析显示OOD激活非零，但门控和投影衰减将残差降至隐藏状态范数的约0.08%，产生很小的KL漂移和可忽略的精度变化。
AI.conclusion: 条件激活是实现模块化、保留记忆的领域专业化的有前景途径，能在冻结骨干网络上实现领域适配而不损害通用能力。

title: Learning to Follow In-Context Watermark Instructions via Self-Distillation
summary: In-context watermarking (ICW) prepends an instruction to a query asking the model to embed a statistically detectable signal in its response. It thus equips LLMs with a watermarking interface that third parties can invoke without access to model internals. Its reliability hinges on the LLM following the instruction without degrading answer quality, yet how well current LLMs do so has not been measured. We introduce $\mathsf{ICWBench}$, a benchmark of three verifiable ICW instruction families, each scored on both detectability and answer quality. Evaluating 14 frontier proprietary and open-source LLMs, we find that none of the evaluated LLMs achieves both objectives across all three families. To address this, we propose a self-contained two-stage training method, requiring no distillation from a stronger model, no manual annotation, and no pre-existing ICW IF ability. The first stage, self-distillation with logits perturbation (SDLP), uses the same base LLM as both teacher and student: an instruction-equivalent decoding-time logits perturbation makes the teacher follow the ICW instruction, and the student is trained to match the teacher's output distribution. The second stage applies reinforcement learning with the automatic verifier as the reward. Applied to Qwen3-14B and GPT-OSS-20B, our method raises average TPR@$1\%$FPR across three ICW instructions from $0.100$ to $0.974$ and from $0.337$ to $0.968$, respectively, while maintaining high response quality under both perplexity evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICWBench基准，用于评估上下文水印（ICW）在LLM中的可检测性和回答质量，并发现现有前沿LLM无法同时满足两者。为解决此问题，提出两阶段训练方法（SDLP + RL），无需蒸馏、标注或预存ICW能力，显著提升Qwen3-14B和GPT-OSS-20B的水印可检测性（TPR@1%FPR从0.1提升至0.974），同时保持高质量回答。
AI.motivation: ICW作为一种无需访问模型内部即可调用水印接口的方法，其可靠性依赖于LLM能否遵循指令而不降低回答质量，但现有LLM在这方面的表现尚未被系统测量。作者希望解决这一评估空白并提升模型的ICW能力。
AI.method: 提出ICWBench基准（包含三个可验证的ICW指令家族，从可检测性和回答质量两个维度评分）。在此基础上提出两阶段训练方法：第一阶段SDLP（自蒸馏+logits扰动），用同一基础LLM既当教师又当学生，通过解码时logits扰动让教师遵循ICW指令，学生匹配教师输出分布；第二阶段使用自动验证器作为奖励进行强化学习。
AI.result: 对14个前沿专有和开源LLM的评估显示，没有模型能在三个指令家族中同时实现水印可检测性和高回答质量。应用所提方法后，Qwen3-14B的TPR@1%FPR从0.100提升至0.974，GPT-OSS-20B从0.337提升至0.968，且在困惑度和LLM-as-a-Judge评估下均保持高回答质量。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM的ICW能力普遍不足，但通过提出的两阶段训练方法（无需蒸馏、标注或预存能力）可以显著提升模型的ICW能力，同时不牺牲回答质量，为LLM水印的实际部署提供了可行路径。

title: Arabic Safety Alignment as Selective Refusal: An Empirical Study of SFT, DPO, and Guard Calibration
comment: The Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference(ArabicNLP 2026)
summary: Arabic large language models must refuse harmful prompts without over-refusing benign or sensitive prompts, yet a single refusal rate hides this trade-off. We evaluate it using benign refusal B and harmful-prompt refusal H, where H measures refusal rather than harmful compliance. Across five Arabic-capable models and 130 runs on the full human-written AraSafe set, refusal-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses toward blanket refusal, whereas selected mixed-SFT configurations reach H = 90% to 93% at B = 14% to 23%; four selected configurations exceed the H = 90% target in all three runs, while Fanar does so in two of three. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and inference guards change B and H differently across models rather than acting as uniform upgrades. In a blinded 300-response audit, annotator binary-refusal agreement is 89.0% (kappa = 0.78); Qwen3Guard and Aya Expanse 32B reach 88.7% and 91.0% accuracy, respectively, with no conclusive paired difference. Selected SFT raises H on Arabizi for all five models, but none reaches 90%, showing only partial transfer from Modern Standard Arabic. Overall, the results support model-specific operating-point selection: set a deployment target and retain only interventions that improve it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿拉伯语大语言模型的拒绝行为，提出用良性拒绝率(B)和有害提示拒绝率(H)两个指标替代单一拒绝率来评估，避免掩盖良性提示被过度拒绝与有害提示未被拒绝之间的权衡。通过130次运行、5个模型及全人工编写的AraSafe数据集，发现仅用拒绝样本进行SFT会导致全面拒绝崩塌，而精选的混合SFT配置可在B=14%-23%时达到H=90%-93%。DPO和推理护栏对不同模型影响不同，并非统一升级。盲审300条响应显示注释者二值拒绝一致性达89.0%(kappa=0.78)。选定的SFT在所有模型上提升了Arabizi的H值但均未达90%，说明从现代标准阿拉伯语到方言转移不完整。最终建议按模型选择特定运行点，设定部署目标并只保留能改善目标的干预措施。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅用单一拒绝率衡量安全对齐效果，无法区分良性提示被过度拒绝（影响可用性）与有害提示被拒绝（安全性）之间的权衡。阿拉伯语模型的这类失效模式尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 引入双指标评估框架(B对H)，在5个阿拉伯语能力模型上，在完整的AraSafe数据集上进行130次运行，比较仅拒绝SFT、混合SFT、DPO及推理护栏等多种对齐策略；并设计300条响应的盲审实验验证注释一致性及Guard模型性能。
AI.result: 仅拒绝SFT导致全面拒绝（blanket refusal）；精选混合SFT配置达到H=90%-93%且B=14%-23%，其中4个配置在所有3次运行中超过H=90%目标，Fanar在3次中2次达标。DPO和推理护栏对不同模型产生不同影响。盲审注释者一致性89.0%(kappa=0.78)，Qwen3Guard和Aya Expanse 32B分别达88.7%和91.0%准确率。SFT提升所有模型Arabizi的H但均低于90%。
AI.conclusion: 单一拒绝率不足以评估阿拉伯语大模型的拒绝行为，应采用(H,B)双指标评估并针对不同模型选取特定操作点。对齐干预并非普遍升级，必须根据部署目标筛选。Arabizi等方言的安全对齐仍需进一步改进。

title: EmoLASP: Emotion Recognition with Language Models and Answer Set Programming
comment: 13 pages. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Emotion recognition in conversations is increasingly tackled with language models, but these models can be unstable and expensive to fine-tune or to prompt with long dialogue histories. We propose EmoLASP, a framework that combines a language model with declarative reasoning via Answer Set Programming (ASP) to predict VAD scores (Valence-Arousal-Dominance) in conversations. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset (IEMOCAP) across six open-source LLMs (3B-120B) and two PLMs (BERT, RoBERTa) show that EmoLASP improves prediction performance compared to using the language model alone, even when the LLMs/PLMs are given no dialogue history in their prompts or input vectors. The gains are largest for prompt-only LLMs, which EmoLASP uses without any fine-tuning. However, for fine-tuned PLMs, the reasoner adds little once dialogue history is available. EmoLASP's LLM pipeline demonstrates the potential advantages of using a reasoning approach to ensure emotion prediction consistency and to reduce both the cost of fine-tuning and the cost of prompting with long dialogue histories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EmoLASP框架，将语言模型与基于Answer Set Programming（ASP）的声明式推理相结合，用于对话中的情绪识别（预测VAD分数）。在IEMOCAP基准上对六个开源LLM（3B-120B）和两个PLM（BERT、RoBERTa）的实验表明，EmoLASP相比单独使用语言模型能提升预测性能，尤其在无需微调的纯提示LLM上收益最大，同时降低了微调成本和长对话历史提示成本。
AI.motivation: 对话情绪识别越来越多地使用语言模型，但现有方法存在两大问题：(1) 对长对话历史进行微调或提示既昂贵又不稳定；(2) 缺乏推理机制来确保情绪预测的一致性。作者希望通过引入声明式推理来缓解这些问题。
AI.method: EmoLASP框架将语言模型与ASP（Answer Set Programming）声明式推理相结合。语言模型负责生成初步的情绪预测（VAD分数），ASP推理器则在此基础上进行逻辑推理和约束推理，以优化和确保情绪预测的一致性。该方法兼容多种模型架构，支持纯提示LLM（无需微调）和微调PLM两种模式。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP基准上，EmoLASP在六种LLM（3B-120B）和两种PLM上均优于单独使用语言模型的效果。增益最大的是纯提示LLM（无需微调即可使用EmoLASP）。对于已微调的PLM，当对话历史可用时，推理器带来的增益很小。
AI.conclusion: EmoLASP展示了将推理方法与语言模型结合的潜力，能够在确保情绪预测一致性的同时，降低微调成本以及长对话历史提示的成本，为对话情绪识别提供了一种更高效、更稳定的方案。

title: AlgoWorlds: Benchmarking Tool Use for Global Optimization in Algorithmic Worlds
summary: Tool-use benchmarks generally evaluate whether an agent completes a workflow using appropriate tools and valid arguments. However, feasibility alone is insufficient in real-world decision settings such as route planning and fleet dispatch. Individual choices interact through shared constraints and costs, so a feasible solution may still be substantially suboptimal. This raises a harder question: can an agent turn information gathered through tools into a globally optimal decision? We introduce AlgoWorlds, a benchmark that transforms formally specified combinatorial optimization problems into partially observed decision environments with verifiable global optima. Each environment contains a hidden instance observed only through task-specific information tools, after which the agent commits to one structured decision evaluated for feasibility and optimality. AlgoWorlds contains 240 environments covering ten combinatorial optimization families and four workload levels. Family-specific deterministic programs generate the instances, exact algorithms certify their optima and determine workload levels, and two structurally different tool interfaces present each underlying instance. We evaluate seven leading LLMs, including Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Achieving global optimality remains highly challenging: although leading models produce feasible decisions in most cases, the best-performing model reaches exact optimality in only 38.61% of cases. Even when agents collect sufficient information to reconstruct the hidden instance, most failures end in feasible but suboptimal decisions. The challenge therefore extends beyond information acquisition to information integration, global constraint reasoning, and decision verification. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/AlgoWorlds/, and the code is available at https://github.com/xzx34/AlgoWorlds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AlgoWorlds基准，将组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境，用于检验大语言模型能否通过工具收集信息并做出全局最优决策。评估了7个领先LLM，结果显示最佳模型仅在38.61%的情况下达到精确最优，说明从"可行决策"到"全局最优决策"仍存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有Tool-use基准仅评估智能体能否使用合适工具和有效参数完成工作流，但在路由规划、车队调度等真实决策场景中，个体选择通过共享约束和成本相互影响，可行解未必是全局最优解。因此需要一个新的基准来回答：智能体能否将通过工具获取的信息转化为全局最优决策？
AI.method: AlgoWorlds将正式定义的组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境：每个环境包含隐藏实例（仅能通过任务特定的信息工具观测），智能体提交结构化决策后评估其可行性和最优性。共240个环境，覆盖10个组合优化族和4个工作负载级别；由族特定确定性程序生成实例，精确算法验证最优解，并设计了两种结构不同的工具接口。
AI.result: 评估了7个领先LLM（包括Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.6 Sol），发现：大多数情况下模型能产生可行决策，但最佳模型仅在38.61%的情境中达到精确最优；即使智能体收集了足够重构隐藏实例的信息，多数失败仍以可行但次优决策告终。
AI.conclusion: 全局最优决策的挑战远超信息获取本身，其瓶颈在于信息整合、全局约束推理和决策验证。AlgoWorlds为这一研究方向提供了可验证的测试平台。

title: Let Prompts Bridge Defense Knowledge: Transferable Graph Purification via Vulnerability-Aware GPL
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26). 10 pages, 7 figures, and 4 tables. Shuomin Xue and Jingyuan Li contributed equally to this work
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone for representing complex relational dependencies in diverse multimedia tasks, particularly in cross-platform user interest modeling and cross-modal semantic alignment. In the real world, a practical defense against graph adversarial perturbations is needed. However, we observe that the prevailing adversarial purification methods are essentially domain-restricted defenses, which leads to the following shortcomings: (1) single-domain data provides insufficient structural and semantic diversity for learning robust purification criteria; (2) training of domain-specific defense strategies from scratch consumes substantial computational cost. To address the above limitations, we propose a transferable graph purification scheme, named ProGAP, to bridge adversarial defense knowledge via vulnerability-aware graph prompt learning. Firstly, to capture universal adversarial patterns, a perturbation-capture edge detector is pretrained on data-rich graphs by jointly modeling topological and semantic information. Subsequently, to achieve more knowledge transfer w.r.t. robustness, vulnerability-aware prompts are designed that inject targeted purification guidance into biased nodes, during which the pretrained detector adapts to distribution shifts in downstream graphs without parameter-laborious updates. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our ProGAP achieves 1%-9% improvement, and reduces the time consumption by up to 2.2x. The code for ProGAP is available at https://github.com/Lieyoufffff/ProGAP.

AI.tldr: 提出ProGAP，一种可迁移的图净化方案，通过漏洞感知的图提示学习在不同域间桥接对抗防御知识，解决现有对抗净化方法仅针对单一域防御的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有图对抗净化方法本质上是域受限的防御，存在两个不足：(1)单域数据缺乏足够的结构和语义多样性，难以学习鲁棒的净化标准；(2)从头训练特定域的防御策略计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 首先，在数据丰富的图上预训练一个扰动捕获边检测器，联合建模拓扑和语义信息以捕获通用对抗模式；其次，设计漏洞感知提示，为有偏节点注入针对性的净化指导，使预训练检测器无需大量参数更新即可适应下游图的分布偏移。
AI.result: 与最先进的基线相比，ProGAP在性能上提升1%-9%，时间消耗最多减少2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: ProGAP通过可迁移的图净化方案有效解决了跨域对抗防御知识迁移问题，在提升鲁棒性的同时大幅降低了计算成本。

title: HoopMind: A Real-Time Neural Game-Tree System for Opponent-Aware Possession Planning
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, 2 algorithms. Submitted to the IEEE ICDM 2026 Teen Research Symposium. Code and live demo: https://github.com/sujo666/hoopmind
summary: School coaches prepare for opponents with game film and intuition. The analytics tools of professional teams stay out of reach. We ask how far public data can close this gap. Professional basketball is our case study, chosen for its data rather than the league. We fuse five public sources into one per-shot dataset of 4.23M shots over 21 seasons. The sources are shot locations, two play-by-play feeds, official matchup tracking, and player biometrics. Alignment across them is 99.5% to 100%. We also report two data pitfalls that are easy to miss. We then model a half-court possession as a sequential game. Shot values come from ShotNet, an embedding multilayer perceptron (MLP). On a held-out season it beats a zone-rate baseline and a logistic baseline, and its probabilities are well calibrated. A depth-limited expectimax search then solves the offensive decision tree, with branch-and-bound pruning to keep it real time. All training runs offline, so the online system stays light. A scouting planner and a playable simulator both run in a single browser page.

AI.tldr: 本研究融合五个公开数据源，构建了包含423万次投篮、覆盖21个赛季的职业篮球数据集（对齐率达99.5%-100%），并基于此开发了ShotNet模型和深度受限的expectimax搜索算法，用于半场进攻决策分析，最终以可运行于单浏览器页面的侦察规划器和可玩模拟器形式呈现。
AI.motivation: 校队教练只能靠比赛录像和直觉来准备对手，无法使用职业球队的分析工具。作者希望探究公开数据能在多大程度上缩小这一差距，为资源有限的球队提供可用的分析能力。
AI.method: 融合五个公开数据源（投篮位置、两个play-by-play数据流、官方对位追踪、球员生物特征）构建统一数据集；开发ShotNet（嵌入多层感知机）预测投篮价值，并通过深度受限的expectimax搜索结合分支定界剪枝来求解进攻决策树，所有训练离线完成以保持在线系统轻量。
AI.result: 数据对齐率达99.5%-100%；ShotNet在保留赛季上优于区域比率基线和逻辑回归基线，概率校准良好；expectimax搜索通过剪枝可实时运行；整个系统（侦察规划器和模拟器）可在单浏览器页面中运行。
AI.conclusion: 通过公开数据融合和轻量级建模，可以构建接近职业级别的篮球分析工具，显著缩小校队与职业球队之间的数据分析差距。同时论文还报告了两个容易被忽视的数据陷阱，为后续研究提供参考。

title: Evaluating the Semantic Specificity of Representation Steering in Language Models
summary: Localized Representation Steering (LRS) is widely used to correct reasoning pathologies in large language models. However, standard benchmark evaluations can easily be fooled by superficial label overrides, creating a false impression of reasoning circuit repairs. In this work, we propose Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT), a diagnostic framework that audits representational interventions by evaluating them on rule families where the model is natively competent. Evaluating late-layer LRS for a widespread logical failure, contradiction blindness, reveals that the intervention merely injects a global label bias: applying the steering vector to rules the model already handles correctly (99.6% baseline) degrades performance to 40.4% by forcing false contradiction predictions. We support this diagnosis with four complementary controls (direct logit bias equivalence, control vector label-flipping, cross-model grafting, and early-layer steering checks), providing a rigorous methodology to distinguish genuine reasoning repairs from superficial label overrides.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)框架，用于审计大语言模型中局部表征引导（LRS）干预是否真正修复了推理缺陷，还是仅仅注入了表面的标签偏差。通过将干预应用到模型本就擅长处理的规则上，发现LRS实际上只是强制加入全局标签偏差，导致性能从99.6%骤降至40.4%，并非真正的推理电路修复。
AI.motivation: 标准基准评估容易被表面的标签覆盖所欺骗，造成推理电路已被修复的虚假印象。需要一种更严格的诊断方法来区分真正的推理修复与表面性的标签覆盖。
AI.method: 提出CRT诊断框架，将表征干预应用于模型天然擅长的规则家族上进行评估；并采纳四种互补对照验证：直接logit偏差等价性、控制向量标签翻转、跨模型移植、早期层引导检查。
AI.result: 对晚期层LRS在矛盾盲视（contradiction blindness）这一逻辑缺陷上的评估表明，干预仅注入了全局标签偏差：将引导向量应用于模型已正确处理的规则（99.6%基线）时，性能降至40.4%，说明干预强迫产生错误的矛盾预测。
AI.conclusion: LRS在大语言模型上的应用并非如表面所见修复了推理电路，而是通过注入标签偏差掩盖了问题。CRT为区分真正的推理修复与表面的标签覆盖提供了严谨的方法论。

title: Agent2UCB: Agentic System for Generative Engine Optimization
summary: Large language model driven search engines such as Google AI Overviews and Perplexity have created new opportunities for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) the practice of refining content to increase its likelihood of being cited or summarized by generative systems. We demonstrate Agent2UCB, an agentic GEO system that autonomously improves content visibility through customized, feedback-driven optimization. For each content item, the system evaluates nine GEO strategies, identifies the most effective method, and accelerates selection using a bandit-based Agent2UCB policy that integrates LLM priors with online reward signals. To monitor side effects, the system also provides a lightweight, text-only SEO readiness evaluation covering readability, topical coverage, and EEAT-style credibility. Experiments on GEO-Bench show consistent visibility gains while preserving SEO quality. The demo allows users to choose the websites of interest, observe the optimization workflow, and compare GEO/SEO outcomes across methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent2UCB，一种基于智能体的生成式引擎优化（GEO）系统，利用bandit策略结合LLM先验和在线奖励信号，自动为内容选择最优的九种GEO策略以提升在生成式搜索引擎中的可见性，同时通过轻量级文本SEO评估监控副作用。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型驱动的搜索引擎（如Google AI Overviews和Perplexity）改变了内容被发现的方式，催生了GEO这一新领域。现有方法缺乏自动化和反馈驱动的优化机制，需要一种能够自主评估多种策略并根据反馈迭代优化的系统。
AI.method: Agent2UCB系统对每个内容项评估九种GEO策略，使用基于bandit的Agent2UCB策略（整合LLM先验与在线奖励信号）加速最优策略的选择，并提供轻量级文本SEO就绪度评估（涵盖可读性、主题覆盖和EEAT式可信度）来监控优化带来的副作用。
AI.result: 在GEO-Bench基准上的实验显示一致的可见性提升，同时保持了SEO质量不下降。系统演示支持用户选择感兴趣网站、观察优化工作流并比较GEO/SEO结果。
AI.conclusion: Agent2UCB证明了将智能体方法与bandit学习结合可以有效地进行生成式引擎优化，在提升内容可见性的同时保持SEO质量，为该领域提供了可复用且可监控的自动化优化框架。

title: Whose Assessment of Distress? Community Perspectives and LLM Alignment on Well-Being Posts
summary: Judgments about psychological distress are socially situated: what counts as concerning hinges on community norms around emotional expression, vulnerability, and help-seeking. Yet large language models (LLMs) used for distress detection are typically aligned to a single, undifferentiated standard. How well do these models capture the perspectives of the communities whose language they assess? We address this question through a perspectivist annotation study in which 321 participants provided 9,587 judgments on 1,198 Reddit posts spanning six identity-based communities, yielding community-specific labels. Raters in the contextualized in-group condition show a modest tendency to agree more with their community than uncontextualized out-group raters (OR = 1.18), an effect varying significantly across communities. We then evaluate nine open-weight LLM configurations and four frontier configurations against these labels. Open-weight LLMs systematically over-estimate distress: when communities perceive none-to-mild distress, these models achieve only 31-44% accuracy, predominantly producing false positives. GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro show the same none-to-mild inflation even when their full-sample over/under rates are mixed, while Claude Opus 4 is more conservative. This pattern does not simply mirror an outsider reading position: uncontextualized out-group human aggregates were nearly symmetric, with 18% over-estimation versus 19% under-estimation. Instead, the models that inflate none-to-mild cases exhibit a distress prior that exceeds both contextualized in-group and uncontextualized out-group human judgments. These findings have implications for equitable AI deployment in mental health contexts, where miscalibrated distress detection may unevenly affect the communities being assessed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过perspectivist标注研究（321名参与者对6个身份群体的1,198条Reddit帖子提供9,587条判断），发现LLM在心理困扰检测中系统性地高估困扰程度，尤其在社区认为无到轻度困扰的情况下，开源模型准确率仅31-44%。这种偏差源于模型的"distress prior"超过人类判断，可能对心理健康的AI部署产生不公平影响。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM用于心理困扰检测时被对齐到单一标准，忽略了心理困扰判断本质上是社会情境化的——不同社区对情绪表达、脆弱性和求助的规范各不相同。研究旨在回答：这些模型在多大程度上能捕捉其所评估社区的语言视角？
AI.method: 1) 进行perspectivist标注研究：321名参与者对6个身份相关社区的1,198条Reddit帖子提供9,587条判断，产生社区特异性标签；2) 比较情境化的内群体标注者与未情境化的外群体标注者的一致性（OR=1.18）；3) 评估9种开源LLM配置和4种前沿模型配置（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4等）在这些标签上的表现。
AI.result: 开源LLM系统性高估困扰：当社区认为无到轻度困扰时，模型准确率仅31-44%，主要为假阳性。GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro同样存在此问题，而Claude Opus 4更保守。未情境化的外群体人类聚合判断几乎对称（18%高估 vs 19%低估），说明模型偏差并非简单的外来者视角，而是模型具有超过两类人类判断的distress prior。
AI.conclusion: LLM的困扰检测校准不当可能导致对特定社区的不均衡影响，这对心理健康领域的公平AI部署具有重要意义。模型并非简单地复制外群体视角，而是表现出一种系统性高估困扰的固有偏差。

title: Revolutionizing Turn-by-Turn Navigation with Cloud-Edge Deep Learning
comment: This paper has accepted by IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: Turn-by-turn (TBT) navigation systems are integral to modern driving experiences, providing real-time audio instructions to guide drivers safely to destinations. However, existing audio instruction policy often relies on rule-based approaches that struggle to balance informational content with cognitive load, potentially leading to driver confusion or missed turns in complex environments. To overcome these difficulties, we first model the generation of navigation instructions as a multi-task learning problem by decomposing the audio content into combinations of modular elements. Then, we propose a novel deep learning framework that leverages the powerful spatiotemporal information processing capabilities of Transformers and the strong multi-task learning abilities of Mixture of Experts (MoE) to generate real-time, context-aware audio instructions for TBT driving navigation. A cloud-edge collaborative architecture is implemented to handle the computational demands of the model, ensuring scalability and real-time performance for practical applications. Experimental results in the real world demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces the yaw rate (the proportion of vehicles deviating from navigation routes) compared to traditional methods, delivering clearer and more effective audio instructions. This is the first large-scale application of deep learning in driving audio navigation, marking a substantial advancement in intelligent transportation and driving assistance technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer和混合专家（MoE）的深度学习方法，用于生成逐向（TBT）驾驶导航的实时音频指令。通过将导航指令生成建模为多任务学习问题（分解为模块化元素），并采用云边协同架构，该方法在真实世界中显著降低了车辆偏离导航路线的偏航率，是深度学习在驾驶音频导航领域的首次大规模应用。
AI.motivation: 现有的TBT导航音频指令策略依赖基于规则的方法，难以在信息含量和认知负荷之间取得平衡，在复杂环境中可能导致驾驶员困惑或错过转弯。因此需要更智能的方法来生成适时且上下文感知的音频导航指令。
AI.method: 首先将导航指令生成建模为多任务学习问题，将音频内容分解为模块化元素的组合；然后提出结合Transformer（强大的时空信息处理能力）与MoE（强大多任务学习能力）的深度学习框架来生成实时、上下文感知的音频指令；最后通过云边协同架构处理模型计算需求，保证可扩展性和实时性能。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明，与传统方法相比，所提方法显著降低了偏航率（偏离导航路线的车辆比例），提供更清晰、更有效的音频指令。
AI.conclusion: 这是深度学习在驾驶音频导航中的首次大规模应用，标志着智能交通和驾驶辅助技术的重大进步。

title: Predicting the Unpredictable: LLM-powered Long-term Chaotic Time Series Forecasting under Short-term Observations
summary: Chaotic time series forecasting is a challenging task due to its sensitivity to initial conditions and long-term unpredictability. Traditional methods typically rely on sufficient temporal trajectories to learn long-term dynamics, which limits their applicability when only short-term observations are available.
