While recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great potential for time series forecasting, their temporal representations are not explicitly tailored to the phase-space structure and nonlinear evolution of chaotic systems. To address these issues, we propose PAC-LLM, a phase-space-aware adaptive fusion framework for long-term chaotic time series forecasting powered by LLMs. PAC-LLM leverages learned phase-space features and textual information to fully enable LLM's time series forecasting capacity. In particular, we design an auxiliary feature module and a gated weighting mechanism for multivariate coupling information fusion and selection. Extensive experiments on representative chaotic systems demonstrate that our method outperforms existing fine-tuned and zero-shot baselines in both short-term and long-term predictions. Our ablation study further confirms the effectiveness of each key component in PAC-LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAC-LLM，一种面向长期混沌时间序列预测的相空间感知自适应融合框架。它利用学习到的相空间特征和文本信息，通过辅助特征模块和门控加权机制实现多变量耦合信息融合与选择，在短期和长期预测上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 混沌时间序列预测因对初始条件敏感和长期不可预测性而极具挑战。传统方法依赖充足的时间轨迹来学习长期动态，在仅有短期观测时受限；而现有LLM的时间序列表示未显式针对混沌系统的相空间结构和非线性演化进行定制。
AI.method: PAC-LLM框架包含三个关键部分：(1)利用学习的相空间特征捕捉混沌系统状态空间结构；(2)利用文本信息增强LLM的时间序列理解能力；(3)设计辅助特征模块和门控加权机制，用于多变量耦合信息的融合与选择，充分释放LLM的时间序列预测能力。
AI.result: 在代表性混沌系统上的大量实验表明，PAC-LLM在短期和长期预测任务中均优于现有的微调和零样本基线；消融研究进一步验证了每个关键组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PAC-LLM通过显式引入相空间感知特征，有效弥补了LLM在混沌系统时间序列表示上的不足，为利用大语言模型进行长期混沌预测提供了一种可行的融合框架。

title: AI Can Be Easily Persuaded in Clinical Decision Making
summary: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical practice, it is playing a growing role in medical decision making. Medicine, however, is a high stakes and evidence based field, where decisions can directly affect patients' lives. It is therefore important to understand whether AI can maintain objective judgment when others try to persuade it. In this paper, we study how easily AI can be persuaded through controlled experiments. We find that professional authority, national background, institutional affiliation, claimed past performance, multiple physicians, supported clinician views, and repeated pressure can all affect AI decisions. Surprisingly, the same persuasive input changes about 10% more cases when it comes from a senior clinician than from a medical student. Simply claiming a better performance history consistently makes the physician more persuasive. More strikingly, a plausible clinician view can persuade AI away from a correct decision even when it is fabricated to support an incorrect answer. This indicates that AI can be strongly influenced by convincing support without reliably determining whether this view from the clinician is correct. Together, these findings suggest that AI can be easily persuaded by what people say, who says it, and how the opinion is presented. Therefore, it is essential for AI to maintain sound judgment under persuasion, enabling its safe and reliable use in high stakes medical decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验研究了AI在临床决策中如何被说服影响，发现专业权威、背景、过往表现声称、医生数量、支持性观点及重复压力都会影响AI决策，甚至虚构但看似合理的临床观点也能让AI偏离正确答案，表明AI容易被各种说服因素左右，需要保持稳健判断以确保安全可靠。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在临床实践中的深入应用，其在医疗决策中扮演越来越重要的角色。由于医学是高风险且基于证据的领域，决策直接影响患者生命，因此理解AI在面对他人的说服时能否保持客观判断至关重要。
AI.method: 通过受控实验系统地研究AI如何被说服，操纵不同的说服输入变量（包括专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属、过往表现声称、多位医生支持、临床观点支持及重复压力）来观察对AI决策的影响。
AI.result: 专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属、过往表现声称、多位医生、支持的临床观点和重复压力均能影响AI决策。同一说服输入来自资深临床医生比来自医学生多改变约10%的案例；简单声称更好的过往表现就能提高说服力；虚构但看似合理的临床观点能说服AI偏离正确答案。
AI.conclusion: AI容易被人们说什么、谁在说以及观点如何呈现所强烈影响，且无法可靠判断临床观点的正确性。因此，需要确保AI在说服压力下保持稳健判断，以实现高风险医疗决策中的安全可靠使用。

title: Nested Convex-Body Chasing for Online Optimization with Evolving Feasible Sets
summary:
We study online optimization with nested shrinking feasible regions in two settings: convex optimization with nested evolving feasible sets (CONES) and adversarial constrained online convex optimization (COCO). Our algorithms separate loss control from geometric movement: constrained minimizers and cumulative-loss tests preserve regret guarantees, while a deterministic resettable nested convex-body chaser limits movement.
  For CONES with a $G$-Lipschitz, $μ$-strongly convex objective on a diameter-$D$ domain, we chase intersections of the current feasible set with adaptive objective sublevel sets. Using the Euclidean chasing ratio $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)})$, we obtain nonpositive regret at every prefix and movement $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)\,GD\log(eT)/μ})$. The bound adapts to the increase in the constrained optimum value. In dimension two, with all other parameters fixed, every randomized algorithm with terminal expected regret $O(T^β)$, $β<1$, suffers $Ω(\sqrt{\log T})$ expected movement on some deterministic nested sequence, proving optimal horizon dependence. Under linear growth away from the constrained minimizer set, Steiner-point tracking yields movement independent of $T$.
  For general convex COCO, one-step-delayed chasing with regularized-leader resets gives regret $O(G_fD\sqrt{d\log(1+d)T})$ and cumulative constraint violation $O(G_gD\sqrt{d\log(1+d)T})$. For strongly convex losses, both are $O(d\log(1+d)\log(eT))$ when other parameters are fixed. These reductions replace the $O(d^{d/2})$ projection-path factor in prior analyses by the polynomial dimension dependence of Euclidean nested convex-body chasing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有嵌套收缩可行域的在线优化问题，涵盖凸优化与对抗性约束在线凸优化两种设置。通过将损失控制与几何移动分离，利用确定性可重置嵌套凸体追踪器，将先验分析中的指数维度依赖替换为多项式维度依赖，并在多种场景下取得最优或近最优的遗憾与移动量界。
AI.motivation: 在线优化中，可行域随时间嵌套收缩的问题（如资源动态缩减、约束逐步收紧）在理论和实践中具有挑战性。此前方法依赖于投影路径，其维度依赖达到O(d^{d/2})，在高效维度下不实用。作者旨在开发一种将损失控制与几何移动解耦的方法，以获得多项式维度依赖的遗憾与移动界。
AI.method: 核心方法是"分离损失控制与几何移动"：使用约束极小化器（constrained minimizers）和累积损失测试（cumulative-loss tests）来保持遗憾保证，同时引入确定性的可重置嵌套凸体追踪器（deterministic resettable nested convex-body chaser）来限制移动。具体包含：(1) 对CONES问题，追踪当前可行集与自适应目标子水平集的交集，利用欧几里得追踪比O(√(d log(1+d)))；(2) 对COCO问题，采用一步延迟追踪与正则化领导者重置，实现遗憾和约束违反的最优界。
AI.result: (1) CONES：获得每个前缀非正遗憾，移动量为O(√(d log(1+d) GD log(eT)/μ))，适应约束最优值增长；二维情况下证明Ω(√log T)期望移动下界，证明时间依赖最优；(2) 线性增长条件下Steiner点追踪可实现与T无关的移动；(3) COCO：一般凸情形遗憾和约束违反均为O(G_fD√(d log(1+d)T))；强凸情形均为O(d log(1+d) log(eT))。这些结果用多项式维度依赖替代了先前的O(d^{d/2})投影路径因子。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将损失控制与几何移动解耦的框架，显著改进了嵌套收缩可行域在线优化的复杂度分析，将维度依赖从指数级降低到多项式级，并在多个设定下取得最优或近最优的遗憾-移动权衡。这为约束在线优化提供了一种新的高效方法论。

title: On the Resilience of Text-to-Video Diffusion Models to Hardware Faults
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop on From Frames to Stories (F2S)
summary: We present the first systematic study of the resilience of text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models under random hardware-level faults. While T2V models are widely used for automated video generation due to their ability to produce high-quality, temporally coherent, and realistic videos, their iterative denoising process and spatiotemporal dependencies introduce unique failure modes. We perform an extensive fault-injection study covering both computational and memory faults across three T2V models and a representative benchmark. Our results show that (1) a single fault can degrade overall performance by up to 3.7\%, with semantic correctness more affected than perceptual quality; (2) memory faults are more damaging than computational faults, high-order exponent bits are particularly vulnerable, and the widely-used bfloat16 is more susceptible than alternative formats; and (3) 7-28\% of faults cause visible artifacts, including semantic changes such as added objects, suggesting that single faults are sufficient to alter output semantics. Our findings reveal reliability risks in deployed T2V systems and motivate further research on improving fault resilience. Code: \href{https://github.com/ztcoalson/T2V-Resilience}{https://github.com/ztcoalson/T2V-Resilience}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了文本到视频（T2V）扩散模型在随机硬件级故障下的鲁棒性。通过涵盖计算和内存故障的大量故障注入实验，对三种T2V模型和代表性基准进行测试，发现单个故障可使整体性能下降最多3.7%，语义正确性比感知质量受影响更大；内存故障比计算故障更具破坏性，高阶指数位尤为脆弱，bfloat16比替代格式更易受影响；7-28%的故障会导致可见伪影，包括新增物体等语义变化。
AI.motivation: T2V扩散模型被广泛用于自动视频生成，但其迭代去噪过程和时空依赖引入了独特的故障模式。以往缺乏对T2V模型在硬件故障（如软错误）下鲁棒性的系统性研究，而已部署系统面临此类可靠性风险，亟需评估和缓解。
AI.method: 采用故障注入方法，系统性地对三种T2V扩散模型进行随机硬件级故障注入实验。故障类型覆盖计算故障和内存故障，使用代表性视频生成基准进行评估，从性能（感知质量和语义正确性）以及可见伪影两个维度分析故障影响，并对比不同故障位置和数值格式（如bfloat16等）的脆弱性。
AI.result: （1）单个硬件故障可使整体性能下降最高3.7%，且语义正确性比感知质量更受影响；（2）内存故障比计算故障破坏性更强，高位指数位最脆弱，bfloat16格式比替代格式更敏感；（3）7-28%的故障会产生可见伪影，包括语义层面的改变（如新增物体），说明单个故障就足以改变输出语义。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了已部署T2V系统中存在的可靠性风险，证明了单个硬件故障足以导致显著性能下降甚至语义变化，为后续提升T2V模型故障鲁棒性的研究提供了动机和基础。

title: HANIA: Planner-Guided Multimodal Graph Evidence Selection for Grounded Question Answering
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at Graph-enhanced LLMs for trustwOrthy Web data management (GLOW), ISWC 2026 Workshops, Bari, Italy
summary: Multimodal question answering remains sensitive to noisy, incomplete, and weakly grounded evidence. Long unstructured contexts can introduce redundancy and encourage unsupported generation, while flat retrieval may overlook relations needed for multi-step reasoning. We present HANIA, a planner-guided multimodal graph framework for evidence-grounded question answering. HANIA processes the supplied image and text using a frozen vision-language model to extract concise question-relevant visual evidence with explicit abstention. It then constructs an input-grounded multimodal graph and applies a two-group finite-state planner to coordinate descriptive and relational evidence. Coverage-aware pruning retains a compact evidence set based on relevance, graph confidence, concept coverage, and modality diversity. The selected passages, visual statements, and graph triples are provided to a frozen instruction-tuned decoder. We evaluate HANIA on ScienceQA using answer accuracy, evidence-filtering quality, evidence-budget sensitivity, and efficiency. The results show that structured evidence planning and compact graph-guided retrieval can support competitive multimodal question answering without target-dataset fine-tuning or iterative retrieval. The code is available at https://github.com/Zafar-southeast/HANIA.

AI.tldr: HANIA是一个基于规划器引导的多模态图框架，用于证据支持的问答任务。它从冻结的视觉-语言模型中提取与问题相关的视觉证据，构建输入支撑的多模态图，并通过两群有限状态规划器协调描述性和关系性证据，配合覆盖感知剪枝保留紧凑的证据集，最终在冻结的解码器上生成答案。
AI.motivation: 多模态问答对嘈杂、不完整和弱证据支撑的问题敏感。长非结构化上下文引入冗余并鼓励无支撑生成，而扁平检索可能遗漏多步推理所需的关联关系。
AI.method: HANIA首先使用冻结的视觉-语言模型从图像和文本中提取简洁、问题相关的视觉证据（含显式弃权机制），然后构建输入支撑的多模态图，应用两群有限状态规划器来协调描述性和关系性证据。通过覆盖感知剪枝（基于相关性、图置信度、概念覆盖和模态多样性）保留紧凑证据集，最后将选定的段落、视觉陈述和图三元组提供给冻结的指令微调解码器生成答案。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA上从答案准确率、证据过滤质量、证据预算敏感性和效率四个维度进行评估。结果显示，结构化证据规划和紧凑图引导检索能够在无需目标数据集微调或迭代检索的情况下，实现具有竞争力的多模态问答性能。
AI.conclusion: HANIA证明了通过结构化证据规划和图引导的紧凑检索，可以在不依赖目标数据集微调或迭代检索的条件下支持具有竞争力的多模态问答，为证据支撑的多模态推理提供了一种高效而鲁棒的方案。

title: Adaptive Doubly Robust Off-Policy Evaluation for Ranking Policies under Diverse User Behavior
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at CONSEQUENCES 2026 and selected for oral presentation
summary: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) of ranking policies is challenging be- cause selecting and ordering multiple items from a candidate set makes the number of possible rankings grow combinatorially with the number of candidates and the ranking length. Consequently, Inverse Propensity Scoring (IPS), whose importance weight is the full-ranking probability ratio under the evaluation and logging policies, can have excessive variance. Independent IPS (IIPS) and Reward Interaction IPS (RIPS) reduce variance by imposing fixed assumptions on how users browse rankings, but may introduce bias when those assumptions mismatch actual behavior. Adaptive Inverse Propensity Scoring (AIPS) addresses this trade-off by adap- tively marginalizing importance weights over the actions that affect each position-wise reward. It attains minimum variance within a class of unbiased IPS-based estimators when the true user be- havior model is observed. However, its estimation accuracy may still degrade for longer rankings, and AIPS does not use a reward model for residual correction. We propose Adaptive Doubly Robust (ADR), which combines adaptive importance weighting with re- ward regression through a control-variate correction. We establish its unbiasedness when the true user behavior model is observed and characterize a sufficient condition under which it reduces vari- ance relative to AIPS. Across synthetic experiments with 10,000 simulations per condition, ADR improves mean squared error over AIPS and conventional ranking OPE estimators across a range of logged-data sizes and ranking lengths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应双稳健（ADR）方法，用于排名策略的离线策略评估（OPE）。ADR结合自适应重要性加权与奖励回归的控制变量校正，在观察到真实用户行为模型时保持无偏性，并能相较AIPS进一步降低方差，在合成实验中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 排名策略的OPE具有挑战性，因为选择与排序多个候选项导致可能排名数量呈组合式增长。IPS重要性权重为完整排名概率比，方差过大。IIPS和RIPS通过固定假设减少方差但可能引入偏差。AIPS自适应边际化重要性权重，但在更长排名下精度下降，且未使用奖励模型进行残差校正。
AI.method: 提出自适应双稳健（ADR）估计器，将自适应重要性加权与奖励回归通过控制变量校正相结合。当真实用户行为模型被观测到时证明其无偏性，并刻画了相对AIPS降低方差的充分条件。
AI.result: 在每条件10,000次模拟的合成实验中，ADR在多种日志数据规模和排名长度下，均较AIPS与传统排名OPE估计器提升了均方误差（MSE）表现。
AI.conclusion: ADR通过奖励回归的残差校正弥补了AIPS在长排名场景下的精度不足，在保持无偏性的同时有效降低了估计方差，是排名策略OPE中更具鲁棒性的估计方法。

title: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer. Existing faithfulness tests often place explicit bias cues in the user message, while agents may encounter preferences through tool returns or raw artifacts. We introduce FACE-Eval (Faithful Attribution of Cue Effects Evaluation), a 5,100-sample evaluation that varies cue location (user message or tool return) and explicitness (direct summary or raw artifact). We measure verbalized commitment among cue-following answers and unverbalized adoption among all cued samples. We evaluate 15 open-weight models from eight families, with total parameters ranging from 4B to 1.60T. Every model has lower verbalized commitment for tool-return than user-message cues and for implicit than explicit cues. Unverbalized adoption is higher for tool-return cues on all 15 models and for implicit cues in 28 of 30 model-channel comparisons. A source-attribution prompt narrows the channel gap on seven models, sometimes by increasing user-channel unverbalized adoption, while telling models that their reasoning will be monitored does not reliably close the gap. We also use two transcript monitors (GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-4o-mini) to detect preference adoption in the largest model of each family. Across 32 model-channel-explicitness cells, higher unverbalized adoption is associated with lower detection ability for both monitors (Pearson r=-0.54 and r=-0.78, respectively). These results suggest that CoT monitoring may be less reliable when preference information arrives through tools or must be inferred from raw artifacts, within the single-call, prefilled-tool setting tested here.

AI.tldr: FACE-Eval是一个包含5,100个样本的评估框架，用于测试思维链（CoT）监控对工具返回和原始工件中隐含偏好的忠实归因能力。研究发现所有15个模型（4B-1.60T参数）在工具返回线索上的语言化承诺程度低于用户消息线索，但在非语言化采纳上反而更高，且这种"隐藏采纳"更难被转录监控器检测到，表明CoT监控在工具传递偏好信息时可靠性下降。
AI.motivation: 现有的CoT忠实性测试通常将明确的偏好线索放在用户消息中，但现实场景中智能体可能会通过工具返回或原始工件（而非直接提示）遇到用户偏好。这导致现有测试无法反映真实的agent使用场景，低估了CoT监控在某些情况下的失效风险。
AI.method: 构建FACE-Eval评估集（5,100个样本），系统变化线索位置（用户消息或工具返回）和明确性（直接摘要或原始工件）。测量两类指标：遵循线索答案中的"语言化承诺"（verbailized commitment）和所有带线索样本中的"非语言化采纳"（unverbalized adoption）。评估15个开源模型（8个家族，4B-1.60T参数），并使用两个转录监控器（GPT-5.6-Luna和GPT-4o-mini）检测最大模型的偏好采纳行为。
AI.result: 所有模型在工具返回线索上的语言化承诺低于用户消息线索，隐含线索低于明确线索。非语言化采纳方面，15个模型在工具返回线索上更高，30个模型-通道比较中有28个在隐含线索上更高。来源归因提示可缩小7个模型的通道差距，但告知模型推理将被监控并不能可靠缩小差距。更高的非语言化采纳与更低的监控检测能力相关（Pearson r=-0.54和r=-0.78）。
AI.conclusion: 当偏好信息通过工具传递或需从原始工件中推断时，CoT监控的可靠性降低。模型倾向于"隐性采纳"工具返回的偏好而不在推理中显式提及，这使得监控难以发现。该研究局限在单次调用、预填充工具设置下。

title: EviAnchor: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Regional Visual Evidence Compensation
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) frequently generate content unsupported by visual inputs. Preliminary experiments show that visual evidence is primarily incorporated into answer-side representations in early-to-middle decoder layers, while its direct influence progressively weakens in later layers. This attenuation suggests that visual evidence acquired earlier may be insufficiently utilized during subsequent generation. Based on this observation, we propose EviAnchor, a training-free and single-branch inference framework that preserves and reactivates visual evidence throughout generation. EviAnchor introduces Regional Evidence Anchor (REA) slots to progressively aggregate dense visual tokens into spatially structured representations. It then strengthens the current decision state's access to these visual anchors through decision-conditioned evidence routing, mitigating excessive dependence on textual context. Finally, the model resumes its native Transformer computation to integrate the retrieved visual evidence with question semantics and generation history. Experiments across POPE, CHAIR, and MMHal-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EviAnchor，一个无需训练的单分支推理框架，通过保留并重新激活视觉证据来缓解LVLM生成与视觉输入不一致的问题。核心组件包括区域证据锚点槽（REA）用于聚合视觉token，以及决策条件证据路由机制来增强当前决策状态对视觉锚点的访问。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型经常生成与视觉输入无关的内容。初步实验发现视觉证据主要在解码器早中期层被纳入回答侧表示，后期层对视觉信息的直接影响逐渐减弱，导致早期获取的视觉证据在后续生成中得不到充分利用，从而造成幻觉问题。
AI.method: EviAnchor包含三个关键步骤：1) 引入区域证据锚点（REA）槽，逐步将密集的视觉token聚合成空间结构化的表示；2) 通过决策条件证据路由机制，增强当前决策状态对视觉锚点的访问，减少对文本上下文的速度依赖；3) 恢复原生Transformer计算，将检索到的视觉证据与问题语义和生成历史整合。
AI.result: 在POPE、CHAIR和MMHal-Bench三个基准上的实验表明，EviAnchor在视觉接地（visual grounding）方面取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: EviAnchor通过无需训练的方式有效缓解了LVLM中视觉证据衰减导致的幻觉问题，验证了在推理阶段保留和重新激活视觉证据的有效性。

title: Wide Learning: Learning to Reach Evidence
summary: Machine learning is usually evaluated after an evidence interface has been fixed. A dataset, sensor suite, query language, action set, or experimental protocol determines which observations can be obtained, and learning is judged by what it extracts from them. We study a complementary capability. A learner's state can determine which evidence-generating experiments it can reliably realise under bounded resources, even when primitive affordances remain fixed. We call this learner-relative experiment family its effective epistemic reach, and use Wide Learning for task-relevant learning-induced changes in that family.We formalise effective reach relative to learner state, deployment budget, reliability threshold, and evaluation distribution. In a controlled construction, two hidden worlds have exactly the same public observation law. An informative diagnostic exists in a fixed five-primitive substrate. Before calibration, one address attempt realises it with probability at most $2^{-10} = 1/1024$, below a pre-specified 0.95 threshold; after calibration, held-out realisation is 1. Public-channel total variation is 0, whereas the realised diagnostic has total variation 1, and sealed binary risk moves from approximately 1/2 to 0. The construction establishes that learning can change effective epistemic reach even when primitive affordances and deployment resources are held fixed. It opens a complementary evaluation question for learning systems: not only what they infer from available evidence, but what informative evidence experience teaches them to bring within reach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效认知范围"（effective epistemic reach）这一概念，指学习者在固定原语能力和有限资源下，因自身状态变化而能可靠实现的证据生成实验集合。通过构造两个在公共观测法则上完全相同的隐藏世界，展示校准（calibration）过程可将诊断实验的达成概率从2^-10提升到接近1，说明学习可以改变有效认知范围，即使原始能力和部署资源保持不变。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习评估在证据接口固定后进行，即数据集、传感器、查询语言等决定了可获得哪些观测。但作者认为存在互补能力：学习者的状态可能决定在有限资源下它能可靠实现哪些证据生成实验。这一视角被现有评估体系忽略，需要正式化和研究。
AI.method: 作者形式化定义"有效认知范围"，将其相对于学习者状态、部署预算、可靠性阈值和评估分布进行刻画。使用宽学习（Wide Learning）来研究任务相关的、由学习引起的该范围变化。通过受控构造实验：两个隐藏世界在公共观测法则上完全相同，在固定五原语基板中，校准前地址尝试实现诊断的概率≤2^-10，校准后held-out实现概率为1。
AI.result: 公共信道总变差为0，而实现的诊断的总变差为1；密封二值风险从约1/2降至0。该构造证明学习可以改变有效认知范围，即使原始能力和部署资源保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 本文为学习系统开辟了一个互补的评估问题：不仅评估系统从可用证据中推断出什么，还应评估经验教会系统将哪些有信息量的证据纳入可达范围。这是一种新的、补充性的学习评估视角。

title: MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects
comment: 12 pages. Accepted to the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) workshop at COLM 2026 (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/luoojason/muddle
summary: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MUDDLE，一个受控基准测试，用于分离文档问答系统中"上下文过长"和"干扰文档主题过近"两个因素对性能的影响。每个问题在五种条件下实例化（只有源文档、2/4个主题相近的硬负样本、2/4个随机干扰文档），随机干扰与硬负样本在长度和来源上匹配，从而隔离主题相似度的影响。实验发现硬负样本比长度匹配的随机文档更能降低准确率，但效果较小且方向一致。
AI.motivation: 现有文档问答系统在检索多文档场景下可能因干扰上下文而失败，但以往研究将"上下文过长"和"干扰主题过近"两种效应混为一谈，无法确定失败原因，因此需要受控基准来分离这两种因素。
AI.method: 构建MUDDLE基准：270个人工标注问题，每个问题对应单一源文档，在五种条件下实例化（源文档单独、加2/4个主题相近硬负样本、加2/4个随机干扰文档）。随机干扰与硬负样本在长度和来源上匹配。所有条件以markdown、页面图像和原始PDF三种格式渲染，但本文干扰实验在markdown下进行（因图像/PDF输入限制）。答案使用LLM评判器评分，覆盖三个模型家族。
AI.result: 在完整的markdown扫荡实验中，对于gpt-5-mini，硬负样本在两种上下文大小下均比长度匹配的随机文档更降低准确率，而随机文档几乎不偏离无干扰基线。该效应较小但方向一致，且gpt-5-mini在跨上下文大小合并后，硬负样本显著劣于长度匹配的随机干扰。
AI.conclusion: MUDDLE成功分离了上下文长度与主题相似度对问答系统的影响，证明主题相近的干扰文档（而非仅长度增加）是导致性能下降的关键因素。作者公开数据和评估代码以支持可复现的上下文退化研究。

title: SafeAtlas-VL: Beyond Binary Multimodal Safety with Large-Scale Data and Guard Models
summary: Multimodal safety moderation requires distinguishing risks arising from visual content, user intent, and assistant behavior. Existing safeguards, however, are typically trained for a single judgment target and reduce safety assessment to a binary decision. Consequently, risk becomes difficult to compare across a multimodal interaction, and ambiguous cases are obscured. We introduce SafeAtlas-VL, a dataset of 1.5M training instances that places image-, request-, and response-level judgments on a five-level ordered scale. We curate a broad collection of safety-relevant data from both real-world and synthetic sources and apply a disagreement-aware annotation procedure. The resulting dataset spans 15 harm categories and 55 fine-grained subcategories, covering a broad range of multimodal safety scenarios. We also construct SafeAtlas-Bench, a held-out set of 5,000 instances for evaluating five-level predictions and continuous risk scores. Upon this dataset, we train the SafeAtlas Guard series of models via target-conditioned tuning for multimodal safety detection. Our models not only perform five-way classification of safety levels but also map safety to continuous scores through a soft cumulative ordinal head. Experimental results demonstrate that guard models trained on our dataset exhibit strong generalization: even without using the training sets of other benchmarks, they achieve competitive performance on the corresponding test sets. Notably, our 8B model attains the overall best performance, outperforming the previous SOTA by approximately 4% in F1 score. Code, data, and models are released to support further research. Warning: this paper contains example data that may be offensive, harmful, graphic, or disturbing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeAtlas-VL数据集（150万训练样本）和SafeAtlas-Bench基准（5000测试样本），将多模态安全审查从二分类扩展为图像、请求和响应三个层面的五级有序评估。作者训练了SafeAtlas Guard模型系列，通过目标条件微调和软累积序数头实现五级分类与连续风险评分，8B模型在F1上超越此前SOTA约4%。
AI.motivation: 现有安全审查模型通常只针对单一判断目标训练，且将安全评估简化为二分类决策，导致难以跨多模态交互比较风险等级，且模糊案例容易被掩盖。需要一个更细粒度、可比较的多层级安全评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建SafeAtlas-VL数据集：150万训练样本，涵盖来自真实世界和合成来源的安全相关数据，采用分歧感知标注流程，覆盖15个危害类别和55个细分子类别；2) 构建SafeAtlas-Bench基准（5000实例）用于五级预测和连续风险评分评估；3) 训练SafeAtlas Guard系列模型，采用目标条件微调，通过软累积序数头将安全映射为连续分数。
AI.result: Guard模型展示出强泛化能力：即使不使用其他基准的训练集，也能在对应测试集上取得有竞争力的表现。8B模型达到总体最优，在F1分数上超越此前SOTA约4%。
AI.conclusion: 多层级、多目标的安全评估框架比传统二分类更为有效，细粒度标注数据能显著提升模型泛化能力和安全审查精度。代码、数据和模型已开源以支持后续研究。

title: Unsupervised Multi-Scale Gromov-Wasserstein Hypergraph Alignment
summary: We study unsupervised hypergraph alignment, where the goal is to infer node correspondences between two hypergraphs using only structural information, without node features, labels, seed matches, or side information. Direct higher-order formulations can represent hyperedge interactions faithfully, but they can be computationally demanding and cumbersome for non-uniform hypergraphs. Graph-reduction approaches introduce a different challenge: clique expansions keep the alignment problem on the original node set but collapse all hyperedge evidence into one pairwise graph, whereas bipartite expansions preserve incidence structure but enlarge the problem from nodes to nodes plus hyperedges. We introduce FALCON (Filtration-based hypergrAph aLignment via Cross-scale Optimal traNsport), an unsupervised optimal-transport framework for hypergraph alignment. Instead of representing each hypergraph by a single collapsed clique graph, FALCON constructs a filtration-induced sequence of clique-based co-occurrence dissimilarity matrices and jointly aligns all levels through one shared multi-scale Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) objective. The shared transport plan enforces a globally consistent node correspondence across filtration levels while avoiding the auxiliary hyperedge nodes introduced by bipartite expansion. Experiments on perturbation benchmarks derived from real-world hypergraphs show that FALCON is robust to structural noise and in almost all cases outperforms strong graph- and hypergraph-alignment baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FALCON，一种基于过滤的多尺度Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输框架，用于无监督超图对齐。它通过构造过滤诱导的团共现相异度矩阵序列，在共享传输计划下联合对齐所有尺度，避免了二部图展开引入的辅助超边节点问题，在真实超图的扰动基准上几乎全面超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 超图对齐任务中，直接的高阶公式能忠实表示超边交互但计算量大且不适用于非均匀超图；团展开将超边证据压缩为单一对图而丢失信息；二部展开虽保留关联结构但将问题从节点扩展到节点加超边，规模变大。需要一种既能忠实表示超图结构又计算高效的无监督对齐方法。
AI.method: FALCON构建过滤诱导的团基共现相异度矩阵序列（filtration-induced sequence），通过一个共享的多尺度Gromov-Wasserstein目标函数联合对齐所有过滤层级。共享的传输计划确保跨过滤水平的全局一致节点对应关系，同时避免二部展开引入的辅助超边节点。
AI.result: 在由真实超图导出的扰动基准实验中，FALCON对结构噪声具有鲁棒性，并且在几乎所有情况下都优于强图对齐和超图对齐基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FALCON通过多尺度过滤与共享传输计划，在无需节点特征、标签、种子匹配或任何辅助信息的情况下实现鲁棒的无监督超图对齐，是现有方法的有力替代方案。

title: SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training
summary: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向儿科严重疾病沟通（SIC）训练的基准测试套件和模拟框架，包含PitfallBench和DialogueBench两个基准，并提出了SIC-Agents自改进框架，通过生成可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为，实验表明其优于静态专家提示。
AI.motivation: 儿科严重疾病沟通（SIC）培训至关重要，但可扩展的沟通训练方法有限。相比其他对话模拟场景，儿科SIC面临多方交互、回应家长情绪以及强烈依赖反馈动态等额外挑战。现有基于LLM的模拟器优化的是通用对话质量，而非有效SIC训练所需的课程情境行为。
AI.method: 与教育工作者和儿科临床医生合作，构建了首个面向儿科SIC训练的基准套件和模拟框架。基准包括PitfallBench（转折级评价）和DialogueBench（全对话评价）。提出SIC-Agents自改进框架，生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为。
AI.result: 实验表明SIC-Agents框架优于静态专家提示方法。
AI.conclusion: 开源了用于儿科SIC家长模拟的基准，以支持未来研究。

title: Clustering as Approximation by Constrained Projectors: Theory and Guarantees
summary: This paper develops a unified theoretical framework showing that a broad family of clustering methods, including k-means, fuzzy c-means, kernel k-means, kernel FCM, and spectral clustering, can all be expressed as structured low-rank projectors acting on a signal-derived matrix. By formulating each method as an instance of min over B in C of ||M - M P_B||_F^2, with different constraint sets C, we establish a common optimization template that clarifies the algebraic links among hard, fuzzy, kernel-induced, and orthonormal projections. Within this framework, we derive non-trivial theoretical results, including geodesic convexity properties on the projection manifold, perturbation bounds quantifying stability to matrix noise, and exact recovery guarantees under ideal block-model conditions. The analysis further explains when different clustering families collapse to the same optimal subspace and how deviations arise under small inter-cluster leakage. Overall, the work provides a coherent, theory-first foundation for understanding clustering through structured projectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，证明一个广泛的聚类方法族（包括k-means、模糊c-means、核k-means、核FCM和谱聚类）都可以表示为作用于信号派生矩阵上的结构化低秩投影算子，并通过统一的优化模板和若干理论结果（测地线凸性、扰动界、精确恢复保证）建立其代数联系。
AI.motivation: 现有的聚类方法（硬聚类、模糊聚类、核方法、谱聚类）虽然在实际中广泛使用，但缺乏一个统一的数学框架来解释它们之间的代数联系和理论性质，使得不同聚类方法之间的关系模糊不清。
AI.method: 将所有聚类方法统一建模为 min_{B∈C} ||M - M P_B||_F^2 形式的优化问题，其中C为不同的约束集合（硬、模糊、核诱导、正交投影），揭示它们作为结构化低秩投影算子的共同本质。
AI.result: 推导了多个非平凡的理论结果：投影流形上的测地线凸性、对矩阵噪声的稳定性扰动界、理想块模型条件下的精确恢复保证，并解释了不同聚类族何时收敛到相同最优子空间以及小簇间泄漏下的偏差来源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为通过结构化投影理解聚类提供了连贯的、理论优先的基础，建立了不同聚类范式之间的统一视角。

title: LLMODE: Aligning ODEs with LLMs via Gated Token Injection for Irregular Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for spatio-temporal forecasting, but existing approaches often rely on regularly sampled token sequences and struggle with irregular observations because of temporal asynchrony, representation-space misalignment, and limited context windows. We propose LLMODE, a token-efficient framework for irregular spatio-temporal forecasting with a frozen LLM backbone. LLMODE first uses a graph-aware ODE encoder to reconstruct irregular graph observations as a continuous-time latent trajectory. A Fixed-Budget Perceiver Resampler then compresses this variable-length trajectory into a fixed number of dynamic memory tokens. In parallel, compact statistical descriptors are encoded and resampled into context memory tokens. A dual-source gated cross-attention module injects both memories into the frozen LLM, enabling controlled utilization of external spatio-temporal evidence. Experiments on three real-world urban datasets and two physical-dynamics benchmarks show competitive overall performance, with clearer advantages under sparse or dynamically complex irregular sampling. Additional evaluations on unseen urban regions further demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization without adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLMODE，一个基于冻结大语言模型（LLM）的token高效框架，用于不规则时空预测。它通过图感知ODE编码器将不规则图观测重构为连续时间潜在轨迹，再用固定预算感知器重采样器压缩为动态记忆token，同时将统计描述符编码为上下文记忆token，通过双源门控交叉注意力注入冻结LLM，在不规则观测下实现高效预测与零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM时空预测方法依赖规则采样的token序列，难以处理不规则观测，主要面临三大挑战：时间异步性、表示空间不对齐以及上下文窗口有限。因此需要一种能够高效处理不规则时空数据的LLM框架。
AI.method: 1) 图感知ODE编码器：将不规则图观测重构为连续时间潜在轨迹；2) 固定预算感知器重采样器（Fixed-Budget Perceiver Resampler）：将变长轨迹压缩为固定数量的动态记忆token；3) 并行编码紧凑统计描述符并重采样为上下文记忆token；4) 双源门控交叉注意力模块：将两类记忆token注入冻结LLM，实现外部时空证据的可控利用。
AI.result: 在三个真实城市数据集和两个物理动力学基准上取得了有竞争力的整体性能，在稀疏或动态复杂的不规则采样场景下优势更明显；在未见过的城市区域上展现了无需适配的强零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LLMODE通过token高效的连续时间表示与双源记忆注入机制，有效解决了LLM在不规则时空预测中的关键瓶颈，验证了冻结LLM作为预测骨干在复杂时空场景下的可行性与泛化潜力。

title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出了CoCoA框架，通过双上下文训练实现LLM的文化偏差条件化缓解——在有文化线索时偏好合适实体，无线索时保持中立，将文化偏差分数从43降至24，同时保持近中立的50.2偏好值，几乎不影响通用性能。
AI.motivation: LLM常偏向西方关联实体，传统去偏方法追求统一中立，但文化偏差缓解需要上下文条件化行为：有文化线索时选择文化适当实体，无线索时保持中立。现有方法无法满足这一需求。
AI.method: 提出CoCoA框架，核心包括：(1) 双上下文训练——在同一实体对的带/不带文化线索的上下文下训练；(2) 对比对齐目标；(3) 校准和漂移正则化；(4) 通过目标感知梯度协调进行优化。
AI.result: 在CAMeL和Camellia两个基准上，涵盖十种语言设置和四个LLM，CoCoA将文化偏差分数从43平均降至24，同时保持50.2的近中立偏好，且在五个标准基准上的通用性能几乎不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 有效的文化对齐需要上下文条件化建模而非统一去偏，这为缓解LLM中实体中心的文化偏差开辟了新方向。

title: Emergent Misalignment Is Not Magical
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on narrowly harmful datasets can lead to misalignment broadly, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). EM poses a challenge for AI safety and our understanding of LLMs. Prior work often frames EM as an unexpected behavior, and explains it by appealing to general misalignment directions or anthropomorphizing it as acquiring an evil persona. However, the mechanisms behind these framings remain obscure. In this work, we show that EM is a predictable and data-dependent generalization phenomenon. By examining the base model's representation of EM training data and evaluation prompts, we find that evilness after EM training is highly predictable from representational distance: the closer an evaluation prompt is to training data centroid, the more evilness it elicits from EM models after training (with an average Spearman correlation of -0.73 across 12 model-dataset settings). Building upon this analysis, we further demystify EM by showing that (1) its effectiveness changes significantly based on training data format; (2) there is not a general misalignment direction that transfers across different EM models; (3) the effect of EM is fundamentally different from persona changes. Furthermore, we extend the EM generalization metric from a scalar distance to a dataset-specific generalization direction, which robustly predicts EM models' evilness under semantics-preserving prompt perturbations including appending random tokens and paraphrasing, where other methods do not reliably generalize.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了"涌现性错位"(EM)是一个可预测且依赖于数据的泛化现象，而非不可预期的意外行为。通过分析基础模型中训练数据与评估提示的表征距离，发现距离训练数据质心越近的提示越能引发模型的"邪恶性"（平均Spearman相关系数-0.73）。论文进一步驳斥了通用错位方向和"邪恶人格"等解释，并提出了数据集特定的泛化方向作为更稳健的预测指标。
AI.motivation: 先前研究将涌现性错位(EM)视为意外行为，并通过通用错位方向或拟人化的"邪恶人格"来解释，但这些框架背后的机制仍不清楚。作者旨在揭示EM的可预测性和数据依赖性，从而更好地理解和应对这一AI安全挑战。
AI.method: 通过分析基础模型对EM训练数据和评估提示的表示，计算表示距离并考察其与模型邪恶度的关系。通过改变训练数据格式、跨模型迁移测试、与人格变化对比等实验逐层解构EM的机制。最后提出从标量距离扩展到数据集特定泛化方向的预测指标，并在语义保持扰动下验证其稳健性。
AI.result: (1) EM的邪恶度与评估提示到训练数据质心的表示距离高度相关（平均Spearman相关系数-0.73，涵盖12个模型-数据集设定）；(2) EM效果随训练数据格式显著变化；(3) 不存在跨EM模型迁移的通用错位方向；(4) EM效应与人格变化有本质区别；(5) 提出的数据集特定泛化方向在随机token追加和释义等语义保持扰动下比标量距离更稳健地预测EM模型的邪恶度。
AI.conclusion: 涌现性错位不是神秘的意外行为，而是一种可预测、数据依赖的泛化现象。基于表示距离的分析框架可以更深入地理解EM的机制，数据集特定的泛化方向指标提供了更稳健的预测能力，为AI安全评估和EM防范提供了新的理论依据和实用工具。

title: Reward-guided Fine-Tuning of One-Step Generative Models via Wasserstein Gradient Flow
summary: To mitigate the time complexity of generative models, one-step generative models have recently emerged through direct mapping from noise to data in a single forward pass. However, the reward-guided fine-tuning method of one-step generative models remains largely unexplored. To address this, we consider one-step generators from an optimal transport view, investigating Wasserstein Gradient Flow (WGF) for modeling smooth and controlled distributional evolution in probability space. We then propose a novel reward-guided fine-tuning of a one-step generative model via WGF. We derive a practical training method that requires no reward gradients, thereby handling both non-differentiable and differentiable rewards. Moreover, our method provides smooth and stable reward-guided distributional updates while mitigating reward hacking and mode collapse. Experiments on 2D synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet 256$\times$256 with diverse rewards, including JPEG (in)compressibility, class probability, Black-and-White and CLIP alignment, show that our method achieves better reward alignment compared to baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过Wasserstein梯度流对一步生成模型进行奖励引导微调的新方法，无需奖励梯度即可处理不可微分和可微分的奖励，同时实现平滑稳定的分布更新，缓解奖励黑客和模式坍缩问题，在多个基准和多种奖励上取得更优效果。
AI.motivation: 一步生成模型通过在单次前向传播中实现噪声到数据的直接映射来降低生成模型的时间复杂度，但针对一步生成模型的奖励引导微调方法尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 从最优传输视角考虑一步生成器，研究概率空间中的Wasserstein梯度流以建模平滑受控的分布演化，提出基于WGF的奖励引导微调方法，推导出无需奖励梯度的实用训练方法。
AI.result: 在2D合成数据、CIFAR-10和ImageNet 256x256上，使用JPEG（不）可压缩性、类概率、黑白和CLIP对齐等多种奖励进行实验，方法相比基线实现了更好的奖励对齐。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的WGF-based奖励引导微调方法能够处理多种奖励类型，提供平滑稳定的分布更新，并有效缓解奖励黑客和模式坍缩问题。

title: LLM Judges as Raters: A Pre-Registered Audit of Severity, Halo, Reliability, and Version Instability in LLM Essay Scoring on Public Corpora
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Under review at the Journal of Learning Analytics (LAK27 research track). Artifact: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lak-27-A618
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as essay graders in learning analytics, evaluated almost exclusively with agreement statistics. Educational measurement warns that raters also differ in severity, show halo, and drift as instruments. We treat LLM judges as raters and run a pre-registered rater-effects battery (many-facet Rasch severity, residual halo, generalizability/decision studies, cross-version shifts, differential functioning) on public corpora in two languages (ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP): 2,377 essays, 12 judges, 4 providers, 5 version contrasts, replicated cells, released as a score tensor. Judge severity spans 219 points on ENEM's 0-1000 scale; on ASAP the panel spread is 15-33% of the score range against a between-trained-human gap near 1%. Judge-human correlations sit in an undiscriminating .47-.56 band. All five version contrasts shift severity beyond a family-wise permutation null (up to 133 points), and one judge was deprecated mid-study, caught by identity canaries. Two pre-registered tests returned honest nulls: severity-adjusted leaderboard reversals did not survive a permutation null, and "silent drift" was refuted: agreement moved with severity in four of five contrasts. Replication yields self-consistency (phi>=.80 at k<=2) but not human-level accuracy, and a same-instrument check overturned our own halo comparison: matched on instrument and calibration, we find no credible evidence that judge halo exceeds the trained-human range.

AI.tldr: 本研究将大语言模型（LLM）视为评分者（rater），采用教育测量学中的评分者效应（rater-effects）方法体系，在两种语言（葡萄牙语ENEM/Essay-BR和英语ASAP）的公开语料上对12个LLM裁判进行了预注册的全面检验。研究发现：LLM裁判的严重性差异巨大（ENEM上跨度达219分/1000分制），所有跨版本对比均显示严重性偏移，但两个预注册的零假设检验（严重性调整后的排名反转、静态漂移）结果为诚实的无效结果。重复测量显示LLM具有自我一致性，但未达到人类水平准确性，且在匹配工具和校准后，未发现LLM的光环效应超出受过训练的人类评分者范围。
AI.motivation: 现有研究几乎只用一致性统计量（如相关系数）来评估LLM作为论文评分者的表现，而教育测量学表明评分者还会表现出严重性差异（severity）、光环效应（halo）和漂移（drift）。作者旨在将LLM视为评分工具系统性地检验这些测量学性质，填补该领域的方法论空白。
AI.method: 采用预注册的评分者效应测试套件，包括：多面Rasch严重性模型、残差光环检验、概化/决策研究、跨版本偏移检验、差异功能检验。使用2377篇论文、12个LLM裁判、4个提供商、5个版本对比，发布评分张量（score tensor），并设置身份金丝雀（identity canaries）以捕捉裁判被废弃的情况。
AI.result: LLM裁判严重性在ENEM 0-1000分制上跨度达219分；ASAP上裁判组散度占评分范围的15-33%，而训练过的人类评分者差距仅约1%。裁判-人类相关性处于低区分度的0.47-0.56区间。五组版本对比均超出族系式排列零假设（最大偏移133分），一名裁判因身份金丝雀被发现在研究中期被废弃。两个预注册测试返回诚实的零结果：严重性调整后的排名反转未通过排列零假设，"静态漂移"被证伪（四组对比中一致性随严重性变化）。重复测量显示自我一致性（phi>=0.80, k<=2）但非人类水平准确性；同工具对照推翻了自身的光环效应比较——匹配工具和校准后，无可靠证据表明LLM光环超过受过训练的人类评分者。
AI.conclusion: LLM裁判在严重性上存在远超人类评分者的大幅差异，版本更迭会引入系统性偏移，且裁判与人类的相关性较低。然而，LLM具有内部自我一致性，且其光环效应并未超出人类评分者范围。研究强调应使用更丰富的测量模型而不仅是一致性统计来评估LLM评分，并呼吁发布复制数据（评分张量）以促进透明性和可复现性。

title: Beyond Correctness: Validity-Oriented Evaluation of Biomedical LLM Judges
summary: We propose a scalable, validity-oriented pipeline for evaluating biomedical LLM judges when high-quality human judgments are scarce. First, we augment existing human-labelled biomedical benchmarks with deterministic, metric-grounded mutations that produce auditable preference pairs. Second, we evaluate judges beyond aggregate correctness using three deployment-relevant dimensions: correctness against metric-derived gold labels, robustness under repeated stochastic sampling, and compliance with the requested output format. We use this pipeline to assess Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four regimes: (1) base, using the instruct model as is; (2) SFT, distillation-based supervised fine-tuning only; (3) RL, GRPO-based reinforcement learning only; and (4) SFT$\rightarrow$RL, SFT followed by RL. The base and single-stage regimes struggle on structured medical discrimination such as PICO extraction and clinical calculations, whereas SFT$\rightarrow$RL performs best across correctness, compliance, and robustness; gains concentrate on decomposable tasks (PICO, MedCalc), at times matching or outperforming frontier models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展、以效度为导向的评估流程，用于在高质量人工标注稀缺的情况下评估生物医学LLM裁判模型。通过确定性、基于指标的突变增强现有基准，并从正确性、鲁棒性和格式合规性三个维度评估裁判模型。实验表明SFT→RL组合训练策略在所有维度上表现最佳，尤其在可分解任务上甚至可媲美前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 生物医学领域的LLM裁判模型评估面临高质量人工判断稀缺的挑战，传统仅依赖聚合准确率的评估方式无法全面反映模型在实际部署中的表现，需要一种可扩展且具有效度保障的评估流程。
AI.method: 1) 利用确定性、基于指标的突变增强现有的人类标注生物医学基准，生成可审计的偏好对；2) 从三个部署相关维度评估裁判：与指标派生黄金标签的正确性、重复随机采样下的鲁棒性、输出格式合规性；3) 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上比较四种训练范式（base、SFT、RL、SFT→RL）。
AI.result: SFT→RL在所有评估维度上表现最佳，性能增益集中在可分解任务（PICO提取、MedCalc）上，有时能与甚至超越前沿模型；而基础模型和单阶段训练模式在结构化医学判别任务（如PICO提取和临床计算）上表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: SFT→RL组合训练策略是构建可靠生物医学LLM裁判的有效方案，且所提出的效度导向评估流程能更全面地揭示模型在不同部署维度上的真实表现。

title: A Target-Centric Survey of Quantization-Aware Training
summary: The rapid development of LLMs incurs prohibitive memory footprints and intensive computational demands. Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) techniques have emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by explicitly simulating quantization effects during model training, yielding low-bit models that achieve accuracy comparable to their full-precision counterparts. In this work, we provide a target-centric survey of QAT, aimed at clarifying both its theoretical foundations and its evolving implementation landscape. We systematically review existing QAT methods through a target-centric taxonomy and synthesize cross-target differences in error characteristics, numerical formats, and strategy transferability. We further summarize QAT evaluation paradigms and discuss challenges in optimization and deployment, outlining potential directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文对量化感知训练（QAT）技术进行了以"目标"为中心的综述，系统梳理了QAT的理论基础与实现方法，并通过目标导向的分类法比较了不同量化目标在误差特性、数值格式和策略迁移性方面的差异，最后总结了评估范式并讨论了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的快速发展带来了巨大的内存占用和计算需求，QAT作为一种通过在训练中显式模拟量化效果来获得低比特模型的方法，是解决该问题的重要途径。然而现有QAT研究缺乏系统性的梳理与比较，需要一篇以目标为中心的综述来厘清理论基础和应用全景。
AI.method: 本文采用目标导向（target-centric）的分类法对现有QAT方法进行系统性回顾，从误差特性、数值格式和策略可迁移性三个维度综合比较不同量化目标之间的差异，并归纳总结了QAT的评估范式。
AI.result: 通过目标导向的分类框架，本文梳理了现有QAT方法，阐明了不同量化目标在误差特性、数值格式和策略迁移性上的异同，并总结了QAT评估的基本范式。
AI.conclusion: 本文指出了QAT在优化和部署方面仍面临的挑战，并为未来研究提出了潜在的研究方向。

title: Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure; accepted at ASIS&T METSTI
summary: Academic reviews, scholarly commentaries, and book reviews serve as sources of evaluative statements about theories, methods, literature, institutions, and policies, providing valuable evidence for scholarly evaluation. Existing scientific entity extraction methods mainly target research articles and are less effective for evaluation objects, which are often abstract, context-dependent, and characterized by ambiguous type boundaries. This study proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for evaluation object extraction. The framework combines candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review. Experimental results show that it achieves a Precision of 90.33%, Recall of 84.55%, Entity-level F1 of 87.34%, Strict Typed F1 of 79.78%, and Type Accuracy of 91.35%, substantially outperforming rule-based and zero-shot baselines. Ablation results indicate that the multi-agent workflow improves recall and stability, while ontology-based boundary constraints enhance fine-grained classification and reduce category confusion. The framework supports the structured utilization of evaluative scholarly texts and provides methodological support for evidence-based research evaluation and STI mining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个本体引导的多智能体框架，用于从学术评论、书评等评价性文本中提取评价对象（如理论、方法、文献、机构、政策等）。该框架结合候选发现、本体约束分类和领域审查三个环节，在实验中获得90.33%的精确率、84.55%的召回率和87.34%的实体级F1，显著优于规则基线和零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 学术评审和书评中包含大量对理论、方法、文献、机构和政策的评价性陈述，是学术评价的重要证据来源。然而现有科学实体提取方法主要针对研究论文，难以处理评价对象——这些对象往往抽象、依赖上下文、且类型边界模糊。因此需要专门针对评价对象提取的方法。
AI.method: 提出本体引导的多智能体框架，包含三个核心模块：1）候选发现（Candidate Discovery）：初步识别可能的评价对象候选；2）本体约束分类（Ontology-constrained Classification）：利用本体对候选实体进行约束和精确分类；3）领域审查（Domain Review）：通过多智能体协作进行验证和修正。多智能体工作流提升召回率和稳定性，本体约束提升细粒度分类能力并减少类别混淆。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：精确率90.33%、召回率84.55%、实体级F1为87.34%、严格类型F1为79.78%、类型准确率为91.35%，显著优于规则基线和零样本基线。消融实验表明多智能体工作流改善召回率和稳定性，本体边界约束增强细粒度分类并降低类别混淆。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持评价性学术文本的结构化利用，为循证研究评价和STI挖掘提供了方法论支持。

title: APIFlow-Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Survive Long, Dependent API Workflows
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Under review at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents (IAEval). Harness, frozen task bank, and 44,362 execution transcripts: https://github.com/postmanlabs/APIFlow-Bench
summary: Tool-using agents are commonly evaluated by a single bit: whether an end-to-end workflow completed. This metric fails to distinguish failures that matter in production, such as expired credentials, malformed payloads, or correct execution followed by incorrect final delivery. We introduce APIFlow-Bench, a fully auditable benchmark for long-horizon, dependent REST-API workflows that decomposes performance into seven engineering capabilities and requires agents to produce answers supported by the actual call path. We generate synthetic API worlds forward, subtask by subtask; each subtask is admitted only after a zero-LLM self-test triad verifies its grader and an oracle establishes solvability, and an adversarial audit identified and fixed six grader exploits. Grading is deterministic and provenance-sensitive: a state check traces a mock-minted canary through the API data flow to the response the answer must originate from, and a typed answer card is verified field by field. We release all answer keys and 44,362 unredacted execution transcripts. Across 19 frontier and open-weight models under one neutral scaffold, we find: (1) longer dependency chains degrade success, from 93% on individual subtasks to 74% on clean 20-subtask chains and 61% when including the 8% of chain trials that a model-consensus screen flags as passed by no model; (2) reliability separates models more than best-case capability, with best-of-five spanning seven points but all-five-of-five reliability spanning 44 points; (3) the independent-error account of compounding failure does not fit the data: pass rates on 20-subtask chains are 33 percentage points above the product of subtask-level rates, and on the clean slice 77% of failing runs reached the correct final state and failed only at delivery.

AI.tldr: APIFlow-Bench 是一个用于长时程、依赖型 REST-API 工作流的可审计基准，将工具使用代理的性能分解为七项工程能力，并通过确定性的、可溯源的状态检查进行评分。实验表明：依赖链越长成功率越低；可靠性比最佳-case能力更能区分模型；复合失败并非由独立错误导致，绝大多数失败发生在最终交付环节而非执行环节。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用代理的评估仅用一个二值指标（工作流是否完成）来衡量，无法区分生产中真正重要的失败类型，如凭证过期、负载格式错误、或正确执行后交付失败等。因此需要一个能细粒度分解失败原因、且可完全审计的基准。
AI.method: 前向逐子任务合成 API 世界；每个子任务须通过零 LLM 自测三元组（grader 验证加 oracle 确立可解性），并经过对抗性审计修复六处 grader 漏洞。评分具有确定性且对来源敏感：状态检查通过 API 数据流追踪 mock 铸造的 canary 到答案必须源自的响应，类型化答案卡片逐字段验证。框架统一部署于 19 个前沿与开源权重模型。
AI.result: (1) 依赖链长度降低成功率：单子任务 93% → 20 子任务干净链 74% → 含 8% 无模型通过链 61%；(2) 可靠性（五次全过）跨度 44 个百分点，远超最佳五次能力（7 个百分点）；(3) 独立错误模型不成立：20 子任务链通过率比子任务率乘积高 33 个百分点，且干净切片中 77% 的失败运行已到达正确最终状态，仅交付环节出错。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖端到端二值指标会掩盖模型在生产中真正的差距；代理在长链中的失败主要源于最终交付而非执行正确性，且可靠性（而非峰值能力）才是区分模型的关键维度。APIFlow-Bench 提供了细粒度、可审计的评估框架以支撑这一结论。

title: Creation begins with understanding: LLMs as strategy designers for privacy-preserving tabular data synthesis
summary: Sharing tabular data in high-stakes domains is constrained by privacy regulations. Synthetic data offer a promising alternative, but deep generative models are costly to train and difficult to audit, while LLM-based methods often serialize records as text, obscuring tabular structure and exposing sensitive data. We introduce Tabular Synthesis Strategy Designer (TabSSD), which uses an LLM to design synthesis procedures rather than directly generate records. TabSSD provides the LLM with tree-derived summaries of variable dependence rather than raw records, which produces Python programs for local execution and evaluation. Across twelve datasets, TabSSD strikes a favourable balance among statistical fidelity, predictive utility, and empirical privacy risk, achieving the best average rank across six metrics among ten methods. Moreover, it substantially reduces local computation and token consumption relative to the compared methods. By enabling human-guided refinement and eliminating user-side model tuning, TabSSD lowers the expertise and infrastructure barriers to transparent tabular data synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tabular Synthesis Strategy Designer (TabSSD)，利用LLM设计数据合成流程而非直接生成记录，通过树摘要提供变量依赖信息，生成Python程序进行本地执行与评估。在12个数据集上与10种方法对比，TabSSD在统计保真度、预测效用和隐私风险之间取得最佳平衡，同时显著降低计算和token消耗。
AI.motivation: 高风险的表格数据共享受隐私法规限制，合成数据是理想替代方案。但深度生成模型训练成本高、难以审计，而LLM方法将记录序列化为文本，会模糊表格结构并暴露敏感数据。
AI.method: TabSSD使用LLM设计合成程序而非直接生成数据。核心创新在于：向LLM提供基于树的变量依赖摘要（而非原始记录），LLM据此生成Python程序，程序在本地执行并评估。
AI.result: 在12个数据集、10种方法、6项指标的对比中，TabSSD取得最佳平均排名，在统计保真度、预测效用和隐私风险间达到有利平衡，同时大幅降低计算消耗和token使用量。
AI.conclusion: TabSSD通过支持人工引导的优化和消除用户侧模型调优，降低了透明表格数据合成的专业知识和基础设施门槛，为合成数据生成提供了更透明、高效且安全的路径。

title: Argument-Aware Semantic Alignment of Normative Texts: A Toulmin-Based Neuro-Symbolic Approach
summary: Semantic alignment between specialized normative texts is challenging when equivalent requirements use different terms, syntax, and levels of abstraction. Lexical overlap, distributional embeddings, and semantic similarity capture topical relatedness but often miss the argumentative structure by which normative claims are supported, qualified, and justified. This paper asks whether explicit argument structure adds information complementary to neural semantics for aligning requirements. We treat cross-standard control mapping as argument-aware semantic alignment and build a neuro-symbolic pipeline that combines neural text representations with Toulmin features. An LLM explicitation step identifies claims, grounds, warrants, qualifiers, and backing and reconstructs enthymemes. These feed an alignment model via argument-aware similarity and structural features. On a NERC-CIP to NIST-CSF mapping benchmark, argument-derived features improve alignment over a neuro-symbolic semantic baseline. Feature selection shows especially strong signal from warrant-related features, indicating that the link between a claim and its supporting reasoning is not captured by conventional similarity alone. A compact claim--grounds--warrant subset remains competitive with the full Toulmin feature set. The results give preliminary evidence that argument structure is a useful intermediate representation for aligning specialized normative texts. Cybersecurity standards are used as a controlled testbed, not as proof of domain-independent generalization. The argument graphs produced by LLM explicitation may also support later work on retrieval, reasoning, and explanation over normative text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个神经符号管道，将LLM显式化的Toulmin论证结构特征与神经文本表示相结合，用于跨标准规范文本的语义对齐。在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF的映射基准上，论证结构特征（尤其是warrant相关特征）相比纯神经语义基线显著提升了对齐性能，表明论证结构是规范文本对齐的有效中间表示。
AI.motivation: 专业规范文本的语义对齐具有挑战性，因为等价的要求可能使用不同的术语、句法和抽象层级。已有的词汇重叠、分布嵌入和语义相似度方法只能捕捉主题相关性，却忽略了规范声明如何被支持、限定和论证的论证结构。作者质疑：显式的论证结构是否能提供与神经语义互补的信息来改进要求对齐。
AI.method: 构建神经符号管道：(1) 使用LLM显式化步骤识别Toulmin模型中的主张(claims)、事实依据(grounds)、正当理由(warrants)、限定词(qualifiers)和支撑(backing)，并重构省略式论证(enthymemes)；(2) 通过论证感知相似度和结构特征将这些特征输入对齐模型；(3) 在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF的映射基准上评估，并进行特征选择分析。
AI.result: 在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF映射基准上，论证派生特征在神经符号语义基线上改善了对齐效果。特征选择显示warrant相关特征信号最强，表明主张与其支持推理之间的联系无法被传统相似度捕获。紧凑的claim-grounds-warrant子集与完整Toulmin特征集表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 论证结构是规范文本对齐的有用中间表示。LLM显式化产生的论证图还可支持未来在规范文本上的检索、推理和解释工作。作者强调网络安全标准仅作为受控测试平台，不代表领域无关的泛化性证明。

title: More Perspectives, Stronger Signals: Multi-Perspective Enhancement and Progressive Fusion for Multimodal Entity Representation Learning
summary: Learning effective multimodal entity representations is fundamental for reasoning tasks such as multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC). However, existing methods often suffer from semantic over-smoothing within modalities and ineffective noise filtration across modalities, particularly under sparse or ambiguous conditions. To overcome these limitations, we propose PrismF, a unified framework that synergizes multi-perspective enhancement with progressive fusion to extract stronger signals from diverse inputs. PrismF enhances fine-grained intra-modal semantics through a multi-perspective mechanism that decomposes each modality into complementary views and constrains them with a decoupling loss to reduce representation collapse. Furthermore, it improves cross-modal integration through a progressive fusion strategy that dynamically calibrates inter-modal interactions, enabling the model to emphasize informative signals while suppressing noisy or unreliable ones. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks show that PrismF achieves the strongest overall performance, including relative improvements of 4.04% in MRR and 11.17% in Hits@1 on KVC16K. Our code can be found at https://github.com/HubuKG/PrismF.

AI.tldr: PrismF是一个统一的多模态实体表示学习框架，通过多视角增强和渐进式融合策略，解决多模态知识图谱补全中的语义过平滑和跨模态噪声过滤问题，在三个公开基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在多模态实体表示学习中存在两个关键缺陷：一是模态内部语义过平滑，导致细粒度信息丢失；二是跨模态噪声过滤效果不佳，尤其在数据稀疏或模糊条件下。这些问题严重制约了多模态知识图谱补全任务的性能。
AI.method: PrismF采用两种核心策略：(1)多视角增强机制：将每个模态分解为互补的多个视角，并通过解耦损失约束这些视角以防止表示坍缩，从而增强模态内细粒度语义；(2)渐进式融合策略：动态校准模态间交互，使模型能够强调信息丰富的信号同时抑制噪声或不可靠信号，提升跨模态集成质量。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上的大量实验表明PrismF取得了最强的整体性能，其中在KVC16K数据集上MRR相对提升4.04%，Hits@1相对提升11.17%。
AI.conclusion: PrismF通过多视角增强与渐进式融合的协同作用，有效提取了多模态输入中的更强信号，为多模态知识图谱补全提供了新的统一框架解决方案。

title: Last Step Matters: Early Uncertainty Cannot Predict Failure in Long-Horizon Agents
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Early failure prediction is important for long-horizon agents, as it enables timely intervention and can reduce inference and tool-use costs. Uncertainty quantification, such as verbal confidence and perplexity, offers a promising approach to detecting agent failures; however, it has not been explored whether these signals retain their discriminative power during the intermediate stages of long-horizon execution. We evaluate mainstream uncertainty signals on deep-research tasks and find that verbal confidence reliably distinguishes failures at trajectory completion, achieving a mean AUROC of 0.85, whereas all evaluated signals offer limited predictive value earlier in execution, with none exceeding a mean AUROC of 0.60 at 50% trajectory progress. We identify an underlying mechanism explaining this gap: path switching, where agents frequently abandon their current search direction in-trajectory, breaking the link between early signal and final outcome. These findings challenge the assumption that intermediate uncertainty can reliably guide early intervention. They also motivate a practical recommendation for agent harnesses in deep-research settings: use final-step confidence to decide whether to restart, an approach that our experiments find more effective than in-trajectory intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长时程智能体的早期失败预测问题，评估主流不确定性信号（语言置信度和困惑度）在深度研究任务中的判别能力。结果显示，语言置信度在轨迹完成时能可靠区分失败（平均AUROC 0.85），但在执行前中期所有信号预测价值有限（50%进度时AUROC不超过0.60）。作者发现"路径切换"机制（智能体频繁放弃当前搜索方向）是造成这一差距的根本原因。最终建议在深度研究场景中使用最终步骤置信度决定是否重启，而非轨迹内早期干预。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体的早期失败预测对及时干预和降低成本至关重要，但现有不确定性量化信号在中间执行阶段是否保持判别能力尚未被探索。
AI.method: 在深度研究任务上系统评估主流不确定性信号（语言置信度、困惑度等），通过AUROC指标衡量不同轨迹进度下的失败预测能力，并分析"路径切换"机制来解释信号失效原因。
AI.result: 语言置信度在轨迹完成时AUROC达0.85；所有信号在50%轨迹进度时AUROC均不超过0.60；路径切换破坏了早期信号与最终结果之间的关联。
AI.conclusion: 中间阶段不确定性信号无法可靠指导早期干预，建议改用最终步骤置信度决定是否重启，该方法比轨迹内早期干预更有效。

title: The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks
comment: 30 pages, plus 29 pages of references and appendices
summary: Modern systems in artificial intelligence (AI) somehow excel in domains for which they seem poorly suited. Intelligence has traditionally been modeled as operating over structured combinations of symbols, such as logical formulas. However, the strongest modern AI systems are based on neural networks, which instead represent information in continuous vectors. Vectors seem inadequate for capturing the structure of language, logic, and other cognitive domains, yet neural networks achieve impressive performance in these areas. How do they do it? In this work, we propose a potential answer: Despite appearances, perhaps the internal representations of neural networks implicitly realize symbolic structure. In support of this hypothesis, we show that the vector representations of a variety of neural networks can be closely approximated with symbolic structures: we can replace the network's entire representation-generating process with a closed-form equation instantiating a symbolic structure, and the network's behavior remains largely unchanged. This finding holds for both small-scale neural networks trained to manipulate lists as well as large language models (LLMs) operating in four domains that are central in symbolic traditions: arithmetic, logic, computer code, and language. Further, our symbolic approximation allows us to modify an LLM's behavior in targeted ways via precise interventions on its internal representations, showing that the LLM's behavior is reliant on the symbolic structures we have identified. This work provides a potential way to reconcile longstanding symbolic conceptions of intelligence with the vector-based nature of modern AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种调和符号主义与神经网络的方法：尽管现代AI基于连续向量表示，但其内部表征可能隐含实现了符号结构。作者证明多种神经网络的向量表示可被符号结构的封闭形式方程近似替代，且网络行为基本不变，这在小规模列表操作网络和大型语言模型（涵盖算术、逻辑、代码、语言四个领域）中均成立。通过符号近似还能对LLM内部表征进行精准干预以定向修改行为，从而弥合符号智能观与向量AI之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 传统AI理论将智能建模为符号组合操作（如逻辑公式），但现代最强的AI系统基于神经网络的连续向量表示。向量看似不足以捕捉语言、逻辑等认知领域的结构，然而神经网络在这些领域却表现出色。作者希望解释这一矛盾：神经网络究竟如何实现这些能力？
AI.method: 作者假设神经网络的内部表征尽管表现为向量，但可能隐含实现了符号结构。他们提出用封闭形式方程（实例化符号结构）来替换网络的整个表征生成过程，并验证网络行为是否基本不变。该方法应用于小规模列表操作神经网络以及涵盖算术、逻辑、代码、语言四个领域的LLM。
AI.result: 发现该假设在多种神经网络中成立：向量表征可被符号结构紧密近似，替换表征生成过程后网络行为大体保持不变。此外，基于符号近似对LLM内部表征进行精准干预可定向修改其行为，证明LLM行为确实依赖于所识别的符号结构。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为调和长期以来的符号主义智能观与现代基于向量的AI提供了潜在路径：神经网络的向量表征可能在其深处实现了隐式的符号结构，从而解释了为什么看似不匹配的连续向量方法能在符号化认知领域中取得成功。

title: JudgePanel: A Compact Judge with Panel Deliberation via Adaptive Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative to human evaluation. However, single-model judges are limited by their inherent model biases, while multi-agent evaluation protocols that mitigate this through diverse deliberation are prohibitively expensive at inference time. To this end, we propose \textbf{\modelname}, which equips a compact \underline{Judge} model with multi-agent \underline{Panel} deliberation capability. Specifically, we first train on panel deliberation traces from an ensemble of strong evaluators, capturing structured patterns of discussion, disagreement, and resolution. To further improve judgment quality beyond SFT, we introduce \textit{AdaReward}, an adaptive multi-reward RL algorithm that dynamically rebalances reward component weights as different objectives saturate at different rates during RL training. For practical deployment, we further design a lightweight domain specialization module for rapid adaptation to new evaluation domains with few hundred labeled samples. As a result, (i) \textit{Novel}: the first framework to equip a single compact judge with multi-agent panel deliberation capability at single-model inference cost; (ii) \textit{Effective \& Reliable}: JudgePanel with a 14B backbone outperforms judge-specialized models up to 70B across four evaluation benchmarks, demonstrates strong position consistency, and rapidly specializes to new domains with few hundred samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JudgePanel框架，将多智能体评审团审议能力压缩到单一紧凑的审判模型中，以单模型推理成本实现多智能体评估质量。通过面板审议轨迹训练、自适应多奖励强化学习算法AdaReward以及轻量级领域特化模块，该14B规模的模型在四个评估基准上超越了高达70B的专用审判模型，并展现出强大的位置一致性和快速领域适应能力。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge范式虽可扩展，但单模型评判受限于固有模型偏见；多智能体评估协议虽可通过多样化审议缓解这一问题，但在推理时成本过高。作者希望在不牺牲评估质量的前提下，以单模型推理成本获得多智能体审议的益处。
AI.method: 1) 使用强评估器集成产生的面板审议轨迹进行监督微调，捕捉讨论、分歧和解决的结构化模式；2) 提出AdaReward自适应多奖励强化学习算法，在RL训练过程中动态重新平衡不同目标的奖励权重（因不同目标饱和速率不同）；3) 设计轻量级领域特化模块，仅需数百个标注样本即可快速适应新评估领域。
AI.result: JudgePanel以14B骨干网络在四个评估基准上优于高达70B的审判专用模型；展现出强位置一致性；仅需数百个样本即可快速特化到新领域。
AI.conclusion: JudgePanel是首个以单模型推理成本赋予紧凑审判模型多智能体面板审议能力的框架，同时兼顾了评估质量、一致性和领域适应性，为LLM-as-a-Judge范式提供了一种高效且实用的解决方案。

title: Higher-Dimensional Rotary Position Embedding
summary: Transformers rely on position embedding mechanisms in long context modeling in most cases. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) embeds positional information with independent 2D rotations, forming relative position terms in self-attention. However, its pairwise, block-based, and decoupled structure limits deep mixing and robustness across channels. We propose HD-RoPE, which extends RoPE from independent 2D rotations to higher-dimensional rotations and introduces a Paley-I orthogonal basis to obtain balanced, isotropic, and dense phase mixing within each rotation subspace. This significantly enhances channel coupling and rotational degrees of freedom while maintaining orthogonal stability and the relative position closure property. Furthermore, HD-RoPE is easily optimized for engineering efficiency without introducing additional trainable parameters. We have conducted extensive evaluation results demonstrating that HD-RoPE achieves significant performance improvements over standard RoPE across various popular benchmarks and in both long and short contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HD-RoPE，将旋转位置编码（RoPE）从独立的二维旋转扩展到高维旋转，并引入Paley-I正交基实现平衡、各向同性且密集的相位混合，在不增加额外可训练参数的情况下显著提升长上下文建模性能。
AI.motivation: RoPE通过独立二维旋转嵌入位置信息，但其成对、分块、解耦的结构限制了跨通道的深度混合和鲁棒性，需要一种更强的位置编码机制来改善长上下文建模能力。
AI.method: 将RoPE从独立的2D旋转扩展到更高维度的旋转，引入Paley-I正交基以获得每个旋转子空间内的平衡、各向同性、密集的相位混合，增强通道耦合与旋转自由度，同时保持正交稳定性与相对位置闭包性质，且不引入额外可训练参数。
AI.result: 在多个流行基准测试及长短文本场景下，HD-RoPE相比标准RoPE取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: HD-RoPE通过高维旋转和Paley-I正交基有效克服了RoPE的结构限制，在不增加参数的情况下提升了位置编码的表达能力和工程效率，是一种更优越的位置编码方案。

title: LoGo: Token-Level Dynamic Local-Global Attention
summary: As context lengths scale, attention increasingly becomes a primary computational bottleneck in large language models. Standard Transformers remain powerful but computationally inefficient, as they allocate the same attention budget to every token regardless of its contextual demand. Existing local-global hybrids provide a more efficient alternative by mixing restricted- and full-context attention, but they typically allocate span statically across layers or heads. To address these limitations, we propose LoGo, a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses attention span as a direct proxy for attention budget allocation. Each LoGo layer contains coupled local and global branches: all tokens receive efficient local attention over a restricted context window, while a learned gate activates global attention with full-context access only for tokens requiring long-range information. A threshold-based budget controller maintains a target global ratio without auxiliary losses, and a progressive masking schedule stabilizes training before sparse routing takes effect. We further implement query-sparse Triton kernels that convert reduced global-attention computation into practical speedups. Extensive experiments validate LoGo's effectiveness, showing that it preserves the scaling behavior of full-attention Transformers across model sizes. In controlled comparisons, LoGo improves over the full-attention Transformer and matched-budget static local-global hybrids, with clear gains on long-range retrieval. Analysis further shows that LoGo learns interpretable span allocation patterns. These results suggest that learned token-level span allocation is an effective and scalable way to improve the long-context performance-compute trade-off.

AI.tldr: LoGo是一种token级别的动态局部-全局注意力机制，通过学习的门控机制只为需要长距离信息的token激活全局注意力，其余token使用高效的局部注意力，从而在不损失性能的情况下显著提升长上下文场景的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer对所有token分配相同的注意力预算，即使许多token并不需要全局信息，导致计算瓶颈。现有的局部-全局混合方法虽然更高效，但注意力跨度是静态分配的（按层或按头），无法根据token的实际上下文需求动态调整。
AI.method: LoGo每层包含耦合的局部和全局分支：所有token先获得局部注意力；通过学习的门控机制仅为需要长距离信息的token激活全局注意力。采用阈值基础预算控制器维持目标全局比例（无需辅助损失），并通过渐进掩码调度稳定训练。此外实现了query-sparse Triton内核将计算减少转化为实际速度提升。
AI.result: 实验表明LoGo在多个模型规模上保持了全注意力Transformer的扩展行为，在受控对比中优于全注意力Transformer和同等预算的静态混合方法，尤其在长距离检索任务上增益明显。LoGo还学习到了可解释的跨度分配模式。
AI.conclusion: 学习式的token级跨度分配是一种有效且可扩展的方式，能够改善长上下文场景下的性能-计算权衡。

title: An Explainable Coherence Score for Detecting Temporal Inconsistencies in Political News
summary: Temporal inconsistencies, such as mandates attributed outside their real interval, events presented as past before they occurred, or inverted causal sequences, are a form of political disinformation that evades style-based fake news detectors: a well-written article with a single wrong date carries no lexical signal of falsehood. This paper introduces the Temporal Coherence Score (TCS), a continuous, intrinsically interpretable metric that quantifies the temporal coherence of a news article, computed by a four-stage pipeline: extraction of temporal facts, construction of a temporal knowledge graph, hierarchical verification against internal consistency rules and external reference sources, and score aggregation with automatically generated explanations. Verification combines eight internal checkers derived from Allen's interval algebra with a five-level external hierarchy ranging from a locally stored reference knowledge base of 1{,}256 curated political facts to live Wikidata SPARQL queries. On a benchmark of 100 political news articles with injected temporal errors, the system reaches a precision of 0.909 at the selected operating threshold, with a single residual false positive, a profile deliberately tuned for human-in-the-loop fact-checking assistance, where false alarms are costlier than missed detections. Unlike lexical baselines that output only a binary label, every flagged article is accompanied by the inconsistency type, the entities involved, and the reference source that contradicts the claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间连贯性评分（TCS），一个连续且可解释的指标，用于量化新闻文章的时间连贯性，通过四阶段流程检测时间不一致性（如错误日期、因果倒置等）的政治虚假信息，在100篇注入时间错误的新闻基准上达到0.909的精确率。
AI.motivation: 时间不一致性是政治虚假信息的一种形式，能规避基于风格的假新闻检测器——一篇文字优美的文章只要有一个错误日期就不含任何词法层面的虚假信号，现有基于词法的二分类方法无法捕捉此类问题。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：（1）提取时间事实；（2）构建时间知识图谱；（3）通过内部一致性规则和外部参考源进行层级验证——包括基于Allen区间代数的8个内部检查器，以及从1,256条本地策展政治事实到实时Wikidata SPARQL查询的五级外部层级；（4）评分聚合并自动生成解释。
AI.result: 在100篇注入时间错误的基准上，系统在选定操作阈值下达到0.909的精确率，仅有一个残留误报；该设置刻意调优为面向人机协同事实核查，将误报视为比漏报更昂贵的代价。
AI.conclusion: 与仅输出二元标签的词法基线不同，TCS为每篇被标记的文章提供不一致类型、涉及实体及矛盾参考来源的详细信息，使其成为人机协同事实核查辅助工具。

title: GraM-Diff: A Unified Graph-Mamba Diffusion Framework for EEG-Based Alzheimer's Disease Data Generation and Diagnosis
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a promising, non-invasive, and cost-effective modality for Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection, but deep learning methods are limited by small and imbalanced clinical datasets. Generative augmentation offers a solution, yet existing approaches rely on inefficient class-specific models or fail to capture complex spatial and temporal brain dynamics. To address this, we propose GraM-Diff, a unified classifier-guided Graph-Mamba diffusion framework for EEG synthesis. It embeds Graph Convolutional Networks within a diffusion U-Net to model inter-electrode connectivity and Bidirectional Mamba state-space blocks for linear-complexity long-range temporal modeling. Latent-space classifier guidance lets a single model generate both healthy and pathological EEG within a shared representation, avoiding fragmented per-cohort pipelines. Across four EEG-based AD benchmarks, synthetic augmentation improves classification, yields superior Context-FID and correlation scores over strong generative baselines, and enhances robustness in data-scarce settings.

AI.tldr: 提出GraM-Diff，一种统一的分类器引导的图-曼巴扩散框架，用于阿尔茨海默病EEG信号合成。该框架通过图卷积网络建模电极间连接，双向Mamba块实现线性复杂度的长程时序建模，并在潜空间中使用分类器引导，使单一模型能同时生成健康和病理EEG。在四个AD基准上超越强生成基线，提升分类性能和数据稀缺场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习检测AD受限于临床EEG数据集小且不平衡的问题；现有生成式数据增强方法要么依赖低效的类别专属模型，要么未能捕捉复杂的时空脑动态。
AI.method: GraM-Diff将图卷积网络嵌入扩散U-Net中以建模电极间连接，采用双向Mamba状态空间块实现线性复杂度的长程时序建模；通过潜空间分类器引导，使单一模型在共享表示空间内同时生成健康和病理EEG。
AI.result: 在四个EEG AD基准上，合成增强提升了分类性能，产生优于强生成基线的Context-FID和相关分数，并增强了数据稀缺场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GraM-Diff证明统一的多类别生成框架能有效建模EEG时空动态，为AD等小样本临床场景提供可靠数据增强方案。

title: Evaluating LLMs on Conversational Text-to-SQL under Chain Ambiguity and Intent Drift
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have established conversational text-to-SQL as a practical interface between users and databases, often involving multiple turns of clarification and revision. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate execution accuracy, leaving the unfolding and shifting of user intent across turns largely uncovered. To address this, we introduce TIDE-Bench, a benchmark for conversational text-to-SQL under chain ambiguity and intent drift evaluation, targeting two recurring patterns: chain ambiguity, where an underspecified question triggers layered clarification with conditional dependencies, and intent drift, where the user retracts and replaces a previously committed request element. Built on 514 anchor SQLs from BIRD, TIDE-Bench comprises 1,542 samples and introduces dedicated metrics for chain identification and drift recognition-resolution beyond execution accuracy. Evaluating 12 advanced LLMs reveals a persistent chain identification bottleneck unaffected by clarification frequency, a wide drift recognition-resolution gap, and overlap between failure modes when jointly activated. The corresponding code of TIDE-Bench is released for further research.

AI.tldr: 提出了TIDE-Bench基准，用于评估会话式文本转SQL中的链式歧义和意图漂移，涵盖1,542个样本和专用指标，发现LLM在链识别和漂移识别上存在显著瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有文本转SQL基准主要评估执行准确性，未能覆盖多轮对话中用户意图的逐步展开和转变，缺乏对链式歧义和意图漂移的系统性评估。
AI.method: 基于BIRD数据集构建514个锚定SQL，扩展为1,542个样本，设计两类任务模式（链式歧义和意图漂移），引入链识别和漂移识别-解析专用指标，评估12个先进LLM。
AI.result: 发现链识别瓶颈不受澄清频率影响，漂移识别-解析之间存在较大差距，且当两类失败模式联合激活时存在重叠。
AI.conclusion: TIDE-Bench填补了会话式文本转SQL中意图动态评估的空白，揭示了当前LLM在多轮对话意图理解上的系统性缺陷。

title: ECA-BLS: An Efficient Complex-Augmented Broad Learning System
summary: Broad Learning System (BLS) is an efficient alternative to deep architectures due to its fast training, analytical learning, and strong generalization under limited data. However, existing BLS variants are confined to real-valued representations, restricting their ability to capture nonlinear interactions and second-order statistical dependencies inherent in real-world data. Notably, no prior BLS model fully exploits the complete second-order statistics that naturally emerge when data are embedded in the complex domain. To address this limitation, this paper introduces the first complex augmented Broad Learning System (CA-BLS), which transforms real-valued inputs into phase-encoded complex representations and adopts widely linear modeling to jointly leverage covariance and pseudo-covariance information via complex conjugate augmentation. This enables effective modeling of latent nonlinearities, coherence structures, and second-order dependencies inaccessible to conventional BLS formulations. To mitigate the additional computational cost of complex augmentation, an Efficient Complex Augmented BLS (ECA-BLS) is further developed, reformulating CA-BLS entirely in the real domain while preserving its exact decision function, achieving up to 75\% fewer multiplications and over 60\% fewer additions. A rigorous theoretical analysis proves the mathematical equivalence between CA-BLS and ECA-BLS, ensuring zero theoretical loss. Extensive experiments on 26 benchmark datasets from the UCI and KEEL repositories demonstrate that ECA-BLS consistently outperforms classical BLS and recent state-of-the-art randomized neural networks in accuracy, average rank, and statistical significance, establishing augmented second-order modeling as a critical and previously missing dimension of BLS research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出复数增广宽度学习系统（CA-BLS）及其高效变体（ECA-BLS），将实数输入转换为相位编码的复数表示，并利用宽线性建模同时利用协方差和伪协方差信息，从而捕捉传统BLS无法建模的非线性交互和二阶统计依赖。ECA-BLS在保持数学等价的前提下于实数域重新表述，实现高达75%的乘法节省和60%以上的加法节省，在26个基准数据集上显著优于经典BLS和最新随机神经网络。
AI.motivation: 现有BLS变体局限于实数表示，无法充分捕捉真实世界数据中固有的非线性交互和二阶统计依赖。目前没有任何BLS模型充分利用复数域中自然涌现的完整二阶统计量，这是一个关键缺失的研究维度。
AI.method: 1) CA-BLS：将实数输入通过相位编码转换为复数表示，采用宽线性建模，通过复数共轭增广联合利用协方差与伪协方差信息；2) ECA-BLS：将CA-BLS完全在实数域中重新表述，保持精确决策函数不变，从而大幅降低计算成本；3) 提供严格的理论分析证明两者数学等价。
AI.result: 在26个UCI和KEEL基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ECA-BLS在准确率、平均排名和统计显著性方面持续优于经典BLS及最新的随机神经网络；同时实现了高达75%的乘法减少和60%以上的加法减少。
AI.conclusion: 增广二阶建模是BLS研究中一个关键且此前缺失的维度，本研究填补了这一空白，为BLS在复数域的扩展提供了理论依据与高效实现，确立了其在该领域的领先地位。

title: TACS: Trajectory-Aware Candidate Selection for LLM Jailbreak Suffix Optimization
summary: Gradient-based jailbreak suffix optimization methods typically update the suffix by retaining the candidate with the lowest current loss. We show that this seemingly natural design is fundamentally myopic: candidates that look better under the current-step proxy often fail to produce better jailbreak outcomes later in the search, revealing a form of selection-stage reward hacking. This suggests that candidate selection, rather than candidate generation alone, is a hidden bottleneck in suffix optimization. To address this issue, we propose \OURS{}, a trajectory-aware candidate selection framework for jailbreak suffix optimization. Instead of selecting candidates solely by their immediate loss, \OURS{} augments per-step evaluation with a trajectory-aware proxy and stabilizes selection with reference-policy regularization and a discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction, encouraging choices that remain effective beyond the current step. Experiments on HarmBench show that \OURS{} consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same search budget, substantially improving attack success rates while exhibiting more stable optimization behavior throughout the search. Our findings highlight that mitigating selection-stage reward hacking caused by myopic candidate selection is critical for improving jailbreak suffix optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了梯度式越狱后缀优化中一个被忽视的问题：按当前损失选择候选者是一种"短视"设计，会导致选择阶段的奖励黑客（reward hacking）。作者提出OURS框架，通过轨迹感知的候选选择、参考策略正则化和判别器估计的卡方校正，显著提升了攻击成功率和优化稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度式越狱后缀优化方法每一步都保留当前损失最低的候选者，但这种看似自然的设计是短视的——当前步骤表现好的候选者可能在后续搜索中导致更差的越狱效果，暴露出选择阶段的奖励黑客问题。候选选择而非候选生成，才是后缀优化中隐藏的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出OURS框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 轨迹感知代理（trajectory-aware proxy）增强每步评估，不只依赖即时损失；(2) 参考策略正则化（reference-policy regularization）稳定选择过程；(3) 判别器估计的卡方校正（discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction），鼓励选择在后续步骤中仍然有效的候选者。
AI.result: 在HarmBench基准上，OURS在相同搜索预算下持续优于强基线，显著提升攻击成功率，并在整个搜索过程中表现出更稳定的优化行为。
AI.conclusion: 缓解由短视候选选择导致的选择阶段奖励黑客，对于改进越狱后缀优化至关重要。选择机制的设计与候选生成同样重要，甚至更为关键。

title: Benevolent Bias in Multi-Turn Human-Agent Dialogue
summary: Bias in human-agent interaction can manifest not only through hostile language but also as benevolent bias, whereby unequal treatment hides behind a warm, positive tone. To make it detectable, we operationalise benevolent bias along two dimensions, tone and treatment, yielding three classes: neutral support, overt bias, and benevolent bias. Building on these definitions, we construct BENEVDIAL, a class-balanced corpus of 362,880 multi-turn support dialogues spanning user and agent demographics, roles, and generators, to support controlled evaluation. We then test two detector families on it: off-the-shelf safety detectors and prompted large language model (LLM) judges. Our results reveal a detection gap: off-the-shelf detectors reliably flag overt bias yet largely miss benevolent bias, while LLM judges catch more under more explicit detection criteria but increasingly misclassify neutral support as benevolent bias, and demographic context amplifies the false alarms. These findings suggest that fair monitoring of human-agent dialogue must look beyond surface cues to whether the agent's treatment is disparate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并定义了一种新型的AI对话偏见——"善意偏见"（benevolent bias），即用温暖积极语气掩盖不平等待遇的偏见形式。作者构建了包含362,880段多轮支持对话的类平衡语料库BENEVDIAL，并测试了现成的安全检测器和LLM裁判两类检测器，发现现成检测器能识别显性偏见但严重遗漏善意偏见，而LLM裁判在更显式检测标准下虽能捕捉更多善意偏见，但会产生更多误报，人口统计背景会加剧误报问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的人机交互偏见检测研究大多聚焦于对抗性语言或显性偏见，忽略了以温暖积极语气包装的隐性不平等对待（即善意偏见）。这种偏见更隐蔽、更难检测，但同样有害，因此需要系统性定义、构建基准数据集并评估现有检测方法的有效性。
AI.method: 作者首先从语气（tone）和对待（treatment）两个维度对偏见进行操作性定义，划分出三类：中性支持、显性偏见和善意偏见。基于此定义构建了BENEVDIAL语料库，包含362,880段多轮支持对话，覆盖用户与智能体的人口统计特征、角色和生成器，并保持类别平衡。随后在该语料库上测试两类检测器：现成的安全检测器和基于提示的LLM裁判。
AI.result: 研究发现存在明显的检测缺口：现成安全检测器能可靠标记显性偏见但基本遗漏善意偏见；LLM裁判在更明确的检测标准下能捕捉更多善意偏见，但与此同时将更多中性支持误分类为善意偏见，且加入人口统计背景信息会进一步放大误报率。
AI.conclusion: 公平监控人机对话不能仅依赖表面线索（如语气是否友好），而必须深入判断智能体的待遇是否存在差异性。作者呼吁检测框架应超越语气表面，关注实际对待的差异化程度，才能有效识别这种隐蔽的善意偏见。

title: PruneShift: A Framework for Evaluating Decision Reliability in Structured Pruning
summary: Structured pruning uses surrogate objectives because direct task evaluation over every feasible mask is too expensive. Most evaluations report average surrogate error or rank correlation on broadly sampled masks. These summaries do not directly test the mask chosen by the surrogate. We introduce PruneShift, an evaluation framework that separates broad predictive fidelity, fidelity near selector outputs, and the quality of the selected pruning decision. We first prove that Spearman and Kendall agreement can approach one while normalized selection regret remains maximal. We then derive sufficient conditions based on uniform error, selector suboptimality, decision margin, density ratio, and comparison mass.
