The analysis also yields a finite pool certificate with an explicit excess cost bound. Four studies test different links in this argument. External TextbookQA confirmation is heterogeneous: 7 of 20 simultaneous intervals favor the surrogate-selected mask, 6 favor its fixed comparator, and 7 cross zero. On a fixed Natural Questions pool, strict improvement holds in one of four settings. A controlled QQP experiment supports the proposed coverage mechanism in all 16 prespecified endpoints, although the sufficient bounds are conservative. Finally, a restricted OSSCAR reconstruction study on OPT-125M shows better local than broad fidelity in 68 of 75 primary endpoints. Independent fixed-mask confirmation is inconclusive in 24 of 25 endpoints and favors the comparator in one. These results show why predictive fit, decision reliability, and pruning method quality require separate evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PruneShift评估框架，用于分离结构化剪枝中代理目标的预测保真度、选择器输出的局部保真度以及最终剪枝决策质量三个层面。理论证明Spearman/Kendall相关性接近1时选择遗憾仍可最大化，并推导了基于均匀误差、选择器次优性、决策余量、密度比和比较质量的充分条件，同时给出有限池证书和显式超额成本界。四项研究验证了该论证框架的各环节，结果显示出预测拟合、决策可靠性和剪枝方法质量需要分开评估。
AI.motivation: 结构化剪枝中直接对每个可行掩码进行任务评估成本过高，因此必须使用代理目标（surrogate objectives）。然而现有评估大多只报告平均代理误差或秩相关系数，这些汇总指标不能直接检验代理目标实际选出的剪枝掩码的质量，导致评估与最终决策质量之间脱节。
AI.method: 提出PruneShift评估框架，将评估分解为三个层面：广泛的预测保真度、选择器输出附近的保真度、以及所选剪枝决策的质量。理论上证明了Spearman和Kendall一致性趋近1时归一化选择遗憾仍可达到最大；推导了基于均匀误差、选择器次优性、决策余量、密度比和比较质量的充分条件；并给出有限池证书和显式超额成本界。通过四项实验（TextbookQA、Natural Questions、QQP、OSSCAR重建）验证论证的不同环节。
AI.result: 外部TextbookQA确认结果异质：20个同时区间中7个支持代理选择掩码，6个支持固定比较器，7个跨零。固定Natural Questions池上，在四个设置中仅一个呈现严格改进。受控QQP实验在所有16个预设端点支持所提出的覆盖机制，但充分界较保守。受限OSSCAR重建研究中，OPT-125M在75个主要端点中有68个显示局部保真度优于广泛保真度。独立固定掩码确认在25个端点中有24个不确定，1个支持比较器。
AI.conclusion: 预测拟合（predictive fit）、决策可靠性（decision reliability）和剪枝方法质量（pruning method quality）需要独立的证据来分别评估，不能仅依赖平均代理误差或秩相关等汇总指标。现有评估实践的汇总统计可能掩盖代理目标在选择关键决策时的真实失败。

title: Which one is banana man? Evaluating vision-language models in multi-turn pragmatic interpretation
summary: Flexible adaptation to context and shared pragmatic intuitions contribute to smooth human conversation. Iterated reference games---in which players repeatedly pick out novel referents using language---present a test case for agents' ability to perform context-sensitive pragmatic reasoning in multi-turn linguistic environments. We tested humans and vision--language models on their ability to identify the intended meaning of descriptions produced in iterated reference games, varying the provided context in terms of amount, order, and relevance. While humans performed well consistently, the models we evaluated could make use of prior context to interpret humans' referring expressions, but they struggled to build up the relevant context to interpret those expressions effectively. Our results suggest that the models we evaluated lack core skills needed for efficient linguistic collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了人类和视觉-语言模型在迭代参照游戏中的语境敏感语用推理能力。研究发现人类能始终如一地利用上下文理解指称表达，而视觉-语言模型虽然能利用先前语境，但难以有效构建相关上下文来正确解释人类的指称表达，表明这些模型缺乏高效语言协作的核心技能。
AI.motivation: 流畅的人机对话需要灵活的语境适应和共享的语用直觉。迭代参照游戏为测试智能体在多轮语言环境中进行语境敏感的语用推理能力提供了理想的测试场景，而现有视觉-语言模型在这方面的能力评估尚不充分。
AI.method: 在迭代参照游戏中，通过操纵上下文的数量、顺序和相关性三个维度，对人类参与者和多种视觉-语言模型进行对照实验，测试他们对自然语言描述中意图含义的识别能力。
AI.result: 人类在所有条件下都表现稳定良好；视觉-语言模型能够利用先前的上下文信息来解释人类的指称表达，但在构建必要上下文以有效解释这些表达方面存在明显困难。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉-语言模型缺乏高效语言合作所需的语境构建能力，在需要主动积累和整合上下文信息的协作任务中表现不足，这为此类模型的应用提供了重要局限提示。

title: Hyper-Fold: Exploring the Expressive Limit of Sequence-Geometry Learning for Proteins via Hypergraph Modeling
summary: Protein structure modeling rests on a single computational primitive: the interaction between what a residue is (sequence content) and where it sits (three-dimensional geometry). What is the expressive limit of this layer class? We show that the complete bilinear operator over content-geometry outer products--the sufficient statistic of all second-order interactions--is the expressive ceiling, while the additive message passing of mainstream geometric GNNs is provably blind to content-geometry binding. We then introduce Hyper-Fold, a rank-K separable convolutional backbone approaching this ceiling at message-passing cost: each radius neighborhood is organized into a sequence hyperedge and a contact hyperedge, modulated by an edge-conditioned matrix-valued operator factorized into K learned basis operators with geometry-generated coefficients. Across enzyme function prediction, fold classification, and ligand binding site detection, Hyper-Fold and its hierarchical variant Hyper-Fold-Deep achieve the best results among protein-specific structure encoders; Hyper-Fold-Pocket, an anchored set-prediction head, surpasses UniSite-3D on UniSite-DS and two zero-shot benchmarks with no sequence language model features, 68x fewer parameters, and 4.8x lower latency--suggesting that a sufficiently expressive 3D backbone recovers information that fusion architectures previously borrowed from evolution-scale pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper-Fold，一种秩K可分卷积骨干网络，通过完整的双线性算子逼近内容-几何外积的表达上限，以消息传递成本实现蛋白质结构编码的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 主流几何GNN的加性消息传递对内容-几何绑定天生不可见（provably blind），无法捕捉残基序列内容与三维几何之间的二阶交互信息，需要探索该层类的表达极限。
AI.method: 将每个半径邻域组织为序列超边和接触超边，通过边条件矩阵值算子（分解为K个学习到的基算子，用几何生成系数调制）实现秩K可分卷积，逼近双线性算子表达上限。
AI.result: 在酶功能预测、折叠分类和配体结合位点检测任务中，Hyper-Fold及其层次变体Hyper-Fold-Deep达到最优；Hyper-Fold-Pocket在UniSite-DS和两个零样本基准上超越UniSite-3D，参数少68倍，延迟低4.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 足够有表达力的3D骨干网络可以恢复融合架构先前从进化规模预训练中借用到的信息，无需序列语言模型特征。

title: Structure Aware Neural Architecture Search for Mixture of Experts
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has so far rarely been applied to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, and existing MoE designs leave the alignment between experts and the structure of the data to emerge on its own. We propose an architecture search framework that makes this alignment an explicit search variable: the assignment of data clusters to experts is optimised jointly with the per-expert architectures. We cast the joint problem as a cluster-aware likelihood maximisation, show that it coincides with the incomplete-data maximum likelihood of a latent-variable mixture, and solve it by a generalised Expectation-Maximisation procedure whose otherwise intractable expert-quality term is supplied by an adaptively refined surrogate. We prove that the iterates converge whenever the surrogate errors are summable, and that at every limit point no candidate the search produces improves the true objective. On a heterogeneous image-classification mixture the method recovers the underlying domain partition on 95% of clusters without ever observing domain labels, and on that benchmark and a four-domain time-series forecasting one alike it outperforms the MoE and NAS baselines that likewise use no label information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个神经架构搜索框架，将数据簇到专家的分配与每个专家的架构作为联合搜索变量，通过广义EM过程求解，使专家与数据结构对齐，在两个异构基准上超越MoE和NAS基线。
AI.motivation: NAS很少应用于MoE模型，且现有MoE设计让专家与数据结构的对齐自行涌现，缺乏显式优化该对齐机制的框架。
AI.method: 将数据簇到专家的分配与专家架构联合优化，建模为簇感知似然最大化问题，等价于潜在变量混合模型的不完整数据极大似然，采用广义EM过程求解，其中难以处理的专家质量项由自适应精化的代理函数提供。
AI.result: 在异构图像分类混合任务中，该方法在未见过域标签的情况下恢复了95%簇的底层域划分；在图像分类和四域时间序列预测基准上均优于不使用标签信息的MoE和NAS基线。
AI.conclusion: 证明了迭代在代理误差可求和时收敛，且每个极限点上搜索产生的候选都无法改进真实目标，表明该方法理论上可靠且实践有效。

title: SemTrace: Source-Grounded Semantic Signatures for Tracing LLM Exposure to Protected Documents
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to read documents and produce downstream text, creating a provenance problem when the document owner cannot control or inspect the model that performs the generation. We introduce SemTrace, a source-grounded semantic watermark for detecting whether a generated review was influenced by a known protected manuscript copy. Rather than biasing token probabilities or imposing surface-form patterns, SemTrace constructs a document-specific binary signature from factual propositions that are directly supported by the manuscript itself. A protected PDF invisibly carries a content contract that selects one fact from each binary pair and asks an instruction-following reviewer to express those facts in fixed review slots without changing its independent evaluation. A frozen natural language inference model then decodes the resulting semantic evidence with explicit erasures and scores the recovered bits against the codeword assigned to that copy. This design targets model-agnostic, assigned-copy exposure detection while keeping the watermark semantically tied to the source document.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemTrace，一种基于源文档语义的文本水印方法，用于检测AI生成的评论是否受到了受保护论文手稿的影响。它通过从文档事实命题中构建二进制签名，利用受控的NLI模型对生成文本中的语义证据进行解码和匹配，实现模型无关的副本暴露检测。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被广泛用于阅读文档并生成下游文本，但当文档所有者无法控制或检查执行生成的模型时，会产生溯源（provenance）问题。现有水印方法通常通过偏置token概率或强制表面形式模式，容易被忽略或不能与源文档语义建立联系。
AI.method: SemTrace从受保护手稿中提取事实命题，构造文档特定的二进制签名。受保护的PDF中嵌入"内容合约"，从每个二元事实对中选择一个事实，并要求遵循指令的评审模型在固定评审槽位中表达这些事实（不改变其独立评估）。随后，一个冻结的自然语言推理（NLI）模型对生成的语义证据进行解码（包含显式擦除），并将恢复的比特与分配给该副本的码字进行比对评分。
AI.result: 该方法实现了模型无关的、针对特定分配副本的暴露检测，同时保持水印与源文档在语义上紧密关联，而非依赖表面形式或token概率偏差。
AI.conclusion: SemTrace通过将水印嵌入文档的事实语义层面，而非语言表面形式，解决了LLM生成文本场景下的溯源问题，是一种语义驱动、模型无关的文档副本暴露检测方案。

title: Imag-Eval: a language-grounded framework for interpretable Text-to-Image instruction following evaluation
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently achieved impressive visual fidelity, yet their evaluation remains constrained by benchmarks that are often difficult to interpret and insufficiently diagnostic. Existing skill-based evaluations tend to overlook critical failure modes that strongly impact usability but fall outside standard taxonomies, such as global incoherence arising from missing parts or physically implausible configurations (e.g., floating objects). In addition, prompt difficulty is typically controlled along a single dimension; either prompt length or the number of elements to generate. To address these limitations, we introduce Imag-Eval, a controlled benchmark designed to assess how T2I models ground compositional natural-language instructions into visual outputs. Unlike prior work that conflates surface linguistic complexity with compositional difficulty, Imag-Eval explicitly seeks to disentangles these factors by independently varying both the number of instances and the combination of constraints (rules), while avoiding error propagation. This design enables fine-grained and interpretable analysis of where cross-modal instruction following fails. Our benchmark comprises 1,140 prompts and 8,842 combined rules, and we evaluate it on several state-of-the-art models. Complementing this analysis with an additional study of over 2,000 prompts from a concurrent benchmark, our results suggest that, for structured skills, compositional difficulty is primarily governed by the number of grounded rules and their binding to instances,, rather than by prompt length alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Imag-Eval，一个受控的文本到图像（T2I）模型评估基准，通过独立变化实例数量和约束规则数量来解耦表面语言复杂度与组合难度，包含1,140个提示和8,842条组合规则，并发现组合难度主要由规则数量及其与实例的绑定决定，而非提示长度。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型评估存在两个主要问题：(1)基于技能的评估往往忽略标准分类法之外的严重失败模式，如全局不连贯（缺失部件、物理上不合理的配置如漂浮物体）；(2)提示难度通常只沿单一维度控制（提示长度或元素数量），无法真正衡量组合指令跟随能力。
AI.method: Imag-Eval通过独立变化实例数量和约束（规则）组合方式来解耦表面语言复杂度与组合难度，避免错误传播。基准包含1,140个提示和8,842条组合规则，并在多个SOTA模型上评估。此外还补充了来自并发基准的2,000多个提示的对照研究。
AI.result: 通过对多个SOTA模型及并发基准的2,000多个提示进行补充研究，结果表明：对于结构化技能，组合难度主要受已落地规则数量及其与实例的绑定程度控制，而非仅由提示长度决定。
AI.conclusion: Imag-Eval提供了细粒度、可解释的跨模态指令跟随失败分析，揭示了T2I模型评估中被忽视的关键失败模式，并阐明了组合难度的核心驱动因素，为未来T2I评估提供了更有诊断性的基准设计方向。

title: Designing for the Next Click: Bandits for Real-Time Page Layout
comment: Accepted to The Web Conference 2026 (short paper track), but later withdrawn due to internal prioritization. Subsequently accepted to the Online & Adaptive Recommender Systems Workshop (held in conjunction with the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems, RecSys 2026)
summary: E-commerce platforms increasingly personalize user experiences through machine learning, yet page layout decisions remain dominated by static rules and manual curation. We present a scalable bandit-based system that optimizes product page layouts in real time while preserving human control over design intent. A contextual bandit model dynamically selects the most effective layout for each session using user, item, and category-level features. The system leverages a LinUCB-based policy to balance exploration and exploitation as it learns from live user interactions. The architecture is designed for seamless integration into large-scale web serving stacks, supporting low-latency inference and continuous model updates. The system was first tested on entry product pages. In online A/B deployments on a major retail platform, our approach achieved positive lifts in session-level performance metrics over a strong heuristic baseline. Our results demonstrate that contextual bandits can effectively optimize visual and structural aspects of product discovery for user engagement, providing a scalable path toward learning-to-design the web.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于上下文赌博机（contextual bandit）的可扩展系统，用于实时优化电商产品页面布局，在保持人类设计意图的前提下，通过LinUCB策略动态选择最适合每个会话的布局，并在大规模零售平台在线A/B测试中取得了优于启发式基线的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 电商平台虽然通过机器学习实现个性化体验，但页面布局决策仍依赖静态规则和人工策展，缺乏实时优化能力，因此需要一种既能保持设计控制又能动态优化布局的系统。
AI.method: 采用LinUCB策略的上下文赌博机模型，利用用户、商品和类别级特征在每个会话中动态选择最佳布局，通过平衡探索与利用从实时用户交互中学习；架构设计支持低延迟推理和持续模型更新，可无缝集成到大规模Web服务栈中。
AI.result: 系统在入口商品页面上进行了在线A/B部署，与强启发式基线相比，在会话级性能指标上取得了正向提升。
AI.conclusion: 上下文赌博机能够有效优化产品发现中的视觉和结构方面以提升用户参与度，为"学习设计网页"提供了可扩展的可行路径。

title: SUP-MIMIC: A Multi-Task Clinical Diagnosis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs' Robustness to Contradictory Evidence
summary: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on factual knowledge retrieval, overlooking the fundamental challenge of navigating the complex, non-bijective mappings between clinical indicators and diagnoses. Existing benchmarks fail to assess whether large language models truly possess the reasoning capability required for diagnostic ambiguity scenarios, where identical clinical presentations may correspond to different etiologies, and diagnostic convergence scenarios, where heterogeneous symptoms ultimately indicate the same disease. To address this issue, we propose SUP-MIMIC, a multi-task framework utilizing MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that comprises Basic Assessment (BA), Diagnostic Divergence Task (DDT), and Diagnostic Convergence Task (DCT). Specifically, DDT is designed to evaluate the model's "one-to-many" disambiguation capability among phenotypically similar cases, while DCT assesses the model's ability to identify "many-to-one" diagnostic patterns across different pathophysiological pathways. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs reveals substantial performance degradation on DDT and DCT compared to baseline tasks, exposing a systemic reliance on statistical shortcuts over genuine causal reasoning. Our findings further highlight a conservative bias toward "healthy" predictions, implying non-trivial risks for missed diagnoses in realistic medical settings. This work establishes a rigorous methodology for quantifying clinical reasoning robustness and provides a roadmap for enhancing the safety of language models in clinical medicine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUP-MIMIC框架，基于MIMIC-IV-v3.1构建三大评估任务（BA、DDT、DCT），专门针对LLM在临床诊断中的非双射映射推理能力进行评估，发现现有LLM在诊断发散（一对一多）和诊断收敛（多对一）任务中表现出显著性能下降，暴露了模型依赖统计捷径而非真正因果推理的问题，并揭示了模型倾向于预测"健康"的保守偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估主要关注事实知识检索，忽略了临床诊断中最核心的挑战——临床指标与诊断之间复杂的非双射映射关系。缺乏能评估模型在诊断模糊场景（相同表现对应不同病因）和诊断收敛场景（异质症状指向同一疾病）中推理能力的基准。
AI.method: 提出SUP-MIMIC多任务评估框架，包含三个任务：基础评估（BA）作为基线；诊断发散任务（DDT）评估"一对多"去歧义能力；诊断收敛任务（DCT）评估"多对一"模式识别能力。基于MIMIC-IV-v3.1构建数据，对现有SOTA LLM进行全面评估。
AI.result: SOTA LLM在DDT和DCT上相较于基线任务表现出显著性能下降，说明模型依赖统计捷径而非真正的因果推理；同时还发现模型存在保守性偏差，倾向于预测"健康"结果，在真实医疗场景中可能导致漏诊风险。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了量化临床推理鲁棒性的严谨方法论，为提升语言模型在临床医学中的安全性提供了路线图，揭示了当前LLM在临床诊断推理方面的关键局限性。

title: Computational Depth Measurement in Thermographic Video: Overcoming Spatial Overfitting via Spatio-Temporal Decoupling
summary: Accurate through-thickness measurement of subsurface delamination depth in Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) is important for structural assessment because defect location determines affected load-bearing layers. Optical pulsed thermography (OPT) provides a two-dimensional thermal video rather than volumetric measurements, so depth must be inferred from temporal heat-diffusion responses. A challenge is spatial dataset bias: when calibration defects follow regular grids, regression models may memorize their geometry instead of learning physical relationship between thermal decay and depth. This work introduces a spatio-temporal decoupling architecture that separates spatial defect localization from temporal depth measurement. Defect regions are first localized using segmentation methods, after which thermal responses are spatially averaged and converted into sixteen physics-informed temporal, energy, statistical, and geometric features. These features expose the one-dimensional heat-conduction relationship while withholding pixel coordinates from the depth model. Four regression models are evaluated using specimen-level cross-validation: Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), Advanced Multi-Layer Perceptron (Adv-MLP), and XGBoost. Unregularized trees and over-parameterized Adv-MLP exhibit calibration collapse under geometric shifts, with errors exceeding 0.5 mm. In contrast, regularized XGBoost with L1/L2 penalties and column sampling maintains cross-specimen calibration, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.056 mm and root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.085 mm. Predicted depths are merged with masks to generate Delaunay-triangulated three-dimensional defect models in three to five seconds per specimen. Results show that mathematical regularization and spatio-temporal decoupling reduce spatial memorization in thermal-video depth regression.

AI.tldr: 本文针对光学脉冲热成像（OPT）中复合材料层间分层深度测量问题，提出一种时空解耦架构，将空间缺陷定位与时间序列深度测量分离。通过分割定位缺陷区域、提取十六种物理信息特征（排除像素坐标），并采用正则化XGBoost回归模型，在保持跨样本校准的同时实现MAE 0.056 mm和RMSE 0.085 mm的深度测量精度，最终通过Delaunay三角化生成三维缺陷模型。
AI.motivation: CFRP层间分层深度对结构评估至关重要，但OPT只提供二维热视频而非体积测量，深度需从时间热扩散响应推断。然而校准缺陷若按规则网格排列，回归模型可能记忆其几何位置而非学习物理映射关系，导致空间数据集偏差与过拟合问题。
AI.method: 提出时空解耦架构：(1) 先用分割方法定位缺陷区域；(2) 对区域热响应进行空间平均，转换为十六种物理信息特征（时间、能量、统计、几何），完全剔除像素坐标输入；(3) 采用四种回归模型（RF、GBM、Adv-MLP、XGBoost）进行样本级交叉验证，其中XGBoost采用L1/L2正则化与列采样；(4) 将预测深度与分割掩膜融合，通过Delaunay三角化在3-5秒内生成三维缺陷模型。
AI.result: 正则化XGBoost在跨样本校准中表现最佳，MAE为0.056 mm，RMSE为0.085 mm；而未正则化的决策树和过参数化Adv-MLP在几何偏移下出现校准崩溃，误差超过0.5 mm。三维缺陷模型生成效率为每样本3-5秒。
AI.conclusion: 数学正则化与时空解耦能有效减少热视频深度回归中的空间记忆效应。将空间定位与时间深度测量分离，并采用正则化集成学习方法，是克服校准数据几何偏差、实现跨样本泛化的关键策略。

title: Uncertainty-Driven Replay Memory for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Uncertainty estimation provides promising capabilities for reinforcement learning (RL) agents. Notably, estimating uncertainty can reduce the training time and enable agents to obtain greater rewards over time by exploiting information related to whether an action would facilitate exploration of portions of an environment that are well-known versus those that are relatively unknown. In this work, we propose a novel formulation of the experience replay buffer commonly used in RL that we call uncertainty-driven replay memory (UDRM), which entails an update scheme for internally stored memories based on uncertainty estimates obtained by an RL model during training. In contrast to existing forms of RL, which typically use temporal difference error or the distribution of transitions to update the replay memory buffer and train RL controllers, our scheme biases the memory buffer to store more uncertain transitions that will improve an RL agent's generalization throughout training. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed uncertainty-aware replay buffer enables an RL agent to obtain higher rewards during training compared to other existing uncertainty-aware RL frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于不确定性的经验回放内存（UDRM）机制，通过利用强化学习模型训练过程中获得的不确定性估计来更新内部存储的记忆，使回放缓冲区偏向存储更多不确定的转换，从而提高RL智能体的泛化能力和训练奖励。
AI.motivation: 不确定性估计为强化学习智能体提供了有价值的能力，可以帮助智能体判断动作是促进对已知环境的探索还是未知环境的探索，从而减少训练时间并获得更高回报。然而现有的经验回放机制通常基于时间差分误差或转移分布来更新缓冲区，没有充分利用不确定性信息。
AI.method: 提出不确定性驱动的回放内存（UDRM），设计基于RL训练过程中获得的不确定性估计的记忆更新方案，使回放缓冲区偏向存储更多不确定的转换，以改善智能体在训练过程中的泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的不确定性感知回放缓冲区使RL智能体在训练过程中比其他现有的不确定性感知RL框架获得更高的奖励。
AI.conclusion: 基于不确定性的回放内存更新机制能够有效提升强化学习智能体的训练性能和泛化能力，相比现有方法具有显著优势。

title: How You Ask Shapes What You Get: A Theory-Seeded Measurement of Articulation in Advice-Seeking LLM Conversations
summary: Users articulate the same advice-seeking request in different ways: some specify detailed constraints, others gesture at a vague need. Prior work treats this variation as noise to be averaged away; we instead treat it as a stable, measurable structure in the input distribution. We ask whether articulation (how people ask) forms latent dimensions separable from topic (what they ask about), and whether it is associated with how language models respond. We extract interpretable features from 16,447 advice-seeking prompts pooled from public chat corpora (WildChat, LMSYS, and ShareChat) and recover a small set of latent articulation factors that replicate across train/test splits and across corpora. Because this structure is largely separable from topic, the populations it defines cut across topics and stay invisible to topic- or task-based evaluation. The factors define a handful of recurring articulation styles, one of which stands out: a long-form but information-poor style, roughly one in six prompts in the largest corpus, where models return shorter, vaguer answers and do not ask for clarification even though under-specification is exactly the condition that warrants it. The contrast holds within every topic group and length quintile, and is not under-specification alone -- a second, equally under-specified style does draw clarifying questions. Two independent human annotators reproduce this contrast. We argue that benchmarks should stratify on articulation, and we offer the extracted structure as a measurement instrument for doing so.

AI.tldr: 本文从16447条求助提示词中提取出可复现的潜在"表达方式"(articulation)因子，发现其与"主题"(topic)可分，并定义了若干反复出现的表达风格。其中一种"长而信息贫乏"的风格(约占最大语料库的1/6)会导致模型返回更短、更模糊的回答且不主动澄清，即使未充分说明恰恰是需要澄清的情况。作者主张基准测试应基于表达方式进行分层，并提供了测量工具。
AI.motivation: 以往研究将用户提问方式的差异视为需要被平均掉的噪声，作者反其道而行之，认为这种差异是输入分布中稳定、可测量的结构。核心动机是：(1) 探究"如何提问"(articulation)是否构成与"问什么"(topic)分离的潜在维度；(2) 揭示这种结构是否影响语言模型的回应方式，并指出基于主题或任务的评估会忽略这一维度。
AI.method: 从三个公开聊天语料库(WildChat、LMSYS、ShareChat)中汇集16447条求助提示词，提取可解释特征，通过潜变量方法恢复出一小组可复现的表达因子(在训练/测试集及跨语料库间均稳定)。随后分析这些因子与模型回应(长度、模糊度、是否主动澄清)之间的关联，并用两位独立人工标注者验证关键对比。
AI.result: (1) 恢复了与主题大致可分离的少量潜在表达因子，这些因子定义的人群跨越主题、在主题/任务类评估中不可见；(2) 发现一种突出的"长形式但信息贫乏"的表达风格，约占最大语料库的1/6，该风格下模型回答更短更模糊且不主动澄清；(3) 两个独立人工标注者复现了这一对比；(4) 该效果在每个主题组和长度分位组内均成立，且不能仅归因于未充分说明——另一种同样未充分说明的风格确实会引发澄清提问。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试应基于表达方式进行分层(stratify on articulation)，而不是仅基于主题或任务。作者将提取出的结构作为测量工具提供出来，以支持未来的评估设计。

title: Localizing Emergent Failures in Agentic AI: Recovering Minimal Repair Families via Counterfactual Replay
summary: Failures in agentic AI systems can arise from interactions among messages exchanged by multiple large language model (LLM) agents. Pointwise attribution cannot distinguish a jointly necessary repair from alternative singleton repairs. We formulate Minimal Repair Family Recovery (MRFR): recovering all inclusion-minimal event sets whose counterfactual replay restores task success within a declared size bound. We propose Graph-Constrained Joint Replay (GCJR), which slices failure-relevant events from an execution dependency graph, constructs graph-feasible singleton and pair candidates, and verifies them by replay with paired clean counterparts. For fixed replay outcomes, GCJR is exact within its declared graph domain. On 90 in-scope cases from a 120-DAG controlled benchmark, GCJR achieves 1.000 Family Exact Match while reducing mean replay calls from 56.3 to 25.3 (55.1%) relative to exhaustive search. On a 24-case, four-agent LLM pilot, it again achieves 1.000 Family Exact Match and reduces mean model calls from 21.0 to 10.0 (52.4%); single-event replay misses jointly necessary repairs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出最小修复家族恢复（MRFR）问题及图约束联合重放（GCJR）方法，用于在多智能体LLM系统中恢复所有最小的事件集修复。GCJR通过执行依赖图切分相关事件、构建图可行的单例和配对候选并通过重放验证，在受控基准上实现1.000家族精确匹配，同时减少约55%的重放调用。
AI.motivation: 多智能体AI系统的故障可能源于多个LLM智能体之间交互消息的联合效应。传统的逐点归因（pointwise attribution）无法区分联合必要的修复与替代性的单点修复，因此需要一种能够识别所有最小联合事件集的归因方法。
AI.method: 提出GCJR方法，包括三个步骤：(1) 从执行依赖图中切分故障相关事件；(2) 构建图可行的单例和配对候选；(3) 通过配对清洁对照（paired clean counterparts）进行重放验证。该方法在声明的图域内对固定重放结果是精确的。
AI.result: 在120个DAG控制基准的90个范围内案例中，GCJR实现1.000家族精确匹配，同时将平均重放调用从56.3降至25.3（减少55.1%）。在24个案例的四智能体LLM试点中，同样实现1.000家族精确匹配，平均模型调用从21.0降至10.0（减少52.4%），且单一事件重放会遗漏联合必要的修复。
AI.conclusion: GCJR能够高效且精确地恢复所有最小联合修复事件集，显著优于穷举搜索，并证明了单事件归因不足以处理多智能体系统中联合导致的故障。

title: Partially Linear Autoencoders for Manifold Learning and Dimensionality Reduction
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Preprint also available on HAL: https://hal.science/hal-05646575
summary: Autoencoders are widely used for nonlinear dimensionality reduction and manifold learning. While most common implementations rely on both nonlinear encoders and decoders, we investigate the specific role of the encoder and the extent to which it can be constrained to be linear without reducing accuracy. We conduct a comparative study on four autoencoder architectures: standard fully nonlinear autoencoders (AE), linear-encoder autoencoders (Lenc-AE), linear-decoder autoencoders (Ldec-AE), and fully linear autoencoders (LAE), evaluated on synthetic manifolds, computational mechanics data sets, and real-world image data sets including MNIST. We demonstrate that imposing a linear encoder preserves most of the representational capacity of the autoencoder, provided the decoder remains nonlinear. In particular, Lenc-AE consistently outperforms both Ldec-AE and LAE, and achieves reconstruction quality comparable to fully nonlinear AE, while offering advantages in terms of parsimony and interpretability of the latent representation. These results suggest that the nonlinear decoder is the critical component for manifold learning, rather than the encoder. A geometric interpretation of this finding is developed, which identifies the precise conditions under which a linear encoder is sufficient, and the specific manifold configurations that expose its limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比四种自编码器架构（全非线性AE、线性编码器Lenc-AE、线性解码器Ldec-AE、全线性LAE），发现线性编码器在解码器保持非线性时能保留大部分表示能力，Lenc-AE在重建质量上接近全非线性AE，且具有更简洁、可解释的潜在表示优势。
AI.motivation: 虽然自编码器广泛用于非线性降维和流形学习，但编码器与解码器各自的具体作用尚不清楚。研究者希望探究编码器可以被限制为线性的程度，以及这种限制是否会影响精度，从而揭示哪个组件才是流形学习的关键。
AI.method: 在合成流形、计算力学数据集和真实图像数据集（如MNIST）上，对四种自编码器架构（AE、Lenc-AE、Ldec-AE、LAE）进行系统的比较研究，并发展了几何解释来刻画线性编码器适用的精确条件及其局限性。
AI.result: 线性编码器在解码器保持非线性的情况下，能够保留大部分自编码器的表示能力。Lenc-AE始终优于Ldec-AE和LAE，重建质量可与全非线性AE相当。非线性解码器才是流形学习的关键组件。
AI.conclusion: 非线性解码器是流形学习的关键组件，而非编码器。线性编码器在特定条件下是充分的，但某些流形配置会暴露其局限性。Lenc-AE在保持重建质量的同时，提供了稀疏性和潜在表示可解释性方面的优势。

title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
summary: Memory operations of long-horizon LLM agents are hard to supervise: an operation's value is unobservable when it is taken. But they are special -- they leave machine-readable evidence in the trajectory: retrieval hits and answer-time citations. Hindsight Memory-PRM exploits this audit trail twice: offline to train an operation-conditioned memory-utility critic, and online, where retrievals, citations, and one controlled deletion-and-reanswer per probe settle an intervention-calibrated entry-level presence credit, propagated along version chains as an action-level proxy reward -- no per-operation human labels, no Monte-Carlo replay of continuations. On held-out LoCoMo a local 8B policy reaches 77.5% under a fixed shared reader, surpassing its API teacher (65.1%) and all reproduced external systems, at one eighth the context of Mem0's official operating point; on LongMemEval, 79.0%. Ablations attribute the gain to causal calibration rather than signal density, and the policy converges to a multi-version memory organization whose gains no tested open-loop baseline reproduces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hindsight Memory-PRM，利用长时程LLM智能体记忆操作留下的机器可读痕迹（检索命中与答案引用）作为审计轨迹，训练操作条件下的记忆效用评论器，并通过干预校准的条目级信用分配沿版本链传播，实现无需人工标注的记忆操作监督。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上分别达到77.5%和79.0%的准确率，超越API教师模型及现有系统。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体的记忆操作难以监督，因为操作的价值在操作发生时无法直接观察。现有方法需要人工标注或蒙特卡洛重放，成本高昂且效率低下。
AI.method: 利用记忆操作留下的机器可读审计轨迹（检索命中、答案引用），离线训练操作条件下的记忆效用评论器；在线运行时通过检索、引用及受控的删除-重答探针，建立干预校准的条目级存在信用，并沿版本链传播为动作级代理奖励。整个过程无需逐操作人工标注，也无需蒙特卡洛续写重放。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo上本地8B策略达到77.5%（超越API教师65.1%及所有复现的外部系统，且上下文仅为Mem0官方配置的八分之一）；在LongMemEval上达到79.0%。消融实验表明增益来自因果校准而非信号密度，策略收敛到多版本记忆组织，其增益无法被任何无环开放式基线复现。
AI.conclusion: Hindsight Memory-PRM证明了记忆操作的天然审计痕迹可以转化为高效、无需人工标注的监督信号，大幅超越更大规模教师模型与现有系统，并揭示了因果校准在记忆信用分配中的核心作用。

title: Validating FKG.in: Soundness Assessment in LLM-Augmented Indian Food Knowledge
summary: The online culinary ecosystem is increasingly populated by recipe content generated, modified, or summarized by Large Language Models (LLMs). While often plausible, such outputs may contain hallucinated ingredients, misrepresented quantities, or culturally implausible combinations, limiting their suitability for downstream applications and knowledge graph construction. In this paper, we present a semi-automated soundness assessment workflow for validating structured recipe data extracted and augmented by LLMs from informal culinary sources. Developed as part of FKG.in, a knowledge graph of Indian food, the pipeline identifies and addresses common failure modes, including structural inconsistencies, semantic and logical incoherence, and deviations from the source text, through a multi-stage process combining formal grammars, vocabulary-based checks, statistical heuristics, Set Transformer-based coherence modeling, and retrieval-based verification. Although evaluated on Indian recipes, the proposed methods are applicable to broader multilingual and multicultural culinary domains. We provide a practical, auditable, and application-agnostic framework for validating LLM-augmented recipe data, thereby strengthening the foundations of machine-readable food knowledge infrastructures in the era of LLM-generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种半自动化的"健全性评估"工作流，用于验证由大语言模型（LLM）从非正式烹饪来源中提取和增强的结构化食谱数据。该流水线是FKG.in（印度美食知识图谱）项目的一部分，通过多阶段流程（形式语法、词汇检查、统计启发式、Set Transformer一致性建模、检索验证）识别并解决结构不一致、语义逻辑不连贯及偏离源文本等常见故障模式。
AI.motivation: 在线烹饪生态中，LLM生成的食谱内容日益增多，但这些看似合理的输出可能包含幻觉成分、错误数量或文化上不合理的组合，限制了其在下游应用和知识图谱构建中的适用性，因此亟需一个系统化的验证框架。
AI.method: 采用多阶段验证流水线：(1) 形式语法检查结构一致性；(2) 词汇表检查成分合法性；(3) 统计启发式检测异常；(4) Set Transformer模型评估语义和逻辑连贯性；(5) 检索式验证核对与源文本的一致性。
AI.result: 该框架在印度食谱数据集上得到评估，能够有效识别和纠正LLM生成食谱中的各类错误，并且方法可推广到更广泛的多语言、多文化烹饪领域。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一个实用、可审计且与应用无关的验证框架，用于验证LLM增强的食谱数据，加强了LLM生成内容时代下机器可读食品知识基础设施的基础。

title: Towards an Expressivity-Normalized Energy-Demand Comparison of ANNs and SNNs
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are often regarded as energy-efficient alternatives to artificial neural networks (ANNs), yet their advantage depends critically on both network architecture and data properties. We develop an analytical framework to compare fully-connected ReLU ANNs and integrate-and-fire SNNs for time-series data with respect to their theoretical energy efficiency at matched expressive capacity. By relating an inference-energy model to theoretical bounds on representational expressivity, we derive an expressivity-normalized efficiency ratio and explicit thresholds in network width, spike sparsity, and ANN depth scaling. Our analysis characterizes the regimes in which event-driven computation offsets the temporal overhead of SNNs, providing capacity-aware principles for designing energy-efficient temporal networks. It shows that ANNs exceed SNNs in expressivity-normalized efficiency only in specific regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个分析框架，在匹配表达能力的前提下，比较全连接ReLU人工神经网络（ANN）与整合-发放（integrate-and-fire）脉冲神经网络（SNN）在时间序列数据上的理论能效。通过将推理能耗模型与表示表达能力理论界关联，推导出表达能力归一化的效率比，并给出网络宽度、脉冲稀疏性和ANN深度缩放方面的显式阈值。
AI.motivation: 尽管SNN常被视为ANN的节能替代品，但其能效优势并非无条件成立，而是高度依赖于网络架构和数据特性。现有研究缺乏在相同表达能力基础上的公平能效比较框架，因此需要建立分析工具来阐明SNN优势的具体适用条件。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个解析框架：(1)建立推理能耗模型；(2)将其与表示表达能力的理论界相关联；(3)推导表达能力归一化的效率比（expressivity-normalized efficiency ratio）；(4)分析给出网络宽度、脉冲稀疏性和ANN深度缩放方面的显式阈值条件，用于刻画事件驱动计算抵消SNN时间开销的适用区域。
AI.result: 分析表明，ANN仅在特定区域内才能在表达能力归一化能效上超过SNN，而非普遍优势。研究刻画了SNN相对于ANN能效优越的具体参数区间，为设计节能时间网络提供了基于表达能力的指导原则。
AI.conclusion: SNN在能效上的优势是条件性的，需要通过匹配表达能力进行公平评估。该框架为设计者在"时间事件驱动计算"与"时间开销"之间做出权衡提供了能力感知的设计原则，指出ANN优于SNN仅在特定网络宽度、稀疏性和深度条件下成立。

title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents need durable, faithful memory of everything a user or organization has said and stored, yet most memory systems commit to a single organizing structure (a fact store, a vector index, or a knowledge graph) and inherit its blind spots. We present Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distils a user's conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the same history: an episodic Memory Events timeline that makes when and what changed first-class, an associative entity-event knowledge graph that links people and projects across sessions, and a semantic, curated, citation-locked Hierarchical Documentary Memory (HDM) of durable facts. A retrieval turn runs an intent gate (so self-contained turns add no latency), a source router, and three concurrent agentic searches, one per system, each a tool-using loop over hybrid (embedding + lexical) search under agent-controlled filters; their grounded, cited answers are integrated into one answer with a single confidence. We formalize the reading discipline: every learned item is a provenanced item carrying its origin, timestamp, and evidence pointer, and every answer is read under a citation lock, so it may cite only evidence its reader actually opened; fabrication is structurally excluded and the system abstains rather than guesses. On two public benchmarks the system sets a new state of the art: 95.60% on LongMemEval and 93.60% on LoCoMo, improving over the strongest prior systems by +0.73 and +1.10 points. A controlled study across eight backbone LLMs characterizes the accuracy-cost-latency frontier: accuracy varies by only 3.4 points while per-query cost varies by ~30x, with near-state-of-the-art quality at up to 20x lower cost per query, the signature of memory-driven, rather than model-driven, quality.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent Zero Memory，一种基于来源感知的长期记忆系统，将用户对话、文件和连接源提炼为三个并行记忆系统（事件时间线、实体事件知识图谱、语义文档记忆），通过意图门控、来源路由和三个并行的智能体搜索实现检索，以引用锁定机制从结构上排除捏造。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上分别达到95.60%和93.60%的最新水平。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统大多采用单一组织结构（事实存储、向量索引或知识图谱），每种结构都有固有的盲区，无法全面可靠地捕捉用户和组织的历史信息。需要一种能同时捕捉记忆不同侧面、并保证忠实性与可追溯性的记忆系统。
AI.method: 构建三个并行的记忆系统捕捉同一历史的不同侧面：(1) 情节性Memory Events时间线（时间与变化优先）；(2) 关联性实体-事件知识图谱（跨会话关联人与项目）；(3) 语义的、策划的、引用锁定的分层文档记忆（HDM）用于持久事实。检索过程包含意图门控（自包含回合零延迟）、来源路由和三个并发的智能体搜索；每个学习项都携带来源、时间戳和证据指针，每个回答都在引用锁定下只能引用读取器实际打开的证据，无法引用则弃权而非猜测。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval上达到95.60%，在LoCoMo上达到93.60%，分别比最强的现有系统提高+0.73和+1.10分。在8个骨干LLM上的对照研究表明，准确率仅波动3.4分，而单次查询成本波动约30倍，且能以最高20倍更低的成本实现接近最先进的质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过多模态并行记忆架构和严格阅读纪律（来源感知+引用锁定），Agent Zero Memory证明了记忆驱动而非模型驱动的质量——即记忆系统的设计才是核心性能来源，而非底层模型能力。

title: GuardianAgent: Policy-Conditioned Risk-Adaptive Anonymization with Verified Adversarial Escalation
summary: Privacy protection for live web traffic requires more than detecting private spans. Agent-based privacy protection systems must determine whether an outgoing action complies with the destination site's privacy policy, then apply only the level of rewriting or sanitisation justified by the residual disclosure risk. We present GuardianAgent, a policy-conditioned anonymization framework that couples structured risk assessment with verified adaptive rewriting. GuardianAgent computes risk through AMRSF (Adaptive Multi-factor Risk Scoring Formula), an explicit controller that combines policy-violation likelihood with data sensitivity, recipient transmission, purpose legitimacy, contextual basis, and policy transparency, rather than relying on an LLM to assign risk directly. This risk score determines both the allow/transform/deny decision and the initial anonymization level. For efficiency, GuardianAgent uses an evidential fast path for low-uncertainty policy matches and invokes an LLM slow path only for uncertain cases. For rewriting, it applies a five-level hierarchy driven by a verified adversarial guesser: guesses trigger escalation only when supported by the original text, preventing hallucinated attacker confidence from causing unnecessary over-anonymization. Experiments across three benchmarks spanning legal text (TAB), Reddit posts (SynthPAI), and multi-format synthetic PII records (PII-Masking-300k) show that GuardianAgent achieves the strongest privacy-utility trade-off among published baselines and is the only method to reach more than 0.90 privacy in all three domains, remaining robust under a backbone switch. Action-context stress tests further show that the same outgoing text receives different decisions and anonymization strengths under different recipients, purposes, action bases, and policy-transparency conditions.

AI.tldr: GuardianAgent是一个策略条件化的匿名化框架，通过AMRSF（自适应多因素风险评估公式）进行结构化风险评分，结合验证性对抗猜测器的五级重写层级，在保护隐私的同时维持效用，在三个基准上达到最强隐私-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 代理驱动的隐私保护系统不能仅检测隐私片段，还需要判断传出动作是否符合目标站点的隐私政策，并根据残余泄露风险应用适当的重写或净化级别。现有方法依赖LLM直接分配风险，缺乏结构化评估和验证机制。
AI.method: GuardianAgent由两部分组成：(1) AMRSF风险评分器，结合策略违规可能性、数据敏感性、接收方传输、目的合法性、上下文基础和政策透明度六个因素计算风险，决定允许/转换/拒绝决策及初始匿名级别；(2) 五级重写层级，由验证性对抗猜测器驱动，仅在原始文本支持时才升级攻击猜测，防止幻觉导致的过度匿名化。同时采用证据快速路径处理低不确定性策略匹配，仅对不确定情况调用LLM慢路径。
AI.result: 在三个基准（TAB法律文本、SynthPAI Reddit帖子、PII-Masking-300k多格式合成PII记录）上，GuardianAgent在所有已发布基线中达到最强隐私-效用权衡，是唯一在三个领域均超过0.90隐私分数的方法，且在骨干模型切换下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GuardianAgent证明了结构化风险评分加验证性重写可以有效替代纯LLM驱动的方法。动作上下文压力测试进一步表明，相同的传出文本在不同接收方、目的、动作基础和策略透明度条件下会得到不同的决策和匿名化强度，体现了其上下文感知能力。

title: Structural Hierarchy and Geometry in Molecular Representation Learning
summary: Molecular self-supervised learning uses chemical structures to guide which molecular embeddings should be similar. We study whether explicitly encoding a molecule's Bemis-Murcko scaffold and using it to supervise the molecular embedding changes what the model learns. We further test whether this effect depends on the embedding geometry by comparing Euclidean and Lorentz contrastive objectives. Across two augmentation strengths, scaffold-supervised models consistently organize molecules according to both identical and structurally related scaffolds. The resulting embeddings also improve molecular property prediction on several tasks, while the exact gains depend on the predicted property. The effect of scaffold supervision on molecular organization is stronger under Lorentz objectives, but neither geometry provides a consistent overall advantage. These results show that explicitly teaching the relation between a molecule and its structural core can reliably shape the organization of molecular embedding space, while the extent of usefulness of this organization remains task dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在分子自监督学习中，显式编码Bemis-Murcko骨架并用于监督分子嵌入是否改变模型所学内容，以及该效果是否依赖于欧几里得与Lorentz对比目标的嵌入几何。结果表明骨架监督能稳定地按相同或结构相关的骨架组织分子，并在多个任务上改善性质预测，但具体收益取决于预测属性；骨架监督在Lorentz目标下对分子组织的效果更强，但两种几何没有一致的整体优势。
AI.motivation: 分子自监督学习通常仅依赖化学结构来定义嵌入相似性，但未显式利用分子的结构骨架（Bemis-Murcko scaffold）这一化学中关键的结构核心概念。作者希望探究显式编码骨架进行监督是否会对模型学习产生不同影响，并考察该影响是否受嵌入几何（欧几里得 vs. Lorentz）的调节。
AI.method: 在两种增强强度下，使用Bemis-Murcko骨架作为监督信号来引导分子嵌入学习；通过比较欧几里得和Lorentz两种对比学习目标，评估骨架监督在不同几何空间下的作用效果。
AI.result: 骨架监督的模型在两种增强强度下均能一致地将分子按相同及结构相关的骨架进行组织；所得嵌入在多个分子性质预测任务上有所提升，但提升幅度取决于预测属性；骨架监督在Lorentz目标下对分子组织的影响更强，但两种几何在整体性能上没有一致优势。
AI.conclusion: 显式教授分子与其结构核心之间的关系可以可靠地塑造分子嵌入空间的组织方式，但这种组织方式的实用性因任务而异，说明结构骨架信息是有价值的归纳偏置，但其下游效用具有任务依赖性。

title: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
comment: PhD Thesis submitted to UChicago (https://knowledge.uchicago.edu/records/5jrnc-nvp13). Update Branching Factor, AI Realtor, and BACo to the latest versions
summary:
The current alignment tuning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs) prioritizes surface-level behaviors -- fluency, safety, and tonal consistency. While effective for casual chat, this thesis argues that such surface alignment masks a lack of grounding, creating models that are stylistically confident but situationally brittle. We propose a framework of Grounded Alignment, analyzing how models process context (Input) and structure generation (Output), then aligning these grounded behaviors to human needs.
  First, we evaluate failures in Situational Grounding. SitTest shows that despite large context windows, state-of-the-art models struggle to maintain a consistent "mental model" of a changing environment. ReCode further shows that models rely on surface heuristics rather than deep syntactic dependencies: they "read" extensive histories without truly "understanding" the evolving situation.
  Second, we evaluate Generative Grounding. We introduce the Branching Factor (BF) to map LLM generation, finding that standard alignment tuning constricts this landscape into premature stylistic collapse. Hindsight further shows that models often fail to understand their own generations.
  Finally, we propose Dynamic Control for grounded interaction. AI Realtor demonstrates context engineering to compensate for poor situational grounding. Base-Aligned Model Collaboration decouples exploration from stylistic constraints. We also present Annealed Sampling for verifiable reinforcement learning and apply these ideas to Addiction Support, where model-generated rationalization offers a communication interface for high-stakes domains. Collectively, this work moves beyond surface alignment toward agents anchored in both context and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文批判当前LLM对齐范式过度关注表面行为（流畅性、安全性、语调一致性），提出"接地对齐"（Grounded Alignment）框架，分别评估模型在情境接地（情境理解）和生成接地（生成结构）两方面的不足，并提出动态控制方法来改善人机交互中模型的接地能力。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的对齐调优范式只关注表面层面的行为（如流畅、安全、语调一致），导致模型"风格上自信但情境上脆弱"——看似合理却不具备真正的接地能力，无法在变化环境中保持一致的思维模型，也无法深度理解自身生成内容。
AI.method: 提出Grounded Alignment框架，包含三部分：(1) 情境接地评估：通过SitTest测试模型在变化环境中维持心智模型的能力，通过ReCode揭示模型依赖表面启发式而非深层句法依赖；(2) 生成接地评估：引入Branching Factor (BF)映射LLM生成空间，发现标准对齐会压缩生成空间导致过早风格崩塌，Hindsight揭示模型常不理解自身生成；(3) 动态控制方法：AI Realtor展示情境工程补偿情境接地不足，Base-Aligned Model Collaboration解耦探索与风格约束，Annealed Sampling用于可验证强化学习，并应用于成瘾支持等高危领域。
AI.result: SitTest和ReCode证明现有模型尽管有巨大上下文窗口，仍无法维持变化环境的连贯心智模型，且依赖表面启发式而非深层理解。BF指标发现标准对齐调优导致生成空间过早风格崩塌。提出的动态控制方法（如情境工程、协作模型、退火采样）可在高交互和高风险场景中补偿接地不足。
AI.conclusion: 本文主张对齐范式应从表面行为对齐转向接地对齐，使模型真正锚定于情境理解和生成结构之中，而非仅追求风格上的流畅与安全。通过在情境和生成两个维度上系统地评估与干预，可为构建真正稳健、可信的AI代理提供新路径。

title: Dynamic Important Example Mining for Reinforcement Finetuning
summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used to strengthen the reasoning abilities of large models, yet its effectiveness is bound by how training data are selected and used. Most data-centric RFT methods rely on static or heuristic sample selection, implicitly assuming a sample's value is fixed over training. This overlooks the non-stationary dynamics of policy learning and can lead to suboptimal updates. We propose Dynamic Important Example Mining (DIEM), a principled and fully automated framework that makes data utilization adaptive throughout RFT. DIEM integrates two components into each optimization step: (i) a gradient-alignment importance estimator that efficiently approximates each sample's marginal contribution to policy improvement; and (ii) a constrained batch reweighting scheme that maximizes aggregate utility while preserving the update's gradient magnitude to stabilize optimization. Across several reasoning benchmarks, DIEM consistently outperforms strong static and dynamic baselines. The code will be released via https://github.com/hrtan/DIEM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIEM框架，通过梯度对齐重要性估计和约束批次重加权策略，使强化微调（RFT）中的数据利用在训练过程中动态自适应，解决了静态或启发式样本选择忽视策略学习非平稳性的问题，在多个推理基准上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有数据中心的RFT方法依赖静态或启发式样本选择，隐含假设样本价值在训练过程中固定不变，忽视了策略学习的非平稳动态特性，可能导致次优的参数更新。
AI.method: DIEM包含两个核心组件：(i) 梯度对齐重要性估计器，高效近似每个样本对策略改进的边际贡献；(ii) 约束批次重加权方案，在最大化聚合效用的同时保持更新梯度幅度以稳定优化过程。两者集成到每个优化步骤中，实现全自动的自适应数据利用。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，DIEM一致优于强静态基线和动态基线方法，验证了动态样本重要性挖掘的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DIEM表明样本价值在训练过程中是动态变化的，通过原则性的自适应数据选择机制可以有效提升RFT的推理能力，代码已开源。

title: Sensitivity-Constrained Neural Operators for Data-Efficient Forward and Inverse Modeling of Partial Differential Equation Systems
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for partial differential equation (PDE) solvers, but their reliability can degrade for high-dimensional spatial inputs and inverse or repeated inference. State-only training constrains solution values but not the learned input--output response. We study sensitivity-constrained neural operators (SC-NOs), which augment standard training with sampled solver-derived Jacobian supervision. Selected sensitivities from differentiable solvers or discrete adjoints are matched during training, allowing response information to be amortized across minibatches without imposing the full Jacobian at every update. We evaluate SC-NO on advection--diffusion and RANS--Spalart--Allmaras benchmarks, input-dimensionality scaling tests, long-horizon autoregressive rollout, and a shallow-water Tohoku tsunami source-inversion case. Sensitivity supervision improves forward prediction and yields larger gains in gradient-based inverse reconstruction of distributed fields. Scaling experiments show an improved accuracy--cost tradeoff for high-dimensional gridded inputs, while ablations indicate that state values and Jacobian information provide complementary supervision. In the tsunami case, SC-FNO reconstructs gridded seafloor deformation from sparse early gauge observations and forecasts subsequent wave propagation in a near-real-time proof-of-concept workflow. These results support sampled sensitivity supervision as a practical way to improve neural PDE surrogates when forward accuracy, inverse stability, robustness, and computational cost must be considered together.

AI.tldr: 本文提出灵敏度约束神经算子（SC-NO），通过在标准训练中额外加入从可微求解器或离散伴随中采样的雅可比监督信号，使神经偏微分方程代理模型在保持前向预测精度的同时，显著提升逆向推断的稳定性和高维输入的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 神经算子作为PDE求解器的快速替代品具有吸引力，但其在高维空间输入以及逆向或重复推断场景下可靠性会下降。仅状态训练只约束了解值本身，而未约束学习到的输入-输出响应关系（导数信息），这导致模型在逆向问题和高维场景中表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出灵敏度约束神经算子（SC-NO）：在标准训练基础上，从可微求解器或离散伴随方法采样的雅可比矩阵作为额外监督信号。训练时选择性匹配这些灵敏度信息，并跨minibatch摊销响应信息，避免每次更新都施加完整雅可比矩阵。
AI.result: 在对流扩散、RANS-Spalart-Allmaras基准、输入维度扩展测试、长时程自回归滚动及浅水Tohoku海啸源反演等任务上验证。灵敏度监督改善前向预测精度，并在基于梯度的分布式场反演中带来更大增益。高维网格输入下展示出改进的精度-成本权衡；消融实验表明状态值与雅可比信息具有互补性。海啸案例中SC-FNO从稀疏早期水位观测重建海底形变场并预测后续波形，实现近实时概念验证。
AI.conclusion: 采样的灵敏度监督是一种实用方法，可在需要同时考虑前向精度、逆向稳定性、鲁棒性和计算成本的场景下，有效改善神经PDE代理模型的整体性能。

title: Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Function vectors (FVs) have recently emerged as a promising mechanism for steering the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by injecting task-specific latent direction representations derived from in-context demonstrations. While prior studies have shown that FVs can recover task behavior in structured in-context learning settings, their effectiveness on semantically complex tasks and their ability to generalize across languages remain underexplored. We investigate the cross-lingual transferability of FVs using multilingual multi-label emotion recognition as a challenging semantic classification benchmark. Specifically, we examine whether FVs extracted from a source language can steer task behavior in another language under both standard clean and perturbed zero-shot settings without providing demonstrations during inference. Across diverse cross-lingual settings, applying FVs substantially improves performance, suggesting that FVs capture language-agnostic, task-relevant signals rather than purely language-specific lexical patterns, and highlighting their potential as a lightweight and transferable mechanism for multilingual task adaptation. We observe that each LLM exhibits a relatively stable optimal range of attention heads for constructing effective FVs, and the pattern remains consistent across languages. In addition, FVs can partially replicate the task-steering effects of standard few-shot in-context learning while avoiding the computational overhead of processing multiple demonstrations, making them effective for large-scale practical applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingjie7/cross_lingual_fvs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了函数向量（FVs）在多语言多标签情感识别任务中的跨语言迁移能力，发现FVs能够捕获语言无关的任务相关信号，在不同语言间有效迁移任务行为，并且在不提供演示的情况下显著提升零样本性能，同时保持较低的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已表明FVs能在结构化上下文学习场景中恢复任务行为，但其在语义复杂任务上的有效性以及跨语言泛化能力尚未得到充分探索，因此需要验证FVs是否能在多语言设置下工作。
AI.method: 使用多语言多标签情感识别作为语义分类基准，从源语言提取FVs，在干净和扰动两种零样本设置下（不提供推理演示）检验其能否在目标语言中引导任务行为，并分析不同语言下注意力头的选择模式。
AI.result: 在多种跨语言设置下，应用FVs显著提升了性能，表明FVs捕获了语言无关的任务相关信号；每个LLM在构建有效FVs时存在相对稳定的最优注意力头范围，且该模式跨语言一致；FVs能部分复现少样本上下文学习的任务引导效果，同时避免处理多个演示的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: FVs是一种轻量且可迁移的多语言任务适配机制，具有实际大规模应用的潜力。

title: RACER: Reinforced Agent Collaboration for Explainable Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs
comment: 15 pages, 1 figures, This paper has been accepted by ICONIP 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from hallucination and struggle with complex reasoning tasks requiring multi-hop domain knowledge. While integrating Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provides a structured and verifiable information source, current KG-enhanced LLM paradigms usually rely on single-agent path extraction and fixed prompting, lacking adaptability and facing huge search spaces. To address these challenges, we propose RACER, a Reinforced Agent Collaboration framework for Explainable Reasoning on knowledge graphs. RACER employs a semantic-aware action pruning and teacher-guided reinforcement learning mechanism to efficiently extract high-quality reasoning pathways from large-scale KGs. Furthermore, to mitigate single-path generation pitfalls, we introduce a cross-task accumulated shared memory graph paired with an attention-driven multi-path knowledge refinement module. Finally, RACER orchestrates these components through a four-role multi-agent collaboration system (GraphAgent, TemplateAgent, AnswerAgent, and CriticAgent) to dynamically refine prompts and evaluate answers. Extensive experiments on CommonsenseQA and OpenBookQA datasets demonstrate that RACER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art KG-enhanced LLM baselines with an average improvement of 5\%, offering robust and highly interpretable reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: RACER是一个基于知识图谱的强化多智能体协作框架，通过语义感知的剪枝、教师引导的强化学习、跨任务共享记忆图和注意力驱动的多路径知识精炼模块，结合四角色多智能体系统，在CommonsenseQA和OpenBookQA上平均提升5%，显著优于现有KG增强LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有KG增强LLM方法通常依赖单智能体路径提取和固定提示词，缺乏适应性且面临巨大搜索空间，难以解决LLM的幻觉问题和多跳复杂推理挑战。
AI.method: RACER包含三个核心组件：(1) 语义感知动作剪枝与教师引导强化学习用于高效提取高质量推理路径；(2) 跨任务累积共享记忆图与注意力驱动的多路径知识精炼模块以缓解单路径生成缺陷；(3) 四角色多智能体协作系统（GraphAgent、TemplateAgent、AnswerAgent、CriticAgent）动态优化提示词并评估答案。
AI.result: 在CommonsenseQA和OpenBookQA数据集上，RACER平均提升5%，优于最先进的KG增强LLM基线，展现出强大且高度可解释的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: RACER通过多智能体协作与强化学习的结合，有效解决了KG增强推理中的搜索空间与适应性瓶颈，为实现可靠、可解释的LLM推理提供了新范式。

title: Joint Spatiotemporal Spectral Neural Operators for Learning PDEs on Irregular Domains
summary: Learning solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) on irregular and geometry-dependent domains remains a central challenge in scientific machine learning. While spectral methods provide strong inductive biases for modeling global interactions, they are typically limited to regular domains, and existing neural approaches often require domain warping, interpolation, or costly geometric embeddings. We introduce the \textbf{Graph Spectral Neural Operator (GSNO)}, a neural operator that combines spatial graph spectral decompositions with temporal Fourier transforms through a unified space--time spectral kernel. This formulation enables globally coherent operator learning on non-Cartesian discretizations without domain warping or autoregressive rollouts. By replacing learned geometric embeddings with a graph Laplacian spectral basis, GSNO provides geometry-aware spectral learning with low parameter complexity. Across steady and unsteady PDE benchmarks on irregular and geometry-dependent domains, GSNO achieves strong accuracy with reduced runtime and parameter counts, while demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization across mesh resolutions and geometry families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图谱神经算子（GSNO），通过将图拉普拉斯谱分解与时间傅里叶变换结合为统一的时空谱核，在不规则和几何相关域上实现全局一致的算子学习，无需域扭曲或自回归滚动，在零样本泛化和计算效率上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在科学机器学习中，在不规则及几何相关域上学习偏微分方程的解算子仍是核心挑战。现有谱方法虽具有全局交互的强归纳偏置，但通常限于规则域；而现有神经方法往往需要域扭曲、插值或昂贵的几何嵌入，缺乏几何感知的谱学习能力。
AI.method: GSNO将图拉普拉斯谱基（空间）与傅里叶变换（时间）结合，构建统一的时空谱核。用图拉普拉斯谱基替代学习的几何嵌入，实现几何感知的谱学习，保持低参数复杂度，无需域扭曲或自回归滚动。
AI.result: 在不规则及几何相关域的稳态与非稳态PDE基准上，GSNO以更低的运行时间和参数数量实现高精度，并在不同网格分辨率和几何族上展现稳健的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GSNO通过统一的时空谱核有效解决了不规则域上的算子学习问题，验证了图谱方法作为几何感知且参数高效的神经算子范式的可行性。

title: JPO: Juris Policy Optimization for Structured Legal Reasoning in Criminal Judgment Prediction
summary: Criminal judgment prediction requires models to infer statutory articles, charges, and sentencing outcomes from case facts. Unlike standard classification tasks, it involves a structured reasoning process in which statutes should be matched with facts, charges should be justified by statutes, and sentencing outcomes should remain consistent with charges. Existing approaches optimize final labels, and while some have attempted to evaluate reasoning quality, their evaluations are indirect, often relying on LLM-generated rubrics that reflect model-internal preferences rather than the inherent logical structure of legal adjudication. We propose Juris Policy Optimization (JPO), a post-training framework for structured legal reasoning in Chinese criminal judgment prediction. JPO first uses teacher-generated rationales to supervise a standardized four-step reasoning process, and then applies reinforcement learning with a composite reward over legal prediction quality, reasoning structure completeness, and cross-step consistency. JPO further introduces token-level advantage reweighting and adaptive clipping for legally salient reasoning segments. Experiments on multiple open-source language models and three Chinese legal benchmarks show that JPO consistently improves both judgment prediction and reasoning quality over supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出JPO框架，一种用于中文刑事判决预测的结构化法律推理后训练方法。通过教师生成的推理过程监督标准化的四步推理，并结合强化学习与复合奖励（涵盖预测质量、推理结构完整性和跨步骤一致性），引入token级优势重加权和自适应裁剪。在多个开源语言模型和三个中文法律基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有刑事判决预测方法直接优化最终标签，缺乏对法律裁决内在逻辑结构（法条-事实匹配、罪名-法条论证、量刑-罪名一致）的显式建模。已有推理质量评估依赖LLM生成的rubric，反映模型内部偏好而非法律裁判的逻辑结构，评估方式间接且不客观。
AI.method: 1) 教师生成推理过程监督标准化的四步推理流程；2) 使用强化学习优化复合奖励，涵盖法律预测质量、推理结构完整性和跨步骤一致性；3) 引入token级优势重加权，针对法律关键推理段进行自适应裁剪。
AI.result: 在多个开源语言模型和三个中文法律基准上的实验表明，JPO相比监督微调和强化学习基线，在判决预测和推理质量两方面均取得一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模法律裁决的结构化推理过程并引入与法律逻辑对齐的奖励信号，能够有效提升刑事判决预测的准确性与推理质量，优于仅优化最终标签的传统方法。

title: EpaCache: Error-Propagation-Aware Caching for Accelerating Diffusion-Based Visual Generation
comment: This is a preview version of EpaCache, which is still under review
summary: Diffusion-based visual generative models deliver strong image and video synthesis quality but incur high inference costs because sequential samplers repeatedly evaluate large networks. Caching-based methods reduce inference latency by reusing intermediate computations across adjacent timesteps. However, existing cache controllers rely primarily on local temporal variation and overlook the trajectory-level consequences of cache reuse. We introduce Error-Propagation-Aware Cache (EpaCache), a training-free caching policy that adaptively allocates the reuse budget on timesteps with lower downstream impact. Experiments on image and video synthesis models demonstrate that EpaCache consistently improves the latency--fidelity trade-off over existing caching methods. On FLUX.1-dev, EpaCache outperforms the prior state-of-the-art caching method in both latency and fidelity, reducing inference time from $11.7$ s to $11.3$ s while improving PSNR from $21.4$ to $22.8$. On HunyuanVideo, EpaCache achieves a $2.63\times$ speedup over uncached inference and improves SSIM from $0.891$ to $0.905$ over the prior state-of-the-art method at matched latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EpaCache，一种无需训练的缓存策略，通过感知误差传播来自适应分配缓存预算，在时间步上选择下游影响较小的位置进行缓存复用，从而在图像和视频扩散模型上改善延迟与保真度的权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量的图像和视频，但顺序采样需反复评估大型网络导致推理成本高。现有的基于缓存的加速方法只关注局部时间变化，忽视了缓存复用在轨迹层面的后果，因此无法最优地分配缓存预算。
AI.method: EpaCache是一种训练无关的缓存策略，核心思想是自适应地将缓存复用预算分配给具有较低下游影响的timestep，即通过误差传播分析来识别哪些步骤的缓存复用不会对最终生成结果造成显著质量损失。
AI.result: 在图像和视频合成模型上的实验表明，EpaCache持续优于现有缓存方法的延迟-保真度权衡。在FLUX.1-dev上，推理时间从11.7s降至11.3s，同时PSNR从21.4提升至22.8；在HunyuanVideo上，相对无缓存推理实现2.63倍加速，并在相同延迟下将SSIM从0.891提升至0.905。
AI.conclusion: EpaCache通过轨迹级别的误差传播感知来指导缓存预算分配，显著优于仅依赖局部时间变化的现有缓存控制器，为扩散模型推理加速提供了更优的方案。

title: INTERVenE: Temporal-Abstraction-Interval Based Transformers for Short-Horizon Medical Event Prediction
summary: Electronic Health Record (EHR) prediction models in the intensive care unit must learn from sparse and irregular measurements while preserving the clinical meaning of time and supporting transparent decision-making. We present INTERVenE, a family of Transformer architectures whose input is an interval-based, knowledge-based temporal abstraction (KBTA), a token stream of named clinical concepts (states, trends, events, contexts) drawn from a curated medical ontology, rather than an unnamed bin index or a raw measurement triplet. This naming layer is what we ask KBTA to do: it makes the model's per-token attributions resolve to clinical concepts by construction. INTERVenE offers two complementary variants: an auto-regressive decoder that generates future abstraction trajectories with a per-step risk readout (localizing \emph{when} and \emph{after which events} risk rises), and a bidirectional encoder for single-pass joint risk and time-to-event prediction. Evaluated on 57,078 MIMIC-IV admissions against GRU-D, STraTS, and KarmaLego, INTERVenE-Enc reaches a support-weighted AUPRC$_w$ of 0.672, improving by 0.041 over the strongest neural baseline with non-overlapping 95\% bootstrap CIs, while also taking the best AUROC$_w$ (0.901) and length-of-stay MAE (44.4\,h). INTERVenE-Ar (AUROC$_w$ $0.854$, AUPRC$_w$ $0.587$ under the same evaluation contract - a strictly harder generative readout) provides a complementary token-level risk trajectory. An input-representation ablation confirms the lift transfers across structured discretizations, positioning KBTA-based intervals as the interpretable substrate that makes per-token attributions resolve to meaningful clinical concepts within the deployed model.

AI.tldr: INTERVenE是一个基于间隔的知识型时间抽象（KBTA）的Transformer架构家族，用于ICU电子健康记录预测。通过将临床测量转化为有命名的临床概念token流，INTERVenE-Enc在MIMIC-IV的57,078次入院预测中达到AUPRC_w 0.672，优于最强神经基线0.041，同时提供可解释的逐token归因和风险轨迹预测。
AI.motivation: ICU中的EHR预测模型面临三大挑战：测量稀疏且不规则、需要保留时间的临床意义、以及需要支持透明的决策过程。现有方法要么使用未命名的分箱索引，要么使用原始测量三元组，无法让模型的归因直接对应到有临床意义的概念。
AI.method: 提出INTERVenE家族，包含两个变体：(1) 自回归解码器（INTERVenE-Ar）生成未来抽象轨迹并给出逐步风险读数；(2) 双向编码器（INTERVenE-Enc）进行单次联合风险和事件时间预测。核心创新是将输入建模为基于医学本体论的命名临床概念token流（状态、趋势、事件、上下文），而非匿名索引或原始测量值。
AI.result: 在57,078个MIMIC-IV入院记录上评估，INTERVenE-Enc达到支持加权AUPRC_w 0.672（比最强神经基线提升0.041，95% bootstrap置信区间不重叠）、最佳AUROC_w 0.901和住院时长MAE 44.4小时。INTERVenE-Ar在更具挑战性的生成式读出协议下达到AUROC_w 0.854和AUPRC_w 0.587。消融实验确认提升可跨结构化离散化迁移。
AI.conclusion: KBTA-based间隔作为可解释的底层表示，使部署模型中的逐token归因能够解析为有意义的临床概念，同时不损失预测性能，在性能和可解释性之间取得了有效平衡。

title: Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection
summary: This paper introduces a hybrid fact-checking framework that integrates Knowledge Graph-based semantic memory with adversarial multi-agent reasoning for explainable misinformation detection. The proposed system follows a memory-first, web-fallback architecture, in which input claims are initially evaluated against a dual-index Knowledge Graph through Sentence-BERT-based semantic retrieval and Natural Language Inference. When the evidence retrieved from the graph is insufficient to support a reliable decision, the framework collects information from trusted web sources and assesses it using an adversarial tribunal composed of support, contradiction, and judging agents. A graph-aware confidence mechanism combines semantic similarity, NLI confidence, and structural graph evidence to determine whether internal knowledge is sufficient, thereby reducing unnecessary web retrieval. Following verification, validated information is transformed into structured triples and incorporated into the Knowledge Graph, supporting the incremental expansion of the system's semantic memory. Experimental evaluation on a curated COVID-19 misinformation benchmark demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 97.4\% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 92.6% on resolved claims, outperforming a Llama~3.3~70B baseline, which obtains an accuracy of 87.7% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 86.3%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合事实核查框架，将知识图谱语义记忆与对抗式多智能体推理相结合，用于可解释的虚假信息检测。系统采用"记忆优先、网页回退"架构，先通过Sentence-BERT语义检索和自然语言推理在知识图谱中评估声明，当证据不足时再回退到可信网络来源，并通过支持、反驳和裁决三类智能体组成的对抗法庭进行验证。实验在COVID-19虚假信息基准上达到97.4%准确率和92.6%宏平均F1分数，优于Llama 3.3 70B基线。
AI.motivation: 现有事实核查方法面临两个挑战：一是知识图谱方法在证据不足时难以做出可靠判断，二是大语言模型虽然性能强大但缺乏可解释性且可能产生幻觉。作者旨在通过混合架构结合两者的优势，在保证可解释性的同时提高检测准确性，并减少不必要的网络检索开销。
AI.method: 框架采用内存优先、网络回退的双阶段架构。第一阶段通过Sentence-BERT语义检索和NLI在双索引知识图谱中评估声明；当图证据不足时，系统从可信网络来源收集信息，并使用由支持、反驳和裁决智能体组成的对抗法庭进行三角验证。图感知置信度机制综合语义相似度、NLI置信度和结构图证据判断内部知识是否充分；验证后的信息被转化为结构三元组并纳入知识图谱，实现语义记忆的增量扩展。
AI.result: 在COVID-19虚假信息基准上，框架在已解决声明上取得97.4%的准确率和92.6%的宏平均F1分数，显著优于Llama 3.3 70B基线（准确率87.7%，宏平均F1 86.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，知识图谱语义记忆与对抗式多智能体推理的混合架构能有效提升虚假信息检测的准确性和可解释性，同时通过记忆优先策略减少不必要的网络检索，并支持知识图谱的持续扩展。

title: Understanding Deep Learning via Entropy Space Theory
summary: Deep learning is often criticized for its theoretical research lagging behind practice. To make deep learning easier to understand, the entropy space theory is first introduced here. The entropy space can cover all the possibilities of any deep learning model by topological structure. It is independent of network parameters. Through the designed fundamental operations and norm, entropy space is proven to be a normed space within the formal axiomatic framework. Based on the theory, a unified coordinate system is proposed. It can coordinatize every state of a model and rank them by compression of the maximal value of information entropy. The theory offers a novel priori framework for mathematical fundamentals of deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出熵空间理论，通过拓扑结构覆盖深度学习模型的全部可能性，并构建了统一坐标系，为深度学习提供了新的先验数学基础框架。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的理论研究严重滞后于实践，缺乏一个统一的、易于理解的数学理论框架来解释模型的本质行为。
AI.method: 引入熵空间概念，通过拓扑结构覆盖深度学习模型的全部可能性，该空间独立于网络参数。设计了基本运算和范数，在形式公理化框架内证明了熵空间是赋范空间。基于该理论提出统一坐标系，能够对模型的每个状态进行坐标化，并通过信息熵最大值压缩进行排序。
AI.result: 成功证明了熵空间构成赋范空间，并基于该理论构建了统一坐标系，能够对模型状态进行坐标化和排序。
AI.conclusion: 熵空间理论为深度学习提供了一种新颖的先验数学基础框架，有望缩小理论研究与实践之间的差距。

title: Diffusion-Based Inverse Design of Dielectric Resonator Metasurfaces for Shaping Smart Electromagnetic Environments
summary: Future wireless systems are expected to transform the surrounding space from a passive propagation medium into a smart electromagnetic environment, where engineered surfaces control wave propagation, support wireless sensing, and create programmable electromagnetic fingerprints. A key challenge in realizing this vision is the inverse design of metasurfaces for tailored electromagnetic propagation. While forward analysis evaluates the response of a known geometry, the inverse task starts from a prescribed scattering signature and seeks a physically realizable structure that produces it. This inverse task is inherently nonlinear and often high-dimensional, while candidate solutions may be non-unique and provide no direct indication of practical realizability. Here, we introduce a conditional diffusion framework for inverse design of dielectric resonator metasurfaces from target angular scattering patterns. Trained on T-matrix simulated geometry-response pairs, the model learns a conditional distribution of geometries instead of a deterministic mapping, enabling multiple candidate designs for the ill-posed inverse problem. The best generated metasurface achieves a mean percentage error of 1.39%, outperforming CMA-ES optimization (4.1% after 10 h) while requiring only about one minute for after-training inference. The model also produces lower error distributions than deterministic neural baselines for out-of-distribution spectra, highlighting the potential of diffusion models for efficient metasurface design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散模型的框架，用于从目标角散射模式反设计介电谐振器超表面。该模型在T矩阵模拟数据上训练，学习几何结构的条件分布而非确定性映射，解决了逆设计问题中的非线性和非唯一性问题。生成的最佳超表面平均百分比误差仅1.39%，优于CMA-ES优化（4.1%，耗时10小时），且推理仅需约1分钟。
AI.motivation: 未来无线系统需要将空间转变为智能电磁环境，其中超表面是关键组件。超表面的逆设计（从目标散射特征反推物理结构）本质上是非线性、高维且非唯一的病态问题，现有方法（如CMA-ES优化）计算成本高、效率低，而确定性神经网络方法无法处理解的非唯一性，因此需要一种能够生成多个候选解并高效推理的新方法。
AI.method: 提出一个条件扩散模型框架：以目标角散射模式为条件，在T矩阵模拟的几何-响应配对数据上训练，学习几何结构的条件概率分布（而非确定性映射）。通过扩散模型的生成能力，为病态逆问题提供多个候选设计，而非单一解。
AI.result: 生成的最佳超表面平均百分比误差为1.39%，显著优于CMA-ES优化（4.1%且需10小时），而训练后推理仅需约1分钟。对于分布外（out-of-distribution）光谱，模型产生的误差分布也低于确定性神经网络基线，展示了扩散模型在超表面高效设计中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 条件扩散模型为超表面逆设计提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方案，不仅能处理逆问题的非唯一性（生成多个候选设计），还在准确性和计算效率上均优于传统优化方法和确定性神经网络方法，为智能电磁环境中的超表面设计开辟了新途径。

title: MI-Distillation: Selecting from Model-Interpolated Instruct-Reasoning Data Spectrum for Chain-of-Thought Distillation
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have shown strong performance on complex problems through long chain-of-thought (Long CoT) reasoning. However, distilling such trajectories into smaller student models remains challenging: direct Long CoT supervision often provides limited gains and can be less effective than concise Short CoT rationales. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from a gradient-centric perspective. Our analysis shows that Long CoT induces larger gradient magnitudes and more concentrated update directions than Short CoT, with this effect becoming more pronounced as student model capacity increases. These findings suggest that effective Long CoT distillation requires balancing the reasoning information density of reasoning trajectories with their distributional alignment to the student model. Motivated by this insight, we propose \textbf{M}odel \textbf{I}nterporlation \textbf{Distillation} (\textbf{MI-Distillation}), a framework that constructs a continuous Instruct-Reasoning data spectrum through model interpolation. To select suitable trajectories from this spectrum, we further introduce \textbf{Seq}uential \textbf{L}earnable \textbf{S}urprisal \textbf{S}core (\textbf{SeqLSS}), which favors reasoning paths that are both informative and learnable for the student. Extensive experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that MI-Distillation consistently improves small model CoT distillation over strong Long CoT baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MI-Distillation框架，通过模型插值构建连续的教学-推理数据谱系，并结合SeqLSS可学习惊喜分数选择既信息丰富又适合学生模型学习的推理轨迹，从而提升小模型的长思维链（Long CoT）蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 长思维链推理在大型推理模型中表现优异，但将其蒸馏到小模型时，直接监督Long CoT轨迹往往增益有限，甚至不如简洁的Short CoT。现有方法缺乏对这种现象的深入理解，因此需要从梯度视角探究其根本原因，并设计更有效的蒸馏策略。
AI.method: 1）从梯度中心视角分析Long CoT与Short CoT蒸馏的差异，发现Long CoT会导致更大的梯度幅度和更集中的更新方向，且随学生模型容量增大而更显著。2）提出MI-Distillation框架，通过模型插值构建连续的Instruct-Reasoning数据谱系。3）引入SeqLSS（Sequential Learnable Surprisal Score），用于从数据谱系中选择既信息丰富又适合学生模型学习的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上的大量实验表明，MI-Distillation相比强Long CoT基线，能持续提升小模型CoT蒸馏的性能。
AI.conclusion: 有效进行Long CoT蒸馏需要平衡推理轨迹的推理信息密度与学生模型的分布对齐。MI-Distillation通过构建数据谱系与智能轨迹选择，成功实现了这一平衡，为小模型推理蒸馏提供了新的有效框架。

title: MMPCBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models on Proactive Critique of Flawed Inputs
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) evolve into sophisticated interactive assistants, their reliability depends not only on following instructions but also on validating them. We define Proactive Critique as the model's autonomous ability to identify, analyze and fix faulty user inputs without extra prompts. However, evaluations mainly test models under ideal circumstances or simple refusal behaviors, largely ignoring active error processing. To fill this gap, we propose MMPCBench, a comprehensive framework for evaluating MLLMs' proactive critique competence. It features a fine-grained taxonomy of 4 primary error types spanning 12 subcategories, ranging from cross-modal contradictions to missing visual premises. We adopt a hierarchical evaluation protocol to measure models' error detection, diagnosis and resolution performance, and apply alignment-aware metrics to assess the coherence between internal reasoning and final responses. Tests on 14 mainstream MLLMs show obvious weaknesses in proactive critique, especially in dealing with subtle visual anomalies. Notably, we identify a pervasive "consistency gap": reasoning models can often correctly identify and analyze errors during internal reasoning yet suppress these valid insights in final outputs to prioritize response compliance. The code and data is available at https://github.com/ALIENS32/MMPCBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMPCBench，一个评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）主动批判能力的综合框架，涵盖4类主要错误类型和12个子类别，采用分层评估协议衡量模型的错误检测、诊断和解决能力，并在14个主流MLLM上测试发现模型的主动批判能力普遍不足，尤其是在处理微妙视觉异常时存在"一致性差距"——推理模型能在内部推理中正确识别错误，但最终输出时却抑制了这些有效见解以优先服从指令。
AI.motivation: 随着MLLMs演变为复杂的交互式助手，其可靠性不仅取决于遵循指令，还取决于验证指令。然而现有评估大多在理想条件下测试或仅关注简单的拒绝行为，忽视了主动的错误处理能力。为填补这一空白，作者提出主动批判（Proactive Critique）概念——模型无需额外提示就能自主识别、分析和修复有缺陷的用户输入。
AI.method: 作者构建了MMPCBench框架：1) 设计了细粒度的错误类型分类法，涵盖4类主要错误和12个子类别（从跨模态矛盾到缺失视觉前提）；2) 采用分层评估协议来衡量模型的错误检测、诊断和解决性能；3) 应用对齐感知指标评估内部推理与最终回复之间的一致性。
AI.result: 在14个主流MLLM上的测试显示：模型在主动批判方面存在明显不足，尤其是在处理微妙的视觉异常时。最显著的发现是普遍存在的"一致性差距"——推理模型在内部推理过程中往往能够正确识别和分析错误，但在最终输出中却抑制了这些有效见解，以优先保证响应合规性。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs的主动批判能力仍然薄弱，尤其是在视觉异常处理方面。推理模型在内部推理与最终输出之间的"一致性差距"揭示了模型在遵循性与批判性之间的张力，这对未来MLLM的安全性和可靠性设计提出了重要挑战。

title: On the Recoverability of Private Information Unlearning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize sensitive information, raising serious privacy concerns. Machine unlearning offers a potential solution to remove such information, but it remains unclear whether existing methods truly erase it or merely hide it within the model. A key challenge is quantifying the persistence of sensitive data under a unified evaluation framework. To address this, we construct a synthetic dataset containing fake private information and propose a white-box auditing framework to systematically assess whether claimed-forgotten information is genuinely removed. Using this framework, we evaluate five existing unlearning methods and find that a simple "inverse greedy" decoding -- selecting the least likely token at each step -- can recover supposedly forgotten private information. Our results reveal that current unlearning approaches often fail to fully eliminate sensitive information, highlighting the need for more reliable methods to ensure privacy in deployed LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含虚假私人信息的合成数据集，并提出白盒审计框架来系统评估大语言模型机器遗忘方法的真实效果。研究发现，简单的"逆贪心"解码（每步选择概率最低的token）能恢复被认为已遗忘的隐私信息，表明现有五种遗忘方法往往未能真正消除敏感信息，而只是将其隐藏。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可能记忆敏感信息引发隐私担忧，机器遗忘虽被视为解决方案，但现有方法是否真正擦除信息还是仅将其隐藏到模型深处尚不明确。缺乏统一的评估框架来量化敏感数据的持久性。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含虚假私人信息的合成数据集；2) 提出白盒审计框架系统评估遗忘效果；3) 评估五种现有机器遗忘方法；4) 设计"逆贪心"解码策略（每步选取概率最低的token）来探测被遗忘的信息。
AI.result: 发现简单的"逆贪心"解码策略能够恢复所谓已遗忘的私人信息，说明现有五种机器遗忘方法未能真正消除敏感数据，仅将其隐藏而并未彻底擦除。
AI.conclusion: 当前机器遗忘方法在完全消除敏感信息方面存在明显不足，需要开发更可靠的遗忘方法以确保部署LLM的隐私安全。

title: PrivBench: A Holistic and Modular Benchmarking Platform for Evaluating Text-to-Text Privatization
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations
summary: Natural Language Processing methods have enabled novel solutions and advances in the field of privacy, particularly in the sub-domain of text-to-text privatization, where the goal is to transform a sensitive input text into a privatized output by ideally masking (in)directly identifiable or otherwise private information. The evaluation of text-to-text privatization, however, is not straightforward, and the extant literature has utilized a myriad of techniques and metrics to quantify the privacy-preserving capabilities of privatization methods. Seeking to unify the evaluation of text-to-text privatization, we introduce PrivBench, a holistic and modular benchmarking platform for researchers and practitioners working on text privatization. PrivBench is holistic in that it evaluates privatization on a series of defined desiderata, which are structured into modules. PrivBench is not only modular but also extensible, allowing for future updates and benchmark versions. PrivBench is user-centered and promotes competition via real-time evaluation and a live public leaderboard. The platform is free to use and openly accessible at https://privbench.com/.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PrivBench，一个用于文本到文本隐私化（text-to-text privatization）评估的统一基准测试平台。它通过模块化结构、一系列定义的期望标准（desiderata）、实时评估和公开排行榜，为研究人员和实践者提供全面且可扩展的隐私化评估方案。
AI.motivation: 文本隐私化领域的评估缺乏统一标准，现有文献使用了大量不同的技术和指标来衡量隐私保护能力，导致结果难以比较和复现，亟需一个统一的评估平台。
AI.method: PrivBench是一个整体性且模块化的基准测试平台，通过一系列定义的期望标准（structured into modules）来评估隐私化方法；平台具有可扩展性以支持未来更新，并提供实时评估和公开排行榜以促进竞争。
AI.result: PrivBench平台已上线，免费开放使用，可通过https://privbench.com/访问，提供实时评估和公开排行榜功能。
AI.conclusion: PrivBench旨在统一文本到文本隐私化的评估标准，填补了该领域缺乏系统性评估平台的空白，为研究人员和实践者提供了一套整体、模块化、可扩展且用户友好的评估工具。

title: Accelerating Unified Multimodal Models with Core-Expansion Routing and Unified Computation Scheduling
summary: Unified multimodal models jointly support understanding and generation, but incur substantial redundant computation across tokens, layers, and generation timesteps. Through token-importance probing, we identify an asymmetric core-expansion structure: understanding exhibits a stable importance component, while generation largely shares this component but requires progress-dependent corrections. We therefore propose CE-Router, which uses a task-shared core scorer and progress-conditioned generation expansions, optimized through generation decomposition and cross-task core alignment. At inference, CE-Router compacts token computation and supplies a learned routing signal to Unified Computation Scheduling, which coordinates layer skipping, FFN pruning, diffusion-head cache reuse, and denoising-step early exit. Experiments on two representative UMM architectures demonstrate consistent quality--efficiency improvements across both tasks, retaining 98.03\% of dense understanding performance with a 1.93$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CE-Router，一种面向统一多模态模型（UMM）的计算高效路由机制。通过token重要性探测，发现理解和生成任务存在"非对称核心-扩展"结构：理解有稳定的重要性核心，生成共享该核心但需要随生成进度变化的修正。CE-Router利用任务共享核心评分器和进度条件生成扩展，结合统一计算调度（层跳过、FFN剪枝、扩散头缓存复用、去噪步早退），在两种代表性UMM架构上实现98.03%的稠密理解性能同时获得1.93倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型同时支持理解和生成任务，但在token、层和生成时间步上存在大量冗余计算。需要在保持性能的同时减少这种冗余，提升推理效率。
AI.method: 1) 通过token重要性探测识别"非对称核心-扩展"结构；2) 提出CE-Router，包含任务共享核心评分器和进度条件生成扩展；3) 通过生成分解和跨任务核心对齐进行优化；4) 推理时结合统一计算调度，协调层跳过、FFN剪枝、扩散头缓存复用和去噪步早退。
AI.result: 在两种代表性UMM架构上均实现质量和效率的一致性提升，保留98.03%的稠密理解性能，同时获得1.93倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: CE-Router通过利用理解与生成任务之间共享的核心计算结构，实现了统一多模态模型高效且高质量的计算压缩，验证了"核心-扩展"结构假设的有效性。

title: Robust Broad Learning System with Wave Loss for Classification under Data Uncertainty
summary: Broad Learning System (BLS) offers an efficient alternative to deep architectures by enabling fast learning through randomized feature mapping and closed-form solutions. However, its reliance on squared error loss makes it highly sensitive to noise, outliers, and corrupted labels, limiting its reliability in real-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Wave-BLS, a robust broad learning framework that integrates the wave loss function, which is asymmetric, bounded, and smooth, enabling controlled penalization of large errors. The proposed formulation replaces the standard least-squares objective with a wave-loss-based optimization problem, solved efficiently using a Nesterov accelerated gradient (NAG)-based scheme without requiring matrix inversion, thereby improving scalability. Extensive experiments on 30 UCI benchmark datasets demonstrate that Wave-BLS consistently outperforms classical BLS and several robust variants. Statistical validation using Friedman and Nemenyi post-hoc tests confirms the significance of the observed improvements. Furthermore, robustness evaluations under controlled noise and outlier injection reveal that Wave-BLS exhibits substantially slower performance degradation compared to BLS, even in challenging contamination settings. These results establish Wave-BLS as a stable and robust alternative to existing broad learning models for learning under data uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wave-BLS，一种将wave损失函数集成到宽度学习系统（BLS）中的鲁棒框架。Wave-BLS通过不对称、有界且平滑的损失函数替代传统平方误差损失，并使用Nesterov加速梯度（NAG）方法求解，避免了矩阵求逆，在30个UCI数据集上显著优于经典BLS及其鲁棒变体。
AI.motivation: 传统宽度学习系统（BLS）依赖平方误差损失，对噪声、异常值和损坏标签高度敏感，限制了其在真实场景中的可靠性。因此需要一种能够鲁棒处理数据不确定性的宽度学习框架。
AI.method: 将标准最小二乘目标替换为基于wave损失的优化问题（wave损失具有不对称、有界、平滑特性，可控制大误差的惩罚），并使用Nesterov加速梯度（NAG）方案高效求解，避免了矩阵求逆，提升了可扩展性。
AI.result: 在30个UCI基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Wave-BLS持续优于经典BLS及多种鲁棒变体；Friedman和Nemenyi事后检验证实了改进的统计显著性；在受控噪声和异常值注入下的鲁棒性评估显示，Wave-BLS的性能退化速度显著慢于BLS。
AI.conclusion: Wave-BLS被确立为在数据不确定性条件下，现有宽度学习模型的稳定且鲁棒的替代方案。

title: ACTD: Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization
summary: Knowledge distillation effectively transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight student models. To enable knowledge transfer across disparate model families, researchers increasingly explore cross-tokenizer distillation. However, cross-tokenizer distillation remains challenging due to vocabulary and sequence misalignment, while approximate vocabulary alignment can introduce additional noise into distillation. To address these challenges, we propose Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization (ACTD). ACTD bridges structural heterogeneity through vocabulary and sequence alignment, while mitigating alignment noise via a novel anchor loss with residual regularization. We further extend this framework to a multi-teacher setting. Evaluated across five reasoning benchmarks with three distinct teacher models, ACTD achieves state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, its multi-teacher extension outperforms the strongest single-teacher and multi-teacher baselines, further demonstrating the robustness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACTD（基于锚点的跨分词器蒸馏与残差正则化）方法，通过词汇和序列对齐桥接不同模型家族的结构异质性，并利用锚点损失与残差正则化减少对齐噪声，同时扩展到多教师蒸馏场景，在五个推理基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 跨分词器蒸馏中，由于不同模型家族的词汇表和序列长度不一致，导致知识难以直接迁移。近似词汇对齐会引入额外噪声，影响蒸馏效果，因此需要更鲁棒的对齐机制。
AI.method: ACTD通过词汇对齐和序列对齐弥合结构异质性，提出带残差正则化的锚点损失来缓解对齐噪声；并进一步将框架扩展至多教师蒸馏设置。
AI.result: 在五个推理基准上使用三个不同教师模型进行评估，ACTD达到最先进性能；多教师扩展版本优于最强的单教师和多教师基线，验证了方法的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ACTD有效解决了跨分词器蒸馏中的词汇与序列错配问题，并通过残差正则化抑制对齐噪声，同时多教师扩展进一步增强了蒸馏性能，展示了较强的泛化能力。

title: Predicting Future Organ Dysfunction in ICU Patients Using Temporal Convolutional Networks on MIMIC-IV Data
summary: Predicting future organ dysfunction in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patients is critical for early clinical intervention, yet existing machine learning approaches have largely treated the Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score as an input to binary mortality prediction rather than as a continuous clinical outcome in its own right. We investigate the extent to which a Temporal Convolutional Net work (TCN) can predict next-day SOFA scores from multivariate ICU time-series data extracted from MIMIC-IV, characterise the relative contribution of each organ system to total SOFA variance and deterioration, and identify distinct trajectory patterns across ICU stays. A residual TCN trained on three-day sliding windows achieved a five-fold cross-validation R2 of 0.740 +- 0.013 and MAE of 1.431 +- 0.022, outperforming a naive persistence baseline on RMSE and R2.
