SHAP interpretability analysis revealed that the model functions primarily as a severity-anchoring mechanism rather than a true sequence model, with predictions dominated almost entirely by the most recent observation day. Cardiovascular dysfunction emerged as the strongest discriminator of both cross-sectional severity and acute deterioration, and unsupervised trajectory clustering identified two clinically meaningful phenotypes, an improving group (58.9%) and a persistently severe group (41.1%), differentiated by cardiovascular, hepatic, coagulation, and renal involvement. We conclude that TCNs can extract meaningful predictive signal from ICU physiological data, but that short input windows and complete-case selection bias currently limit their clinical utility, motivating future work on longer input horizons, alternative missing-data strategies, and external validation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用时序卷积网络（TCN）从MIMIC-IV多变量ICU时间序列数据预测次日SOFA评分，五折交叉验证R²为0.740，MAE为1.431。SHAP分析显示模型主要作为"严重程度锚定机制"而非真正的序列模型（预测几乎完全由最近观察日主导）。心血管功能障碍是横断面严重程度和急性恶化的最强判别因素，无监督轨迹聚类识别出两个临床表型：改善组（58.9%）和持续严重组（41.1%）。作者认为TCN能提取有意义预测信号，但短输入窗口和完全病例选择偏差限制了临床实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法大多将SOFA评分作为二元死亡预测的输入特征，而非将其视为需要预测的连续临床结局本身。作者旨在弥补这一空白，探索能否直接预测ICU患者次日SOFA评分，从而为早期临床干预提供更有价值的连续监测工具。
AI.method: 使用残差TCN模型，基于MIMIC-IV提取的多变量ICU时间序列数据，采用三天滑动窗口预测次日SOFA评分。通过五折交叉验证评估性能（R²和MAE），使用SHAP进行可解释性分析以表征各器官系统的贡献，并采用无监督轨迹聚类识别ICU住院期间的临床表型。比较基线为朴素持久性模型。
AI.result: TCN模型实现五折交叉验证R²为0.740±0.013和MAE为1.431±0.022，在RMSE和R²上优于朴素持久性基线。SHAP分析揭示模型主要是严重程度锚定机制，预测几乎完全由最近观察日主导。心血管功能障碍是横断面严重程度和急性恶化的最强判别因素。轨迹聚类识别出两个临床表型：改善组（58.9%）和持续严重组（41.1%），在心血管、肝脏、凝血和肾脏受累方面存在差异。
AI.conclusion: TCN能够从ICU生理数据中提取有意义的预测信号，但当前短输入窗口和完全病例选择偏差限制了临床实用性。未来工作应聚焦于更长输入时间范围、替代缺失数据处理策略以及外部验证。

title: The Intervention Gap in Latent World Models
summary: Planning-time intervention fidelity is a distinct, measurable property of a learned world model: whether the model's own open-loop transitions move task variables the way matched environment interventions do. In the settings we test, it is neither revealed by reward fit nor ensured by task-anchored training. Across released TD-MPC2 checkpoint sizes, episode return falls as an operator-error diagnostic on task observables grows, while reward-prediction error stays small and nearly flat, and a self-supervised world model trained without task signal preserves the same operator substantially better than a task-anchored model on the shared task. A capture-gated matched-intervention audit then localizes what fails. On Cheetah, three LeWorldModel checkpoints capture the current task query and support decodable real intervention effects; however, their imagined five-step effects are worse than predicting no effect and worse than an environment-endpoint oracle. The failure is task-direction rotation with excess gain, not feature collapse. This severe pattern is conditional: five PreJEPA seeds retain an oracle-relative deficit without it, Finger Spin experiments extend the deficit beyond locomotion with heterogeneous severity across seeds, and shared-bank effect geometry is both candidate- and support-dependent. We also test practice-side questions. In DreamerV3 the posterior distribution, not its sample, carries the current query; ensemble disagreement ranks error only near training support; and a frozen support-aware score degrades held-out error ranking in both tested transfer directions while native disagreement remains informative in both. We conclude that intervention fidelity must be audited directly, capture-first, on the model's native interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"规划时干预保真度"作为世界模型的一个独立可测量属性，指模型自身的开环转移能否像匹配的环境干预那样推动任务变量。研究发现该属性既不被奖励拟合揭示，也不被任务锚定训练保证；跨TD-MPC2检查点、Cheetah和Finger Spin等多个实验中，干预保真度普遍缺失（表现为任务方向旋转和过度增益），并给出多项实践侧结论，最终强调需在模型原生接口上以"捕获优先"方式直接审计干预保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型评估主要依赖奖励预测误差或任务锚定训练表现，但这些指标无法揭示模型在规划时对任务变量的干预效果是否真实可信。作者旨在确立"规划时干预保真度"作为独立属性，并系统检验其与现有指标的关系及被何种训练方式影响。
AI.method: 采用捕获门控的匹配干预审计方法：在模型原生接口上对比模型开环想象转移与真实环境干预对任务可观测变量的效果；跨TD-MPC2多个checkpoint尺寸、PreJEPA种子、Finger Spin实验及DreamerV3实践侧（后验分布、集成分歧、冻结支持感知分数）进行系统测试。
AI.result: 干预保真度缺失普遍存在：TD-MPC2中episode return随算子错误诊断增大而下降而奖励预测误差保持小而平；Cheetah上想象五步效果比"预测无效果"和环境端点oracle更差，失败模式为任务方向旋转加过度增益而非特征坍塌；该模式具条件性（PreJEPA无此模式、Finger Spin异质性）；DreamerV3中后验分布而非样本承载当前查询，集成分歧仅在训练支持附近有效，冻结分数损害迁移。
AI.conclusion: 干预保真度必须作为世界模型的独立维度被直接、捕获优先地在模型原生接口上审计，不能依赖奖励拟合或任务锚定训练作为代理指标。

title: A Hub of Short Rows Inflates Intrinsic Dimension Estimation of Token Embeddings
summary: A token-embedding table holds a hub of short rows near its origin, and we show that this cluster biases what nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension (ID) estimators report. Because of the concentration of measure, a token is closer to the central cluster than to any other token, so its first two neighbors are both hub rows at nearly the same distance. As a result, the ID estimators such as TwoNN return a dimension far above the real ID. Measured one token at a time, dimension is a heavy-tailed distribution. Measured on the full vocabulary, it grows with the model's parameter count. However, when we remove the hub, the heavy tail disappears and the measured dimension collapses to a narrow range for eleven models, from GPT-2 to models such as K3 and GLM-4.7. The hub acts as a switch: a few hundred rows are enough to fully inflate the estimate. We reproduced an experiment stating that the intrinsic dimension (ID) of Pythia's token-embedding table grows with the parameter count, from $27$ to $122$ between 160M and 12B parameters. We show that this result disappears when the hub is removed: the table then reads $10$ to $17$ at every size. The hub contains a subset of the population that under-trained-token detectors flag, but on Pythia the hub that we detected and removed as a whole was updated during training: what seem to characterize these rows is simply their length, not an absence of updates. Finally, we show that normalizing the rows instead of removing them gives the same lower reading.

AI.tldr: 本文发现token嵌入表中心存在一个由短向量构成的"枢纽簇"(hub)，该簇会严重偏置最近邻内在维度(ID)估计器的结果。移除或归一化这些枢纽行后，原本随参数规模增长的ID估计值会坍塌到10-17的窄范围，表明此前的ID随参数增长结论是伪象。
AI.motivation: 近年来有研究声称token嵌入表的内在维度随模型参数规模增长(如Pythia从160M到12B参数，ID从27增长到122)，作者怀疑这一结论可能被嵌入表的某些结构特征所误导，而非反映真实的内在维度。
AI.method: 作者识别出嵌入表原点附近存在一个短行hub簇，由于测度集中效应，所有token的最近邻都落在该hub中，导致TwoNN等ID估计器严重高估。作者通过在11个模型(GPT-2到K3、GLM-4.7)上移除hub或对行向量做归一化处理，比较处理前后的ID估计值。
AI.result: (1) 逐token测量的维度呈重尾分布，完整词表上测量的维度随参数规模增长；(2) 移除hub后重尾消失，11个模型的ID全部坍塌到窄范围；(3) 仅几百行hub行就足以完全膨胀估计值；(4) 在Pythia上复现了ID从27到122随参数增长的结果，但移除hub后变为10到17；(5) 归一化行向量而非移除也能得到相同的低读数；(6) hub包含未被充分训练检测器标记的一部分行，但在Pythia上这些行在训练中是被更新的，真正特征只是长度而非缺少更新。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入表中心hub导致的测度偏置使得基于最近邻的ID估计在此类数据上不可靠，此前关于嵌入表内在维度随模型规模增长的结论是被hub伪象所驱动的。移除或归一化hub可得到更真实的低维估计。

title: Formal Concept Analysis with Three Types of Negation
summary: Classic Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) primarily focuses on the positive relationships between objects and attributes and does not have mechanisms for handling negation.To overcome this limitation, we introduce three types of negation concepts (contradictory negation, opposite negation, intermediary negation) into FCA.Based on the set SCOI and logic LCOI+PLCOI with these three types negation, we define formal context, Galois connection operators, formal concept and concept lattice with three types of negation,this leads to the proposal of a FCACOI: Formal Concept Analysis with contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation.For the reasoning in FCACOI, this paper focuses on attribute implication reasoning. Based on the logic LCOI+PLCOI and its semantics, we introduce the notion of ICOI-entailment as the semantic implication for attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI. Through ICOI-entailment, a connection is established between attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI and inference in the logic LCOI+PLCOI, it indicate that formally proven inference rules (theorems) in LCOI+PLCOI are valid in the attribute implication reasoning of FCACOI, LCOI+PLCOI provides a logical foundation for attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI. To illustrate the capability of attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI, we discuss its application in a concrete example. Moreover, we explore attribute reduction of the formal context in FCACOI, propose two research frameworks for attribute reduction from different perspectives, and compare their characteristics.We believe that, based on richer logic and semantics, FCACOI elevates FCA from a theory that describes affirmations to one that can describe affirmations and its contradiction(either this or that), opposition(extreme negation) and intermediary (transitional states between oppositions).

AI.tldr: 本文在经典形式概念分析（FCA）基础上引入三种否定类型（矛盾否定、对立否定、中介否定），提出FCACOI框架，并基于逻辑LCOI+PLCOI建立属性蕴含推理的语义基础，同时探讨了形式背景的属性约简问题。
AI.motivation: 经典FCA仅能处理对象与属性之间的肯定关系，缺乏处理否定关系的机制，这限制了其表达能力和应用范围。作者希望突破这一局限，使FCA不仅能描述肯定关系，还能描述否定与其衍生的对立、中介等复杂语义。
AI.method: 基于集合SCOI和带三种否定的逻辑LCOI+PLCOI，定义了包含三种否定的形式背景、Galois连接算子、形式概念和概念格；引入ICOI-蕴含作为属性蕴含推理的语义蕴含，建立了FCACOI中属性蕴含推理与LCOI+PLCOI逻辑推理之间的联系；并提出两种属性约简研究框架。
AI.result: 成功构建了FCACOI框架，证明了LCOI+PLCOI中经过形式化证明的推理规则（定理）在FCACOI的属性蕴含推理中有效，为该推理提供了逻辑基础；通过具体实例展示了属性蕴含推理的能力；提出了两种属性约简框架并比较了其特征。
AI.conclusion: FCACOI借助更丰富的逻辑和语义，将FCA从仅描述肯定的理论提升为能够同时描述肯定及其矛盾（非此即彼）、对立（极端否定）和中介（对立之间的过渡状态）的理论，并为属性蕴含推理提供了坚实的逻辑基础。

title: Error Detection for PET/CT Radiology Reports: Domain-Specific vs Large Language Models
summary: Errors in radiology reports can adversely affect patient treatment, yet automated report quality assurance remains challenging because errors are often subtle and require domain expertise to detect. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently been proposed for radiology report verification, their ability to detect clinically meaningful errors beyond chest X-ray datasets remains under-explored. To this end, we present the first systematic evaluation of language models for PET/CT report error detection, comparing compact domain-specific models with SOTA open-weight LLMs. We collected 30,633 oncology FDG PET/CT reports from 23 radiologists over 10 years. We trained domain-specific BERT models to detect clinically motivated synthetic reporting errors and evaluated alongside zero-/few-shot Qwen3-32B, Gemma-3-27B and Llama-3.3-70B on a held-out benchmark of 11,500 reports. A 15M-parameter model achieved 94.4% balanced accuracy with a 5.8% false-positive rate, compared with 84.0% for the strongest prompted LLM. Task-specific adaptation of Llama-3.3-70B closed this performance gap (94.4%) but retained substantially greater computational requirements. Our results suggest that domain-specific training matters more than model scale for PET/CT report error detection, supporting compact models as an accurate and computationally efficient approach to automated radiology report quality assurance.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统评估了语言模型在PET/CT影像报告错误检测中的表现，使用30633份真实临床报告训练领域专用的BERT模型，并与SOTA开源LLM（Qwen3-32B、Gemma-3-27B、Llama-3.3-70B）对比。结果表明1500万参数的领域专用模型以94.4%的平衡准确率和5.8%的误报率优于最强的提示LLM（84.0%），而Llama-3.3-70B只有通过任务微调才能追赶性能但计算成本远高。
AI.motivation: 放射学报告中的错误会影响患者治疗，但自动化报告质量保证仍然困难，因为错误通常微妙且需要专业知识。LLM虽已被用于放射报告验证，但其在胸部X光数据集之外检测临床有意义错误的能力尚未被充分探索，尤其在PET/CT报告领域。
AI.method: 收集来自23位放射科医生10年间的30,633份肿瘤科FDG PET/CT报告，训练领域专用的BERT模型检测临床上驱动的合成报告错误，并与零样本/少样本的Qwen3-32B、Gemma-3-27B和Llama-3.3-70B在包含11,500份报告的保留测试集上进行评估，同时对Llama-3.3-70B进行了任务特定微调。
AI.result: 1500万参数的领域专用模型达到94.4%的平衡准确率和5.8%的误报率，而最强的提示LLM（Llama-3.3-70B）仅为84.0%。对Llama-3.3-70B进行任务微调后性能追平（94.4%），但计算需求显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 对于PET/CT报告错误检测，领域专用训练比模型规模更重要，支持紧凑模型作为准确且计算高效的自动化放射学报告质量保证方案。

title: The Depth Flow of Token Representations Is Nonlinear and Does Not Descend Its Own Density
summary:
A token's representation is carried through the network layer by layer. The whole vocabulary carried together forms a flow. We fit this flow's equation of motion as a discrete Langevin model over corpus-mean trajectories of Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, and score the predicted steps on held-out tokens. Linear maps are often used as cheap surrogates for a layer. The flow they summarize is not linear: a quadratic drift beats the linear linear map at every transition of both models, and the Kramers--Moyal estimator agrees wherever its neighborhoods stay local.
  We then characterize the flow further. First, we show that it does not descend its own log-density. The drift instead descends a potential that is not the density. Second, the rotational component is not negligible, $4$ to $45\%$ of the explainable drift, and the circulation shows in what the flow preserves: a token keeps its angular rank across all thirteen layers while its norm rank is shuffled and its concentration rank is reversed by the last block.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将token表示在网络层间的流动建模为离散Langevin方程，分析了Pythia-160M和Pythia-410M的语料平均轨迹。研究发现二次漂移优于线性映射，流动并不沿自身对数密度下降，且旋转分量占可解释漂移的4-45%，token的角向排名在13层中保持稳定，而范数排名被打乱、浓度排名被最后一块反转。
AI.motivation: 理解token表示在神经网络层间如何演化是解释深度模型内部机制的核心问题。线性映射常被用作层间转换的廉价替身，但作者希望探究这种线性近似是否充分，以及层的真实动力学是否具有更丰富的结构。
AI.method: 将token表示跨层的流动拟合成离散Langevin方程，使用Kramers-Moyal估计器计算漂移和扩散项。在Pythia-160M和Pythia-410M的语料平均轨迹上拟合模型，并在留出token上评分。通过比较线性映射和二次漂移的性能，并分析旋转与非旋转分量来刻画流动特征。
AI.result: 二次漂移在每个转换处都优于线性映射；流动不沿自身对数密度下降，而是沿一个非密度的势能下降；旋转分量占可解释漂移的4-45%；token的角向排名在全部13层中保持，范数排名被混淆，浓度排名被最后一块反转。
AI.conclusion: 层间表示的流动本质上是非线性的，线性映射作为替代品无法完全捕捉其动力学。该流动具有旋转性质，且不同token属性（角向、范数、浓度排名）在层间展现截然不同的保持或变换模式，揭示了深层网络内部表征演化的丰富几何动力学结构。

title: BIRD-History: A Benchmark for History-Driven Text-to-SQL with Fine-Grained Knowledge Annotations
comment: Accepted at Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP, 2026
summary: While recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based text-to-SQL systems achieve impressive performance on standard benchmarks, they struggle when user queries implicitly rely on domain-specific knowledge, such as business logic, data conventions, and analytical practices, that is neither captured by the schema nor explicitly stated in the natural language question. Historical SQL query logs offer a valuable source of such knowledge, yet existing benchmarks do not adequately support evaluation of history-driven approaches. To address this gap, we introduce BIRD-History, a benchmark consisting of 1,393 tasks across 11 databases, designed to evaluate text-to-SQL systems' ability to ground underspecified natural language questions using historical SQL scripts. Each task is annotated with ground-truth labels specifying which historical queries contain relevant knowledge and which SQL clauses encode it, enabling systematic evaluation of both retrieval effectiveness and knowledge utilization. Alongside the benchmark, we propose a plug-in retriever that extracts five types of external knowledge from historical SQL scripts, then retrieves and reranks relevant fragments for query generation. The retriever integrates seamlessly into existing few-shot text-to-SQL pipelines without requiring prompt modifications. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across four text-to-SQL systems, highlighting the value of leveraging historical query logs for handling underspecified queries. Dataset and code are open-sourced on https://github.com/zjuidg/BIRD-History.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BIRD-History基准测试集，用于评估文本到SQL系统利用历史SQL查询日志来处理隐含领域知识（如业务逻辑、数据约定和分析实践）的未明确指定的自然语言查询的能力。该基准包含1,393个任务、11个数据库，并附带提出了一种即插即用的检索器，可从历史SQL脚本中提取五种类型的外部知识并进行检索重排序，在四个文本到SQL系统上均取得了一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的文本到SQL系统在标准基准上表现优异，但当用户查询隐含依赖领域特定知识（如业务逻辑、数据约定和分析实践）且这些知识既不在schema中也不在自然语言问题中明确表述时，系统表现不佳。历史SQL查询日志是这类知识的宝贵来源，但现有基准不支持对基于历史驱动方法的评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建BIRD-History基准：包含1,393个任务、11个数据库，每个任务标注了哪些历史查询包含相关知识以及哪些SQL子句编码了这些知识，从而支持对检索效果和知识利用的系统性评估。2) 提出即插即用检索器：从历史SQL脚本中提取五种类型的外部知识，然后检索并重排序相关片段以用于查询生成。该检索器无需修改提示即可无缝集成到现有的少样本文本到SQL流水线中。
AI.result: 在四个不同的文本到SQL系统上进行的实验表明，该方法带来了一致的性能提升，验证了利用历史查询日志处理未明确指定查询的价值。
AI.conclusion: 利用历史SQL查询日志可以显著提升文本到SQL系统处理未明确指定查询的能力，BIRD-History基准和即插即用检索器为这一方向提供了有效的评估工具和实用方法。数据集和代码已开源。

title: Multiclass Linear Perceptrons with Multiplicative Margins
summary: This paper introduces a family of multiclass linear Perceptron classifiers with a multiplicative margin mechanism (MMPerc), as an alternative to standard margin-free and additive margin Perceptrons. The multiplicative formulation enforces classification confidence by requiring the true class score to exceed that of competing classes by a specified fraction of itself, rather than by a fixed additive threshold. This avoids dependence on score magnitudes arising from varied norms of data and class weight vectors. We propose several architectural and algorithmic variants of MMPerc, derive associated loss functions and mistake bounds for both linearly separable and non-separable data, and analyze key design considerations, including bias, margin threshold selection, and training modes. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that MMPerc classifiers typically outperform the standard Perceptron, as well as classic baselines such as Support Vector Machines and Ridge classifiers. Owing to their simplicity, minimalistic design, and computational efficiency, MMPerc classifiers are promising candidates for conventional machine learning tasks, linear evaluation of Deep Neural Networks, integration with Hyperdimensional Computing / Vector Symbolic Architecture representations, and deployment in resource-constrained applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类具有乘法边界机制的多类线性感知机分类器（MMPerc），通过对真实类分数设定相对自身的比例阈值而非固定加性阈值来强化分类置信度，在合成与真实数据集上优于标准感知机、SVM和Ridge分类器。
AI.motivation: 标准感知机的边界机制是加性的（固定阈值），且传统边界-free感知机无法保证分类置信度。加性阈值受数据范数和类权重向量范数影响，导致分数量级依赖问题。因此需要一种乘法边界机制，使阈值随真实类分数按比例缩放，从而避免量级依赖。
AI.method: 提出MMPerc系列多类线性感知机，核心在于乘法边界约束：要求真实类分数超过其他竞争类分数的一定比例（而非固定差值）。提供了多种架构与算法变体，推导了线性可分与不可分数据下的损失函数和错误界，并分析了偏置、边界阈值选择及训练模式等设计要点。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MMPerc分类器通常优于标准感知机，也优于SVM和Ridge分类器等经典基线，且具有简单、极简设计和计算高效的特点。
AI.conclusion: MMPerc因简单性、极简设计和计算效率，适用于常规机器学习任务、深度神经网络的线性评估、与超维计算/向量符号架构表示集成，以及资源受限场景的部署。

title: DVBench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Understanding Dynamic Charts and Narratives in Data Videos
summary: While MLLMs have made significant strides in chart comprehension and video understanding, current evaluations largely isolate these capabilities, leaving a critical gap in understanding temporally evolving structured visual information. To address this gap, we introduce DVBench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on data videos, a storytelling medium that integrates dynamic charts with structured narratives. We decompose data video understanding into five dimensions. DVBench comprises 300 real-world data videos and 1,000 human-verified QA pairs curated through a rigorous semi-automated pipeline. Extensive evaluations of nine MLLMs show that Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves the best overall performance, while Kimi-k2.5 is the strongest open-source model. We further identify two notable phenomena: open-source model performance does not scale strictly with parameter size, and narrative proficiency does not guarantee visual capability. Fine-grained analyses and ablation studies further reveal dimension-specific weaknesses and the effects of frame configurations and subtitle inputs, informing future MLLM development. DVBench is publicly available at https://bomiaowang.github.io/DVBench/.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍DVBench，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在"数据视频"（结合动态图表与结构化叙事的媒介）上理解能力的基准。包含300个真实数据视频和1000个经过人工验证的问答对，从五个维度分解理解任务，并对九种MLLM进行广泛评估。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM评估将图表理解与视频理解割裂开来，缺乏对随时间演变的、结构化视觉信息（即数据视频）理解的系统评估，存在关键研究空白。
AI.method: 构建DVBench基准：将数据视频理解分解为五个维度，通过严格的半自动化流程收集300个真实数据视频和1000个人工验证的QA对，并在九个MLLM上进行评估，包括消融实验和细粒度分析。
AI.result: Gemini-3.1-Pro综合表现最佳，Kimi-k2.5为最强开源模型。发现开源模型性能不与参数规模严格成正比，叙事能力不一定保证视觉能力。消融实验揭示了帧配置和字幕输入的影响。
AI.conclusion: DVBench填补了MLLM在数据视频理解评估上的空白，揭示维度级弱点与能力差异，为未来MLLM发展提供指导性见解。

title: Extending TotalSegmentator: Predicting Patient and Acquisition Characteristics from CT and MR Images
summary:
Background: Patient details and acquisition metadata are important for clinical decisions, image quality control, and automated research pipelines, but may be missing or unreliable in imaging archives.
  Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fast open-source model that predicts patient and acquisition characteristics directly from CT and MR images.
  Materials and Methods: Separate 3D ResNet-10 ensembles for CT and MR were trained on 57,291 and 43,200 clinical examinations acquired from 2011 to 2025. Both predicted weight, height, age, sex, contrast presence, vertebral coverage, and image noise. The CT model additionally predicted scanner manufacturer, tube voltage, tube current, convolution kernel, and post-injection time; the MR model predicted sequence class. Performance was evaluated on internal CT (n=501) and MR (n=636) test sets and an external CT dataset (n=54).
  Results: Internal CT MAEs were 3.90 kg, 3.68 cm, and 4.42 years for weight, height, and age, with sex F1=0.990; corresponding MR results were 4.34 kg, 4.62 cm, 7.13 years, and F1=0.970. The CNN outperformed a segmentation-derived XGBoost baseline for all four core targets in both modalities (adjusted P<=.042). F1 scores were 0.963 for CT contrast, 0.953 for MR sequence, and 0.823 for MR contrast. External CT MAEs were 4.45 kg, 4.05 cm, and 5.17 years, with sex F1=0.971. CPU inference required 20 seconds for CT and 12 seconds for MR.
  Conclusion: One 3D multitask model per modality can rapidly recover patient and acquisition characteristics from heterogeneous CT and MR examinations. Models are available in TotalSegmentator: https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator

AI.tldr: 本文开发并评估了一个快速开源模型（基于3D ResNet-10集成），可直接从CT和MR图像预测患者特征（体重、身高、年龄、性别）及采集元数据（对比剂、椎体覆盖、噪声、扫描仪厂商等）。模型在57,291例CT和43,200例MR临床检查上训练，内部及外部测试集均表现良好，推理速度快（CPU上CT 20秒、MR 12秒），已集成到TotalSegmentator工具中。
AI.motivation: 影像档案中的患者详细信息和采集元数据常缺失或不可靠，而这些信息对临床决策、图像质量控制和自动化研究流程至关重要。因此需要一种直接从图像本身快速恢复这些特征的方法。
AI.method: 分别训练CT和MR两个3D ResNet-10集成模型，在多任务学习中同时预测体重、身高、年龄、性别、对比剂、椎体覆盖和图像噪声；CT模型额外预测扫描仪厂商、管电压、管电流、卷积核和注射后时间，MR模型预测序列类别。用分割衍生的XGBoost作为基线对比。
AI.result: 内部测试集上：CT体重/身高/年龄MAE分别为3.90kg/3.68cm/4.42年，性别F1=0.990；MR对应值为4.34kg/4.62cm/7.13年，F1=0.970。CNN在四个核心目标上均优于XGBoost基线（P≤0.042）。CT对比剂F1=0.963，MR序列F1=0.953，MR对比剂F1=0.823。外部CT测试集MAEs为4.45kg/4.05cm/5.17年，F1=0.971。
AI.conclusion: 单一3D多任务模型可快速地从异构CT和MR检查中恢复患者特征和采集特征，性能优秀且推理高效，模型已开源供社区使用。

title: Forget or Fine-tune? A Comparative Study of Machine Unlearning Strategies for Noisy Label Correction
summary: Noisy labels remain a critical challenge for training deep neural networks, since memorizing incorrect labels degrades generalization. Once noisy samples are identified after training, the standard solution is to retrain the model from scratch on the cleaned dataset, which is increasingly expensive as datasets and models grow. Machine Unlearning (MU) has recently emerged as a computationally efficient alternative, but the relative effectiveness of different MU strategies for noisy-label correction remains poorly understood. In this work, we conduct a comparative empirical study of five MU methods (NegGrad, Fine-Tuning (FT), Random Labeling (RL), SalUn, and MUNBa) across symmetric, asymmetric, instance-dependent, and open-set noise on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and the real-world noisy dataset Food-101N. Our central finding is that the appropriate unlearning strategy is conditioned on the noise structure. Simple FT is a strong baseline across most closed-set scenarios; RL and SalUn are the most consistently robust methods and, under instance-dependent noise, approach retraining accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost; MUNBa shows advantages mainly under extreme symmetric noise. Under open-set noise, in contrast, we show that retraining on the cleaned subset degrades accuracy relative to the noisy baseline, so approximating the retrained model is not an adequate objective in this regime. On Food-101N, all MU methods remain competitive and achieve accuracies close to retraining despite reducing runtime by an order of magnitude. These findings provide practical guidelines for selecting MU strategies for post-training noisy-label correction.

AI.tldr: 本文对五种机器遗忘（Machine Unlearning）方法在噪声标签修正任务中的效果进行了系统对比研究，发现最合适的遗忘策略取决于噪声结构：FT在大部分闭集场景表现强劲，RL和SalUn在实例依赖噪声下接近重训练精度且计算成本低，MUNBa仅在极端对称噪声下占优，而开集噪声下重训练本身并非合适目标。
AI.motivation: 噪声标签会导致深度神经网络记住错误信息而降低泛化能力。传统解决方案是在识别出噪声样本后从头重训练模型，但随着数据和模型规模增大，重训练成本越来越高。机器遗忘（MU）作为计算高效的替代方案虽已出现，但不同MU策略在噪声标签修正中的相对有效性尚未被充分理解，缺乏系统性的比较研究。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和真实噪声数据集Food-101N上，对五种MU方法（NegGrad、Fine-Tuning、Random Labeling、SalUn和MUNBa）进行对比实验，覆盖对称噪声、非对称噪声、实例依赖噪声和开集噪声四种噪声类型。
AI.result: 研究发现：FT在多数闭集场景是强基线；RL和SalUn最稳健，在实例依赖噪声下以极小计算成本逼近重训练精度；MUNBa仅在极端对称噪声下表现突出；开集噪声下重训练反而降低精度；在Food-101N上所有MU方法均与重训练精度接近且运行时间减少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 合适的遗忘策略取决于噪声结构，这为实际选择MU策略进行训练后噪声标签修正提供了实践指南。

title: Evaluating the Capabilities of LLMs for Persuasive Dialogue
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate apparently highly persuasive text, but does sounding persuasive mean arguing well? We introduce \textsc{Persuasio}, a multi-agent dialogue platform grounded in a formal argumentation-based theory of persuasion dialogues that adjudicates logical winners during free-text debates. Using this system, we generated 192 debates on a UK political topic between humans and LLMs, and evaluated 22 interlocutors through both automated adjudication and 9,702 crowdsourced pairwise judgements across 1{,}386 annotation instances. We observed a consistent decoupling between subjective and formal persuasiveness: LLMs dominated the subjective ranking yet performed substantially worse under argumentation-theoretic adjudication, where humans remained competitive. Multi-agent and retrieval-augmented variants further widened this divergence. These findings reveal a systematic gap between rhetorical fluency and formal argumentative strength in LLM-based persuasive dialogues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Persuasio，一个基于论证理论的多智能体对话平台，通过形式论证判定辩论逻辑胜负。实验发现LLM在主观说服力排名上占优，但在形式论证评估下表现显著较差，揭示了修辞流畅性与形式论证强度之间的系统性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明LLM能生成高度有说服力的文本，但缺乏对"听起来有说服力"与"论证得好"之间区别的严格审视。作者希望用形式化的论证理论来评判自由文本辩论中的逻辑胜者，从而揭露主观感知与客观论证质量之间的潜在脱节。
AI.method: 构建Persuasio平台，基于形式论证理论的多智能体对话系统，在自由文本辩论中判定逻辑胜者。生成192场英国政治话题辩论（人类与LLM对决），评估22个对话者，同时采用自动化裁决和9,702次众包成对判断（1,386个标注实例）。包含多智能体和检索增强的变体实验。
AI.result: 发现主观与形式说服力之间存在一致的解耦：LLM在主观排名中占主导地位，但在论证理论裁决下表现明显较差，人类仍具竞争力。多智能体和检索增强变体进一步扩大了这一分歧。
AI.conclusion: LLM基于修辞流畅性产生主观上的说服力，但缺乏正式论证强度，揭示了对话式AI在修辞流畅与逻辑严谨之间的系统性差距，呼吁对LLM说服能力进行更严格的论证理论评估。

title: Cross-Relational Preference Learning for Better LLM Instruction Following
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) still exhibit limited capability in following complex instructions. While existing approaches often rely on preference learning to enhance this ability, they typically overlook the relationships between the permissible response spaces of different instructions, which restricts a model to align with subtle and diverse constraint variations. To address this, we propose Cross-Relational Preference Learning (CRPL), a novel framework for constructing preference data that explicitly models inter-instruction relationships through two key techniques: Cross-Relationship Perturbation and Cross-Region Pair Sampling. This enables the generation of more diverse preference data that captures a wide spectrum of constraint variations. Additionally, we introduce an atomic constraint-based verification mechanism to rigorously assess response satisfaction, ensuring high-quality preference pair construction. Extensive experiments across multiple preference learning methods (e.g., DPO, KTO), LLM backbones and four instruction-following benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves substantial improvements over prior baselines and exhibits strong generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRPL框架，通过显式建模指令间关系（跨关系扰动和跨区域配对采样）来构建更高质量的偏好数据，并引入基于原子约束的验证机制，从而提升大语言模型遵循复杂指令的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的偏好学习方法在提升LLM复杂指令遵循能力时，忽略了不同指令之间允许响应空间的关系，导致模型难以对齐细微且多样的约束变化。
AI.method: 提出Cross-Relational Preference Learning (CRPL)框架，包含两个关键技术：Cross-Relationship Perturbation（跨关系扰动）和Cross-Region Pair Sampling（跨区域配对采样），并引入基于原子约束的验证机制来严格评估响应满足度，确保构建高质量的偏好对。
AI.result: 在多种偏好学习方法（如DPO、KTO）、多个LLM骨干以及四个指令遵循基准上的大量实验表明，该方法相较之前基线有显著提升，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模指令间响应空间的关系并生成多样化的偏好数据，CRPL能够有效增强模型对复杂和细微约束变化的对齐能力，优于现有基线方法。

title: When 3D Gaussian Splatting Recovers Real Surfaces
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. 30 pages, 3 figures, 1 table; includes supplementary material
summary: When does 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) recover the true scene surface rather than just overfitting view-dependent appearance? We answer this by developing a mathematical framework based on a first-hit rendering abstraction that cleanly isolates geometry from appearance. We prove that geometric misalignment forcefully converts spatial textures into high-frequency angular signals via parallax. This establishes a strict identifiability window: if angular capacity is bounded, surface-consistent solutions are mathematically preferred; if unrestricted, the same images can be perfectly explained by an incorrect, opaque billboard geometry. Experiments on synthetic stress tests confirm this prediction, showing billboard failures emerge precisely at high angular capacities. Conversely, in the real-world datasets we evaluate under standard capture protocols, reconstructions remain surface-consistent even at high SH degrees, which is consistent with the prediction that rich spatial texture can push billboard solutions outside the tested angular-capacity range.

AI.tldr: 本文通过首命中（first-hit）渲染抽象建立数学框架，分析3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）何时能恢复真实场景表面而非仅过拟合视角相关外观。证明几何错位会将空间纹理强制转化为高频角度信号，从而建立可辨识窗口：角度能力受限时表面一致解被数学偏好，不受限时错误的不透明广告牌几何也能完美解释相同图像。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在实际应用中可能仅过拟合视角相关外观而非恢复真实几何，但何时发生这种失败缺乏严格的理论分析。作者希望建立数学框架来明确界定3DGS能恢复真实表面与退化为广告牌（billboard）几何的条件。
AI.method: 提出基于首命中（first-hit）渲染抽象的数学模型，该抽象将几何与外观清晰分离。通过数学证明建立可辨识性窗口，分析角度容量（angular capacity）与空间纹理之间的关系，并通过合成压力测试和真实世界数据集进行验证。
AI.result: 合成压力测试证实：广告牌几何失败恰好出现在高角度容量时。真实世界标准采集协议下，即使高SH阶数重建仍保持表面一致性，与"丰富空间纹理可将广告牌解推出测试角度容量范围"的预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 3DGS能否恢复真实表面取决于角度容量与空间纹理的博弈：几何错位产生的视差效应将空间纹理转化为高频角度信号，当角度容量受限时表面一致解占优，否则广告牌退化解可能出现。但实际标准采集协议下的数据通常表面一致。

title: ReTrace: Rejected-Trajectory Conditioning for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language model inference by having a lightweight draft model propose multiple candidate tokens, which are then verified in parallel by a larger target model. However, after the first rejection, standard prefix-based verification discards the remaining draft suffix, so the computation spent generating and verifying those positions does not contribute to decoding progress. Focusing on DFlash, we show that rejected positions in a rejected suffix may still align with the target continuation, indicating that the draft model can retain useful semantic and structural information despite local token-level errors. Motivated by this observation and inspired by conditional diffusion, we introduce~\textbf{ReTrace}, a rejected-trajectory conditioning method that conditions each draft block on the rejected suffix from the previous round rather than generating it from fresh mask placeholders alone. ReTrace retains the hidden representations of the rejected suffixes, aligns them with the next draft block, refines them using target-aware correction signals from the same verification pass, and admits them into the drafter's input embeddings through gated residual fusion. Because rejected tokens are never committed and target-side verification remains unchanged, ReTrace preserves the lossless property of speculative decoding without requiring an additional model forward pass. Experiments with Qwen3 models across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and open-ended dialogue demonstrate that ReTrace consistently improves average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding speed over its DFlash backbone. By introducing cross-round conditioning without modifying within-round proposal generation, ReTrace is largely orthogonal to existing drafting improvements and might be combined with them for further gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReTrace，一种基于拒绝轨迹条件化的投机解码加速方法。其核心洞察是：被拒绝的草稿后缀中仍可能包含与目标模型续写对齐的有效语义信息。ReTrace将上一轮被拒绝的后缀隐藏表示保留下来，通过目标感知的校正信号对齐并融合到下一轮草稿块的输入嵌入中，使得草稿模型能从"失败"中学习，而不改变目标侧验证逻辑，从而保持投机解码的无损特性。实验表明，在Qwen3模型上的数学推理、代码生成和开放式对话任务中，ReTrace相比DFlash基线一致地提升了平均接受长度和端到端解码速度。
AI.motivation: 标准投机解码中，首个token被拒绝后，后续草稿后缀全部被丢弃，导致生成和验证这些位置的计算被浪费。作者发现DFlash中，被拒绝位置仍可能与目标续写对齐，说明草稿模型在局部token错误下仍保留有用的语义和结构信息。这激发作者思考如何利用这些被拒绝的轨迹信息来提升下一轮的草稿质量。
AI.method: ReTrace的关键创新是跨轮条件化：将上一轮被拒绝后缀的隐藏表示保留并用于条件化下一轮草稿块的生成，而非仅从空白mask占位符重新生成。具体包括：1)保留拒绝后缀的隐藏表示；2)将其与下一草稿块对齐；3)利用同一验证过程中的目标感知校正信号进行精炼；4)通过门控残差融合将这些表示注入草稿模型的输入嵌入中。由于被拒绝token从未被提交且目标侧验证保持不变，ReTrace保持投机解码的无损属性，且不需要额外的模型前向传播。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型上，覆盖数学推理、代码生成和开放式对话三个任务的实验表明，ReTrace相比DFlash基线一致地提升了平均接受长度（average acceptance length）和端到端解码速度。此外，由于ReTrace不修改轮内提案生成，它与现有的草稿改进方法大体正交，可进一步组合以取得更大收益。
AI.conclusion: ReTrace通过跨轮条件化利用被拒绝轨迹中的有价值信息，在不增加额外模型前向传播、保持无损性的前提下有效提升投机解码效率。该方法受条件扩散启发，为投机解码的草稿生成提供了新思路，且与现有改进方法正交，具有良好扩展性。

title: APPSolver: Adaptive Patch Partitioning for Point-Wise Ship Flow Prediction on Unstructured Meshes
summary: Large non-uniform point sets make direct attention-based surrogate modeling costly for ship hydrodynamics. We introduce APPSolver, a point-wise flow-prediction framework built around Adaptive Patch Partitioning (APP), a deterministic quadtree representation for fixed two-dimensional horizontal slices extracted from ship CFD simulations. APP assigns finer patches near the hull and coarser patches farther away, downsamples patch contents, and recovers predictions to the full reference point set. Under a corrected protocol that constructs natural $(t,t+1)$ pairs before splitting, reuses training-set normalization statistics, and reports three model seeds, learned tokenizers are more accurate than APP-Transformer, and a persistence baseline has lower one-step MAE on all three ShipBench hulls. The supported benefit of APP is therefore computational rather than universal predictive superiority: on a representative DTC input, APP-Transformer requires 1.815 GFLOPs and 1.309 ms per model forward, while a matched ablation shows that adaptive partitioning reduces MAE by 16.4-24.9\% relative to a uniform partition augmented with learned slicing. Condition encoders provide setting-dependent gains in leave-one-hull-out evaluation, but the current absolute next-state objective does not establish accurate long-horizon dynamics. These results characterize APP as a compact spatial representation with an explicit accuracy--efficiency trade-off. Code is available at https://github.com/wenhuahuo/APPSolver .

AI.tldr: APPSolver是一个基于自适应分块(APP)的船舶水动力流场预测框架。APP采用确定性四叉树表示对船舶CFD仿真的二维水平切片进行划分，在船体附近使用更细的patch，远处使用更粗的patch。在修正的实验协议下，学习的tokenizer比APP-Transformer更准确，持久性基线的单步MAE在所有三个ShipBench船体上更低。APP的收益主要体现在计算效率上而非预测精度上：在DTC输入上仅需1.815 GFLOPs和1.309 ms，而自适应划分相比均匀划分可将MAE降低16.4-24.9%。条件编码器在留一船体评估中提供增益，但当前绝对下一状态目标无法建立准确的长期动力学。
AI.motivation: 船舶水动力中大规模非均匀点集使得直接基于注意力机制的代理建模成本高昂，需要更高效的空间表示和计算方法来降低计算开销。
AI.method: 提出APPSolver框架，核心是自适应分块(APP)的确定性四叉树表示：对二维水平切片进行分块，靠近船体区域使用更细粒度patch，远处使用粗粒度patch，对patch内容进行下采样并在预测后恢复到完整参考点集。同时修正实验协议（先构造(t,t+1)对再分裂、复用训练集归一化统计量、报告三个模型种子），并引入条件编码器。
AI.result: 学习的tokenizer比APP-Transformer更准确；持久性基线在所有三个ShipBench船体上单步MAE更低；APP的效益主要在计算层面（DTC输入仅1.815 GFLOPs和1.309 ms）；自适应划分比均匀划分降低MAE 16.4-24.9%；条件编码器在留一船体评估中提供增益，但当前目标函数无法保证准确的长期动力学。
AI.conclusion: APP被定位为一种紧凑的空间表示方法，具有明确的精度-效率权衡。其优势主要体现在计算效率上，而非预测准确性的普遍提升。目前该方法适合作为高效的空间表征工具，但在长期动力学预测方面仍需进一步改进。

title: How do World Models and Policies Compose in LLM Agents? A Joint Spectral and Behavioral Account
summary: How do LLM agents come to both understand environments they act in and master tasks set within them? Through controlled experiments combining world-model training (next-state prediction) and policy training (reward maximization), we investigate this question. We dissect the resulting models through their additive parameter updates. Geometrically, we find effective world-model updates are low-rank and share an input-feature subspace with policy updates while writing to nearly orthogonal output directions, whether trained separately or sequentially. However, we find that, in projection interventions, the sequential update induces more robustness than separate policy RL when removing the world model's leading input directions, suggesting that it has learned alternative input pathways. Behaviorally, we find the sequentially trained agent explores a wider range of states and actions. Based on this, we ask: does policy training preserve world knowledge as well as it could? We probe this with training-free merging built on the geometrically motivated input basis plus an online world-model loss during policy RL, and show both improve over the untreated baseline. Our findings suggest world knowledge and task-directed ability can be learned in geometrically complementary forms, and that future post-training pipelines should consider how best to engineer the interface between them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验研究了LLM智能体如何同时理解环境（世界模型训练）并掌握任务（策略训练）。通过参数更新分析，发现两种训练产生低秩更新，共享输入特征子空间但写入近乎正交的输出方向。顺序训练比单独RL训练更鲁棒、探索更广，且可通过训练自由融合和在线世界模型损失进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM智能体如何同时获得环境理解和任务掌握能力，以及世界模型训练和策略训练之间的几何关系与相互作用机理。
AI.method: 通过受控实验结合世界模型训练（下一状态预测）与策略训练（奖励最大化），使用加性参数更新来剖析模型；实施投影干预测试鲁棒性，并采用基于几何输入基底的训练自由融合及在线世界模型损失进行改进。
AI.result: 发现有效世界模型更新是低秩的，与策略更新共享输入特征子空间但写入近乎正交的输出方向。顺序训练在去除世界模型主导输入方向时比单独RL更鲁棒，探索更广。提出的训练自由融合方法和在线世界模型损失均优于未处理基线。
AI.conclusion: 世界知识与任务导向能力可以以几何互补的形式学习，未来后训练流程应考虑如何优化二者之间的接口。

title: HiVe: Beyond Static Prompts for Multitask Learning via Hierarchy-based Vertical Mixture-of-Experts
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to scale, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a practical alternative to full-parameter adaptation. Prompt tuning is effective, but existing approaches either use flat prompt structures or hierarchical structures with fixed prompt composition, limiting adaptive prompt specialization. To address this limitation, we propose HiVe, a prompt tuning framework that models prompts at multiple levels and enables input-dependent specialization. HiVe constructs a prompt hierarchy by leveraging inter-task relationships during training, and employs a vertical mixture-of-experts (V-MoE) mechanism at inference time to compose prompts up to the level of specialization required for each input. Experiments show that HiVe consistently outperforms strong prompt tuning baselines across diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: HiVe是一个提示词调优框架，通过多层级提示结构和垂直混合专家（V-MoE）机制，实现基于输入的提示词自适应特化，在多种任务上优于现有强基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示词调优方法要么使用扁平提示结构，要么使用固定组合的分层结构，限制了提示词的自适应特化能力，无法根据具体输入灵活调整提示词。
AI.method: HiVe构建多层级提示词层次结构，训练时利用任务间关系形成提示词层次，推理时通过垂直混合专家（V-MoE）机制，根据每个输入所需特化程度动态组合不同层级的提示词。
AI.result: 实验表明HiVe在多样化任务上一致优于强提示词调优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过层级提示结构和输入依赖的特化机制，HiVe有效解决了提示词调优中自适应特化不足的问题，验证了多层级V-MoE架构的优越性。

title: Plant-Inspired AI: Plants as Inspiration for Novel Problem Formulations, and Two Case Studies
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has long been inspired by studies of biological intelligence. Reinforcement learning, for instance, drew inspiration from studies involving animal learning and is now a powerful paradigm for solving many real-world problems. Recently, plant biologists have uncovered a wide range of complex behaviors in plants that enable them to flexibly adapt to variable environments. Here, we argue that such behavior can motivate new AI frameworks encompassing a range of problems overlooked by existing problem-solving frameworks such as supervised learning, tree search, and constraint satisfaction. We illustrate this idea with two examples of intelligent problem-solving in plants: (1) leaf mimicry in Boquila trifoliolata, a vine capable of altering its leaves' morphology to resemble those of multiple host trees simultaneously; and (2) coordinated root-shoot growth, wherein plants allocate resources across organ systems exploring distinct environments. While leaf mimicry is highly specific to Boquila, coordination of root-shoot growth is shared across most plants. For both examples, we capture underlying computational principles and identify problems fitting these frameworks that are currently unaddressed by AI. Finally, we outline preliminary task formulations and discuss how these formulations may be applied to non-plant problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出植物智能行为（如拟态和根-芽协调生长）可以为AI提供新的问题求解框架灵感，涵盖现有AI框架（如监督学习、树搜索、约束满足）未解决的问题，并通过两个具体案例阐述其计算原理和潜在应用。
AI.motivation: AI长期受生物智能启发（如强化学习受动物学习启发），但植物行为研究尚未被AI领域充分关注。植物展现的复杂适应行为可能揭示AI框架尚未覆盖的新问题类型。
AI.method: 以两个植物智能案例为核心：(1) Boquila trifoliolata叶拟态——藤本植物同时模仿多个宿主树叶片形态；(2) 根-芽协调生长——植物在多个探索不同环境的器官系统间分配资源。从案例中提取底层计算原理，识别对应的未解决AI问题，并初步规划任务形式化。
AI.result: 识别出两个现有AI未充分覆盖的问题框架：多目标同步拟态（对应叶拟态）和跨异构环境的资源分配协同优化（对应根-芽协调生长），并给出初步的任务形式化方案。
AI.conclusion: 植物智能为AI提供了新颖的问题求解视角，通过研究植物行为可以拓展AI框架的边界，并可能应用于非植物领域的类似问题。

title: Selection, Representation, and Execution in Sparse Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Sparse representations are often expected to make models smaller and also reduce inference cost. For Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), these objectives are not equivalent or do not always align: removing parts of the learned operator can leave the underlying transforms and dense computations unchanged, while changing the grid on which the model is evaluated can introduce overhead of its own. We therefore distinguish sparsity in the representation, in the stored parameters, in the theoretical operation count, and in measured runtime, and present an empirical study of several routes toward sparse FNOs that tests each transition between them separately. Coarsening the execution grid reduces the theoretical cost without reducing measured latency, and adding a correction term recovers accuracy at the cost of making the model slower. Even an 83\% parameter reduction remains slower than the dense baseline under ordinary execution. These results motivate a stricter definition of useful sparsity: the deployed operator must preserve solution accuracy and map its reduced support to a genuinely cheaper execution path.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了稀疏傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的多个稀疏化维度，发现表示稀疏、参数稀疏、理论计算量减少与实际运行时间减少之间并不等价。通过在粗网格上执行可降低理论成本但不减少延迟，添加校正项恢复精度却使模型更慢，即使83%的参数削减在常规执行下仍比稠密基线慢。
AI.motivation: 稀疏表示通常被期望同时实现模型更小和推理成本更低，但对于FNO而言，这两者并不总是对齐：移除算子部分可能不改变底层变换和稠密计算，而改变执行网格可能引入额外开销。因此需要区分不同层面的稀疏性并逐一验证其实际收益。
AI.method: 作者将稀疏性区分为四个维度：表示稀疏、存储参数稀疏、理论操作数稀疏、实测运行时间稀疏，并针对FNO逐一测试这些维度之间的转换关系。具体路线包括：在执行网格上粗化以降低理论成本，以及添加校正项以恢复精度。
AI.result: 粗化执行网格降低了理论计算成本但未减少实测延迟；添加校正项恢复了精度但使模型变慢；甚至83%的参数削减在常规执行下仍慢于稠密基线。
AI.conclusion: 提出了"有用稀疏性"的更严格定义：部署的算子必须同时保持解的精度，并将缩减的支持映射到真正更廉价的执行路径上。

title: R$^2$A: Learning Persona Policies Through Persona Representation Learning and Runtime Alignment
summary: The same Persona behavior can be beneficial in one context but harmful in another, causing static Persona elicitation to perform inconsistently across tasks. We introduce the Persona Selection--Realization Framework, which models behavior generation through a latent Persona state and decomposes it into Persona Selection and Persona Realization. The discrepancies between static Persona elicitation and an ideal Persona policy in these two components define the Selection Gap and Realization Gap, respectively. Building on this framework, we propose R$^2$A, a two-stage approach for learning Persona policies. Persona Representation Learning uses structured Who--How--What presentations to encode the target Persona's objective, conditional behavioral principles, and trajectory-level manifestations. Persona Runtime Alignment then removes the explicit Persona specification and jointly calibrates behavior selection and trajectory realization using task feedback. Across 12 evaluation settings covering the four principles of the Accountable-Professional Persona studied in this work, R$^2$A overall outperforms both the base model and static Persona elicitation. Ablation results further show that Persona Representation Learning is critical for preventing Runtime Alignment from producing behaviorally imbalanced policies and for achieving more stable Persona policy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Persona选择-实现框架（Persona Selection--Realization Framework），将行为生成建模为潜在Persona状态，分解为Persona选择与Persona实现两个环节。基于该框架提出R²A两阶段方法：Persona表示学习（使用Who--How--What结构化表征编码目标Persona）和Persona运行时对齐（移除显式Persona规范，通过任务反馈联合校准行为选择与轨迹实现）。在12个评估设置中，R²A整体优于基线和静态Persona引导方法。
AI.motivation: 同一Persona行为在不同上下文中可能有利也可能有害，导致静态Persona引导在不同任务上表现不一致。现有方法缺乏对Persona生成过程的系统建模，无法动态适应任务需求。
AI.method: 提出Persona Selection--Realization Framework，通过潜在Persona状态将行为生成分解为Persona选择（Selection）和Persona实现（Realization）两个组件，并据此定义Selection Gap和Realization Gap。R²A包含两个阶段：1) Persona Representation Learning——使用Who--How--What结构化呈现编码目标Persona的目标、条件行为原则和轨迹级表现；2) Persona Runtime Alignment——去除显式Persona规范，利用任务反馈联合校准行为选择和轨迹实现。
AI.result: 在覆盖Accountable-Professional Persona四个原则的12个评估设置中，R²A整体优于基线和静态Persona引导。消融实验显示Persona Representation Learning对防止Runtime Alignment产生行为失衡策略和实现更稳定的Persona策略学习至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 将Persona生成分解为选择与实现两个环节，并通过两阶段学习（先学表示、再运行时对齐）可以有效提升跨任务的Persona策略性能，其中表示学习阶段是稳定性和行为平衡性的关键保障。

title: LiteSearch-VL: Small Multimodal Search Agents via Trajectory Distillation and Synthetic Step-DPO
summary: Multimodal search agents answer visual questions by interleaving image understanding, web retrieval, tool use, and evidence synthesis. Strong systems exist, but in two expensive regimes: proprietary frontier models such as GPT-5 and Gemini, or large open vision-language backbones trained with substantial agentic data and reinforcement learning. We ask a different question: when released agent trajectories are distilled into much smaller backbones under a single-node budget, what is actually transferred? We study this with LiteSearch-VL, a low-compute recipe for Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B that uses only released OpenSearch-VL trajectories, parameter-efficient LoRA adapters, and synthetic step-level preferences: DPO on GPT-5-generated hard negatives targeting five local failure modes (premature answer, wrong tool, weak query, repeated query, ignored image). Across 12,400 GPT-5-judged rollouts on SimpleVQA, FVQA, LiveVQA, and VDR-Bench-testmini, the dominant effect is behavioral rather than a uniform accuracy lift: full-trajectory supervised fine-tuning transfers the agent contract, taking the 2B model from almost never emitting a usable answer (1,237/1,240 no_answer rollouts) to 28.4% macro Pass@1, matching or slightly exceeding the off-the-shelf 4B base (25.6%). Synthetic preference learning and compact tool distillation act as refinements rather than phase transitions (best 4B configuration: 30.8% macro Pass@1). Finally, a controlled VDR step-budget ablation shows that extra search turns convert abstentions into wrong_entity errors rather than correct answers, identifying answer verification, not search depth, as the next bottleneck for small multimodal agents.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将大型多模态搜索智能体（如GPT-5、Gemini）的轨迹蒸馏到小型模型（Qwen3-VL-2B/4B）时的转移效应。作者提出LiteSearch-VL低计算方案，仅使用公开的OpenSearch-VL轨迹、LoRA适配器和基于GPT-5生成硬负样本的合成步骤级偏好（DPO）训练。实验表明主要效果是行为层面的转变（让2B模型从不输出可用答案变为28.4% Pass@1），而非均匀的准确率提升；额外的搜索轮次将弃答转化为错误实体错误而非正确答案，验证瓶颈在于答案验证而非搜索深度。
AI.motivation: 现有强大的多模态搜索智能体依赖昂贵的专有前沿模型或需要大量智能体数据训练的大规模开源模型。作者想探索一个不同问题：在单节点预算下，将已发布的智能体轨迹蒸馏到更小的骨干模型时，究竟转移了什么能力？这有助于理解小模型智能体的能力边界与瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出LiteSearch-VL低计算训练方案，基于Qwen3-VL-2B和Qwen3-VL-4B：1）仅使用公开的OpenSearch-VL轨迹进行全轨迹监督微调；2）使用参数高效的LoRA适配器；3）利用GPT-5生成的硬负样本进行合成步骤级偏好优化（DPO），针对五种局部失败模式（过早作答、错误工具、弱查询、重复查询、忽略图像）进行训练；4）控制VDR步骤预算消融实验。
AI.result: 在12,400个GPT-5评估的rollout上（SimpleVQA、FVQA、LiveVQA、VDR-Bench-testmini），全轨迹SFT将2B模型从几乎不输出可用答案（1,237/1,240无答案rollout）提升至28.4%宏观Pass@1，匹配或略超未微调的4B基线（25.6%）。合成偏好学习和工具蒸馏作为精化手段而非质变（最佳4B配置达30.8%）。VDR消融显示额外搜索轮次将弃答转化为错误实体错误。
AI.conclusion: 小模型智能体蒸馏的主要收益是行为契约的转移（学会输出结构化的可评估答案流程），而非均匀的能力提升。对于小规模多模态搜索智能体，下一个关键瓶颈是答案验证而非搜索深度——增加搜索轮次只会把不确定转为错误实体，需要更好的验证/反思机制。

title: Tracing Generated Samples to Training-Data Clusters in Flow-Matching Models
summary:
Understanding which training samples influence a generated image is an important problem in generative modeling. In flow matching, training samples influence the generated image through the velocity field along the generation trajectory. Removing samples to examine their counterfactual influence changes the velocity field, and the resulting effect on the final image depends on how the change propagates through the trajectory. Consequently, local changes in the velocity field do not necessarily predict the final counterfactual effect.
  This work investigates attribution in flow-matching models through a hybrid analytical--learned approach, and uses it to derive trajectory-based attribution scores at the cluster level. We evaluate these attribution scores using independently retrained leave-one-cluster-out (LOO) models, and compare with several attribution baselines using two different flow-matching latent spaces. Our experiments show that semantic similarity constitutes a strong baseline, while the closed-form trajectory-based attribution is competitive in some metrics without requiring counterfactual retraining or model gradients.
  Our results show that attribution in flow matching depends not only on semantic similarity to training samples, but also on the latent representation, trajectory dynamics, and how influence is propagated to the final output.

AI.tldr: 本文研究流匹配（flow matching）生成模型中的训练样本归因问题，提出了一种混合分析-学习的方法来推导基于轨迹（trajectory-based）的簇级归因分数，并通过独立重训练的留一簇（LOO）模型进行评估。
AI.motivation: 理解哪些训练样本影响生成图像是生成建模中的重要问题。在流匹配中，训练样本通过生成轨迹上的速度场影响生成结果，局部的速度场变化并不一定能预测最终的对抗性效果，因此需要更全面的归因方法。
AI.method: 提出一种混合分析-学习（hybrid analytical-learned）的归因方法，从速度场沿轨迹传播的角度推导簇级归因分数，并与多种基线方法在两种流匹配潜空间中进行比较。
AI.result: 实验发现：语义相似性是一个强基线条；封闭形式的轨迹归因在某些指标上具有竞争力，且无需对抗性重训练或模型梯度；归因不仅依赖于语义相似性，还取决于潜空间表示、轨迹动力学及影响的传播方式。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配中的归因是一个复杂问题，仅靠语义相似性不足够，需要考虑潜空间、轨迹动态和影响传播等多方面因素。轨迹基归因方法在无需重训练的情况下能取得有竞争力的表现。

title: A^2Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents
summary: Localizing issue-relevant code regions is a critical step in automated software engineering. However, due to their reliance on sparse trajectory-level signals, existing methods cannot identify which per-turn actions are effective and often discover correct code regions during exploration but fail to commit them. To address these limitations, we propose an action-aware reinforcement learning method that combines a per-turn reward sequence rewarding both the discovery and commitment of gold code regions with an action-level advantage estimation scheme that isolates each action's credit by grouping turns sharing the same exploration context. Extensive evaluations show that our method improves the average F1 over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 1.58% on SWE-Bench Verified and 8.55% on SWE-Bench Pro, with our 4B model outperforming baselines up to 8x larger. Our code is available at https://github.com/donian00/A2Agent.

AI.tldr: 提出一种动作感知的强化学习方法（A2Agent），通过逐轮奖励序列和动作级优势估计来解决代码定位中探索正确区域但无法提交的问题，在SWE-Bench上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖稀疏的轨迹级信号，无法识别哪些逐轮动作是有效的，常常在探索过程中发现了正确的代码区域却未能将其提交。
AI.method: 结合逐轮奖励序列（同时奖励金子代码区域的发现和提交）与动作级优势估计方案（通过分组共享相同探索上下文的轮次来隔离每个动作的贡献）。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Verified上平均F1提升1.58%，在SWE-Bench Pro上提升8.55%，4B模型的表现优于高达8倍规模的基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 动作感知的强化学习能够更细粒度地定位有效动作，显著提升代码区域定位的精确性与提交成功率。

title: TRACER: Per-Tool Context Retention for LLM Agents via Consequence-Attributed Reinforcement Learning
summary: Enterprise data agents answer business queries by chaining many tool calls over multiple reasoning steps, routinely accumulating hundreds of thousands of context tokens per session. Existing compression strategies typically allocate retention budgets without accounting for the downstream consequences of removing individual tool outputs. Aggressive compression may therefore trigger costly tool re-invocations that offset the initial savings. We call this the compression--consequence gap. To close it, we propose TRACER, which formulates compression as a sequential per-tool decision problem. A lightweight REINFORCE policy assigns query-conditioned retention ratios using only information available at each compression event. Its consequence-aware objective jointly accounts for task success, total token consumption, and post-compression tool re-invocations. To improve credit assignment, TRACER uses a learned outcome model to compare the predicted consequences of the selected retention ratio with those of fully retaining each tool output. On held-out production queries across three compressor backends, TRACER reduces total token consumption by 29--46% relative to keeping all context while maintaining comparable or higher task success. Compared with a tool-type-conditional static policy, TRACER provides an additional 15--18% of token savings. Interventional rollouts show that the learned per-tool credit scores correlate with measured single-tool consequences. The learned policy also yields positive savings when transferred across agent backbones and compressor architectures, and reduces token consumption by 18--25% on five held-out LOCA-bench environments. These results demonstrate the value of consequence-aware, per-tool context retention for improving the efficiency of long-horizon language agents.

AI.tldr: TRACER 提出了一种基于后果感知的逐工具上下文压缩策略，通过强化学习为每个工具输出分配查询条件化的保留比例，同时考虑任务成功率和工具重新调用代价，在多种场景下实现29-46%的token节省。
AI.motivation: 企业数据代理在处理长链条工具调用时会积累大量上下文token，现有压缩策略不考虑删除单个工具输出带来的下游后果（如昂贵的工具重新调用），导致压缩节省被抵消，形成"压缩-后果差距"。
AI.method: TRACER将压缩建模为逐工具的序列决策问题：使用轻量级REINFORCE策略，根据每个压缩事件可用的信息为每个工具输出分配保留比例；目标函数联合考虑任务成功、总token消耗和压缩后的工具重新调用；采用学习到的结果模型来比较所选保留比例与完全保留每个工具输出的预测后果，以改善信用分配。
AI.result: 在三个压缩后端的生产查询中，相比保留全部上下文，TRACER减少29-46%的token消耗，同时维持相当或更高的任务成功率；相比工具类型条件静态策略，额外节省15-18%的token；跨代理骨干和压缩器架构迁移时仍产生正收益；在五个LOCA-bench环境中减少18-25%的token消耗。
AI.conclusion: 后果感知的逐工具上下文保留能有效提升长时域语言代理的效率，学习到的逐工具信用评分与实际单工具后果相关，验证了该方法的有效性和可迁移性。

title: A Lightweight Phenology-Aware YOLOv5 Framework for Tomato Growth Stage Detection in Resource-Constrained Bhutanese Greenhouse Environments
summary: Accurate detection of tomato growth stages is essential for stage-specific greenhouse management and precision agriculture. In Bhutan, greenhouse cultivation is affected by altitude variability, large diurnal temperature fluctuations, diffuse illumination, limited automation, and a scarcity of locally annotated datasets, limiting the applicability of conventional deep learning models. This work proposes Pheno-Lite + Efficient Channel Attention (ECA), a lightweight, phenology-aware object detection architecture derived from Ultralytics YOLOv5 for tomato growth stage recognition. A balanced dataset of 2,464 annotated images was constructed from locally collected greenhouse images in Bhutan and publicly available tomato images, with augmentation designed to simulate local greenhouse conditions. The dataset includes vegetative (820), flowering (824), fruiting (820), and background (26) samples. The proposed architecture introduces two customized backbone modules: C3 PhenoLite, which enhances spatial and texture feature extraction using depthwise residual refinement, and C3 ECA, which strengthens inter-channel feature interactions through efficient channel attention. The proposed model achieves 90.6% precision, 88.8% recall, and 92.6% mAP@50, with 4.0 million parameters and 10.9 GFLOPs at 640 x 640 resolution. These results demonstrate its potential for real-time and climate-resilient greenhouse deployment in Bhutan.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pheno-Lite + ECA，一种基于YOLOv5的轻量级番茄生长阶段检测模型，在尼泊尔温室复杂环境下实现90.6%精度和92.6% mAP@50。
AI.motivation: 准确检测番茄生长阶段对温室精准管理至关重要，但不丹温室环境受海拔变化、昼夜温差、散射光照和缺乏本地标注数据等限制，传统深度学习模型难以适用。
AI.method: 构建含2,464张标注图像（营养期820、开花期824、结果期820、背景26）的平衡数据集，并设计增强模拟本地温室条件。提出两种定制骨干模块：C3 PhenoLite（深度可分离残差精化增强空间和纹理特征）和C3 ECA（高效通道注意力强化跨通道特征交互）。
AI.result: 模型达到90.6%精确率、88.8%召回率和92.6% mAP@50，仅4.0M参数和10.9 GFLOPs计算量（640×640分辨率）。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量级模型具备在不丹温室环境中实时部署和气候适应性的潜力。

title: You Know What I Mean: A Benchmark for Agentic Conversational Reference Grounding
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Collaborative conversations frequently contain references whose targets are indirect rather than named: resolving "this looks like the fix discussed yesterday" requires combining conversational context with evidence from the surrounding workspace which is accessible through APIs or user interfaces. We formalize this problem as Conversational Reference Grounding (CoRG): using a given set of tools to resolve a reference in conversation to the unique external item intended by the speaker. CoRG is challenging because it combines lexical, semantic, and temporal cues distributed across the conversation and the external workspace. Agents must translate these heterogeneous signals into effective tool use: formulating strategies, discovering plausible candidates, inspecting their metadata and content, and ruling out close alternatives. We study CoRG through RepoRef, a benchmark of 400 developer-chat segments grounded in GitHub issues, pull requests, and commits across 92 repositories. Unlike single-shot retrieval tasks, RepoRef often requires multi-step tool use. Our results show that CoRG remains challenging for current agents, even the best agent reaches only 67.0% success rate, leaving one third of references unresolved. These findings position CoRG as a concrete benchmark for studying how agents search, inspect, and verify information in realistic multi-tool environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"会话引用定位"(CoRG)问题——通过工具集解析对话中指向外部工作区条目的间接引用，并构建RepoRef基准（包含92个仓库中400个开发者聊天片段，锚定于GitHub issue、PR和commit）进行评测。结果显示即使最佳智能体成功率仅67.0%，表明该任务对当前AI代理仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 协作对话中经常包含指向未点名目标的间接引用（如"昨天讨论的修复方案"），解析这类引用需要结合对话上下文和通过API/UI可访问的工作区证据。这个问题此前未被系统形式化和评测。
AI.method: ①形式化定义CoRG问题，即使用给定工具集将对话中的引用解析为用户意图的唯一外部条目。②构建RepoRef基准数据集，包含92个GitHub仓库中400个开发者聊天片段，锚定于issue、PR和commit。③与单次检索任务不同，RepoRef设计为需要多步工具使用（制定策略、发现候选、检查元数据与内容、排除近似替代）。
AI.result: 最佳智能体在RepoRef上仅达到67.0%的成功率，仍有三分之一的引用无法被解析，表明CoRG对当前AI代理而言仍具显著挑战性。
AI.conclusion: CoRG为研究智能体在真实多工具环境中如何搜索、检查和验证信息提供了具体基准，同时揭示了当前代理在处理结合对话与外部工作区证据的间接引用方面的不足。

title: Reviving our data foundations is the most disruptive step to data maturity
summary: The most disruptive step that enterprises of small-medium size and maturity can take to make the most of the latest technological advances in AI is to step back from the hype and focus on establishing or reviving a good knowledge foundation layer. It is a hard message to present to the executive team; therefore, it needs to be backed by evidence, and its implementation needs to be of minimal impact on the existing processes. In this vision statement, we discuss how we need to rethink what evidence speaks to the decision-makers and propose a low-impact data strategy that adapts to the existing and ever-changing data flows and processes across the company. We firmly believe that knowledge graph techniques will increasingly become non-negotiable in the data strategy of an AI-powered enterprise, provided that we approach their design in a modular, dynamic and cross-functional way.

AI.tldr: 本文提出中小企业成熟度不高时，应摒弃AI炒作，优先建立或恢复良好的知识基础层；并提出一种低影响、适应现有数据流的数据策略，强调知识图谱技术将成为AI驱动企业数据战略中不可或缺的部分。
AI.motivation: 中小企业面临AI技术浪潮的诱惑，但直接追逐最新AI进展往往是破坏性的。作者希望说服管理层回归知识基础建设，但需要强有力的证据支撑，并且实施过程必须对现有流程影响最小。
AI.method: 本文是一篇愿景声明（vision statement），讨论了如何重新思考面向决策者的证据呈现方式，并提出一种低影响数据策略——该策略能适应公司现有且不断变化的数据流和流程，主张以模块化、动态和跨职能的方式设计知识图谱。
AI.result: 作者提出知识图谱技术将越来越成为AI驱动企业数据战略中的"不可谈判"要素，前提是采用模块化、动态且跨职能的设计方法。
AI.conclusion: 中小企业应暂缓AI炒作，优先夯实知识基础层；知识图谱是实现这一目标的核心理念，但需要以低影响、适应性的方式落地执行。

title: SMOTE-VAR: An Uncertainty-Aware Oversampling Method for Predicting Depression Remission in University Students
summary: University students experience disproportionately high rates of common mental health conditions, such as depression, which can impair learning, social functioning, and overall well-being. Although lifestyle interventions such as mindfulness and physical activity can reduce the symptoms, many do not achieve symptomatic remission. Developing new approaches to identify students with poor outcomes could enable earlier and more targeted intervention. Machine learning (ML) methods have increasingly been used to predict remission in depressive patients. However, these ML models often suffer from class imbalance, where there may be an unequal proportion of people in the remitted group relative to the non-remitted group. This imbalance can reduce model accuracy and bias predictions. To address this, studies commonly employ the popular oversampling strategy SMOTE. However, SMOTE has a notable limitation: it may generate invalid synthetic minority samples. In a clinical context, these false positives can lead to incorrect risk stratification, potentially delaying necessary escalated care for patients unlikely to remit. In this paper, we introduce a novel and effective oversampling method that addresses this shortcoming. Our approach leverages the variance function of a Gaussian process to estimate the uncertainty of generated minority samples to reduce false positives. We validate our method on a depression dataset collected from university students and demonstrate that it is better than existing oversampling approaches in predicting remission (i.e., treatment outcome). By improving the reliable identification of non-responders, our method provides a robust computational tool to help clinicians rapidly pivot to adjunctive therapies, thereby personalizing and optimizing mental health care pathways.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于高斯过程方差函数的新型过采样方法，用于解决机器学习预测大学生抑郁症康复结果时的类别不平衡问题，通过减少SMOTE产生的无效合成少数类样本（假阳性）来提高预测准确性，帮助临床医生更可靠地识别非缓解者。
AI.motivation: 大学生群体中抑郁症等常见心理健康问题高发，虽然正念和体育活动等生活方式干预可减轻症状，但许多人未能达到症状缓解。虽然机器学习已被用于预测抑郁患者的康复，但这些模型常面临类别不平衡问题，导致模型准确性下降和预测偏差。常用的SMOTE过采样方法可能生成无效的合成少数类样本，在临床情境中这些假阳性会导致错误的风险分层，可能延误对不太可能康复患者所需的升级护理。
AI.method: 本文引入一种新颖且有效的过采样方法，利用高斯过程的方差函数来估计生成的少数类样本的不确定性，从而减少假阳性样本的生成，克服SMOTE方法的局限性。
AI.result: 在从大学生中收集的抑郁症数据集上验证了该方法，证明其在预测康复（治疗结果）方面优于现有的过采样方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过提高对非响应者的可靠识别，该方法为临床医生提供了一种稳健的计算工具，帮助其快速转向辅助治疗，从而实现个性化并优化心理健康护理路径。

title: EVAR: Evidence-Validated Hypothesis Admission for Budget-Aware Narrative Reasoning
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 3 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but weakly grounded conclusions when reasoning over non-interactive, long-form narratives. A central failure mode is that unsupported intermediate hypotheses can enter the reasoning trajectory and contaminate subsequent inference, especially when evidence is scattered across distant parts of the story. To address this problem, we propose EVAR, an evidence-validated hypothesis admission framework for budget-aware narrative reasoning. EVAR first compiles the narrative into an immutable evidence store of source-linked atomic claims and assigns an instance-specific inference budget from unresolved gaps and uncertainty signals. During refinement, EVAR directly proposes candidate hypotheses for unresolved gaps, constructs hypothesis-conditioned validation challenges, and verifies each candidate against the locked store before admission: supported hypotheses enter the answer-supporting state, unverifiable ones are quarantined, and contradictory ones are discarded. A sufficiency-based stopping mechanism further avoids unnecessary refinement. Experiments on NarraCrime and multiple public reasoning benchmarks show that EVAR improves both task performance and evidence faithfulness while maintaining controllable inference cost.

AI.tldr: EVAR是一个证据验证的假设准入框架，用于预算感知的叙述性推理。它将叙述编译为不可变的证据库，在推理过程中对候选假设进行验证后才准入，被支持的假设进入答案支持状态，不可验证的被隔离，矛盾的被丢弃，并通过充分性停止机制控制推理成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长叙述推理中经常产生流畅但证据不足的结论，核心失败模式是不受支持的中间假设进入推理轨迹并污染后续推理，尤其是当证据分散在故事的不同部分时。
AI.method: 1) 将叙述编译为源链接原子声明组成的不可变证据库；2) 从未解决缺口和不确定性信号中分配实例特定的推理预算；3) 直接为未解决缺口提出候选假设；4) 构建假设条件验证挑战，对每个候选假设对照锁定证据库验证：支持的进入答案支持状态，不可验证的隔离，矛盾的丢弃；5) 基于充分性的停止机制避免不必要的细化。
AI.result: 在NarraCrime和多个公开推理基准上的实验表明，EVAR同时提升了任务性能和证据忠实度，同时保持可控的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过严格的假设准入机制和预算控制，EVAR有效解决了LLM在长叙述推理中假设污染问题，实现了性能、证据忠实度与推理成本的平衡。

title: FORESIGHT-9: Prospective and Process-Aware Evaluation of Adaptive Trading Agents
summary: Retrospective backtests provide a limited test of adaptive trading agents: they cannot rule out historical contamination, expose sensitivity to a single realized market path, or reveal internal degeneration during long-horizon adaptation. We introduce FORESIGHT-9, a prospective and process-aware benchmark built from nine auditable counterfactual stress worldlines branching from a common July 2026 information boundary. Each worldline specifies staged macro-financial events and joint multi-asset anchors; a deterministic generator realizes the trajectories, while observations are disclosed according to in-world time. A common contract standardizes observations and execution while preserving each agent's native adaptation loop. We evaluate two adaptive trading-agent frameworks with two foundation-model backbones across 36 long-horizon runs. Agent rankings vary substantially across worldlines and backbones, and a fixed equal-weight policy outperforms 31 of 36 runs. Process telemetry exposes failures that terminal returns conceal: in one high-return run, the live factor library collapsed while executed holdings converged to the equal-weight fallback, even though decision records continued to report an active factor ensemble. FORESIGHT-9 therefore evaluates not only portfolio outcomes, but whether adaptive agent state and execution remain coherent across alternative futures. We release the worldlines, trajectories, audit traces, and regeneration scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FORESIGHT-9，一个前瞻性、过程感知的自适应交易智能体基准。它从2026年7月的共同信息边界出发，构建九条可审计的反事实压力世界线，通过确定性生成器实现多资产轨迹，并以世界内时间披露观测。实验表明智能体排名随世界线和骨干模型变化显著，固定等权策略优于36次运行中的31次；过程遥测揭示了高收益运行中因子库崩溃但决策记录仍报告活跃因子集合的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 传统的回溯测试无法充分评估自适应交易智能体，存在三个关键局限：无法排除历史污染、对单一实现市场路径过度敏感、无法揭示长期适应过程中的内部退化。这促使需要一种前瞻性且过程感知的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建FORESIGHT-9基准：从共同2026年7月信息边界分支九条反事实压力世界线；每条世界线规定阶段性宏观金融事件和联合多资产锚点；确定性生成器实现轨迹，观测按世界内时间披露；通用合约标准化观测与执行，同时保留智能体原生自适应循环。在两个自适应交易框架和两个基础模型骨干上进行了36次长时域运行评估，并利用过程遥测分析智能体内部状态。
AI.result: 智能体排名在不同世界线和骨干模型间差异显著；固定等权策略在36次运行中胜过31次；过程遥测揭示终端收益掩盖的失败——某个高收益运行中，实时因子库已崩溃，执行持仓收敛到等权回退方案，但决策记录仍报告活跃因子集成。
AI.conclusion: FORESIGHT-9不仅评估投资组合结果，还评估自适应智能体状态与执行在替代未来中是否保持一致。该基准为交易智能体提供了比回溯测试更全面的过程级评估框架，并发布世界线、轨迹、审计轨迹和再生成脚本以供复现。

title: Graph4BiLO: Graph Neural Network Approximation for Bilevel Mixed-Integer Linear Optimization
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Bilevel mixed-integer linear optimization problems model hierarchical decision processes in which a leader anticipates the optimal response of a follower. Although expressive, these problems are computationally challenging because lower-level optimality is embedded in the leader's feasible region. Value-function reformulations replace the nested follower optimization with a constraint involving the follower's optimal value, but evaluating this value function exactly can itself be expensive. This paper introduces Graph4BiLO, a graph neural network (GNN) approach for learning bilevel value functions from variable--constraint graph representations. In contrast to fixed-length multilayer perceptron (MLP) representations, the GNN uses shared message-passing parameters and can therefore be applied across multiple problem sizes with a single trained model. The learned ReLU network is encoded exactly as mixed-integer linear constraints and embedded in an approximate single-level formulation. A repair step subsequently re-solves the follower problem for the selected leader decision to recover a bilevel-feasible follower response. We evaluate Graph4BiLO on knapsack interdiction instances with 20--100 items against the exact MibS solver and the learning-based Neur2BiLO method. Graph4BiLO obtains objective values comparable to Neur2BiLO across all tested sizes while avoiding size-specific neural networks. An additional out-of-distribution experiment demonstrates zero-shot transfer from 20-item training instances to previously unseen 40- and 60-item instances. However, embedding message passing at every graph node substantially increases the resulting mixed-integer formulation size and solve time. These results identify a central tradeoff between size-generalizable graph representations and the computational cost of embedding GNNs within optimization models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graph4BiLO，一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的二层整数线性优化值函数学习方法。与固定长度的MLP表示不同，GNN利用共享消息传递参数，可用单一模型处理多种问题规模。学习到的ReLU网络被精确编码为混合整数线性约束，嵌入近似单层公式中，并通过修复步骤恢复可行解。在20-100项的背包拦截实例上，Graph4BiLO获得了与Neur2BiLO相当的目标值，同时避免了对规模特定的神经网络需求，并展示了从20项到40/60项实例的零样本迁移能力。然而，GNN嵌入导致混合整数公式规模和求解时间大幅增加，揭示了规模泛化图表示与嵌入计算成本之间的核心权衡。
AI.motivation: 二层混合整数线性优化问题在领导者的可行域中嵌入了跟随者的最优性条件，计算上极具挑战性。值函数重构将嵌套的跟随者优化替换为涉及跟随者最优值的约束，但精确评估该值函数本身代价高昂。现有学习方法如MLP表示受限于固定长度输入，无法跨问题规模泛化，因此需要一种能够处理不同规模问题的值函数学习方法。
AI.method: Graph4BiLO采用图神经网络从变量-约束图表示中学习二层值函数。GNN通过共享消息传递参数，使单个训练模型能够应用于多个问题规模。学习到的ReLU网络被精确编码为混合整数线性约束，嵌入到近似的单层优化公式中。随后通过修复步骤重新求解跟随者问题，恢复二层可行的跟随者响应。
AI.result: 在20-100项的背包拦截实例上，Graph4BiLO的目标值与Neur2BiLO相当，但无需针对不同规模训练不同的神经网络。额外的分布外实验展示了从20项训练实例到未见过的40项和60项实例的零样本迁移能力。然而，在图的每个节点嵌入消息传递显著增加了混合整数公式的规模和求解时间。
AI.conclusion: Graph4BiLO证明了基于GNN的值函数学习可以实现跨规模泛化，这是固定长度MLP方法无法做到的。研究揭示了规模泛化的图表示与嵌入GNN到优化模型中所产生的计算成本之间的核心权衡：虽然GNN带来了更好的泛化性，但嵌入开销也成为实际应用的重要瓶颈。

title: SkillForge: Compositional Skill Synthesis with Verification-in-the-Loop for Generating Formally Verified Dafny Programs
summary: Generating formally verified programs from natural language remains challenging: existing approaches either produce code in a single pass without recourse when verification fails, or rely on open-ended agentic reasoning that is non-deterministic and opaque. We introduce SKILLFORGE, a framework that decomposes formal code synthesis into a library of atomic, reusable skills, each targeting a specific subtask such as specification inference, body synthesis, invariant generation, error diagnosis, or targeted repair, and defined by a prompt template, tool binding, and decidable success criterion. A verification-driven harness orchestrates these skills: it submits candidates to the Dafny verifier, diagnoses failures into structured categories, deterministically routes to the appropriate repair skill, and iterates until formal correctness is proved or a budget is exhausted. On a curated benchmark of natural language to Dafny specification pairs, SKILLFORGE substantially outperforms both state-of-the-art agentic approaches (including ReAct-style agents, MCTS-based repair, and RL-guided verification) and traditional iterative baselines, while requiring fewer tokens and lower latency. Ablation studies confirm that every skill contributes measurably, and the harness converges rapidly with the majority of programs verified on the first attempt.

AI.tldr: SKILLFORGE是一个将自然语言到正式验证代码合成分解为原子、可复用技能库的框架，通过验证驱动的编排器（harness）确定性路由到合适的修复技能，并在Dafny验证器上迭代直到证明正确性或预算耗尽。在基准测试上显著优于现有方法，且更节省令牌和延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有从自然语言生成正式验证程序的方法存在两大问题：(1) 单次生成的代码在验证失败后没有后续补救机制；(2) 开放式的agentic推理方法非确定性且不透明。需要一个确定性、可解释且高效的框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: SKILLFORGE将形式化代码合成分解为原子且可复用的技能库，每个技能针对特定子任务（如规格推断、主体合成、不变量生成、错误诊断或定向修复），由提示模板、工具绑定和可判定成功标准定义。一个验证驱动的编排器负责：提交候选代码给Dafny验证器，将失败分类为结构化类别，确定性路由到适当的修复技能，并迭代直到形式正确性被证明或预算耗尽。
AI.result: 在自然语言到Dafny规格对的基准上，SKILLFORGE显著优于最先进的agentic方法（包括ReAct风格代理、基于MCTS的修复和RL引导的验证）以及传统迭代基线，同时需要更少的令牌和更低延迟。消融研究证实每个技能都有可测量的贡献，且编排器快速收敛，大多数程序在第一次尝试时就得以验证。
AI.conclusion: SKILLFORGE通过将验证失败诊断为结构化分类并确定性路由到专门的修复技能，实现了比开放式agentic方法更高效、更透明、更确定性的正式验证代码合成。

title: Evaluating Tiny Recursive Models Across Training for Code Generation
summary: Code generation increasingly relies on large transformer models, whose capability advances with scale. Yet such a scale is costly, creating demand for small models, especially where data is limited. Recursive models address this by reusing a single block to add depth rather than stacking independent layers. Such models are typically evaluated by teacher-forced fit (next-token loss on ground-truth prefixes) or task accuracy, at a single checkpoint, whereas code is produced by free-running generation, where the model extends its own output. Whether a teacher-forced advantage survives free-running generation, and whether it holds across training, remains open. To study both, we compare a ~28M-parameter autoregressive Tiny Recursive Model (TRM-AR) on natural-language-to-Python code generation against parameter-matched and depth-matched controls, tracking fit and generation across 40 epochs and three seeds. The fit ranking between the recursive model and the depth-matched control reverses twice. Selecting each checkpoint by validation loss and examining the trajectory yields a consistent comparison. At equal parameters, TRM-AR fits, generates, and generalizes better than the parameter-matched control while recovering approximately 45% of the validation-loss gap and 57% of the generation-quality gap between the two controls, at roughly 175 times the per-step cost of the parameter-matched control. However, at equal effective depth, the larger transformer fits and generates better at its validation optimum, suggesting TRM-AR's advantage lies in resistance to overfitting, not greater capability. These findings suggest that recursive code generation models should be evaluated jointly on fit and generation across the training trajectory rather than at a single checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了递归模型（TRM-AR）在自然语言到Python代码生成任务中的表现，通过对比参数匹配和深度匹配的Transformer控制模型，在40个epoch和多种随机种子下追踪训练轨迹，发现教师强制下的拟合优势不一定能延续到自由生成中，且评估应联合考虑拟合与生成质量并跨训练轨迹进行。
AI.motivation: 大型Transformer模型在代码生成上表现出色但成本高昂，小型模型需求迫切。递归模型通过复用单个模块增加深度来降低成本，但现有评估仅关注单检查点下的教师强制拟合或任务准确率，忽略了代码生成中自由运行生成（模型自主扩展输出）的实际情况，以及训练过程中的表现变化。
AI.method: 使用约2800万参数的Tiny Recursive Model (TRM-AR)进行自然语言到Python代码生成，与参数匹配和深度匹配的控制模型进行对比。在40个epoch和三个随机种子下，同时追踪拟合损失和自由生成质量，并按验证损失选择检查点分析训练轨迹。
AI.result: 递归模型与深度匹配控制模型之间的拟合排名在训练过程中发生了两次反转。在等参数下，TRM-AR在拟合、生成和泛化上均优于参数匹配控制模型，恢复了约45%的验证损失差距和57%的生成质量差距，但每步计算成本约为参数匹配模型的175倍。在等效深度下，更大的Transformer在验证最优值时表现更好，说明TRM-AR的优势在于抵抗过拟合而非更强的能力。
AI.conclusion: 递归代码生成模型的评估应联合考虑拟合和生成质量，并跨越整个训练轨迹，而非仅依赖单一检查点。递归模型的优势主要来自对过拟合的抵抗能力，而非模型本身更强的表达能力。

title: Supraglacial Lake Fate Is Knowable Long Before the Season Ends
summary: A supraglacial lake on the Greenland Ice Sheet ends its melt season in one of four ways: it drains rapidly through a hydrofracture, drains slowly across the surface, refreezes in place, or is buried by late-season snowfall. Which one occurs decides whether the meltwater reaches the ice bed. Satellite classifiers recover the outcome accurately but only after the season closes, and how much of a season each outcome actually requires has never been measured. We measure it directly: holding the representation and the classifier fixed, we truncate the input at $14$ cutoffs from 1 May to 31 December, retrain at each, and record the earliest cutoff at which each outcome's per-class $F_1$ reaches a fixed target. The outcomes resolve in a consistent order, two of them months early: rapid drainage by 15 July and slow drainage by 1 August, $92$ and $75$ days ahead of the earliest date a full-season pipeline can be computed at all, with buried and refreeze following at $44$ and $30$ days. Five further learners, from a majority-class floor and $54$ summary statistics to a trigger-based early classifier, leave the ordering intact: every learner that produces a per-class trajectory reproduces it despite end-of-season accuracies differing by up to $18$ percentage points, and it survives leave-one-basin-out evaluation, though not the substitution of machine labels for expert ones in an unseen season. Every feature we compute at day $t$ reads only days up to $t$, at a cost of at most $1.3$ percentage points. A monitoring system should therefore not have one release date: rapid drainage can be flagged on 15 July, three months before a full-season pipeline can be computed at all.

AI.tldr: 本文直接测量了格陵兰冰盖冰上湖泊四种季末结局（快速排水、缓慢排水、原地再冻结、被降雪掩埋）各自所需的观测时长。通过固定表征和分类器，在不同截断日期重新训练，发现四种结局以一致顺序提前分辨：快速排水7月15日、缓慢排水8月1日即可判定，分别比全季管道提前92和75天。该顺序在多种学习器和评估设置下保持稳健。
AI.motivation: 冰上湖泊的季末结局决定了融水是否到达冰床，影响冰川动力学。现有卫星分类器只能在季节结束后准确恢复结局，但每种结局实际需要多长的观测时间从未被直接测量过。
AI.method: 固定表征和分类器不变，将输入从5月1日到12月31日的14个截断日期逐步截断，在每个截断点重新训练，记录每种结局的每类F1达到固定目标的最早截断日期。用多种学习器（多数类基线、54个汇总统计、基于触发器的早期分类器）验证顺序稳健性，并进行留一盆地检验和标签替换检验。
AI.result: 四种结局以一致顺序分辨：快速排水7月15日（提前92天）、缓慢排水8月1日（提前75天）、被掩埋44天、再冻结30天。所有能产生每类轨迹的学习器都复现了该顺序，尽管季末准确率相差高达18个百分点。顺序在留一盆地评估中稳健，但用机器标签替换专家标签时不成立。每天计算的特征只读取截至当天的数据，代价最多1.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 监测系统不应只有一个发布日：快速排水可在7月15日标注，比全季管道可计算的时间早三个月。不同结局应有不同的预警时间窗口。

title: Influence-Directed Distillation: Solving the Diversity Bottleneck in Sampled-Token On-Policy Distillation
summary: Sampled-token on-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from teacher to student using student-generated tokens, requiring teacher probabilities only for sampled tokens. Yet it frequently suffers from diversity distillation failure: the student's pass@1 improves while its pass@$k$ plateaus, failing to inherit the teacher's diversity. To explain this, we introduce First-Order Local Entropy Influence, a signed first-order proxy that decouples each update's entropy effect into the teacher--student log-probability gap and the student's local probability structure, and empirically links entropy contraction to negative-influence positions. Motivated by this, we propose Influence-Directed Adaptive On-Policy Distillation (IDA-OPD): rather than relying on costly full-vocabulary Forward-KL objectives, it preserves entropy-expanding updates while replacing entropy-contracting ones with divergence-adaptive advantage shrinkage, using only the teacher's sampled-token log-probability. Experiments on reasoning-oriented distillation show IDA-OPD consistently improves pass@$k$, inheriting the teacher's diversity through distillation, matches the strongest teacher-informed methods at strictly lower cost, and broadly maintains vanilla OPD's pass@1, all without full-vocabulary teacher information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDA-OPD方法，解决采样token在线蒸馏（OPD）中存在的多样性蒸馏失败问题（pass@1提升但pass@k停滞）。通过引入一阶局部熵影响（First-Order Local Entropy Influence）作为代理指标，将每次更新的熵效应解耦为师生对数概率差和学生局部概率结构，识别导致熵收缩的更新位置，并有选择性地保留熵扩张更新、用发散自适应优势缩缩减替换熵收缩更新，从而在仅用教师采样token对数概率的条件下恢复多样性继承。
AI.motivation: OPD虽然高效（只需采样token的教师概率），但存在多样性蒸馏失败的问题：学生pass@1提升但pass@k停滞，未能继承教师的输出多样性。作者希望通过理论分析和方法设计来解决这一关键缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 提出First-Order Local Entropy Influence，一个有符号的一阶代理指标，将每次更新的熵效应解耦为师生log-prob差距和学生局部概率结构；2) 通过实证将熵收缩与负影响位置关联；3) 提出IDA-OPD：保留熵扩张更新，用发散自适应优势缩缩减替换熵收缩更新，仅需教师采样token的对数概率。
AI.result: 在推理导向的蒸馏实验中，IDA-OPD一致提升pass@k，成功继承教师多样性；在更低成本下匹配最强教师知情方法的表现；广泛保持vanilla OPD的pass@1水平，且无需全词汇表教师信息。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析揭示OPD多样性失败机制，并设计了仅依赖采样token信息的轻量级解决方案，在多样性继承和效率之间取得良好平衡。

title: EvoGenUI-Bench: Evaluating LLMs as Multi-Turn Generative UI Assistants
summary: Large language models can generate interactive web interfaces, but reliable generative UI requires maintaining an executable artifact as user requests evolve. We introduce EvoGenUI-Bench, a benchmark for multi-turn interface maintenance comprising 150 five-turn tasks and 750 turns across three scenarios: information presentation, executable interaction, and tool-grounded external state. We execute generated artifacts in a browser and evaluate them using screenshots, source and DOM evidence, actor traces, and runtime logs. Beyond turn-level and episode-level success, we measure cross-turn retention with Adjacent Pass Retention. Across eight models, even the strongest achieves 74.9% Turn Pass while completing only 37.3% of five-turn episodes; APR further falls to 52.4% on tool-grounded tasks. Diagnostic analysis shows that presentation failures center on information architecture, interaction failures on derived-state propagation and affordance binding, and tool-grounded failures additionally involve external-state grounding and requirement decomposition. These results reframe generative UI evaluation from judging isolated outputs to testing whether interface behavior, derived state, external state, and assistant claims remain synchronized as the artifact evolves.

AI.tldr: 提出了EvoGenUI-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型在多轮交互中维护可执行Web界面的能力，涵盖三类场景共150个五轮任务。通过浏览器执行生成物并进行多维评估，发现即使最强模型也只能完成37.3%的五轮任务，揭示了界面演化中各类状态同步的核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可以生成交互式Web界面，但可靠生成式UI需要随着用户请求的演化维护一个可执行工件。现有评估通常聚焦于单次输出，缺乏对多轮界面维护能力的系统评测。
