In this work, we theoretically show that directly leveraging PRM score is vulnerable to verifier noise through an extreme-value effect: non-viable prefixes become more likely to receive spuriously high scores as reasoning depth increase. Therefore, we formulate the PRM-guided search as a robust optimization problem over plausible reward perturbations, termed maximin PRM-guided search, leading to a training-free robust process supervision method that preserves promising alternatives when step-level scores are noisy. Maximin PRM-guided search mitigates this failure mode by reducing sensitivity to over-optimized PRM outliers. Without fine-tuning or online adaptation, maximin search consistently improves the PRM-guided search by 17-35\% on average, outperforming outcome- and step-level baselines in 14 out of 16 settings. Our source code is available at https://github.com/tjoo512/maximin-search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为maximin PRM-guided search的训练免费方法，通过将过程奖励模型（PRM）引导的搜索公式化为对奖励扰动的鲁棒优化问题，来减轻PRM分数噪声导致的过度优化问题，在14/16设置中优于基线，平均提升17-35%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明PRM引导的搜索会过度优化不完美的过程奖励，剪除可行轨迹而扩展虚假轨迹。作者从理论上证明直接利用PRM分数容易受到验证器噪声的影响，存在极值效应：随着推理深度增加，不可行前缀更可能获得虚假高分。
AI.method: 将PRM引导搜索公式化为对合理奖励扰动的鲁棒优化问题（maximin优化），即在最坏情况扰动下最大化最坏情况奖励，从而降低对过度优化PRM离群值的敏感性。该方法无需微调或在线适应。
AI.result: 在16个设置中，maximin搜索在14个设置中优于结果级和步骤级基线，平均提升17-35%。
AI.conclusion: 通过鲁棒优化视角，maximin PRM-guided search有效解决了PRM噪声导致的过度优化问题，且无需额外训练成本，是一种实用且有效的推理时过程监督方法。

title: Locally-Guided Actor-Critic: Training a Goal-conditioned Actor with a Subgoal-aware Critic
summary: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning struggles with long horizons when rewards are sparse. While a planner can provide subgoals to guide a low-level policy, its use at test time may introduce practical subgoal management difficulties. An alternative paradigm utilizes a high-level planner to assist learning, while the policy remains conditioned only on the final goal, enabling planner-free deployment. Among these methods, Reinforcement Learning with Imagined Subgoals (RIS) introduces a regularization term that encourages the policy to take the same actions for the final goal as it does for an intermediate goal. This regularization, however, may lead to goal-chaining issues when intermediate goals are low-dimensional. Potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) translates plans into an additional reward while ensuring that the optimal policy remains unchanged. Yet, it can generate deceptive rewards in terminal states. We study these failure cases and first propose an alternative reward shaping method (RS) that removes these deceptive rewards at the expense of theoretical guarantees of PBRS. Similar to this RS variant, we then propose another method named Locally-Guided Actor Critic (LG-AC) that rewards the agent for reaching intermediate goals. Unlike RS, where intermediate rewards are implicit in the shaping signal, we explicitly condition a value estimator on the full sequence of intermediate goals but represent the value function as a sum of subgoal-conditioned value functions, enabling dense hindsight relabeling. We evaluate all these methods in tasks with challenging goal-chaining requirements and empirically highlight specific cases in which either action regularization or reward shaping yield low performance, while LG-AC achieves the best overall performance across tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对目标条件强化学习在稀疏奖励长时程任务中的挑战，研究了规划器辅助学习的两种范式（动作正则化与奖励塑形）的失败案例，提出了一种新的方法LG-AC（Locally-Guided Actor Critic），通过将价值函数表示为子目标条件价值函数之和来实现密集的 hindsight relabeling，在目标链式任务中取得了最佳综合性能。
AI.motivation: 目标条件强化学习在稀疏奖励的长时程任务中表现不佳。虽然规划器可以提供子目标引导低层策略，但在测试时引入规划器会带来子目标管理的实际困难。替代范式是让高层规划器仅辅助训练，而策略在部署时只依赖最终目标。然而现有方法存在缺陷：RIS方法通过动作正则化可能导致低维中间目标下的目标链式问题；PBRS方法虽保证最优策略不变，但在终止状态会产生欺骗性奖励。
AI.method: 首先提出了一种改进的奖励塑形方法（RS），去除了PBRS在终止状态的欺骗性奖励，但牺牲了PBRS的理论保证。在此基础上提出了LG-AC（Locally-Guided Actor Critic），该方法显式地以完整中间目标序列为条件来估计价值，但将价值函数表示为子目标条件价值函数之和，从而实现密集的事后重标记（hindsight relabeling）。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性目标链式需求的任务中评估了所有方法，实证显示了动作正则化和奖励塑形各自在某些特定场景下的低性能，而LG-AC在所有任务中取得了最佳综合性能。
AI.conclusion: LG-AC通过将价值函数分解为子目标条件价值函数之和，既避免了RIS动作正则化的目标链式问题，又避免了PBRS/RS奖励塑形的欺骗性奖励问题，在目标链式任务中表现最优，为规划器辅助训练但部署时无需规划器的范式提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction
summary: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将拟合分类器与大型语言模型（LLM）结合用于信用违约预测。实验表明，将分类器预测的概率加入提示词可将LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提升至0.78（与随机森林持平），同时保持更高召回率，推荐使用分类器引导的提示词方法。
AI.motivation: 信用违约预测是金融决策中的重要任务。传统方法使用拟合分类器（如逻辑回归、随机森林），而LLM通过提示词也被应用于此任务。作者希望探究如何将两者的优势结合，因为假设拟合分类器能提供LLM提示所缺乏的排序能力。
AI.method: 在信用卡客户违约数据集上进行实验，区分了两种结合方式：（1）让LLM模仿分类器；（2）用分类器构建提示词。具体包括特征剪枝（保留分类器最重要的8个特征）和将分类器预测概率加入提示词。使用召回率、F1、AUC-ROC和AUC-PR等指标，并采用bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: 少样本LLM在单一模型中召回率（0.47）和F1（0.50）最高，但排序能力不如随机森林（AUC-ROC 0.72对0.79）。让LLM模仿分类器无显著变化。将提示词剪枝为分类器最重要的8个特征可提升召回率0.071和F1 0.032。将分类器预测概率加入提示词可将LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提升至0.78，与随机森林持平，同时保持高出0.118的召回率。反向组合和使用多个分类器无帮助。
AI.conclusion: 推荐采用简单的分类器引导提示词方法用于LLM信用预测。拟合分类器能有效弥补LLM在排序能力上的不足，而将分类器概率融入提示词是一种简单且有效的最佳实践。

title: Game-Agnostic Value Functions through Automatic JSON Feature Extraction
comment: 4 pages, to be published in Conference on Games (CoG) 2026
summary: JSON Bag-of-Tokens (JSON-Bag) is a recently proposed method to generically represent game trajectories by tokenizing their JSON descriptions. We introduce JSON-Bag VF, a game-agnostic approach to training value functions for game-playing agents using JSON-Bag prototypes. We show that this approach can be enhanced with Random Forest-based feature selection and a method to select game-stage-specific features. We evaluate JSON-Bag VF with One-step-look-ahead (JSON-Bag OSLA) on six tabletop games over different combinations of prototype-tokenization and feature selections. JSON-Bag OSLA outperforms baseline OSLA agents in most games. Our analysis also shows that feature selection significantly improves JSON-Bag VF and that feature selection is the most important factor in JSON-Bag VF performance, over prototype-tokenization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JSON-Bag VF，一种基于JSON-Bag原型tokenization的、与游戏无关的价值函数训练方法，并结合随机森林特征选择与游戏阶段特定特征选择，在六款桌游上评估其与One-step-look-ahead（OSLA）代理的结合表现。
AI.motivation: JSON-Bag是一种通过将游戏轨迹的JSON描述进行token化来泛化表示游戏轨迹的新方法，但如何利用它训练价值函数以提升游戏代理性能尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出JSON-Bag VF方法：使用JSON-Bag原型（prototypes）训练价值函数；通过随机森林进行特征选择；并设计游戏阶段特定特征选择方法。将JSON-Bag VF与One-step-look-ahead（JSON-Bag OSLA）结合，在六款桌游上配置不同的原型tokenization与特征选择组合进行评估。
AI.result: JSON-Bag OSLA在大多数游戏中优于基线OSLA代理。分析表明，特征选择显著提升了JSON-Bag VF的性能，且相对于原型tokenization，特征选择是影响JSON-Bag VF性能的最关键因素。
AI.conclusion: JSON-Bag VF是一种有效的游戏无关价值函数训练方法，特征选择在其中的作用尤为关键，为后续提升游戏代理泛化能力提供了重要方向。

title: No Equivariant Architecture Covers All Equivariant Attention
summary: We give a complete characterization of equivariant multi-head self-attention (MHSA): if an MHSA layer is equivariant to a symmetry group $G$, then $G$ can only act by permuting head-clusters, with QK and OV matrices satisfying an equivariance constraint tied to the group action. As a consequence, we prove that any fixed MHSA architecture that achieves exact equivariance by polynomially parameterizing unconstrained MHSA parameters inevitably leads to expressivity loss within the class of equivariant maps: the equivariance locus of unconstrained MHSA forms a union of extremely many Zariski-irreducible components in a reduced parameter space, and any single architecture covers at most one. For $G=D_4$ acting on $C$ copies of the regular representation as the token feature space, we show that there are $Ω(C^{64})$ components for eight attention heads.

AI.tldr: 本文对等变多头自注意力（MHSA）进行了完整刻画，证明若MHSA层对对称群G等变，则G只能通过排列头簇的方式作用，且QK和OV矩阵需满足与群作用相关的等变约束。进一步证明，任何通过多项式参数化无约束MHSA参数来达成精确等变的固定架构，必然导致等变映射类内的表达力损失：无约束MHSA的等变轨迹在约化参数空间中构成大量Zariski不可约分量的并集，而单一架构最多覆盖其中之一。对于D4群作用于C个正则表示副本的情形，8个注意力头对应Ω(C^64)个分量。
AI.motivation: 理解等变MHSA层的完整结构特征，以及探讨通过参数化无约束MHSA实现精确等变时固有的表达力限制。
AI.method: 通过数学刻画证明MHSA等变性的充分必要条件，利用代数几何中Zariski不可约分量的概念分析等变轨迹的结构，并给出D4群作用下的具体复杂度下界。
AI.result: 给出了等变MHSA的完整刻画；证明了固定架构实现精确等变必然导致表达力损失；在D4群、C个正则表示副本、8个注意力头的设定下，证明了存在Ω(C^64)个Zariski不可约分量。
AI.conclusion: 等变MHSA的本质结构约束是头簇排列，任何固定参数化架构都无法覆盖全部等变映射，这揭示了等变注意力机制在表达力上的根本性局限。

title: Arkios: An Open Bilingual English-Nepali Language Model Trained From Scratch, with a Devanagari-Aware Tokenizer
summary: We present Arkios, a 1.04B-parameter dense transformer pretrained from scratch on 150B tokens of bilingual English-Nepali text, using a custom single-file C/CUDA training stack and a Devanagari-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer built for this project. On ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge, Arkios exceeds three comparably sized open models (Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B, OLMo-1B) despite an order of magnitude fewer training tokens, likely aided by a match between our educational-web-text pretraining data and ARC's grade-school-science format rather than a general capability advantage. We report full evaluation results under standard protocols, including a correction to an earlier partial-sample estimate, and findings specific to evaluating small models in a low-resource language: the standard multiple-choice-letter prompt format used by common evaluation harnesses places this model at chance on Nepali reading comprehension, and simultaneously at chance on English in the same format, which would lead a naive benchmark run to conclude the model has no Nepali ability when in fact it does. Concretely, both languages score at chance in the letter-choice format (0.240 Nepali, 0.236 English, against a chance baseline of 0.250), while scoring the answer text directly reveals genuine, English-favoring comprehension (0.306 Nepali, 0.387 English). We describe a manifest-conditioned tool-use contract introduced during instruction tuning, where tool calls are permitted only when a tool manifest is declared in context and suppressed otherwise, and report where that contract holds and where it does not. We release both the base and instruction-tuned model weights under Apache-2.0. The training code and a small privately-sourced portion of the Nepali pretraining corpus are not released; everything needed to reproduce the reported numbers from the released weights is included here.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Arkios，一个从零开始在150B英语-尼泊尔双语tokens上预训练的1.04B参数稠密Transformer模型，使用自研的C/CUDA训练栈和针对Devanagari文开发的字节级BPE分词器。在ARC基准上超越同类规模开源模型，并揭示了一个关键评估陷阱：标准字母选项格式会让低资源语言小模型在尼泊尔语和英语上都处于偶然水平，掩盖其真实能力。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如尼泊尔语）的大型语言模型研究不足，且现有评估框架对这类语言存在系统性偏见——标准的选择题字母格式会导致模型在尼泊尔语阅读理解任务上表现为偶然水平，从而错误地得出模型无能力的结论。作者旨在构建一个高质量的双语小模型并揭示此类评估陷阱。
AI.method: 1) 从零开始训练1.04B参数稠密Transformer，使用自研单文件C/CUDA训练栈；2) 设计Devanagari感知的字节级BPE分词器；3) 在150B英语-尼泊尔语双语tokens上预训练；4) 通过指令微调引入"manifest条件化的工具使用契约"（仅在上下文中声明工具清单时才允许工具调用）；5) 在标准评估协议下进行全面评测，对比字母选项格式与直接作答格式的差异。
AI.result: 1) Arkios在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上超过Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B、OLMo-1B等同类模型，尽管训练tokens少一个数量级（可能受益于预训练数据与ARC格式的匹配）；2) 字母选项格式下尼泊尔语(0.240)和英语(0.236)均接近偶然水平(0.250)，而直接作答显示真实理解能力（尼泊尔语0.306，英语0.387）；3) 报告了工具使用契约的成立与失效情况；4) 模型权重以Apache-2.0开源。
AI.conclusion: 评估低资源语言小模型时必须谨慎选择评测格式，标准字母选项提示格式可能导致严重的误导性结论。Arkios展示了在有限训练资源下利用双语数据和小模型取得竞争性表现的可能性，同时也揭示了现有评估工具链对低资源语言的系统性局限。

title: VERA: Authority-Preserving Edge Revocation for Federated AI-Agent Workflows
summary: Modern agent frameworks compose planners, tool agents, remote services, and shared specialists into runtime delegation graphs, but their revocation APIs still resemble token or subtree invalidation. When one delegation is withdrawn, the runtime must know which agents lose authority while independently authorized agents keep working. We study this authority consistency problem and introduce VERA (Verifiable Edge Revocation for Agents), a verifier-checkable revocation contract and API emitted by agent-runtime adapters as signed evidence. Under disjunctive authority, revoking edge e invalidates exactly T_intent(e,G) = reach(G) \ reach(G \ {e}), the agents whose every authorizing root path used e. Used as a contract, this target exposes two runtime failures: tree cascades over-revoke shared agents, while deployer-scoped cascades under-revoke cross-domain descendants. In a LangGraph framework-replt cells repeated 20 times yield 500compiled-framework traces and 2,000 valid signed delegation decisions; 13/25 cells contain runtime multi-parsharing and 8/25 contain cross-deployer shies 500/500 target proofs, preserves all320 alternate-parent shared-agent cases that tree cascade revokes, and rejects unauthorized signers and omission attacks. Baseline replay over 1,9that holder/node and tree-style targetscannot express this behavior. We further validate schema portability on A2A, AutoGen, and CrewAI artifacts: nine traces, including five executable Cregned delegation events that pass schema and signature checks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERA（Verifiable Edge Revocation for Agents），一种用于智能体运行时中权威撤销的验证器可检查的合约与API。在析取权威（disjunctive authority）模型下，撤销边e恰好使T_intent(e,G)中的智能体失效——即那些所有授权根路径都经过e的节点。该方法解决了树形级联过度撤销和部署者作用域级联撤销不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体框架将规划器、工具智能体、远程服务和共享专家组合成运行时委派图，但现有的撤销API仍类似令牌或子树失效。当一个委派被撤销时，运行时必须知道哪些智能体失去权威，同时独立授权的智能体应继续工作——即"权威一致性"问题（authority consistency）。
AI.method: 提出VERA协议，由智能体运行时适配器发出带签名的证据作为可验证的撤销合约。其核心思想是：在析取权威下，撤销边e的目标集合为T_intent(e,G) = reach(G) \ reach(G \ {e})，即所有授权根路径都用过e的智能体。该合约揭示了两种运行时故障：树形级联会过度撤销共享智能体，而部署者作用域级联则对跨域后裔撤销不足。
AI.result: 在LangGraph框架中，重复20次的replt cells产生500条编译后框架轨迹和2000个有效签名委派决策；25个cells中13个包含运行时多共享、8个包含跨部署者事例。验证500/500目标证明，保留所有320个树级联会撤销的交替父级共享智能体案例，并拒绝未授权签名者和遗漏攻击。基线回放表明holder/node及树风格目标无法表达该行为。在A2A、AutoGen和CrewAI工件上验证了模式可移植性：9条轨迹（含5条可执行委派事件）通过模式和签名检查。
AI.conclusion: VERA通过可验证的边缘撤销合约解决了智能体架构中的权威一致性问题，在析取权威模型下精确定义了撤销目标，避免了树级联的过度撤销和部署者作用域级联的撤销不足，并在多个主流智能体框架中验证了可移植性和有效性。

title: A.X K2 Technical Report
summary: We introduce A.X K2, a 688B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model trained from scratch as a high-performance foundation for \emph{agentic} applications. Trained on approximately 8.5T tokens---fewer than its predecessor, A.X K1---on a smaller but higher-quality mixture with substantially expanded agentic and software-engineering data, it nonetheless improves over A.X K1 across the board, by over 30 percentage points on some benchmarks, reflecting large gains in token efficiency. To support long contexts efficiently, we introduce Sparse Gated Attention (SGA), which combines sparse attention with gated attention, and adopt Gated Norm (GN) to stabilize large-scale training. SGA is trained natively at 128K through a \emph{sparse} indexer warmup that optimizes the indexer against its own sparse top-$k$ selection rather than the dense attention distribution, making adaptation markedly cheaper: each query reads only 2,048 positions, yet long-context quality is unchanged and A.X K2 scores 94.6 on RULER out to 256K. The outlier suppression of GN in turn keeps 4-bit NVFP4 serving within one point of FP8 accuracy. A simple yet effective Think-Fusion recipe further lets users switch between thinking and non-thinking modes within a single unified model. Extensive evaluations show that A.X K2 performs competitively against strong open-weight baselines, matching or exceeding them on math and Korean-language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了A.X K2，一个688B参数的MoE语言模型，从头训练以作为agentic应用的高性能基础模型。它用更少的token（约8.5T）但在更高质量、更丰富agentic和软件工程数据上训练，全面超越前代A.X K1。引入Sparse Gated Attention（SGA）和Gated Norm（GN）以支持高效长上下文和稳定大规模训练，并提出了Think-Fusion训练方案在单一模型内实现思考/非思考模式切换。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建一个面向agentic应用的高性能基础语言模型，同时提高token效率（用更少数据达到更好效果），并解决长上下文推理的成本问题和大规模训练的稳定性问题。
AI.method: 1) 采用MoE架构（688B参数），在更小但更高质量的数据混合上训练，大幅扩充agentic和软件工程数据；2) 提出Sparse Gated Attention（SGA），将稀疏注意力与门控注意力结合，通过稀疏索引器warmup机制让每个query只读取2,048个位置仍保持长上下文质量；3) 采用Gated Norm（GN）通过异常值抑制稳定大规模训练并提升低精度量化性能；4) 提出Think-Fusion配方实现单一模型中的思考/非思考模式切换。
AI.result: A.X K2在多个基准上超过前代A.X K1超过30个百分点，RULER基准在256K上下文上得分94.6，4-bit NVFP4推理精度与FP8相当（差距在1点以内），在数学和韩语基准上与强开源模型竞争或超越。
AI.conclusion: 通过高质量数据、高效稀疏注意力架构和训练稳定性技术，A.X K2展示了显著的token效率提升，在不牺牲长上下文质量的前提下大幅降低推理成本，并验证了面向agentic应用的大规模MoE模型的可行性和竞争力。

title: PRIME: Mitigating Subgroup Optimization Competition in Shared CTR Top Networks with Plug-in Residual Input-Conditioned Mixture of Expert
summary:
Click-through rate (CTR) models vary in feature-interaction design, yet their top networks usually remain a single multilayer perceptron shared by all examples. Heterogeneous user, item, and context subgroups therefore update the same parameters; weakly aligned learning signals make the aggregate gradient a compromise among competing directions. We study the competition on Avazu with 4 models and 4 semantic fields. Across all architectures, semantic subgroups show lower Top-NN gradient cosine similarity than random groups matched by sample size and label ratio, with reductions of 0.23-0.37.
  This competition motivates input-conditioned experts, but directly replacing an established Dense mapping changes its initial function, sharing pattern, and capacity, obscuring the source of gains. We introduce PRIME (Plug-in Residual Input-conditioned Mixture of Experts), a Dense-anchored mixture of low-rank residual experts. PRIME anchors the original prediction and uses zero-residual initialization to match the Dense baseline exactly at training onset. Input-dependent routing weights low-rank experts for example-specific logit corrections; multi-bag aggregation and EMA load biases stabilize conditional estimation.
  We evaluate PRIME on held-out Avazu and Criteo test sets across 13 CTR architectures and five paired seeds. Median paired AUC gains are +0.0022 and +0.0066, with LogLoss reductions of 0.0011 and 0.0081, respectively. On FiBiNET and DCNv2, PRIME outperforms APG in all ten seed-level AUC comparisons while using fewer parameters and lower inference latency on both backbones. These results show that function-preserving conditional residuals add input-dependent capacity while preserving the Dense path and its optimization stability. Code is available at https://github.com/YH-learning/PRIME.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRIME（Plug-in Residual Input-conditioned Mixture of Experts），一种Dense锚定的低秩残差专家混合模型。PRIME通过零残差初始化精确匹配Dense基线，利用输入依赖的路由机制分配低秩专家进行逐样本logit修正，在13种CTR架构上取得了稳定的AUC提升（Avazu +0.0022，Criteo +0.0066）和LogLoss下降，且参数更少、推理延迟更低。
AI.motivation: 现有CTR模型中，不同用户、物品和上下文的子群体共享同一个MLP顶网络参数，导致弱对齐的学习信号使聚合梯度成为竞争方向的折中。作者在Avazu上通过4个模型和4个语义字段验证了这种竞争：各架构中语义子群体的Top-NN梯度余弦相似度显著低于随机分组（降低0.23-0.37）。这促使需要输入条件化的专家机制，但直接替换Dense映射会改变初始函数、共享模式和容量，掩盖改进来源。
AI.method: PRIME锚定原始Dense预测，使用零残差初始化精确匹配Dense基线。核心组件包括：1）输入依赖的路由权重，为每个样本分配低秩残差专家；2）多bag聚合和EMA负载偏置稳定条件估计。其设计确保训练开始时与Dense基线完全一致，从而在保持Dense路径和优化稳定性的同时，添加输入依赖的容量。
AI.result: 在Avazu和Criteo测试集上评估13种CTR架构和5组配对种子：中位配对AUC增益分别为+0.0022和+0.0066，LogLoss分别降低0.0011和0.0081。在FiBiNET和DCNv2上，PRIME在全部10个种子级AUC比较中优于APG，且参数更少、推理延迟更低。
AI.conclusion: PRIME证明了函数保持的条件残差能够在保留Dense路径和优化稳定性的前提下增加输入依赖容量。实验表明条件专家机制是有效的，且PRIME相比现有方法（如APG）在效果、参数效率和推理延迟方面均有优势。

authors: Shrinidhi Kumbhar Santosh Mashetty Divij Handa Kevin Coutinho
title: COGTRL: Training LLMs for Scientific Discovery Assistance using Cognitive Traces via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on extensive scientific research are increasingly integrated as assistants for scientific discovery. However, most research papers omit the fine-grained cognitive process of examining constraints, failed alternatives, and iterative decisions required to achieve the desired goal. Such cognitive processes are vital for real-world scientists working toward specific goals under constraints. In this paper, we show that LLMs, when trained to produce such cognitive traces, perform better as scientific discovery assistants than when trained solely on scientific literature. We propose COGTRL, a trajectory-level reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to emulate cognitively grounded reasoning by jointly optimizing cognitive traces and the scientific steps produced in an interleaved manner. Across two 3B-parameter models and two scientific domains (AI and Materials Science), COGTRL improves method quality by an average of 7.85 points over comparable 3B model baselines and achieves competitive performance relative to 70B parameter models. Moreover, analysis by domain experts shows a preference for methods generated by COGTRL over the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COGTRL框架，一种轨迹级强化学习方法，训练LLM生成认知轨迹（包括约束检验、失败替代方案和迭代决策），使其作为科学发现助手时比仅训练于科学文献的模型表现更好。
AI.motivation: 大多数研究论文省略了科学发现过程中的细粒度认知过程（如约束检验、失败替代方案、迭代决策），而这些认知过程对现实科学家在约束下实现特定目标至关重要。仅基于科学文献训练的LLM缺乏这种认知能力。
AI.method: 提出COGTRL，一种轨迹级强化学习框架，通过联合优化认知轨迹和科学步骤的交错生成来训练LLM模仿认知支撑的推理过程。
AI.result: 在两个3B参数模型和两个科学领域（AI和材料科学）上，COGTRL相比同规模基线平均提升7.85分，并达到与70B参数模型相当的性能。领域专家偏好COGTRL生成的方法。
AI.conclusion: 训练LLM产生认知轨迹能显著提升其作为科学发现助手的表现，证明认知过程的显式建模对科学AI的重要性。

title: FaVOR: LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Factor Mining via Empirical Validation
summary: Traditional finance relies on experts to hand-craft factors through a principled process grounded in economic rationale. Recent LLM-based multi-agent systems have automated this process, scaling factor mining far beyond manual effort. However, these automated approaches optimize directly for returns and rarely check whether a generated factor still expresses the economic hypothesis that motivated it. We identify this inconsistency between mathematical form and economic meaning as a structural failure mode of return-oriented automation. The resulting factors blur the line between real signals and spurious correlations and break down across regime shifts. We propose FaVOR (Factor Validation through Observable Reasoning), an agentic framework that restructures factor mining around hypothesis-level evidence rather than return outcomes. In place of the standard hypothesis-to-formula leap, FaVOR enforces a three-stage consistency loop tying mathematical form to economic rationale throughout. (1) Decomposition splits a broad economic hypothesis into independent observable conditions. (2) Validation checks whether each factor reflects its intended condition. (3) Integration merges them into a composite whose structure remains interpretable. On the CSI 500 and S&P 500 in 2025, FaVOR outperforms existing baselines while remaining effective across regimes. FaVOR shows that hypothesis-grounded factor discovery produces signals that are interpretable by construction, regime-robust, and economically faithful. The code is available at https://github.com/damilab/FaVOR.

AI.tldr: FaVOR是一个基于可观测推理的智能体框架，将因子挖掘从回报导向重构为假设证据导向，通过分解-验证-整合三阶段一致性循环，确保数学形式与经济假设保持一致，在CSI 500和S&P 500上优于现有基线且具备跨体制鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统虽能自动化因子挖掘，但直接优化回报而很少验证因子是否仍表达其背后的经济假设，导致数学形式与经济含义不一致，产生虚假相关的信号并在体制转换时失效。
AI.method: FaVOR将标准假设到公式的直接跳跃替换为三阶段一致性循环：(1)分解——将宽泛经济假设拆分为独立可观测条件；(2)验证——检查每个因子是否反映其预期条件；(3)整合——将因子合并为结构仍可解释的复合因子。
AI.result: 在2025年CSI 500和S&P 500上，FaVOR优于现有基线，并在不同市场体制下保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 假设驱动的因子发现能产生天然可解释、对体制变化鲁棒且经济上忠实的信号，证明锚定经济假设是提升因子质量的有效途径。

title: Self-Supervised Pretext Tasks for Infant Cry Analysis: A Controlled Comparison and a Cautionary Result on Donateacry
summary: We compare six self-supervised pretext tasks for infant cry analysis under a fixed budget, meaning the same compact encoder of 1.17M parameters, the same 115 hours of license-verified public pretraining audio, and the same evaluation protocol for every candidate. On cry detection the reconstructive objectives dominate, and a linear probe over a masked-spectrogram encoder reaches 0.988 AUC with subject-wise splits even though the encoder never observed a cry during pretraining. On cry-reason classification over donateacry, the de facto public benchmark for cry reasons, every encoder performs at chance (0.38 to 0.54 macro AUC over 5 classes), and neither domain adaptation on 1.8 hours of real cries nor end-to-end fine-tuning moves the result. Since a frozen HuBERT-base with 80 times more parameters shows the same pattern, the bottleneck must sit in the labels and not in model capacity. We then reproduce the 90\%+ accuracies of the donateacry literature on our own system by changing nothing but the evaluation protocol: clip-wise splits raise accuracy to 85.2% (barely above the 83.8% majority-class baseline), and applying augmentation before splitting raises it to 97.9%, matching the reported state of the art, from the same model that measures 0.49 macro AUC under subject-wise splits. Under leakage-free splits, a twentyfold augmentation of the labeled set (vocoder speaker perturbation and noise mixing, 21 hours) leaves cross-subject AUC unchanged: for this task the effective sample size is the number of infants. We release code, seeds and per-clip license manifests.

AI.tldr: 本文在固定预算下（相同编码器1.17M参数、115小时预训练音频、相同评估协议）比较了六个自监督预训练任务用于婴儿哭声分析。发现重建类目标在哭声检测上表现最佳（masked-spectrogram编码器线性探针达0.988 AUC），但在哭声原因分类任务上所有编码器均接近随机水平（0.38-0.54 macro AUC）。作者复现了文献中90%+的准确率，但证明这源于有泄漏的评估协议（clip-wise split和split前增强），在无泄漏的subject-wise split下同一模型仅0.49 macro AUC。关键结论是瓶颈在于标签而非模型容量，有效样本量实际是婴儿数量。
AI.motivation: 揭示婴儿哭声分析领域文献中报告的高准确率可能源于评估协议泄漏而非真实模型能力，并通过严格受控的实验对比不同自监督预训练任务在固定预算下的真实表现。
AI.method: 在固定预算下对比六个自监督预训练任务（重建类与判别类）；采用相同紧凑编码器（1.17M参数）、相同115小时公开预训练音频、相同评估协议。通过改变评估协议（subject-wise vs clip-wise split、split前后增强）复现文献中的高准确率，并揭示数据泄漏的影响；使用去重器和噪声混合进行二十倍增强测试。
AI.result: 哭声检测中重建目标主导，masked-spectrogram编码器线性探针达0.988 AUC；哭声原因分类中所有编码器均为随机水平（0.38-0.54 macro AUC），领域适应和微调均无效；HuBERT-base（80倍参数）同样表现，证明瓶颈在标签；复制文献评估协议后准确率从49%升至97.9%，证明文献结果来自数据泄漏；二十倍增强不改变cross-subject AUC。
AI.conclusion: 婴儿哭声原因分类任务的瓶颈在于标签质量/定义而非模型容量或预训练策略；文献中90%+的准确率是评估协议泄漏的产物。有效样本大小取决于婴儿数量而非增强后的片段数量。作者发布代码、种子和许可清单以支持可复现研究。

title: Can LLMs Take the Pulse of the Economy? A Real-Time Evaluation of LLM Nowcasts on Macroeconomic Indicators
summary: Nowcasting headline macroeconomic indicators, i.e., estimating an indicator's value for the current reference period before its official release, is critical for monetary policy and financial markets, and central banks devote dedicated teams of expert economists to producing such estimates. Large language model (LLM) agents are a promising candidate for this task, combining broad world knowledge with real-time web search and supporting queries at higher frequency than institutional nowcasts. Evaluating their nowcasting capability is, however, challenging: headline indicators such as GDP and CPI are widely reported and likely memorized during pretraining, so any evaluation on historical releases is vulnerable to data contamination. To address this, we introduce LiveMacroEval, a live, contamination-resistant benchmark in which LLM agents produce hourly nowcasts for sixteen major U.S. macroeconomic indicators over a pre-release window closing at each official release. Nowcast quality is assessed through a LiveMacro Score against announcement-window equity returns and a LiveBetting Score from simulated Polymarket-style trading, with Federal Reserve regional-bank nowcasts, the Bloomberg ECOS professional consensus, and an auto-ARIMA baseline as comparators. Over six months with four state-of-the-art LLM agents configured with web search, aggregate nowcast accuracy is broadly comparable to the institutional and professional benchmarks, with performance varying widely across individual indicators. This highlights LLM agents' potential as real-time estimators of macroeconomic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiveMacroEval，一个实时、抗数据污染的基准测试，用于评估LLM智能体对16个美国宏观指标的即时预测（nowcasting）能力。该基准在官方发布前窗口内每小时生成预测，通过LiveMacro Score（对照公告窗口股票收益）和LiveBetting Score（模拟Polymarket交易）评估质量，并与美联储地区银行预测、Bloomberg ECOS专业共识及auto-ARIMA基线对比。六个月测试表明，四个配备网络搜索的SOTA LLM智能体的聚合预测精度与机构及专业基准大致相当，但个体指标间差异显著。
AI.motivation: 宏观经济指标的即时预测对货币政策与金融市场至关重要，LLM智能体结合世界知识、实时网络搜索和高频查询能力，是理想候选。然而，GDP和CPI等头条指标在预训练中可能被记忆，历史数据评估易受数据污染影响，亟需一个抗污染的实时评估基准。
AI.method: 构建LiveMacroEval实时基准，对16个美国宏观指标在官方发布前的窗口内进行每小时预测；采用LiveMacro Score（基于公告窗口股票收益）和LiveBetting Score（模拟Polymarket式交易）双重评估体系；以美联储区域银行预测、Bloomberg ECOS共识和auto-ARIMA作为对比基线；对四个配备网络搜索的SOTA LLM智能体进行了六个月测试。
AI.result: LLM智能体的聚合即时预测精度与机构及专业基准大致相当，但在不同个体指标上的表现差异显著，凸显了LLM智能体作为宏观条件实时估计器的潜力。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体能够作为宏观经济指标的实时估计器，其整体预测能力与专业机构相当，为货币政策和金融市场提供了有价值的参考工具，但个体指标间的性能差异仍需进一步优化。

title: SPARK: Skeleton-Guided Reasoning Synthesis from Large-Scale Scientific Literature
summary: Scientific reasoning remains challenging for open-source models, largely due to the lack of high-quality scientific reasoning data. Existing datasets are often dominated by factual recall or formulaic problem solving, with limited emphasis on mechanism understanding, evidence-grounded reasoning, and hypothesis evaluation. To address this, we introduce SPARK (Scientific Paper Abstracted Reasoning sKeleton), a paper-oriented synthesis framework built on Sci-Base, a large-scale corpus of research papers spanning 10 scientific disciplines. Instead of directly converting papers into question-answer pairs, SPARK treats the claim-evidence-derivation structure of a paper as the fundamental unit of reasoning synthesis. Specifically, SPARK (1) distills each paper into a compact reasoning skeleton capturing its central claims and supporting evidence, enabling self-contained question generation, and (2) synthesizes reasoning tasks from four scientific perspectives: mechanistic reasoning, hypothesis falsification, quantitative derivation, and boundary calibration. A final consistency verification stage further removes unsupported or contradictory outputs. Using this framework, we construct Spark-234K, a scientific reasoning dataset with substantially higher difficulty and diversity than existing resources. Experiments show that Spark-234K consistently outperforms existing scientific reasoning datasets while achieving stronger performance with significantly fewer training samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPARK框架，基于大规模学术论文语料库Sci-Base，将论文的"主张-证据-推导"结构提炼为推理骨架，从机制推理、假设证伪、定量推导、边界校准四个科学视角合成高质量科学推理数据，构建了Spark-234K数据集。
AI.motivation: 开源模型在科学推理上表现不佳，主要由于缺乏高质量的科学推理训练数据。现有数据集多偏向事实记忆或公式化解题，缺乏对机制理解、证据推理和假设评估的重视。
AI.method: SPARK框架包含三个关键步骤：(1)将每篇论文提炼为紧凑的推理骨架，捕捉核心主张与支撑证据，实现自包含问题生成；(2)从四个科学视角合成推理任务：机制推理、假设证伪、定量推导、边界校准；(3)通过最终的一致性验证阶段，去除无支撑或矛盾的输出。
AI.result: 构建了Spark-234K数据集，其难度和多样性显著高于现有资源。实验表明，Spark-234K在科学推理任务上持续优于现有科学推理数据集，且使用更少的训练样本即可获得更强的性能。
AI.conclusion: 以论文中的"主张-证据-推导"结构为推理合成的基本单元，而非简单地将论文转化为问答对，能够更有效地生成高质量、高难度的科学推理训练数据，从而提升开源模型的科学推理能力。

title: Learning Where Outcomes Change:Credit-Addressable Reasoning for Multimodal Geometry
summary: Multimodal geometry reasoning requires VLMs to extract precise visual relations and preserve them through multi-step deduction. Existing free-form traces obscure the decisions that determine the answer, and trajectory-level reinforcement learning distributes a single terminal signal across the entire response. We introduce credit-addressable reasoning, in which the semantic units exposed during inference also define where learning compares alternatives and assigns credit. We instantiate this principle with Code-CoT, which retains the diagram, represents visual relations as line-addressable executable code, and organizes reasoning into typed events, and CE-GRPO, which selects event boundaries using structural priors and type-normalized entropy, samples complete continuations from shared prefixes, and converts outcome differences into localized advantages. Across nine geometry benchmarks, CE-GRPO achieves an average accuracy of 76.04, outperforming Qwen3-VL-8B and trajectory-level GRPO by $8.09$ and 3.43 points, respectively. Its relative advantage increases with the number of intermediate events, demonstrating the value of representation--optimization co-design for long, dependency-heavy multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可寻址信用"（credit-addressable reasoning）范式，通过Code-CoT将多模态几何推理组织为可寻址代码事件，结合CE-GRPO在事件边界处分配局部优势，在九个几何基准上平均准确率达76.04%，超越基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在几何推理中面临两个核心问题：自由文本推理过程模糊了决定答案的关键决策；轨迹级强化学习将单一终端信号均匀分配到整个响应，无法精确定位推理中的错误步骤。这限制了模型在长链条、强依赖的多模态推理任务上的表现。
AI.method: 提出两个协同组件：(1) Code-CoT：保留图表信息，将视觉关系表示为可寻址的（行寻址）可执行代码，并将推理组织为带类型的离散事件；(2) CE-GRPO：利用结构先验和类型归一化熵选择事件边界，从共享前缀采样完整后续，并将结果差异转化为局部优势信号（per-event advantage）。
AI.result: 在九个几何基准上，CE-GRPO平均准确率为76.04%，比Qwen3-VL-8B高出8.09个百分点，比轨迹级GRPO高出3.43个百分点。且中间事件数量越多，相对优势越大，表明该方法在长链条推理上的优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过表示-优化协同设计（representation-optimization co-design），即推理表示与学习信号对齐，能够更有效地将信用分配到关键推理步骤，显著提升多模态几何推理的长链条、深依赖任务性能。

title: Manacá-1B: An Open, Reproducible Brazilian-Portuguese Language Model and a Tokenizer-Aware, Paired Evaluation
summary: Brazilian Portuguese remains under-served by open language models, and the few that exist are difficult to reproduce and are often compared without measures of uncertainty. We release Manacá-1B, an open decoder-only model of 1.72 billion parameters trained from scratch for Brazilian Portuguese with a fully containerized, reproducible pipeline. The pretraining is stable, with zero skipped or NaN steps and self-recovering loss spikes, and we release its full log and dynamics. We evaluate the model against nine open baselines on four Portuguese benchmarks under a single harness. Every comparison reports a standard error and a paired significance test, and the harness is validated against previously published numbers. On last-word prediction Manacá-1B is the strongest model below the 7B scale, exceeding both Tucano-1b1 and Tucano-2b4 on LAMBADA-PT with large paired margins; it is competitive on commonsense completion and near chance on multiple-choice reasoning, as are all small base models. Along the way we document a concrete evaluation pitfall: converting a SentencePiece tokenizer with case-folding normalization to the HuggingFace fast format silently drops the normalizer, routing every capitalized token to byte-fallback and depressing scores in a way that is invisible in aggregate metrics. The uncorrected tokenizer lowered LAMBADA-PT accuracy from 45.3 to 25.0; we quantify the effect and provide a one-line fix that reproduces the training tokenizer exactly. Code, raw training and evaluation logs, per-example prediction vectors, the model weights, and the corrected tokenizer are released so that every number in this paper can be recomputed.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 Manacá-1B，一个从零训练、完全可复现的 17.2 亿参数巴西葡萄牙语开源解码器模型，并基于统一评估框架与九个月开源基线对比，同时揭示并修复了 SentencePiece 分词器转换中的评估陷阱。
AI.motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语缺乏可复现的开源语言模型；现有的少数模型难以复现，且对比评估往往缺乏不确定性度量（如标准误和显著性检验）。
AI.method: 从零预训练 Manacá-1B（17.2 亿参数解码器），采用完全容器化的可复现管道；在四个葡萄牙语基准上，通过统一评估框架对九个月开源基线进行对比，每次比较都报告标准误和配对显著性检验；并探究了分词器转换导致的评估缺陷。
AI.result: Manacá-1B 在 LAMBADA-PT 末词预测任务上是 7B 规模以下最强模型，显著超过 Tucano-1b1 和 Tucano-2b4；在常识补全上具有竞争力，在多选推理上接近随机水平（与其他小型基础模型一致）。此外，发现并量化了分词器大小写折叠归一化在转换到 HuggingFace fast 格式时被静默丢弃的问题，该缺陷使 LAMBADA-PT 精度从 45.3 降至 25.0，并提供了一行修复代码。
AI.conclusion: 通过完全透明的训练日志、评估过程和修正后的分词器，Manacá-1B 实现了论文中每个数字的可复现性，同时揭示了小型基础模型在复杂推理任务上的固有局限，以及分词器转换中容易被忽略但影响重大的评估陷阱。

title: LaMoC: Loss-Aware Modular Compression for LLMs
summary: Modular compression has enabled considerable parameter reduction in LLMs while preserving strong language understanding and downstream task accuracy. However, existing joint modular compression methods primarily rely on activation statistics, leaving loss-sensitivity information and its module-level characterization underexplored. We investigate addressing this gap with LaMoC, a loss-aware modular compression methodology that blends activation and Empirical Fisher statistics through gradient-error alignment. LaMoC improves joint compression by selecting compression statistics that better align local module reconstruction error with the downstream loss. Our contributions are three-fold: (1) We characterize the Empirical Fisher as a module-level loss-aware proxy that can be blended with the activation statistics required for compression. (2) We reformulate joint modular compression as a two-tiered optimization problem that minimizes module reconstruction error while tuning the activation and gradient information blending rate. (3) We implement an empirically driven methodology with statistical validation to solve the resulting compression problem. We evaluate LaMoC across four model families spanning eight models. On the 4-8B models, LaMoC achieves an average 2.5% reduction in perplexity and a 1% relative improvement in task accuracy over state-of-the-art modular compression methods.

AI.tldr: LaMoC是一种损失感知的模块化压缩方法，通过将激活统计与Empirical Fisher信息以梯度误差对齐方式融合，在保持模型性能的同时实现更优的LLM参数压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有的联合模块化压缩方法主要依赖激活统计信息，未充分利用损失敏感性信息及其模块级特征，导致压缩策略与下游损失不完全对齐。
AI.method: (1) 将Empirical Fisher刻画为模块级损失感知代理，并与激活统计融合；(2) 将联合模块化压缩重构为双层优化问题，最小化模块重建误差的同时调整激活与梯度信息的混合率；(3) 采用经验驱动方法结合统计验证来求解该压缩问题。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族共八个模型上评估，对于4-8B规模模型，LaMoC相比最先进的模块化压缩方法，平均困惑度降低2.5%，任务准确率相对提升1%。
AI.conclusion: LaMoC通过融合损失感知信息与激活统计，有效弥补了现有模块化压缩方法在损失敏感性利用上的不足，取得了显著的压缩性能提升。

title: ToxLens: A Reproducible Graph-Learning Framework for Leakage-Aware, Uncertainty-Calibrated Molecular Toxicity Prediction
summary: Molecular toxicity prediction is increasingly used to prioritise compounds before experimental testing, but conventional benchmark performance can overstate practical utility when structurally related molecules occur across training and test folds. We introduce ToxLens, a reproducible multi-task graph-learning framework for 11 toxicity endpoints spanning Ames mutagenicity, acute oral toxicity, hERG inhibition, and Tox21 nuclear-receptor and stress-response assays. The workflow combines conservative chemical curation, sphere-exclusion filtering, a leakage-aware UMAP-HDBSCAN split, parallel graph and global-feature encoders joined by late concatenation, temperature-scaled Monte Carlo dropout with conformal-style prediction sets, applicability-domain analysis, and SHAP-guided toxicophore discovery with occlusion controls. On the leakage-controlled test fold, a five-seed soft-voting ensemble achieved a Matthews correlation coefficient score of 0.44, an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve score of 0.83, and an area under the precision-recall curve score of 0.58. It exceeded four ECFP4-based shallow baselines on all 11 endpoints under the same split and validation-based threshold-selection protocol. Controlled ablations showed that the global pathway was important, whereas late concatenation outperformed the tested gated and feature-wise linear modulation fusion variants. Conformal-style prediction sets revealed substantial endpoint-specific variation in set efficiency, and discrimination and calibration improved with similarity to the training domain. Retraining on fixed published Tox21 Challenge and TDA folds produced competitive, but not uniformly state-of-the-art, performance. SHAP-guided occlusion and consensus subgraph mining yielded model-derived structural hypotheses, 44 of which contained at least one occurrence that passed the predefined counterfactual criteria.

AI.tldr: ToxLens是一个可复现的多任务图学习框架，用于11个毒性终点预测。该框架结合了保守的化学数据整理、球排除过滤、泄漏感知的UMAP-HDBSCAN数据分割、并行图与全局特征编码器、温度缩放蒙特卡洛dropout（含共形预测集）、适用域分析和SHAP引导的毒效团发现。在泄漏控制测试集上，五种子软投票集成达到MCC 0.44、AUROC 0.83、AUPRC 0.58，超过四种ECFP4浅层基线。消融实验显示全局通路重要，晚期拼接优于门控和FiLM融合变体。
AI.motivation: 传统基准性能会因训练集和测试集中存在结构相关分子而高估实际效用，需要开发更严谨的毒性预测框架，以在实验测试前更好地优先排序化合物。
AI.method: 采用保守化学数据整理、球排除过滤、泄漏感知UMAP-HDBSCAN分割、并行图编码器和全局特征编码器（晚期拼接）、温度缩放MC dropout共形成预测集、适用域分析、SHAP毒效团发现（含遮挡控制），以及五种子软投票集成。
AI.result: 泄漏控制测试集上MCC 0.44、AUROC 0.83、AUPRC 0.58，超越四种ECFP4浅层基线；共形预测集显示终点特异性的集合效率差异；在固定Tox21挑战和TDA折上具竞争力但非统一最优；SHAP引导发现44个通过反事实标准的子结构假设。
AI.conclusion: ToxLens提供了一个全面且可复现的毒性预测框架，通过泄漏感知分割和不确定性量化提高实际效用评估的可靠性，并支持模型驱动的结构毒理学假设生成。

title: Verification-Aware Training for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a draft model to generate candidate tokens, which are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Verification proceeds sequentially and discards every position from the first rejection onward, yet existing draft training relies on token-level imitation of the target with a fixed per-position weighting that reflects neither property. We introduce Verification-Aware Training (VAT), a plug-in framework that simulates verification at every training step and turns the resulting accept and reject patterns into supervision. VAT consists of two components: (i) a verification head, a lightweight jointly trained binary classifier that supervises the draft model on whether each position survives sequential verification; (ii) verification-adaptive weighting, which replaces the fixed weighting schedule by keeping full weight up to each sample's first rejection point and re-anchoring the decay to start there. VAT modifies only the training objective, so it can be layered on top of existing methods without changing the draft architecture, the target model, or the inference procedure. Applied to EAGLE-3 and DFlash on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B, VAT improves average acceptance length by up to 11.4% and wall-clock speedup by up to 8.7%, with consistent gains across math, code, and chat benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/vat

AI.tldr: 本文提出验证感知训练（VAT）框架，通过在训练过程中模拟推理阶段的顺序验证过程，将接受/拒绝模式转化为监督信号，从而提升推测解码中草稿模型的生成质量，显著提高接受长度和推理加速比。
AI.motivation: 推测解码中，草稿模型生成候选令牌后需经目标模型顺序验证，从首个拒绝位置起所有后续位置都会被丢弃。然而现有草稿训练仅采用固定逐位置权重的令牌级仿拟目标，既未反映验证的"顺序性"（顺序依赖），也未反映"全丢弃"（一旦拒绝即全部作废）这两个关键特性，导致训练目标与推理机制不匹配。
AI.method: VAT包含两个核心组件：(i) 验证头——一个轻量级联合训练的二分类器，监督草稿模型判断每个位置能否通过顺序验证；(ii) 验证自适应加权——替代固定权重调度，在样本首个拒绝点之前保持全权重，并将衰减重新锚定到该位置开始。VAT仅修改训练目标，可即插即用地叠加到现有方法上，无需改变草稿架构、目标模型或推理流程。
AI.result: 在EAGLE-3和DFlash上应用于Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B，VAT将平均接受长度提升最多11.4%，端到端加速比提升最多8.7%，在数学、代码和对话基准上均取得一致的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: VAT通过将验证机制融入训练目标，有效弥合了草稿模型训练与推测解码推理之间的鸿沟，是一种轻量、通用且有效的插件式训练框架，在不改变推理流程的前提下显著提升推测解码效率。

title: Rethinking the Test-Time Prompt Tuning Objective from the Perspective of Calibration
summary: Test-time prompt tuning (TPT) has emerged as a powerful paradigm, refining prompts for each test sample via entropy minimization (EM) over multiple augmented views. However, we identify a limitation in the standard EM-based adaptation: it inherently drives the model toward overconfident predictions disregarding sample-specific uncertainty, leading to significant calibration degradation. To address these limitations, we propose a new objective that replaces the conventional EM loss by aligning the original-view prediction with a target distribution derived from augmented views via cross-entropy, while adversarially incorporating the entropy of the target distribution to capture sample-specific uncertainty. Furthermore, to better construct this target distribution, we apply confidence-aware temperature scaling to each augmented-view prediction according to its confidence, sharpening confident predictions while softening uncertain ones. This formulation allows the model to increase confidence only when the target distribution is reliable, while preserving uncertainty when it reflects ambiguous or conflicting augmented-view predictions. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy but also significantly improves model calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的测试时提示调优方法，通过交叉熵对齐原始视图预测与增强视图目标分布，并对抗性地纳入目标分布的熵来捕捉样本特定不确定性，同时采用置信度感知的温度缩放构建更可靠的目标分布，在提升准确率的同时显著改善模型校准。
AI.motivation: 标准的基于熵最小化（EM）的测试时提示调优存在固有缺陷：它倾向于使模型产生过度自信的预测，忽略了样本特定的不确定性，从而导致校准性能严重下降。作者希望解决这一校准退化问题。
AI.method: 1) 用交叉熵替代传统的EM损失，将原始视图预测与从增强视图推导的目标分布对齐；2) 对抗性地引入目标分布的熵项来捕捉样本特定不确定性；3) 采用置信度感知的温度缩放，根据每个增强视图预测的置信度进行锐化或软化处理，以构建更可靠的目标分布。
AI.result: 在多个多样化基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法不仅达到了最先进的准确率，还显著改善了模型校准性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将不确定性建模纳入测试时提示调优框架，能够在不牺牲准确率的前提下有效改善校准，为可靠深度学习提供了新的视角。

title: Measuring Memory and Generalization as Separable Geometric Channels: The Topo^2 Framework
summary: Deep networks trained on noisy labels simultaneously generalize on clean data and memorize flipped labels. These are usually conflated as pressures on one capacity. We present Topo^2, a measurement framework that makes them causally separable, measurable, and law-governed. Persistent-homology H1 structure of the representation space separates into a within-class manifold channel (a function of the training stopping point) and a cross-class channel (a monotone readout of memorized flipped samples). An intervention, the FM0 prescription (zero loss on flipped samples from epoch 0), reaches each setting's generalization ceiling while memorizing essentially nothing. Within the framework we establish a law set with graded evidence: (L2) FM0 separation prescription (9/9); (L1) the within-channel as a training-position function (mid-rise 6/6; convergence-back CIFAR 3/3, SVHN 2/3); (L3) a ring-construction identity (definitional, not a law); and TLS (memory-generalization topological layering): memory is causally additive, anchored (silencing clean collapses the representation), invertible (stripping memory restores near-ceiling generalization), and quantitatively billable (the memorization cost law, effective slope coefficient C ~ 0.38 at the reference capacity: CIFAR-10 0.3801 / SVHN 0.3806 / CIFAR-100 0.384 / VGG 0.3715, capacity-dependent in general and traced to clean-sample feature displacement). We also publish the framework's boundaries: a falsification ledger of nine dead ends, and an instrument-vindication section that excludes six families of global statistics as explanations of the within-channel. The framework turns "memorization" from an ill-defined capacity into a measurable, separable, invertible topological layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Topo²框架，利用持久同调的H1结构将深度网络在噪声标签训练中的"泛化"与"记忆"两个过程在因果上分离，并通过FM0干预实现几乎零记忆下的最优泛化，同时建立了记忆-泛化拓扑分层（TLS）及其定量规律。
AI.motivation: 深度网络在噪声标签上训练时，泛化（学习干净数据）和记忆（记住翻转标签）常被视为同一容量上的压力，难以区分。作者希望将这两个过程因果分离、可测量、并受规律支配。
AI.method: 利用表示空间的持久同调H1结构，将其分解为类内流形通道（与训练停止点相关的函数）和跨类通道（记忆翻转样本的单调读出）。提出FM0干预方案（从第0个epoch起对翻转样本施加零损失），并构建定律体系（L1-L3、TLS）以及伪造记录和仪器验证部分。
AI.result: FM0方案在9/9的设置中达到泛化上限且几乎不记忆；类内通道作为训练位置函数在多数实验中得到验证；建立了记忆成本定律，有效斜率系数C≈0.38（CIFAR-10: 0.3801, SVHN: 0.3806, CIFAR-100: 0.384, VGG: 0.3715），且与容量相关、可追溯到干净样本的特征位移。同时公开了九个死胡同的证伪记录以及排除六类全局统计量解释的验证部分。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将"记忆"从模糊的容量概念转变为可测量、可分离、可逆的拓扑层。记忆具有因果可加性、锚定性（抑制干净样本会破坏表示）、可逆性（剥离记忆可恢复近最优泛化）和可量化计费性（记忆成本定律）。

title: CAST: Critique-Aware Supervision for Training Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, interactive, and stateful environments. In these settings, a single wrong action, such as refunding the wrong purchase, can cause irreversible task failure and must be intercepted before execution. Such failures may not appear in every single run, but can emerge across repeated trials, making reliability across steps and trials critical. However, ensuring agentic reliability is challenging: even frontier LLMs struggle to explain why an action may be wrong, especially in long, intertwined trajectories governed by domain-specific policies. Much recent work relies on prompt-based critique agents, while optimization-based methods lack a systematic way to produce rich verification rationales for training. We address this gap with CAST, a critique-aware training framework that converts sparse task outcomes into action-level supervision for critique learning and policy optimization. CAST analyzes agent trajectories to synthesize structured rationales explaining action validity under partial observability. The resulting critique model is used to construct critique-aware training data for optimizing the policy model. Fine-tuning Qwen3-family models on dynamic tool-calling benchmarks, CAST improves reliability across domains, outperforming GPT-OSS-120B by over 10% pass^4 on Retail tasks and yielding an additional 9% improvement on Telehealth in an out-of-domain setting. These results demonstrate that critique-aware training improves the robustness of LLM agents in realistic dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAST框架，通过将稀疏的任务结果转化为动作级别的监督信号，用于批判学习和策略优化，从而提升LLM智能体在长周期、交互式、有状态环境中的可靠性。实验表明CAST在Retail和Telehealth等动态工具调用基准上显著优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长周期、有状态环境中，一个错误动作就可能导致不可逆的任务失败。现有方法中，基于提示的批评智能体缺乏系统性优化，而基于优化的方法无法生成丰富的验证推理过程用于训练。此外，最先进的LLM在解释动作为何错误方面存在困难。
AI.method: CAST是一个批判感知训练框架，包含三个关键步骤：1) 分析智能体轨迹，在部分可观测性下合成结构化推理过程来解释动作的有效性；2) 利用生成的批判模型构建批判感知训练数据；3) 基于这些数据优化策略模型（在Qwen3系列模型上进行微调）。
AI.result: 在动态工具调用基准上，CAST在Retail任务中比GPT-OSS-120B提升超过10%的pass^4指标，在Telehealth领域（域外设置）额外提升9%，证明了跨领域的可靠性提升。
AI.conclusion: 批判感知训练能够有效提升LLM智能体在真实动态环境中的鲁棒性，通过将任务结果转化为可理解的动作级推理，为智能体可靠性提供了一种系统化的训练方法。

title: CoLa-ICD: A Knowledge-Enhanced Framework for Long-Tail Automated Medical Coding
summary: Automatic medical coding assigns ICD codes to clinical notes, but it remains challenging due to long documents, imbalanced label distributions, and diverse terms. These challenges are especially severe for rare codes, which have limited training instances and are easily confused with semantically similar labels. We introduce CoLa-ICD, a knowledge-enhanced framework for long-tail prediction. CoLa-ICD enriches ICD labels with external terms, models dependencies among related codes, and learns stronger alignment between label semantics and clinical evidence for long-tail prediction. Experiments show that CoLa-ICD improves long-tail prediction with larger gains in larger and sparser label spaces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in AUC, F1, and P@k. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD.

AI.tldr: CoLa-ICD是一个知识增强的自动医疗编码框架，专门针对长尾ICD代码预测问题。它通过丰富ICD标签的外部术语、建模相关代码间的依赖关系，以及增强标签语义与临床证据之间的对齐，显著提升了长尾代码的预测性能，在更大更稀疏的标签空间中获得更大增益，并在AUC、F1和P@k指标上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 自动医疗编码面临长文档、标签分布不均衡和术语多样等挑战，其中稀有代码（长尾代码）问题尤为严重，因为它们在训练数据中实例稀少，且容易与语义相似的标签混淆。现有方法难以有效解决这一长尾预测难题。
AI.method: CoLa-ICD框架包含三个核心组件：(1)利用外部术语丰富ICD标签的语义表示；(2)建模相关ICD代码之间的依赖关系；(3)强化标签语义与临床证据之间的对齐学习，以提升长尾预测性能。
AI.result: 实验表明CoLa-ICD在长尾预测上取得显著改进，在更大和更稀疏的标签空间中增益更大，并在AUC、F1和P@k指标上达到最先进水平（state-of-the-art）。
AI.conclusion: CoLa-ICD通过知识增强的方法有效解决了自动医疗编码中的长尾预测问题，证明外部知识和标签间依赖关系建模对稀有代码预测具有重要价值，代码已开源。

title: Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving
summary: Plane geometry problem (PGP) solving has become a critical benchmark for multimodal reasoning because it requires accurate visual perception and precise multi-step symbolic deduction. Although test-time scaling (TTS) has demonstrated remarkable success in general mathematical reasoning, it fails to scale effectively under the symbolic-program paradigm for plane geometry. We identify two key obstacles: limited reasoning diversity induced by rigid symbolic programs and insufficient explicit visual grounding before symbolic deduction. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS), which converts each symbolic program into heterogeneous reasoning traces, including executable Python scripts and CoT-augmented variants. We further propose Perception-Augmented (PA) training, which parses diagrams into structured semantic clauses before deduction, and Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE) for efficient self-adaptive inference. Experiments on three geometry benchmarks show that our method consistently improves PGP-solving across model scales and achieves strong performance against both general-purpose MLLMs and specialized geometry solvers. Under test-time scaling, CG-MTE achieves comparable accuracy to high-budget self-consistency while reducing sampling cost by up to 8x. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Jason8Kang/ReTTS-PGPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS)方法解决平面几何问题（PGP）中测试时扩展（TTS）效率低下的问题，通过将符号程序转换为异构推理轨迹（包括可执行Python脚本和CoT增强变体），并结合Perception-Augmented (PA)训练和Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE)推理策略，在多个几何基准上显著提升了性能，同时将采样成本降低至原来的1/8。
AI.motivation: 平面几何问题求解需要精确的视觉感知和多步符号推理，是评估多模态推理能力的重要基准。虽然测试时扩展在一般数学推理中表现出色，但在符号程序范式下无法有效扩展，主要原因有两方面：一是刚性符号程序导致推理多样性不足；二是在符号演绎之前缺乏充分的显式视觉锚定。
AI.method: 提出了三个核心组件：(1) Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS)将每个符号程序转换为异构推理轨迹，包括可执行Python脚本和CoT增强变体，增加推理多样性；(2) Perception-Augmented (PA)训练在符号演绎前将图表解析为结构化语义子句，增强视觉感知；(3) Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE)用于高效的自我自适应推理，通过一致性引导实现智能集成。
AI.result: 在三个几何基准上的实验表明，该方法在不同模型规模上持续提升了PGP求解性能，优于通用多模态大语言模型和专用几何求解器。在测试时扩展场景下，CG-MTE在保持与高预算自我一致性相当的准确率的同时，将采样成本降低了最多8倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过增加推理轨迹的多样性并强化符号演绎前的视觉感知，可以有效解决平面几何问题中测试时扩展效率低下的问题，为PGP任务提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: LLM-Based Knowledge Graph Completion Combining Discrete Structural Coding with Similar Entity Information
comment: Accepted by ISWC 26 Posters and Demos Track
summary: Knowledge graph completion requires models to use both textual descriptions and relational structure. Existing LLM-based methods either encode KG structure as discrete tokens or refine a restricted set of candidate entities, and these two directions have largely been studied separately. We propose CoSC for LLM-based KGC, which combines discrete structural coding with similar entity information. Specifically, an LLM generates an initial candidate entity ranking from discrete structural codes, after which information from entities with structures similar to that of the query entity refines the ranking. Experiments on FB15k-237 show that CoSC outperforms existing baselines on MRR and Hits@10 while remaining competitive on Hits@1.

AI.tldr: CoSC是一种面向LLM的知识图谱补全方法，结合离散结构编码与相似实体信息，先由LLM基于离散结构码生成初始候选排序，再利用与查询实体结构相似的实体信息细化排序，在FB15k-237数据集上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的知识图谱补全方法存在两大局限：一是将知识图谱结构编码为离散token，二是仅对有限的候选实体进行精炼，这两类方法通常被分开研究，未能充分结合结构与相似实体信息的优势。
AI.method: 提出CoSC方法，包含两阶段流程：第一阶段由LLM基于离散结构编码生成初始候选实体排序；第二阶段利用与查询实体结构相似的实体信息来细化该排序，从而融合离散结构编码与相似实体信息两种信号。
AI.result: 在FB15k-237数据集上的实验表明，CoSC在MRR和Hits@10指标上优于现有基线，在Hits@1上也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CoSC通过将离散结构编码与相似实体信息相结合，能够有效提升LLM在知识图谱补全任务上的性能，验证了融合两种信息源的可行性。

title: Tensor Methods for Language Models: From Token Representation to Training, Adaptation, Inference, Compression, and Interpretability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are built from structured high-dimensional objects such as token representations, weights, adaptation updates, caches, and activations, whose multilinear structure is underexploited by the conventional matrix-centric view. Tensor decompositions and tensor networks provide a principled algebraic language for this structure, yet the literature often treats them as isolated compression mechanisms. This survey organizes tensor methods for LLMs through two complementary views: a seven-stage lifecycle taxonomy covering tokenization, embeddings, pre-training, adaptation, compression, inference, and interpretability, and a component view covering embeddings, attention, and feed-forward networks. We provide unified notation and theoretical foundations, analyze tensorization strategies for individual Transformer components, and compare methods at each lifecycle stage while making differences in evaluation protocols and model scales explicit. We further connect tensor methods to neighboring efficiency techniques and probabilistic tensor networks. Finally, we synthesize open challenges and introduce $ρ_{\rm gap}$, a metric for the compression-realization gap between theoretical memory reduction and measured system-level speedup. By treating tensorization as a common structural principle, the survey provides a structured entry point to tensorized language models and clarifies when parameter savings can plausibly translate into memory efficiency, computational efficiency, or interpretability. The GitHub page dedicated to this paper is accessible at \href{https://github.com/ma-tt-a/awesome-tensor-methods-for-llms}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述论文，系统性地组织并总结了张量方法在大语言模型（LLMs）中的应用，提出了七阶段生命周期分类法和组件视角两种互补的分析框架，并引入了压缩-实现差距指标ρ_gap来度量理论内存缩减与实际系统加速之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型由大量结构化高维对象组成（如token表示、权重、适配更新、缓存和激活），这些对象具有多重线性结构，但传统的矩阵中心视角未能充分利用这种结构。张量分解和张量网络提供了描述这些结构的代数语言，然而现有文献往往将它们视为孤立的压缩机制，缺乏系统性的组织和比较。
AI.method: 该综述通过两个互补视角组织张量方法：(1) 七阶段生命周期分类法，涵盖分词、嵌入、预训练、适配、压缩、推理和可解释性；(2) 组件视图，覆盖嵌入、注意力和前馈网络。文章提供统一符号和理论基础，分析Transformer各组件的张量化策略，比较各生命周期阶段的方法，并明确评估协议和模型规模的差异，同时将张量方法与邻近的效率技术及概率张量网络联系起来。
AI.result: 文章提供了对张量化语言模型的系统性梳理，比较了各生命周期阶段的张量方法在评估协议和模型规模上的差异，并引入了ρ_gap指标来量化理论内存缩减与实测系统级加速之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该综述将张量化视为一种通用的结构原则，为张量化语言模型提供了结构化的入门路径，并阐明了参数节省在何种条件下能够合理地转化为内存效率、计算效率或可解释性。同时综合了开放挑战，指出了该领域未来的研究方向。

title: CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.

AI.tldr: CPR（Critical-Point Routing）是一种在基础模型与其SFT专家模型之间进行token级路由的框架。通过识别基础模型失败但专家模型成功的"关键token"，训练轻量级分层路由器来决定何时调用专家模型，从而在保持领域性能的同时避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 监督微调（SFT）在将大语言模型适配到目标领域时，往往会导致灾难性遗忘，即模型通用能力下降。现有方法通过修改SFT损失来缓解遗忘，但本质上仍处于"领域-通用能力"的权衡之中，无法二者兼得。
AI.method: 提出CPR框架，在模型层面解耦领域能力与通用能力：保留原始基础模型负责通用能力，仅对"关键token"（基础模型失败但专家模型成功的token）选择性调用SFT专家。具体包括：(1) 训练轻量级分层路由器，估计每个token需要调用专家的概率；(2) 设计结合动量平滑和阈值门控的推理流程。
AI.result: 在多种模型-领域配置下，CPR在所有设置中达到最先进水平。相比SFT专家，领域性能提升1.4-5.5%，通用能力下降从3.4-14.5%恢复至最多仅0.5%，且仅在三分之一的token上调用专家，开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 通过token级选择性路由策略，CPR成功突破了领域-通用能力的权衡困境，以极小的推理开销实现了领域性能与通用能力兼得的效果。

title: Generating Workflow DAGs from Natural Language with Non-Reasoning LLMs
summary: This paper addresses the problem of translating natural-language routing rules written by business administrators into executable workflow graphs for enterprise contact centers. Each target is a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of conditional actions with parallel branches, hit-first fallback chains, and per-branch Boolean predicates, encoded in the JSON dialect of a commercial routing platform. We show that neuro-symbolic decomposition enables lower-cost, non-reasoning large language models to generate complex workflow DAGs at production-relevant quality without expensive extended-reasoning models. Our central diagnostic is an emission-density bottleneck: on a 635-rule benchmark of manufactured synthetic data, models select the correct graph nodes with high accuracy but increasingly misconfigure attributes and Boolean grouping as the number of interdependent nodes emitted in one pass grows. We therefore move combinatorial graph construction from the model into a deterministic compiler driven by a compact intermediate representation, with a learned registry-selection front end that focuses generation on relevant vocabulary. Across four models, the full system reaches approximately 89% LLM-judge validity, approximately 90% exact-match condition accuracy, and 99-100% valid JSON while using roughly half the per-rule prompt tokens of a monolithic prompt. On GPT-5.3-chat, the method improves judge validity by 24 percentage points and achieves statistical equivalence to a reasoning model's out-of-the-box quality, although an approximately 8-point frontier gap remains. We also present a deployment path and transferable lessons for structured-generation applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经-符号分解方法，将业务管理员编写的自然语言路由规则翻译为可执行的工作流DAG（有向无环图），使低成本的普通LLM无需昂贵的扩展推理模型即可生成生产级别质量的复杂工作流图。通过将组合图构建从模型转移到确定性编译器，并配合学习式注册表选择前端，系统在四个模型上达到约89%的LLM评判有效性、约90%的条件准确匹配率和99-100%的有效JSON输出。
AI.motivation: 企业中业务管理员需要将自然语言路由规则转化为可执行的复杂工作流DAG（含并行分支、hit-first回退链和布尔谓词），传统上依赖昂贵的长推理模型。作者发现基础LLM存在"发射密度瓶颈"：模型能高精度选择正确的图节点，但随单次发射的相互依赖节点数量增长，属性配置和布尔分组的错误率上升。
AI.method: 采用神经-符号分解：将组合图构造从LLM中剥离，交给确定性编译器处理，由紧凑的中间表示驱动；同时设计一个学习式注册表选择前端，使模型聚焦于相关词汇表。这种架构让非推理型低成本模型承担语言理解，而将结构生成交给确定性工具。
AI.result: 在635条规则的合成基准上，四个模型达到约89% LLM-judge有效性、约90%精确匹配条件准确率、99-100%有效JSON，每规则提示词元仅约为整体式提示的一半。在GPT-5.3-chat上，有效性提升24个百分点，与推理模型的开箱即用质量达到统计等价，但仍存在约8个百分点的前沿差距。
AI.conclusion: 神经-符号分解是一种降低结构化生成应用成本的有效范式：将组合博奕从模型转移至确定性编译器，使普通LLM达到接近高级推理模型的质量。文章同时提供了部署路径和可迁移的经验教训，对结构化生成应用具有参考价值。

title: GPAgentBench-2K: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Complex Clinical Action Space
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential as clinical agents, yet existing benchmarks reduce clinical workflows to static predictions or unconstrained Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with coarse action sets. To address this, we introduce GPAgentBench-2K, the first Constrained MDP (CMDP) LLM-agent benchmark for primary-care clinical decision-making, constructed from expert-validated records of real-world GP encounters. Our environment models a full spectrum of six foundational clinical actions, imposes a topological workflow prior over the action space, and operationalizes safety-informed abstention as a first-class outcome. Evaluating 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a significant performance degradation as the action space scales. Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases. Finally, we establish a reference point using Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), and show that while explicitly modeling constraints improves performance over unconstrained RL methods, it remains far from clinically acceptable safety.

AI.tldr: 提出了GPAgentBench-2K，首个面向初级医疗临床决策的约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）LLM智能体基准，基于真实全科医生就诊记录构建，评估16个SOTA LLM后发现模型在动作空间扩展时性能显著下降，且存在临床质量-安全差距：即使是前沿模型在高风险病例中也会有超过一半违反安全约束。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM临床基准将临床工作流简化为静态预测或带有粗粒度动作集的非约束MDP，无法真实反映临床决策中的约束条件和安全性要求，缺乏对初级医疗（全科医生）场景的专项评估基准。
AI.method: 从专家验证的真实GP就诊记录构建CMDP环境，建模六种基础临床动作的全谱，在动作空间上施加拓扑工作流先验，并将安全知情弃权（safe abstention）作为一等结果建模。同时引入C-GRPO（受约束的组相对策略优化）作为参照方法进行对比训练。
AI.result: 评估16个SOTA LLM，发现随着动作空间规模扩大，模型性能显著退化；揭示了临床质量-安全差距——前沿模型中诊断准确率最高的模型在高风险病例中有超半数违反安全约束；C-GRPO虽优于无约束RL方法，但距离临床可接受的安全水平仍有很大差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在临床决策中面临严重的约束满足挑战，显式建模约束的RL方法（如C-GRPO）虽能改善表现，但远未达到临床安全可接受的标准，凸显了该领域的开放问题。

title: SimCRAFT: Distilling Remote Sensing Agents via Synthetic Trajectories and Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning
summary: The unprecedented surge in Earth observation data volume and diversity has exposed a critical bottleneck for traditional manual workflows, catalyzing the emergence of Remote Sensing (RS) Agents. However, the practical deployment of these advanced agents is severely hindered by their heavy reliance on large-scale general-purpose LLMs, which lack deep domain expertise and impose prohibitive infrastructure demands. To resolve this, we propose SimCRAFT, a model-agnostic framework that distills sophisticated RS orchestration capabilities into a compact 7B-scale model. Addressing data scarcity, we first pair a multiagent synthesis engine with a Mock Execution Engine that checks schema correctness, inter-tool dependencies, and sensor/tool compatibility, producing SimRS-14k, a large-scale, constraint-validated workflow planning corpus. Second, we propose Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (CRAFT) that finetunes the model to reason analogically by adapting retrieved Standard Operating Procedures to novel queries under a noise-robust objective, generalizing RAFT to multi-step RS workflow planning without mechanical copying. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SimCRAFT-7B significantly outperforms openweights LLMs and rivals advanced closedsource models and specialized RS agents, while reproducing across three 7B backbones. This work contributes a competitive open-weights baseline for lightweight RS intelligence, enabling efficient autonomous deployment under resource-constrained or resource-conserving conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimCRAFT，一个模型无关的框架，将复杂的遥感（RS）编排能力蒸馏为紧凑的7B规模模型。通过多智能体合成引擎和Mock执行引擎生成约束验证的工作流规划语料库SimRS-14k，并提出上下文检索增强微调（CRAFT）方法，使模型能类比推理而非机械复制。实验表明SimCRAFT-7B显著优于开源LLM，可媲美高级闭源模型和专业RS智能体，并在三个7B骨干网络上可复现。
AI.motivation: 遥感数据量的激增使传统人工工作流成为瓶颈，促进了RS Agent的出现。然而现有高级智能体严重依赖大规模通用LLM，缺乏领域专业知识且基础设施开销巨大，阻碍了实际部署。作者旨在解决这一部署瓶颈，实现轻量高效的遥感智能。
AI.method: 1）针对数据稀缺，将多智能体合成引擎与Mock执行引擎配对，后者验证模式正确性、工具间依赖及传感器/工具兼容性，生成大规模约束验证的工作流规划语料库SimRS-14k；2）提出上下文化检索增强微调（CRAFT），通过噪声鲁棒目标微调模型，使模型从检索到的标准操作流程（SOP）中类比推理以适配新查询，将RAFT泛化到多步RS工作流规划，避免机械复制。
AI.result: 实验表明SimCRAFT-7B显著优于开放权重LLM，与高级闭源模型和专业RS智能体相当，且在三个不同的7B骨干网络上都能复现良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 本工作贡献了一个有竞争力的开放权重轻量级RS智能基线，使得在资源受限或资源节约条件下实现高效的自主部署成为可能。

title: PAC: Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning of LLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is used to improve the reasoning abilities of LLMs, while training data span heterogeneous tasks. However, most RL post-training pipelines rely on fixed or manually designed task mixtures, even though task usefulness changes as training progresses. Online curriculum methods often define learnability by update magnitude, ignoring whether the update translates into reward gains, which can misallocate rollout budget toward tasks with large but ineffective updates. We propose PAC, a Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for multi-task RL of LLMs that combines two task-level signals: advantage-derived learnability, which measures the magnitude of the policy update a task can induce, and recent reward gains, which show whether those updates have improved task performance. A Bayesian Thompson Sampling controller uses these signals to allocate rollouts across tasks during GRPO training. We evaluate PAC under two settings: a multi-level reasoning setting and a multi-domain reasoning setting. PAC improves sample efficiency and final performance: it reaches comparable validation scores with fewer rollout steps and achieves higher final averages than random sampling and advantage-based curriculum baselines in both settings. These results show that jointly tracking advantage signals and actual reward gains yields an effective online curriculum for LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出PAC（Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum），一种面向LLM多任务强化学习的在线课程学习方法，结合优势信号（衡量策略更新幅度）和奖励增益（衡量实际性能提升），通过贝叶斯汤普森采样动态分配各任务的采样预算，提升样本效率和最终性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RL后训练依赖固定或人工设计的任务混合比例，无法适应训练过程中任务有用性的动态变化；已有的在线课程方法仅以更新幅度定义可学习性，忽略了更新是否转化为实际奖励提升，可能导致采样预算被分配到产生大但无效更新的任务上。
AI.method: PAC结合两个任务级信号：优势派生可学习性（测量任务能引发的策略更新幅度）和近期奖励增益（反映更新是否改善任务性能）；采用贝叶斯汤普森采样控制器在GRPO训练过程中跨任务分配rollout预算。
AI.result: 在多层次推理和多领域推理两种评估设置下，PAC比随机采样和基于优势的课程基线达到可比验证分数所需的rollout步骤更少，最终平均分数更高，展现出更好的样本效率和最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 同时追踪优势信号和实际奖励增益能生成有效的LLM后训练在线课程，优于仅依赖单一信号的课程设计方法。

title: ALTSTEER: Selective Safety Steering for Moving Beyond Hard Refusals to Constructive Alternatives
summary: Safety alignment is essential for deploying large language models, requiring systems to prevent harmful compliance while preserving helpfulness on benign requests. Activation steering offers a training-free inference-time approach to safety control, but effective safety steering requires addressing two coupled questions: when to intervene and how generation should be shaped after intervention. However, existing safety steering methods remain limited along both dimensions, as their triggering mechanisms can be unstable across domains and refusal-oriented steering often yields rigid refusals rather than constructive safe guidance. To address these limitations, we propose ALTSTEER, an inference-time framework that couples selective intervention with refusal-anchored constructive redirection within a single inference pass. ALTSTEER uses an internal refusal-relevant signal to decide when to steer, and applies staged steering to shift generation from refusal-oriented control toward constructive alternatives. Evaluations on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 show that ALTSTEER preserves benign utility while improving constructive safe-completion behavior, especially on models that otherwise tend to produce short refusals for harmful requests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ALTSTEER，一个推理时的安全对齐框架，通过将选择性干预与拒绝锚定的建设性重定向相结合，在同一推理过程中同时解决"何时干预"和"干预后如何生成"两个问题。在Llama-3.1和Qwen2.5上的评估显示，该方法在保持良性请求效用的同时，提升了建设性安全完成行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全steering方法存在两个局限：(1)触发机制在不同领域间可能不稳定；(2)拒绝导向的steering往往产生僵硬的拒绝而非建设性的安全引导。这两个问题（何时干预、干预后如何生成）是耦合的，但现有方法未能很好地同时解决。
AI.method: ALTSTEER采用推理时框架，包含两个关键组件：(1)利用内部拒绝相关信号来决定何时进行steering（选择性干预）；(2)采用分阶段steering将生成从拒绝导向控制转向建设性替代方案（拒绝锚定的建设性重定向）。两者在单个推理过程中耦合实现。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1和Qwen2.5上的实验表明，ALTSTEER保持了良性请求的效用，同时改善了建设性安全完成行为，尤其是在那些原本容易对有害请求产生简短拒绝的模型上效果显著。
AI.conclusion: ALTSTEER通过同时解决"何时干预"和"如何引导生成"两个耦合问题，在推理时实现了更有效的安全控制，为安全对齐提供了一种无需训练的可扩展方案。

title: Ignorance or Incompetence? Constructing Knowledge-Gated, Verifiable Tasks for LLM Agents
summary: Professional agent tasks often depend on conventions that are absent from public corpora, yet benchmarks rarely control whether an agent has access to those conventions. We introduce a knowledge-gated task-construction protocol that separates a task instruction from a compact artefact containing private conventions, reference tables, and utility operators. Construction-time provenance, byte-identical task instructions across the provided- and withheld-artefact conditions, leak audits, and executable witnesses make dependence on the artefact explicit and testable. Across fifteen calibration tasks, one frontier agent configuration achieves a 68.0% pass rate with the artefact and 0% without it; on one task, a plausible but incorrect artefact also yields 0% across five trials. Deterministic solvers and rule corpora provide exact ground truth for structured tasks, while named criterion-level rubrics support outputs that cannot be checked by a single executable oracle. A configuration-relative calibration screen retains seven tasks satisfying our five-trial empirical knowledge-gating screen. These experiments validate the behavior of the construction protocol; they do not establish that the retained tasks improve post-training. We publicly release part of the task suite and supporting tooling at https://github.com/DatagridsAI/Knowledge-Gated-Task-Construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种知识门控的任务构建协议，将任务指令与包含私有约定、参考表和工具的工件分离，以显式测试智能体是否依赖这些私有知识。实验发现某前沿智能体在有工件时通过率68%，无工件时为0%，验证了协议的有效性。
AI.motivation: 专业智能体任务常依赖于公开语料中不存在的约定（惯例），但现有基准很少控制智能体是否能访问这些约定。这导致无法区分智能体是真正理解任务还是仅依赖公开知识，因此需要一种机制来显式构建和测试任务对私有工件的依赖。
AI.method: 提出知识门控任务构建协议，包含四个关键要素：(1)将任务指令与紧凑工件（含私有约定、参考表和工具算子）分离；(2)构造时可追溯性，确保提供与保留工件条件下任务指令逐字节一致；(3)泄漏审计与可执行见证，使对工件的依赖性显式且可测试；(4)使用确定性求解器和规则语料库为结构化任务提供精确真值，命名标准级评分标准支持无法由单一可执行预言机检查的输出。此外设计了配置相对的校准筛选，保留通过五轮经验知识门控筛选的七个任务。
AI.result: 在十五个校准任务中，某前沿智能体配置在提供工件时达到68.0%的通过率，而在无工件时通过率为0%；在某一任务上，使用看似合理但错误的工件在五轮试验中也获得0%。通过五轮经验知识门控筛选后保留了七个任务；此外部分任务套件和工具已在GitHub上公开。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了构建协议的行为正确性，表明该协议能有效创建对私有工件有显式依赖的任务，并能筛选出满足知识门控条件的任务。但作者明确指出这些实验并不证明保留的任务能改善训练后的性能，这是未来需进一步检验的方向。

title: Q-Strata: Hierarchical Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
summary: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) assigns a different bitwidth to each linear layer of a large language model (LLM) to minimize the quantization-induced quality loss under a fixed budget, but Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models contain these layers in every expert of every MoE block, so the allocation space grows far larger than in a dense model. Existing methods either allocate within each block under a uniform per-block budget, or allocate across blocks through an additive proxy, and neither directly optimizes a model-level objective over the choices that couple the blocks. We propose Q-Strata, a bi-level allocator that ranks within-block assignments with a cheap proxy and allocates across blocks with a model-level objective evaluated on the assembled quantized model. Its inner stage caches a Pareto frontier of candidates per block over finely spaced budgets, leaving the outer stage to set one budget per block instead of a bitwidth for every linear layer. With the search reduced to one budget per block, the outer stage optimizes this model-level objective directly, capturing the inter-block coupling that additive proxies miss. On Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Q-Strata consistently achieves lower WikiText2 perplexity than uniform-bitwidth GPTQ and the state-of-the-art MoE MPQ methods MxMoE and GEMQ in the low-bit regime. The code is available at https://github.com/snu-mllab/Q-Strata/tree/main.

AI.tldr: Q-Strata 是一种用于 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 大语言模型的双层混合精度量化分配方法。其内层阶段通过廉价代理为每个块缓存覆盖精细预算的帕累托前沿候选，外层阶段则以模型级目标直接优化每个块的预算分配，从而捕捉块间耦合关系。在 Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上，Q-Strata 在低比特率场景下比均匀位宽 GPTQ 及现有最优方法 MxMoE 和 GEMQ 取得了更低的 WikiText2 困惑度。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型中的每个专家都包含线性层，导致混合精度量化的分配空间远大于稠密模型。现有方法要么在每块均匀预算下进行块内分配，要么通过加法代理进行跨块分配，均未直接优化耦合块间选择的模型级目标。
AI.method: 提出双层分配器 Q-Strata：(1) 内层阶段使用廉价代理对块内赋值进行排序，为每个块在精细间隔的预算上缓存帕累托前沿候选；(2) 外层阶段将搜索空间简化为每块一个预算，直接优化在组装后的量化模型上评估的模型级目标，从而捕捉加法代理忽略的块间耦合。
AI.result: 在 Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 三个 MoE 模型上，Q-Strata 在低比特率场景下一致地取得了比均匀位宽 GPTQ、MxMoE 和 GEMQ 更低的 WikiText2 困惑度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将搜索空间从每个线性层的位宽减少到每块一个预算，Q-Strata 能够直接优化模型级目标，有效解决了 MoE 模型跨块分配耦合问题，显著提升了低比特率下的量化性能。代码已开源。

title: When Errors Become Memories: Causal Pathway Tracing in Multi-Turn Memory-Augmented LLMs
summary: Long-term memory enables large language models (LLMs) to preserve and reuse information across interactions, but it can also turn localized errors into persistent risks. Existing work mainly evaluates whether memory systems store and retrieve information correctly, leaving limited understanding of how errors propagate across responses, memory states, and future interactions. We propose a structural causal model (SCM)-based framework for cross-turn error propagation in memory-augmented LLMs. We model user questions, model responses, and memory states as a dynamic causal process, and identify two entry pathways: internal memory updating and external question feedback. By intervening on these pathways, we construct four counterfactual trajectories and quantify their downstream effects and interaction. Error influence is evaluated at four levels: memory retention, natural responses, targeted diagnostic probing, and probability-level error preference. Experiments show that error influence generally decays with interaction distance, while the memory-update pathway contributes more persistent effects than question feedback; latent errors may remain even after disappearing from natural responses. Propagation patterns also vary across memory categories and memory mechanisms. Pathway-guided restoration further validates this decomposition: Question Repair reduces residual error by 27.5%, Memory Repair by 70.2%, and Joint Repair by 98.3%, nearly eliminating residual propagation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于结构因果模型（SCM）的框架，用于分析记忆增强型大语言模型中跨轮次错误传播的机制，识别内部记忆更新和外部问题反馈两条错误进入路径，并通过四条反事实轨迹量化错误在下游效应中的传播与交互。实验发现错误影响随交互距离衰减，记忆更新路径影响更持久，且潜在错误在自然响应中消失后仍可能存在。基于路径分解的修复策略几乎完全消除了残留传播。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要评估记忆系统能否正确存储和检索信息，缺乏对错误如何跨响应、记忆状态及未来交互传播的系统性理解。由于长期记忆既带来便利也可能将局部错误固化为持久风险，因此亟需建立量化错误传播机制的框架。
AI.method: 构建基于结构因果模型（SCM）的动态因果框架，将用户问题、模型响应和记忆状态建模为动态因果过程。识别记忆更新和问题反馈两条错误入口路径，通过干预构造四条反事实轨迹，并在四个层面（记忆保留、自然响应、目标诊断探测、概率级错误偏好）评估错误影响，同时进行路径引导的修复验证。
AI.result: 错误影响通常随交互距离衰减，但记忆更新路径比问题反馈产生更持久的影响；潜在错误在从自然响应消失后仍可能保留。传播模式因记忆类别和记忆机制而异。修复实验表明：问题修复减少27.5%残留错误，记忆修复减少70.2%，联合修复达到98.3%，几乎完全消除残留传播。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了对记忆增强LLM中错误传播的因果视角，揭示了不同错误路径的持久性差异及潜在错误存在的隐蔽性，并证明路径引导的联合修复策略能显著降低甚至消除错误传播，为设计更可靠的长期记忆系统提供了理论指导和实践方法。

title: Answer Probing-Guided Search for Diverse Solution Exploration of LLMs
summary: Generating multiple diverse and high-quality solutions is valuable for many applications, such as code-test generation and drug discovery. However, Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to converge on a single high-confidence solution during inference, limiting exploration of alternative valid solution paths. Existing test-time methods promote diversity through tree-like search and prune semantically similar branches using response-level semantic embeddings. However, we find that such embeddings are easily confounded by linguistic and stylistic similarities, making it difficult to distinguish genuinely distinct solution paths. To address this, we introduce Answer Probing, which probes the potential answer an LLM would reach from an intermediate reasoning path. We demonstrate that the hidden states of probed answers more effectively differentiate distinct solution paths than semantic embeddings, and the perplexity of probed answers serves as a practical proxy for reasoning correctness. Based on these findings, we propose Answer Probing-Guided Tree Search (APTS), which guides the tree search by the probed answers' hidden state similarity and perplexity. Experiments on three reasoning tasks across two LLMs show that APTS consistently enhances solution diversity, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Answer Probing-Guided Tree Search (APTS)，通过探测LLM从中间推理路径可能得出的答案，利用答案的隐藏状态相似度和困惑度来引导树搜索，从而在推理过程中生成更多样化且高质量的解决方案。
AI.motivation: LLM在推理时倾向于收敛到单一高置信度解，限制了多样解的探索。现有基于语义嵌入的方法容易被语言和风格上的相似性混淆，难以区分真正不同的推理路径，因此需要更好的多样性度量方法。
AI.method: 提出Answer Probing技术：从中间推理路径探测LLM可能到达的答案，证明答案的隐藏状态比语义嵌入更有效地区分不同解路径，且答案的困惑度可作为推理正确性的实用代理。基于此构建APTS，用探测答案的隐藏状态相似度和困惑度来引导树搜索。
AI.result: 在两个LLM上的三个推理任务实验中，APTS一致性地提升了解决方案的多样性，展示了其有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 答案探测的隐藏状态和困惑度是比语义嵌入更优越的多样性引导信号，基于此的APTS方法能有效增强LLM推理中的解决方案多样性。

title: Collapsibility of Performance Metrics in Clinical Predictive AI
summary:
Background: Population level assessments of predictive artificial intelligence (AI) can conceal performance disparities across subgroups. Fairness evaluations commonly rely on performance analyses across subgroups. However, some performance metrics are non-collapsible, meaning that the overall population performance value does not equal the weighted average of subgroup specific values.
  Objective: To examine the collapsibility properties of commonly reported performance metrics in predictive AI, with a focus on the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, also known as c-statistic).
  Methods: We investigate the collapsibility of 15 performance metrics, either by expressing each metric as a linear combination of its stratum specific values or, where non-collapsible, by providing a counterexample inspired by Simpson's paradox as a formal disproof.
  Results: Five performance metrics (AUC, calibration intercept, calibration slope, expected calibration error, and Nagelkerke R^2) are shown to be non-collapsible, and ten (O:E ratio, logloss, Brier score, accuracy, F1-score, true positive rate, true negative rate, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and net benefit) are shown to be collapsible.
