title: Sequential Trajectories and Simultaneous Blending: Multi-Emotion Modeling for Instruction-Following TTS
comment: Code is available at https://github.com/ictnlp/HybridEmo. Demo page: https://zhouyan19.github.io/HybridEmo-demo/
summary: Natural-language instructions enable flexible control of synthesized speech, yet emotional TTS systems primarily model a single utterance-level affect, leaving multi-emotion control underexplored. We study two complementary multi-emotion TTS tasks: emotion trajectory, which spans several ordered affective stages, and emotion blending, in which multiple emotions coexist throughout an utterance. These tasks expose a supervision mismatch: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) does not explicitly evaluate emotion features, while single-emotion rewards provide neither structure-aware feedback for trajectory completion nor pair-aware feedback for blending. We introduce HybridEmo, a post-training framework that initializes both tasks with SFT and then aligns the speech-token policy through Group Relative Policy Optimization using a sample-aware hybrid reward. For trajectory samples, segment-aligned consistency combines average and weakest-stage evidence to preserve the correctness and completeness of prescribed stages. For blending samples, a GMM-based reward combines frame-level support from the union of target-emotion anchors in an offline emotion space with an utterance-level weaker-target margin. Both branches share an ASR reward and are routed within a unified policy. On MultiEmo-Test, HybridEmo significantly improves trajectory correctness and blending intensity, without a noticeable degradation in speaker similarity. Human evaluation prefers HybridEmo to CosyVoice 3 and EmoVoice-0.5B, with nearly balanced preferences against Qwen3-TTS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HybridEmo，一个面向多情感TTS的后训练框架，通过GRPO和样本感知混合奖励同时解决情感轨迹（顺序情感阶段）和情感混合（多重情感共存）两个任务，显著提升轨迹正确性和混合强度且不损害说话人相似度。
AI.motivation: 现有情感TTS主要建模单一话语级情感，多情感控制（轨迹和混合）未被充分探索。监督微调(SFT)不显式评估情感特征，而单情感奖励既缺乏结构感知的轨迹完成反馈，也缺乏成对感知的混合反馈，存在监督不匹配问题。
AI.method: HybridEmo采用两阶段框架：先用SFT初始化两个任务，再通过GRPO对齐话语标记策略。奖励设计为混合式：(1)轨迹样本采用分段对齐一致性，结合平均和最弱阶段证据；(2)混合样本采用基于GMM的奖励，结合离线情感空间中目标情感锚的帧级支持与话语级弱目标边际。两个分支共享ASR奖励并在统一策略中路由。
AI.result: 在MultiEmo-Test上，HybridEmo显著提升轨迹正确性和混合强度，说话人相似度无显著退化。人工评测优于CosyVoice 3和EmoVoice-0.5B，与Qwen3-TTS偏好近乎平衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过混合奖励设计，HybridEmo有效弥补了SFT和单情感奖励的监督缺口，实现了多情感TTS中轨迹和混合两个任务的统一后训练对齐，验证了策略优化方法在多维情感控制中的有效性。

title: Designing an Auditable LLM-Supported Workflow for Qualitative Thematic Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for scaling qualitative analysis, but existing applications often provide limited methodological transparency regarding how qualitative methods are translated into computational procedures. This paper presents an auditable and privacy-preserving computational operationalization of inductive and latent Thematic Analysis (TA). This paper first derives five design principles from the methodological requirements of TA and the conditions introduced by LLM-based inference: preserving interpretative context, maintaining traceable relationships between empirical material and analytical outputs, representing analytical constructs and reasoning explicitly, constraining LLM inference to interpretative tasks, and enabling privacy-preserving local deployment. Second, it presents a proof-of-concept for a two-phase workflow that operationalizes these principles by combining interpretative LLM inference with deterministic procedural control to generate codes, analytical justifications, themes, and theme descriptions while preserving explicit links to the source material. Third, it proposes an evaluation framework combining structural comparison with human-led TA and independent expert assessment of analytical quality. The evaluation is conducted on semi-structured Danish interview transcripts. and the results shows that the workflow produces code-level outputs with coverage broadly comparable to human annotations and highly rated analytical justifications, while generating a more compressed thematic structure characterized by fewer and broader themes. The findings demonstrate the feasibility of auditable LLM-supported TA through a modular workflow designed to scale to larger datasets, accommodate different LLMs, and support transfer across research domains, with domain adaptation primarily requiring adjustments to the prompting strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可审计且隐私保护的计算化操作方案，用于归纳和潜在主题分析（TA），通过两阶段工作流结合解释性LLM推理与确定性程序控制，生成代码、分析理由、主题及主题描述，并保持与原始材料的显式链接。在丹麦语半结构化访谈数据上评估，结果显示代码级输出覆盖度与人工标注相当，但生成的主题结构更压缩（更少更广）。
AI.motivation: LLM为大规模定性分析提供了新可能，但现有应用在方法论透明度方面有限，即定性方法如何被转化为计算程序的过程不清晰。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，提供可审计的LLM支撑的主题分析方案。
AI.method: 首先从TA方法论要求和LLM推理条件推导出五个设计原则（保留解释语境、维护实证材料与分析输出之间的可追溯关系、显式表达分析构念和推理、约束LLM推理于解释性任务、支持隐私保护的本地部署）。其次提出两阶段工作流的概念验证，结合解释性LLM推理与确定性程序控制。最后提出结合结构比较、人工TA和独立专家评估的评价框架。
AI.result: 在丹麦语半结构化访谈转录上评估，工作流产生的代码级输出覆盖度与人工标注大致相当，分析理由获得高评分；但产生更压缩的主题结构，主题数量更少、范围更广。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了可审计的LLM支撑TA的可行性，该模块化工作流可扩展到更大数据集、适配不同LLM，并支持跨研究领域迁移（领域适配主要需调整提示策略）。

title: E-Commerce Bench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Business Operation
summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks go beyond chaining short tasks over more interaction turns. Their evolving dynamic environments and long-range dependencies require Large Language Models (LLMs) to continually explore, learn from experience, and adapt their policies over thousands of steps. We introduce E-Commerce Bench, the first open-source benchmark that integrates multi-round counterpart negotiation and dynamic events into a year-long business operation. Over a 365-day year, an LLM agent concurrently runs multiple online stores, researching the market, negotiating with suppliers to source inventory, optimizing sales strategies, fulfilling orders, handling returns, and managing cash flow to maximize its end-of-year total assets. To construct a realistic merchant-side operating environment, the product and supplier data are derived from a real e-commerce platform, while a year-long calendar of promotions, natural disasters, and supply-chain shocks continually reshapes demand. For reproducibility, both sides of the market are deterministic: customer purchases and returns follow a fixed demand model, while a negotiation kernel determines supplier pricing, concessions, and decisions, with an LLM used only to verbalize them. We evaluate 18 frontier models across seven dimensions, including year-end assets, and find that no single model dominates. GPT-5.6 Sol earns the most, growing the 100,000 opening stake into 1,431,425, yet it ranks 16th of 18 on fraud avoidance and trails Fable5 in operational efficiency. Among open-weight models, Qwen3.8-Max-Preview leads with 416,252, 38% above GLM 5.2 (high), and achieves the strongest learning over the horizon, progressively bargaining down prices across repeated orders. Our code is available at https://github.com/QwenLM/E-CommerceBench.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍E-Commerce Bench，首个将多轮谈判和动态事件整合进长达一年商业运营的开源基准测试。LLM代理需同时运营多家在线商店，在365天中研究市场、与供应商谈判、优化销售策略、处理订单退货和管理现金流，以最大化年末总资产。基准基于真实电商平台数据构建，市场两侧均确定性可复现。评估了18个前沿模型，发现没有单一模型在所有维度占优。
AI.motivation: 长时程代理任务不仅是在更多交互轮次上串联短任务，其动态环境和长程依赖要求LLM在数千步中持续探索、从经验中学习并调整策略。现有基准缺乏能够评估这种长期适应性能力的场景。
AI.method: 构建E-Commerce Bench基准：(1) 整合多轮谈判和动态事件于365天商业运营中；(2) 产品与供应商数据来自真实电商平台；(3) 一年日历涵盖促销、自然灾害和供应链冲击重塑需求；(4) 市场两侧确定性设计——客户购买/退货遵循固定需求模型，谈判内核决定供应商定价，LLM仅用于语言表达。
AI.result: 评估18个前沿模型在7个维度（含年末资产）的表现。GPT-5.6 Sol以100,000启动资金赚到1,431,425最高收益，但在欺诈规避上排名16/18，运营效率逊于Fable5。开源模型中Qwen3.8-Max-Preview以416,252领先，比GLM 5.2高38%，并展现了最强随时间的策略学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 该基准揭示了没有单一模型在所有维度占优的现实，长时程运营任务需要模型在收益追求与风险评估、运营效率等多方面取得平衡，为未来LLM长期自适应能力研究提供了全面的评测平台。

title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Measuring Context Use on a Bilingual Bangladesh Legal Benchmark
summary: Fine-tuning can improve legal question-answering accuracy without improving how models use law supplied in context. We study this distinction in bilingual Bangladeshi legal QA, where observed errors can arise from answer scoring, retrieval, or failure to use relevant law. We construct a hierarchy-preserving statutory corpus, 2,165 reviewed bilingual fine-tuning examples, and a 150-item supplied-law control. We evaluate six instruction-tuned models: Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Gemma-4-E2B, with three LoRA seeds per model. To separate effects, we combine constrained option-letter scoring, cyclic option rotation, and controlled removal of the governing provision. On 398 Bar Council outputs, an exact-line parser attributes an accuracy gain of 50.0\% to the Qwen3.5-2B seed-42 adapter, whereas option scoring yields only $3.0\%$. For Gemma-4-E2B, the two scoring methods favor different systems. When the governing provision is guaranteed to be present, five of six reference models improve by $14.7\%-19.3\%$ under the four-order criterion. Removing that provision reduces accuracy by $8.0\%-15.3\%$ for models and by $13.8\%-14.9\%$ points for their adapters. However, difference-in differences estimates show no increase in reliance on the governing provision after fine-tuning. Results show that legal adaptation claims require separating scorer, retriever, and model effects. Our Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bangladesh-legal-qa-11E3

AI.tldr: 本文研究微调能否提升法律问答准确率而不提升模型对上下文法律条文的利用能力。在孟加拉语双语法律问答场景中，通过层级保留的法规语料库、2165条人工审核的双语微调样本和150项提供法律对照实验，对6个指令微调模型（Llama-3.2系列、Qwen3.5系列、Gemma-4-E2B）各用3个LoRA种子进行评测。通过受限选项字母评分、循环选项轮转、删除主要法律条文等分离手段发现：Qwen3.5-2B的seed-42适配器在线条解析下准确率提升50.0%，但选项评分仅提升3.0%；双重差分估计显示微调后模型对主要法律条文的依赖并未增加，说明法律领域适配声明需要区分评分器、检索器和模型三者的效应。
AI.motivation: 法律问答中微调可以提升准确率，但模型是否真正学会利用提供的法律条文尚不清楚。在孟加拉双语法律问答中，错误可能来自答案评分、检索或未使用相关法律，需要区分这些因素来验证法律适配的真实效果。
AI.method: 构建层级保留的法规语料库、2165条双语微调样本和150项提供法律对照实验。对6个指令微调模型各用3个LoRA种子训练，采用受限选项字母评分、循环选项轮转、控制性移除主要法律条文三种手段分离评分器、检索器与模型效应，并用精确行解析器和双重差分估计进行分析。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-2B seed-42适配器在精确行解析下准确率提升50.0%，但选项评分仅得3.0%。主要法律条文保证存在时，6个参考模型中有5个提升14.7%-19.3%；移除该条文则使模型准确率下降8.0%-15.3%，适配器下降13.8%-14.9%。但双重差分估计显示微调后模型对主要条文的依赖没有显著增加。
AI.conclusion: 微调带来的准确率提升更多来自答案评分机制的改进，而非模型对法律条文利用能力的提升。法律领域适配的评估必须分离评分器、检索器和模型效应，否则会得出误导性结论。

title: GarmentWeaver: Schema-Aware Structured Synthesis for Multimodal Sewing Patterns
summary: Multimodal Sewing pattern generation aims to infer executable sewing patterns from design cues such as sketches and textual descriptions. As an interpretable and simulation-compatible representation, sewing patterns are particularly valuable for digital garment creation. However, existing methods often model garment specifications as flat long sequences, which entangles garment structure with detailed parameters and leads to redundant components, inaccurate local details, and poor simulation compatibility. In this paper, we present GarmentWeaver, a schema-aware framework for multimodal Sewing pattern generation. GarmentWeaver constructs compact hierarchical targets by activating garment-relevant structural branches and predicts executable Sewing patterns in a structured manner. Specifically, we introduce a schema-aware target construction strategy, build the generator on top of a pretrained vision-language model for multimodal garment understanding, and impose feasibility-aware regularization to encourage structurally valid and simulation-compatible outputs. Extensive experiments show that GarmentWeaver produces more accurate and more executable sewing patterns than strong baselines, while also yielding better simulation results. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of schema-aware structured generation for reliable multimodal Sewing pattern prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GarmentWeaver框架，通过模式感知的层级目标构建和结构化预测方式，实现多模态服装缝纫图案生成，相比基线方法在精度和模拟兼容性上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有服装缝纫图案生成方法将服装规格建模为扁平的长序列，导致服装结构与详细参数纠缠不清，产生冗余组件、局部细节不准确以及模拟兼容性差的问题。
AI.method: GarmentWeaver采用模式感知框架，通过激活服装相关结构分支构建紧凑的层级目标，基于预训练视觉-语言模型构建生成器以支持多模态服装理解，并引入可行性感知正则化以鼓励结构有效且模拟兼容的输出。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GarmentWeaver相比强基线方法生成了更准确、更具可执行性的缝纫图案，同时也取得了更好的模拟结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了模式感知的结构化生成方法对于可靠的多模态缝纫图案预测是有效的。

title: Functional Degeneracy in Neural Networks: Measurement and Pruning
summary: A central question in modern machine learning is how much a trained model can be compressed without changing its behavior, to reduce the memory, compute and energy required to deploy it. To study this, we quantify functional degeneracy through the behavioral recovery rank, defined as the number of leading behavioral-Hessian eigendirections required to recover a trained model's performance. Using the behavioral recovery rank as a geometric benchmark for compression, we find that structural and magnitude pruning retain more degrees of freedom, even after the task is saturated. This gap suggests that functional redundancy is distributed across parameter directions and is not exposed by individual weights or neurons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为恢复秩（behavioral recovery rank）来量化训练模型的功能退化性，即恢复模型性能所需的领先行为-海森特征方向数量，并将其作为压缩的几何基准。研究发现结构和幅度剪枝在任务饱和后仍保留更多自由度，表明功能冗余分布在参数方向上，而非单个权重或神经元所暴露。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是在现代机器学习中，训练后的模型能被压缩多少而不改变其行为，以降低部署所需的内存、计算和能耗。需要一个量化工具来衡量模型的功能退化程度，从而指导更有效的压缩策略。
AI.method: 定义行为恢复秩（behavioral recovery rank），即恢复训练模型性能所需的前导行为-海森（behavioral-Hessian）特征方向数量，以此作为压缩的几何基准；并将其用于比较结构剪枝和幅度剪枝在任务饱和前后的自由度保有情况。
AI.result: 发现结构和幅度剪枝即使在任务饱和后仍保留更多的自由度。这一差距表明功能冗余是分布在参数方向上的，而不是由单个权重或神经元暴露出来的。
AI.conclusion: 功能退化性需要通过参数方向（而非单参数级别）来理解和利用，行为恢复秩提供了一个有效的几何框架来指导模型压缩，揭示了现有剪枝方法在捕获功能冗余方面的局限性。

title: Auditing MCQA Benchmarks through Probability Landscapes
summary: As Large Language Models rapidly advance, performance on standard multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks is reaching saturation. While the community has responded by developing increasingly difficult datasets, validating question quality and filtering flawed items remains a labor-intensive process. To provide a scalable diagnostic approach, we propose a two-component probabilistic framework for auditing MCQA benchmarks using model output distributions. First, for benchmark-level analysis, we characterize the probability landscape using the top prediction probability ($P_{top1}$) and normalized residual entropy ($H_{norm}$), summarized globally by Mean Pairwise Distance (MPD). Second, for item-level diagnostics, we introduce noise injection to reduce meaningful distractor competition, enabling us to flag candidate items for targeted human review and categorize residual failure patterns. Across four MCQA benchmarks, our landscape analysis reveals benchmark-level differences in model confidence and residual option competition. Concurrently, our noise-injection method flags potentially actionable item-level issues, showing alignment with expert error annotations from MMLU-Redux. These results suggest that our probability-based framework provides a lightweight audit lens for comparing macro-level benchmark structure and prioritizing individual items for targeted human review.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个基于模型输出分布的两组件概率框架，用于审计多项选择问答（MCQA）基准测试。该框架在基准层面使用top-1预测概率和归一化残差熵通过平均成对距离（MPD）刻画概率景观；在题目层面通过噪声注入减少干扰项竞争，标记需要人工审查的候选题目。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在标准MCQA基准上的性能已趋于饱和，社区虽然开发了更难的数据集，但验证题目质量和筛选有缺陷的题目仍然费时费力。需要一个可扩展的诊断方法来审计MCQA基准。
AI.method: 提出两组件概率框架：(1) 基准级分析：使用top预测概率（P_top1）和归一化残差熵（H_norm）刻画概率景观，通过平均成对距离（MPD）全局汇总；(2) 题目级诊断：引入噪声注入来减少有意义的干扰项竞争，标记候选题目供人工审查，并分类残余失败模式。
AI.result: 在四个MCQA基准上，景观分析揭示了基准级别在模型置信度和残余选项竞争方面的差异；噪声注入方法标记了潜在可操作的题目级问题，与MMLU-Redux中的专家错误注释相吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该概率框架为比较宏观基准结构提供了轻量级审计视角，并能优先排序需要人工审查的单个题目，具有可扩展性。

title: AdaPath: Query-Adaptive Path-Finding via Path-Bank for Multi-Hop Implicit Biomedical KGQA
summary: Path-finding over knowledge graphs has become an effective way to ground LLM reasoning on multi-hop questions. However, biomedical QA introduces two distinct challenges that general-domain methods are not designed for: (i) queries do not expose intermediate reasoning and can be answered through multiple valid pathways, and (ii) biomedical knowledge graphs are densely connected, so path-finding methods easily take wrong turns. To address these challenges, we propose AdaPath, a path-finding framework that retrieves query-adaptive meta-paths from Path-Bank, which captures both query semantics and biomedical knowledge graph structure. AdaPath provides the missing cues in biomedical queries while effectively pruning dense knowledge graph neighborhoods during multi-hop reasoning. We further release BioStrat-QA, a biomedical KGQA benchmark that stratifies multi-hop queries by how much intermediate reasoning they expose. Across biomedical KGQA benchmarks, AdaPath consistently outperforms baselines, sustaining meaningful path-finding even when multi-hop queries expose less surface information. The source code is available at https://github.com/Jun-Hyeong-Kim/AdaPath.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaPath，一种针对生物医学知识图谱问答的路径查找框架，通过从Path-Bank检索查询自适应的元路径来提供查询中缺失的中间推理线索并剪枝稠密的知识图谱邻域，同时发布了BioStrat-QA基准测试数据集来按中间推理暴露程度分层评估多跳查询。
AI.motivation: 生物医学问答场景存在两个通用领域方法未解决的挑战：(1) 查询不暴露中间推理步骤，且可通过多条有效路径回答；(2) 生物医学知识图谱连接稠密，路径查找方法容易走错方向。
AI.method: 提出AdaPath框架，从Path-Bank中检索查询自适应的元路径（meta-paths），这些元路径同时捕获查询语义和生物医学知识图谱结构，为查询提供缺失线索并有效剪枝稠密邻域。
AI.result: 在多个生物医学KGQA基准上，AdaPath持续优于基线方法，即使在多跳查询暴露较少表面信息的情况下仍能保持有意义的路径查找性能。此外发布了BioStrat-QA基准，按中间推理暴露程度对查询进行分层评估。
AI.conclusion: AdaPath通过查询自适应的元路径检索有效解决了生物医学KGQA中查询信息不足和知识图谱稠密连接两大难题，为生物医学多跳推理提供了更可靠的路径查找方案。

title: TDDM-Melatt: A Decoupled Memory and Diffusion Framework for Generalizable Encrypted Traffic Classification
comment: 18 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables, accepted at the 2026 ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS 2026)
summary: The widespread adoption of encrypted traffic poses severe challenges to current security situational awareness systems based on network traffic monitoring. In existing dataset-driven training and testing studies, limitations such as shortcut learning induced by spurious feature correlations and sample imbalance caused by the long-tail distribution of real-world traffic result in weak generalization of traffic identification performance to real-world network traffic. To address these limitations, we propose TDDM-Melatt, a disentangled memory-based traffic classification framework with diffusion-based data augmentation. First, we design Melatt, a memory-decoupled traffic representation model, which employs Competitive Gating Long Short-Term Memory (CG-LSTM) to construct the encoder and decoder. We design a spurious-correlation-free pre-training and inference paradigm, employing strict topology anonymization and a frozen pre-trained encoder strategy to cut off the model's learning pathways for spurious features. During inference, classification is performed efficiently by a downstream classifier on the frozen representations. Second, we propose a Traffic Denoising Diffusion Model (TDDM) tailored to the characteristics of traffic data. Extensive experiments are conducted on 4 representative public benchmark datasets. Under strict flow-level splitting and anonymization, TDDM-Melatt outperforms 6 basic classification models and 6 SOTA representation learning models. The proposed method provides a new and effective technical pathway for encrypted traffic classification in real-world network environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TDDM-Melatt框架，用于解决加密流量分类中因虚假特征关联导致的捷径学习和真实流量长尾分布导致的样本不平衡问题。该框架包含记忆解耦的流量表示模型Melatt（基于竞争门控LSTM）和针对流量数据特性设计的流量去噪扩散模型TDDM，通过严格拓扑匿名化和冻结预训练编码器策略切断虚假特征的学习路径，在4个公开基准数据集上优于6个基础分类模型和6个SOTA表示学习模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于数据集驱动的流量分类研究存在两大局限：一是虚假特征相关性引发的捷径学习（spurious correlation导致模型学到错误关联），二是真实流量长尾分布导致的样本不平衡，两者共同导致模型在真实网络环境中泛化能力弱，亟需新的方法应对加密流量普及带来的安全态势感知挑战。
AI.method: 提出TDDM-Melatt框架：(1)设计Melatt记忆解耦流量表示模型，采用竞争门控LSTM（CG-LSTM）构建编码器和解码器；(2)设计无虚假相关性的预训练与推理范式，通过严格拓扑匿名化和冻结预训练编码器策略切断虚假特征学习路径；(3)推理时由下游分类器在冻结表示上高效分类；(4)提出针对流量数据特性定制的流量去噪扩散模型TDDM进行数据增强。
AI.result: 在4个代表性公开基准数据集上，采用严格流级划分和匿名化设置下，TDDM-Melatt分别超越了6个基础分类模型和6个SOTA表示学习模型，验证了方法的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TDDM-Melatt为真实网络环境下的加密流量分类提供了一条新的有效技术路径，有效解决了捷径学习和样本不平衡两大问题，为提升网络安全态势感知能力做出了贡献。

title: Beyond Consensus: Downward Bias and Role Asymmetry in Multi-Agent LLM Judges for Subjective Evaluation
summary: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) has been widely adopted to improve LLM-based evaluation by prompting multiple agents to negotiate and reach a consensus. However, for subjective rubric-based scoring, inter-agent agreement does not guarantee alignment with human judgments. In this paper, we compare a single-judge baseline against a consensus-based MAD protocol on subjective evaluation tasks and design three ablations to isolate the impact of role prompting, multi-round interaction, and explicit score sharing. Evaluations across six LLMs show that the single-judge baseline achieves the strongest human alignment on average across six judge models, whereas MAD shows degradation in human alignment on both tasks. Our ablations demonstrate that this performance drop stems primarily from asymmetric role prompting rather than the interaction itself. Specifically, assigning a strict judge role introduces a systematic downward bias that the consensus process fails to correct. The central finding is that this bias reflects strict-stance dominance beyond averaging: the consensus score falls well beyond the arithmetic midpoint of the standalone strict and lenient conditions, rather than averaging them out. Removing role asymmetry (Symmetric MAD) largely recovers baseline performance, while masking peer scores widens inter-agent disagreement on average and worsens average human alignment. These findings demonstrate that multi-agent consensus can enforce artificial agreement at the expense of true human alignment, revealing a structural limitation in consensus-style, role-specialized MAD protocols for subjective scoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了单一评判者基线与基于共识的多智能体辩论（MAD）协议在主观评分任务中的表现，发现单一评判者基线的人类对齐性最好，而MAD因角色提示的不对称性（严格评判角色引入系统性向下偏差）导致人类对齐性下降，且共识分数远超严格与宽松条件的算术中点，表明严格立场主导而非简单平均。去除角色不对称的对称MAD可恢复基线性能，揭示了共识式、角色专业化MAD在主观评分中的结构局限性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论（MAD）被广泛用于改进基于LLM的评估，但此前缺乏对主观rubric评分中智能体间共识与人类判断对齐之间关系的系统性检验。作者质疑：智能体间达成一致是否真正意味着与人类判断一致？这是本研究的核心动机。
AI.method: 对比单一评判者基线（无MAD）与基于共识的MAD协议，在主观评估任务上设计三个消融实验，分别隔离角色提示（严格/宽松角色不对称）、多轮交互、显式分数共享的影响。使用六个LLM作为评判模型在六个评估/任务上测试，并比较共识分数与各独立条件的算术中点。
AI.result: 六个评判模型中，单一评判者基线在人类对齐性上平均最强；MAD在两类任务上均表现出人类对齐性退化。消融表明退化主要源于不对称角色提示而非交互本身：严格裁判角色引入系统性向下偏差，共识过程无法纠正。关键发现是共识分数远超出严格与宽松条件独立预测的算术中点，体现严格立场主导。对称MAD（无角色不对称）基本恢复基线性能；屏蔽同伴分数则扩大平均智能体间分歧并恶化人类对齐性。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体共识可强制产生人为的一致，但以牺牲真正的人类对齐性为代价。共识式、角色专业化的MAD协议在主观评分中存在结构性限制：角色不对称引入的立场偏差无法通过多轮协商和共识机制纠正，反而可能被放大。建议在主观rubric评分中慎用角色不对称的共识式MAD，对称设计或单一评判者可能是更可靠的选择。

title: TuringLLM: Efficiently Scaling Foundation Models Toward Physical AI
summary: We present Turing-20B-A2B, a 20B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model that activates approximately 2B parameters per token, designed for long-context and latency-sensitive physical AI applications. The model adopts Quantile Routing in a dynamic top-k configuration, enabling token-adaptive expert allocation while maintaining balanced expert utilization and a controlled average compute budget. During deployment, we further apply capacity-constrained routing to prompt prefill for more regular and efficient expert execution, while retaining dropless routing during pretraining. Turing-20B-A2B also employs a hybrid attention architecture that combines Lightning Attention with a small number of full-attention layers for efficient long-context modeling. The model is pretrained with a progressive three-stage curriculum and extended to a native context length of 128K through continued pretraining, with further inference-time extension to 512K using YaRN. Despite its compact active-parameter budget, Turing-20B-A2B achieves, at the base-model stage, overall general capability exceeding Qwen3-8B Base and approaching Qwen3.5-9B Base, while maintaining strong long-context performance and favorable prefill-latency scaling. These results demonstrate an effective balance among model capability, long-context scalability, and practical inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Turing-20B-A2B，一个20B参数的MoE语言模型，每个token仅激活约2B参数。该模型采用Quantile Routing实现动态top-k专家分配，结合混合注意力架构（Lightning Attention + 少量全注意力层），通过渐进式三阶段预训练课程扩展到128K原生上下文长度，并可用YaRN进一步扩展到512K。在基础模型阶段，其综合能力超过Qwen3-8B Base并接近Qwen3.5-9B Base，同时保持优秀的长期上下文性能和prefill延迟扩展。
AI.motivation: 面向物理AI等延迟敏感的长上下文应用场景，需要在大模型能力、长上下文可扩展性和实际推理效率之间找到平衡。传统MoE模型采用固定top-k路由，无法根据token复杂度自适应分配专家资源，且长上下文场景下的推理延迟是核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 采用Quantile Routing实现动态top-k配置，支持token自适应的专家分配，同时维持专家均衡利用和控制平均计算预算；2) 部署时对prompt prefill应用容量约束路由以提升专家执行效率，预训练阶段保留dropless路由；3) 采用混合注意力架构，结合Lightning Attention与少量全注意力层；4) 通过渐进式三阶段预训练课程，经过继续预训练扩展至128K原生上下文，并使用YaRN在推理时扩展至512K。
AI.result: 在仅激活2B参数的情况下，Turing-20B-A2B在基础模型阶段的综合通用能力超过Qwen3-8B Base并接近Qwen3.5-9B Base，同时保持强大的长上下文性能和良好的prefill延迟扩展特性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有效地在模型能力、长上下文可扩展性和实际推理效率三者之间取得了平衡，验证了动态路由与混合注意力架构结合在小激活参数预算下实现高性价比大模型的可行性。

title: Do VLMs Share Safety Neurons Across Modalities?
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) can comply with harmful requests delivered through images, even when their LLM backbones would refuse the same content in text. While prior work characterizes these jailbreaks empirically or at the representation level, how visual inputs perturb safety pathways at the neuron level remains uncharted. We close this gap with a causal, neuron-level analysis of safety mechanisms in 10 VLMs. We propose a two-stage detection pipeline with iterative ablation that accounts for self-repair, and introduce two modality-isolated benchmarks, ViSafe-Detect and ViSafe-Eval, which decouple visual and textual safety signals.
  Our analysis reveals: (i) Text safety in VLMs is localizable: $\sim$88 neurons ($<$0.01%) whose targeted ablation substantially reduces refusal. (ii) Text safety neurons constitute the dominant refusal pathway: ablating them is the only intervention that consistently and substantially reduces refusal across all models. (iii) Visual safety is high-dimensional and diffuse at the single-neuron level: text safety concentrates in $\sim$5 subspace directions while visual safety requires $\geq$50. This gap holds across architectures, explaining why current alignment has not closed the visual safety gap. Project page is at: https://jiaxuan-li.github.io/vlm-safety-neuron/
  Warning: this paper may include examples of harmful content.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从神经元层面因果分析了10个VLM中的安全机制，发现文本安全是可定位的（~88个神经元），而视觉安全是高度分散和高维的（需要≥50个子空间方向），这解释了当前对齐为何无法弥合视觉安全差距。
AI.motivation: VLM可以通过图像传递有害请求，即使其底层LLM在文本形式下会拒绝相同内容。虽然已有工作在经验层面或表征层面刻画了这种越狱行为，但在神经元层面视觉输入如何扰动安全通路仍是未知的。作者希望填补这一空白，从因果关系和神经元层面理解VLM的安全机制。
AI.method: 提出两阶段检测流程，结合迭代消融方法以处理自修复效应；并引入两个模态隔离的基准数据集ViSafe-Detect和ViSafe-Eval，将视觉和文本安全信号解耦。在10个VLM上进行因果性、神经元层面的安全机制分析。
AI.result: （i）文本安全在VLM中是可定位的：约88个神经元（<0.01%）的定向消融即可大幅降低拒绝率。（ii）文本安全神经元构成主导的拒绝通路：消融它们是唯一能跨所有模型持续显著降低拒绝的干预。（iii）视觉安全在单神经元层面是高维且分散的：文本安全集中在约5个子空间方向，而视觉安全需要≥50个方向。该差距跨架构普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: 文本安全与视觉安全在神经元层面的分布存在根本性不对称：文本安全高度集中可定位，而视觉安全高维分散。这种结构性差异解释了当前对齐方法为何无法弥合视觉安全差距，为未来改进VLM安全对齐提供了新的方向和线索。

title: Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Paper 4 of the Kathleen series. Mechanism covered by U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/140,260
summary: Recurrent, attention-free sequence models share a structural weakness: a fading state cannot perform exact recall of something seen once, far in the past. We add to the Kathleen trunk a second memory layer -- a "notebook": a fixed-key holographic (HRR) associative store with a learned local write gate, a self-gating raw read, and write-triggered forgetting -- 25K parameters that attach to the logits of any trunk. (1) Mechanism: on a controlled needle-in-haystack task the notebook reaches 80-82% one-shot recall at 4x the training length, where the bare trunk scores ~4% and a parameter-matched attention head scores 100% inside its training length and 0% beyond it. Addressing is length-invariant by construction; the untrained memory alone recalls at 90% accuracy identically at 512, 2048 and 4096 bytes. Because the store is a linear superposition, two capabilities follow from arithmetic alone: selective unlearning (one subtraction erases one fact to chance, retained facts unharmed) and per-token attribution (counterfactual erasure names the source fact of every correct byte, 100% provenance). (2) Real text: on WikiText-2 bytes the notebook improves prediction of repeated rare words by +0.15-0.27 bits/byte, the gain growing with the distance between mentions and holding zero-shot at 4x training length; write-triggered forgetting eliminates memory pollution at 8x length (first-mention cost +0.33 -> -0.004). (3) Scope and scale: a parameter-matched attention head does generalize on natural-text repetition, so the notebook's claim is exact recall at O(L); on a WikiText-103 ladder (8 to 512 MB) the zero-shot repeat gain rises monotonically. All experiments are pre-registered, seeds reported, and reproducible on a single free-tier GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文向Kathleen序列模型主干增加了一个"笔记本"层——一种固定键全息（HRR）联想存储，带有学习的局部写入门、自门控原始读取和写入触发的遗忘机制。仅用25K参数，该层实现了长度不变的精确单次回忆（在4倍训练长度处达80-82%，而裸主干仅4%），支持选择性遗忘和逐token归因，并在WikiText上改善了重复罕见词的预测，同时消除记忆污染。
AI.motivation: 递归、无注意力序列模型存在结构性弱点：衰减状态无法对遥远过去的单次观察进行精确回忆。作者希望通过一种轻量、长度不变的外部记忆机制弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 在Kathleen主干上附加"笔记本"记忆层：固定键HRR（全息简化表示）联想存储，配备学习到的局部写入门、自门控原始读取以及写入触发的遗忘机制。整个附加层仅25K参数，直接连接到任何主干的logits上。
AI.result: （1）机制方面：在干草堆找针任务上，笔记本在4倍训练长度处达到80-82%的精确单次回忆（裸主干约4%，注意力头在训练长度内100%但超出后为0%）；寻址天然长度不变，未训练记忆在512/2048/4096字节处均保持90%回忆准确率。线性叠加特性支持选择性遗忘和逐token归因（100%溯源）。 （2）真实文本：WikiText-2上重复罕见词预测改善+0.15-0.27 bits/byte，且增益随提及间距增大而增长，在4倍训练长度处保持零样本泛化；写入触发遗忘在8倍长度处消除记忆污染（首次提及代价从+0.33降至-0.004）。 （3）规模：参数匹配的注意力头能泛化自然文本重复，笔记本的优点是O(L)的精确回忆；WikiText-103阶梯（8至512MB）上零样本重复增益单调上升。
AI.conclusion: 笔记本提供了一种轻量、参数高效、长度不变的外部记忆机制，赋予递归序列模型精确回忆能力，同时支持算术级的可控遗忘与可归因性，且所有实验均预先注册、可复现于单块免费GPU。

title: Automated Testing of LLM-Based Post Hoc Explainers Using Model Checking as an Oracle
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used as post hoc explainers of sequential decision-making policies, producing natural-language explanations of why an action was chosen. However, LLMs often generate plausible but incorrect statements, and no existing approach systematically tests whether such explanations are faithful to the underlying environment. Two classic software testing challenges stand in the way: there is no oracle for the correctness of an explanation, and the test inputs, natural language queries about a policy's behavior, lack the structure needed for systematic test case generation. We address both. Probabilistic model checking provides the test oracle, computing exact reference results against which LLM answers are graded automatically. A taxonomy of post hoc query categories structures the input space around the environment-level facts from which policy explanations are composed; test cases generated from it are prioritized by question-specific diagnostic difficulty scores. Across seven MDP environments, the testing separates three open-weight LLMs: a reasoning model passes 85% of test cases, a mid-size model 70%, and a 1B model falls below the random baseline, while prioritization surfaces significantly harder cases than random selection. Our results indicate how trustworthy LLM-generated explanations are in model-free settings, where the same LLMs are used but no oracle exists to verify them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统测试LLM作为序列决策策略事后解释器忠实性的方法，通过概率模型检验提供测试预言机，并基于事后查询分类法构建结构化测试用例生成框架。在七个MDP环境中测试三个开源LLM，发现推理模型通过85%测试、中型模型通过70%、1B模型低于随机基线。
AI.motivation: LLM常被用作序列决策策略的事后解释器，但会产生看似合理实则错误的陈述。现有方法缺乏系统性测试解释忠实性的手段，主要面临两大挑战：缺乏解释正确性的预言机（oracle），以及自然语言查询缺乏结构化输入空间难以进行系统性测试用例生成。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心部分：(1) 使用概率模型检验（probabilistic model checking）作为测试预言机，自动计算精确的参考结果来评判LLM答案；(2) 构建事后查询分类法（taxonomy），围绕环境层面事实组织输入空间，并基于问题特定的诊断难度分数（diagnostic difficulty scores）对生成的测试用例进行优先级排序。
AI.result: 在七个MDP环境中，该方法有效区分了三个开源LLM的性能：推理模型通过85%的测试用例，中型模型通过70%，而1B模型低于随机基线。优先级排序策略能显著发现比随机选择更难的测试用例。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM生成解释在不同规模模型下的可信度差异，其测试框架可用于评估LLM解释的忠实性。该方法同样适用于无模型（model-free）设置，即当无法使用预言机验证时，可参考此框架评估LLM解释的可靠性。

title: PRACTICE: From Experience to Expertise in Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
summary: Recent studies have shown that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can serve as embodied agents, translating language instructions and visual observations into executable plans. However, building agents that can continually improve through interaction and rapidly adapt to their environments remains challenging. Summing up experience from past interaction trajectories provides a promising solution, but existing experience-based methods often rely on manually designed prompting workflows to extract and update skills. Such fixed procedures may struggle to learn updated skills from new and diverse experiences. We introduce PRACTICE, which trains a skill learner to discover and maintain a persistent skill library from past interaction trajectories while keeping the task executor frozen. Given the historical accumulated skills and incoming trajectories, the skill learner produces structured batch-edits that add, refine, merge, or remove skills, and then hierarchical consolidate all collected edits into a consistent updated skill library. We train the learner with a two-stage curriculum. First, it learns basic skill generation and library maintenance from oracle trajectories. Then, by contrasting successful and failed trajectories from heterogeneous executors on the same tasks, it learn to identify invalid action patterns and recovery strategies. Finally, we apply online skill-edit distillation to align the skill learner with a stronger teacher on its current edit distribution to further improves the policy. Experiments demonstrate that a compact skill learner delivers consistent performance improvements across successive library-update rounds for multiple frozen executors. On EB-ALFRED and EB-Habitat, PRACTICE further outperforms the strongest experience-based baselines. Project resources are publicly available at: https://baai-agents.github.io/PRACTICE

AI.tldr: PRACTICE提出了一种训练技能学习器（skill learner）的方法，该学习器能够从过去的交互轨迹中自主发现并维护一个持久的技能库，同时保持任务执行器（task executor）冻结不变。通过两阶段课程学习和在线技能编辑蒸馏，PRACTICE在多个冻结执行器上实现了连续的技能库更新和性能提升，并在EB-ALFRED和EB-Habitat基准上超越了最强的基于经验的方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）可以作为具身智能体，但从交互中持续改进和快速适应环境仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于经验的方法依赖人工设计的提示工作流来提取和更新技能，这种固定的流程难以从新的多样化经验中学习更新技能。
AI.method: PRACTICE训练一个技能学习器（skill learner），从过去的交互轨迹中发现并维护持久技能库，同时保持任务执行器冻结。技能学习器产生结构化的批处理编辑（添加、精炼、合并或删除技能），然后分层整合所有收集的编辑为一致的更新技能库。训练采用两阶段课程：第一阶段学习从oracle轨迹中生成基本技能和进行库维护；第二阶段通过对比异构执行器在相同任务上的成功与失败轨迹，学习识别无效动作模式和恢复策略。最后应用在线技能编辑蒸馏，使技能学习器与更强的教师模型在其当前编辑分布上对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，一个紧凑的技能学习器在多个冻结执行器上通过连续的库更新轮次提供了持续的性能改进。在EB-ALFRED和EB-Habitat上，PRACTICE超过了最强的基于经验的方法基线。
AI.conclusion: PRACTICE证明了通过训练技能学习器而非依赖人工设计的提示流程，可以更有效地实现具身智能体的持续学习和技能积累，为多模态具身智能体的快速环境适应提供了新的范式。

title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale
comment: 33 pages. Accepted to the Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Understanding agent behavior requires methods that scale to thousands of trajectories and surface new patterns in long, often unfamiliar tasks where pre-built classifiers fall short. We propose to bring grounded theory into agent trajectory analysis: a six-decade-old qualitative method from the social sciences, with a principled saturation criterion and an auditable trail from data to theory. We propose AutoTraceGT (Automated Trace analysis through Grounded Theory), the first multi-agent pipeline that automates grounded theory on agent trajectories. It iteratively performs open, axial, and theoretical coding until saturation, producing a behavioral taxonomy tailored to each task. Across six trajectory corpora, AutoTraceGT produces codebooks that recover 73-91 percent of the failure modes in human-annotated taxonomies and surface additional patterns that those taxonomies miss. The emergent theoretical narrative aligns with prior expert accounts. Used as a deductive feature space, the codebook outperforms zero-shot and few-shot LLM baselines on downstream failure prediction. These results suggest Grounded Theory offers a scalable analytic tool for ML researchers and agent developers studying what agents actually do.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoTraceGT，首个将社会科学中历时六十年的扎根理论方法自动化应用于智能体轨迹分析的多智能体流水线。它通过迭代执行开放编码、轴心编码和理论编码直至饱和，为每个任务生成行为分类体系。在六个轨迹语料库上，该方法恢复了人类标注分类中73-91%的失败模式，并发现了分类体系遗漏的额外模式，且在下游失败预测任务中优于零样本和少样本LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 理解智能体行为需要能扩展到数千条轨迹的方法，并在长而陌生的任务中发现新模式。预构建的分类器在这些场景下表现不足，需要一种可扩展、可审计的定性分析方法。
AI.method: 将扎根理论（一种源自社会科学、具有原则性饱和准则和可审计数据到理论追踪链的定性方法）引入智能体轨迹分析。提出AutoTraceGT，一个自动化扎根理论的多智能体流水线，迭代执行开放编码、轴心编码和理论编码直至饱和，为每个任务生成定制的行为分类体系。
AI.result: 在六个轨迹语料库上，AutoTraceGT生成的编码手册恢复了人类标注分类中73-91%的失败模式，并发现了这些分类遗漏的额外模式。生成的理认叙事与先前专家描述一致。作为演绎特征空间使用时，该编码手册在下游失败预测任务中优于零样本和少样本LLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 扎根理论为ML研究人员和智能体开发者研究智能体实际行为提供了可扩展的分析工具，能在大规模轨迹分析中发现新的行为模式并支持可靠的演绎性预测任务。

title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning
summary: LLM agents need to sustain goal-consistent reasoning across long multi-turn interactions under strict resource constraints. However, as the multi-turn context accumulates, it can destabilize the underlying LLM's internal representation of task-relevant information from earlier turns, blurring the boundary between constructive reasoning and representation drift. We formulate multi-turn reasoning as a hidden-state trajectory of the underlying LLM that is characterized via two complementary signals: temporal curvature that captures the directional consistency of turn-to-turn updates, and variance slope which measures the expansion or contraction of the exploration space. Across four tasks and three underlying LLMs, we observed that these geometric signals distinguish between correct and incorrect episodes prior to completion. We further decompose each episode into three-action chains formed from four actions (Read, Write, Respond, Transfer) and show that separability is action-dependent, with different signals distinguishing various chain patterns. Our experiments demonstrate that trajectory geometry can identify critical turns in the reasoning process, increasing task success rates on $τ$-Bench from 24.1% to 39.6% while reducing token cost by 11.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用LLM多轮推理的隐藏状态轨迹几何特征（时间曲率与方差斜率）来检测推理过程中的表示漂移，从而识别关键转折点并提升任务成功率，在τ-Bench上从24.1%提升至39.6%且降低11.2%的token成本。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需在长时间多轮交互中维持目标一致的推理，但上下文累积会导致底层LLM对早期任务相关信息的内部表征不稳定，模糊了建设性推理与表征漂移之间的界限。需要一种信号来区分这两种状态，以便在推理过程中及时干预。
AI.method: 将多轮推理建模为底层LLM的隐藏状态轨迹，通过两个互补的几何信号来刻画：(1)时间曲率——捕捉轮次间更新的方向一致性；(2)方差斜率——衡量探索空间的扩张或收缩。进一步将每个回合分解为四个动作（读、写、响应、转移）构成的三动作链，分析不同信号对不同链模式的区分能力。
AI.result: 在四个任务和三个底层LLM上的实验表明：(1)这些几何信号能在任务完成前区分正确与错误回合；(2)信号的可分离性与动作依赖相关，不同信号可区分不同的链模式；(3)利用轨迹几何识别关键推理轮次，将τ-Bench任务成功率从24.1%提升至39.6%，同时将token成本降低11.2%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹几何特征（时间曲率和方差斜率）可作为有效的早期预警信号，在推理完成之前检测表示漂移并识别关键转折点，从而在资源受限条件下实现更高效、更准确的多轮LLM推理。

title: T3S: Improving Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Task-Specific Feature Selector and Scheduler
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Published in the 2023 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
summary: Multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) is a technique to train multiple tasks simultaneously, where previous works usually train a single model to solve different tasks by sharing parameters across various tasks. However, these methods are faced with inter-task interference since what parameters should be shared across tasks is not addressed, dramatically reducing learning efficiency. To solve these problems, we propose a novel MTRL framework called Task-Specific feature Selector and Scheduler (T3S), which consists of two components: a feature selector and a task scheduler. Specifically, the feature selectors employ hypernetworks to construct task-specific soft masks, which can be applied by globally shared representation to construct task-specific features. The task scheduler selects tasks for learning through two metrics, where the selection probability is inversely proportional to task progress (e.g., success rate) and task learning speed. Experimental results show that T3S consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art MTRL algorithms on various robotics manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为T3S的多任务强化学习框架，通过特征选择器和任务调度器两个组件来解决任务间干扰问题。特征选择器利用超网络构建任务特定的软掩码，作用于全局共享表示以生成任务特定特征；任务调度器根据任务进度和学习速度计算选择概率，优先训练进展较慢的任务。实验结果表明T3S在多种机器人操作任务上持续优于现有最先进的多任务强化学习算法。
AI.motivation: 现有的多任务强化学习方法通常通过共享参数训练单一模型来解决多个任务，但未解决哪些参数应该跨任务共享的问题，导致任务间干扰，显著降低了学习效率。
AI.method: 提出T3S框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 特征选择器：利用超网络为每个任务构建任务特定的软掩码，应用于全局共享表示以生成任务特定特征；(2) 任务调度器：通过两个度量指标（任务进度和学习速度）来选择训练任务，选择概率与任务进度和学习速度成反比，优先训练进展缓慢的任务。
AI.result: T3S在多种机器人操作任务上一致性地优于最先进的多任务强化学习算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式区分任务特定与全局共享的表示，并结合自适应任务调度策略，T3S有效缓解了多任务学习中的干扰问题，提升了多任务强化学习的整体性能。

title: Quantitative Evidence Mining for Plausibility-Aware Biomedical AI
summary: Biomedical artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly extract, organize, and reuse scientific claims from literature, clinical trials, and regulatory documents. But automatic extraction alone does not make a claim reliable evidence: a claim becomes useful only when it can be traced to its source, linked to the quantitative details that support it, and read within its biomedical context and uncertainty. This matters as large language models (LLMs) and increasingly autonomous systems drive evidence synthesis, knowledge graph (KG) construction, and decision support. Many text-mining and LLM pipelines remain relation-centric: they capture entities and relations such as Drug--TREATS--Disease, but drop the dose, effect size, population, comparator, uncertainty, and conditions under which a claim holds. Such relations can look actionable yet remain hard to verify, compare, or reuse. In this perspective, we argue for a shift toward quantitative evidence mining---extracting values, units, measured entities and properties, context, uncertainty, provenance, and plausibility as structured evidence units that populate evidence-aware KGs and can be checked for source grounding, unit consistency, completeness, and biological plausibility. We outline a framework for plausibility-aware AI that treats extracted claims not as final answers but as auditable evidence objects, making clear what was measured, how much it changed, in which setting, with what uncertainty, and from which source. The central risk is not only incorrect extraction, but claims that look like evidence while lacking the structure needed to trust them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生物医学AI系统应从关系为中心的抽取转向定量证据挖掘（quantitative evidence mining），将数值、单位、背景、不确定性、来源等结构化信息作为可审计的证据单元，构建证据感知的知识图谱，使抽取的声明成为可验证、可比较、可复用的证据对象而非看似可靠却缺乏信任结构的最终答案。
AI.motivation: 当前生物医学文本挖掘和LLM管道大多以关系为中心（如Drug-TREATS-Disease），丢失了剂量、效应量、人群、对照、不确定性及声明成立的条件等关键定量细节。这类关系虽然看似可操作，却难以验证、比较或重用。随着LLM和自主系统越来越多地驱动证据综合、知识图谱构建和决策支持，这一缺陷变得尤为关键——最大的风险不仅是抽取错误，而是那些看起来像证据却缺乏可信任结构的声明。
AI.method: 作者提出一个向定量证据挖掘转变的框架：（1）提取数值、单位、被测实体与属性、背景、不确定性、来源和合理性作为结构化证据单元；（2）构建证据感知的知识图谱（evidence-aware KGs）；（3）建立合理性感知的AI（plausibility-aware AI），将抽取的声明视为可审计的证据对象而非最终答案；（4）对声明进行来源接地、单位一致性、完整性和生物学合理性检查。
AI.result: 本文是一篇perspective（观点性文章），没有实验数据或定量结果，而是提出了一个概念框架和论证。作者阐明：抽取的声明应明确测量了什么、变化了多少、在什么背景下、具有什么不确定性、来自哪个来源，从而使其成为可审计的证据对象。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学AI领域需要从"看起来像证据"的关系抽取，转向结构完整、可审计的定量证据挖掘。这不只是提高抽取准确率的问题，而是要重新定义证据的结构标准——让每个声明都具备足以被信任的元数据结构。核心风险在于：声明看似可靠却缺乏信任所需的结构。

title: PyKEEN-NSX: A Modular Framework for Static, Dynamic and Schema-Aware Negative Sampling in PyKEEN
summary: Embedding methods have become popular due to their scalability on link prediction and/or triple classification tasks on Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Embedding models are trained relying on both positive and negative samples of triples. However, since KGs generally contain only positive assertions, negative samples are artificially generated through negative sampling strategies, ranging from simple random corruption to more sophisticated approaches that exploit structural, semantic, or embedding information. The design and implementation of advanced negative samplers remains challenging, as most popular Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) libraries provide support only for basic strategies and lack a unified framework for developing more advanced and customized solutions. To address this gap, we introduce PyKEEN-NSX, an extension of PyKEEN, the popular KGE framework, that provides a modular engineered abstraction for negative sampling. The proposed architecture separates the generation of candidate negative pools, conditioned on an explicit context, from the selection strategy, enabling the development and integration of static, schema-aware and dynamic approaches within a consistent framework. Based on this abstraction, we implement six negative samplers, while remaining fully compatible with existing PyKEEN workflows and pipelines. As a proof of concept, we study negative availability across four datasets, showing that constrained pools frequently fall below the requested number of negatives, so that the encoded criterion is to a large extent replaced by the random fallback that supplements them.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PyKEEN-NSX，这是对流行知识图谱嵌入框架PyKEEN的扩展，提供了一个模块化的负采样抽象架构，将候选负样本池的生成与选择策略分离，并实现了六种负采样器。作为概念验证，研究发现约束性负样本池常常低于所需数量，导致随机回退机制在很大程度上替代了编码标准。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱嵌入模型依赖正负样本训练，但大多数KGE库仅支持基础负采样策略，缺乏统一框架来开发高级和定制化的负采样解决方案，这阻碍了更先进负采样方法的实现与集成。
AI.method: PyKEEN-NSX构建了一个模块化工程抽象，将条件于显式上下文的候选负样本池生成与选择策略分离，支持静态、模式感知和动态方法在统一框架内的开发与集成。基于该抽象实现了六种负采样器，并保持与现有PyKEEN工作流完全兼容。
AI.result: 作为概念验证，在四个数据集上研究了负样本可用性，发现受约束的负样本池经常低于请求的负样本数量，说明编码的约束标准在很大程度上被补充它们的随机回退所替代。
AI.conclusion: PyKEEN-NSX为KGE负采样提供了统一的模块化框架，但其研究发现约束负采样策略在实践中可能因池容量不足而退化为随机采样，这提示需要更细致地设计负样本生成策略以确保其有效性。

title: TrainSDC: Characterizing and Mitigating Silent Data Corruption in Large Language Model Training
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with additional experiments
summary: LLM training is increasingly vulnerable to silent data corruption (SDC), yet existing protection methods largely treat Transformer computations uniformly because their vulnerability remains poorly understood. We present the first systematic characterization of SDC vulnerability across major computation interfaces in both the forward and backward passes of Transformer training. Our analysis reveals two distinct error propagation mechanisms: forward-pass vulnerability is highly location dependent, with faults on the Q/K path producing persistent training deviations, whereas backward-pass vulnerability is largely governed by gradient exponent distributions rather than computation locations. Motivated by these observations, we propose TrainSDC, a characterization-guided protection framework consisting of Q/K-path recomputation, residual-gain monitoring, and exponent-aware gradient scaling. Experiments on Llama 3.2-1B and Qwen3-0.6B show that TrainSDC maintains training behavior close to fault-free execution under both sparse and dense fault injection while introducing only 1.65%-6.76% runtime overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统地表征了Transformer训练中前向和后向传播各计算接口对静默数据损坏（SDC）的脆弱性，发现前向传播的脆弱性与计算位置高度相关（Q/K路径故障导致持续训练偏差），而后向传播的脆弱性主要由梯度指数分布决定。基于此提出TrainSDC保护框架，包含Q/K路径重计算、残差增益监测和指数感知梯度缩放，在Llama 3.2-1B和Qwen3-0.6B上仅引入1.65%-6.76%运行时开销即可维持接近无故障的训练行为。
AI.motivation: LLM训练越来越容易受到静默数据损坏（SDC）的影响，而现有保护方法对Transformer计算均匀处理，因为其脆弱性尚未被充分理解。需要对不同计算接口的SDC脆弱性进行系统表征，以指导更有效的保护策略。
AI.method: 首先对Transformer训练的前向和后向传播中各主要计算接口进行系统化的SDC脆弱性表征分析，揭示两种不同的错误传播机制。基于分析结果提出TrainSDC框架，包含三个组件：Q/K路径重计算（应对前向位置依赖性脆弱性）、残差增益监测（检测异常）、以及指数感知梯度缩放（应对后向梯度指数分布驱动的脆弱性）。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.2-1B和Qwen3-0.6B上进行实验，TrainSDC在稀疏和密集故障注入下均能维持接近无故障执行的训练行为，同时仅引入1.65%-6.76%的运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: Transformer训练的SDC脆弱性并非均匀分布，前向和后向传播遵循截然不同的错误传播机制；通过表征引导的保护设计可以以极低的开销实现有效的SDC防护。

title: When LLM Meets Tree Search: A Systematic View of Inference as Search in Large Language Models
summary: As pretraining scaling laws approach saturation, Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as an important direction for improving reasoning by allocating inference-time compute to a fixed model prior. Viewed at a high level, TTS reframes inference as search over a space of partial reasoning states. While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exposes intermediate steps, common instantiations rely on single-trajectory decoding, limiting recovery from early errors and exploration. This survey systematizes recent progress in tree-search-based reasoning, viewing inference as instance-specific optimization rather than decoding. We trace the evolution from uninformed search to Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), highlighting how sampling-based control supports principled exploration-exploitation trade-offs. To unify a fragmented literature, we introduce a Unified Design Space spanning search topology, evaluation signals, and control dynamics, and advocate a standardized compute-reporting abstraction to make compute-accuracy trade-offs explicit and comparable.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于测试时扩展（Test-Time Scaling, TTS）的综述，系统梳理了基于树搜索的推理方法，将其视为实例特定的优化问题而非单纯解码，并提出了统一设计空间（涵盖搜索拓扑、评估信号和控制动态）以及标准化的计算量报告抽象。
AI.motivation: 预训练规模法则趋于饱和，测试时扩展成为提升推理能力的重要方向。现有TTS方法大多依赖单轨迹解码（如CoT），限制了从早期错误中恢复的能力和探索空间。同时，相关文献分散、缺乏统一框架，难以比较不同方法的计算-精度权衡。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法：1）将TTS重构为对部分推理状态空间的搜索；2）梳理从无信息搜索到蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的演进，强调基于采样的控制在探索-利用权衡中的作用；3）提出统一设计空间（Unified Design Space），涵盖搜索拓扑、评估信号和控制动态三个维度；4）倡导标准化的计算量报告抽象以使计算-精度权衡显式化和可比较。
AI.result: 系统化了树搜索推理领域的最新进展，提出统一框架来整合零散文献，并倡导标准化计算量报告以实现公平比较。
AI.conclusion: 测试时扩展应被视为实例特定的优化问题而非简单解码过程，基于树搜索的方法（尤其MCTS）能够通过采样控制实现更优的探索-利用平衡。统一设计空间和标准化计算报告是推动该领域可比较、可复现发展的关键。

title: HiRS-Agent: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Reliable Long-Horizon Remote Sensing Task Solving
summary: Recent advances in large language models and multimodal models have pushed remote sensing (RS) processing from simple perception models to agentic systems designed to tackle complex, long-horizon RS tasks. However, existing systems often rely on monolithic decision-making frameworks, which fail to accommodate the multi-stage, interdependent nature of RS tasks. This centralized approach leads to challenges such as unstable task execution, incorrect tool usage, and error propagation across stages. To address these issues, we propose HiRS-Agent, a hierarchical multi-agent system for long-horizon RS task solving. HiRS-Agent adopts a two-level collaborative architecture: the Manager Layer handles dynamic routing, step-level verification, replanning, and termination control, while the Specialist Layer organizes domain-specific tools according to the RS workflow and is responsible for subtask reasoning and tool execution. To further enhance the system's capability, we introduce a two-stage supervised tuning strategy and a verification-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning stage to jointly optimize coordination and tool-use policies. Experiments on Earth-Agent Benchmark and ThinkGeo show that HiRS-Agent substantially improves long-horizon tool-use capability and final-task correctness, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured multi-agent collaboration for reliable RS agents. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/IntelliSensing/HiRS-Agent.

AI.tldr: HiRS-Agent是一个层次化多智能体系统，用于解决遥感领域的长程任务。它采用Manager层（负责动态路由、步骤验证、重规划和终止控制）与Specialist层（按RS工作流组织领域特定工具并负责子任务推理和工具执行）的两级协作架构，并引入两阶段监督调优和验证引导的层次化强化学习策略来联合优化协调与工具使用策略。实验表明其在Earth-Agent Benchmark和ThinkGeo上显著提升了长程工具使用能力和最终任务正确率。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感处理系统多依赖单体的决策框架，无法适应RS任务多阶段、相互依赖的特性，导致任务执行不稳定、工具使用错误以及跨阶段错误传播等问题。
AI.method: 提出HiRS-Agent层次化多智能体系统：(1) 两级架构——Manager层负责动态路由、步骤级验证、重规划与终止控制，Specialist层按RS工作流组织领域工具并负责子任务推理与工具执行；(2) 两阶段监督调优策略；(3) 验证引导的层次化强化学习阶段，联合优化协调策略和工具使用策略。
AI.result: 在Earth-Agent Benchmark和ThinkGeo上，HiRS-Agent显著提升了长程工具使用能力和最终任务正确率，验证了结构化多智能体协作对构建可靠RS智能体的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化多智能体协作能够有效解决遥感长程任务中集中式决策框架带来的不稳定性问题，为可靠的遥感智能体构建提供了有效的解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Reciprocity Separates Gradient Flow from Rotation in Conservative Physical Learning
summary: Physical learning lets a trainable material or network use its own physical response to carry error signals, reducing the need for a separately programmed backward computation. We ask what determines whether such a system follows conventional gradient descent or evolves along a genuinely different learning trajectory. Our canonical model is a directed layered transport network in which every node redistributes a fixed amount of flow, so learning preserves positivity and total mass. In this model, conservation constrains only the allowable learning directions. Within the matched response class studied here, adjoint matching gives the physical output response a symmetric form. Non-negative mode-wise feedback then produces a reciprocal closed-loop response and a reweighted gradient flow. Adding an antisymmetric boundary component makes the closed-loop response rotational: the learning path can turn while the error driving that update still decreases at that moment. Turning is not automatically beneficial. Its finite-step effect is set by local curvature, and its accumulated effect also depends on step selection and on the new states visited along the path. Numerical consistency checks reproduce the exact response structure, predict the sign of the local effect across new network families, and show how trajectory drift can negate a local advantage. These results separate the roles of conservation, reciprocity, and nonreciprocity in physical learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究物理学习系统的学习轨迹性质，通过一个有向分层传输网络模型，分析了守恒约束、互惠性（reciprocity）和非互惠性（nonreciprocity）在学习过程中的作用。核心发现是：在匹配响应类中，非负模式反馈产生互惠闭环响应和重新加权的梯度流；而添加反对称边界分量会使闭环响应旋转，使学习路径可以转向，但这种转向并非自动有益，其效果取决于局部曲率、步长选择和新访问的状态。数值检验验证了响应结构，并表明轨迹漂移可能抵消局部优势。
AI.motivation: 物理学习允许可训练材料或网络利用自身物理响应来携带误差信号，减少对单独编程的反向计算的需求。然而，关键问题是：什么因素决定这类系统是遵循传统梯度下降，还是沿着真正不同的学习轨迹演化？理解这一区别对于设计有效的物理学习系统至关重要。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个有向分层传输网络的规范模型，其中每个节点重新分配固定量的流量，从而保持正性和总质量守恒。在匹配响应类（matched response class）中研究学习动力学。使用伴随匹配（adjoint matching）使物理输出响应具有对称形式；分析非负模式反馈（non-negative mode-wise feedback）产生互惠闭环响应和重新加权梯度流的行为；通过添加反对称边界分量引入旋转动力学，并分析有限步效应和累积效应，辅以数值一致性检验。
AI.result: 研究揭示了：守恒约束仅限制允许的学习方向；非负模式反馈产生互惠闭环响应和重新加权梯度流；反对称边界分量使闭环响应旋转，学习路径可以转向，但误差仍在减少。转向的有限步效果由局部曲率决定，累积效果还取决于步长选择和新访问状态。数值检验精确再现了响应结构，预测了跨新网络族的局部效应符号，并展示了轨迹漂移如何抵消局部优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作分离并阐明了几何守恒、互惠性和非互惠性在物理学习中的各自作用。非互惠性可以引入学习轨迹的旋转，但这并不自动带来好处——其价值依赖于具体的动力学环境和状态空间几何。这项工作为理解物理学习系统的学习轨迹偏离传统梯度下降的机制提供了理论框架。

title: Co-Evolving Actor-Conditioned Critics for Non-Verifiable Generation
summary: Natural-language critiques provide supervision beyond scalar rewards for non-verifiable generation, which lacks deterministic verifiers. In critique-guided refinement, a critic gives feedback on an initial response and an actor revises it. However, final revision quality does not reveal whether the critique was actually useful: a capable actor may improve without following the feedback, while valid feedback may fail if the actor cannot execute it. We frame critique as actor-conditioned revision guidance, where usefulness depends on whether the feedback helps the target actor address the intended weakness. We introduce TAIScore (Targeted Actionable Improvement Score), a reward that evaluates the instruction, initial response, critique, and revision together, assessing whether the critique targets a real weakness, whether the actor follows it, and whether the intended aspect improves. We use this reward to train an actor-tailored critic with GRPO, and use critique-guided refinements to construct DPO preference pairs for the actor, forming a co-evolving critic-actor loop where the critic adapts to the actor's changing capability. Experiments show that an 8B critic trained with TAIScore outperforms both a zero-shot 120B critic and critics trained with outcome-only or critique-only reward signals. Co-evolving the critic and actor further improves performance, suggesting that effective critique supervision should adapt as the actor changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAIScore（目标可执行改进分数），一种评估批评反馈对特定actor是否有用的奖励指标，并利用它训练actor定制化的批评者（critic），与actor形成共同进化的循环，使批评反馈能随着actor能力变化而适应。
AI.motivation: 现有基于自然语言批评的细化方法存在根本性缺陷：仅通过最终修订质量无法判断批评是否真正有用——能力强的actor可能不遵循反馈也能改进，而有效的反馈可能因actor无法执行而失败。需要一种能将批评与特定actor能力条件化的评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出TAIScore，通过联合评估指令、初始响应、批评和修订四要素，判断批评是否针对真实弱点、actor是否遵循以及预期方面是否真正改进；2) 使用GRPO用TAIScore训练actor定制化的批评者；3) 利用批评引导的细化工序构造DPO偏好对来训练actor，形成批评者-actor共同进化的循环。
AI.result: 用TAIScore训练的8B批评者在零样本场景下超越120B批评者，也优于仅用结果或仅用批评作为奖励信号训练的批评者。批评者与actor共同进化进一步提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 有效的批评监督应随actor变化而适应，批评的价值是actor条件化的——同样的批评对不同能力的actor可能有不同效用，共同进化的批评者-actor循环是更优的范式。

title: MedAgent-R1: Faithfulness-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Medical Reasoning
summary: When medical AI systems hallucinate clinical reasoning, the consequences extend beyond incorrect answers: fabricated justifications that superficially reference retrieved evidence can mislead clinicians into unsafe treatment decisions. Medical reasoning agents must therefore produce not only correct answers but also faithful justifications that clinicians can verify against cited evidence. We identify a systematic failure mode in RL-trained retrieval agents: outcome-only rewards improve accuracy while degrading faithfulness, a phenomenon we term confident hallucination. The agent learns to answer from parametric memory and backfill plausible but unsupported justifications; citation fabrication rates rise from 16.5% to 31.8% even as accuracy improves by 5 points over the supervised baseline. We address this with a faithfulness-gated reward design: accuracy credit is conditioned on evidence grounding via a hard gate, complemented by retrieval validity and conciseness signals that close exploitation paths unique to agentic retrieval. The resulting system, MedAgent-R1, reduces citation fabrication from 31.8% to 4.7% and raises evidence completeness from 58.7 to 82.6 while maintaining 75.1% accuracy, with 13.2-point gains on HealthBench Safety. Under the same agentic retrieval setup, MedAgent-R1 outscores GPT-4o on faithfulness-specific dimensions (Factual Support 4.55 vs. 4.25; Overclaiming 4.40 vs. 4.15) while remaining below GPT-4o in overall accuracy, suggesting that explicit faithfulness training yields evidence-grounding gains not achieved by scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedAgent-R1系统，揭示了强化学习训练检索体中的"自信幻觉"现象（仅结果奖励提升准确率但降低忠实度），并通过忠实度门控奖励设计将引文捏造率从31.8%降至4.7%，证据完整性从58.7提升至82.6，同时在忠实度维度超越GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 医学AI系统在临床推理中的幻觉不仅产生错误答案，还会生成表面引用证据的虚假理由，可能误导临床医生做出不安全的治疗决策。现有强化学习训练的检索体仅优化结果奖励，导致"自信幻觉"——智能体从参数记忆作答并用看似合理但无证据支持的引用填充理由。
AI.method: 提出忠实度门控奖励设计：通过硬门控将准确率奖励与证据基础条件绑定，辅以检索有效性和简洁性信号，堵住智能体检索中特有的利用漏洞，构建MedAgent-R1系统。
AI.result: 引文捏造率从31.8%降至4.7%，证据完整性从58.7提升至82.6，准确率保持75.1%；HealthBench Safety上获得13.2分提升；在忠实度相关维度（Factual Support 4.55 vs 4.25；Overclaiming 4.40 vs 4.15）超过GPT-4o。
AI.conclusion: 显式的忠实度训练能带来仅靠模型规模扩展无法实现的证据基础收益；对抗自信幻觉需要在奖励设计中直接对证据基础进行条件约束，而非仅依赖更大的模型。

title: Geometric Attractor Monitoring: A Robust and Frugal Framework for Multi-modal Industrial Robotic Cycles
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Monitoring the health of heterogeneous industrial robot fleets is severely challenged by the multi-modal nature of their operational cycles and a persistent scarcity of run-to-failure data. Standard data-driven approaches, particularly deep learning architectures relying on sequential reconstruction, often struggle in this specific setting; they tend to over-smooth complex dynamics, masking early signs of degradation. To address these industrial constraints, we reframe the monitoring problem through a framework based on Phase Space Reconstruction (PSR). Instead of predicting temporal sequences, this framework transforms univariate sensor data into a geometric attractor, explicitly unfolding the mechanical states independently of their temporal occurrence. By evaluating various anomaly scoring techniques within this space, we demonstrate that discrete support estimation provides an effective and computationally frugal Health Indicator (HI). Validated on a real-world dataset of 21 heterogeneous robots over three years and a synthetic Langevin system, our approach outperforms standard deep learning baselines. We show that aligning the algorithmic bias with the geometric properties of the target system yields a pragmatic, traceable and easily deployable approach perfectly tailored to the realities of industrial constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于相空间重构（PSR）的工业机器人健康监测框架，将单变量传感器数据转化为几何吸引子，替代传统的时序预测方法，并在21台异构机器人三年真实数据集和合成Langevin系统上验证，优于标准深度学习基线。
AI.motivation: 异构工业机器人车队健康监测面临两大挑战：操作周期的多模态特性以及run-to-failure数据的稀缺。传统深度学习方法（尤其是基于序列重建的架构）容易过度平滑复杂动力学，掩盖早期退化迹象，无法适应工业实际约束。
AI.method: 利用相空间重构（PSR）框架重新定义监测问题：将单变量传感器数据转化为几何吸引子，显式展开机械状态而不依赖时间顺序；在此空间中评估多种异常评分技术，发现离散支持估计能有效且计算高效地构建健康指标（HI）。
AI.result: 在21台异构机器人三年真实数据及合成Langevin系统上验证，该方法优于标准深度学习基线，证明对齐算法偏差与目标系统几何特性能产生实用、可追踪且易部署的工业监测方案。
AI.conclusion: 将算法偏差与目标系统几何特性对齐，是一种务实、可追踪且易于部署的工业健康监测方法，能有效应对工业现实约束。

title: Beyond Polarization: The Generative Constraint of Chain-of-Thought in Pointwise Reranking
summary: In pointwise document reranking, Chain-of-Thought models typically underperform direct scoring models. While existing diagnostics attribute this to inferior classification, score polarization, or calibration breakdown, whether targeted training can bridge this gap remains unclear. Our empirical study first confirms that this gap is stable across scales up to 32B parameters, ruling out model and data capacity confounders. We then apply stress tests utilizing reinforcement learning, fine-grained supervision, and architectural decoupling to explicitly repair these deviations. Although these interventions improve classification accuracy and absolute scores, the relative ranking gap persists. These findings suggest that, within the pointwise scoring paradigm, routing continuous relevance semantics through discrete text constrains ranking signal resolution, revealing a bottleneck that is stable and difficult to overcome under current standard methods, rather than an easily resolvable training bias.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究发现，在点式文档重排序任务中，思维链模型与直接评分模型之间的性能差距在高达320亿参数规模下依然稳定存在。作者通过强化学习、细粒度监督和架构解耦等压力测试试图修复这一差距，发现虽然可以提升分类准确率和绝对分数，但相对排序差距仍然存在，表明这是点式评分范式下通过离散文本路由连续相关性语义所固有的信号瓶颈，而非可简单修复的训练偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有诊断将思维链模型在点式重排序中表现不佳归因于分类能力差、分数极化或校准失效，但尚不清楚针对性地训练能否弥合这一差距。作者希望系统性地验证这些缺陷是否可以通过训练干预修复。
AI.method: 首先在不同规模（最高32B参数）下的模型中确认思维链与直接评分模型的差距稳定性，排除数据与模型容量混淆因素；然后设计三类压力测试：强化学习、细粒度监督和架构解耦，分别针对分类缺陷、分数极化和校准问题进行显式修复。
AI.result: 三类干预虽能显著提升分类准确率和绝对评分质量，但相对排序（ranking gap）的差距始终无法消除。这证明差距不是简单的训练偏差，而是范式层面的结构性瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 点式评分范式下，通过离散文本（思维链）传递连续的相关性语义会限制排序信号的解析精度。这一瓶颈在现有标准方法下是稳定且难以克服的，提示研究者可能需要突破点式评分范式本身，而非仅仅优化训练策略。

title: ATLAS: Dual-Horizon Diagnostic Evaluation for Industrial Tool-Use Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in user-facing services that require iterative tool use under dynamic business conditions. Reliable evaluation is essential for sustained improvement: it must reveal capability deficiencies, inform priorities, and assess interventions. Yet industrial agent service unfolds both through the iterative trajectory of a current request and through continued user interaction. Final-outcome assessment can therefore obscure where deficiencies arise and whether later service remains aligned with context from earlier exchanges. We propose ATLAS, a dual-horizon diagnostic evaluation framework for industrial tool-use agents. At the request horizon, trajectory-wise diagnostic signals relate deficiencies to execution locations and capability concerns. At the interaction horizon, user-wise signals assess whether service remains responsive across continued interaction. Together, these views provide structured diagnostic evidence for analyzing execution deficiencies and sustained service behavior. ATLAS instantiates them as executable signals with explicit evidence scopes and decision boundaries. LLM judge interfaces are calibrated against high-confidence references from real business logs; when needed, their decision behavior is distilled into efficient diagnostic models for lower-latency, lower-cost evaluation. The resulting feedback supports policy optimization. We evaluate ATLAS on Meituan Xiaotuan production traffic. Offline experiments assess diagnostic-signal fidelity and replay-based policy improvement, while online A/B experiments show concurrent gains in user engagement, downstream business outcomes, and sampled human-audit quality.

AI.tldr: 提出ATLAS，一个面向工业工具使用型LLM代理的双视野诊断评估框架，在请求层面（轨迹诊断）和交互层面（用户持续服务诊断）提供可执行的评估信号，并在美团小团生产流量上验证了其有效性与在线收益。
AI.motivation: 工业代理服务既包含当前请求的迭代轨迹，也包含持续的用户交互，仅靠最终结果评估无法定位能力缺陷来源，也无法判断后续服务是否与先前交互上下文保持一致，需要更细粒度的诊断评估框架。
AI.method: ATLAS提出双视野框架：请求视野下通过轨迹级诊断信号将缺陷关联到执行位置与能力维度；交互视野下通过用户级信号评估持续交互中的服务响应性。信号具有显式证据范围与决策边界，LLM裁判接口用真实业务日志的高置信参考进行校准，必要时将决策行为蒸馏为高效诊断模型以降低延迟与成本。
AI.result: 在美团小团生产流量上，离线实验验证了诊断信号保真度与基于回放的政策改进效果；在线A/B实验显示用户参与度、下游业务结果和人工审计质量均有同步提升。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS通过双视野诊断框架提供了结构化证据以分析执行缺陷和持续服务行为，其反馈可用于策略优化，并在工业级生产环境中取得显著效果，证明该评估范式有效且可落地。

title: What Emerges and What Breaks in Self-Play Driving
summary: Training autonomous driving policies through pure self-play has recently shown promising results. Following Gigaflow and Puffer- Drive, we train driving policies in a similar self-play fashion, but extend the models from MLPs to Transformers and train on the high-definition map of a real city, where we ultimately aim to deploy them. On the CARLA and Waymax benchmarks, our policies fall short of Gigaflow, and we trace the gap to specific failure modes, including reward hacking at traffic lights and a missing incentive to stop at stop signs. We further analyze which traffic rules emerge from self-play and how closely they match human driving, and we confirm that reward conditioning yields the intended diversity of driving behaviors. A demonstration of a trained policy is available at https://laursisask-ut.github.io/eccvdemo.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了将纯自我对弈训练从MLP扩展到Transformer架构，并在真实城市的高精地图上训练驾驶策略。虽然在CARLA和Waymax基准上未能超越Gigaflow，但作者追踪了性能差距的根因（包括红绿灯处的奖励黑客行为和缺乏停车让行激励），并分析了自我对弈中涌现的交通规则与人类驾驶的匹配程度，同时确认奖励条件化能产生预期的驾驶行为多样性。
AI.motivation: 纯自我对弈训练自动驾驶策略在近期展现出有前景的结果（如Gigaflow和Puffer-Drive），但现有工作尚未探索更强大的Transformer架构，也缺乏在真实城市高精地图上的训练与部署验证。作者希望扩展这一范式，验证其在实际部署场景中的可行性。
AI.method: 采用与Gigaflow和Puffer-Drive类似的自我对弈训练框架，将模型架构从MLP扩展为Transformer，并在真实城市的高精地图上训练驾驶策略。训练后通过CARLA和Waymax基准进行评估，并对失败模式进行归因分析，同时评估交通规则涌现情况、与人类驾驶的匹配度以及奖励条件化的效果。
AI.result: 在CARLA和Waymax基准上，基于Transformer的策略性能不及Gigaflow。性能差距主要归因于特定失败模式：红绿灯处的奖励黑客行为和缺少停车让行（stop sign）的激励。此外，分析了自我对弈中涌现的交通规则与人类驾驶的差异，并确认奖励条件化能有效产生多样化的驾驶行为。
AI.conclusion: 自我对弈训练扩展到Transformer架构是可行的，但在真实城市场景中仍面临规则遵循方面的挑战，尤其在交通灯和停车标志等关键交互场景。这些失败模式的识别为后续改进提供了明确方向，奖励条件化被验证为控制驾驶行为多样性的有效手段。

title: SemPOI-RL: Aligning LLM Semantic Reasoning for Interpretable Out-of-Town POI Sequential Generation
comment: 19 pages in total, including 9 pages of main text and 4 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning and open-ended generation abilities, but aligning these abilities with structured sequential generation remains challenging. This challenge is particularly evident in out-of-town (OOT) POI sequence generation, where a model must infer transferable travel intent from a user's hometown behaviors, adapt to cross-city interest drift, and generate a coherent destination trajectory under structural constraints. Existing approaches either rely on latent ID-based transfer with limited interpretability or directly use LLMs for sequence generation without explicitly grounding inferred semantics into position-aware predictions. To address this gap, we propose SemPOI-RL, a framework that aligns LLM semantic reasoning with structured sequence generation for interpretable OOT recommendation. Specifically, we first fine-tune an LLM to infer destination-oriented travel styles from users' hometown trajectories, using natural language as an interpretable semantic intermediate. We then introduce a Semantic POI Alignment Module (SPAM) to ground these inferred styles into a style-conditioned masked autoencoder for position-aware trajectory generation. Finally, we apply reinforcement learning with recommendation-oriented rewards to align LLM-generated styles with downstream sequence quality. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that SemPOI-RL consistently outperforms both traditional recommenders and direct LLM baselines, while providing interpretable style attribution across different phases of a trip. The code is available at https://github.com/Wind-Flipped/SemPOI-RL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemPOI-RL框架，通过将LLM的语义推理能力与结构化序列生成对齐，解决跨城市（OOT）兴趣点序列推荐中语义解释性与位置感知生成难以兼顾的问题。框架包含三个核心组件：基于自然语言的出行风格推断、风格条件掩码自编码器进行位置感知轨迹生成、以及强化学习对齐语义风格与下游序列质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两方面局限：基于潜在ID迁移的方法缺乏可解释性；直接使用LLM生成序列的方法未能将推断出的语义显式地锚定到位置感知预测中。这导致在OOT POI序列生成这一需要同时处理可迁移旅行意图推断、跨城市兴趣漂移适应和结构化约束下轨迹生成的任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 1) 微调LLM从用户家乡轨迹中推断目的地导向的旅行风格，以自然语言作为可解释的语义中间表示；2) 引入语义POI对齐模块（SPAM），将推断风格作为条件输入到掩码自编码器中，实现位置感知的轨迹生成；3) 使用以推荐为导向的奖励进行强化学习，将LLM生成的风格与下游序列质量对齐。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SemPOI-RL在性能上持续优于传统推荐器和直接LLM基线，并且能够提供跨旅行不同阶段的解释性风格归因。
AI.conclusion: SemPOI-RL证明了将LLM语义推理与结构化序列生成显式对齐的有效性，为OOT推荐提供了兼具性能与可解释性的解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal Prototype Optimization for Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) is a fundamental component of affective computing that aims to decipher complex emotional states by integrating verbal content with non-verbal cues including vocal intonation and facial micro-expressions. While recent disentanglement-based approaches have advanced the field, their potential is hindered by two methodological challenges. First, static computation graphs process all samples indiscriminately regardless of semantic complexity, which leads to suboptimal representation for diverse emotional expressions and contextual scenarios. Second, generic contrastive objectives often neglect the intrinsic ordinal hierarchy of sentiment intensities. To systematically address these limitations, we introduce Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal prototype optimization (MAESTRO), a novel framework designed to dynamically orchestrate and refine multimodal representations. Drawing inspiration from an orchestra conductor, we design a Text-Guided Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Unlike static fusion, this module utilizes linguistic context as a routing signal to dynamically activate specific audio-visual experts, thereby resolving cross-modal ambiguity through adaptive feature enhancement. Furthermore, to capture fine-grained sentiment gradations, we propose an Ordinal-aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (O-PCL). By incorporating distance-based penalties into the prototype learning objective, O-PCL enforces a structured latent space that preserves the natural order of emotion. Extensive experiments on the CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that MAESTRO achieves state-of-the-art performance, and qualitative analysis further confirms the interpretability of our dynamic routing paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAESTRO框架，通过文本引导的混合专家（MoE）动态路由机制和序数感知原型对比学习（O-PCL），解决多模态情感分析中静态计算图和通用对比学习的两大局限，在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于解纠缠的多模态情感分析方法面临两个关键挑战：一是静态计算图对所有样本一视同仁，未能考虑语义复杂度的差异，导致对多样化情感表达和情境的表示次优；二是通用的对比学习目标忽略了情感强度的内在序数层级结构，难以捕捉细粒度的情感渐变。
AI.method: MAESTRO框架包含两个核心模块：1) 文本引导的混合专家（Text-Guided Hybrid MoE）机制，以文本语境作为路由信号，动态激活特定的音视频专家，解决跨模态歧义并实现自适应特征增强；2) 序数感知原型对比学习（O-PCL），通过在原型学习目标中引入基于距离的惩罚项，构建保持情感自然顺序的结构化潜在空间。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI两个多模态情感分析基准数据集上，MAESTRO取得了最先进的性能；定性分析进一步验证了动态路由范式的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MAESTRO通过动态路由机制和序数感知学习的结合，有效解决了现有方法的静态性和序数信息缺失问题，证明了依据语义复杂度自适应调整计算路径以及保留情感强度顺序结构对于多模态情感分析的重要性。

title: Deploying DeepSeek 175B Locally on a Single Consumer-Grade RTX 4060 Laptop with 32GB RAM for 200k-Scale Protein-Ligand Virtual Screening
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in protein-ligand interaction prediction, but state-of-the-art pipelines for large-scale virtual screening almost exclusively rely on high-end GPU clusters with hundreds of gigabytes of memory, creating prohibitive hardware barriers for small academic teams. In this work, we present a fully local low-resource framework that deploys the 175-billion-parameter DeepSeek 175B LLM on a single consumer-grade RTX 4060 laptop equipped with 32GB system RAM and 8GB VRAM, completing a full 200k-scale protein-ligand virtual screening workflow across 20 distinct protein targets. Our implementation achieves 100x throughput of an 8-card A100 cluster baseline under identical task configurations within 72 hours, with an average binding affinity prediction error of 0.88 kcal/mol across all targets, satisfying the 1.0 kcal/mol chemical accuracy requirement for preclinical drug discovery. Systematic runtime profiling reveals that heterogeneous memory management overhead accounts for 72% of total execution time, while accuracy loss introduced by model optimization contributes less than 10% to total prediction error. This work validates the engineering feasibility of running industrial-scale trillion-parameter LLM-driven biomedical computing tasks on consumer hardware, establishing a new low-barrier paradigm for AI-powered early stage drug discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个完全本地化的低资源框架，在配备32GB系统内存和8GB显存的消费者级RTX 4060笔记本上部署1750亿参数的DeepSeek 175B大语言模型，成功完成20个蛋白质靶点的20万规模虚拟筛选流程，72小时内实现8卡A100集群100倍的吞吐量，平均结合亲和力预测误差0.88 kcal/mol，满足临床前药物发现的1.0 kcal/mol化学精度要求。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的蛋白-配体相互作用预测管道严重依赖高内存GPU集群（数百GB内存），为小型学术团队设置了难以逾越的硬件门槛。作者旨在打破这一硬件壁垒，探索在消费级设备上运行工业级LLM驱动的药物发现任务的可能性。
AI.method: 将175B参数的DeepSeek 175B LLM部署于单台RTX 4060笔记本（32GB系统RAM + 8GB VRAM），通过异构内存管理实现完整的20万规模蛋白-配体虚拟筛选工作流，覆盖20个不同蛋白质靶点。
AI.result: 在72小时内实现8卡A100集群100倍的吞吐量；平均结合亲和力预测误差为0.88 kcal/mol；运行时剖析显示异构内存管理开销占执行总时间的72%，模型优化引入的精度损失对总预测误差贡献不足10%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了在消费级硬件上运行工业级万亿参数LLM驱动的生物医学计算任务的工程可行性，为AI驱动的早期药物发现建立了低门槛的新范式。

title: Generative Models Enhanced by Sequence Labelling and Aspect-Code Switching Improve Cross-lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
comment: Accepted for The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Cross-lingual aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) transfers knowledge from a source language with annotated data to a target language, enabling fine-grained sentiment analysis without annotated target-language data. While monolingual ABSA has seen significant progress, cross-lingual ABSA remains underexplored, especially for complex tasks involving multiple sentiment elements like target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD). In this paper, we propose a novel SeqLab framework that enhances cross-lingual ABSA using a sequence-to-sequence model with an auxiliary sequence-labelling task performed by the encoder, enhancing aspect term recognition and sentiment predictions. Additionally, we incorporate aspect-code switching (ACS), a translation-based technique that swaps aspect terms between source and translated sentences, generating additional training data to enhance the model's cross-lingual understanding. We evaluate our approach across eleven languages, three domains, and two backbone models, surpassing previous state-of-the-art results for the commonly studied E2E-ABSA task. Unlike most prior work that relies solely on English as the source language, we systematically assess different source-target language pairs and extend our evaluation to the more challenging, yet underexplored TASD task in cross-lingual settings. Finally, we provide a detailed error analysis highlighting key challenges and limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeqLab框架，通过序列到序列模型中的编码器辅助序列标注任务，并结合方面词代码切换（ACS）数据增强技术，提升跨语言方面级情感分析（ABSA）的性能，在11种语言、3个领域和2个骨干模型上超越先前最优结果，并首次系统性地扩展评估到更具挑战性的TASD任务。
AI.motivation: 跨语言ABSA虽已有一定研究，但仍未被充分探索，尤其是涉及多个情感要素的复杂任务（如TASD）研究不足；此外，大多数先前工作仅依赖英语作为源语言，缺乏对不同源-目标语言对的系统评估。
AI.method: 1) SeqLab框架：采用序列到序列模型，在编码器上增加辅助序列标注任务，以增强方面词识别和情感预测；2) 方面词代码切换（ACS）：一种基于翻译的技术，将方面词在源句和译文之间进行交换，生成额外的训练数据以增强跨语言理解能力。
AI.result: 在11种语言、3个领域、2个骨干模型上进行了全面评估，在E2E-ABSA任务上超越先前最先进结果；同时系统评估了不同源-目标语言对，并扩展评估到跨语言设置下更具挑战性的TASD任务。
AI.conclusion: SeqLab框架结合序列标注辅助任务与ACS数据增强，能有效提升跨语言ABSA性能；论文还提供了详细的错误分析，指出了关键挑战和局限性，为未来跨语言ABSA研究提供了方向。

title: Autoregressive Mosaics: Probing 2D Spatial Reasoning in Text-Only Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained only on text and code can sometimes generate programs that draw recognizable images. However, it is unclear whether this reflects an internal representation of 2D spatial layout or simply the ability to translate spatial descriptions into code. We introduce Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench), a benchmark that separates these factors: First, a translation task gives a model a fully specified geometry of a picture in words as a prompt and asks for the code that produces it. Second, a layout task requires the model to compose an image from an underspecified prompt. Across eight open-weight text-and-code-only models, all models reliably translate specified geometry into code, but their open-ended layout performance differs substantially, indicating that these differences are not explained by code-generation ability alone. An output-medium ablation further shows that the interface or medium of expression that the model uses matters: replacing procedural code with raw SVG improves layout scores across all models. Finally, probing model activations shows that a coarse layout plan is present before generation, but reflects only the layout implied by the prompt. During generation, models track the evolving geometric state instead of executing an initially fixed plan. Overall, these results show that 2D spatial performance in text-only LLMs depends on both the model and the output medium, and is not explained by code-generation ability alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AM-Bench基准，将"将空间描述翻译为代码"与"从模糊提示构图"两种能力分离，发现纯文本LLM在二维空间布局任务上的表现不仅取决于代码生成能力，还受模型本身和输出媒介（如SVG优于过程式代码）影响。通过激活探针发现模型在生成前仅有粗粒度的布局计划，生成过程中动态跟踪几何状态而非执行固定计划。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅凭文本和代码训练的LLM能生成可识别图像的程序，但无法确定这是否代表模型内部真正拥有2D空间布局的表示，还是仅仅具备将空间描述翻译成代码的能力。作者希望分离这两个因素，探究LLM的2D空间认知本质。
AI.method: 提出Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench)基准，包含两个任务：(1)翻译任务——给定完全指定的几何描述，要求生成对应代码；(2)布局任务——从模糊提示中构图。对8个开源纯文本+代码模型进行测试，并进行输出媒介消融实验（过程式代码 vs 原始SVG），最后通过激活探针分析模型内部的布局计划。
AI.result: 所有模型都能可靠地将指定几何翻译为代码，但开放式布局表现差异显著，说明差异不能仅用代码生成能力解释。将输出媒介从过程式代码替换为SVG后，所有模型的布局分数均提升。激活探针显示生成前存在粗粒度布局计划但仅反映提示词隐含的布局，生成过程中模型追踪演化的几何状态而非执行初始固定计划。
AI.conclusion: 纯文本LLM的2D空间表现同时依赖于模型本身和输出媒介，不能仅归因于代码生成能力。模型内部不存在完整的先验空间图景，而是在生成过程中逐步构建和追踪几何状态。

title: Fine-Tuning Low-Bit Models with Gradient in Quantized Code Space
summary: Fine-tuning Low-bit models aims to adapt a quantized model while keeping the final deployed checkpoint in the same low-bit form. This setting is practically important as it reduces memory and inference cost for storage and deployment. Under this constraint, adaptation becomes an optimization problem over quantization codes and scales. Existing continuous low-bit training is efficient, but it can be distorted by straight through estimation error or by post-quantize gap; discrete search is deployment-faithful, but it is often too inefficient under a finite training budget. We propose code surrogate gradient as the first order signal in deployable code space to acceleate optimization, and performing guided search to preserve deployment faithfulness. Experiments across arithmetic reasoning, instruction following, and structured language understanding show that GradCodes consistently improves fine-tuning low-bit models across different quantization datatypes. Code is provided at https://github.com/ovo67/GradCodes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GradCodes方法，用于低比特模型微调（fine-tuning low-bit models），通过代码代理梯度（code surrogate gradient）在可部署的代码空间中加速优化，并结合引导搜索保持部署保真度，在算术推理、指令跟随和结构化语言理解等任务上一致优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 低比特模型微调在实际中很重要，因为可以减少存储和推理成本。但现有方法存在两难：连续低比特训练虽然高效，但会受直通估计器误差或后量化差距（post-quantize gap）的扭曲；离散搜索虽然部署保真度高，但在有限训练预算下效率太低。
AI.method: 提出代码代理梯度作为可部署代码空间中的一阶信号来加速优化，并执行引导搜索（guided search）以保持部署保真度。该方法在量化码（quantization codes）和缩放因子（scales）上进行优化。
AI.result: 在算术推理、指令跟随和结构化语言理解等任务上的实验表明，GradCodes在不同量化数据类型下均一致地提升了低比特模型微调的性能。
AI.conclusion: GradCodes通过结合代理梯度的优化效率与引导搜索的部署保真度，有效解决了低比特微调中效率与保真度的权衡问题。

title: Learning to Reason and Use Tools through Unsupervised Fine-Tuning in Task-Oriented Dialog Systems
summary: Current dialogue systems struggle with dynamic information retrieval, often leading to hallucinations and lower response accuracy.
