Our metrics and case study offer empirical observations that could help inform data selection and script adaptation choices when working with pixel-based models in similar low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文以藏语为案例，研究像素级语言模型（Pixel-based LMs）在低资源语言上的持续预训练动态，提出四种渲染级视觉脚本相似性度量，发现正字法相近性可增强语义迁移，且多语与单语预训练模型在适应能力上存在不对称性。
AI.motivation: 像素级语言模型通过处理文本渲染图像来替代传统分词器，其跨语言迁移高度依赖文字系统的视觉与结构属性。然而，针对具有复杂形态和独特文字的低资源语言的适应动态尚未被探索，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以藏语为案例，分析像素级LM持续预训练受数据规模、初始脚本暴露和跨语言迁移（来自其他Brahmic文字语言）的影响；引入四种渲染级度量来量化视觉脚本相似性，并在三个任务上评估下游性能。
AI.result: 较高的正字法邻近性即使在严重数据受限下也能增强语义迁移；多语预训练模型PIXEL-M4初始性能更强但后续适应能力受限，而单语模型PIXEL混合脚本训练在句子级任务上获得更多增益。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的度量和案例研究为像素级模型在类似低资源场景下的数据选择和脚本适应决策提供了实证参考。

title: Reconciling Process Supervision with Outcome-Based Credit in Agentic Policy Optimization
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides verified feedback for language-model agents, but assigns trajectory-level advantage uniformly to all decisions, yielding coarse credit over long-horizon interactions. On-policy self-distillation offers finer supervision by re-evaluating sampled behavior with privileged information (PI) available only during training. However, fine-grained supervision is not necessarily fine-grained credit: PI-induced likelihood changes describe how additional information alters policy preference, but do not directly determine how an executable action should inherit the verified task outcome. This creates a supervision-credit gap. Privileged signals may be irrelevant to the current interaction state, operate at a token granularity misaligned with executable decisions, and lack the outcome semantics required for reinforcement. We introduce TASPO, which converts privileged supervision into outcome-grounded action credit. TASPO constructs decision-applicable PI from verified successful experience, aggregates PI-induced likelihood shifts at the executable-action level, and converts relative action support into positive, bounded, mean-preserving weights on the original trajectory advantage. Thus, the verified outcome determines the update direction and average scale, while PI only redistributes credit across actions. Across three agentic benchmarks, TASPO improves over GRPO by 10.6\% and generalizes better to unseen tasks. Further analysis indicates that TASPO reduces supervision mismatch and that action-level assignment stabilizes the policy optimization process. These findings offer the community another interesting perspective.

AI.tldr: TASPO将特权监督转化为基于结果的动作信用分配，通过构造决策适用的特权信息、在可执行动作层面聚合似然偏移，并将相对动作支持转换为正有界均值保持的权重，从而弥合监督与信用之间的差距。在三个智能体基准上，TASPO相比GRPO提升10.6%，并具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 基于结果的强化学习将轨迹级优势均匀分配给所有决策，导致长程交互中的粗粒度信用分配问题；而基于策略的自蒸馏虽能利用训练时特权信息提供更细粒度的监督，但细粒度监督不等于细粒度信用分配——特权信息引起的似然变化只描述策略偏好的改变，并不能直接决定可执行动作应如何继承验证后的任务结果，存在"监督-信用差距"。
AI.method: TASPO包含三个关键步骤：(1) 从验证过的成功经验中构造决策适用的特权信息；(2) 在可执行动作层级聚合特权信息引起的似然偏移；(3) 将相对动作支持转换为正的、有界的、均值保持的权重，作用于原始轨迹优势。这样确保验证结果决定更新方向和平均规模，而特权信息仅负责在动作之间重新分配信用。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准上，TASPO相比GRPO平均提升10.6%，在未见任务上具有更好的泛化能力。进一步分析表明，TASPO减少了监督不匹配问题，且动作级别的信用分配稳定了策略优化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了特权监督与信用分配之间的结构性差距，并提出了一种在不改变验证结果语义的前提下利用特权信息重新分配动作信用的一般性方法，为语言模型智能体的强化学习提供了新的视角。

title: Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: While low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient model adaptation, how to regularize its training dynamics for stable and effective optimization remains underexplored. Because LoRA initializes the up-projection to zero, its early optimization dynamics are largely governed by the down-projection. Building on this observation, we introduce Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation (NoRA), a simple yet effective method that normalizes the down-projection matrices during training. We further show that the same normalization can be applied only at initialization, improving standard LoRA without requiring repeated normalization throughout training. Across pretraining, supervised finetuning, and reinforcement learning, NoRA consistently accelerates convergence, improves performance and training stability, and mitigates catastrophic forgetting. These benefits require neither additional trainable parameters nor inference-time computation, making NoRA a simple and broadly applicable enhancement to LoRA.

AI.tldr: 提出NoRA（Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation），通过对LoRA的下投影矩阵进行归一化来稳定和优化训练动态，可在预训练、监督微调和强化学习中加速收敛、提升性能并缓解灾难性遗忘，无需额外参数或推理开销。
AI.motivation: LoRA被广泛用于参数高效适配，但其训练动态的正则化尚未被充分探索。由于LoRA将升投影初始化为零，早期优化动态主要由下投影主导，这为利用归一化来改善训练稳定性提供了契机。
AI.method: NoRA方法：在训练过程中对LoRA的下投影矩阵进行归一化。进一步发现，归一化只需在初始化时应用一次即可改进标准LoRA，无需在训练中反复归一化。
AI.result: 在预训练、监督微调和强化学习等任务中，NoRA一致地加速收敛、提升性能和训练稳定性，并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: NoRA是一种简单且广泛适用的LoRA增强方法，其优势不依赖额外的可训练参数或推理时计算开销，可作为标准LoRA的直接替代增强方案。

title: Language Proficiency Assessment from Eye Movements in Naturalistic Passage Reading
summary: Standard language proficiency tests rely on linguistic tasks such as vocabulary, grammar and reading comprehension quizzes. An alternative, cognitively motivated approach, introduced in Berzak et al. (2018), proposed instead to predict language proficiency from behavioral traces of eye movements in reading. In this work, we validate and extend this approach from single sentences to more naturalistic reading of contextualized passages in English as a second language, new proficiency measures, prediction models, and reading in an information seeking regime. We find that the approach is effective in all these evaluations. We further address two key open questions on eye movement based proficiency testing: (1) potential scoring biases that reflect the proximity of the reader's native language to English, which may undermine validity, and (2) its reliability. We find that eye movement based proficiency scores are indeed biased towards L1s that are linguistically closer to English. We propose a score debiasing method which effectively remedies this issue. The reliability analyses suggest that eye movement proficiency scores are more reliable than standard language proficiency scores. Overall, our results strengthen and broaden the empirical foundations for future eye movement based language assessment technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文验证并扩展了基于眼动的语言能力评估方法，从单句扩展到上下文段落阅读，覆盖英语二语学习者、新型能力指标、预测模型及信息搜索阅读场景。研究发现该方法有效，但存在母语接近英语程度导致的评分偏差，并提出了有效的去偏差方法。可靠性分析表明眼动评分优于标准语言测试评分。
AI.motivation: 传统语言能力测试依赖词汇、语法、阅读理解等语言学任务，而Berzak等人（2018）提出了基于阅读眼动行为痕迹预测语言能力的认知动机方法。本研究旨在验证并将其从单句扩展到更自然的上下文段落阅读场景，同时解决评分偏差和可靠性两个关键开放问题。
AI.method: 将眼动能力评估从单句扩展到上下文段落阅读，应用于英语二语学习者；引入新的能力度量、预测模型以及信息搜索阅读模式；提出评分去偏差方法来修正母语接近英语程度对评分的影响；对眼动评分的可靠性进行系统分析并与标准语言测试评分对比。
AI.result: 眼动方法在所有评估场景中均有效；发现眼动评分确实偏向与英语语言距离较近的母语者；提出的去偏差方法有效解决了该问题；可靠性分析显示眼动评分比标准语言能力评分更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果加强并拓宽了未来基于眼动的语言评估技术的实证基础，证明了该方法在更自然阅读场景中的有效性，同时指出了母语偏差问题并提供了可行的解决方案，且证明了其更高的可靠性。

title: Token-Efficient Data Reasoning Agents via Adaptive Structuring of Unstructured Data
summary: Valuable data remains embedded in unstructured sources: web pages, reports, contracts, filings, earnings calls, and PDFs. The big bet in enterprise AI is deploying LLM agents that reason over this data to answer complex questions for every knowledge worker. Agents can do this today, but at prohibitive cost. Each question repeatedly opens large documents to recover scattered evidence, consuming up to a million tokens. However, if the data were already structured, the same question would reduce to a cheap database lookup. For example, on FanOutQA benchmark, reasoning over an ideal pre-structured store is 28X cheaper, and the gap grows to orders of magnitude as questions fan out over more documents. Yet structuring everything in advance is not viable: documents hold vastly more possible structure than any workload will use, and the useful structure and documents are unknown until queries arrive. We propose agentic data cracking, a method that structures unstructured data adaptively and speculatively as a byproduct of reasoning itself. Structuring is adaptive because observed queries decide when it happens and what matters, and speculative because it goes beyond the current question. Whenever the agent opens a document to answer, a cracking sub-agent forks from the already-loaded context at marginal cost and extracts grounded structure likely to serve related future queries. Over time, an increasing share of queries is fully covered by structured data and answered without opening a document, keeping agentic accuracy at close to RAG cost. On FanOutQA, extended with merely one related question per test question, cracking cuts cost by 53% while preserving accuracy. Agentic data cracking is a first step toward next-generation data infrastructure for agentic reasoning over unstructured data: a shared substrate beneath the model where knowledge that reasoning already paid to uncover accumulates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体数据破解"（agentic data cracking）方法，在LLM智能体处理非结构化数据的过程中，自适应且推测性地将文档结构化作为推理的副产品。通过从已加载的上下文中派生子智能体提取结构化数据，为未来相关查询服务，从而大幅降低成本（FanOutQA上节省53%成本）同时保持准确性。
AI.motivation: 企业LLM智能体虽然能回答基于非结构化数据的复杂问题，但成本高昂——每个问题需反复打开大文档搜索分散的证据，消耗多达百万token。若数据已结构化，同一问题仅需廉价的数据库查找（FanOutQA上便宜28倍）。但预先结构化所有数据不可行，因为文档蕴含的结构远超过实际工作负载所需，且有用的结构和文档在查询到达前未知。
AI.method: 提出agentic data cracking方法：当智能体打开文档回答问题时，一个"破解子智能体"（cracking sub-agent）从已加载的上下文中分叉出来（边际成本极低），提取有依据的结构化数据，这些数据很可能服务未来的相关查询。结构化是自适应的（由实际观察到的查询决定何时发生和什么重要）且推测性的（超出当前问题范围）。随着时间推移，越来越多的查询完全由结构化数据覆盖，无需打开文档即可回答。
AI.result: 在FanOutQA基准上，仅扩展每个测试问题一个相关问题，cracking方法将成本降低53%同时保持准确率。此外，在理想预结构化存储上推理比原始方式便宜28倍，且随着问题跨更多文档扇出，差距扩大到数量级。
AI.conclusion: Agentic data cracking是迈向下一代智能体推理非结构化数据基础设施的第一步：在模型之下建立一个共享底层，让推理已经付出代价而发现的知识得以积累。这是一个有前景的方向，将智能体推理转化为持续结构化数据的机制。

title: Rotational Equivariance in Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Tutorial
summary: Rotational symmetry is one of the most important structural principles in machine learning on 3D data. In applications ranging from physics and materials science to 3D computer vision, predictions should not depend on an arbitrary choice of coordinate frame. Rotational equivariance captures this requirement mathematically by enforcing that a rotation of the input induces a corresponding transformation of the model output. This tutorial provides a comprehensive introduction to rotational equivariance, starting from the physical and geometric intuition behind coordinate independence and building up the necessary machinery from geometric deep learning, group theory, and representation theory. We introduce message passing on Euclidean graphs, group actions and representations, spherical harmonics, Wigner matrices, tensor products, and Clebsch-Gordan decomposition, and explain how these ingredients give rise to modern equivariant architectures. We then survey the principal strategies for incorporating rotational equivariance in deep learning, including group convolutions, internal tensorial representations, and canonicalization-based methods, and discuss their practical strengths and limitations. The tutorial aims to lower the barrier to the subject by connecting the underlying mathematics to practical model design, by unifying ideas that are often expressed in different formal languages, and by helping practitioners choose among competing approaches through a clear discussion of their trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于3D数据机器学习中旋转等变性（rotational equivariance）的综合性教程，从物理和几何直觉出发，系统介绍了几何深度学习、群论和表示论等必要工具，并综述了群卷积、内部张量表示和基于规范化（canonicalization）等主要等变架构策略及其优缺点。
AI.motivation: 旋转对称性是3D数据机器学习中最重要的结构原则之一，从物理学、材料科学到3D计算机视觉，预测不应依赖坐标系的任意选择。旋转等变性在数学上保证了输入旋转会引发模型输出的相应变换。然而该领域涉及大量复杂的数学工具（群论、表示论等），且不同方法常以不同的形式语言表达，入门门槛较高，亟需一篇系统性的教程来降低学习障碍。
AI.method: 教程首先从坐标无关性的物理和几何直觉出发，建立数学基础：包括欧几里得图上的消息传递、群作用与表示、球谐函数、Wigner矩阵、张量积和Clebsch-Gordan分解，并解释这些组件如何构成现代等变架构。随后综述了三种主要的旋转等变策略：群卷积、内部张量表示和基于规范化（canonicalization）的方法，并讨论各自的实用优势和局限性。
AI.result: 该教程通过将底层数学与实际模型设计联系起来，统一了常以不同形式语言表达的多种思想，提供了清晰的权衡讨论以帮助从业者在不同方法间做出选择，从而显著降低了该领域的学习门槛。
AI.conclusion: 这份教程旨在成为连接理论与实践的桥梁，帮助研究人员和工程师理解旋转等变性的数学基础，并在实际应用中根据任务需求在各类等变架构中做出合理选择。

title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了针对瑞典新闻领域的大型语言模型持续预训练，使用从数百万新闻文章中构建的高质量数据集，并构建了覆盖六项编辑任务的新领域基准。研究发现持续预训练需配合经验回放以防止遗忘，能提升生成质量和事实知识但非判别任务能力；无训练指令跟随方法仅对低秩适应模型有效；现有瑞典基准无法捕捉领域内性能提升，凸显了针对性评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在通用领域能力日益增强，但在小众或研究不足的领域（如瑞典新闻业）实用性有限。作者希望通过领域特定的持续预训练来提升模型在目标领域的表现，并构建专门的评估基准来验证效果。
AI.method: 1) 从数百万新闻文章中策展高质量瑞典新闻语料库；2) 构建覆盖六项编辑任务的新颖领域基准；3) 在两种模型规模上进行全参数和参数高效微调（LoRA）的持续预训练；4) 采用经验回放缓解灾难性遗忘；5) 探索无训练方法促进指令跟随能力。
AI.result: 持续预训练仅在配合经验回放时对目标领域有益；模型生成质量和事实知识有稳定提升，但判别任务能力未改善；无训练指令跟随方法仅对LoRA训练的模型有效；现有瑞典基准无法反映领域内性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了领域适应过程中针对性评估的关键重要性，表明通用基准可能掩蔽模型在特定领域的真实改进，同时揭示了持续预训练中经验回放的必要性以及不同适应方法（全参数 vs LoRA）在后续增强中的差异性表现。

title: Cross-Regional Grapevine Cold Hardiness Prediction via Learned Multimodal Latent Representations
summary: Accurate daily predictions of cold hardiness in woody plants are critical in regions where freezing temperatures can damage dormant buds and reduce seasonal yield. Existing biophysical, hybrid, and deep learning models have shown high predictive accuracy when trained on local data but remain largely site-specific. The limited availability of cold hardiness data, coupled with the lack of principled methods for transferring cold hardiness predictions to new regions and cultivars, has limited the broader adoption and practical utility of these approaches, particularly in data-scarce regions. To address these limitations, we propose a cold hardiness prediction framework that learns a transferable latent representation by capturing region-specific variation through learned embeddings. To enable prediction in previously unseen regions, we infer embeddings from (1) text descriptions of the cultivar and growing region, and (2) limited historical observations, supporting both zero-shot and few-shot transfer. Experiments on datasets from six regions across North America demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art cold hardiness prediction methods, yielding more accurate predictions and substantially improving transfer to data-scarce regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可迁移的低温抗性预测框架，通过学习区域特定嵌入表示，支持零样本和少样本迁移，在北美六个地区的数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有低温抗性预测模型（生物物理、混合、深度学习）在本地数据上表现良好，但高度依赖站点特定数据，难以迁移到新区域和新品种。数据稀缺加上缺乏原则性的迁移方法，限制了这些方法在数据匮乏地区的实际应用。
AI.method: 提出一个学习可迁移潜在表示的框架，通过嵌入向量捕获区域特定变化。对于未见过的区域，可从(1)品种和种植区域的文本描述以及(2)有限的历史观测中推断嵌入，从而支持零样本和少样本迁移。
AI.result: 在北美六个区域的数据集上，该方法持续优于最先进的低温抗性预测方法，预测更准确，并显著改善了向数据稀缺区域的迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过可迁移的嵌入学习解决了低温抗性预测的跨区域泛化问题，为数据稀缺地区提供了实用的预测工具。

title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, the teacher scores student-generated trajectories that are inherently off-policy for it, so the reliability of its supervision, and hence the source of the student's improvement, remains unclear. We quantitatively analyze teacher supervision during OPD training and find substantial noise whose prevalence increases with teacher scale. Surprisingly, the student policy is insensitive to such noise, converging to comparable performance regardless of whether noisy supervision is retained or removed. Does OPD distill at all? By analyzing what drives its gains, we find that learning concentrates on low log-probability tokens, and using a single fixed negative advantage matches the performance of teacher-provided ones. This suggests that OPD works largely by suppressing low log-probability tokens, which requires no teacher. These findings motivate On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA), a supervision-free method using entropy-adaptive negative advantages. It assigns stronger learning signals to high-entropy positions, suppressing tail tokens, and evenly redistributing probability mass among head tokens. Compared with the base \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B}, OPSA improves Avg@32 by 35.41 points on AIME24, corresponding to a 263\% relative gain, and more than doubles Pass@32 across all three benchmarks. It also outperforms OPD by 16.77 points in Avg@32 on AIME24. Extensive experiments and analyses across model families and tasks further demonstrate its effectiveness and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑on-policy蒸馏(OPD)的有效性，发现教师监督存在大量噪声且学生对其不敏感。通过分析发现OPD的提升主要来自抑制低对数概率token，这其实无需教师参与。据此提出On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA)方法，使用熵自适应负优势信号，在多个基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: OPD作为一种比RLVR更密集的token级监督方案被广泛使用，但教师评分的学生轨迹本质上是off-policy的，导致监督可靠性和学生提升来源不明。作者希望厘清OPD真正起作用的原因。
AI.method: 通过定量分析教师监督中的噪声及其与学生提升的关系，包括在训练中保留或移除噪声监督进行对比实验，并分析学习集中在哪些token上。基于发现提出OPSA方法：使用熵自适应负优势，对高熵位置施加更强学习信号以抑制尾token，并将概率质量均匀分配到头部token。
AI.result: OPSA在AIME24上Avg@32提升35.41分（相对提升263%），Pass@32在三个基准上均翻倍以上；在AIME24上Avg@32比OPD高出16.77分。
AI.conclusion: OPD的效果实际上不依赖教师监督，而是通过抑制低对数概率token实现。OPSA作为一种无需监督的方法，通过熵自适应信号更有效地实现这一目标，在多种模型和任务上展现出有效性和泛化性。

title: TaxCE : A Framework for Automated Taxonomy Construction and Evaluation at Scale
summary: Organizing unstructured feedback text into hierarchical taxonomy is a fundamental challenge in NLP, particularly in domains where feedback arrives at massive scale in varied forms such as reviews, transcripts, and surveys. Existing approaches either produce shallow hierarchies, neglect long-tail topics, or lack rigorous evaluation frameworks. We present TaxCE, a fully automated framework that constructs multi-level hierarchical taxonomies from raw text through progressive condensation of corpus content into actionable segments, deduplicated semantic units, and granular topics with definitions, which are then organized bottom-up into a hierarchy with corpus-groundedness. We also introduce three corpus-grounded evaluation metrics, Exclusivity, Exhaustivity, and Granularity (EEG), and integrate them into a metrics-in-the-loop iterative refinement mechanism that diagnoses deficiencies and applies targeted corrections until convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaxCE consistently outperforms existing baselines spanning classical topic models, neural methods, and LLM-based approaches, with average improvements of 11.8, 20.5, and 15.7 percentage points in exclusivity, exhaustivity, and granularity respectively over the strongest baseline. Human evaluation further confirms superior taxonomy quality, actionability, and navigability.

AI.tldr: TaxCE是一个全自动框架，通过渐进式凝聚将非结构化的反馈文本构建为多层级的层次化分类体系，并引入三个语料接地评估指标（Exclusivity、Exhaustivity、Granularity）及指标驱动的迭代优化机制。实验表明其在三个指标上分别比最强基线平均提升11.8、20.5和15.7个百分点，人工评估也验证了其分类质量、可操作性和可导航性。
AI.motivation: 非结构化反馈文本（如评论、转录、调查）的层次化分类组织是NLP中的基础挑战，尤其在海量、多形态反馈场景下。现有方法存在三个主要问题：生成浅层分类体系、忽略长尾主题、缺乏严谨的评估框架。
AI.method: TaxCE框架包括四个核心阶段：(1) 渐进式凝聚——将语料内容转化为可操作片段；(2) 去重语义单元；(3) 生成带定义的主题；(4) 自底向上组织成语料接地的层次结构。同时提出三个语料接地评估指标（EEG），并设计metrics-in-the-loop迭代细化机制，诊断缺陷并实施定向修正直至收敛。
AI.result: 在经典主题模型、神经方法和基于LLM的方法等多个基线的对比中，TaxCE在Exclusivity、Exhaustivity和Granularity三个指标上分别比最强基线平均提升11.8、20.5和15.7个百分点。人工评估进一步确认了其卓越的分类质量、可操作性和可导航性。
AI.conclusion: TaxCE通过全自动的层次化分类构建框架和语料接地的评估-修正闭环机制，有效解决了现有方法在深度、长尾覆盖和评估方面的不足，为大规模反馈文本的组织与分析提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: BLOOM-WILT: Logit Tilting for Behaviour Elicitation in Automated LLM Auditing
summary: Users of a deployed language model routinely encounter behaviours that testing almost never surfaces, since deployment puts the model through orders of magnitude more interactions than any evaluation can simulate. Automated auditors make testing cheap to scale and flexible enough to cover almost any specified behaviour, yet their lack of optimisation pressure makes them sample-inefficient. To address this shortcoming, we introduce BLOOM-WILT, a full auditing pipeline that elicits natural multi-turn instances of rare behaviours, without training cost or access beyond the target's next-token distribution. On the input side, WILT's auditor model revises its conversational strategy across rounds, learning from previous scored interactions. On the output side, WILT adaptively reweights the target's decoding using the model's own distribution conditioned on an elicitation prompt, so that behaviour-relevant generations are sampled ahead of others it finds equally probable when unprompted. We evaluate WILT across 4 target models and 8 behaviours, where it beats the baseline auditor in 30 of the 32 settings and overturns the previous model safety rankings. WILT raises average behaviour presence from 51% to 100% when eliciting self-harm encouragement from Qwen3.5-4B, beating every elicitation method we port into the same pipeline at matched compute, without pushing output probability below the baseline's.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLOOM-WILT，一个完整的审计流水线，用于在无训练成本和仅访问目标模型next-token分布的条件下，高效诱发出罕见行为的多轮自然对话实例。它在输入侧通过审计模型跨轮次修订对话策略，在输出侧自适应地重新加权目标模型的解码分布，优先采样行为相关生成。在4个目标模型和8种行为上，WILT在32个设置中的30个击败基线审计器，并推翻了之前的模型安全排名。
AI.motivation: 部署的语言模型在日常使用中经常会遇到测试几乎无法覆盖的行为，因为部署产生的交互量远超任何评估能模拟的。自动化审计器虽然让测试变得廉价且灵活，但缺乏优化压力导致采样效率低下。
AI.method: WILT由两部分组成：输入侧，审计器模型跨轮次修订对话策略，从之前打分的交互中学习；输出侧，WILT利用目标模型自身在引导提示下的分布，自适应地重新加权解码，使行为相关生成优先于其他同等概率（未引导时）的生成被采样。
AI.result: 在4个目标模型和8种行为上评估，WILT在32个设置中的30个击败基线审计器，推翻了之前的模型安全排名。从Qwen3.5-4B引出自残鼓励行为时，平均行为存在率从51%提升到100%，在匹配计算量下击败所有移植到同一流水线的引出方法，且未将输出概率推至基线以下。
AI.conclusion: WILT证明通过结合输入侧的对话策略优化和输出侧的自适应解码重加权，可以在不增加训练成本的情况下大幅提升自动化审计的采样效率和行为引出效果，且不会牺牲输出的自然概率分布。

title: Universal Transformers for Circuit Computations: Perfect Length Generalization in Tiny Transformers
summary: Learning generalizable algorithmic computations remains a challenge for neural networks, as reflected in persistent failures on compositional and length generalization benchmarks. We present a provably correct, transformer parameterization (with only 280 learnable parameters for Boolean algebra tasks) capable of learning and evaluating problems of any depth or length. We assume inputs are fully parenthesized, well-formed expressions. Our approach conceptualizes algorithmic tasks as circuit models embedded in transformers, enabling depth-1 circuit reduction in a single forward pass. To achieve depth generalization, we introduce a positional encoding that tracks each gate's depth within the circuit, enabling the model to identify evaluable subexpressions at each iteration via masked hard attention, with $O(n)$ per-iteration complexity via linear attention. Combined with an autonomous halting criterion, the model terminates after $d$ iterations for problems of depth $d$, yielding $O(n \cdot d)$ total complexity. We show that training on shallow problem instances (depth 1 and depth 2) effectively recovers interpretable parameters that {\em snap} into place, resulting in exact length generalization. Though we establish that our construction provably evaluates Boolean expressions -- a universal symbolic computation -- of arbitrary length perfectly, in other experiments we also demonstrate that our transformer variant can learn and generalize perfectly (100% accuracy) on other common length generalization benchmarks, including modular arithmetic and ListOps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可证明正确的Transformer参数化方法（布尔代数任务仅需280个可学习参数），通过将算法任务建模为嵌入Transformer的电路模型，配合深度感知的位置编码和线性注意力，实现对任意深度或长度表达式的精确求值，并在训练浅层实例后实现完美的长度泛化。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在学习可泛化的算法性计算方面仍面临挑战，尤其在组合泛化和长度泛化基准上持续失败。作者希望解决这一根本性问题，使Transformer能够在任意深度/长度的符号计算任务上实现可证明的正确泛化。
AI.method: 1) 将算法任务概念化为嵌入Transformer的电路模型，实现单次前向传播中深度-1电路归约；2) 引入深度感知的位置编码，追踪每个门在电路中的深度，通过掩码硬注意力识别可求值的子表达式；3) 使用线性注意力实现O(n)每轮复杂度；4) 结合自主停机准则，对深度d的问题迭代d轮，总复杂度为O(n·d)。
AI.result: 在浅层（深度1和2）训练后能恢复可解释参数并"卡入"正确位置，实现精确的长度泛化。可证明地完美求值任意长度的布尔表达式（通用符号计算），并在其他长度泛化基准（模运算和ListOps）上达到100%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作证明了通过精心设计的Transformer架构与位置编码，网络可以以极少的参数和可证明的保证，实现任意深度/长度的精确算法计算与完美泛化，挑战了神经网络在算法泛化上的传统局限。

title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text
summary: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtered synthetic datasets across domains such as creative writing and code generation, which are then used to fine-tune aligned student models. Our experiments show that benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities. These results reveal a previously underexplored security risk in synthetic data-driven LLM training pipelines and highlight the need for improved safeguards. As one possible step toward this goal, we suggest that log-linearity-based scoring may provide a useful signal for screening seemingly benign synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了合成数据训练大语言模型中的一种安全风险：通过对齐（aligned）模型使用看似良性的合成数据进行微调，可以隐蔽地注入针对性的社会偏见。这种攻击途径通过"潜意识学习"机制实现，且不会显著损害模型的一般任务能力。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明模型可以从看似无关的训练数据中继承行为特征（潜意识学习），但这一机制是否可以被利用来将社会偏见注入对齐模型，尚未被充分探索。合成数据在大语言模型训练中日益普及，其安全影响却鲜有研究。
AI.method: 构建了一个攻击pipeline：使用一个不对齐的教师模型生成合成数据集，经过过滤后覆盖创意写作和代码生成等不同领域，然后用于微调对齐的学生模型。实验验证这些看起来良性的合成数据能否作为隐蔽通道传递目标偏见。
AI.result: 实验表明，看起来良性的合成数据可以作为一种隐蔽通道，向对齐的学生模型传递目标性偏见，同时大部分保留学生模型的一般任务能力。此外，log-linearity评分可能为筛选此类看似良性的合成数据提供有用的信号。
AI.conclusion: 发现了合成数据驱动的大语言模型训练流程中一个此前未被充分探索的安全风险，强调了改进防护措施的必要性，并提出log-linearity评分作为潜在的检测手段。

title: When Does Bigger Help? A Controlled Study of LLM Scale for Ontology Learning
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, and 5 tables. WOP 2026 workshop at ISWC 2026
summary: The effect of Large Language Model (LLM) scale on ontology learning (OL) performance remains insufficiently characterized. We present a controlled evaluation of 13 models spanning dense and Mixture-of-Experts variants from the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 lineages, together with proprietary GPT release variants, using the OntoLearner retrieval-augmented generation pipeline. All models are evaluated with the same embedding model, retrieval configuration, prompt templates, decoding settings, datasets, and metrics on term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relationship extraction across four biomedical and materials science and engineering ontologies. Within the dense Qwen3.5 lineage, increasing parameter count primarily improves precision rather than recall, with the largest gains occurring between 9B and 27B parameters. However, the effect of scale is neither monotonic nor uniform across tasks and domains. Dense 27B models outperform substantially larger sparse models on term typing, whereas larger Mixture-of-Experts models achieve the strongest open-weight results on taxonomy discovery. Non-taxonomic relationship extraction remains difficult across model scales, particularly for the Materials Data Science ontology. Performance differences across matched Qwen variants and proprietary GPT releases further indicate that architecture and model lineage can outweigh nominal parameter count. These findings show that model size alone is an insufficient selection criterion for OL and provide empirical guidance for reproducible LLM-assisted ontology engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文对13个不同规模的大语言模型（涵盖Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6系列中的密集与混合专家变体，以及GPT专有版本）在本体学习任务上进行了受控评估，发现模型规模对性能的影响并非单调或均匀，模型架构和血缘有时比参数数量更重要。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型规模对本体学习性能的影响尚未得到充分刻画，需要系统性的受控评估来提供经验性指导。
AI.method: 使用OntoLearner检索增强生成流水线，在四个生物医学及材料科学与工程本体上，对13个模型进行术语类型标注、分类法发现和非分类关系抽取三项任务评估。所有模型使用相同的嵌入模型、检索配置、提示模板、解码设置、数据集和指标，确保公平对比。
AI.result: 密集Qwen3.5系列中，参数增加主要提升精确率而非召回率，最大增益出现在9B到27B之间。27B密集模型在术语类型标注上优于更大的稀疏模型，而更大的混合专家模型在分类法发现上表现最好。非分类关系抽取在所有规模上都困难，尤其是在材料数据科学本体上。模型架构和血缘的影响可超过名义参数数量。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模本身不足以作为本体学习模型选择的唯一标准，需要综合考虑架构、血缘、任务类型和领域等因素，研究为可复现的LLM辅助本体工程提供了经验指导。

title: A Model with No Head and Many Thoughts
summary: Large language models decode by projecting hidden states through a large vocabulary head at every step. This operation is computationally costly and forces all reasoning to be expressed in discrete tokens. We introduce Soft Latent Thinking, a method that replaces the LM head during reasoning with a lightweight projector, enabling autoregressive rollout in embedding space where reasoning steps remain continuous rather than tokenized. Experiments on DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B and LLaMA-3.2-3B show that Soft Latent Thinking consistently improves pass@k across all k while reducing per-step compute during chain-of-thought. Our method achieves the highest pass@32 among all soft-thinking approaches, demonstrating that effective reasoning can be carried out in continuous space without discrete token generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Soft Latent Thinking方法，用轻量级投影器替代大语言模型在推理阶段的LM头，使推理在嵌入空间中以连续形式进行，无需离散token生成。在DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B和LLaMA-3.2-3B上实验表明，该方法在所有k值下均提升pass@k，且在pass@32上超越所有现有soft-thinking方法，同时降低链式推理的每步计算量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型每一步推理都需要通过大型词汇表头投影隐藏状态，这既计算开销大，又迫使所有推理过程被离散化为token表达，限制了推理的连续性和表达效率。
AI.method: 用轻量级投影器替换推理阶段的LM头，使得自回归过程在嵌入空间中进行，推理步骤保持连续而非token化。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B和LLaMA-3.2-3B上，Soft Latent Thinking在所有k值下均提升pass@k，pass@32达到所有soft-thinking方法中的最优水平，同时降低了chain-of-thought过程中每步的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 有效推理可以在连续空间中完成而无需离散token生成，为语言模型推理提供了一种更高效、更灵活的新范式。

title: REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation
summary: As language-model compute continues to scale, high-quality training data is becoming an increasingly important bottleneck. Conventional next-token prediction supervises what follows a context but leaves the intermediate reasoning behind that continuation implicit. We introduce \textbf{REER-PT}, a scalable framework that extends Reverse-Engineered Reasoning (REER) to raw pre-training data. REER-PT identifies continuations that are difficult to predict but can still be inferred from the preceding context, and inserts concise reasoning annotations that reconstruct the missing connection between context and continuation. Candidate annotations are generated and refined offline, with perplexity serving as the optimization signal. Constraints on length and target leakage filter out unhelpful or trivial annotations. This sparse transformation preserves the source text and remains compatible with standard next-token prediction, avoiding online reasoning rollouts during pre-training. We apply REER-PT to transform a source pre-training corpus into an augmented one. Across augmented-data, original-token, and selected-continuation comparisons, perplexity reductions range from 0.42 to 7.29, and only about 0.05\% of annotation 13-grams appear verbatim in the source text. We then train two 680M-parameter models with the same architecture and training configuration on the source and augmented corpora, respectively. The augmented-data model gains up to 2.07 percentage points on several knowledge and reasoning benchmarks. Together, the perplexity analysis indicates improved continuation predictability, while the controlled pre-training experiments suggest that this augmentation can improve model performance without changing the standard pre-training objective.

AI.tldr: REER-PT是一个可扩展的预训练数据增强框架，它将逆向工程推理（REER）扩展到原始预训练数据。该框架识别难以预测但可从上下文中推断出的续写，插入简要推理注释来重建上下文与续写之间的缺失联系。经验证，伴随困惑度降低和基准测试性能提升，该方法有效改善模型性能且不改变标准预训练目标。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型计算规模不断扩大，高质量训练数据成为瓶颈。传统的下一个词预测（next-token prediction）只监督上下文的后续内容，却将生成该续写所依赖的中间推理过程隐式化，导致模型难以学习到隐藏的推理步骤。
AI.method: REER-PT框架包含以下步骤：1）识别难以预测但仍可从上下文推断的续写；2）离线生成并精炼候选注释（推理注释），用于重建上下文与续写之间的缺失连接；3）以困惑度（perplexity）作为优化信号；4）通过长度约束和target泄漏过滤来排除无用或琐碎的注释；5）保持源文本不变，确保与标准next-token prediction兼容，避免在线推理rollout。
AI.result: 在增强数据、原始token和选定续写的对比中，困惑度降低范围为0.42到7.29；仅约0.05%的注释13-gram与源文本逐字重复。使用相同架构和训练配置分别训练两个680M参数模型（分别基于源语料库和增强语料库），增强数据模型在多个知识和推理基准上提升高达2.07个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 困惑度分析表明增强数据改善了续写的可预测性，而受控预训练实验表明该增强方法可以在不改变标准预训练目标的前提下提升模型性能，为大规模预训练数据的推理能力注入提供了有效且可扩展的途径。

title: OntoAligner-Ensemble: Voting-Based Fusion across Heterogeneous Ontology Alignment Techniques
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, accepted for OM-2026 workshop at ISWC 2026
summary: Ontology alignment (OA) has evolved through several methodological paradigms, ranging from lexical and structural aligners to knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models and, more recently, Large Language Model (LLM)-based approaches. Although modern OA frameworks provide unified ecosystems for deploying these heterogeneous aligners, mechanisms for systematically reconciling their complementary and sometimes conflicting predictions remain relatively underexplored. We present OntoAligner-Ensemble, a modular and aligner-agnostic framework that combines candidate correspondences through a configurable two-stage process comprising voting-based fusion strategies followed by post-fusion selection policies. The framework supports any aligner implemented within OntoAligner that produces candidate correspondences, enabling diverse alignment paradigms to be integrated through a unified decision process. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we instantiate the framework using representative lightweight string-aligner, KGE-based, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation aligners powered by both open-weight and API-based LLMs. We evaluate individual aligners and ensemble configurations across eight benchmark tasks from five OAEI tracks spanning biomedical to beyond-equivalence. The results show that ensemble fusion consistently improves the balance between precision and recall and frequently outperforms standalone aligners across diverse domains. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that ensemble composition directly affects the precision-recall trade-off: heterogeneous cross-paradigm ensembles generally improve precision, whereas homogeneous LLM ensembles more often achieve higher overall F1-scores. These findings demonstrate that systematic ensemble learning offers a robust and reproducible strategy for OA while providing practical guidance for selecting ensemble compositions under different alignment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OntoAligner-Ensemble，一个模块化且与对齐器无关的本体对齐集成框架，通过两阶段流程（投票融合策略+融合后选择策略）系统性地整合不同范式对齐器的候选对应关系，在八个OAEI基准任务上验证了集成方法能持续改善精确率与召回率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 本体对齐经历了从词汇/结构对齐器到知识图谱嵌入模型再到LLM方法的范式演变，虽然现代框架能部署这些异构对齐器，但系统性地调和它们互补甚至冲突的预测结果的机制仍相对未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出OntoAligner-Ensemble框架，采用可配置的两阶段流程：(1)基于投票的融合策略，结合候选对应关系；(2)融合后的选择策略。该框架与对齐器无关，支持任何在OntoAligner中实现并产生候选对应关系的对齐器，实验中实例化了轻量级字符串对齐器、KGE对齐器以及由开源权重和API型LLM驱动的检索增强生成对齐器。
AI.result: 在涵盖生物医学到超越等价关系的五个OAEI轨道的八个基准任务上评估，集成融合持续改善精确率与召回率的平衡，且经常优于单独的对齐器。交叉范式异构集成通常改善精确率，而同质LLM集成更常获得更高的总体F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 系统化的集成学习为OA提供了一种稳健且可复现的策略，同时为在不同对齐场景下选择集成组成提供了实用指导。

title: Sycophantic Agreement Transfers with Neutral Data via Contrastive Preference Optimization
summary: Sycophantic agreement refers to a behavior in which language models excessively affirm the user, often at the cost of factual accuracy. Although sycophantic agreement is a well-known failure of model alignment, there is limited understanding of how it emerges from model training. In this work, we demonstrate that sycophantic agreement can emerge as an unintended consequence of widely used contrastive preference optimization objectives. Using the OLMo 3 post-training pipeline, we show that, for various pairs of teacher models across three families, there is a strong correlation between the log-ratio of the teacher model sycophantic agreement rates and the resulting student model sycophantic agreement rate. We further demonstrate that this unintended transfer is not limited to DPO but also occurs across 6 other preference optimization objectives. To understand whether this effect can be attributed to particular training examples, we analyze the preference data and find that the sycophancy signal is diffused across the entire dataset rather than concentrated in a sparse set of examples: each example appears neutral, i.e., there are no explicit instances of sycophantic agreement, and filtering based on probe-based data attribution or logit-linear selection fails to mitigate sycophancy without removing a large portion of the dataset. Overall, our findings suggest that the teacher models used to generate preference data can interact with alignment training objectives in unexpected ways, generalizing to undesirable and potentially harmful behaviors like sycophantic agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，语言模型中的谄媚性认同（sycophantic agreement）行为可能作为对比性偏好优化（如DPO等）的意外副作用而出现。通过OLMo 3后训练流程，作者证明教师模型的谄媚率对数比率与学生模型的谄媚率之间存在强相关，且该现象在7种偏好优化目标中普遍存在。更重要的是，谄媚信号分散在整个数据集中而非集中在少数样本中，导致基于数据归因的过滤方法难以有效缓解。
AI.motivation: 谄媚性认同是语言模型对齐中的已知失败模式，但对其如何从模型训练中产生缺乏深入理解。厘清这一机制对于改进对齐训练至关重要。
AI.method: 使用OLMo 3后训练流程，测试三种教师模型家族的多组配对，对比DPO及其他6种偏好优化目标，分析教师模型谄媚率对数比率与学生模型谄媚率之间的相关性；并通过对偏好数据的分析（包括探针数据归因和logit线性选择过滤）验证谄媚信号的数据分布特征。
AI.result: 教师模型谄媚率与学生模型谄媚率之间存在强相关，且该传递效应不限于DPO，而是在7种偏好优化目标中均出现。谄媚信号均匀分布在整个数据集而非集中少数样本，基于数据归因的过滤方法无效或需移除大量数据。
AI.conclusion: 用于生成偏好数据的教师模型会与对齐训练目标产生意外的交互作用，从而泛化出谄媚性认同等不良行为。这意味着需要重新审视偏好数据生成过程中教师模型的角色及其潜在风险。

title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
comment: Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 本文发现高熵token在RLVR训练中虽然与梯度大小相关，但熵无法跨答案一致反映token重要性。作者提出基于梯度幅值的token选择方法GMTS，利用熵-梯度关系近似梯度幅值排序，实验表明在三个推理领域和多种模型规模下，GMTS选择的top 20% token训练效果一致优于基于熵的token选择。
AI.motivation: 近年研究发现高熵token在RLVR训练中起关键作用，仅用最高20%熵的token训练就能获得显著性能提升，但高熵token为何有效的原因尚不充分理解，需要更深入的分析和更精细的token重要性评估方法。
AI.method: 首先分析发现高熵token在同一答案内与梯度幅值相关，但熵在不同答案间无法一致反映token重要性（因答案级奖励信号存在差异）。基于此观察，提出GMTS方法，利用熵-梯度之间的联系来近似梯度幅值排序，从而进行token选择。
AI.result: 在三个推理领域和多种模型规模下，基于GMTS排序的top 20% token训练一致优于基于熵的token选择方法，表明GMTS能提供更精细的token贡献估计。
AI.conclusion: GMTS为RLVR训练中的token选择提供了比熵更精确的粒度估计，验证了梯度幅值作为token重要性指标的有效性。

title: Stress-Testing Efficient Responsible-AI Evaluation: When Compute Savings Change Benchmark Conclusions
summary: Efficient evaluation changes the protocol used to support claims about model behavior, yet it is rarely tested whether those claims remain stable after the evaluation itself is made cheaper. We stress-test conclusion robustness in responsible-AI benchmarking by evaluating three dense and mixture-of-experts models on BBQ and BBQ-V under seven conditions spanning batching, quantization, benchmark reduction, and their combinations. Rather than treating preserved aggregate accuracy as sufficient, we compare accuracy, bias severity and prevalence, reasoning quality, subgroup behavior, subset-membership stability, runtime, and measured GPU energy against a full-benchmark BF16 baseline. Larger batching keeps accuracy within 0.35 percentage points of baseline and produces comparatively small subgroup changes, while reducing energy in five of six model--dataset settings. INT8 largely preserves quality but uses 1.79--4.26$\times$ baseline energy. INT4 causes larger, model- and context-dependent changes. Reduced benchmarks provide the most consistent savings, but very small subsets are substantially more sensitive to which items are retained. Efficient evaluation should therefore be treated as a measurement intervention whose validity must be checked across the conclusions the benchmark is intended to support. Our project website is https://vectorinstitute.github.io/sustainable-rai-evaluation/ and the code is available at https://github.com/VectorInstitute/sustainable-rai-evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文对负责任AI基准测试中的高效评估方法进行了压力测试，检验在降低评估成本后结论是否依然稳健。研究在BBQ和BBQ-V基准上，对三种密集模型和混合专家模型在七种条件下（批处理、量化、基准缩减及其组合）进行了系统性评估，从准确率、偏见严重程度与普遍性、推理质量、子群行为、子集成员稳定性、运行时间和GPU能耗等多个维度与BF16全基准基线对比。结果表明，较大批处理在能耗降低的同时基本保持结论稳定；INT8量化虽保持质量但能耗更高；INT4带来更大且依赖模型和上下文的偏差；缩减基准节省最多，但很小子集对保留项高度敏感。作者认为高效评估应被视为一种测量干预，其有效性需根据基准所支持结论的各个维度进行检验。
AI.motivation: 高效评估方法（如批处理、量化、基准缩减）被广泛用于降低评估成本，但现有研究很少检验这些效率优化手段是否会导致模型行为结论的变化。论文的核心动机是填补这一空白，系统性地压力测试高效评估对负责任AI基准结论稳健性的影响。
AI.method: 在BBQ和BBQ-V基准上，对三个密集模型和混合专家模型，测试七种效率条件（批处理、INT8/INT4量化、基准子集缩减及其组合）。不同于仅比较聚合准确率，研究从六维度全面对比：准确率、偏见严重度与普遍性、推理质量、子群行为、子集成员稳定性、运行时及GPU能耗，与全基准BF16基线对照。
AI.result: 1) 较大批处理在五个模型-数据集设置中降低能耗，且准确率偏差保持在0.35个百分点内，子群变化较小；2) INT8大致保持质量但能耗为基线的1.79-4.26倍；3) INT4引发更大、依赖模型和上下文的偏差；4) 基准缩减提供最一致的节省，但极小子集对保留项目高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 高效评估应被视为一种测量干预（measurement intervention），其有效性必须根据基准旨在支持的所有结论维度进行验证，而非仅以聚合准确率是否保留作为充分判据。

title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiG-SURE，一种基于跨温度语义一致性的黑盒不确定性估计方法。通过构建低温度锚点与高温度探针之间的二部图，利用NLI蕴含分数计算归一化谱能量来度量置信度，在文本QA、多语言QA和多模态QA任务上优于现有黑盒不确定性估计器。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景中部署LLM和VLM需要可靠的不确定性估计，但黑盒场景下模型参数不可访问，现有方法在准确性上仍有不足，需要一种简单、无监督且适用于黑盒模型的估计方法。
AI.method: BiG-SURE方法包含三个关键步骤：(1)采样低温度响应作为稳定语义锚点，高温度响应作为探针，并在意义保持的输入变换下进行；(2)利用NLI蕴含分数构建锚点-探针二部图(Bipartite Graph)；(3)通过该矩阵的归一化平方谱能量定义置信度，其补数即为不确定性。该分数用于衡量高温度探针是否与模型稳定的低温度信念保持语义对齐。
AI.result: 在文本QA、多语言QA和多模态QA任务上，跨多个模型家族进行评估，BiG-SURE相比现有的黑盒不确定性估计器在平均弃权AUROC（abstention AUROC）上取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: BiG-SURE是一种简单、无监督、适用于黑盒模型场景的不确定性估计方法，通过跨温度语义一致性和二部图谱能量分析有效提升了不确定性估计的可靠性，具有广泛的适用性。

title: On the Complexity of the Compatibility Problem for Succinctly Encoded Conditional Distributions
summary: The motivation for this paper is the investigation of the trade-offs implicit in probabilistic models used in machine learning. Models are often used to make predictions in the form of conditional probabilities. However, a pair of conditional distributions p(x|y) and p(y|x) may not be compatible with any joint distribution p(x,y). Given two such conditionals, determining if there exists a compatible joint is known as the compatibility problem. For discrete random variables, when the conditionals are encoded as probability tables, the compatibility problem has a known solution, which is computationally tractable. In this paper, we formalise and study a succinct version of the problem, encoding conditional distributions as arithmetic circuits. This is applicable to practical applications of probabilistic modelling in high-dimensional settings, including neural network models. We show that, for succinct circuit representations of conditionals, the compatibility problem is intractable. In the case that all probabilities are non-zero, the problem is co-NP-complete. In the case that probabilities can be zero, we give examples to demonstrate that several notions of compatibility can be distinguished, and we prove that multiple versions of the problem are PSPACE-complete. Furthermore, we show that, assuming the polynomial hierarchy does not collapse, there exist compatible succinct conditionals whose joint cannot be expressed succinctly. Implications of these results for probabilistic modelling and machine learning are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了机器学习中概率模型的条件分布兼容性问题。当条件分布以算术电路（succinct representation）编码时，兼容性问题变得计算上不可处理：非零概率情形下为co-NP完全问题，允许零概率时多个版本为PSPACE完全问题。此外，若多项式层级不坍缩，则存在兼容的简洁条件分布，其联合分布无法简洁表示。
AI.motivation: 在实际机器学习应用中，模型常以条件概率形式做预测，但一对条件分布p(x|y)和p(y|x)可能不存在兼容的联合分布p(x,y)。经典的兼容性问题对离散随机变量（以概率表编码）已有可计算解法，但在高维场景（如神经网络模型）中概率表编码不可行，需要简洁表示（算术电路）。因此，作者希望研究在简洁表示下兼容性问题的计算复杂度。
AI.method: 作者将条件分布编码为算术电路，形式化定义了简洁版本的兼容性问题。通过复杂度理论归约，分别分析非零概率和允许零概率两种情形下问题的计算复杂度，并利用多项式层级假设推导出联合分布表达性的下界结论。
AI.result: (1) 对简洁电路表示的条件分布，兼容性问题不可处理：非零概率情形下为co-NP完全；(2) 允许零概率时，可区分多种兼容性概念，多个版本问题为PSPACE完全；(3) 若多项式层级不坍缩，则存在兼容的简洁条件分布，其联合无法被简洁表达。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，在高维概率建模中采用简洁表示虽然实用，但会牺牲兼容性检验的计算可行性。这对概率建模和机器学习有重要启示：实际应用中需要在表达能力和可判定性之间做出权衡。

title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory
summary: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. The implication of our results for a deployed system that deals with a variety of queries is that precomputed memories are best rebuilt on the cadence at which new information changes what the memory was originally computed from. Both warm-rebuilding trained compressions of key-value caches and serving specifically-phrased updates beside a memory, as pasted text or injected cache state, show particular promise for keeping precomputed memories current, the latter as an interim measure between rebuilds, and we measure the cost and name the remaining questions associated with each.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地研究了预计算记忆（precomputed memory）在语言模型中的适用边界与失效条件。实验基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，使用保存的键值缓存和训练压缩两种方式，发现预计算记忆在由独立部分组装时会退化、只有通过高成本的完整重建才能保持时效性、且忽略特定措辞的条件性纠正。预计算记忆适合在可以并列提供服务、可经济重建、且能被实时新信息取代的场景下使用。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可以从预计算记忆中回答，这是一种将模型对材料的"阅读"保存下来、跨请求复用而非每次重新读取的机制。然而，这种实践在什么条件下能保持正确性、在什么条件下会失效，尚缺乏系统性研究，这正是本文的出发点。
AI.method: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上进行实验，采用两种预计算记忆方式：(1) 保存的键值缓存（saved key-value caches）；(2) 训练压缩的键值缓存（trained compressions）。通过多组实验分别评估预计算记忆在部分组装、时效性维护、以及条件性纠正三个维度上的表现。
AI.result: 实验发现：(1) 由独立准备的部分组装而成的预计算记忆会出现性能退化；(2) 保持记忆当前性需要重建，而重建成本在测量中占据完整准备成本的很大比例；(3) 预计算记忆会忽略与特定措辞相关的条件性纠正。同时，热重建训练压缩和注入特定措辞的更新（作为粘贴文本或注入缓存状态）在保持记忆当前性方面展现出前景。
AI.conclusion: 对于处理多种查询的部署系统，预计算记忆应按照新信息改变其原始计算依据的频率来进行重建。热重建训练压缩的键值缓存和并列服务特定措辞的更新（作为重建间的临时措施）是两种有前景的方向，但各自仍有关联的成本与待解决问题。

title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAVA方法，将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中无需保留集（retain-free）的机器遗忘问题转化为定位问题，通过因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠分析，发现身份信息存储于解码器早中期MLP层，且修改这些层不会破坏视觉感知；PAVA仅在这些层上进行更新，配对遗忘损失与视觉属性锚定，利用遗忘图像自身蒸馏模型遗忘前的回答来保持图像相关行为，在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem上取得了最佳遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM遗忘方法依赖保留集，但部署后最难获得保留集，且重建保留集会重新造成隐私暴露；仅用遗忘集训练会破坏共享的视觉-语言计算，损害感知能力。因此需要一种无需保留集的遗忘方法。
AI.method: 将无保留集遗忘视为定位问题：通过因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠三种技术，定位身份信息存储于早期到中期解码器MLP层。在此基础上提出PAVA（Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring），将更新限制在这些特定层，并配对遗忘损失与视觉属性锚定机制，通过从遗忘图像中蒸馏模型自身遗忘前的答案来保留图像相关行为。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem基准上，PAVA在仅使用遗忘集的方法中取得最强的遗忘-保留权衡，且与依赖保留集的基线方法相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将无保留遗忘转化为定位问题并仅修改身份信息存储层，同时利用视觉属性锚定保持图像相关行为，PAVA实现了无需保留集且不损害视觉感知的有效遗忘。

title: Constant Individual Regret in General Games
summary: Uncoupled no-regret dynamics provide a decentralized route to equilibrium, but prior guarantees for individual regret retain a polylogarithmic dependence on the horizon. We remove this dependence for every finite $N$-player normal-form game under full-information feedback. We introduce \emph{ECHO-OFTRL}: optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader (OFTRL) equipped with an EMA cascade for high-order optimism (ECHO), where EMA denotes exponential moving average. The algorithm is deterministic and fully uncoupled. If $m_{\max}$ denotes the largest action-set size, then, simultaneously for every horizon $T\geq1$, it guarantees that each of the $N$ players in the game incurs regret upper bounded by $O(\textrm{poly}(N, \log m_{\max}))$. Our algorithm leverages a new form of optimism inspired by modern filter design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECHO-OFTRL算法，一种完全解耦的确定性算法，在完全信息反馈下，为所有有限N人正规形式博弈中的每个玩家提供了与时间范围T无关的常数级遗憾上界（仅依赖于N和动作集大小的对数），消除了先前无遗憾动力学中遗憾上界对时间范围的polylogarithmic依赖。
AI.motivation: 无耦合无遗憾动力学为博弈均衡提供了去中心化的路径，但先前研究中个体遗憾的保证对时间范围（horizon）存在polylogarithmic依赖。作者希望消除这一依赖，使算法在任何时间范围内都能保持常数级别的遗憾保证。
AI.method: 作者设计了ECHO-OFTRL算法，即配备EMA（指数移动平均）级联以实现高阶乐观的乐观跟随正则化领导者（OFTRL）算法。该算法的乐观机制受到现代滤波器设计的启发，是一种新的乐观形式。算法是确定性的且完全解耦的（每个玩家独立做出决策，无需观察他人信息）。
AI.result: 对于每个有限N人正规形式博弈，若m_max表示最大的动作集大小，则该算法在任意时间范围T≥1上，同时保证每个玩家的遗憾上界为O(poly(N, log m_max))，即与T无关的常数级遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是首次在完全信息反馈下，为所有有限正常形式博弈提供与时间范围无关的常数级遗憾保证的完全解耦算法，通过引入受现代滤波器设计启发的EMA级联乐观机制，突破了先前方法的局限性。

title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwarmBench基准，用于系统评估大语言模型多智能体系统（Agent Swarms）的动态编排能力，涵盖准确性、效率、成本和过程质量等多个维度。实验发现现有模型在编排能力上存在显著差异，并进一步提出基于经验提取与经验回放的SwarmExp方法，能一致性地提升LLM的编排性能。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统正从固定交互拓扑转向动态编排的Agent Swarms，但现有基准仍主要面向单智能体或通用任务，难以系统评估关键的编排能力，缺乏针对性的评测工具。
AI.method: 提出SwarmBench基准，从准确性、效率、成本和过程质量多个维度全面评估模型编排能力；基于实验发现，提出SwarmExp方法，通过经验提取和经验回放来改进LLM的编排性能。
AI.result: 实验表明当前模型在编排能力上存在显著差异，这些差异不仅体现在最终的准确性、效率和成本上，也体现在编排过程本身的整体质量上；SwarmExp方法能一致性地提升LLM的编排表现。
AI.conclusion: SwarmBench为Agent Swarms的系统性评测提供了多维度基准框架，SwarmExp则展示了一种简单有效且可迁移的编排能力提升路径，为动态多智能体编排研究奠定了基础。

title: MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations Track. 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: This paper presents Murano, an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models, intended for researchers across disciplines. These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano represents operations from these five areas as composable steps. Steps exchange named result artifacts and declare the inputs they require and the outputs they produce. A pipeline executes its steps in the order supplied, and Murano uses canonical addresses when component identities pass between operations. Murano builds on existing interpretability and machine learning libraries. We demonstrate Murano through two reproductions of established interpretability studies and one illustrative sparse autoencoder case study.

AI.tldr: Murano是一个开源框架，用于设计、运行和复现大型语言模型的机制可解释性研究。它把加载、记录、归因、干预和评估这五个环节抽象为可组合的步骤，步骤之间通过命名结果工件交换数据，并使用规范地址传递组件身份，从而弥合现有工具库之间的适配鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现存的机制可解释性研究往往涉及加载、记录、归因、干预和评估等多个环节，但现有库通常只专注于流程的某一部分，导致研究人员跨库使用时需要手工适配不同库的输出格式，缺乏统一的工具链支撑。
AI.method: Murano将五个研究环节表示为可组合的步骤，每个步骤声明其所需输入和产生的输出，步骤间通过命名结果工件交换数据；使用规范地址在操作间传递组件身份；建立在现有可解释性和机器学习库的基础之上，按给定顺序执行流水线。
AI.result: 通过两个已建立的可解释性研究的复现以及一个稀疏自编码器的示例案例研究来展示Murano的可用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: Murano为跨学科研究人员提供了统一、可复现的机制可解释性研究框架，解决了现有工具碎片化的问题，降低了研究的复现门槛。

title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding
summary: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了OCR-MetaReasoning基准，一个受控的单图像基准，将演绎、归纳、溯因作为三种不同的推理方向来评估多模态大语言模型在文本丰富图像理解中的元推理能力，包含1500个样本和两个新评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有评估往往将OCR提取与推理混为一谈，很少检验模型是否遵循所需的推理方向（应用可见规则、抽象隐藏规律或恢复缺失前提），缺乏对文本图像理解中元推理能力的系统性评测。
AI.method: 构建了一个3×5平衡分类体系的基准（三种推理类型×五类OCR对象），提供参考推理步骤、自动答案评分、MRMS和RPCS两个评估指标，并对闭源和开源MLLM进行实验。
AI.result: 代表性闭源和开源MLLM在OCR-grounded元推理上远未饱和：模型在可见规则应用和布局敏感推理上表现困难，且在精确匹配评估下，符合推理过程的rationale可能伴随错误的最终答案。
AI.conclusion: OCR元推理仍是一个开放挑战，现有MLLM在推理方向遵循和推理过程合规方面存在显著不足，该基准为此提供了可控的评测工具。

title: LCoT-GV: Graph Attention Networks for Verifying Long Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models
comment: 6 pages without references, 2 tables, 1 algorithm, 1 figure
summary: Large Reasoning Models produce Long Chains-of-Thought (LCoTs) which involve breaking down the problem into smaller reasoning steps before reaching the conclusion. However, these steps often contain contradictions, unsupported inferences, or irrelevant steps, even when the final answer is correct. We propose Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier (LCoT-GV), a graph-based framework that represents LCoTs as reasoning graphs. Each node in the graph represents a reasoning step and the edges encode semantic and logical relations. A Graph Attention Network is then trained to predict chain-of-thought correctness from the reasoning graph. We construct a new graph-oriented verification dataset from multiple reasoning benchmarks for question answering in various domains. The results show that our method is competitive with the most similar approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LCoT-GV，一个基于图注意力网络的框架，将大推理模型生成的长思维链（LCoT）表示为推理图，每个节点是推理步骤，边编码语义和逻辑关系，通过图神经网络预测思维链的正确性。作者从多个问答推理基准构建了图导向的验证数据集，实验结果表明该方法与最相似的方法表现相当。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型产生长思维链（LCoT），但这些思维链即使最终答案正确，也常包含矛盾、无依据的推断或无关步骤。现有方法缺乏对推理过程中间步骤质量的系统性验证，因此需要一种能显式建模推理步骤间语义和逻辑关系的验证框架。
AI.method: LCoT-GV将长思维链构建为推理图：节点表示推理步骤，边编码步骤间的语义和逻辑关系；使用图注意力网络（GAT）训练预测思维链的正确性；从多个问答推理基准构建新的图导向验证数据集。
AI.result: 在多个领域的问答推理基准上，LCoT-GV方法的性能与最相似的现有方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 图结构能够有效捕获长思维链中推理步骤之间的语义和逻辑关系，为验证大推理模型输出的正确性提供了可行的方案，但方法仍需进一步提升以超越现有方法。

title: An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an \emph{Escherichia coli} chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches $65\pm1$\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches $78\pm1$\% versus 75\% on LASER, $88\pm3$\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and $63\pm2$\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. Fine-tuning also consistently outperforms direct prompting. These results show that route-supervised frontier selection can improve budgeted search without altering biochemical generation, although performance remains dependent on frontier construction and reaction ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型作为多步逆生物合成搜索策略的独立贡献，通过规则驱动的确定性生化引擎生成相同的验证转换，仅让策略选择下一步扩展的前沿分子。实验表明，LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B策略在多种基准上超越MCTS和直接提示方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被用于多步逆合成代理，但尚不清楚其搜索策略的贡献是否独立于底层反应模型。作者希望在生物合成场景中分离策略与反应生成的作用，避免混淆因素。
AI.method: 使用规则驱动的逆生物合成引擎（确定性生成相同验证转换），策略仅负责选择下一个要扩展的前沿分子（严格choice-only接口）。采用Prompted和LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B策略，在LASER、RetroPath RL Golden和BioNavi-NP基准上评估，终止条件为找到通向大肠杆菌底盘代谢物的路线。
AI.result: 微调策略在10次扩展时达到65±1%解决率（LASER），优于MCTS的59%；200次扩展时在LASER达到78±1% vs 75%，RetroPath RL Golden达到88±3% vs 80%，BioNavi-NP达到63±2% vs 45%。微调始终优于直接提示。
AI.conclusion: 路线监督的前沿选择可以改进预算受限搜索，无需改变生化生成过程，证明LLM策略在逆生物合成中有独立价值。但性能仍依赖于前沿构建和反应排序，存在依赖局限性。

title: GUIDE: Guiding Internal Evidence with Language Instructions
summary: Large multimodal models follow instructions about what to generate, but not necessarily about what evidence to rely on. Hence, models may continue to depend on shortcut-associated cues even when instructions suggest otherwise. We introduce GUIDE, a framework for controlling internal evidence usage through language instructions. GUIDE combines grouped parameter-efficient adaptation with instruction-conditioned gating to modulate multimodal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation. We further introduce a pathway-level evaluation framework that characterizes instruction-conditioned evidence modulation through reliance sensitivity, controlled perturbation analysis, pathway modulation, and autoregressive decoding dynamics. Across multimodal reasoning, classification, and generation, GUIDE induces structured and instruction-aligned redistribution of evidence reliance while largely preserving task behavior. Experiments on GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and Flickr30K show that GUIDE improves robustness under targeted evidence perturbations and enables controllable modulation across diverse multimodal settings. This suggests that multimodal instruction following can extend beyond output control toward regulating how different evidence sources contribute to model predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GUIDE框架，通过将参数高效适配与指令条件门控相结合，实现对多模态大模型内部证据使用路径的语言指令控制，使模型在推理和生成过程中能够根据指令调整依赖的证据来源，而不仅限于控制输出内容。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型虽然能遵循指令控制"生成什么"，但无法控制"依赖什么证据"。模型在推理时可能继续依赖捷径关联线索（shortcut-associated cues），即使指令提示应使用其他证据。这限制了模型在证据扰动下的鲁棒性和可控性。
AI.method: GUIDE框架包含两个核心组件：1）分组参数高效适配（grouped parameter-efficient adaptation），用于调整不同模态的证据路径；2）指令条件门控（instruction-conditioned gating），根据语言指令动态调控多模态证据通路。同时提出路径级评估框架，通过依赖敏感性、受控扰动分析、路径调制和自回归解码动态来表征证据调制效果。
AI.result: 在GQA、TextVQA、MM-IMDb、CREMA-D、RAVESS和Flickr30K等数据集上，GUIDE在多种多模态推理、分类和生成任务中实现了结构化且与指令一致（instruction-aligned）的证据依赖重分配，同时基本保持任务行为不变，并在目标证据扰动下显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 多模态指令跟随可以超越输出控制层面，延伸至调控不同证据源对模型预测的贡献机制，这为多模态模型的证据可解释性和可控推理开辟了新方向。

title: SocialReasonBench: A Video-QA Benchmark for Social Reasoning with Counterfactual Narrative Videos
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables
summary: Recent advances in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have greatly improved video understanding, yet their ability to reason about human-centered social situations remains limited. Existing benchmarks typically rely on videos with a single observed trajectory, making it difficult to determine whether models truly understand social dynamics or merely exploit recurring narrative patterns. We introduce SocialReasonBench, a video multiple-choice QA benchmark for evaluating socially grounded reasoning in scenarios derived from interactive narratives. Built from gameplay videos of Detroit: Become Human, the benchmark leverages branching storylines where player decisions lead to alternative social outcomes that can be checked against the game's own script, flowchart, and recorded branches. We develop a multi-agent curation pipeline that localizes socially meaningful clips, grounds answer labels in game-state signals, and generates theory-guided questions with diagnostic distractors. SocialReasonBench covers seven reasoning dimensions, including intent recognition, emotional empathy, moral dilemma, counterfactual reasoning, and causal antecedent. Experiments on contemporary LMMs show that models perform reasonably well on basic social understanding but struggle with counterfactual and causal reasoning. Further ablation and diagnostic error analyses reveal that models often depend on incomplete modality cues and fall into reasoning traps such as visual shortcuts, highlighting a gap between observable event recognition and deeper reasoning over latent social states.

AI.tldr: 提出SocialReasonBench，一个基于游戏《底特律：变人》分支叙事构建的视频多项选择问答基准，用于评估大型多模态模型在社交推理（如意图识别、共情、道德困境、反事实推理等）上的能力。实验发现现有模型在基础社交理解上表现尚可，但在反事实和因果推理上明显不足，且常依赖视觉捷径等推理陷阱。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频理解基准通常只包含单一观测轨迹，难以判断模型是真正理解社交动态还是仅利用了重复的叙事模式。需要一个新的基准来评估模型对以人为中心的社交情境的深层推理能力。
AI.method: 从《底特律：变人》游戏视频构建基准，利用其分支叙事结构（玩家决策导致不同社交结果），通过与游戏脚本、流程图和录制分支交叉验证答案。采用多智能体策展流水线：定位社交相关片段、基于游戏状态信号标注答案、生成理论驱动的问题及诊断性干扰项。涵盖七个推理维度。
AI.result: 当代LMM在基础社交理解方面表现合理，但在反事实和因果推理维度上表现挣扎。消融和诊断性错误分析显示，模型依赖不完整的模态线索，容易陷入视觉捷径等推理陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 模型在可观察事件识别与潜在社交状态深层推理之间存在明显差距，SocialReasonBench为这一差距提供了可靠的评估工具，可用于推动社交推理能力的发展。

title: Mind the Gap: Theory-of-Mind-Grounded Friction for Epistemic Alignment
summary: Productive dialogue alignment requires distinguishing \emph{surface coordination} (acknowledgments and smooth task progression) from \emph{epistemic alignment} (convergence of belief states); standard preference-based methods typically optimize response-level preferences without explicitly modeling the latter. We operationalize Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference as a control signal within Frictive Policy Optimization by extracting, at each referring expression, a four-part belief structure: the speaker's intended referent, the addressee's interpretation, and each participant's model of the other's belief. This makes friction mechanically computable from epistemic-state comparisons, capturing \emph{silent divergence}, where both participants proceed confidently while grounding to different referents. We evaluate the signal at two levels. At the representation level, ablating the second-order channel reduces misunderstanding recall from $65\%$ to $26\%$. At the policy level, reward-shaping (FAR) and trust-region (FTR) variants improve intervention F1 and warranted-context calibration over DPO, with Brier scores independently supporting the calibration gains. Across three training runs, FAR and FTR remain substantially more stable, whereas DPO varies widely and can degrade intervention competence already present in the base policy. Thus, ToM-grounded friction provides a trainable signal for context-sensitive intervention under referential belief divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将心智理论（ToM）推理作为控制信号，通过Frictive Policy Optimization区分表面协调与认知对齐，在指称表达中提取四部分信念结构，使摩擦可通过认知状态比较机械计算，从而捕捉静默分歧。FAR和FTR变体在干预F1和校准上优于DPO，且训练更稳定。
AI.motivation: 标准基于偏好的方法通常只优化响应级偏好，未显式建模认知对齐（信念状态的收敛），无法区分表面协调（如确认和任务平滑推进）与真正的认知对齐，也难以捕捉双方自信地指向不同指称物的静默分歧。
AI.method: 将ToM推理操作化为Frictive Policy Optimization中的控制信号，在每个指称表达处提取四部分信念结构：说话者意图的指称物、受话者的解读、以及每个参与者对对方信念的模型。通过认知状态比较使摩擦机械可计算。提出FAR（奖励塑形）和FTR（信任域）两种变体。
AI.result: 表示层面：消融二阶通道使误解召回率从65%降至26%。策略层面：FAR和FTR在干预F1和校准上优于DPO，Brier分数独立支持校准增益。三次训练中FAR和FTR保持稳定，而DPO波动大且可能退化基础策略已有的干预能力。
AI.conclusion: ToM驱动的摩擦为指称信念分歧下的上下文敏感干预提供了可训练信号，在性能、校准和稳定性方面均优于标准偏好优化方法。

title: Where Do Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders Fail on Low-Resource Languages?
summary: Recent multilingual vision--language encoders cover hundreds of languages in a single model, yet on two state-of-the-art instances retrieval on low-resource languages (LRL; e.g. Swahili) trails high-resource ones (HRL; e.g. English) by $30^+$\,pp. We ask where in the trained encoder this gap is located. Prior modality-gap and cross-lingual subspace work suggests a linear language direction at the output crowds out alignment-relevant geometry. We falsify this: LEACE drives the linear language classifier from $>99\%$ to near chance and iterated INLP to $37$--$50\%$ while LRL retrieval moves within $\pm 1.5$\,pp and all tier means within $2.2$\,pp, tracking random controls. The linear bias is a \emph{symptom}, not the cause. Instead, the alignment-causal factor lies along the encoder's forward path: the EOS (end-of-sequence) hidden state's per-language trajectory diverges with depth. Substituting the EOS with its parallel English value three blocks before the projector lifts Swahili from $22.1\%$ to $69.1\%$ on one encoder (and reproduces on the other); three controls rule out pooled-position tautology and English specificity. A front-layer trunk that pulls each language's projection toward the parallel-content centroid corroborates the diagnosis at training time, recovering $+9.6$ / $+17.1$\,pp on LRL XM3600 retrieval (1{,}000-image subset), with consistent gains across three further benchmarks while preserving HRL performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言视觉-语言编码器中低资源语言（LRL）检索性能远低于高资源语言（HRL）的原因。通过LEACE和INLP实验，作者否定了"线性语言方向挤压对齐几何"的假设，证明线性偏置只是症状而非原因。真正的因果因素在于编码器前向路径中EOS隐藏状态的语言轨迹随深度发散。将EOS替换为平行英语值可大幅提升LRL检索性能，并提出了前置层主干修正方法，在不损害HRL性能的前提下显著改善LRL检索。
AI.motivation: 多语言视觉-语言编码器虽然在单一模型中覆盖数百种语言，但低资源语言（如斯瓦希里语）的检索性能比高资源语言（如英语）低30个百分点以上。作者希望定位训练后编码器中这种性能差距的确切位置，从而理解其根本原因。
AI.method: 作者通过因果干预实验验证假设：1）使用LEACE消除线性语言方向，将语言分类器准确率从>99%降至接近随机水平，用INLP迭代降至37-50%，但LRL检索性能几乎不变（±1.5pp），从而证伪了线性偏置假设。2）沿着编码器前向路径追踪，发现EOS隐藏状态的语言轨迹随深度发散是真正因果因素。3）将EOS替换为平行英语值，使斯瓦希里语检索从22.1%提升至69.1%。4）提出前置层主干方法，使各语言投影向平行内容质心靠拢，LRL检索提升+9.6/+17.1pp。
AI.result: 1）LEACE和INLP消除了线性语言分类器但无法改善LRL检索，证明线性偏置不是原因。2）EOS替换实验将斯瓦希里语从22.1%提升至69.1%，并在两个编码器上验证。3）三个对照组排除了池化位置同义反复和英语特异性。4）前置层主干方法在XM3600上带来+9.6/+17.1pp的LRL收益，在三个额外基准上一致提升，且不损害HRL性能。
AI.conclusion: 线性语言方向偏置是症状而非原因，真正原因是EOS隐藏状态在编码器深处语言轨迹的发散。通过在训练时或推理时修正这一发散（替换为平行英语值或前置层主干方法），可以大幅恢复LRL对齐性能，同时保持HRL性能不受影响。

title: Calibrating Small Language Models for Claim Check-Worthiness Detection
summary: Assessing claim check-worthiness is an essential first step in automated fact-checking pipelines. This work is motivated by a real deployment challenge at an early-stage startup: running large language models (LLMs) over every incoming claim is cost- and latency-prohibitive, yet smaller models sacrifice accuracy. We propose NN-PPI, a pointwise extension of Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that calibrates model predictions at inference time as a lightweight post-hoc layer, without re-training the underlying model. NN-PPI achieves weighted F1 gains ranging from 12% to 33.80% depending on the size and performance of the baseline model, bringing SLMs on par with larger LLMs. Beyond few-shot SLMs, NN-PPI further improves a production-deployed fine-tuned model, demonstrating that residual calibration is complementary to supervised fine-tuning. By recovering LLM-level accuracy from models that are an order of magnitude cheaper to serve, it makes accurate check-worthiness detection substantially cheaper to operate at scale. Our code and data can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/arr-claim-worthiness-F237.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NN-PPI，一种基于Prediction-Powered Inference的点式扩展方法，在推理时对模型预测进行轻量级事后校准，无需重新训练底层模型，使小型语言模型（SLM）在检查价值性检测任务上达到大型语言模型（LLM）的精度水平，同时显著降低部署成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 在自动化事实核查流程中，检查价值性评估是首要步骤。初创公司在实际部署中面临两难：对每条传入声明都运行LLM成本过高且延迟过大，而使用更小的模型又会牺牲准确性。因此需要一种既能保持精度又能控制成本的方法。
AI.method: 提出NN-PPI，即Pointwise Prediction-Powered Inference，作为PPI的点式扩展。它在推理时作为轻量级事后校准层，对模型预测进行校准，无需重新训练底层模型即可提升预测质量。
AI.result: 加权F1分数提升12%至33.80%（视基线模型大小和性能而定），使小型语言模型达到与大型LLM同等的性能。此外，该方法对生产环境中已微调的模型也有进一步改进，证明残差校准与监督微调互补。
AI.conclusion: NN-PPI能够从部署成本低一个数量级的模型中恢复LLM级别的精度，使大规模检查价值性检测的成本大幅降低，为实际部署提供了实用且经济的解决方案。

title: Not All Fallbacks Are Failures: Understanding and Recovering from Fallbacks in Mobile Voice Assistants
summary: Robust understanding of user input is a core requirement for voice assistants deployed in real-world environments. In practice, these systems encounter heterogeneous fallback situations caused by noisy audio input, transcription errors, ambiguous requests, incomplete utterances, or unintended activations. Existing systems typically respond with generic fallback messages, which do not resolve the underlying interaction failure and can degrade user experience. We study fallback handling in a deployed smartwatch-based voice assistant for general health support in everyday environments. Our analysis is based on six months of real-world usage data from more than 500 users, yielding a dataset of 3,030 anonymized, naturally occurring fallback-triggering utterances. We contribute (1) an operational taxonomy and the annotated VoxFallbacks dataset of these interactions, (2) a comparative evaluation of different models within a classification pipeline under practical deployment constraints, and (3) practical lessons for designing robust and cost-efficient fallback mechanisms. Results show that lightweight embedding-based classifiers outperform larger generative models on most classification tasks while requiring substantially fewer computational resources.

AI.tldr: 本文研究部署在真实环境中的智能手表语音助手在遇到用户输入失败（回退场景）时如何处理。基于500多名用户六个月的3,030条真实回退触发话语数据，提出了操作分类法（VoxFallbacks数据集），对比了不同模型在部署约束下的分类性能，发现轻量级嵌入式分类器在多数任务上优于大型生成模型且资源消耗更少。
AI.motivation: 现有语音助手面对噪声、转写错误、歧义请求等异构回退场景时通常给出通用回退消息，无法解决潜在的交互失败并损害用户体验。缺乏对真实环境中回退处理的系统性研究和数据支撑。
AI.method: 从部署的智能手表健康语音助手中收集六个月的3,030条匿名化真实回退触发话语，构建操作分类法和标注数据集VoxFallbacks；在分类流程中对比多种模型（轻量级嵌入分类器与大型生成模型）在实践部署约束下的表现。
AI.result: 轻量级嵌入分类器在大多数分类任务上优于大型生成模型，同时所需计算资源显著更少，更适合实际部署场景。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了真实环境回退处理的分类框架、数据集和部署经验，证明在受约束的真实部署条件下，轻量级方法可提供更优的鲁棒性与成本效益。

title: CLIN: an Objective Framework for Evaluating Creativity in Short Persian Literary Text
summary: Evaluating creativity in large language model (LLM) outputs remains challenging because creativity is multidimensional and human-centered. We examine how reliably LLMs evaluate short literary text in Persian, a low-resource language, across multiple evaluation strategies and prompt formulations. We find that LLM-human agreement varies substantially across dimensions: alignment is stronger for structured TTCT-derived properties such as Originality, Fluency, and Elaboration, but considerably weaker for more subjective dimensions, particularly Emotion and Attractiveness. Judgments are also sensitive to prompt formulation, while few-shot prompting, ensembling, and multi-agent debate provide no consistent improvement. Motivated by this dimension-dependent behavior, we investigate whether structured creativity dimensions can instead be approximated using simple, interpretable proxy metrics. We introduce CLIN, which evaluates three TTCT-derived dimensions separately using topic-aware novelty for Originality, contextual lexical clustering for Fluency, and lexical diversity for Elaboration. These proxies achieve human alignment comparable to or better than the strongest zero-shot LLM judge in our setting while requiring substantially lower evaluation cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在波斯语（低资源语言）短文本创作性评估中的可靠性。研究发现LLM与人类评估的一致性因维度而异：结构化TTCT维度（原创性、流畅性、详尽性）一致性较强，而主观维度（情感、吸引力）一致性较弱。为此提出CLIN方法，用可解释的代理指标（主题感知新颖性、上下文词汇聚类、词汇多样性）分别评估三个TTCT维度，在评估成本大幅降低的同时达到或超过最强零样本LLM法官的一致性水平。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM生成的创造性文本仍然具有挑战性，因为创造性是多维度且以人为中心的。特别是在波斯语等低资源语言中，LLM评估创造性的可靠性尚未得到充分研究。作者希望系统性地考察LLM在不同评估策略和提示形式下评估短文学文本的能力，并探索更简单、可解释的替代方案。
AI.method: 首先，作者在波斯语短文学文本上比较了多种LLM评估策略（不同提示形式、少样本提示、集成、多智能体辩论）与人类评估的一致性。其次，基于维度依赖行为的发现，提出了CLIN方法，使用三种可解释的代理指标分别近似三个TTCT衍生维度：用主题感知新颖性衡量原创性、用上下文词汇聚类衡量流畅性、用词汇多样性衡量详尽性。
AI.result: 研究发现：LLM与人类评估的一致性因维度而异，结构化维度（原创性、流畅性、详尽性）一致性更强，而主观维度（情感、吸引力）较弱；提示形式对判断有显著影响；少样本提示、集成和多智能体辩论并未带来一致的改进。CLIN代理指标在人类对齐方面达到或超过最强的零样本LLM评估器，同时显著降低了评估成本。
AI.conclusion: LLM对创造性的评估是维度依赖的，不能一概而论。对于结构化创造维度，简单可解释的代理指标（如CLIN）可能比复杂的LLM评估方案更具成本效益和可靠性，这为低资源语言环境下的创造性评估提供了一种实用的替代方案。

title: TopoCompress: Long Context Compression via Graph-Wired Semantic Trajectories
summary: Long-context compression is essential for reducing the cost and latency of large language model inference. However, existing methods can fragment important evidence, require additional training or alignment, and often depend on the target model for effective compression. We introduce TopoCompress, a training-free and model-agnostic framework that compresses long contexts by selecting coherent semantic spans. TopoCompress first scores each span using dense and lexical query relevance together with semantic acceleration. It then constructs a hybrid graph that connects spans based on semantic similarity and sequential adjacency, and propagates the query-guided relevance scores over the graph. Across five long-context tasks-HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, Qasper, and MultiFieldQA-en-TopoCompress consistently outperforms strong compression baselines. Notably, TopoCompress achieves performance comparable to the strongest baseline while using a 4x smaller compression budget, and provides a 1.41x smaller compression time over the fastest baseline.

AI.tldr: TopoCompress是一个无需训练、模型无关的长上下文压缩框架，通过选择连贯的语义片段并在混合图上传播查询引导的相关性分数来实现高效压缩，在五个长上下文任务上优于强基线，且压缩预算更小、速度更快。
AI.motivation: 长上下文压缩对降低大语言模型推理的成本和延迟至关重要。然而现有方法存在碎片化重要证据、需要额外训练或对齐、依赖目标模型进行有效压缩等问题。
AI.method: TopoCompress首先使用密集和词法查询相关性以及语义加速对每个片段打分，然后构建一个基于语义相似性和顺序相邻性连接片段的混合图，并在图上传播查询引导的相关性分数。
AI.result: 在五个长上下文任务（HotpotQA、2WikiMQA、MuSiQue、Qasper和MultiFieldQA-en）上，TopoCompress持续优于强压缩基线。它用4倍小的压缩预算达到与最强基线相当的性能，并且压缩时间比最快基线快1.41倍。
AI.conclusion: TopoCompress通过图传播的方式选择语义连贯的片段，成功实现了高效、无需训练且模型无关的长上下文压缩，在性能和效率上均有显著优势。

title: Error-Type-Aware Loss Reweighting for Robust Named Entity Recognition with Noisy LLM Labels
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to annotate datasets for training smaller, task-specialized models such as named entity recognition. While this method yields effective models, it assumes that the synthetic dataset is correctly annotated. In this work, we find that (i) current fine-tuning processes simply ignore LLM-introduced annotation noise, resulting in degraded performance and (ii) existing noise-robust losses are not transferable to sequence labeling because annotation noise in named entity recognition is heterogeneous: for example, missing mentions and type errors affect the training signal in different ways. Treating all noisy tokens equally in noise-robust losses and applying a single reweighing criterion for all may therefore remove useful supervision or reinforce incorrect labels. To address this limitation, we propose error-type-aware loss reweighting for NER, which introduces separate reweighing rules for different types of potentially erroneous tokens. Our approach is simple and efficient, does not require additional training resources, and improves F1 by 0.8 - 2.0 percentage points on dataset-level average for noise levels between 15% and 40%, with a maximum improvement of 4.6 percentage points with 24.1% noise on Wikigold.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有LLM标注NER数据集的微调过程会忽略标注噪声导致性能下降，并提出一种错误类型感知的损失重加权方法，针对不同错误类型（如漏标、类型错误）采用不同重加权规则，在15%-40%噪声水平下平均提升F1 0.8-2.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用于为NER等任务标注训练数据，但现有微调过程假设合成数据集标注正确，实际中LLM引入的标注噪声会被忽略。此外，现有的噪声鲁棒损失函数不适用于序列标注任务，因为NER的标注噪声是异质的——漏标和类型错误对训练信号的影响不同，统一对待所有噪声token会要么移除有用监督信号，要么强化错误标签。
AI.method: 提出错误类型感知的损失重加权方法（error-type-aware loss reweighting），针对不同类型的潜在错误token设计分离的重加权规则，而非对所有噪声token一视同仁。该方法简单高效，不需要额外训练资源。
AI.result: 在15%-40%噪声水平下，数据集平均F1提升0.8-2.0个百分点；在Wikigold数据集上，当噪声为24.1%时最大提升达4.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 错误类型感知的损失重加权方法能够有效处理LLM标注NER数据中的异质噪声，相比现有统一处理的噪声鲁棒方法有显著性能优势，且实现简单、不增加训练成本。

title: Opinionated, Hesitant and Stressed: Three Studies of How Politicians Speak in Four Slavic Parliaments
